This pure clash of willpower, even if one had lots of strength and power, it wouldn’t help this situation at all.

“I definitely must win!”

“I definitely can win, this killing intent cannot defeat me, it cannot get through!” Luo Feng’s willpower roared.

Time and again, persevering…

Suddenly, the originally incredibly fierce killing intent backed away like a river, swiftly retracting,. Simultaneously the blood river crystal lying in the golden horned beast’s right claw began to flow with blood river energy, the energy continuously entered the right claw, once again changing the beast’s terrifying right claw.

The pain, once again attacked!

One could only imagine the amount of pain the 99th crystal brought with it, it caused the golden horned beast to madly clash against the land, tearing through the mountain ranges, however painful…it could only bear with it.

Finally, the pain subsided.

The 99th crystal had completely fused with its right claw.

Howl…The golden horned beast raised its head and howled happily, its howl reverberating throughout the endless internal world.

It slightly raised its right claw, triggering the powerful blood river crystal within it and immediately the claw began to undergo a change, its bones, scales and muscles etc, up to the finest of its cells began to evolve from within, it immediately formed the dark gold claw and on it were many little complex blood red engravings.

The engravings covered the entire right claw, they joined to form a picture, one of a beast howling.

Before, when he successfully absorbed the 98th crystal, the right claw’s blood red engraving picture that appeared didn’t at all look like this beast howling, however when the 99th went through, it added up to a hundred other engravings that combined and made the originally scattered engravings much more complete than before.

The engravings formed a complete beast, a lot like the beast of the beast god statue.

It doesn’t have the single horn like the beast god statue! And because it’s missing the horn…it looks like this blood red engraving picture is yet to be complete.

Within the plaza.

Sou!

In the vast cold deep abyss world, no matter which direction he looked, it seemed endless, it was littered with endless beasts, and the number of beasts was simply unbelievable.”

“How…how do I get out?” Ice bear Luo Feng was stunned.

Ever since Xi Luo Duo had left this statue here, over the generations, there’s been countless warriors coming here to study it. Even great human beings have come here, like some universe knights and country leaders, yet none have comprehended this beast god statue.

Luo Feng pondered there, and in an instant, over 3 months had passed.

Spreading one’s attacking technique into hundreds of thousands of little blades, and arranging each and every one of them.

Finally reaching a level of satisfaction.

After which, combining them with the laws themselves, and engraving the required laws within, that way, one didn’t need to work so hard when unleashing his move, he just simply needed to trigger them.

Of course.

Luo feng had ordered 3 infant Star eating plants.

Star eating plant: a very special plant life form that was born in the universe. It could be produced on a normal mineral planet. But as it grew, it would swallow the planet’s metals, minerals and rocks etc. Normal minerals on the planet were usually enough to let it evolve to universe level, and the mineral planet later collapse and the plant would begin to wander the galaxy with the large amounts of asteroids.

While wandering the universe, it may swallow other special metals and stones, plant life forms etc, evolving further.

The plant life forms could be divided into many types.

Like those for defense, or attack, or both, along with others. As there were many many types of plants…their abilities were also countless, even to the point where some plants could produce other living things, while others acted like trees and stayed rooted to the spot. Transplanting them had to be done carefully, not all of them could be moved about like the cloud contact vine.

In all, there were many types with countless abilities.

The most suited was best.

Star eating plant: It was named the most sturdy attacking type plant, what ‘most sturdy’ refers to is only within the plants humanity sells. There are other special and mysterious types of plants in the vast universe that cannot be bought. The star eating plant enjoys swallowing rocks, metal, trees etc, it will make it even sturdier.

Its attack method is very simple.

Just one move, entangle and kill!

The cloud contact vine and star eating plant were very different. The cloud contact vine was mainly for defense, and it’s attacking ability was but average.

The star eating plant however is even more expensive than the cloud contact vine. One without position or an avenue…wouldn’t even be able to buy an infant star eating plant! This was because it was the ‘most sturdy’ attacking type plant, hence it was an extremely good assisting life form, during a battle…

It’s countless vines could wrap about an opponent, as long as it affected the enemy’s speed and attack, the battle outcome could be changed!

The only ability of entangling and killing, had given it the title of most sturdy attacking plant life form, leading to it being in high demand.

3 infant star eating plants, they cost Luo feng close to 900,000 mixed elements.

Of course the infant stage was all the same, the nurturing later on would make them different.

Just like the cloud contact vine, the sector lord weakest had 36 vines, and the strongest with 360 vines. Luo Feng’s sector lord cloud contact vine had 216 vines, it was more than 10 times harder for his to breakthrough to undying.

The star eating plant, was more expensive than the cloud contact vine.

Of which at sector lord level, the weakest would have 10 vines, the strongest would have 1,000 vines.

“Star eating plant!” Luo Feng looked at the 3 infant plants, smiling.

The 3 star eating plants, plus the huge amount of material to nurture the plants had filled up the entire world ring. All of them added together had come up to close to 2 million mixed elements! Without enough wealth, how could one even begin to dwell on it?

Virtual universe Yu Xiang mountain primal region.

And the body’s universe limit was a 100 times! Whether it was through techniques or any other method, the highest was still 100 times.

Same theory.

The spirit energy amplitude had a universe limit of 100 times! Luo Feng’s however could reach over 3,200…and as the perfect form was only 100, his was over 32 times that. And according to what he deduced…the final goal of the demon note inheritance was probably 100 times amplitude!

100 times, this was the universe limit.

There was no way to exceed that!

Completing the Deities of the world would increase one’s amplitude to 36 times, and according to Luo Feng’s inherited memories, other than the 1 golden horned beast that created deities of the world back then, the other generations of beasts never ever completed the 3rd level. Amplitude of 36 times, it was extremely tough.

The 2nd, 4 times.

The 3rd, 8 times.

The 6th, 64 times!

…

Demon note inheritance, many emperor level undyings would go receive the inheritance. Even with such an encounter, many were unable to complete even the 1st level! Those without such an encounter would naturally be even weaker.

10,000 soul control technique, it’s pinnacle 10,000 control required one’s spirit energy amplitude to reach 10,000, (100 times). However, even the creator of the technique never completed it, it was but an imagination.

The demon note inheritance had stayed in demon note mountain for a countless amount of time.

Hard!

Extremely tough!

The universe limit had held back Xi Luo Duo, the creator of the 10,000 soul control and other countless absolute beings.

And Luo Feng’s golden horned beast body.

It’s true amplifying techniques were Deities of the world and its natural ability strengthen. Of which, deities of the world could amplify his strength 5 times, and strengthen could raise it only 2 times. Hence, using those alone, he could raise his golden horned beast’s strength by only 10 times.

“Master, creating 1 sector lord pinnacle tiger armored king, has the cost of creating 100 sector lord pinnacle normal tiger armored bugs.” Alina said, “The king’s body is incredibly tough, his strength and attacks are about 10 times that of a normal tiger armored bugs.” She said.

If the million strong tiger armored bug army, battled against a 10,000 tiger armored king army.

The million strong army would definitely win!

However…

One hundred million tiger armored bugs army, compared to a million strong king army, the million kings would definitely win. As it exceeds one million…with just Alina controlling everything, she wouldn’t be able to control so many soldiers.

“Master, you are sure you want to make them?” she asked.

“Hm.” Luo Feng nodded, “How long will it take?”

“Producing the kings will actually be faster.” She said. “As I can easily make endless streams of star and universe levels tiger armored bugs, the burden on me is actually less. It’ll take more time during their killing and massacre process, producing the many sector lord pinnacle tier armored kings! I can probably produce about 100 every day.”

“100 a day…The million strong army will take 30 years.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Thanks for your work Alina.” Luo Feng said.

“No trouble at all.” She said happily. “Producing soldiers is a way for the queen to strengthen herself, I’ve never had so many materials before for me to make so many soldiers.”

Luo Feng smiled, “The bug corpses will come in about half a month.”

The ship continued to progress, after half a month of flying, it finally reached Wu Long starfield.

“Wu Long starfield.”

Luo Feng stood within the control room, gazing at the endless vast goods that filled up the entire space. “Million sector lord king army! Also…Mysterious Silver armor! These two are extremely important in my plans, finally…they’ll be in my hands.”


Chapter 751: Wu Long Starfield

Wu Long starfield, Long Jue emperor’s palace.

At this time, the 5 managers of Wu Long starfield were gathered here.

“Life is so fickle, Luo Feng was so pitiful the last time he was bullied by Yan Zhu emperor. In the blink of an eye, only a few thousand years have passed.” Long Jue emperor shook his head. “The tables have turned now, Yan Zhu is now in the 9th jail hell, imprisoned for 1,000 eras, and Luo Feng is soaring, becoming the disciple of the primal chaos city leader.”

“Long Jue emperor, you’ll have to help us this time.” The skinny Da Nian emperor put down his wine glass. “The last time Yan Zhu treated Luo feng like that, we all didn’t even stop him. I’m afraid…he will remember it.”

“Hm.” Yin Ge emperor nodded too.

“Long Jue emperor, we’ll rely on you to persuade him.” Ceng Yu emperor said.

To be able to take on the position of manager here, it showed they all knew how to deal with people. They were clear on the fact that even though Luo Feng was still unable to do anything to them, and they were a different level of power with him at the moment. However what about the future? The way he’s growing, he may become the new Shi Huo knight!

The moment his strength grew, dealing with them would be easy.

Those petty and vengeful warriors, there were plenty of them.

“Haha…relax.” Long Jue emperor nodded and smiled. He was however proud within, him helping them out would mean they would owe him a favor.

“I’ll have to thank his majesty Luo Feng too.” Beside them sat a handsome man.

In terms of beauty, Yan Zhu back then was so beautiful it was hard to tell whether he was a man or lady.

This man however was easily distinguishable as a man.

“If it weren’t for him, I wouldn’t be here.” The man smiled.

“Haha Qi Li emperor, you’ll have to thank him.”

“Hm, indeed.”

“Otherwise, Yan Zhu wouldn’t be chased away so easily.”

the other 4 all laughed.

Suddenly…

“Lord, lord.” A silver armored sector lord rushed in from outside, kneeling respectfully, “His majesty Luo Feng has already arrived.”

“Luo Feng?” Long Jue and the others were shocked.

Hua.

The 5 got up simultaneously.

“Let’s go welcome him.” Da Nian Emperor said.

“Hm.”

The 5 managers rushed out, as they were clear on Luo Feng’s relationship with Long Jue emperor. They guessed that he would come here first, hence they had all gathered here to welcome him.

Outside the palace.

Luo Feng had already kept his Yun Mo planet ship and stood outside the entrance.

“Luo Feng.” A powerful voice resounded.

Luo Feng turned and saw 5 people approaching, smiling, “Long Jue emperor, ah, Da Nian emperor, Yin Ge emperor, Ceng Yu emperor too.” Even though he wasn’t vengeful against the other 3 emperors, he didn’t have a good impression of them. Back then when Yan Zhu wanted to jail him in the jail hell, the 3 simply stood there and did nothing to stop him.

“We knew that you were coming, so we’ve been waiting for you here.” The tall and skinny Da Nian emperor smiled.

“Ah.” Luo Feng nodded without saying anything else.

“Luo Feng, let me introduce you.” Long Jue emperor smiled and pointed to the handsome man beside him, “This is Qi Li emperor from the Huge Axe Dojo.”

“Qi Li emperor?” Luo Feng looked over.

Damn.

Another handsome fellow. Back then Yan Zhu had reached such a level of beauty, and even though this man before him wasn’t at that level, he was definitely a dashing guy.

“The emperors that the Huge Axe Dojo sends out, are they all handsome fellows?” Luo Feng muttered to himself.

“Greetings your majesty.” Qi Li smiled. “I just took on this position, haha, I really have to thank you for this. If it weren’t for your incident and Yan Zhu emperor being locked up in the 9th jail hell, I wouldn’t be here… Thank you your majesty.”

Luo feng immediately smiled, ah, looks like this Qi Li wasn’t on the same side as Yan Zhu.

“Luo feng, let’s go in, we can sit and discuss matters.” Long Jue emperor said.

“Go go go, let’s go in.”

“Your majesty, please.”

They were all incredibly passionate, as Luo feng showed them respect. With the 5 managers’ welcoming him, he entered the palace. This scene made all the sector lord guards about mutter amongst themselves…just who was this, able to make the 5 managers welcome him so passionately.

…

Within the palace.

A luxurious banquet was spread out as the 6 of them sat down.

“In the blink of an eye, 4,000 years had passed already. In the past, Luo Feng you were still a normal primal region member. Now, you’ve already become the primal chaos city leader’s disciple.” Long Jue emperor lifted his wine glass, “I respect you, come, let’s toast to that.”

“Damn.”

Everybody lifted their glasses, Luo Feng followed suit.

Bottoms up!

“Luo…” Long Jue emperor was about to say something when Luo feng smiled, “Long Jue emperor, we can discuss these later. I’m here at Wu Long starfield this time to purchase bug corpse units, naturally I want to go search for treasure too. Hence, we’ll discuss business first and settle the matters.”

“Alright, we’ll get to work.” Long Jue emperor nodded.

“We should get to work.”

“Business is more important.” The other managers all chimed in.

Luo Feng was shocked.

There was a saying on earth, “The poor are ignored in the busiest streets, the rich will find relatives in the deepest mountains” One theory, when one is weak, the emperors with power didn’t care about him at all, they were all either cold or arrogant before him, in all, they weren’t exactly smiling when they met him the first time.

However after he became the disciple of the primal chaos city leader, every word he said, they complied.

“Forget it.” Luo Feng’s dissatisfaction towards them within dissolved. “They are all in charge of business departments, they should be used to such matters.”

“Luo Feng, you purchased 10,000 sector lord pinnacle bug corpse units, since you’ve already ordered, then it’s simple.” Long Jue emperor smiled, “I’ll arrange for people to go to the storage area and bring over the 10,000 units. Ah, since the size of this deal is huge, it’ll have to go and discuss it with the other 4 managers.”

“No problem.”

“I will definitely pick the best 10,000 units for your majesty.”

“Relax.”

Qi Li emperor was still ok. The other 3 were obviously much more passionate than before, they were obviously trying to make amends for the actions before, since their goal was achieved, Luo Feng was pleased with the scene.

“How long will it take?” Luo Feng asked.

“Within 10 days.” Long Jue emperor said confidently.

“So fast?” Luo Feng was shocked.

The last time he bought 100 units, it took quite long. But this time it was 10,000 units, the time required however was shorter.

“I’ll arrange for 100 members to head straight to where the best units are kept.” Yin Ge emperor laughed. “Naturally it’ll be very fast. Your majesty just needs to rest here, and within 10 days you’ll receive your bug corpses.”

…

Within his 10 short days in Wu Long Starfield, the 5 emperors brainstormed and used all sorts of methods to make him happy and enjoy his stay. Luo Feng realized just how important strength and position was.

“Your majesty.” Long Jue emperor’s voice resounded within the entire palace.

Luo feng walked out.

Two maids stood by the entrance, in the distance, Long Jue emperor swiftly walked over, one step crossing over 1,000km.

“Long Jue emperor.” Luo Feng smiled, “What’s the matter, have the bug corpse units all been gathered?”

“Yes they have.” Long Jue emperor nodded and smiled. With a flip of his hand, a black world ring appeared, “10,000 bug corpse units all in here.”

“Ah?”

Luo Feng received it happily. This world ring was without an owner, hence he easily used his world energy to enter it and begin to check the 10,000 sector lord pinnacle bug corpse units. From the looks of it, Luo Feng couldn’t help but reveal a smile.

“Long Jue emperor, Da Nian emperor, Yin Ge emperor, they were are generous and straightforward.” Luo Feng was happy. “These 10,000 units, their average standard is even better than the 100 units I bought the last time.”

The last time he bought 100 sector lord units, he could produce about 1.8 million tiger armored bugs, it was already top tier. And ordering through the virtual universe network, he also roughly knew the standards. If he had ordered the shipment to be sent to him, the 100 units he bought would roughly produce 1 million bug soldiers.

That meant, that the 10,000 bug units he ordered would probably be able to produce 1 million tiger armored kings!

However, he was delightfully surprised…

He had come personally to choose, and the 10,000 units the 5 managers had given him, were enough to create 2 million tiger armored kings!

“Double the amount.”

“60 million points, yet I managed to buy 120 million points worth of goods.”

“These 5 managers sure have treated me well.” He was happy within. “Of course…this is the overall wealth of humanity, not their own money.”

If Da Nian emperor and the others were to foot the bill, they probably wouldn’t have been so generous.

Long Jue emperor saw the look of glee on Luo Feng’s face, he laughed loudly, “How is it, is it good enough?”

“Very good, these units are really good.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Some of the units are bad while others are good. This time, the other emperors have really worked hard to pick the best ones to send over.” Long Jue emperor smiled. “The 3 have actually been trying hard to make amends for matters from before, we hope you don’t take it to heart.”

“I understand, Yan zhu emperor has Shi Huo knight behind him, I understand their actions.” Luo Feng nodded and smiled, “I don’t blame them.”

“Haha, that’s good.” Long Jue emperor nodded.

After getting some benefit, it was sort of a payment for before, Luo Feng naturally didn’t hold it to heart.

“I remember you wanted to head to rubbish mountain.” Long Jue emperor asked. “How long are you prepared to search for treasure?”

“Not more than a hundred years.” Luo Feng said.

The aim of this time was to collect enough silver fragments to form a silver armor. According to his estimate, a few decades should be enough.

“Ah…Here are 100 world rings, every one of them represents you can hunt for treasure for a year.” With a flip of his hand, Long Jue emperor retrieved 100 world rings. “Also, I’ll send you a surveillance map, with your authority, you can view it. When the time comes, you can freely search for the treasures without needing anybody to follow you.”

Chapter 752: Silver Armor

Luo Feng received the 100 world rings. These sort of huge deals normally came with free chances to hunt for treasure. Buying 10,000 bug corpse units was 100 times that of the previous time, naturally he had 100 years to hunt for treasure.

“Searching about freely within Wu Long starfield would be much better.” Luo Feng smiled.

“Haha, connect to the virtual universe network.” Long Jue emperor said. “I will send the map to you, this has to pass the audit of the virtual universe system.”

“Hm.” Luo feng nodded.

The virtual universe system had many abilities, witnessing, audit etc.

Like the Universe 1st Bank, the Universe Galaxy Bank, the Universe Mercenary Alliance, the Huge Axe Dojo, they all had to use this virtual universe network. This made it so that Luo Feng could not help but exclaim again despite knowing how powerful it was.

…

After awhile, Luo Feng got the authority and the screen on his arm displayed the entire Wu long starfield map.

“Long Jue emperor, I’ll be heading out to hunt for treasure.” Luo Feng smiled.

“I hope you get a treasure.” Long Jue said.

“Haha…” Luo feng smiled, becoming a beam of light and leaving the palace.

Watching him leave, Long Jue couldn’t help but exclaim, “He’s actually wasting time by hunting for treasure? Hm, now that he’s sector lord level…he should be about to go through life or death training. But, before that, he probably wants to relax a little by hunting for treasure. Pitiful punk, who knows whether he can survive the training.”

In history, there were simply too many absolute geniuses that had fallen during this period of training.

Without it, they would never truly become strong warriors.

Despite knowing of the dangers, humanity still sent their sector lord geniuses to go through these trials.

Wu Long starfield, the entire starfield was filled with countless remains from the inter race wars, all sorts of remains were lying around, naturally they were still neatly organized.

“I always had guides beside me the last time I searched for the fragments, it was so troublesome. This time is better…being alone, I can be free.” Luo feng sat in his universe ship and looked at the map on his arm screen. “Hm, there are so many white dots on the map, they should all be internal members. This red light…ah, the place I’m at also has a red dot, looks like it represents an outsider.”

Very quickly, Luo Feng understood the map system.

The authority required for the map system wasn’t exactly very high. One had to know that these internal members were all simply staff members, with Luo Feng’s current level of authority, it was easy for him to get it.

“Babata, we’ll stop here.”

“Understood.”

The Yun mo planet ship swiftly slowed down and stopped, returning to the actual universe.

Chi!

Wu Long starfield, a blood colored triangular ship stopped at one of the stop points.

“Hm?” Luo Feng flew out.

“Calling!”

Luo Feng could once again feel the calling. Turning into the distance, “That way, there are fragments there.”

With a flip of his hand, he kept the Yun Mo planet ship and flew swiftly in that direction. He accelerated and quickly reached light speed, flying at about 280,000 km per second.

…

Light speed was the limit of the actual universe, accelerating past that would send one straight into the dark universe, going through universe travel.

Undyings were all capable of doing that with their bodies alone.

Sector lords were mostly unable to do that. Normal sector lord pinnacle humans usually only reached up to 150,000 km per second, the main thing was their body structures weren’t strong enough. Hence, as they accelerate faster and faster, the burden on their bodies would increase! It would compound and get heavier on them.

The golden horned beast’s body was huge, it was able to go through universe travel with its body.

These are extremely rare!

Even after training in the nameless manual, Luo Feng’s body structure was 3 times stronger than that of a normal sector lord pinnacle, yet he still couldn’t do it. However, he had the soldier armor on him now. Back when he was domain lord pinnacle, he was unable to unleash its true strength, now however, he could do it.

The soldier armor could unleash 1,000 times that of a sector lord pinnacle strength.

In acceleration, this armor could withstand most of the burden, allowing him to easily reach 280,000 km per second, even reaching lightspeed…that wasn’t a hard thing.

“Haha, my luck is not bad.”

“Just from this trip, I’ve discovered 2 silver fragments.” Luo Feng stood within a rubbish mountain, filled with glee. He was happy, “The last time, it took 2 years for me to collect 232 black fragments and 12 silver fragments along with 1 shard. I was only able to assemble 2 full soldier armors.

Soldier armor, it was incredible.

It’s defense was strong, its strength was also incredible, and it also had some effect withstanding spirit energy attacks.

However, it’s ability to give an additional 1,000 sector lord pinnacles’ amount of strength, it was not bad for the golden horned beast back then, but after 1,200 years in primal chaos city, the current beast was much stronger than before…just one soldier armor didn’t do much for it.

One had to know the basic strength of the beast alone was 30 times that of a human (Normal golden horned beasts were 10 times that of humans, but training in the nameless manual, it became 30)!

With the blood river energy triggered, it was 11 times.

And with Deities of the world (7.5 times) and it’s natural ability Strengthen (2 times) it could raise its strength a total of 15 times!

In total, it added up to 4,950 times that of a sector lord’s strength! The reason it was so ridiculous was mainly due to the nameless manual and the blood river energy. Without these twothe beast would only be 150 times that of a human sector lord. It would have been only be a normal golden horned beast sector lord pinnacle level.

The blood river energy and the nameless manual allowed it’s body strength to increase a lot! The soldier armor’s effect…was naturally not as obvious.

Luo Feng stood within Wu Long starfield, almost like treasure hunting rat, searching within the mountains.

Searching for the silver fragments was incredibly tough. His efficiency was not bad at first, however as time went on…it began to decrease. Along the way, he had already collected a few other soldier armors. It was obviously much easier to find the black fragments, the main aim for him this time however was to get the silver fragments.

Luo Feng didn’t give up.

Actually, he had only sent out a thread of consciousness to search for treasures, the golden horned beast and mosha bodies were studying the 2nd level of the Nan shen 7 armaments.

Virtual universe, Black Dragon Mountain island, 9 star bay.

“Dad!”

“Dad!”

Luo Ping and Luo Hai shouted outside the door.

The 2 youths stepped in, even though they had lived for over 4,000 years, they hadn’t aged at all. Among the two of them, Luo Ping was much more poised, he was managing the entire family matters, he was the main authority within the family. Since, he was normally calm and collected, naturally the aura he gave off was so.

Luo Hai was the exact opposite, almost like an uncivilized bandit, his eyes burning with fighting spirit.

Two sons with two different characters.

“Hm.” Luo Feng smiled and nodded.

Collecting a full silver armor wasn’t easy,, he hadn’t succeeded yet.

What’s more, his plan was to collect 2!

“You?”

A strong spirit attack from the other races will easily kill you. Even I have to be extremely careful there, I won’t have a way to protect you at all. Just focus on your training, exploring within humanity’s territories. Don’t think about the outer region wars yet, when you reach sector lord pinnacle and you have the strength of an undying, then we’ll talk.”

“Ah.” Luo Hai drooped his head and replied, within the family, he feared nothing and was almost like a tyrant.

However, he truly feared his father.

“Calm down, “Luo Feng ordered. “You have resources many will never have, treasure them.”

“Understood dad.” Luo Hai replied.

The Luo Family was currently one of the biggest families in the Ganwu universe countries, naturally it had to have some backing. Back when earth was eyed by many knights and Luo Feng made the deal with the Virtual Universe Company, he placed about 10 million mixed elements worth of Luo Ke holy water within the family to nurture plant life forms.

10 million mixed elements worth of Luo Ke holy water, it was enough to nurture 100 sector lord level 9 plant life forms.

And he had plenty of it, this was but a small portion.

Of course, the family was still weak now. Without an undying within, Luo Feng didn’t dare leave too many treasures within the family. However, with the main location on earth, it was extremely safe.

“Dad?” Luo Ping looked curiously at him too.

“Good thing.” Luo Feng smiled.

Wu Long Starfield, within a rubbish mountain.

Fusion!

Rumble!

Chapter 879: Long Time

However, as he grew, it honed his mental state more.

However, as he absorbed more blood river crystals, the pain naturally grew more and more. Back then he had crumbled countless times from the pain, and over these thousands of years, his threshold grew more and more. Currently, the golden horned beast’s right claw and back had a total of 165 crystals!

“It’s easy.”

Even though his body shook slightly, he could still smile.

Luckily in terms of mental states, he had already reached the limit of Knowing oneself. Even though this was the lowest of the three levels, it simply represented where he was at. Like Innocence emphasized on coupling strength with gentleness and the highest level, Encompassing all included everything.

The three levels were explained as such. The first level was stupidly sticking to one’s self, without any skill, simply relying on force alone and perseverance. Almost like a stone against rushing waters, being honed over and over.

The second level had skill involved. Knowing when to be soft, and when to be hard, and eventually melding the two, naturally withstanding any force against it.

The third level was above them all.

However…

The only reason why the second and third levels were higher than the first, was simply because skill was involved and there was an amplifying effect.

The same soul willpower, comprehending Innocence and perfect fusion could withstand pressure and illusions, withstanding soul attacks at least ten to hundreds of times more. If one reached the level of Encompassing all, his ability to withstand all these would rise hundreds to thousands of times more again.

However, this fusion of the crystal had nothing to do with soft or hard, encompassing nothing. It was simply melding the crystal and the soul. All one had to do was to bear the pain! And at this time, the mental states were useless…it all depended on one’s perseverance and pain threshold!

This pain was from within the soul.

Not illusions or from external sources!

Ying Yang?

Encompassing all?

This pain was from within, and not from an attack, rather, true pain from the fusion of his soul with the crystal! Luo Feng had walked the limit of the first level all this while, constantly honing his self and forcefully bearing with pain. His mental state had long been honed to that of a diamond.

The star tower’s crystal gradually melded with his soul in an extremely slow manner. As the level of fusion grew gradually, the pain naturally followed suit!

1 year, 2 years, 3 years…10 years, 20, 30..

In the blink of an eye, 60 years had passed.

On the 61st year, the pain level had already doubled compared to before.

Luo Feng who was optimistic initially began to worry. “The speed of this pain growing is faster than expected. I could easily bear with it initially, but it’s grown so much in 60 years. If it keeps up this way…I don’t have any confidence in bearing with this for over 3,000 years.”

“What do I do?”

“Fall?”

Luo Feng pondered, his mind coming up with many mental state training methods.

From birth till today.

The first 200 years, his mental state training had been going pretty well. The later thousands of years…even though it had risen quite a lot over time, in terms of speed, it was much slower than before.

True. In nature and in virtue.

Honest, having an honest heart.

Heart pure and true, with no other distractions.

Knowing oneself and staying true to it, knowing one’s strength and absolute confidence! No matter what happens, one would always believe in oneself and not be shaken. However the growth of this path was the hardest, with no external factors, relying solely on willpower.

He was struggling! He couldn’t die that easily, even if he knew he would be revived eventually.

Pu Ti’s snake tail lay across the ground. He looked on at Luo Feng who could fall at any time. He understood that this youth was fighting with everything he had.

“You are impressive.”

“The first one lasted 2,600 years, while the second one lasted 3,300 years. Yet, you’ve been here over 6,000 years. It’s already very impressive, and you should be proud. “Star tower!”

“Why is this inheritance so hard?” He sighed, looking at the unconscious shivering and bleeding Luo Feng.

…

Luo Feng had a life changing event before, that was when he immolated his soul to fight the golden horned beast. During that time he was supposed to die too, he was willing to give it all up to kill the beast. Fate plays tricks on people, he didn’t expect to actually possess the beast and begin a whole new life.

He was the pride of the genius battle, the Ganwu universe investigator, the disciple of the Primal chaos city leader. He had massacred emperors till he got the name Blade River emperor… intrepid! Incredibly exciting!

Now he was at this point again.

This was the second life changing event.

If he succeeded, he would live on.

If he failed, he would fall.

…

His body unconsciously made cracking noises, as his expression was warped. His skin was torn apart, even more tragic than most dead people.

Live or die.

Luo Feng struggled on this thin fine line. The mad winds blew at him, blowing him towards the side of death, but his love and affection for his family made him fight hard to hold on, pulling himself to side of living.

However, every thought had its limit, and if the inheritance continued, his soul would continue to be torn up stronger than before!

“I wish…really wish…”

Luo Feng was like a person running on the highway being chased by the cars, running as fast as he could. However the traffic behind was speeding up and gradually catching up…

Finally they caught up!

Within the thousands of forbidden spaces in star tower, many undyings from all over were suddenly shocked.

“What’s going on?”

“Why are the forbidden spaces shaking?”

Rumble…

Almost like a giant who was shaking every space violently, the entire nine light year tall tower shook. However, with the nine whirlpools around, it was hard to tell. The countless undyings within all didn’t know what had happened.

Simultaneously, within an incredibly distant dangerous area, amidst vast energies, a lonely palace glowing with green light floated up.

The many underlings within were all knights.

He got up suddenly.

Sou!

Vanishing from sight.

What was two to three years before the thousands of years before?

Anyone would have known that the end was coming.

Even if he fought hard, with no more fuel left, he would naturally stop moving altogether.

And just earlier, that crystal had finally completely melded with his soul, the fusion was a success.

Fate decreed so!

Actually, if Luo Feng didn’t have such a sturdy heart, withstanding the pain for so long, the evolution wouldn’t even have happened 3,200 years ago. Without that evolution…no matter how strong he was, he wouldn’t have lasted another 3,000 years.

Even with that evolution.

If he didn’t hold on to his thought for close to 500 years…

This final moment! The final evolution!

Even with miracles, one needs hard work to create opportunities!

“Success.” Luo Feng opened his eyes, as his world energy shook off all the blood on his body. His eyes were incredibly fatigued and joyful. “I’ve succeeded, I’ve succeeded, I can return to you all…”

He was relaxed and gleeful.

The extreme fatigue on his soul overtook him and consumed his consciousness.

Rumble!

Luo Feng who had been sitting crossed legged all this while, even when death was upon him, suddenly fell and lay on the ground motionless. He had fallen into a deep sleep.

“He’s fallen asleep?”

“He actually fell asleep?” Pu Ti smiled at the scene, “It’s rare for a sector lord to fall asleep from fatigue.”

An undying would fall into a coma when they lost too much of their undying body.

And the moment a sector lord’s soul collapses, they die. Unless it was like Luo Feng’s condition where he forced too much out of his soul, far exceeding the limits of a sector lord’s soul. Hence he fell asleep right after succeeding. His soul itself was too tired, it required time to recover.

However, normally warriors who are able to unleash their soul strength were already considered not bad, much less exceeding its limits. For a sector lord to lose consciousness from fatigue was incredibly rare.

…

One month, two months, three months…

For a sector lord to be so tired that he required sleep, the sleep naturally lasted a long time. However as his soul was still complete, it wouldn’t be as long as an undying recovering from a coma.

Luo Feng slept for over nine years!

Amidst the vast energy, Luo Feng felt like a normal human being covered by the sun. There was no sense of threat, instead it was very comfortable. This being before him, his life energy forced even the laws of the universe away.

Over 900m tall, it shocked Luo Feng.

Chapter 883: The Great Being

Chapter 885: Touring the Tower

Chapter 904: Primal Sky Mountain

The biggest reward of course was still the life or death inheritance from star tower, the star map and Pearl tower. After over 6,000 years of torture, his willpower had evolved greatly, and his Beast god presence had reached another level too.

In terms of wealth.

During that one month of massacre in star tower with over forty battles, everyone got several billions worth of wealth, occasionally more. In all, how much was that? Even though while massacring, he would only occasionally activate the virtual universe synchronized broadcast to accumulate contribution points. He didn’t declare more than half of them.

Even so, the number of points he got was still shocking. The amount of wealth he could exchange from that may not be as much as the massacre, but it was still very high.

“If the rewards weren’t big, I wouldn’t have been able to afford this Purple flame ape wine.” Luo Feng said. “After I retired, I discovered there was this one bottle within the army system. I was shocked that they actually had it! I immediately thought of you and bought it without any hesitation.”

The Purple flame ape wine was something only a special life form of the universe, the Purple flame ape could produce.

As for this wine, just its flavor alone made it a top class wine.

Of course there were countless good wines in the universe, just the taste alone wouldn’t give it such a high price.

The first point of this wine was it was beneficial to the body and soul. Anyone who drank this would feel his or her comprehension of the fire laws grow! Their bodies would be more adept at the fire laws and thus become stronger with it.

The second point was that it would definitely get one drunk!

Even the strong ones, be it knights or more, as long as they didn’t purposely wipe off the alcohol from within after finishing one cup, they would naturally get drunk. Once they awake from it, they would feel all headaches and troubles vanish after. To the strong, they favored this point even more mainly because it was extremely hard for such beings to even get drunk. It took endless wealth to achieve this effect.

Other than these two points.

There were many other abilities. One cup could make a normal person evolve into a universe level warrior, and drinking more would make him one with an extreme high level of understanding of the fire laws. Of course, no one would waste billions to hundreds of billions just to nurture a universe level warrior.

Even an undying wasn’t worth 1% of this one cup!

For this wine…Luo Feng had spent eighty billion!

“Your luck was good.” True Yan exclaimed. “The army system has many treasures within, as they are provided by the countless races. And many of them aren’t from the Hong alliance! Many are from the distant regions of the universe, and the treasures they provide form the true treasure trove of the army. There are many of other races… hence occasionally there would be special treasures. Only thing is they require contribution points to exchange for. Even if a powerful warrior discovered this bottle of wine, very few would actually exchange so much contribution points just for it. Hence you got it.”

Luo Feng couldn’t help but laugh.

Virtual universe, sky mountain.

“Any human able to pass this is definitely an absolute genius of ten million eras.”

“Only those able to pass this can be considered the most pinnacle of geniuses in the history of humanity.”

The three guards revived and were incredibly surprised and respectful towards Luo Feng.

Luo Feng stood at the peak, gazing at the vast land below. He could see the other two shorter mountains. As he stood there, thoughts filling his mind, the upper echelon of humanity had already gotten the news of him passing the sky mountain.

This piece of news was like a tornado, swiftly spreading.


Chapter 905: Gamble

Standing at the peak with the winds howling.

“I’m finally at the peak.” Luo Feng gazed down at the vast land below, thinking, “The sector lord primal sky mountain, this is a benchmark for countless geniuses in human history. Only after conquering it can one stand amongst these geniuses. I’m currently standing alongside the strongest of geniuses. However, a genius is just a genius, not a true strong warrior yet.”

“One day…”

“I will stand at the peak of the universe!”

Feeling his fighting spirit rush, he made a vow, back on earth when he was still weak he took on this path, for not only his family, but also for his dream! This warrior’s path, he had dreams and feelings for, it was impossible for anyone to take any path without such feelings.

Shua!

He vanished from the peak of sky mountain.

At the heavenly bridge, on the beautiful center island, the watchman Bevin stood there for trillions of years, guarding the front.

Shua.

Luo Feng smiled.

Sou!

The upper echelon of the Virtual Universe Company were the first to know of such news.

Above Blood river continent, the powerful fortress Tian Shi palace that stood over the continent for countless ages.

Back then, the upper echelon of humanity, be it the Virtual Universe Company, the Huge Axe Dojo, the Universe 1st bank…all of them were debating about Luo Feng and Rong Jun.

How high were their perspectives? Even though Bolan’s initial talent far exceeded theirs, his weakness in character made it so that it would be hard for him to reach high, unless he fixed it. Luo Feng and Rong Jun were different, as Luo Feng had his terrifying willpower and mental state. Such a genius…even if he didn’t improve fast, he would constantly grow and finally become an absolute warrior.

As for Rong Jun, he was even more special!

The upper echelon of humanity were all placing bets on these two! Beings like the Tian shi palace leader, or even high universe masters, their bets would naturally be absurd. When Luo Feng returned from Blood river world back then, the leader couldn’t help but give him some pointers as well.

While the city leader and the Tian Shi palace leader were celebrating, some others were sighing in despair.

The beings all sighed.

The news of Luo Feng passing the sky mountain swiftly spread, shocking countless warriors, and making those that were unhappy before submit!

Virtual universe Yu Xiang mountain, within a restaurant.

Bolan and Rong Jun were both primal region sector lords!

From the 20th level to the 21st, there was just one step left.

Finishing this step meant he could become a knight!

Chapter 906: 21st Level

Within the vast darkness, there was silence.

The bridge extended deep into the darkness. Luo Feng’s heart was cool and yet was burning with fighting spirit!

“The 21st guardian! Complete space laws!” Luo Feng thought.

Even an emperor pinnacle or limit or an invincible emperor, they were mostly stuck at the 20th level. While their talent and comprehension may not be that different, and they may have even more resources and treasures, however they were still all stuck at this point. Why? Because this last step was simply too hard!

True Yan, with his many techniques and resources could match even a knight, yet even he still couldn’t finish this step!

This one step…

Meant a step to heaven!

No matter how powerful an emperor is, he is but a strong warrior in the universe, as the knights were the true absolute beings! And the Tian Shi palace leader and Xi Luo Duo were absolute beings of the universe! As for the Primal chaos city leader and other such beings of that level etc…those were already pinnacle beings of the universe.

The 20th to the 21st level may seem like just one step, however, the difficulty of this one step was not lower than the 1st 20 levels combined!

Luo Feng slowed down, the end of the bridge was right before him. Located there was a 2m diameter ball that had caused the space around to tear. Large amounts of space fragments surrounded it.

“Every three levels of the heavenly bridge is a new environment. The 19th to the 21st was a black hole environment, and flying outside earlier allowed me to see the black hole.” Luo Feng looked at this ball. Since it was but a background image, he couldn’t feel any effects of the black hole gravity at all, and no light was being sucked in.

A true black hole was something that couldn’t be seen with the eyes. In the earth era, there were even debates about its existence.

However the universe had long made it clear.

It was a heavenly body that had been compressed to an ultra degree. This was much higher than a star or planet, it was a super evolution of a star in the universe, and it would swallow everything, including ships, stars, asteroids and so on, strengthening itself constantly.

Black holes could be separated into weak and strong ones too. The stronger ones had a greater area. Even a weaker black hole would require at least a knight to actually enter its core. The stronger ones were avoided even by knights.

“Pick your opponent. Fighter, Controller, Illusionist, pick one and if you defeat him, you will pass the 21st level and become a knight.” A voice resounded from within the black hole.

“Controller.” Luo Feng wielded the beast god armament, saying directly.

Hu…

A large black dot suddenly floated above, forming a human silhouette. He was covered in black armor and had a mask on. He carried a huge blade on his back, this huge blade was actually formed from a blur of fragments, it was some special spirit weapon.

“Your majesty Luo Feng, to meet a sector lord challenger is my honor.” The guardian stood above the black hole and floated.

“To battle against the 21st guardian is my honor too.” Luo Feng smiled too.

“I have to say, without completely comprehending the space laws, you will not pass my level.” The guardian was very graceful. “However, I will let you feel the strength of the complete space laws. After passing the previous levels, you should already know that I’m unable to use the beast god armament.”

“I know.” Luo Feng nodded.

Theoretically, choosing controller should result in the guardian using the same spirit weapon as himself. Back then when he used the Nan shen armament, it was a space type spirit weapon, mixed with gold laws. This was a mix of the laws, but not a fusion. The beast god armament however…was a fusion law weapon. This fusion made it so that it was no longer just a space or gold law weapon, but it was of a higher level, a fusion of the two laws.

“Your majesty, please make your move. Once I attack, you won’t have a chance.” The guardian laughed and seemed respectful.

“Then take my attack.” Luo Feng wasn’t arrogant at all.

Rumble!

The beast god armament immediately shot out fragments that were imbued with law engravings within, forming tens of thousands of threads that swiftly interweaved. Luo Feng stared at his opponent, his powerful willpower and world energy triggering the many fragments, after which a hundred meter long Beast god appeared.

Howl…

The Beast god became a beam of light and rushed at the guardian, as the surrounding space was torn apart.

“Seal!” The guardian pointed at the howling Beast god.

A powerful formless binding instantly descended. The Beast god that was rushing forward suddenly stopped, and Luo Feng floating who was in the distance was stuck too. The sealing power was strong, as even the Beast god was held back. Luo Feng was shocked in disbelief.

“The complete space laws’ power exceeds your imagination.” The guardian was very graceful. “You should feel proud that you managed to get to this level, however the complete space laws isn’t something you can…what!”

He looked shocked at Luo Feng.

Luo Feng gaze was filled with madness. The veins on his face were twitching, almost like when he reached the limit of the life or death inheritance back then. Back when he attempted the Primal sky mountain, he had only unleashed his spirit energy amplification, and he didn’t even push his willpower to its limit.

But this time, he unleashed it!

Pushing his willpower and consciousness to their limit, the form he took when he was at his limit at the inheritance before.

“Tail whip! Break!!!” He howled. With his willpower as the commander and consciousness as the general, he controlled his world energy and poured his beast god presence that had been trained over countless years into the Beast god. At this point, the beast god projection seemed almost life like.

It didn’t even howl, simply whipping its tail strongly.

“Ge ge ge…” The space about trembled.

The Beast god’s tail seemed slow but it moved steadily. With rumbling all around, the sealed space was completely broken apart.

“Kill!” The graceful guardian before starred with ferocity. He was no longer graceful, as the huge blade on his back became countless gold lights and flew into the air, forming a huge arc blade. This arc blade slashed at Luo Feng, creating a huge tear in the space around it.

Luo Feng controlled the Beast god to defend.

“Chi chi chi!” Even though the speed was slow, the blade slashed past the entire Beast god, causing it to crumble. After which, its speed soared again. Luo Feng was unable to escape this slash, as it destroyed Luo Feng’s life core.

Luo Feng fell.

Failure!

Watching him vanish, the guardian’s eyes once again regained its calm from before, he said softly, “What terrifying willpower, to actually force me to use my kill technique. Even the knights that have passed the 21st level, when they were knights, very few had willpower like that, and he’s only a sector lord…”

In the center region of the heavenly bridge, watchman Bevin watched Luo Feng’s battle on a screen that floated before him. He had originally wanted to smile and joke about with Luo Feng, as this was something he found interesting. However, his expression changed very quickly.

All the space guardians, even though they may use different weapons, they all still had three moves, Seal, Kill and Teleport. These were the evolution of the normal moves of the space laws, and they were very powerful. Amongst which, Kill was the one with the highest offensive ability.

And Seal was normally used on weaker opponents. Only when they met opponents that were hard to deal with would they be forced to use Kill! Meeting an opponent of the same level, they would be forced to use all three moves together.

Primal chaos city, True Yan’s quarters.

Comprehension at the 20th level was still fragmented, but the complete space laws were much more powerful.

Chapter 907: Devil Hand Emperor

He simultaneously sent a thread of consciousness into the virtual universe to begin his business.

Yu Xiang mountain, Luo Feng’s villa.

“The others are worth 2.86 trillion. Along with the over 300 billion contribution points, and the 100 billion points from the Primal sky mountain.”

Without a doubt, he had to increase his own strength. Next, he had to leave some trump cards for his family, and lastly, he had to strengthen his little team of warriors. Because the alliance has a practice.

Any emperor can be invited straight into the alliance without the managers having a discussion. Only certain special additions require that.

Even the 108 managers, they probably all thought Blade River was another emperor being invited in.

Hence…

Since you passed the sector lord Primal sky mountain, you can enter the alliance immediately! I will arrange a special location for you within. Everytime you enter the alliance…you can pick whether you will enter as Blade River into your little district or as Luo Feng in the new place.

As for the Luo Feng identity, you have extremely high status and privileges. As long as you don’t make a mistake, the Hong alliance will never reveal your identity.

You have to remember, you cannot reveal your identity as Blade River for now!

The details of the mail were pretty long, of which the warning was severe. It was clear that Blade River’s accomplishments had indeed shocked the city leader. For a sector lord to do so much, if the other races knew about it, they definitely wouldn’t believe that he had no special encounters, even the city leader wouldn’t believe him!

He was set to become one of the greatest warriors, the other races would definitely be willing to pay a huge price to kill him!

That would be troublesome.

It’s even close to Seven Blade and Life Fall. Back then when I followed your teacher around the universe, we respected such warriors as you, and we didn’t dare offend such warriors.”

Hu Yan Bo? He couldn’t help recall, Hu Yan Bo was killed back then by an undying that was barely an emperor. He had remembered that he had to help him take revenge, to repay him for the inheritance. Hu Yan Bo had after all given him huge help initially. Without it, he may have still had the chance to become an absolute warrior, but the path would have been completely different.

“One thing at a time.”

“I’ll first head to Hong alliance city and sell and buy items. After that, I’ll research about him.” Even though he couldn’t care less about a low emperor, he still had to study his enemy well enough, to prevent allowing him to escape later on.

Virtual universe, Hong alliance city.

There were many small districts within the city, and every one with at most 10,000 residence. Even though the spaces were separated fairly, as long as one had power, there would never be absolute fairness. Some small districts had True Yan, Heavenly Feather, Seven Blade, such beings. Nan Shi emperor said, “That’s too much, to compliment me before his majesty, I’m ashamed.”

Luo Feng looked carefully at Nan Shi, as he had definitely heard of him before. The two may not be the same race, but they were on good terms and were life or death brothers. He may seem simple too, in truth, he was ferocious, at least hundreds of times stronger than Life Fall or Black Tomb. His reputation was built from massacre.

Even Dream Fire and Nan Shi were that courteous to him, much less the other emperors.

Luo Feng browsed the entire street and got familiar with it. Once others had known that Luo Feng was in this district…he returned to his own villa on Yu Xiang mountain, beginning to plan what to do with the spoils of his battles.


Chapter 908: Back To Earth

After staying in Primal chaos city for over a month, he kept only a few of the treasures from the battles, like some items that were good for recovery of the undying bodies etc. Many of the warriors he killed had such items, he naturally kept them, along with three top class ships.

He sold everything else and begun his huge spending spree, to buy for his team, his family, himself, until there was only about 100 billion left. Only then did he leave Primal chaos city happily.

Solar system, a majestic palace was floating in space protecting earth, this palace far exceeded the size of earth.

Within its first level.

There was a fixed pathway that connected the Virtual Universe Company camp along with the Huge Axe camp, The Universe 1st bank, Universe Galaxy bank and the Universe Mercenary Alliance.

“Release.”

He exploded his body and a huge sun was generated from the blast, as endless energies shot in all directions. He didn’t even care about the human beside him, he was already lost in despair. As to whether the human survived the blast, he couldn’t even be bothered. If he died, so be it, that would be a release for the human too.

…

Deep in the ice mountains.

The soul swallowing beast sat crossed legged, hearing the voice that spread throughout Ice Hell, its fierce eyes shook with some hurt within.

“Old friend, are you just giving up?”

“If you wanted to die, why don’t you die by my hands, that way I’d have a chance of leaving.” The beast’s hoarse voice resounded within the cave.

…

Over 1,000 km deep in a snow cave, a wriggling silhouette sat crossed legged. It had a human like head, his eyes were closed as he sighed, “He’s free.”

…

In a majestic palace deep in the oceans of Ice Hell.

“Another idiot has given up, good, good, good. The more the merrier, the more dead the better. That way my chances of leaving are higher. Go and die you idiots.”

…

The many warriors locked for endless ages within Ice Hell all either felt hurt, laughed or were indifferent. They had different reactions, but no one was shocked, because this type of suicidal incidents had happened many times before.

The energies flowed madly about in mid air, Luo Feng gradually opened his wings that wrapped around him.

Floating in mid air, he looked at the world ring, weapons, armor etc that the Katu warrior left behind.

“Suicide?”

“Anyone able to reach emperor level should all have strong willpower? Which one doesn’t have their own believes? To actually be forced to suicide.” Luo Feng muttered. The words from the warrior before rang in his ears, he slowly began to understand why he did so.

“The Katu race, is a weak race. Even a strong demon warrior here cannot contact their race. Much less a subsidiary race like the Katu.” Luo Feng said softly. “They don’t have the virtual universe and have no way to make contact, they can only stay in here and suffer.”

“Killing is the main thing in Ice Hell.”

“After endless time, solitude, trapped and being unable to make contact. The endless killing and battles. One year, a hundred, 10,000 years…he finally crumbled within.” Luo Feng thought. This was the battle against solitude and time. Against time, if one was forever in solitude, even an emperor would crumble.

“What’s going on?”

Luo Feng was indeed shocked by the suicide of the Katu warrior, he no longer had the patience to walk about slowly, immediately becoming a beam of light and flying in the skies.

Xiu!

He shot across the skies.

He constantly recalled and pondered what happened before. The more he thought about it, the more shocked he was, “I was able to even withstand the life or death inheritance back then, but that was only over 6,000 years, yet every second and year became increasingly difficult. However, I stuck to my beliefs! If I was in the same situation as that Katu before, knowing my loved ones were long gone, would I be able to persevere for trillions of eras in Ice Hell?”

He asked himself.

Could he do it?

“Yes!”

“Definitely!” He nodded.

He would definitely leave and find a way to revive his loved ones.

If he couldn’t, he would take revenge on the green knight, as it was the knight that took away his precious time with his family.

“Strength, the green knight is strong, who is able to lock so many powerful warriors in here for his game.” Luo Feng thought. “If any of them managed to become a knight in here, the green knight would probably immediately eliminate him.”

…

Luo Feng flew in the skies, below him was an endless snowy plain, with ice mountains all around. He finally saw a transparent huge ice tablet.

The tablet was majestic, and on it carved were demon language words.

“No wonder…” He read the words and muttered. “What a vicious green knight!”

Chapter 922

Chapter 923: Ten Emperors

Luo Feng nodded after hearing what it said. He could understand how much those powerful ones who were detained for countless eras wanted to enter the “virtual universe,” as he saw and reunited with his family when he was adventuring in the universe. The virtual universe made Luo Feng feel as if it were reality, and he believed that those detained here had the same desire.

“Do you have an anonymous sensor?” the creature of Cang Jiang Clan suddenly asked.

Luo Feng was stupefied.

“I’ll do anything for you if you let me enter the virtual universe and get in touch with the outside,” the creature continued.

“I don’t have one,” Luo Feng said, shaking his head.

The creature was left in despair.

Luo Feng didn’t show any empathy because he knew that nobody could ever know that he had the sensor. If they did, he would become the common enemy to everyone in Ice Hell. And those powerful ones would conspire to attack him. Luo Feng was not that stupid.

“Let me ask you one more thing.” Luo Feng looked at the giant creature in front of him. “Do you all believe that you can make your way out if you get 10,000 tags?”

“I do! Of course, I do!” The creature looked more vital. “The green knight said it long before, in public, that he would not play us. And anyway, we have no choice but to trust him.”

Luo Feng frowned. “How was Ice Hell in the past eras? How many have survived? How powerful are they?”

“Killing. Backstabbing. Intrigue. One can do anything for that slight trace of hope.” The creature gave an ear-piercing laugh. “Humans. The powerful ones in Ice Hell were much more ruthless than those outside. Some are even willing to perish together.”

Luo Feng recalled the powerful one of the Ka Tu Clan and how it had blown itself up. It did have the intention of fighting Luo Feng and had wanted to perish with him. However, it couldn’t even touch him and didn’t even care whether or not Luo Feng was beside it when it committed suicide.

“As for powers,” the creature went on. “the potential of the powerful ones could be stimulated under extreme pressure. Since the infinite era, 860 powerful ones have survived.”

“860?” Luo Feng sighed because it meant that 11,000 undying were dead.

“Everyone was pushed to the edge,” the creature said. “And that’s why those who come from a strong bloodline have an advantage. Among the 860 survivors, peak emperors and high-level emperors were the least powerful, and high-level emperors can do nothing but hide. As for peak emperors, they have the guts to fight, but they’re in the bottom 800. Also, there are 50 limit emperors. On top of that, there are ten who are almost as powerful as invincible emperors and five who are, indeed, invincible emperors. Let me show you something.”

It waved its enormous arm, after which, a huge ice tablet fell from the sky. Luo Feng took a look. It was ten-meter tall ice tablet, on which were thickly dotted demon-race characters

“This is the ranking—the ranking of the powerful ones in Ice Hell.” The Cang Jiang creature groaned. “It was too lonely and dull to stay in Ice Hell, and it was impossible to practice at ease because you can be attacked at any time. During the infinite amount of time spent here, the ranking is one of the few things that pique our interest. One of the invincible emperors, Sky Wolf, ranked everyone according to their strengths.”

“How is it possible to rank everyone?” Luo Feng said, scowling. “When two are equal, it’s difficult to tell which one will prevail in a fight.”

“Of course, we know,” said the creature. “However, the ranking by Sky Wolf is credible, and it’s based on all the combat that has taken place in Ice Hell. Although they’re hopeless, getting into the top 100 or top 50 is an improvement for them.”

“Don’t you think it’s pathetic?”

“We’re so lonesome that we’re fixated on the ranking.” The creature laughed with its body trembling.

Luo Feng looked at the ranking on the tablet.

“It is good of you to defeat me,” the creature continued. “However, those terrifically powerful ones are very strong. Neither the five invincible emperors nor the ten that come close are easy to deal with. And you, as a newcomer, will surely be subjected to one sneak attack after another. Unless you can defeat the limit emperors and prove yourself, you will endure it forever.”

Luo Feng nodded. “Go,” he said.

“You’re really letting me go?” The creature couldn’t help asking.

Luo Feng looked at him. “I’ll change my mind if you don’t.”

“I’ll give you a suggestion, human,” said the creature. “Don’t have any form of kindness here, or you’ll only end up with misery.”

The creature’s voice echoed in the sky while he escaped using teleportation. Luo Feng had already undone the “space.”

Luo Feng looked at the tablet on the ground and remembered everything on it with a glance. He then put it into the world ring. As for the advice from the creature, he didn’t take it to heart. The powerful didn’t change their personalities just because of a line from others.

“Creature of Ka Tu Clan, ranked 732,” Luo Feng mumbled. “Creature of Cang Jiang Clan, ranked 611. Soul-Swallowing Beast, ranked 102.”

He realized that the creatures of the Ka Tu Clan and the Cang Jiang Clan, whom he had defeated, were ranked at the bottom, whereas the soul-swallowing beast was ranked high because of its gift.

Luo Feng had a clear picture of Ice Hell by reading the passage on the tablet. In the center of Ice Hell was Ice Sea. There were five districts in Ice Hell: Ice Sea, Eastern Ice Hell, Western Ice Hell, Northern Ice Hell, and Southern Ice Hell. The five invincible emperors had their own “manors” and would fight each other only under uncommon circumstances.

“Three of the invincible emperors are special creatures, Luo Feng muttered to himself. “One of the remaining two is from the Ci An Clan, the other is this Sky Wolf from the royal demon race.”

The golden-horned beasts were ten times stronger than humans. The bodies of human peak emperors were 100,000 times more forceful than those of sector lords, whereas the bodies of the beast were 1 million times more forceful.

Nevertheless, the weakest special creatures could match the level of golden-horned beasts, not to mention the ones in Ice Hell. The weakest special species was 60 times as forceful than human beings, and the strongest was 200 times as forceful. Putting aside other amplitude scrolls, the strongest one out of the three peak emperors was 20 million times more forceful than sector lords. How unbelievable!

The Ci An Clan was a scarce race in the universe and was comparable to the Mo Sha Clan. They were ten times more forceful than humans. Sky Wolf, on the other hand, was the least gifted one and was six times more forceful than humans. In short, the five invincible emperors were highly gifted, per se, and after an infinite amount of time of torture, every one of them had tremendous powers.

“Three special creatures survived Ice Hell, and all of them became invincible.” Luo Feng sighed. “Special creatures are indeed almighty. The constitution of human bodies is comparatively weaker, and it was more difficult for them to reach the invincible level.”

Luo Feng gradually realized the disadvantages facing the human races in the universe. Humans were barely mediocre when it came to body constitution. However, a few of the supreme beings that could shake the whole universe came from the human race.

Luo Feng built an underground residence in the snow beside the Ice Sea. He was practicing there temporarily.

“According to the ranking on the tablet, each of the invincible emperors is as powerful as my teacher, True Yan Emperor,” Luo Feng whispered. “I’m not capable enough to get 10,000 tags, but it’s a good thing. I’ll treat it as a chance to steel myself, after which I’ll defeat them one by one. Only then will I walk out of Ice Hell. As for purple knight, it doesn’t matter whether it means to let me go or not. If it wants to toy with me, I’ll summon my teacher, Burgrave of Chaos City. I’ll make it lose everything.”

Luo Feng closed his eyes and cleared his mind. While everyone else was busy trying to get out of here, Luo Feng would treat it as a practice field.

A three-meter-high red creature covered with bony spurs marched through the snow. It wore a scarlet mask, and the 10,000-square-kilometer area was engulfed in fire under the hefty law. Everywhere it touched evaporated.

However, when it walked by, the water in the boiling lakes coagulated into snow under the effects of Ice Hell, as if nothing had happened.

It stopped and looked down.

“Footprints,” it said. “A stranger’s footsteps.”

The voice had echoes in its chest.

“There is a stranger in Ice Hell,” it said. “How reckless was he that he dared not to erase his footsteps? Is it confidence?”

It strode. The snow it passed by turned into boiling lakes, and the entire law field was under its detection.

Eventually, it reached the shoreline of Ice Sea.

“Hong!”

A silver shadow jumped up into the sky. He opened his wings and floated in the air, overlooking everything beneath.

The barbarian looked up at Luo Feng and smirked. That giant eye was filled with madness.

“Human!” it bellowed.

“Bone Emperor, ten of the limit emperors,” Luo Feng said, looking down upon it with this information in his mind. “Ranked 11.”

Five invincible emperors and the ten top limit emperors were the 15 most powerful creatures in Ice Hell. Other than those five invincible emperors, the ten limit emperors weren’t scared of anything.

“Human! Human!” it growled, growing madder by the second.

“Bone Emperor!” Luo Feng’s voice passed over from the above.

The sense of war and killing intent permeated the air.
