Chapter 939: Arrival of the Primal Chaos City Leader

Inside the Ice Hell star band of the Black Flower Secret Region.

A towering palace surrounded by flames appeared out of nowhere, and the second it appeared, it became the core of the entirety Ice Hell, exerting an aggressive and mighty force on it. All the undying playing in the Ice Hell star band instantly began shivering out of fright.

“What’s the point of scaring them as Master of Sky Wolf?”

A trace of purple light and then blue light flew to the floating palace.

“They ought to grovel upon my arrival,” the rumbling sound came out of the palace, and a figure covered with fire walked out.

The figure looked like the manifestation of law of the universe. Tongues of flames surrounded him, and the dark Sky Wolf was walking at a slow pace. The space and time around him were in his control completely, and he was the owner of the entire Ice Hell star band! Even the blue knight and the purple knight had to revere him.

He was the greatest being of the Sky Wolf clan: Master of Sky Wolf!

“There is a sky wolf detained in Ice Hell.” His voice was rumbling, trembling the entire domain. “Let it out.”

The purple knight and the blue knight gave each other a look. There was an immense number of demon-race creatures, and they hadn’t expected that Master of Sky Wolf would show up for merely an undying.

“Please wait a minute, Master of Sky Wolf,” the blue knight said and waved his hand.

A cylindrical icicle appeared on his palm. Since Master of Sky Wolf arrived, he needed to carry his treasure to greet him. Ice Hell was one of the sealing treasures, which was scarce and precious; together with the blue knight’s talents, its tremendous power could be fully utilized.

The blue knight’s mind entered the Ice Hell and locked onto the Sky Wolf, kicking it out easily.

“Get out!”

The white Sky Wolf didn’t stand straight until rolling among the stars. After looking around, exhilaration filled its eyes. When it saw the purple and blue figures, and the palace engulfed in fire where stood the forceful black Sky Wolf, it recalled the legend of the Sky Wolf clan. It couldn’t believe its eyes.

“Leader!” Si Bo Wa groveled with a thrill.

The legendary leader of Sky Wolf clan! The eternal leader!

“Purple knight, how powerful is this Sky Wolf?” The black Sky Wolf looked at the purple knight from afar.

Although the purple knight and Master of Sky Wolf bore some grudges against each other, the knight had to suppress his hostility. Master of Sky Wolf wasn’t just any Universe master with invaluable treasures.

“Master of Sky Wolf,” said the purple knight, “this one is particularly talented, and it is ranked among the top five in Ice Hell. If it were equipped with some suitable treasures, it would rival other invincible emperors.”

“Then why did you detain it, knowing its potential?” Master of Sky Wolf kept grumbling.

“It’s my Ice Hell that detained it,” the blue knight said, clearly irritated.

Master of Sky Wolf looked to the blue knight.

Rumble!

An invisible force assailed the blue knight, whose body bounced away and cracked, after which the pieces were assembled.

“Who allowed you to speak?” the voice was muddled with anger. Coldness flashed through his eyes, which terrified the purple knight.

“Master of Sky Wolf!” the purple knight screamed.

“Relax. Because of you, I won’t actually hurt him.” Master of Sky Wolf calmed himself down. “It was just a small punishment.”

The blue knight flew back to the purple knight. He was filled with exasperation, but all he could do was to suppress it. The purple knight smiled and said, “Master of Sky Wolf, I’ve already let your people go. If you want to catch up with me, you can come with me to the Ice Hell star band, and I can invite some friends.”

“I’ll pass.”

Master of Sky Wolf glimpsed at the purple knight and looked down to Si Bo Wa.

Si Bo Wa said, “Leader, there’s a human in Ice Hell, and he has the beast god token.”

It didn’t dare to tell him that it was the one who had given the human the token, as it was afraid to enrage this supreme being that it had only heard of before.

“Beast god token?” Master of Sky Wolf looked to the purple knight. “Let the human out, and I’ll take him with me,” Master of Sky Wolf said.

It was an excellent deal to get the token with a word, as the tokens were limited resources to a race.

“Human?” The purple knight and the blue knight exchanged eye contact and realized they were in trouble. The purple knight shook his head. “There was no human.”

“Don’t you dare tell me there’s not!” the voice blasted, trembling its surroundings. The space was twisted like waves. “Of course, you know that there’s a human inside!”

“No, there’s not,” the purple knight said and kept shaking his head.

The two knights didn’t have the guts to hand in the human. They had already contacted Mountain Sitting Guest and confirmed that the human was a student highly valued by him. Everyone knew how mighty Mountain Sitting Guest was. Even Master of Sky Wolf was nothing compared to him. They might manage to survive if they wronged Master of Sky Wolf. However, even the Ancestral God School couldn’t protect them if they wronged Mountain Sitting Guest!

“There’s no human,” agreed the blue knight, shaking his head, too. “The little one must have misremembered it. There was a human before, but he died a long time ago.”

Master of Sky Wolf looked at the purple knight and the blue knight in shock. He could not believe they were unwilling to give him the human. Si Bo Wa, standing to the side, was also looking at its leader and waiting for his hint. If he was to give up, it would say the similar thing as the two knights. Otherwise, it would tell a different story.

“Interesting,” Master of Sky Wolf said. “Who is this human? He doesn’t sound like a nobody.” Master of Sky Wolf stood in front of the towering palace and overlooked the knights. “Did a supreme being of the human race make a pact with you both so that you two would rather defy me? If it’s something good to humans, I’ll surely sabotage it! Give me the human!” Master of Sky Wolf glared at them. “Or I’ll get him myself!”

“Leader! They were lying! I just saw the human!” Si Bo Wa shouted.

“Did you hear me?” Master of Sky Wolf looked down at the knights.

“Master of Sky Wolf!” The purple knight said with fury. “Are you going to fight us because of a human?”

“I’ll suggest you back off!” the blue knight said.

They were already secretly notifying Mountain Sitting Guest, who had unbelievable skills, to share the news. However, Mountain Sitting Guest only responded, “Give him the human and meddle. Don’t tell him my relationship with this human.

“Give me the human!” demanded Master of Sky Wolf. “No matter who’s behind him, I won’t be afraid. Even if he’s the founder of Gigantic Axe!”

The purple knight and the blue knight gave each other a look. They were pondering why Mountain Sitting Guest would tell them to stand aside and not expose the relationship. Master of Sky Wolf would certainly go away if he heard the name “Mountain Sitting Guest.” But what was the point of this if Mountain Sitting Guest said so?

“Okay.” The purple knight nodded. “We’ll let him go.”

Deep in the snow of Eastern Ice Hell.

Luo Feng sat in the living room and waiting for the Primal Chaos City Leader.

Rumble!

He suddenly felt the entire sealing force squeezing him. Space cracked at the front. He was squeezed out without even putting up a fight.

Luo Feng opened his wings and floated among the stars.

It must be my teacher, Luo Feng thought.

But he was startled by what he saw. The purple knight and the blue knight were standing afar, and on the other side floated a gigantic palace surrounded by flames. The power that emanated from it was colossal and surpassed that of the Sky-Swallowing Palace which Luo Feng had seen before. The owner, a black Sky Wolf, petrified Luo Feng, and next to him stood a subservient white Sky Wolf.

It’s the Sky Wolf of Ice Hell, Luo Feng thought to himself.

“Human,” Si Bo Wa said, looking down at Luo Feng smugly. “The token was only kept by you temporarily. And now, the token and your life will both be gone.”

Master of Sky Wolf looked down at Luo Feng. “You seem to have a strong background,” the master said. “Unfortunately, you’re dying today and will not be resurrected.”

Where is my teacher? He should’ve arrived a long time ago.

“Die!” Master of Sky Wolf said nonchalantly.

All forms of sound went off and spread to all the creatures detained in Ice Hell. Luo Feng and Si Bo Wa heard it, too, and so did the two knights and Master of Sky Wolf.

Among the Ice Hell star band, a blurry river of sky that was several light years long appeared and covered the entire star band. It looked infinitely long, as if it were opening an entrance to another universe.

On the river floated various kinds of treasures, each of whose force permeated the space.

“It’s thousand-treasure river!” cried the purple knight, dazed.

“Thousand-treasure river!” the blue knight said and looked to Master of Sky Wolf, gloating.

Master of Sky Wolf was bewildered. He roared, standing in front of the palace with his hoofs. “Primal Chaos City Leader! Why don’t you show yourself, since you’re here?”

The fire around him soared with spread everywhere, but it was extinguished by the force from the river. The palace started to oscillate as if it would topple at any minute.


Chapter 940: Seeing Through

The weak undying, together with Luo Feng and Si Bo Wa, were stunned after seeing this. The thousand-treasure river was only a reflection of a river that cast a shadow on the stars, which was why it looked blurry. However, Sky Wolf Palace could only barely resist its mighty power.

“That is the first time I have ever seen thousand-treasure river!” the blue knight sighed. “It is indeed forceful and unstoppable. According to the legend, thousand-treasure river is made up of 1,000 invaluable treasures, and if it was dismantled, it would become 1,000 individual invaluable treasures!”

“Dismantle? Who could do that?” said the purple knight. “The birth of this river is for the treasures to strengthen each other. Each of the treasure has its flaws and is only as powerful as an ordinary top-tier treasure. Only assembling them into the thousand-treasure river can make the invulnerable treasure that roams the universe. You have never seen how the Primal Chaos City Leader slaughters other creatures. This is only an body of him. His original body is more powerful than this.”

“I’ve heard of it before,” the blue knight said as he nodded. “Primal Chaos City Leader. One of the bodies sits in the primal universe and the other in the original one, taking charge of the virtual universe company. And the strongest original is meant for killing.”

Luo Feng couldn’t hear the conversation between the blue knight and the purple knight.

“How powerful my teacher is!” muttered Luo Feng. “And this is only one of his bodys.”

Luo Feng looked at the boundless projection of the river and Master of Sky Wolf, who was struggling to control Sky Wolf Palace inside the project. Luo Feng admired his teacher even more.

Teacher Mountain Sitting Guest thinks that I can become a Universe master and utilize star tower in the future—even surpass the Primal Chaos City Leader in the future? thought Luo Feng, filled with aspiration.

The Primal Chaos City Leader could annihilate everything within several square light years with a snap of his fingers!

A gigantic figure that was 10,000 kilometers tall walked on the waves of the river toward him with a huge stone stick. “Master of Sky Wolf,” said the figure. “It is outrageous for you to kill my human student.”

“What is that?” gasped Luo Feng.

He was thrilled. This was the first time he had seen the other body of his teacher. It was 6,000 miles tall and silvery white. There were 1,000 antennas on its head, and the eyes looked tranquil. He walked on the waves barefoot and held a rugged stick. Only a seemingly ordinary shirt was covering the body, whereas the sound of the treasures on the shirt echoed. Each thread of the shirt looked like a running river.

“Is… is this a special life?” Luo Feng knew that it was a special life, as there were no clans in the human race that looked like this. What’s more, it was 6,000 miles tall. If it wasn’t originally this tall, enlarging one’s size would only make it weaker.

“This is the Primal Chaos City Leader!” Si Bo Wa was dazed and had to reluctantly admit that the Primal Chaos City Leader was indeed more forceful than the leader of its clan. Si Bo Wa glanced at Luo Feng. “He is able to bring the Primal Chaos City Leader here?”

When the Primal Chaos City Leader walked toward everyone with the rugged stick in his hand and thousand-treasure shirt on his body, Master of Sky Wolf did look comparatively inferior.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, you think so highly of this human that you come here by yourself,” Master of Sky Wolf said.

“Didn’t you come for this little one here?” the Primal Chaos City Leader asked, looking at the tiny white Sky Wolf.

There was no comparison between their sizes, but they were at least equally forceful. As for the blue knight and the purple knight, they became the insignificant parts of the conversation and were overlooked by both the Primal Chaos City Leader and the master. As for Luo Feng and Si Bo Wa, they were less than negligible.

“I didn’t come here with a purpose.” Master of Sky Wolf suddenly looked to Luo Feng. “You, on the other hand, gave this human an invaluable treasure.”

Luo Feng was startled.

“An invaluable treasure? He possesses an invaluable treasure?” Si Bo Wa was stupefied and looked to Luo Feng.

“What?” the purple knight and the blue knight said, also looking toward Luo Feng in shock. This was new information for them.

“Let me check,” Master of Sky Wolf said in a hoarse voice. “Blade River Emperor? Interesting. I can’t believe a sector lord is able to disguise himself as an undying with the invaluable treasure and garner such a reputation. This student you have is nothing like the fallen Ke Di. Let’s see which invaluable treasure he possesses. According to the information, Blade River Emperor is incredibly rapid, so I assume this wing is his invaluable treasure? Am I right, Primal Chaos City Leader?”

The purple knight, the blue knight, and Si Bo Wa were all dumbfounded.

Sector lord? He was only a sector lord?

“He can escape from Silver Eye as merely a sector lord?” Si Bo Wa was bewildered. “It must be the invaluable treasure which makes him so powerful.”

“Impressive, indeed,” said the purple knight.

“He can be this mighty as only a sector lord and earn such fame,” said the blue knight. “No wonder Mountain Sitting Guest values him this much.”

The purple knight and the blue knight sighed. They would also definitely aspire to get the invaluable treasure if they had known Luo Feng had one, but they wouldn’t have actually had the guts to take it by force.

Luo Feng was in shock. He looked at Master of Sky Wolf and thought, Teacher Mountain Sitting Guest is right. I do have three invaluable treasures, the tower pearl, star map, and Sha Wu Wing, respectively. However, I’ve never shown them in front of the master, and the powerful creatures shouldn’t be able to recognize them unless I wield their powers. Does he suspect it simply because I’m so fast?

This Master of Sky Wolf is perceptive, indeed. The invaluable treasure can only trick the knights.

Luo Feng recalled how Pu Ti and teacher Mountain Sitting Guest were able to see his real identity as a sector lord. The invaluable treasure wasn’t as effective at concealing the aura.

The Primal Chaos City Leader said, “An ordinary invaluable treasure is nothing, and of course I’ll give it to the juniors of my race who have great potential. This is how the supreme beings are made. Do you know why we of the human race have less undying than the demon race, yet we have more supreme undying? It is because we’re willing to give while you are not. Will you, as Master of Sky Wolf, be willing to give this little one an invaluable treasure?”

Si Bo Wa was thrilled. An invaluable treasure? Could it really get an invaluable treasure? It couldn’t help glancing at the master, but then it looked down instantly. The invaluable treasure could only be rewarded by the master, and Si Bo Wa could never ask for it directly.

“Everyone knows you humans prospered because of the virtual universe,” Master of Sky Wolf roared. “And it’s not your business to tell me how to train my descendants. I’m done talking to you now.” He finished and brought Si Bo Wa into the palace.

The Primal Chaos City Leader burst into laughter, which permeated the thousand-treasure river and made the Sky Wolf Palace tremble. Master of Sky Wolf growled and flew away, entering the dark universe after hitting light speed. Apparently, within the power range of the river, Master of Sky Wolf couldn’t teleport himself even with the palace.

“This Sky Wolf is still so reckless.” The Primal Chaos City Leader shook his head and looked to the two knights. “Thank you for taking care of my student for the past two thousand years,” he said. Then he vanished together with Luo Feng and the river.

“Thank us?” the blue knight said, a bit dazed. “I heard that the Primal Chaos City Leader was belligerent, but now he thanks us? Why is he so good-tempered?”

“Good-tempered?” The purple knight sneered. “You only say that because you’ve never seen how the Primal Chaos City Leader slaughtered before. The master dared to speak only because he was innately reckless, but did you realize he fled after only saying a few words? Among the five forces of the human race, the virtual universe company is as powerful as the Battle-axe Coliseum. Do you really think the Primal Chaos City Leader can control the entire virtual universe by being good-tempered? How can his original be famous for slaughtering if he’s good-tempered?

The blue knight blinked.

“Be careful,” the purple knight said. “The most powerful of the six peak races were all ruthless, and they can destroy us in the blink of an eye if necessary.”

“I get it.” The blue knight nodded.

Inside the primal secret region.

After one god-country transport and a million-lightyear teleportation, the Primal Chaos City Leader arrived at one of the many secret regions of the human race, the primal secret region. The Primal Chaos City Leader jumped up with the thousand-treasure shirt and turned into a boundless river, surrounding the stars and the palaces.

“The river,” Luo Feng said. He looked at the stars and couldn’t see the end of the river.

“The thousand-treasure river can transform into everything, and this river is its original look.” The Primal Chaos City Leader pointed at it. “Luo Feng, the reason that I could intimidate the master is this river. And an invaluable treasure like this is the cornerstone of our race! You are a man with luck. Perhaps you will be able to get an invaluable treasure like this in the future.”

“I’ll try my best,” Luo Feng answered.


Chapter 941: Famous in the Universe

The Primal Chaos City Leader smiled and said, “Then I’ll wait and see.”

Thousand-treasure river was a top-tier invaluable treasure, and even most of the masters of the universe couldn’t obtain treasures like this. The Primal Chaos City Leader was just saying this to encourage Luo Feng instead of actually expecting him to get a top-tier invaluable treasure.

Perhaps you don’t know, teacher, but I’ve already had two invaluable treasures, thought Luo Feng, one of which being Force Armor, and it’s thousand-treasure river’s equal. As for Star Tower, it’s one of the most powerful invaluable treasures in the entire universe.

The Primal Chaos City Leader shrunk to the size of Luo Feng from a planet-sized giant.

“Luo Feng, there’s something I need to ask you,” the Primal Chaos City Leader said. “But the choice is yours.”

“Please, teacher,” Luo Feng answered.

Beside the river and the palaces, they started to talk.

“True Yan Emperor is also your teacher, and that’s why I need to tell you more about him,” the Primal Chaos City Leader said gradually and calmly. “As a matter of fact, True Yan Emperor’s also practicing on the path of beast god.”

“What?” Luo Feng was dazed.

“There are a few powerful ones on that path, but they all kept it as a secret,” the Primal Chaos City Leader explained. “The most talented ones of your generation, like you and Seven Blade Emperor, are all following the path of beast god. However, beast gods belong to Ancestral God School, whose existence is a top secret in the universe, and thus people who train themselves following the path of beast all keep in as a secret, and so do you.”

Luo Feng nodded. Only a small number of people knew that Luo Feng was following the path of beast god.

“I told you this because your teacher True Yan Emperor is following the branch of soil and space,” The Primal Chaos City Leader said.

“Soil and space!” Luo Feng said with shock. The beast god inheritance token he just obtained was of soil and space!

“You’re a smart person, and you must have guessed what I mean,” the Primal Chaos City Leader looked at the boundless thousand-treasure river and said. “Seven Blade Emperor got a token from our race before. Given your potential, you’ll also get one when you officially become an undying.”

“On the contrary,” he continued, “your teacher True Yan Emperor is not as talented as you. He only became an invincible emperor by training for an extraordinarily long time and getting instructions from other powerful ones within our race. It’s impossible for him to get a token from the race. He filed an application before, but the race has never granted him any approval, and thus, he can only earn the token himself. However, the tokens are some of the scarcest resources in the universe, and one can only find them by luck, with which a sector lord can obtain one by accident. But without luck, a universe knight can’t find one even if he were to comb every inch of the universe.”

The Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng. “The resources in our race belong to all the humans. Although there are countless treasures, they must be granted to the most talented, and it must be subject to all the seniors’ discretion. But now, there’s a way to help your teacher.”

“I bet you already understand what I mean,” the Primal Chaos City Leader continued. “You can give the token to your teacher directly. Your teacher is going to the land of inheritance now, and it’s a huge opportunity for him, as he might become a universe knight. He might also fail since he’s far less talented than you or Seven Blade Emperor. You two are almost his rivals by such a short time of training.”

“I’m willing to give it to my teacher,” Luo Feng answered without any hesitation.

He had to pay True Yan Emperor back.

I’ll get the token anyway when I become an undying, he thought. All I need to do is wait. Once my third body comes into being, I’ll become an undying. However, my teacher has already waited for an eternity. A small time of waiting in exchange for a huge opportunity for my teacher is totally worth it.

“You’ve made up your mind already? No regrets?” The Primal Chaos City Leader looked to Luo Feng.

“No, I won’t regret it,” Luo Feng said, nodding sternly.

“Great.” The Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Now, you’ll give the token to your teacher. However, you don’t necessarily have to wait to become an undying to go to the land of inheritance. I’ll file an application for you. Normally, you’ll be granted one after entering the undying level, but I believe Master of Sky Wolf will make the news of Blade River Emperor public.”

“Master of Sky Wolf?” Luo Feng was dazed.

“Yes,” said the Primal Chaos City Leader. “Blade River Emperor is a sector lord. He will definitely let everyone know and will polish the story. Once it’s made known, lots of the peak races will have their eyes on you and try to assassinate you.” The Primal Chaos City Leader sighed. “The human race will know, too.”

“Your identity as Blade River Emperor is only known to few, but it will change soon,” he continued. “I’ll use it as an excuse to file an application for the inheritance token for you. Since you’re already as powerful as Seven Blade Emperor, you’re already qualified to enter the land of inheritance.” The Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “Although that’s a place of danger, it only comes from the competition within our race, as nobody from the other races will dare to assassinate you in the sacred land of Ancestral God School.

“That’s why I think the token will be granted. However, I can’t be 100 percent sure. After all, they’re the resources of the entire human race, and all I’m in charge of is the virtual universe company. The seniors might veto it, since only the undying were able to enter it before. I’ll say you’re more likely to succeed than to fail.”

“Thank you, teacher,” Luo Feng said. He truly appreciated the help.

There would still be grudges between siblings. Hence, normally, there were hidden competitions between the five powers of the human race. It would be conceivably difficult, as the resources didn’t only belong to the Primal Chaos City Leader.

“The more powerful and famous you are, the easier it is for me to apply for the resources,” the Primal Chaos City Leader said with a smile. He was content looking at Luo Feng. Although he already knew Luo Feng’s personality by experience, he was joyful when he saw Luo Feng’s willingness to give the token to True Yan Emperor without any doubts Apparently, Luo Feng knew how to show gratitude.

Blade River Emperor was only a sector lord.

The news was like a thunder and shocked all the powerful creatures. It spread like wildfire, and lots of the powerful ones of the human race knew about it within the day. People everywhere in the Hong Alliance City were talking about it.

“Blade River Emperor is a sector lord!”

“He was able to kill a peak emperor. And now, people are saying he’s only a sector lord? How is it possible for a sector lord to be so mighty? It’s outrageous!”

“It must be fake!”

“It’s real. Both the demon race and the automation race have already found out about it, and they’ve already offered bounties for killing this Blade River Emperor.”

“If he is indeed a sector lord, why were so many powerful ones unable to distinguish him? The auras between a sector lord and an undying are totally different.”

“They said Blade River Emperor obtained an invaluable treasure, which conceals his true identity.”

“Invaluable treasure?”

“Blade River Emperor has an invaluable treasure? That can even set universe knights crazy.”

It was madness. The news that Blade River Emperor is a sector lord and that Blade River Emperor had an invaluable treasure made a plethora of powerful ones jealous. One could tell how tempting an invaluable treasure was by the sound and fury sealing star resulted in.

“If Blade River Emperor is a sector lord, who is he exactly? He’s even more unimaginable than the legendary Ke Di.”

“Perhaps it’s Luo Feng, as he’s the most powerful sector lord of the human race and has already passed the sector-lord-level Sky Mountain.”

“I don’t think it’s Luo Feng. Instead, it might be a super talent who has been undercover all the time. And this talent is even stronger than both Ke Di and Luo Feng, and that’s why they’ve kept it as a secret and given him an invaluable treasure to conceal it.”

“Where did all the talents come from? Luo Feng is already the genius of our time.”

“Maybe this Blade River Emperor is one of the most talented of the human race and is even mightier than Ke Di and Luo Feng.”

“I still think it’s Luo Feng. It’s impossible for such a genius to stay anonymous.”

Within the boundless universe and hundreds of millions of races, most of the creatures had heard the news of Blade River Emperor. They also knew that Blade River Emperor belonged to the human race, but they couldn’t be sure who he really was. Lots of people thought it was Luo Feng because, based on all they knew, only Luo Feng had such potential.

“Dad, are you the Blade River Emperor?”

“Some of the super-families within our Ganwu universe also talk about this Blade River Emperor during businesses. I’ve heard of some of the news and guessed it was you.”

In the nine-star bay of Black Dragon Island, Luo Feng was having meals with his family.

“I also heard of it,” Xu Xin said.

“Don’t interrogate me,” Luo Feng said.

Luo Ping and Luo Hai smiled because their father would’ve denied it if it weren’t true.

“Dad, you’re awesome!” Luo Hai said, opening his eyes wide.

“Remember not to tell anyone,” Luo Feng said as he glanced at his sons.

“We know,” said Luo Ping.

“We know how serious it is,” Luo Hai answered with excitement.

Although Blade River Emperor was yet to become the most powerful one in the universe, he had already garnered widespread fame, and his name would be in history forever. Wasn’t that what they wanted? Fame?

This is only the beginning of my rise, thought Luo Feng. I’ll only become stronger since I’m on the edge now. And the demon race… you’ll lose in the end.


Chapter 942: True Yan Emperor and Luo Feng

Inside, the ancient Chaos City was peaceful as always. Three purple messengers were walking on the street and reached True Yan Emperor’s house.

“It’s the purple messengers of the Primal Chaos City Leader.”

“The purple messengers are here.”

The most frequently seen messengers normally wore black. Some of the students in True Yan Emperor’s house were startled, as they’d rarely seen the arrival of purple messengers. They knew something significant had happened.

“Go, tell the teacher.”

After only a short while, True Yan Emperor came out and greeted them himself. He was also baffled. “Three purple messengers are here?” he said. “One black messenger is enough, normally. What’s the point of sending three purple messengers here?”

“Congratulations, True Yan Emperor!” The tallest messenger laughed. “Congratulations.”

The other two purple knights laughed along.

“Why do you congratulate me? Come, sit inside.”

True Yan Emperor led the three messengers into the hall, and several students served some wine and fruits. They left after duty, as they knew they were not supposed to meddle with some major issues. That left only the three messengers and True Yan Emperor in the hall.

“It’s such great news.” The tall messenger beamed and brought out a metal box.

“What’s so mysterious?” True Yan Emperor took and opened it. There was a hexagonal stone tablet inside, on which was sculpted a roaring beast god.

True Yan Emperor was dazed, and his hand started to tremble. He picked up the stone tablet, and his eyes turned red. He caressed this tablet as if he were worried that it was a phantom. His voice faltered as he said, “Beast god inheritance token! It’s the beast god inheritance token! For such a long time—practically forever—I’ve always wanted it!” True Yan Emperor’s body trembled. “Now, I’ve finally got the chance. Finally!”

He was stuck at the last step for what felt like an infinite amount of time. Although the token could help him greatly, it was almost impossible to get one. The tokens were extremely rare in the universe, as they represented the most special inheritance of Ancestral God School. Perhaps there were only a few of each type of the tokens within the human race, and the race needed to prepare for the potential peerless talents in the future. The tokens would only be granted under few circumstances.

He couldn’t make the final breakthrough if he didn’t get the token. It was indeed only one step, but it was like a chasm, separating countless emperors from universe knights.

“Thank you, Primal Chaos City Leader.” True Yan Emperor kneeled with excitement. “Thank you, seniors. I’ll strive to become a universe knight and live up to the expectations.”

“Please, get up.” The tall messenger helped True Yan Emperor to his feet.

“The race rewarded with a token. I…” True Yan Emperor was thrilled.

“It’s not from the race. It’s from your student Luo Feng.”

“Luo Feng?” True Yan Emperor was stupefied.

“Yes, your student Luo Feng,” the tall messenger continued. “I was serving the Primal Chaos City Leader in the primal secret region. The Primal Chaos City Leader asked us to come here directly and give this to you. As for Luo Feng, he’s still with the Primal Chaos City Leader in the primal secret region.”

“How did he get the token?” True Yan Emperor suddenly had complicated feelings. “My student was also following the path of beast god, and he could certainly trade this token for another. Why did he give this to me?”

No matter how close the relationship between the teacher and the student, the powerful ones would do everything in their power to improve themselves. Giving the insignificant ones to their teachers could be regarded as gratitude.

“True Yan Emperor, you have a great student.”

“We won’t stay for long, as we need to go back and report,” the tall messenger said. “We’ll escort ourselves out.”

The three messengers left.

True Yan Emperor was both exhilarated and anxious. Even though he had desired the token for so long, he felt like it was too much.

True Yan Emperor connected to the virtual universe and sent ten emails to Luo Feng before coming to Luo Feng’s manor in Yu Xiang Mountain.

“Luo Feng,” True Yan Emperor shouted, which baffled all the servants and the guards.

“Teacher!” Luo Feng soon got out of the hall.

“Come with me.”

True Yan Emperor grabbed Luo Feng and entered the hall. True Yan Emperor couldn’t wait to yell, “Where did you get the token? Did you get it from our race? Don’t you know how important it is to you? You’re following the path of beast god yourself! How could you just give it up and hand it in to your teacher? I’ll be restless knowing you’ve traded your future for mine. And you know if I can’t be tranquil, I might fail even if I enter the land of inheritance.”

“Please relax, teacher,” Luo Feng said. “I got it myself instead of getting it from my race.”

“You got it yourself?” True Yan Emperor was startled.

It was not so easy to get one. Once other powerful ones found it, they would use their godly power to penetrate it and discern how important it was. Usually, they would just hand it in to their race. That was how most of the tokens were held by the races.

“It’s true. I obtained it by myself.” Luo Feng said. “Just think about this. I gave this to you in the hands of the Primal Chaos City Leader. If I actually got it from our race, the Primal Chaos City Leader wouldn’t allow me to do so.”

“That makes sense.” True Yan Emperor nodded his head. “The Primal Chaos City Leader won’t let you be reckless.”

“Just use it now, teacher,” Luo Feng continued. “It’s not difficult for me to get a token from our race.”

“You’ll definitely be valued by our race based on your potential, and you’re more than qualified to get the token. Even the Seven Blade Emperor, who is less talented than you, could get one.” True Yan Emperor nodded his head and frowned. “However, you need to become an undying to get the token, and that’s going to take a long time.

“Please don’t worry about that, teacher.” Luo Feng smiled. “Did you forget that I’m Blade River Emperor, teacher? I’m already powerful enough to get one, and the Primal Chaos City Leader will file an application for me. He told me that it would succeed given his presence and my genius.”

True Yan Emperor sighed. “The Primal Chaos City Leader is the ruler of the virtual universe. Okay, he’ll definitely succeed. Luo Feng, I’ve benefited so much from you.”

“It was a piece of cake.” Luo Feng beamed.

Deep in the primal secret region, the thousand-treasure river surrounded the stars. Luo Feng was sitting on top of one of the palaces and looked at the river from afar. He thought back to what the Primal Chaos City Leader had told him.

“Luo Feng, this is the date when we’ll know whether you can get the token or not. If it fails, you’ll have to wait until you become an undying. I hope it can succeed.”

“I will succeed,” said Luo Feng as he sat on the top of the palace with his legs crossed. “Land of inheritance, the sacred place of Ancestral God School. How exciting!”

Time passed. Luo Feng was growing anxious from waiting. However, he knew that the seniors from all the five powers of the human race were negotiating the decision. Could they make an exception for Luo Feng? Could Luo Feng succeed?

After a long while, Luo Feng heard a peaceful voice.

“Luo Feng.”

Luo Feng turned around and saw the Primal Chaos City Leader holding the rugged stone stick. Luo Feng’s heart missed a beat, as he knew the meeting had ended and a decision had been made.

Luo Feng stood up and greeted him. “Teacher.”

“The meeting’s over,” the Primal Chaos City Leader said. “I can tell by the look on your face how concerned you are. Rest assured, because it’s good news. The application was approved, and your identity as Blade River Emperor thrilled the masters of the universe of our race. They all think highly of you, and thus I don’t need to put forth too much effort.”

Luo Feng was overjoyed. He didn’t believe what the Primal Chaos City Leader said and was certain his teacher had pulled lots of strings.

“Thank you, teacher,” Luo Feng said. “I won’t fail you and the other masters of the universe.”

“Just don’t fail the human race.” The Primal Chaos City Leader burst into laughter. “The token will be sent to you in two days, and I’ve already told True Yan to come to the primal secret region to meet with you. You’ll go to the land of inheritance together.”

“Yes, teacher.” Luo Feng was cheerful.

The human race was efficient, and the token arrived after only one day.

“Beast god inheritance token.”

Luo Feng started to examine the hexagonal metal tablet in his hands. There was a single-horned lizard sculpture on the tablet, which was the beast god of Blood River World. However, it was not as distinct as the one Luo Feng had gotten before, and it did not contain any law.

“How marvelous the metal is. I’ve never heard of it.”

Luo Feng caressed the tablet and penetrated it with his spiritual force. The information struck his mind. It was the same as the one before. They even had identical coordinates.


Chapter 943: Land of Inheritance

True Yan Emperor took off from Primal Chaos City immediately after Luo Feng told him the news and arrived at the Primal Secret Region on the same day.

Inside the transportation center of the Primal Secret Region.

Luo Feng was dressed in black armor and True Yan Emperor in gold as they departed from their spaceship and landed on the boundless expanse of the Primal Secret Region. Here, many transportation channels had been built for the purpose of Godly Kingdom transportation. Creatures here didn’t need to fear the risk of discovery.

“Teacher, we’re far from the Land of Inheritance,” Luo Feng said. “Do you have the coordinates of any nearby locations?”

“The closest is 1 billion light years away,” True Yan Emperor said.

“That far?” Luo Feng was startled. A distance of 1 billion light years would take them a whole year to cross. “One of my servants has some coordinates. Maybe we can cut down on the journey by half a year or so.”

Luo Feng waved his hands, and a Barbarian creature covered with scales appeared. It had a purple membrane on its face, and its appearance drew the attention of many powerful warriors in the area.

Murmurs went up among the crowd. “It’s True Yan Emperor!”

“How is it possible that True Yan Emperor left Primal Chaos City?”

“He actually left?”

“Then who is the one with him? The man in the black armor?”

“Could that be Blade River Emperor? Everyone says Blade River Emperor is Luo Feng, and we all know Luo Feng is a student of True Yan Emperor. This black-armored man standing with True Yan Emperor… Can you feel the force emanating from him? It could be Blade River Emperor concealing his wings!”

None of these individuals made any efforts to lower their voices; they deliberately let Luo Feng hear them in order to observe his reaction.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor looked at one another.

They’re quite astute, True Yan Emperor said, speaking to Luo Feng telepathically. Your reputation precedes you.

It’s not surprising that they’ve guessed it, replied Luo Feng. Others already have. And rumor has it that my invaluable treasure is the Silver Wing. Besides, there are only so many powerful individuals within the human race, and everyone knows each other. It’s little wonder that an earthling whom they have never seen before—who suddenly shows up with you, of all people—is the subject of suspicion.

You’re in big trouble, True Yan Emperor teased.

Luo Feng shrugged. Eh. It’s not necessarily bad to be famous. He turned to his servant and said aloud, “Perform Godly Kingdom transportation.”

“Yes, master,” said the Barbarian servant.

It started the transportation process immediately. A flash of aqua-blue light surrounded Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor. In an instant, they saw a boundless world at the other end of the light. It was the Godly Kingdom of the Barbarian race.

Luo Feng, True Yan Emperor, and the servant all vanished.

They soon arrived at a quiet place far away from the territory of humans—a star in a remote region of the universe.

“Disguising a ship as a star?” said True Yan Emperor. “Your servant is very interesting.”

“There are infinite stars in the universe,” replied Luo Feng. “The perfect disguise for any object.”

The teacher and the student flew out to the blinding surface of the star-like object.

“How fast can your ship go?” True Yan Emperor asked.

“In the Dark Universe, 72 times of the speed of light,” said Luo Feng. He sighed. “I had one that was 10 percent faster, but it was taken away by a Universe Knight.”

“Ah, the Green Knight!” said True Yan Emperor with a nod. “How reckless you were to tangle with him.”

They had spoken at length in the Primal Secret Region, and True Yan Emperor had naturally asked Luo Feng how he had acquired the token. Luo Feng had briefed him—without divulging certain important information—about the events pertaining to his situation with the Blue Knight.

“I have a ship that’s 90 times lightspeed,” True Yan Emperor said. He smiled at the look on Luo Feng’s face. “Finally, I have something to be proud of.”

“90 times lightspeed?” Luo Feng was shocked.

True Yan Emperor waved his hands, and a streamlined, shuttle-shaped spaceship appeared in the sky. It shone with lustrous golden plating.

“Master,” came an elderly male voice from the spaceship. “You’re finally using me. I haven’t flown in the Dark Universe for years.”

“This is a Metal Life Form,” True Yan Emperor explained. “I haven’t let him out since I first arrived at Primal Chaos City. Come on, let’s get in.”

The door opened, and Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor entered the spaceship. As soon as they were aboard, the ship surged forward, and they entered the Dark Universe, increasing to lightspeed in an instant. The ship’s speed kept increasing after entering the Dark Universe.

“89 times, 90 times, 91 times—oh, it can’t go faster!” the Metal Life Form within the ship said joyfully. Suddenly, an image of a cute girl appeared on the control panel, and the ship’s voice changed from that of an elderly male to a youthful, energetic female. “Master is finally adventuring again. I have been so lonely!”

Luo Feng, in the middle of a sip of wine, promptly spat a mouthful all over the floor. “Where she come from?”

True Yan Emperor glared at the control panel. “Hey, weren’t you an old man before?”

“It’s been hundreds of millions of years!” squealed the Metal Life Form. “Is it really so surprising that I would transform?”

Luo Feng burst into laughter. “Teacher, let’s face it. Who among us wouldn’t change a little over hundreds of millions of years?”

True Yan Emperor shook his head.

Interstellar travel was a boring affair. The scene outside the ship never changed, and life within the ship went on almost as unchanging. Initially, Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor exchanged some pleasantries, but after getting drunk, they both went back to their cabins and started training. At 90 times lightspeed, it would take four months to reach the Land of Inheritance.

Inside the cabin, the body of the Mo Sha clan was present while the original earthling body went back to the Internal World and started to practice Nine-Calamity Tome.

Inside the Internal World, on the boundless prairie, Luo Feng looked at the Golden-Horned Beast from afar.

“It’s the third metal of Nine-Calamity Tome,” said Luo Feng, filled with delight. “It really is a lot.”

The first two metals he had gotten before only provided him with the tomes of the First, Second, and Fifth Calamity, and he lacked the tomes for all the other calamities. However, the third metal offered him the tomes of the Third and Fourth; thus, Luo Feng could practice three tomes consecutively.

“The First Calamity makes my genes three times stronger, and the Second makes them six times,” he said. “The Third, 12 times. The Fourth, 24 times.”

Luo Feng looked at the Golden-Horned Beast from afar. During the past 2,000 years spent in Ice Hell, the Golden-Horned Beast had already accomplished his goal. However, Luo Feng realized there was an issue. The Golden-Horned Beast’s genes were ten times stronger than those of humans. And now, after finishing the first Five Calamities of the Nine-Calamity Tome, the Golden-Horned Beast was 480 times more powerful than humans. It was outrageous to even comprehend. Not even Dokus—or Silver Eye—were more than 100 times stronger than humans.

“480 times… Unbelievable.” Luo Feng sighed. “That means when I become an Undying Knight, I’ll become 100,000 times stronger than a sector lord, while the Beast can become 48 million times stronger! Many of the Special Life Forms are not even that mighty.”

Special Life Forms generally had genes that possessed 100 times greater potential than those of humans, and even the weakest Special Life Forms were ten times stronger. A small number of Special Life Forms were 500 times more superior. Only a rare number of them could be 1,000 or even several thousand times finer. The more superior they got, the rarer they were. There were quite a few Dokus, whereas Beast Gods and Mountain Sitting Guest were one of a kind.

“I figured out before that the more superior one’s genes are, the less effective Blood River is,” said Luo Feng. “The force of Blood River could make its right hoof 100 times stronger and its entire body ten times stronger. However… it’s not omnipotent. It can strengthen humans and Golden-Horned Beasts, but can it enhance Beast Gods? It is, after all, the essence of the blood of Beast Gods.

The function of the force was obvious when the genes were at a low level. However, to individuals like Mountain Sitting Guest, it might provide zero benefit. The Golden-Horned Beast had been practicing the Nine-Calamity Tome for a long time, and it was already as powerful as a Special Life Form. When the Beast exercised the force again, the effect was significantly smaller.

“The right hoof of the Beast is still stronger,” said Luo Feng, “but it’s only twice as strong as the entire body.”

Luo Feng recalled that it had previously been ten times mightier than its body. Clearly, the strength of the right hoof could not be improved further. Neither the Fourth Calamity nor the Fifth couldn’t improve its strength, as it had already reached its limit.

“Once the force is exercised, the constitution of the Golden-Horned Beast’s body will be 1,000 times stronger,” Luo Feng mused. “That’s rare even for Special Life Forms. I suppose I should be content… I’ll keep practicing. No wonder Nine-Calamity Tome may only be borne by the Sky-Soul Crystal. Only one is qualified to practice it.”

Luo Feng became more and more powerful by practicing during the course of the journey, and the true power of the tome gradually showed.

Four months later, Luo Feng heard True Yan Emperor’s voice calling, “Student! Student! Come out! We’re arriving at the Land of Inheritance!”

Luo Feng smiled eagerly. The Land of Inheritance!


Chapter 944: Bauhinia Island

Inside the control room of the spaceship, Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor were looking at the outside through a virtual scene. One gale after another blew everything they touched, as if they were pythons playing among the stars.

“This is the legendary ancestral god secret region!” True Yan Emperor was amazed.

“The ancestral god secret region is one of the most dangerous secret regions in the universe,” Luo Feng said with wonder. “It’s the same size as a universe country, and dangerous areas are everywhere. Even universe knights can’t manage to survive it.”

There were various levels and areas of the secret regions. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor would certainly research the region, as they had known the coordinates. They were startled to find out that the land of inheritance was located in the ancestral god secret region. As a top-tier secret region filled with hazards and ordinary dangers that could kill a universe knight. In some extremely risky areas, even masters of the universe needed to be careful.

Its diameter was 160 million light years, and it took 200 million years to travel in sub-lightyear speed. One might need to start the adventure from the birth of the universe to pay the entire region even a cursory inspection. Besides, no one dared to do that.

Mysterious! Dangerous! Off-limits! These were the words that best described the ancestral god secret region.

“One of the most common things in this secret region is ‘Hei Chong Whirlpool,’” said True Yan Emperor. “Even a small whirlpool can severely injure a universe knight. And a large one can kill them for good. Look. Those are the Hei Chong Whirlpools ahead of us.”

“There are more of them at the back,” said Luo Feng.

True Yan Emperor turned around and saw a whirlpool that was billions of kilometers long running through the stars. If the whirlpools at the front were like pythons, and the one at the back was hundreds of millions of times mightier.

True Yan Emperor was stupefied. “This is the Hei Chong whirlpool at the periphery. Only the one at the outer right is so enormous.”

“We’ve arrived,” Luo Feng said and nodded his head.

The spaceship slowed down and stopped. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor flew out.

Among the stars were the Hei Chong Whirlpools chasing each other. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor stood amongst the stars and looked at each other.

“Where is it?” Luo Feng said, frowning. “I can’t see the land of inheritance.”

“Just wait,” True Yan Emperor said.

Suddenly, the space twisted and sucked them in like a series of swirls.

“Teleportation?” said Luo Feng.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor thought of this, and everything became clear. They were still both standing in hollow space, but the scene afar was breathtaking. The colorful river was running, emanating a mystical power that was highly enticing. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor both possessed strong wills and realized something was wrong.

“Quick enough,” they heard a cold voice say.

They turned around. An eight-meter-high rock undying stood in the hollow. He was dressed in a fiery armor and was green like an emerald. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor realized he was of the Fei Cang Clan, one of the rock creatures.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor were shocked, as they hadn’t realized anything else was here.

It’s a universe knight, Luo Feng thought. Only a universe knight can teleport without letting us recognize it.

Even I can’t sense it, True Yan Emperor thought, surprised.

“I’m the guide of Ancestral God School,” the knight said. “Give me the token, humans. Or you’ll die with it.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor both felt like they were trapped in a fire, and Luo Feng felt like a boat adrift, lost at sea.

The guide of the school? he thought.

There were gods, beast gods, deified generals, and prophets within the school, and prophets were the weakest. They were merely as powerful as the weakest universe knights. However, this creature of Fei Cang Clan emanated a force that was irresistible.

Teacher, is he a general? Luo Feng asked mentally.

It should be, True Yan Emperor answered.

They took out the tokens anyway.

“The tokens are rare,” the knight said with a smile. “No wonder the human race is one of the top six races. Sending two people with tokens at one time is impressive, indeed. Come with me.”

The knight was flying with Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor aside.

“Do you see that?” The knight pointed to the dreamy and colorful river.

They both nodded.

“Come and look at it closer.” The knight teleported them to beside the river.

“This is…?” Luo Feng held his breath.

It was no river; on the contrary, it was composed of auroras of five different colors. He could still see the river shape from afar, whereas he could only feel its boundlessness standing beside it.

“Is this the five-color aurora lake?” True Yan Emperor asked, thrilled at the idea.

“You do know something,” the knight complimented him. “Yes, it is indeed the five-color aurora lake.”

“A lake?” Luo Feng was bewildered and trying to look to the end of the river.

“Of course, it’s a lake,” the knight explained. “You see it as a river only because you’re standing on the same level of it. However, if you fly above and overlook it, you’ll see a circular lake. This lake has a diameter of ten light years and is almighty. One aurora can severely injure a universe knight, and it’s constituted by countless rays of auroras. It’s one of the most forceful invaluable treasures in the universe.”

Both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor were dazed. Even one aurora was this powerful?

“This lake is the guarding invaluable treasure of the Ancestral God School,” the knight continued. “Who will dare to trespass with such an invaluable treasure around?”

“One of the most powerful invaluable treasures? Guarding invaluable treasure?” True Yan Emperor sighed.

“No wonder the Ancestral God School is the first power of the universe.” Luo Feng recalled his star tower instead.

There were countless auroras on the surface of the lake, and together, it served as the guarding treasure of the Ancestral God School. The spiral of the star tower, which was made up of sealing stars, was also precious, and together with the heavenly pillar, the star tower was also one of the most forceful invaluable treasures in the universe, according to Mountain Sitting Guest.

“What an eye-opener for me to see the five-color aurora lake,” True Yan Emperor said.

“It’s lucky enough for you even to take a look at an invaluable treasure of this level,” the knight said, a bit proud. “There’s another invaluable treasure of this level: star tower. That’s something that can’t be moved by literally anyone, and lots of the powerful ones in the universe still don’t know the tower’s real power.”

“Star tower is also one of the most powerful invaluable treasures?” True Yan Emperor was shocked.

“It seems you don’t know everything.”

The knight shook his head. “Star tower is one of the easiest to see but also the most mystical invaluable treasures in the universe. Nobody’s been able to figure out the mystery behind it, and nobody can take it away. It’s been standing there forever.”

“I’m done talking, and I’ll take you to Bauhinia Island now,” said the knight. With that, he teleported.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor felt a bit dizzy before getting to the edge of the lake. They were only a few hundred meters away from it. Each of the auroras was around 10,000 kilometers long, and its force made Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor shiver.

“Did you see that?” The knight pointed to the deep of the lake. “That’s the Bauhinia Island.”

“What? Inside the lake?” They looked in that direction. They could indeed see a blurry island, dim among the auroras.

“Come in.” The knight flew directly inside.

“Go in? Even though the auroras are forceful?” True Yan Emperor couldn’t help asking.

“Rest assured, this is one of the most powerful treasures in the universe, and it won’t hurt anyone it recognizes,” the knight said. “You both have the tokens, and thus, you’ll both be fine.”

True Yan Emperor looked at Luo Feng and said, “Student, I’ll try first.” And then he touched an aurora with his hands. The aurora encircled his arm like running water without attacking him.

The knight didn’t say anything after seeing this. He had seen how careful and distrustful those heirs were.

“Let’s go,” True Yan Emperor said.

“Yes, teacher,” Luo Feng said and followed him into the lake.

They felt like they were marching in a real lake, and the auroras comforted their bodies. The island became larger and larger as they approached it.

“This is Bauhinia Island, where your beast god heirs will reside on,” the knight said just before they reached the island. “And this is the margin of the lake.”


Chapter 945: Guarding Beast God

Bauhinia Island, with a diameter of millions of kilometers, was far away from the auroras.

Xiu! Xiu! Xiu!

The knight, Luo Feng, and True Yan Emperor landed on the island like three beams of light.

“There are so many palaces,” said Luo Feng, looking at the palaces on the ground and on the mountain. He could literally feel the force coming from all the palaces in every area. He frowned. “There seem to be lots of powerful ones living here.”

“Look at that,” the knight said, pointing to the sky.

They both looked up.

“Huh?” said Luo Feng.

He saw halos enveloping the entire island. The halos kept swelling before they disappeared, and then, a new halo came into being. Each halo surrounded another in concentric circles like the ripples on the water. They were spreading. Born and vanished. Born and vanished. Again and again.

Each halo was made of threads of the law—the time law, space, gold, wood, water, fire, soil, wind, thunder, and light. Each law was mixed in each thread, which made the halos complete and perfect. Luo Feng was amazed as he realized the halos were actually manifesting the laws of the universe.

“You two!” the knight shouted.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor came back to reality.

“This is… This is…” True Yan Emperor was rendered speechless. “It’s incredible!”

“This is the periphery of the laws.” The knight looked at the halos ardently. “The ancestral god school is the first power of the universe and is responsible for maintaining the operation of the laws of the universe. And it’s protected by the laws.”

Luo Feng was bewildered. Maintaining the operation of the laws of the universe?

“The secret region of our school has the most special creatures and treasures,” the knight said with great confidence. “The five-colored aurora lake was also rewarded by the laws of the universe. What we’re doing is following the laws, and ancestral god school is defying the laws of the universe.”

“How overbearing it is,” Luo Feng murmured.

“You don’t believe it?” said the knight. “You’ll understand after living here for hundreds of millions of years.” The knight glanced at Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor.

“Hundreds of millions of years?” Luo Feng was baffled.

“Come with me,” said the knight. “The first thing to do is to build a dwelling place on the island.”

The knight walked quickly with Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor following him. One step was a thousand kilometers, and they reached the destination in no time. They could see all forms of palaces and powerful ones of all races while walking on the island. There were billions of races, and all of them were mystical with different shapes and characteristics. Luo Feng could recognize some of the special creatures.

“How many residents are there on the island?” Luo Feng wondered.

“Other than the island owner, all of the others are the heirs,” the knight said. “My job is to lead you here, and I’ll leave soon. There are a plethora of heirs. You can calculate yourselves. There have been only a few hundred human heirs since the birth of the universe. And when you take into account the entire universe? It’s a fair universe, and the tokens were distributed everywhere. There are hundreds of millions of races in the universe, and adding all of them together makes tens of billions of heirs.”

“Tens of billions of heirs?” Luo Feng stared at the knight.

“There are really that many heirs?” True Yan Emperor found it hard to believe.

“It’s a vast universe, and humanity is only one of the many races,” the knight explained. “Only the ancestral gods know how many heirs there are. Of course, there are only 100 million living on the island.”

“100 million?” Luo Feng pondered. “What about the others?”

“If an heir dies, the Universe master will reverse the time to bring back rather the heir than the token. It’s too costly to bring back a token, and even a Universe master is reluctant to pay the price.” The knight continued, “Each of the heirs comes with a token, and the second you step in here, your life and the token are bound. The token will be shattered if you die, and it can never be reused. Many powerful heirs died. That’s why there are only 100 million of them now.” The knight finished explaining.

They walked to the ground beside a river. The knight said, “You two will build a palace here. Remember, each palace can be no longer or wider than one kilometer. Even those enormous demon races and sky beasts need to shrink to fit the designated space. There are no exceptions.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor nodded. They didn’t see any palace that was over one square kilometer.

“Also! You can leave some authenticating objects in the palace to make sure you can God Country Teleport yourselves here,” the knight said. “You’ll visit the island very often unless you die. If you have soul servants, don’t bring them out. They will be destroyed by the lake. Keep them in the palace, as it’s your place. Don’t ever bring them out. Of course, botanic or metal life forms are the exceptions.”

“We get it.” Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor followed the instructions carefully.

“Come with me,” the knight said and continued briefing them, as he was the guide.

After a short while, they arrived at the tallest mountain where sat a towering palace that was a thousand square kilometers.

“The owner of this island, unlike you heirs, is not restricted.” The knight pointed at the towering palace and said, “That’s the palace of the owner. Let’s go.”

They walked up the mountain.

“Look up,” the knight said, pointing at the sky.

They both followed the knight.

“What is it?”

Luo Feng saw something inconceivably spectacular. He could see a crack inside the lake, inside which a magnificent and extensive palace was located. There were eight sub-palaces surrounding the glowing main palace.

“That is the core of the school,” the knight said admiringly. “That’s the largest palace, which is the ancestral god palace, where the ancestral gods live. Although there are three ancestral gods, only one of them is sitting here. The eight palaces around it are the beast god palace, where the beast gods reside. And there are around a dozen palaces around each beast god palace, which are the guarding beast god palaces.”

“Outside the beast god palaces,” continued the knight, “are the locations of 72 lands, only 63 of which are in our view, of course. And the 72 generals are living there. Each of the general’s land is as large as Bauhinia Island. There are 3,000 stars on the margin, and those are 3,000 starry worlds, on which live the prophets. All these constitute the core of the ancestral god school.” The knight sighed. “Other than these center places, there are lots of islands on the five-color aurora lake, and there are many sub-members of the school living there.”

“Sub-members?” Both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor looked at him in shock.

“Yes. They’re candidates of the prophets and deified generals, and powerful heirs of the beast god.” The knight couldn’t help laughing. “Humans, do you really think there’s free food available in the universe? Remember, it’s a fair universe, and our school is not a charity. We paid a huge price for the inheritance crystals of prophets and the land of inheritance of the generals and the beast gods. You’ll certainly have to pay for it.”

“However…” continued the knight. “The school won’t care much about the weak. That’s why those who receive the inheritance of prophets and deified generals won’t be required to work for the school unless they receive a complete inheritance. However, once one obtains the complete inheritance, like that of deified generals, the entire land of inheritance will crumble.”

Luo Feng’s heart skipped a beat. He recalled that he had been told something similar in the demon-note general’s land of inheritance— that if anyone received a complete inheritance, the entire land would disintegrate.

“All the candidates of prophets and deified generals have received the complete inheritances,” said the knight. “As for those following the path of beast gods, the most powerful ones have reached an extremely supreme level and are close to the complete inheritances. Note this: The school needs to pay a higher price for beast god inheritance, and those who are on the way to triumph will also need to sacrifice more. These are the sub-members.”


Chapter 946: Three Paths

“Then what about the guarding beast god palaces?” Luo Feng couldn’t help asking.

“Guarding beast gods are the ones who gain the complete beast god inheritance and have become masters of the universe,” the knight explained. “They didn’t become actually beast gods either because there were no vacancies, or they themselves didn’t want to inherit the positions in the first place. After all, your power can be significantly improved after inheriting the position, but that’s the end of it.”

“Masters of the universe are the greatest and mightiest beings in the universe, no matter where they are,” the knight continued. “The ancestral god school will respect their will and make them ‘guarding beast gods’ even if they don’t want to inherit the positions.”

Both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor nodded. There was no such thing as a free meal, and everything came at a price. The ancestral god school wouldn’t give resources away without being paid back. For those who had enough potential, the school didn’t care for returns, whereas for those who could gain a complete inheritance, the school would demand something back.

“Rest assured.” The knight smiled. “The ancestral god school is arguably the freest power in the universe, and it has no intention of fighting for other territories. The dangers in the secret region are enough to intimidate other powers. Even if you become the sub-members of the school, you won’t feel restricted.” The knight shook his head. “Of course, it all means nothing if you can’t even become a sub-member in the first place, which is difficult to begin with. No matter which path you’re following—prophet inheritance, general inheritance or beast god inheritance—they’re all highly demanding!”

Luo Feng listened carefully and nodded. None of the hundreds of thousands of creatures in the land of demon-note deified general inheritance managed to get the complete inheritance. However, the land accepted 32 creatures for every 10,081 eras, and the creatures there only tried for 50 million eras, which was a blink of an eye compared to the history of the universe.

“The owner of Bauhinia Island is a guarding beast god.” The knight looked at the towering palace.

“Guarding beast god?” Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor followed him.

There were quite a few sculptures on that palace. Some were like lizards, some were like roaring apes, and some were like birds. Although there were tens of thousands of sculptures, they could all be classified into eight categories. Luo Feng understood them to be the images of the beast gods.

In front of the palace of the island’s owner was an enormous square, which was a section of a mountain. There were three flowing springs on the spectacular square, with their water coming seemingly from out of nowhere. However, the ground on the square was not wet at all.

The knight, Luo Feng, and True Yan Emperor walked to the springs and looked at the door of the palace.

“Get inside,” the knight said. “My job is done here. I hope you can live longer on the island instead of falling, as you won’t be able to come back with another token. I bet few races will give you a token twice.”

“Thank you, knight.” Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor appreciated the knight’s instruction.

The knight smiled and flew into the auroras like a beam of light.

“Let’s go, student.” True Yan Emperor smiled.

“Sure.”

Inside sat a human wearing a simple black cape. He had long blue hair and blue engravings. A dimming force was emanating from him, reserved yet terrifying. Luo Feng felt he must be at least a universe knight.

“A human?” Luo Feng was startled. “Is he the guarding beast god?”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor exchanged a glance. The guarding beast god was a human?

The man stood up, looked at them, and smiled. “I didn’t expect to see humans here. How wonderful. You guys can stop guessing, I’m only a servant of the island owner instead of a guarding beast god. My job is to guard the palace and message the island owner.”

“A servant?” Both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor missed a heartbeat. A soul slave of a universe knight level? And he was a human?

Of course, thought Luo Feng. If I can enslave the barbarian races, then the barbarian races can enslave humans, too. Besides, guarding beast gods are masters of the universe. It’s not surprising for them to have a universe-knight level slave.

Luo Feng could only console himself in this manner.

True Yan Emperor looked at the black-caped man and said, “We’re the new heirs and are here to greet the guarding beast god.”

The man smiled. “You just wait here. I’ve already passed the message to the guarding beast god, but he’s currently busy. Please be patient.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor gave each other a look.

Let’s just wait.

They could only wait for the guarding beast god.

After half a day of waiting, both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor were tired out. Luo Feng asked, “When will the guarding beast god arrive?”

“Be patient,” the man said with another smile. “The issues the guarding beast god is dealing with are much more important, and you guys are not in a rush. According to the rules of the ancestral god school, it will take the ancestral god ten years to show up. If the guarding beast gods know they can’t make it in ten years, other guarding beast gods will take over.”

“Ten years?”

“It ranges from an instant to ten years,” said the sitting man. “The unluckiest guests I received in the past waited for three days shy of ten years. So, please sit down and be patient. Just wait!”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor sat down without knowing when they could meet the island owner.

After twelve days.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor sat on the courtyard of the palace with their eyes closed. Suddenly, they felt an almighty force surrounding the palace. They both opened their eyes instantly.

“It’s the guarding beast god.”

They both stood up, and the knight was already inside the main hall.

They heard a high voice from the hall say, “Come in.”

They both went in, and Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor saw a figure on the throne. It was a special life form in dragon-shape. It possessed wings and strange armor on its body and looked down upon them. There were tongues of flames on the armor, which made Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor feel like they were being engulfed in fire and the special creature was the controller of space. The dragon could kill them with a snap of its fingers.

Guarding beast god, Luo Feng thought to himself. It should be following the path of fire, space.

“From now on, you’re the heirs of Bauhinia Island,” the guarding beast god said. “First of all, I’ll grant you access to the world of glory.”

Two mini-quantum computers appeared after it finished talking, and they flew to Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor.

“This is the receiver of the virtual world,” said the guarding beast god. “The world of glory is the virtual universe of the ancestral god school, and it’s akin to humans’ virtual universe. Although it’s much smaller, they have similar functions. You’ll know when you land on it.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor took the receivers.

“I’ll also grant you the access to the land of inheritance, the land of treasures, and the land of the secret region,” the guarding beast god said. “Did you see the three water curtains outside?”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor nodded. Water curtains? Weren’t those springs?

“That’s the portal,” the guarding beast god continued. “It’s impossible for you to get in without my permission. The one on the left is the portal to the land of inheritance, the one in the middle is to the land of treasures, and the one on the right is to the land of the secret region. Three water curtains are portals to three different places. The land of inheritance is where you accept the beast god inheritance, and you’ll be tested how much you understand the laws.

“In the land of treasures are buried all the valuables left by the beast gods, guarding beast gods, and the powerful ones following the path of beast gods. Not long ago, one of your humans gained a treasure.

“As for the land of the secret region, you can go there for adventures. The secret region of the ancestral god school is the most mysterious secret region in the universe, where reside the most special creatures and the most mystical riches. Even universe knights can be killed, and even masters of the universe can be trapped. Prepare to die if you decide to adventure there.”

“The land of inheritance, the land of treasures, and the land of the secret region, together with the world of glory, are the four places you need to be familiar with. Go build a palace first, and then go to the land of inheritance.” The guarding beast god looked down on them. “Go.”

“Yes, island owner,” they said.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor saluted it before exiting.


Chapter 947: Inheritance

There were hundreds of millions of heirs on the Bauhinia Island. Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor went to the location the knight had given them and started to build a palace.

“Concentrate!” Luo Feng said.

He used force of world in his internal world to build a mansion. It was an enormous courtyard that resembled the Jiang Nan garden of ancient China. There were paths made of cobblestones, and all sorts of flowers were planted on the side.

At the corner of the courtyards sat a pool of water. The water was the essence of a Jiang Nan Garden. There was a stone bridge above the water, and pavilions were placed around it. Besides, there were lots of individual bedrooms and living rooms, and in front of some of the rooms were pools where rock gardens could be seen.

Although the entire garden was only one square kilometer, it was constructed in a mesmerizing way, which was exactly how Luo Feng remembered his hometown. Lots of the gardens had been destroyed during the grand nirvana, but some of the rich built the gardens during the base city era. Luo Feng had learned about it before, when he was a student, and he had an extraordinary memory. All he did was memorize the pictures on the history textbooks. Luo Feng used lots of force of world techniques to solidify the garden.

Luo Feng pointed to the mountain afar.

“Get out!”

Hong!

Another private garden appeared. Afar were the undulating hills which merged as one with the rivers, gardens around them.

“Student, you’re…” True Yan Emperor was still building a huge palace while glimpsing at the residence Luo Feng built. “Extraordinary.”

“Teacher, you can’t actually feel the secret of my hometown by using your godly power. Come inside.” Luo Feng smiled and led True Yan Emperor inside.

True Yan Emperor had adventured the universe long enough to see quite a lot. There were countless other forms of designs of architecture on the Bauhinia Island, and they were just as delicate as the one Luo Feng built. However, True Yan Emperor had never seen something like this.

True Yan Emperor said with surprise, as walking on the stone bridge, “It’s incredible. I feel like it’s dozens of times larger than it actually is. There are different scenes of the same pool at different angles.”

Luo Feng smiled. “A single step can shift the scene, and this is the mystery of it. And all the scenes are breathtaking in a unique way based on the visual guide.”

“Can you make me one?” True Yan Emperor asked him.

“How can I not? You’ve already asked me.” Luo Feng made another garden of a slightly different type. The garden he had made for himself was more akin to those during the Ming and Qing dynasties, while the one for his teacher was of the Tang dynasty, which was more majestic.

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor went back to the square in front of the palace of the Bauhinia Island owner.

“Let’s go.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor entered the spring on the left.

The moment they touched the spring, they disappeared. The scene changed completely, and before Luo Feng could get a clear sight of his surroundings, he felt a terrifying force.

Hong!

The force was stronger than anything in Ice Hell, and he felt like dozens of neutron stars on his body, together with lots of other souls.

“What is this?” Luo Feng asked.

He could finally see everything clearly, and it was hollow surrounded by black mist around him. There was a huge aerolite floating in the hollow, and a purple-armored powerful one with a wolf head was sitting on it. It belonged to one of the most populous branches of the human race—Werewolf.

The werewolf was surprised to see Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor. He laughed and said, “You must be Blade River Emperor and True Yan Emperor. I knew you two are coming.”

“Greetings, Jiu Feng Knight,” True Yan Emperor saluted him.

“Greetings, Jiu Feng Knight.” Luo Feng bowed to him as well, but he was baffled.

Just then, True Yan Emperor started to talk to him in his mind. Student, Jiu Feng Knight is one of the seven-star overlords of the human race, and he’s an equal of the master of the heaven erosion palace. Rumor has it that he received the complete inheritance of deified generals.

Luo Feng was startled. Complete inheritance? An equal of the master of the heaven erosion palace?

“This is the land of inheritance of the ancestral god school,” said Jiu Feng Knight looked at the two of them with a smile. “Naturally, there’s a powerful force, which is to suppress the soul seals in the godly bodies. Creatures less powerful than emperor-level undying will die under the force, which is why only the undying can be granted the tokens. After all, talents who can get the tokens are all at least as powerful as the emperors. Can you see the black mist surrounding us?” Jiu Feng Knight pointed around.

Both Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor nodded. It was such a strange district. Neither godly power nor world power could detect anything, and it was surrounded by black mist.
