Although the ocean was boundless—and there might be more valuables hidden there than on all the other islands combined—it was also more hazardous than all the other islands combined.

The most dangerous thing in the Nine Remoteness Ocean was the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool in the core of the ocean. Once someone was trapped in it, it would be almost impossible to survive even for a universe knight.

Here Crow Knight was worried. “If you want to go to Nine Remoteness Ocean, I’ll come with you. But I need to make sure of one thing. You’re not going to the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool, are you?”

Bark Mirror Emperor shook his head. “Of course not. I’m confident, not reckless. There is danger everywhere in Nine Remoteness Ocean. I might dare to venture into other places, but I’ll avoid the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool at all costs.”

Here Crow Knight was relieved. “Fine,” he said. “I’ll come with you and explore Nine Remoteness Ocean.”

“Haha!” Bark Mirror Emperor’s squeaky voice gave him a shrill laugh.

Here Crow Knight laughed along with him.

The other five great beings looked at each other and consulted with one another telepathically.

What’re we supposed to do? Here Crow Knight and Bark Mirror Emperor are both going to the Nine Remoteness Ocean. What should we do?

Without them, our chance of surviving on the other islands is small. But if we follow them, we might be able to arrive at some magical places and get some treasures by luck. We’re their teammates. They won’t attack us.

We’ve been trapped at this stage for an eternity. I’ll take my chances. Let’s go.

I’ll follow.

Nine Remoteness Ocean is arguably the most dangerous place here. It’ll be worth it even if we die there.

The five undying heirs had made their decisions.

“Here Crow Knight, Bark Mirror Emperor, we’ll follow you.”

“Yeah. Any island in Nine Remoteness Space is dangerous. We’d rather go with you guys.”

“We’ll all come with you.”

Bark Mirror Emperor and Here Crow Knight were glad to bring them along.

“Let me search for any danger within the one billion square miles around us first,” Bark Mirror Emperor said.

“Please do, Bark Mirror Emperor.”

The other six, including Here Crow Knight, all stepped back. Bark Mirror Emperor had the best probing skills in the universe. He stepped forward and concentrated. The intricate engravings on his scales started to glow, and his golden eyes emanated an illusion that seemed to be a reflection of the surrounding space.

“Ahead of us…” said Bark Mirror Emperor, looking ahead. He said calmly and confidently, “There’s no danger on the island. When we cross the island, we’ll arrive at Nine Remoteness Ocean. The danger within 20 million miles of Rock Island can be ignored. The deeper into the ocean, the more dangerous it is. I’ve already discovered a universe-knight-level creature.”

Bark Mirror Emperor looked in another direction.

He claimed to be looking. Actually, it was his talent technique known as “Universe Mirror,” which could inspect everything within one billion square miles by reflecting it in the mirror. All the danger was visible on the mirror, unless it was a universe master who could completely manipulate the time and space of an area. Otherwise, nothing could evade the Universe Mirror. Other great beings wouldn’t even realize that they were being probed.

“I’ve found an undying-level special organism,” he said. He looked to his left and was momentarily dazed. “Huh?” Then he gave a weird smile.

“Bark Mirror Emperor, what did you find?” Here Crow Knight couldn’t help asking after seeing him smile like that.

“Haha… Take a guess!” Bark Mirror Emperor’s look was perplexing, which confused Here Crow Knight and the other five undying heirs. “It’s the famous Blade River Emperor.”

Here Crow Knight and the five undying heirs were all stunned.

“Blade River Emperor?”

“Interesting that Blade River Emperor has the guts to come to Nine Remoteness Space,” said Bark Mirror Knight. “I’ve heard that he has a set of wings that help him fly away. It’s a true treasure. I didn’t have the chance to kill him on Bauhinia Island, but now is a great opportunity.” He stuck out his thick, red tongue and licked his fangs.

“Bark Mirror Emperor, are you serious?” Here Crow Knight was shocked.

“Humph!” said Black Mirror Emperor. “You might not dare to act, but I’m from the Northern Territory Alliance, and we’re not afraid of that human alliance. You don’t need to be a part of it if you don’t want to, Here Crow Knight. Just behave yourself and don’t reveal my intentions to Blade River Emperor. Otherwise, you’ll make yourself my enemy.”

“Rest assured, I won’t meddle,” Here Crow Knight said, nodding.

Northern Territory Alliance was the alliance with the most members, and it was also one of the superpowers of the universe. It could rival the alliances of the peak races like the human race, the demon race, and the bug race.

“Let’s go.”

Bark Mirror Emperor smirked and flew away slowly. He didn’t dare to go too fast, as he didn’t want Luo Feng to notice him.

Greed filled Bark Mirror Emperor’s golden eyes. “It’ll be worth it for me to come to Nine Remoteness Space if I can get those wings. I won’t even need to risk going to Nine Remoteness Ocean after I succeed.” He was a special organism and was naturally greedy and ruthless. However, instead of being ashamed of how he was, he chose to be proud of it.

In the cave of the mountain.

Luo Feng used the micro-detector to conceal himself as he sat with his legs crossed. He had no idea that Bark Mirror Emperor had used Universe Mirror to detect him. Obviously, Bark Mirror Emperor was skilled enough not to be found by the micro-detector.

“One month left,” said Luo Feng. “After a month, I can get the World Tree’s twigs and leaves and breed my third body. After which, I can be an undying fighter.”

Luo Feng was looking forward to what was going to happen without realizing that seven great beings had already arrived at the mountain.

“Stop,” Bark Mirror Emperor said.

Here Crow Knight and the other five followed.

“That human has a micro-detector.” Bark Mirror Emperor sniggered. “Unfortunately, those detectors are useless. Even the top-tier detectors from the automaton race can’t compare with my techniques.”

“Seal!”

Bark Mirror Emperor looked at the mountain in front of him and used Space Seal. Suddenly, the space ripple in almost half the Rock Island stopped.

“Go in,” he said.

Sou!

Bark Mirror Emperor rushed into the mountain.

Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!

The other six followed him.

“Something’s wrong,” Luo Feng said, glancing at some of the gravel in the cave as he sensed Space Seal. One of the gravels was a keepsake, and there was a second one hidden in another cave. They were used by his servants to position God Country Transportation.

“Even if I leave temporarily, I can still transport myself here directly.”

Sou!

Luo Feng opened his wings and flew out of the cave instantly. He felt a remarkable source of strength storming toward him the moment he rushed out of the cave a saw a great being that looked like a werewolf flying toward him. He had golden hair and golden eyes and was covered in scales, which were filled with engravings.

“Bark Mirror Emperor!” Luo Feng said.

He was startled. Dealing with one of the most famous special organisms on Bauhinia Island would be a handful. Bark Mirror Emperor was proficient in tracking and hunting, and he was greedy and merciless. Luo Feng shook his wings and sped up.

Sou!

“Haha, Blade River Emperor, are you really trying to flee from me?” laughed Bark Mirror Emperor. “I’m known for my tracking skills, and I aced space law. Besides, I’m innately fast and have a godly body much better than yours. So, let’s see who’s faster, you or me!”

Bark Mirror Emperor sped up, chasing after Luo Feng.

Bark Mirror Emperor had a mighty godly body, and his constitution was 2,000 times better than that of normal great beings. Human emperor limits were 100,000 times stronger than sector lords, whereas Bark Mirror Emperor was 200,000 times stronger, which made him equal to a universe knight—a powerful godly body with a natural gift for speed.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Bark Mirror Emperor was speeding up. Luo Feng sped up too but was astonished to see that Bark Mirror Emperor was gaining on him.

“What?” he said. “Second form!”

Luo Feng had to admit that he had underestimated Bark Mirror Emperor. He didn’t have time to think of anything else. Instead, he initiated the second form, and the plumes on that wings became sharp like sabers.

Hua, hua!

The wings tore the surrounding space apart, resulting in significant space turbulence. His body appeared blurry within the turbulence.


Chapter 977: Fight

Bark Mirror Emperor, chasing Luo Feng, was also trapped in the space turbulence, where there were all kinds of space fragments. Each space fragment was as enormous as a planet, which slowed him down as he rampaged among the fragments. He couldn’t concentrate on chasing Luo Feng anymore. However, instead of becoming upset, Bark Mirror Emperor grew joyful.

“True treasures are indeed impressive!” he shouted. “But you, as a mere human, are not qualified for such true treasures. As a special organism, only I am good enough for them! Give me the true treasures, and I’ll spare your life.”

Hong!

Bark Mirror Emperor’s force surged; he was already burning his godly body. For true treasures, he was willing to burn his godly body. Besides, the Northern Territory Alliance provided him with endless resources just to attract him, and he had abundant valuables to use to recover his godly body.

Hong!

Bark Mirror Emperor had a godly body that was more powerful than that of an ordinary knight, and once he started to burn it, his power soared.

Hong, long, long!

Bark Mirror Emperor sped up again, opening a wide portal among the space turbulence and crushing all the space fragments in his way.

Luo Feng sensed Bark Mirror Emperor’s speed skyrocket, nearly catching up to him.

“I’m slower than him…!” Luo Feng realized. He shook his wings.

Shua! Shua! Shua! Shua! Shua! Shua!

He started to change directions continuously like a butterfly, pausing, darting, then zigzagging back and forth. Sometimes he rushed forward, sometimes he flew to his left, and sometimes he made a sharp turn. Generally, the faster one went, the more difficult it was to change directions. It was just like a sports car—the greater the speed, the higher the risk of rolling the vehicle while trying to navigate a turn.

Bark Mirror Emperor was unprepared for this. “He’s quite maneuverable!”

Bark Mirror Emperor was following Luo Feng as his directions changed. When flying straight, Luo Feng couldn’t match Bark Mirror Emperor’s speed, even he performed the second form of Shi Wu Wing and caused space turbulence. However, Bark Mirror Emperor panicked as he attempted to quickly change direction.

“Seal!” Bark Mirror Emperor got furious and used his undying power to suppress Luo Feng, but it was torn by Luo Feng’s Shi Wu Wings.

“Bark Mirror Emperor, why are you coming after me?” Luo Feng said. “My wings were given to me by a universe master. Even if you take them, they will be taken back in the future.”

“Haha! Don’t scare me with universe masters,” said Bark Mirror Emperor excitedly. “The Northern Territory Alliance has universe masters, too! No wonder it’s a true treasure. My constitution is way better than yours, and I’m faster than you. But I’m not as maneuverable. I can only speed up again and again to make sure you can’t get away.”

Here Crow Knight and the other five undying heirs flew in the sky above the Nine Remoteness Ocean as they watched Bark Mirror Emperor hunt Blade River Emperor.

“Bark Mirror Emperor can’t catch up with Blade River Emperor even after burning his godly body? Those wings really must be a true treasure.”

“Burning his godly body can speed him up, but the faster he gets, the more difficult it is for him to change his directions,” Here Crow Knight said. “Bark Mirror Emperor can only guarantee that he’s not left far behind. He should be attacking now.”

Bark Mirror Emperor couldn’t catch up. After a while, a purple crystal ball showed up in front of him.

Sou!

The purple crystal ball flew above Luo Feng much faster than Bark Mirror Emperor under his undying power. It quickly expanded and turned into a huge purple star with a diameter of thousands of miles, and a massive hole appeared under it.

Hong, long, long!

A whirlpool formed in the hole, and a forceful, swallowing power dashed Luo Feng. Under its effects, Luo Feng couldn’t maintain his balance.

“This is my sealing treasure,” Bark Mirror Emperor said with a laugh. “Though I can’t comprehend all of space law, with this treasure and my burning godly body, my sealing skills are better than that of a universe knight. Let’s see you break free of that!”

Luo Feng was trapped within an endless swallowing force.

Usually, creatures attack their enemies first and then seal an enemy when they are severely injured and can’t put up a fight anymore, Luo Feng roared in his heart. Yet you attempt to seal me first? Not possible!

“Shi Wu Wing, break it!”

Suddenly, the edges of his Shi Wu Wings sliced the surrounding space into pieces.

Of the many different kinds of treasures, sealing treasures were effective for sealing, but they had weak attacking power. Unless the great being was significantly inferior to the treasure, it was impossible for a sealing treasure to swallow a great being.

Chi, chi, chi, chi!

Shi Wu Wing kept slicing the space, and Luo Feng finally broke out.

“Huh?” Bark Mirror Emperor was dazed, but then he smirked. “True treasures are indeed impressive. Blade River Emperor, I didn’t want to kill you in the first place, but now, you brought this upon yourself.”

Bark Mirror Emperor opened his mouth…

“Silence!”

Everything turned quiet in the sky and land as Bark Mirror Emperor opened his mouth incredibly wide.

Here Crow Knight and the other five undying heirs were terrified and began murmuring to each other.

“If Bark Mirror Emperor howls, Blade River Emperor won’t survive it!”

“But Blade River Emperor has clone technique.”

“Either way, this body is not going to survive it, and his true treasures will fall into the hands of Bark Mirror Emperor.”

Here Crow Knight had the same thought, as Bark Mirror Emperor’s two talent techniques were distinctive in the universe. One of them was inspection, and the other was attack. He could see everything with his inspection technique… but he could crush a soul with his attacking technique.

The moment Bark Mirror Emperor opened his mouth, Luo Feng felt an invisible force.

“Howl!”

Even Luo Feng was knocked unconscious by this attack’s immensely powerful will. The soul roar was trying to annihilate his very soul.

Meanwhile, Tower Pearl, which guarded the core of Luo Feng’s soul, suddenly appeared, started to shine, and surrounded his soul. The roaring continued.

In front of Luo Feng’s soul, Bark Mirror Emperor’s head appeared, its phantom image opening its bloody mouth and bellowing at Luo Feng.

Weng-weng-weng!

The Tower Pearl started to tremble.

Luo Feng’s soul shook. The willpower around his soul had been destroyed. Only his core, which was being protected by Tower Pearl, resisted the force.

“Howl!”

Weng!

Tower Pearl strived to protect the soul.

Luo Feng regained consciousness. “How terrifying!” he mumbled, startled by the realization of what had just happened. “Before the Tower Pearl showed up, that attack knocked me unconscious. Apparently, I can’t resist it in the slightest. If it weren’t for the Tower Pearl, I would’ve been crushed. Even the Tower Pearl had a hard time resisting it.”

The more powerful the special organisms were, the more incredible their talent techniques were. Silver Eye was merely mediocre. Special organisms like Bark Mirror Emperor and Zhu Chong Emperor were the real talents.

“Time to run…!”

Luo Feng dove toward the Nine Remoteness Ocean, knowing he couldn’t get away no matter how skillfully he changed directions. Nine Remoteness Ocean was the largest and most dangerous place in Nine Remoteness Space, especially with considering the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool, but Luo Feng couldn’t worry about that right now.

Peng!

Water in the ocean was blasted away as Luo Feng traveled down into the Nine Remoteness Ocean.

“Impossible!” Bark Mirror Emperor said, blown away by what he had just seen. He couldn’t believe Blade River Emperor could resist the attack he was proudest of. His face was twitching as he dove into Nine Remoteness Ocean.

In the sky above the ocean.

Here Crow Knight and the other five undying heirs were dazed.

“He resisted it?”

“He didn’t die?”

They found it unbelievable.

Here Crow Knight kept shaking his head. “Bark Mirror Emperor’s godly body is so powerful that he can rival universe knights. Now that he’s burning his undying power to perform his talent technique, that attack can rival that of a universe overlord. How could the human, Blade River Emperor, withstand that?”

“Here Crow Knight,” said another heir, “Bark Mirror Emperor has the power of a universe knight, and he just burned his power to use his talent technique. How could Blade River Emperor repel that power? Unless… he has another true treasure used to protect his soul!”

“A true treasure to protect his soul?” The other heirs were dazed.

“That’s right, a true treasure,” Here Crow Knight said, nodding. “He has a soul, and he himself can’t defend against that attack. It had to be the true treasure—a true treasure used to protect his soul! Bark Mirror Emperor has two true treasures. The humans value Blade River Emperor so much that it’s certainly possible he has two true treasures.”

“Two true treasures!” Other five heirs couldn’t believe it.

“This is insane,” said Here Crow Knight, incredibly jealous. He was a universe knight, yet he didn’t have even one.

Bark Mirror Emperor and Zhu Chong Emperor both had two true treasures, and so did Blade River Emperor.

“If I’m lucky enough to have it, I’ll just hide,” said Here Crow Knight. “Two treasures, one used to flee and the other used to protect my soul.”

Aggression flashed across Here Crow Knight’s eyes. He dove toward the ocean, too.

In the cold, oppressive ocean, the water emanated a heart-stopping force.

Hong, long, long!

Bark Mirror Emperor kept chasing Luo Feng and kept and space sealed. At the same time, he roared, “Human, there’s no way you can escape. You could withstand my talent technique attack, which means you have a real treasure to protect your soul! It has to be! They’re both mine! Mine!”

Bark Mirror Emperor had gone crazy. A true treasure to protect souls was much rarer and much more precious than a flying true treasure.

Sou!

Luo Feng kept changing his direction in Nine Remoteness Ocean and dove deeper and deeper into this deadly area.


Chapter 978: Nine Remoteness Whirlpool

Deep in Nine Remoteness Ocean, each drop of water was as heavy as a mountain, but Luo Feng and Bark Mirror Emperor shot like missiles through the depths.

“Blade River Emperor, there’s no way you can escape!” Bark Mirror Emperor roared insanely. “Haha! You’re good at escaping and resisting soul attacks, but unless you have a flying-palace true treasure, I refuse to believe you can defend yourself against my material strike! Die!”

Hong!

Bark Mirror Emperor waved his paws, and a stream of terrifying undying power manifested as a blurry gray beam that shot toward Luo Feng, still trying to escape by changing his directions irregularly.

Luo Feng was startled. “Damn it…!”

Although Bark Mirror Emperor followed the warrior path, releasing undying power was a rather easy way to attack. Normally, it was relatively weak, but Bark Mirror Emperor had extraordinary undying power, which he was currently burning. Even this weak tactic would be enough to kill Luo Feng if he was hit.

There were many kinds of true treasures. Sky Wolf Palace and Star Tower belonged to the “flying palace” category of true treasures.

When it came to avoiding a fight, such true treasures would come in handy. If Luo Feng were able to hide inside Sky Wolf Palace, enemies couldn’t hurt him even if they bombed Sky Wolf Palace continuously.

Unfortunately, I don’t have that kind of true treasure, thought Luo Feng.

He maintained his high speed, and each time his Shi Wu Wings shook, the shockwave resulted in great space turbulence.

Hong!

A pillar of undying power cut through the ocean. Space turbulence and erupted to Luo Feng’s right.

“I’ve dodged it,” Luo Feng thought, relieved. His high-speed changes of direction made him difficult to hit.

“Haha!” Bark Mirror Emperor laughed. “I was right. You don’t have flying palace-type true treasures. Blade River Emperor, you’re relying on your wings to escape and your soul true treasure to resist soul attacks. Unfortunately, you don’t have a true treasure to defend yourself against a material strike. You’re doomed. Let’s see how many more times you can dodge it!”

Hong! Hong!

Two pillars of undying power were fired at Luo Feng. There was no law comprehension in them; on the contrary, they depended on burning, undying power that could rival universe knights.

Madness filled Bark Mirror Emperor’s eyes. “I can’t catch up with you, but my undying power can!”

He was far stronger than Luo Feng and chased him as if trying to swat a troublesome insect. The insect may have been agile and armed with soul true treasures, but if Bark Mirror Emperor used pure undying power to crush him…

Unless Luo Feng had a true treasure like Sky Wolf Palace, he would have no chance of survival!

Should I summon Mosha body back? Luo Feng wondered, still changing his directions irregularly.

A pillar of undying power flashed beside him while the following one clipped the edge of his wing, spinning Luo Feng around. He was stunned but still managed to change directions again rapidly, making the best of Shi Wu Wings.

Although Mosha body has the talent technique “domain,” it only works on the body itself—it can’t carry me, Luo Feng thought.

This was the limitation of domain. It was a completely different skill than teleportation. One could teleport along with other life forms and enter a space ripple together, reaching faraway places instantly. But domain was limited to within a diameter of 6,000 miles of Mosha body.

Domain was achieved when Mosha body merged with space, then turned back into Mosha body. Luo Feng’s original body couldn’t do that—unless, perhaps, he entered the World Ring and let it be carried by Mosha body.

However, with Bark Mirror Emperor’s permeating undying power, he had no chance of getting into his World Ring.

“Escaped again?” Bark Mirror Emperor smiled smugly. “I didn’t expect you to dodge my attacks twice. Those wings aid you well in your escape. Let’s see if you can dodge it for the third time!”

Bark Mirror Emperor’s madness intensified as he began to condense a mass of tempestuous undying power.

Undying power needed to be condensed in order to be forceful. If it was dispersed among a 600-million-mile area, it was feeble and could only be used for detection instead of attacking. When undying power couldn’t be condensed further, it formed a godly body.

“Undying power into threads!” roared Bark Mirror Emperor. “Cage!”

Bark Mirror Emperor reached out his paws, and suddenly, thousands of undying-power threads shot out in pursuit of Luo Feng. Each of the threads was as concentrated as possible, like Bark Mirror Emperor’s godly body.

The move had consumed 10 percent of Bark Mirror Emperor’s godly body. Since the start of the battle, all his other moves had only cost him 1 percent, but this single move, producing thousands of threads, required an immense quantity of undying power.

“There’s nowhere to run!” Bark Mirror Emperor seethed. Two true treasures awaited him after he defeated Blade River Emperor! He could even escape universe overlords if he had those two!

Hong!

In an instant, a giant whirlpool appeared before them, producing a massive, tearing current.

Bark Mirror Emperor turned toward the whirlpool, astonished. “What?”

As Bark Mirror Emperor watched, a towering red figure emerged from the whirlpool. Two bloody horns protruded from its head. The figure leveled its gaze at Bark Mirror Emperor.

“Other races,” growled the horned figure. “How dare you roam the Nine Remoteness Ocean. Die!”

“A Nine Remoteness Whirlpool!” said Bark Mirror Emperor. “And a great being… in a Nine Remoteness Whirlpool?”

He was well aware of the dangers of the Nine Remoteness Ocean, the deadliest of which being Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. But he had never expected the whirlpool to appear out of nowhere or for a great being to reside within it. He could sense the horned figure’s energy. It was a universe knight. And it was superior to him.

Hong!

A burning, bloody light from the horned universe knight shrouded Bark Mirror Emperor.

“Begone!” Bark Mirror Emperor cried, manipulating the threads of undying power against the bloody light.

It would have been easy to kill Blade River Emperor with these threads, but the great being in front of him was his real enemy. Thousands of threads, making up of 10 percent of his godly body, coalesced into a spear flying toward the bloody light.

Hong! Long!

The two forces crashed and exploded in the water, each dispersing in the aftermath.

“You’ve got some skill,” the universe knight said, a bit surprised.

“Die!” Bark Mirror Emperor roared as he cast his talent technique. “Silence!”

Silence engulfed the area around them, and a soundless shock wave ripped forward and slammed into the universe knight in the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. But nothing happened.

“Haha!” the universe knight chuckled. “A soul attack is useless to me!”

The towering figure with its bloody horns roared and hurled himself at Bark Mirror Emperor.

“You can do nothing to me,” Bark Mirror Emperor scoffed.

The thousands of threads had consumed 10 percent of his godly body while the strike from the enemy had cost him less than 2 percent. Although Bark Mirror Emperor knew he was weaker than this great being, he was unafraid.

“It’s no wonder only one in 100 universe knights survives the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool,” said Bark Mirror Emperor. “Is anyone who shows up here as powerful as this universe knight? I’ll disregard him now. I can’t beat him, but I’m faster than he is.”

Bark Mirror Emperor turned around and continued to chase after Luo Feng. The towering figure with the bloody horns raced forward in pursuit.

Sou!

Sou!

Bark Mirror Emperor was proficient in tracking and hunting and possessed unparalleled speed when he accelerated. Luo Feng, even after casting the second form of Shi Wu Wing, couldn’t match Bark Mirror Emperor, and neither could the universe knight.

“I’ll kill you, Blade River Emperor!” roared Bark Mirror Emperor, right on Luo Feng’s heels. “Then I’ll escape.”

He waved his paws, and threads of undying began to concentrate again.

“Fight!”

Luo Feng had been lucky that the bloody-horned figure showed up and forced Bark Mirror Emperor to manipulate his threads to deal with the real threat. But now, Bark Mirror Emperor knew he was not the universe knight’s match and resumed focusing on killing Luo Feng.

Luo Feng had no time to think. His erratic movements had brought him back around, almost in a full circle. He shook his wings and dove directly into Nine Remoteness Whirlpool.

Hong! Long! Long!

Nine Remoteness Whirlpool possessed an incredible tearing, all-consuming current. Luo Feng was sucked inside the moment he touched it.

Bark Mirror Emperor saw Blade River Emperor dive into Nine Remoteness Whirlpool just as he finished condensing his threads.

“No!” he shouted in exasperation.

Bark Mirror Emperor was powerful, but even he didn’t dare to go into the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. As for Luo Feng, he could only resort to taking this last-ditch effort. Bark Mirror Emperor’s only choice now was to flee for his life from the horned universe knight.

“My two true treasures!” Bark Mirror Emperor growled through clenched teeth, flying out of the ocean and up in the sky.

Hong!

The bloody-horned figure of the universe knight stepped out of the ocean and onto the rolling waves. It looked up just in time to see Bark Mirror Emperor teleport and disappear.

The universe knight smirked. “Was it something I said?”

The bloody-horned figure reentered the ocean and swam back down, approaching the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Without hesitation, it dove into the whirlpool.

Above the ocean.

Here Crow Knight remained behind a moment longer. He had been watching the fight and was terrified.

“Everyone says the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool is the portal to the core of Nine Remoteness Ocean,” he said. “There must be a group of great beings living there. The one that just showed up was stronger than me, and it comes from a race that’s immune to soul attack. That human, Blade River Emperor, went directly into Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Now he’s dead, and his true treasures shall be lost forever in the core. What a pity!”

Coldness flashed in Here Crow Knight’s eyes. “But at least Bark Mirror Emperor doesn’t have them…”

He gazed at the whirlpool afar. Although the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool had appeared out of nowhere, it was still there now, and it was likely to remain there for a long time… And it somehow felt enticing. As if it were luring Here Crow Knight to come in.

“Too risky,” said Here Crow Knight, shaking off the strange feeling. “A portal that appears out of nowhere and isn’t God Country Transportation… No wonder it’s the most dangerous place of Nine Remoteness Space.”

He teleported himself and disappeared.


Chapter 979: Another Sky and Land

The moment he entered the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool, Luo Feng felt an immense, tearing current the likes of which he’d never encountered before. He felt like he had been caught beneath a millstone grinding grain. His body crackled, and his face twisted.

“The current alone will annihilate me!” Luo Feng realized, terrified. “Seal Star!”

Sou!

A seal star appeared—a sealing treasure with a space inside—and Luo Feng wriggled into it. As long as he hid in it, attacks from the outside would be significantly weakened. However, there was a major downside to doing so. Since the seal star couldn’t fly quickly or dodge independently, enemies could grab hold of it. This made it practically useless when trying to avoid a pursuer, such as fleeing Bark Mirror Emperor.

It was a beautiful world inside the seal star. Beams of golden light flashed through the sky above the boundless solid ground. Luo Feng merged his mind with the seal star and used his spiritual force to detect the external world around the star.

It’s kind of like the wormholes of the secret region, thought Luo Feng.

Previously, a wormhole had sent to the five-colored pool, and luckily, he had gotten the Space Heart as a result.

“Well, here I am,” he said.

But as Luo Feng felt the surroundings becoming steady, he inspected the external world, and his heart missed a beat. He could distinctly sense an army formed by life forms of other races, all of whom had red, burly bodies and bloody horns. They appeared to be of the same race as the universe knight that had chased after Bark Mirror Emperor.

A squad of warriors closest to the portal of the whirlpool suddenly flew toward it, approaching the seal star.

“Huh? A valuable?” one said.

“What valuable is it?” said another.

When they felt a spiritual force passing through their bodies, all of them started to roar furiously.

“An invader from another race!”

“Other races trespassing!”

Sou!

The star disappeared, instantly replaced by a silver-armored, silver-winged man.

Luo Feng looked around and saw 300 warriors, all of whom were undying fighters. The leader had such powerful energy that he might have been an invincible emperor.

Luo Feng felt numb. Even the human race did not have the ability to deploy 300 undying fighters to guard a single area.

For a random squad stationed here to be so strong… he thought, looking around in astonishment. According to my knowledge of this place, this isn’t the only Nine Remoteness Whirlpool in Nine Remoteness Ocean. I wonder if all of them are so heavily guarded.

Many of the bloody-horned warriors grew eager—like predators in the presence of prey.

“Sorry,” said Luo Feng. “Can’t stick around.”

Sou!

Luo Feng shook his wing and started to fly away.

“Intruder!” one of them roared.

“Quick! Go after him!” the captain shouted. “First team and second team, follow me! Third team, stay here!”

Howl!

Howl!

Suddenly, one bloody shadow after another flew up into the sky, roaring and raced toward Luo Feng.

As soon as Luo Feng breached the ocean, he felt the stark difference between the outside world and the sky and land, which were so different from other districts in Nine Remoteness Space. Stars shone in the sky, and a blurry, bloody mist permeated the air, giving the entire sky and land unparalleled strength.

“The resistance is so strong!” he said.

Suddenly, he realized that the strange strength here stopped the space ripple completely, thus suppressing God Country Transportation.

“No teleportation…!” he muttered in disbelief. “No God Country Transportation!”

Finally, Luo Feng understood why even universe knight-level great beings could only arrive here through the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Teleportation and God Country Transportation were impossible.

Howl!

“Hahaha!”

Laughing voices blasted Luo Feng’s ears with undying energy. He looked back to see a multitude of bloody figures dashing toward him.

“Foreign invader!” roared the captain. “This sky and land belong to our race. While you are heavily suppressed here, we are unaffected. There’s no way you can get away!”

Luo Feng could feel the bloody mist suppressing the space ripple, yet these creatures flew unaffected.

“You, merely undying fighters, want to catch up with me?” Luo Feng said.

Heng!

His Shi Wu Wings ripped through the air, causing space turbulence as his speed surged, and he shot into the distance.

The warriors could only watch as the intruder flew farther and farther away. Soon, he became a small, silver spot, then vanished. They stood there, perplexed and staring at each other.

“How could he be so fast?” they asked one another. “He’s only an undying fighter from a foreign race. How can he be faster than us here in our homeland?”

The 300 undying warriors were unprepared for this. They were highly experienced in dealing with foreign invaders. The speed of undying fighters of other races was always sharply reduced when they entered their homeland, thus allowing them to easily outpace any intruders. If it was a universe knight, they would immediately report it and ask the universe knights of their race to take up the matter, but this one had only been a normal undying fighter.

“Damn it!” roared the biggest of the bloody-horned warriors. “We let an undying fighter from another race get away!”

They warriors looked to their captain. “What should we do, captain? What now?”

The burly figure growled, “We report what happened, of course! Unless you want to die!”

Stars shone in the sky, dimmed by the bloody mist hanging over the land. Mountains, streams, and forests covered the land. When Luo Feng finally felt confident that he had evaded the 300 warriors, he slowed to a halt and looked around.

“Such a large world,” he said. “I’ve flown 6 billion miles already and haven’t encountered any other life forms. This race must only have a small number of creatures, but they’re all incredibly powerful.”

He sat down with his legs crossed.

No teleportation and no God Country Transportation, he thought. Which means I can’t break out of here. All I can do is wait to be killed by this race like a lamb awaiting the slaughter!

Luo Feng checked his coordinates and found that, strangely, this sky and land were the at the bottom of the Nine Remoteness Ocean.

“I’m at the center of Nine Remoteness Ocean,” he muttered to himself. “According to my coordinates, it’s still inside Nine Remoteness Space.”

Though I can’t teleport myself, my Mosha body could use his talent technique “domain” to get in, he thought. As long as Mosha body isn’t also hunted, he should be able to get here without any trouble.

“I’ll wait here first,” he said. “Mosha body has been floating for such a long time on his approach to the World Tree, and it’s only a month before he reaches the final stage of the mission.”

Luo Feng pondered the situation for a while and concluded that what happened around him was already beyond his control, whereas he was confident that Mosha body could get a twig and leaf of the World Tree this time.

“I can’t give up now,” he decided. “Besides, escape is not guaranteed, even if Mosha body were to enter now. I need to get in touch with my teacher first.”

Just as Luo Feng connected to Primal Chaos City Leader through the virtual universe, members of the indigenous race were communicating with each other through the virtual world they had set up in Nine Remoteness Space.

In an opulent palace in an ancient city at the center of Nine Remoteness Space, a burly black-armored universe knight roared with fury.

“A foreign invader? You can’t even catch an undying fighter from another race! Follow me, my children!”

“Yes, general!”

The burly universe knight led an elite team of ten warriors to fly out from the city.

“Ma Ma Tuo,” a voice said within the universe knight’s head.

His godly body trembled before he stopped, and the warriors behind him followed his lead.

“General?” the warriors said, confused.

“It was the prince,” the burly universe knight said in a deep voice.

“Prince?”

The ten captain-level elite warriors were all started. They quickly began to grovel, along with their general, as in the distance, tens of creatures flew out of the most towering palace of the ancient city. Three of them were unbelievably powerful. They reached the group in no time.

“Your highness,” the universe knight-level general said, bowing to show respect.

“Your highness,” echoed the ten warriors behind him as they kneeled.

The leader of the creatures that had just arrived had a handsome face covered in red engravings. He wore gorgeous armor of gold and red, emanating a powerful ripple that could only have come from a true treasure. He was the prince, and he stood apart from all the others of his race. He looked as if he were from a different race entirely.

“General Ma Ma Tuo,” said the prince in a fair voice. “I just heard that a team under your command found a foreign invader. He’s only an undying fighter, yet he managed to escape your team?”

“Yes, your highness,” the burly general answered respectfully.

“Interesting,” the prince continued. “An undying fighter with such power. I heard that out of the heirs in the Ancestral God School, some undying fighters are mighty. I’m also undying. Who’s better? I wonder. Him or me…?”

“You have invincible power, your highness,” answered General Ma Ma Tuo. “That invader is not your match.”

“We can’t underestimate other races,” the prince said. “Lead the way. Let’s go hunt this undying fighter from another race.”

“Um…” The burly general was dazed.

“You’re afraid that I might run into danger?” the prince asked.

“No, that’s not what I meant, your highness,” the general answered.

“Humph! All of my 107 brothers are still alive,” the prince said confidently. “How dangerous can it be? Go.”

“Yes, your highness,” the general said, with no choice but to follow orders.

Sou!

The great beings departed to hunt down this undying fighter alongside their prince.


Chapter 980: Nine Remoteness Master

At the apex of Thunder Island in the virtual universe, outside the palace surrounded by fog, Luo Feng showed up.

“Things are out of my control,” Luo Feng said, standing in front of the palace and pondering what had happened. “If I can’t get out there, my treasures will get taken away. It’ll be difficult to get them back.”

“Luo Feng,” said a voice.

Luo Feng was dazed and turned his head. He saw someone in a golden cape standing beside the cliff. It was Primal Chaos City Leader, who was overlooking Thunder Island below him.

Luo Feng walked towards him and saluted. “Teacher.”

Primal Chaos City Leader glimpsed at Luo Feng and smiled. “You came here to see me, but you’re wandering outside the door. You told me before you were going to Nine Remoteness Space to find the twigs and leaves of World Trees to breed your third body. What happened? Did something go wrong?”

Luo Feng answered respectfully, “I’ve been following my plan with the World Trees, and I hope I can get some. However, something happened to my original earthling body.”

“Hmm.” Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng.

“My original earthling body was hiding in Rock Island, the safest place in Nine Remoteness Space, but I didn’t expect another group of heirs to arrive. One of them was Bark Mirror Emperor. He’s famous for his tracking skills, and that was how he found me. He’s jealous of my true treasures, and he attacked me.”

“Bark Mirror Emperor?” Primal Chaos City Leader was startled. “How did you escape if he attacked you? Have you lost your true treasures to him?”

“No.” Luo Feng shook his head. “I got away.”

“You got away?” Primal Chaos City Leader was bewildered. “Although he’s only an undying fighter, he can rival a universe knight, especially with his talent technique.”

“I have another true treasure to protect my soul,” Luo Feng said.

“Another true treasure?”

Primal Chaos City Leader furrowed his brow. He could infer from Luo Feng’s past battles that Luo Feng’s spiritual force weapon was a true treasure, but he didn’t expect him to have a third true treasure that could protect his soul.

“Luo Feng,” he said, “how many true treasures do you have now?”

Luo Feng was a bit embarrassed. “Three. Shi Wu Wing, spiritual force weapon, and a true treasure to protect my soul. Only three.”

“Only three?” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “I only had one true treasure when I was a sector lord. Count yourself lucky.”

Luo Feng was a bit perturbed. What if Primal Chaos City Leader teacher asked him where he had obtained the other two true treasures?

“Even if you have a true treasure to protect your soul, Bark Mirror Emperor has the power of a universe knight and won’t let you go that easily,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

Luo Feng was relieved that his teacher didn’t ask where the two true treasures had come from. Otherwise, he would have to lie. After all, star tower was the biggest secret. True treasures like Star Map and Shi Wu Wing were looked down upon by lots of universe masters, who gave them to the great beings of their own races.

True treasures like Sky Wolf Palace were desired by universe masters, and true treasures like Thousand-Treasure River were craved for by universe masters. As for the top-tier ones like star map, they would send the races of the universe into a frenzy. Even by the most powerful beings in the universe longed for them, just like Five-Color Aurora Lake, which protected the greatest power in the universe.

Luo Feng knew that the secret of star tower could not be exposed before he could fully control it. Otherwise, no matter how many people were on his side, he wouldn’t be able to stop the mad desire of the other great beings.

“Theoretically, I wouldn’t have gotten away,” said Luo Feng. “However, he was chasing me in the Nine Remoteness Space. I found the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool and thought it would be difficult to get the true treasures back if they fell into the hands of Bark Mirror Emperor. Although the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool is famously hazardous, I figured I wouldn’t die instantly, at least, so I dove into the whirlpool.”

He paused for a moment. “Nine Remoteness Whirlpool was kind of similar to a wormhole. I went to another world. A group of special organisms live there, all of whom are tall and red with bloody horns. There are hundreds of undying fighters of another race guarding the entry point. Luckily, I managed to escape. I think there will be more great beings coming after me, and I can neither teleport nor cast God Country Transportation in that world. The only thing I can do is to stall. The sky and land there are enormous, so I might be able to avoid detection for a while.”

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded his head mildly. “You did the right thing. Bark Mirror Emperor comes from the Northern Territory Alliance, and their behavior has been tyrannical. You won’t get your belongings back if you lose them to them.”

Luo Feng began to sweat. Tower pearl was connected to the most vital things. Although it was unlikely that Bark Mirror Emperor would recognize that, star tower would acknowledge someone as its master only after the tower pearl merged with that creature’s soul, which was why it had to be protected at all costs.

Luo Feng looked at Primal Chaos City Leader. “What should I do now?”

“Haha! Are you asking a favor now?” said Primal Chaos City Leader, a smile on his face. “I’ve never been to the Ancestral God Secret Region, and I know little about it, but I know some of the most terrifying beings in the Ancestral God Secret regions who can roam the universe. What are the universe coordinates of this strange land?”

“Below Nine Remoteness Ocean,” Luo Feng said.

“Hmm.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Then I’ve guessed correctly. I can only sense the keepsake you left there, and it’s being interfered with by that realm. There are only a few beings in the universe that are capable of doing that.”

Luo Feng was startled. That was the saving object his teacher had given to him, and it was used to call for help from his teacher in a crucial moment.

“I’ve never been to Nine Remoteness Space, but I know the master of Nine Remoteness Space is called ‘Nine Remoteness Master,’” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “The sky and land you’re currently in is his home.”

“Nine Remoteness… Master?” Luo Feng blinked his eyes.

“That’s right. He’s a universe master. Of course, you mustn’t compare him with Master of Sky Wolf. Nine Remoteness Master is at least as powerful as me.”

Luo Feng was shocked. At least as powerful as his teacher? Primal Chaos City Leader had three bodies, and all of which were incredibly powerful. To think that Nine Remoteness Master was his teacher’s equal!

“Nine Remoteness Master can roam the universe, and almost no one is his better.” Primal Chaos City Leader continued. “Even the Ancestral God School treats him with respect, and the three ancestral gods are friends with him. Nine Remoteness Master deals with things that they and the beast gods find… tricky.”

Luo Feng listened carefully.

“He is mighty,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “Especially in Nine Remoteness Space, his home. There, he is invincible, and no one in the universe can possibly defeat him.”.

Luo Feng opened his eyes wide. There was no need for his teacher to lie to him.

Everybody said Primal Chaos City Leader was unbeatable while within the primal universe. Little did they know that Nine Remoteness Master was also undefeatable while in Nine Remoteness Space.

“In Nine Remoteness Space, he can realize his full potential,” Primal Chaos City Leader explained. “The most powerful World Tree—and some other beings that have the power of universe masters—as long as they live in Nine Remoteness Space, they all serve Nine Remoteness Master. That’s why other supreme beings of the universe are reluctant to go there. They are at a disadvantage in Nine Remoteness Space. I also don’t want to go to that place. Undying fighters and universe knights are willing to venture there for a chance to acquire some valuables, but real universe masters are not. Nine Remoteness Master is always ruthless. It’s difficult for him to kill a universe master in other places, but in his Nine Remoteness Space, it’s easy for him to do so.”

Luo Feng was amazed. He had never expected such a supreme being to be hidden in Nine Remoteness Space. The heirs throughout history only knew basic facts of that realm. They were not strong enough to make this supreme being show himself.

“He’s invincible,” Luo Feng said, thinking about his destiny. “Teacher is invincible in the primal universe, and Nine Remoteness Master is invincible in Nine Remoteness Space. Can I be like them, undefeatable in the universe, someday in the future?”

They were only invincible in certain places, but it was a tempting thought. As long as they placed one of their bodies in that place, they were immortal.

Primal Chaos City Leader did not answer but said, “Nine Remoteness Master is my equal, and we have cooperated several times. Besides, he owes me a favor.”

“Owes you a favor?” Luo Feng said.

“If you really run into danger and can’t manage to escape,” Primal Chaos City Leader said, looking at Luo Feng, “shout out, ‘Nine Remoteness Space, I’m a disciple of Chaos!’ Nine Remoteness Master controls Nine Remoteness Space completely. Nothing that happens there can be hidden from him. He’ll know when you shout out. No matter what kind of danger you’re in, he’ll make sure you’re safe.”

Luo Feng understood.

“I only ask that you don’t cash in that favor if you don’t need to,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “Do it only if there’s literally nothing else you can do.”

Luo Feng was moved, and he nodded. “I understand.”

Returning a favor was no easy matter. A supreme being like Nine Remoteness Master owing a favor… This was so rare that it was as worthy of a true treasure.

“If you do shout out, you can request that he do something for you,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “For instance, you can tell him that you want the leaves and twigs of that sector lord-level World Tree. He’ll say yes to this kind of request. But remember, such a favor will not be easy to return.”

“I understand.” Luo Feng nodded solemnly.

He still had Mosha body, which at least gave him a small chance of escape. He wouldn’t cash in the favor unless he was at an impasse.

Primal Chaos City Leader smiled and said, “Go.”

“Yes, teacher.” Luo Feng saluted the leader and disappeared.


Chapter 981: Celebration

In a world permeated with blood-red mist.

I didn’t expect the entire Nine Remoteness Space to belong to Nine Remoteness Master, Luo Feng thought, hiding in the grass. Nine Remoteness Master is invincible here. Is it because this special environment helps with his amplification?

Luo Feng pondered the possibilities. This was all far beyond his understanding.

“Hmm,” he muttered. “Why are they looking for me?”

Luo Feng connected to World of Glory with his mind.

In the open-air square of World of Glory.

All the heirs looked to Luo Feng, who had just shown up.

“Look, it’s Blade River Emperor.”

“Blade River Emperor showed up. He’s incredible! It’s difficult to kill him with his talent clone technique.”

Luo Feng felt a bit awkward being stared at like this.

Why are they all staring at me?

These heirs were all peerless talents, and his 620,000 battles were things of the past. He had entered the World of Glory plenty of times before, but only a small portion of the heirs noticed him then. Now, everyone was staring at him as if he were a treasure to be claimed.

“Blade River!” Cha Man Emperor yelled from a corner.

Luo Feng walked toward him, attracting attention everywhere he walked. All the heirs were speaking in low voices while staring at him. He was further perplexed.

“Blade River Emperor, do you still have your true treasure, the wings?” a voice called out.

Luo Feng glanced at the heirs from other races. Many were grinning and shouting at him. They were from Northern Territory Alliance, and their faces, covered with cuticles, disgusted Luo Feng.

Luo Feng sat down at the table with Cha Man Emperor, Li Li Emperor, and Thousand Rain Emperor, all of whom were his closest allies among the heirs from Hong Alliance. “What’s going on?” he asked.

Cha Man Emperor blocked the sound around them and started to whisper. “Blade River, I heard you were hunted by Bark Mirror Emperor and got trapped in Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Is that true?”

Luo Feng was shocked. He’d only been trapped there for a short while. The news had spread quickly.

“So it’s true?” Thousand Rain Emperor asked, surmising the truth from the expression on Luo Feng’s face.

Luo Feng nodded. “Yes.”

There was no need to hide the truth if everyone already knew. “You’re really trapped in the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool?” Thousand Rain Emperor continued. “That place… Even a universe knight is unlikely to survive there.”

Li Li Emperor and Cha Man Emperor, who sat beside him, gazed worriedly at Luo Feng. Cha Man Emperor added, “They say you were hunted, and your true treasure, the set of wings, was left in that dangerous place.”

“Where did you guys hear this?” Luo Feng couldn’t help asking.

“The heirs are talking about it in the square,” Cha Man Emperor answered, “and after a short while, everyone knew. I heard you were chased by Bark Mirror Emperor and you resorted to diving into the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool.”

“Did you really die in the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool?” Li Li Emperor asked.

Many heirs presumed that Luo Feng had already died once and had resurrected himself using his clone technique, leaving his true treasure abandoned there.

Luo Feng shook his head. “I was trapped in the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool, but I didn’t die immediately. I unintentionally entered a dangerous world, and I’m still there, just struggling to survive. It seems you guys knew about it immediately after I got trapped. Word spread pretty quickly…”

It must have been Here Crow Knight or Bark Mirror Emperor or their sidekicks who had spread the news.

“Where did the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool lead?” asked Cha Man Emperor.

“How dangerous is it?” Li Li Emperor asked.

Thousand Rain Emperor just stared at Luo Feng.

This was classified information. Secrets about this place were considered invaluable intelligence that should not be leaked. Only information about places that could be easily discovered by the heirs was made public.

“It’s dangerous,” said Luo Feng. “Highly dangerous.”

Luo Feng summarized the bloody-horned universe knight who had chased Bark Mirror Emperor.

“I can’t teleport or use God Country Transportation there,” he said in a low voice. “Also, there are hordes of great beings. I’m still struggling. Chances are, I won’t make it out.”

“No teleportation and no God Country Transportation?” Cha Man Emperor, Li Li Emperor and Thousand Rain Emperor were stupefied.

“Isn’t that a world of sealing treasure?” Cha Man Emperor said.

Luo Feng sighed. There was no way out. Even he didn’t die, it would be tragic for a great being to be trapped in an alternate world for an eternity.

“I can’t talk with you guys for long. I need to run for my life.” And with that, Luo Feng disappeared.

Cha Man Emperor, Li Li Emperor, and Thousand Rain Emperor all committed the secret of the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool to memory. This was no ordinary intelligence. Luo Feng wouldn’t have told them if he were not close to them.

While Luo Feng was running through that world, trying to flee from the creatures as quickly as possible, everyone was talking about him in the World of Glory. When Bark Mirror Emperor arrived in the open-air square, they stared at him just as they had stared at Luo Feng. Immediately, heirs began approaching him and asking questions.

“Bark Mirror Emperor.”

“It’s Bark Mirror Emperor!”

“Bark Mirror Emperor, I heard that you chased Blade River Emperor, and he got trapped in Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Is that true?”

“Humph!” Bark Mirror Emperor snorted.

Without saying anything, he walked to the place where heirs from Northern Territory Alliance gathered. He had planned to adventure in Nine Remoteness Space after failing to take Blade River Emperor’s true treasures, but he had received an email from his friends suddenly and realized the news of him chasing Blade River Emperor had been spread through the World of Glory.

“Damn it,” said Bark Mirror Emperor. “It’s either Here Crow Knight or those other five bastards. But those five don’t have the guts to do that. It must be Here Crow Knight who’s telling everyone the news.”

He’s not stupid, though, thought Bark Mirror Emperor. Blade River Emperor owning a soul true treasure is new information. He’s smart enough not to spread that information.

Bark Mirror Emperor sat down with the group of Northern Territory Alliance heirs. He glanced at the heirs around him.

“I know everyone’s curious about this,” said Bark Mirror Emperor. He smirked. “I have no idea who spread this news, but… it’s true. Blade River Emperor indeed dove into the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool after I ran after him. Haha! Even universe knights find it difficult to survive in the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool. Even though Blade River Emperor has a clone technique, his true treasures will be lost there.”

Bark Mirror Emperor was bold enough to admit everything without being questioned.

Six days later.

On Bauhinia Island sat palaces of all kinds.

Hong!

A sudden, powerful force from the origin law shook Bauhinia Island. Lots of heirs on Bauhinia Island gathered and looked at the center of the origin law energy: the palace of True Yan Emperor.

A five-colored whirlpool came into being above the palace. Gold, wood, water, fire, and ground—all the five law forces merged and led to a nobler, more vigorous origin law energy, which was the center of the five-colored whirlpool. After that, it turned hollow like a mystical portal connecting to the land of origin.

Immense godly energy entered the palace of True Yan Emperor.

All the figures flew up in the sky over Bauhinia Island, watching the scene, thrilled and envious.

“Who made their breakthrough?”

“Space law!”

“Who fully comprehended space law and became a universe knight?”

More than 100 million heirs were stuck in that step, craving for that day to come for them.

“Whose palace is that?”

“I don’t know.”

“Me neither.”

“Who became a universe knight?”

“Don’t know.”

Only a few of the heirs knew. Even most of the members of the Hong Alliance had no idea. It was Cha Man Emperor who said, “That palace is right next to Blade River Emperor’s. That’s the other heir of our human race. Two heirs came last time. One is Blade River Emperor. The other is True Yan Emperor.”

“True Yan Emperor?”

“True Yan Emperor became a universe knight?”

Lots of heirs within the Hong Alliance were astonished.

“True Yan Emperor has been stuck in the last step forever. Now that he finally made his breakthrough, we must visit and congratulate him.”

“No need to rush. It’s a crucial time for True Yan Emperor. He’s surely absorbing godly power now. He can’t waste any time.”

On the way to becoming a great being, the three most significant milestones were becoming an undying fighter, becoming a universe knight, and becoming a universe master. At those crucial times, and universe origin law would arrive, especially the first time when an ordinary body turned into a godly body. It could take in as much godly power as it wanted.

When someone became a universe knight or a universe master, he couldn’t absorb that much godly power, but it was considerably more than usual. When the origin law arrived, it connected to the “law ocean,” and energy could be soaked up without boundaries. Unfortunately, origin law would only stay for a while and would disappear afterward, which was why there was only a short window to absorb the godly power.

After a moment, all the ripple dissipated, and some of the heirs and even universe knights went to visit True Yan Emperor.

“Zhi Ya.”

The door opened. True Yan Knight looked outside with a big smile. “Haha! Come on in.”

“Congratulations, True Yan Emperor… No, excuse me—True Yan Knight!”

“Congratulations, True Yan, you’re officially a universe knight.”

Unlike Luo Feng, True Yan Emperor had many more friends, and lots of universe knights were close to True Yan Emperor.

“Finally, after such a long time, I’m a universe knight,” True Yan Knight said, nodding. He didn’t look apathetic anymore. Instead, he looked vigorous.

“How much godly power did you take in?”

“I tried my best to absorb as much as I could just now,” said True Yan Knight. “My godly body was improved by 92 percent.”

“Not 100 percent? We humans have smaller bodies and don’t have much undying power. You should’ve grasped the chance and improve 100 percent.”

The larger a body was, the more difficult it was to improve it 100 percent. In the case of the enormous World Trees, if they became universe knights, they could take in more godly power than True Yan Emperor in a short period of time, but compared to their sizes, it was nothing; they would need to cultivate for a long time after that.

“True Yan Knight’s genes evolved tenfold before. After becoming a universe knight, his godly body’s limit is higher. Storing 92 percent is good enough.”

True Yan Knight was talking with other great beings, but he was also confused to note that his disciple Luo Feng hadn’t come to congratulate him on becoming a universe knight.


Chapter 982: True Yan Knight

In True Yan’s palace, all the other great beings were warm and cheerful. It was always was to be on good terms with a universe knight. And the other universe knights in the Hong Alliance were pretty close with True Yan.

Why? Because not all universe knights were the same. Those who had evolved from pinnacle emperors were completely different from universe knights who had evolved from invincible emperors.

There were two kinds of invincible emperors. Silver Eye represented the first type. He had a high life-level. Thus, it was easy for him to become an invincible emperor.

True Yan Emperor represented the second type. He was at an average level within his race and struggled to improve his genes; they were blessed if they could improve it ten times. How difficult it was for them to become invincible emperors—they had to first survive universe knights! This path required some distinctive special skills.

Both of them had great combat power after becoming universe knights. A warrior of the first type had a great godly body after turning into a universe knight. As for the second type, if one could survive universe knight attacks when they were only an undying fighter, how mighty would they be after becoming a universe knight?

Eventually, all the guests left except for Wu Tang Knight.

Wu Tang Knight and True Yan Knight had been close friends for a long time, even remaining close after Wu Tang Knight became a universe knight.

“Wu Tang,” True Yan Knight said. “Do you know what’s going on with Blade River Emperor? I came here with him, and we accepted our inheritance together at the beginning. But after that, I started to live in seclusion and haven’t heard anything about him. Do you know anything?”

He had become a universe knight, yet Luo Feng hadn’t come to congratulate him. He knew something was wrong.

Wu Tang Knight had a firm voice. “You don’t know anything that’s happened since? Then you’ve really missed a lot. Blade River Emperor stole everyone’s thunder by accepting all the battle invitations sent to him by the heirs on this island…”

Wu Tang Knight started to elaborate—from Luo Feng’s 620,000 battles to the assassination attempt… and to what had happened recently in Nine Remoteness Space. True Yan Emperor was beaming at first, but as the story went on, his face took on a ghastly expression, especially when he heard how Luo Feng had nearly been assassinated and was now trapped in an impasse because of Bark Mirror Emperor.

“They say Blade River Emperor is Luo Feng,” Wu Tang Knight said, smiling at True Yan. “Is Blade River Emperor really your disciple?”

“You don’t need to worry about that.” True Yan said.

“Haha…” Wu Tang Knight nodded with a smile.

“I need to ask you a favor,” True Yan said.

“Just say the word,” replied Wu Tang Knight.

He truly did value True Yan highly. For one thing, they had been confidants before. Plus, he believed True Yan had a bright future ahead of him. Given humans’ talents, each invincible emperor that could make a breakthrough and become a universe knight was extraordinary.

“I need some information on the dangerous places in the Ancestral God Secret Region,” True Yan said. “Especially Nine Remoteness Space.”

“You want to go there?” Wu Tang Knight answered.

“Are you kidding?” Fierceness flashed through True Yan’s eyes. “How could I not go?”

“Haha! The ferocious True Yan!” Wu Tang nodded. “I’ve already sent all the information to you through virtual universe.”

True Yan grinned. “I’ve been in Primal Chaos City for hundreds of millions of years. I wonder if anyone remembers me.”

After only half a day.

After True Yan was in his palace, patiently preparing.

“My old friend,” he said, “perhaps you feel really lonely after hundreds of millions of years of not being used.”

Suddenly, a black staff appeared in True Yan’s hands, and there were two golden hoops on each end of the staff. The staff looked like a simple antique, which was a treasure True Yan had obtained when adventuring in the universe long ago. It had remained by his side through countless adventures, and its killing power had helped make him an invincible emperor.

“My disciple treats me as his family,” he said. “I couldn’t have become a universe knight without him. This Bark Mirror Emperor dared to bully my disciple. As such, how can I spare him? A special life form, skilled at soul attack and inspection…!”

True Yan suddenly became aggressive. In the past, he had roamed the universe, killing countless fighters to become an invincible emperor. He had lived in seclusion for so long that many of the undying of his generation had died.

“I’ve created three pinnacle techniques during the past few hundred million of years. Now that I’m a universe knight, I’ll try them on you first!”

Madness filled True Yan Emperor’s eyes. He had provoked universe knights before and had survived. He was born to be reckless. His disposition grew savage. After an eternity spent in Primal Chaos City, the real True Yan was back!

Sou!

True Yan flew out of his palace and teleported to the spring portal in front of the palace of the guarding beast god and entered the secret region.

A universe knight could teleport over 1,000 light years. In less than half a day, True Yan arrived at Rock Island in Nine Remoteness Space.

“I’ll wait here.” True Yan sat at the apex of a mountain with his legs crossed. “Based on the information Wu Tang gave me, the heirs adventuring here will often come back to Rock Island and rest. So when Bark Mirror Emperor comes back…”

True Yan closed his eyes. He was like a tiger—relaxed yet ready to pounce and kill at any moment.

Under Rock Island and at the bottom of Nine Remoteness Ocean, in another world, Luo Feng fled helter-skelter, doing his best just to stay ahead of the army by moving as quickly as possible.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Three shadows flashed in the sky and stopped. They were the noble prince and his two universe knights. Both of the universe knights had red skin and bloody horns.

Coldness flashed in the prince’s eyes. “We still haven’t found this foreign invader, even after all this time.”

“Your highness,” the lanky universe knight said, “our Nine Remoteness World is vast, and that intruder must constantly be fleeing from us. Perhaps he’s far away by now. It could take some time to find him.”

“Some time? How long?” The prince frowned. “I’ll give an order now. In my territory, each city shall designate half of its soldiers to search for the intruder from another race! Each of them will connect to the virtual world, and if anyone finds him, they will alert me right away. And all the soldiers must remain connected to the virtual world with their minds. Being disconnected means death at the hands of that intruder!”

Each prince was in charge of one territory, and they were the only leaders of their territories respectively. The prince gave an order to all the armies under him through the virtual world.

A great number of undying warriors and sector lord-level warriors flocked to the sky and flew out in different directions. Each of the warriors was responsible for one area.

“Search! Search! Search!”

“Quickly!”

“Go! Search the undying intruder!”

The creatures in Nine Remoteness World were special, as they all had red bodies and bloody horns. They were high-powered life forms with great talents. Like Golden Horned Beasts, they became sector lords automatically as they matured. However, their life level was the same as humans’, as they didn’t have talent techniques. Since everyone could become a sector lord when they became adults, sector lords were common in the cities, yet compared to humans, the race had a very small population.

Howl!

Howl!

All the indigenous warriors were baying with excitement. They were distributed everywhere across the sky. Some of them used world projection, some used law domain, and some even used undying-power inspection. In short, they were trying anything they could think of to search for Luo Feng.

Nine Remoteness World was not very large, yet Luo Feng hadn’t seen even a single member of the race. After more than ten days fleeing, Luo Feng finally ran into the first searcher.

While hiding beneath a lake, Luo Feng looked up and saw a bloody shadow flying quickly through the sky. At the same time, an undying power swept across the lake.

Luo Feng hid himself with the micro-detector. He looked above and thought, Humph! You think you can find me with such simple undying-power inspection? Not while I’ve got the most advanced micro-detector I can afford.

However, as the undying power passed over Luo Feng, it suddenly stopped.

“No… I’m found.” Luo Feng realized immediately. “How could I be found?”

The bloody shadow in the sky wheeled around sharply, looked down, and grew excited. “Intruder!” it wailed.

Sou!

Luo Feng didn’t have the luxury to ponder how he had been found. He flew out of the water, shook his wings, and shot across the sky like a beam of silver light.

“Intruder! I found the intruder!” the undying warrior screamed as it flew after Luo Feng, but it was being left farther and farther behind. He immediately reported it through his virtual world. “Haha! I found him! This intruder thought I couldn’t find him just because he used a detector! Haha! In our Nine Remoteness World, my undying power is combined with Nine Remoteness World energies, and I can distinguish all creatures outside of my race. Even universe knights cannot escape us once they’re here.”

Sou!

Sou!

Sou!

Luo Feng was terrifically fast, and he soon flew out of the undying warrior’s sight.

“How could I have been found?” Luo Feng was bewildered as he flew. “Even invincible emperors can’t find me when I turn my detector on. Bark Mirror Emperor found me because of his extraordinary inspection skills, but this was only an ordinary undying creature of this indigenous race! How did he find me? I’m in trouble… Big trouble.”

Luo Feng knew peace was no longer an option.

Indeed, at that moment, the prince raced toward the area with his two universe knights the moment he got the news, and he arranged some undying warriors and universe knights to stop Luo Feng.


Chapter 983: Encirclement and Suppression

In the territory that the prince controlled, the undying warriors and sector lord warriors were distributed everywhere, searching for Luo Feng. As a result, even though the prince had ordered them to encircle and suppress Luo Feng, it would take a long time for all the warriors to gather and arrive.

Got to get out of here! thought Luo Feng. The army might be scattered among many places. They’re probably trying to encircle me, but it might take them a long time to get here. I might still get away if I hurry.

Luo Feng cast Shi Wu Wing and started to fly rapidly, becoming a streak of silver light.

“I must take advantage of the time and get as far from them as possible,” he said under his breath. “I must not allow myself to be encircled. Otherwise, I’ll be doomed.”

A great number of indigenous warriors gathered from all directions while Luo Feng tried to escape from their dragnet.

On the second day, Luo Feng ran into three indigenous warriors consecutively. Two of them were undying warriors while one was a sector lord.

Peng!

Luo Feng’s spiritual force entered that sector-lord warrior, but all Luo Feng discovered there was a crystal.

An energy life, he realized. Like Mosha body. Soul attack is useless on them.

Luo Feng glanced at the indigenous sector lord warrior, knowing he wasn’t able to manipulate him. He didn’t want to waste time killing him, so he shook his wings and flew away.

The indigenous sector-lord warrior was perplexed. “He didn’t kill me?” He immediately reported it through the virtual world. “I found the intruder! I found the fighter from another race!”

On the second day, Luo Feng encountered three indigenous warriors. On the third day, 12. On the fourth day, 21.

On the fifth day, he encountered 52 indigenous warriors.

As time passed by, the scattered indigenous warriors were continuously gathering, giving Luo Feng a stronger and stronger sense of crisis. But he couldn’t do anything about it; the enemies knew his whereabouts.

But on the sixth day, something strange happened. He only ran into one indigenous warrior.

The same thing happened on the seventh day and all the way up to the twelfth day.

“Something’s wrong,” Luo Feng said. “The natives had been tracking me for the past couple of days. They were encircling and suppressing me. The other day, eleven undying fighters tried to team up and kill me. Why have they all disappeared now?”

Luo Feng sensed a storm coming. He was caught like a rat in a trap. Things were serious this time.

In the sky above the mountain valley.

The noble and elegant prince and his two universe-knight servants stood in the sky.

“I didn’t expect that foreign undying fighter to be so good at escaping,” the prince said, smiling. “The undying fighters from my race can’t even catch him. It seems we need to treat him like a universe knight.”

“Your highness, the dragnet is almost complete,” the thin universe knight said respectfully. “The nine generals are all in place and awaiting your orders. Soon the army will capture him. That intruder has no chance to run away.”

“Don’t rush. I’ll go there first.” The prince smiled. “I’m curious about this powerful undying fighter. It’ll be a pity to let the generals kill him. I’ll do it myself.”

“Yes, your highness,” the two universe knights answered with respect.

“Go,” the prince ordered.

Sou!

They flew directly to the dragnet circle.

Even the superior prince didn’t have any universe knights to serve him. Nine generals were the extent of his influence. Fortunately, it was safe for him in Nine Remoteness Space. Thus, he could send all the generals there.

“The native warriors must be preparing to besiege me,” said Luo Feng. He stood at the edge of a swamp and frowned. “There are probably multiple waves of them. Even if I manage to break through the first wave, the rest of the warriors will draw closer to me. There might even be some teams led by universe knights.”

Luo Feng had seen indigenous universe knight warriors before. Even Bark Mirror Emperor would have to run from them.

“I’ll be doomed if I run into a native warrior at the universe knight level.” Luo Feng frowned. “Execute the body plan.”

Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!

Nine figures showed up around Luo Feng. All of them were from other races.

“Master of master,” they said in unison, saluting Luo Feng.

“Turn into me,” Luo Feng ordered.

“Yes, master.”

All the undying slaves had different forms of godly bodies, and all of them transformed their shapes into that of Luo Feng. The only difference was their auras. Undying fighters could transform their shapes—although, if they were too large, their strength would be undermined. But that didn’t matter to Luo Feng. As for different auras, only a few of the indigenous fighters had seen Luo Feng, and it was almost impossible for the entire army to recognize him.

“Follow my lead,” Luo Feng ordered. “You’re number one, and you’re number two. You two will move first.”

With that, Luo Feng initiated his plan. His slaves also had slaves, especially ordinary undying fighters, and official-level ones. Luo Feng didn’t mind losing nine of them if that was what it took to get out of here.

“Yes,” Slave number one and slave number two followed, flying away.

Luo Feng’s plan depended on the nine decoys luring the indigenous warriors to change their plan.

Just as he was executing his plan, he received a message from the World of Glory. The message was simple: “True Yan Knight is fighting the Northern Territory Alliance.”

Luo Feng nearly jumped out of his skin. “True Yan… Knight? My teacher became a universe knight? And he’s fighting the Northern Territory Alliance? How is my teacher fighting Northern Territory Alliance?”

Bark Mirror Emperor came to mind. Although Luo Feng was still carrying out his escape plan, it would take him two to three days to finish that. He spared a bit of his mind to connect to the World of Glory.

In the open-air square of the World of Glory.

Again, Luo Feng’s appearance drew the attention of the other heirs. He went to where the Hong Alliance was gathered.

“What happened?” Luo Feng said down and looked at Cha Man Emperor, Li Li Emperor, and Thousand Rain Emperor.

“They’re fighting!” Thousand Rain Emperor said, excited. “It’s madness!”

“True Yan Knight is impressive.” Cha Man Emperor said. “His time in seclusion has made him furious. Now that he’s finally broke out, he’s thrilling!”

“Thrilling, indeed,” Li Li Emperor said. “Really thrilling.”

“Come on! Tell me what happened.” Luo Feng was totally lost. “True Yan Emperor became a universe knight? And what’s his issue with Northern Territory Alliance?”

They all looked at Luo Feng. Rumor had it that Luo Feng was Blade River Emperor, and if that was true, it was understandable why Blade River Emperor cared about True Yan Knight so much.

“True Yan Emperor became a universe knight around half a month ago,” Cha Man Emperor said. “After that, he left Bauhinia Island. We don’t know where he went, but now we presume he went to Nine Remoteness Space!”

“Nine Remoteness Space?” Luo Feng’s heart missed a beat.

“Yes, it happened today,” Cha Man Emperor said with thrill. “True Yan Knight and Bark Mirror Emperor began doing battle on Rock Island.”

“True Yan Emperor defeated Bark Mirror Emperor,” Thousand Rain Emperor said. “Can you believe that? Bark Mirror Emperor was almost killed! And he survived only by summoning a great being from his Northern Territory Alliance… And his name is Wan Feng Knight.”

“Wan Feng Knight is a sub-member of the Ancestral God School,” Li Li Emperor said. “He’s powerful.”

“It was him?” said Luo Feng.

Other than candidate prophets and candidate deified generals, only high achievers on the path of beast god inheritance—those who had at least completed the fifth-level inheritance—were qualified to be sub-members of the Ancestral God School. Xi Luo Duo, who had completed the sixth-level inheritance, was a universe overlord. Wan Feng knight, although not yet a universe overlord, was pretty close.

“And then?” Luo Feng asked nervously.

“True Yan Emperor pulled no punches,” Cha Man Emperor said excitedly. “After almost killing Bark Mirror Emperor, he started to fight Wan Feng Knight. But Wan Feng Knight is a sub-member of the Ancestral God School. True Yan Knight is not his match. He fled from Wan Feng Knight and retreated back to Bauhinia Island.”

“He successfully retreated?” Luo Feng said, feeling relieved.
