“Yes,” Cha Man Emperor said, nodding. “When True Yan Knight was still an emperor, he fought with universe knights, and he was able to survive. He’s good at escaping. I heard that Bark Mirror Emperor is much slower than True Yan Knight and couldn’t even get away. If Wan Feng Knight hadn’t arrived when he did, Bark Mirror Emperor would have died.”

Luo Feng was amazed. His teacher was always so low-key. He had been hiding in Primal Chaos City for hundreds of millions of years, stuck at the final step. Little did others expect that he might be even faster than Bark Mirror Emperor after becoming a universe knight, as well as being astoundingly aggressive.

Luo Feng was happy for his teacher. “Impressive,” he said. “My teacher can resist Bark Mirror Emperor’s talent technique.”

Luo Feng was curious and exhilarated about that fight. He connected to the virtual universe and got in touch with his teacher.

In an exclusive area in the virtual universe.

Each universe knight of the human race was granted a section of space. This one was a floating golden mountain. The apex of the golden mountain was covered with ice and snow. Flames burned beneath the mountain, while in the middle lived countless black plants. They managed to grow tenaciously despite being constantly burned.

Luo Feng showed up, smiled, and shouted, “Teacher!”

True Yan Knight was sitting in his palace and drinking while wearing golden armor.

“Haha! Come here, my disciple,” True Yan Knight called to Luo Feng. “Drink with me. I’m so joyful. So joyful!”

Luo Feng walked to his teacher without saying anything.

“Disciple, do you know why I’m so joyful?” True Yan Knight looked at Luo Feng.

“Why?” Luo Feng asked. “Is it because of your recent battle?”

“I expected to beat Bark Mirror Emperor easily, yet I was severely injured by that Wan Feng Knight. 54 percent of my godly body was gone! Why would I be joyful of that?” True Yan Knight gritted his teeth.

Luo Feng was curious. “Then why are you so joyful, teacher?”


Chapter 984: Twigs and Leaves of World Trees

“Windfall!” True Yan Knight took the wine and drank three glasses of it. He then looked at Luo Feng with sparkling eyes. “You know, I’m kind of lucky, too. Although my luck is nothing compared to yours, it’s still fairly good.”

“Teacher, you got a valuable?” Luo Feng asked.

“Wrong!” True Yan Knight shook his head. “When you become a universe knight, unless you make another breakthrough during your practice, getting a valuable is what makes you happiest. However, it’s not accurate to say I got a new valuable. I didn’t. The reason I’m happy is because the treasure I have turns out to be extraordinary. Although it’s not a true treasure, it’s definitely a top-tier treasure.”

Luo Feng smiled. “Congratulations, teacher.”

“I’m indeed happy. I didn’t even find it special when I was an undying fighter,” True Yan Knight said. “This was the first time I fought after becoming a universe knight. Under my new burning godly power, it evolved into a second form. It’s definitely a top-tier treasure. If it has a third form, it’s qualified as a true treasure.”

Luo Feng nodded. Shi Wu Wing had three forms. Luo Feng couldn’t help but ask, “Teacher, what kind of treasure are you talking about?”

“Haha!” True Yan Knight glanced at Luo Feng and continued, “Although I have great techniques, Bark Mirror Emperor is proficient in tracking and inspection, and he has incredible escaping skills. Even though I can suppress him, I can’t stop him from running away from me. However, a pair of combat boots I had obtained before changed into their second form, revealing their real power.”

“Those boots I created—the ones with the pinnacle technique— made me much faster,” True Yan Knight said. “Even Bark Mirror Emperor couldn’t run away from me. I could even escape Wan Feng Knight, who’s far stronger than me. My disciple, treasures that can help you flee are precious. Wan Feng Knight is as powerful as Shi Huo Knight. Being able to get away from him means I’m only an average-level universe knight, but I’m much better at fleeing. Getting a treasure is indeed delightful. All the more so if you discover that an ordinary treasure you already possess is incredibly powerful.”

Luo Feng considered these words. Even a dusty old treasure might still shine someday. True Yan had also, finally, seized his opportunity to shine. After many long years, he now stood among the great beings of the universe.

“Teacher,” said Luo Feng, “you said you’re only at the average level. How did you crush Bark Mirror Emperor? I’ve heard that lots of universe knights are afraid of him.”

“Bark Mirror Emperor isn’t that powerful himself,” True Yan Knight explained. “It’s his talent techniques that make him strong. You should know, an ordinary universe knight has a godly body 100 times stronger than an emperor limit.”

“Yes, I do.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Even the most average universe knights have godly bodies ten million times stronger than sector lords,” True Yan Knight continued. “Every universe knight will try to improve their life level. Generally, they can improve it several times. As for me, I’ve already improved mine ten times. After I became a universe knight, my godly body became 100 million times that of a sector lord. Bark Mirror Emperor’s godly body is 2,000 times stronger than that of an average emperor limit, which means his godly body is only twice as powerful as mine.”

Luo Feng nodded. That gap was not excessively large.

“His godly body, together with his defending true treasures, is what gives him the leverage to rival ordinary universe knights. Unfortunately for him, his attacking skills are mediocre, and his godly body is only twice as powerful as mine. Besides, his law comprehension is worse than universe knights, and his techniques are weaker than most universe knights. That’s why he has such mediocre attacking skills. He can only resort to his talent techniques.”

“His talent techniques are indeed mighty,” True Yan Knight went on. “Fortunately, I’m on the warrior path. I’ve been studying ‘soul defense technique,’ knowing that warriors are most vulnerable to soul attacks like illusions. I already had strong soul defense when I roamed the universe before, and it’s already a pinnacle technique. During my hundreds of millions of years in Chaos City, I spent much of my time and energy creating techniques because I knew I couldn’t have a key breakthrough in law comprehension. Though I’m not as talented as you, I created three pinnacle techniques after hundreds of millions of years of practice. The most useful and powerful one is soul defense technique. It’s still a pinnacle technique, but it’s ten times sturdier than the original one.”

True Yan Knight smiled and added, “My burning godly power, my soul defense technique, and my will—after being polished for hundreds of millions of years—give me the confidence to resist that soul attack. After all, Bark Mirror Emperor has never killed a universe knight up until now.”

Luo Feng nodded. Zhu Chong Emperor had killed universe knights before, but Bark Mirror Emperor hadn’t.

“I can withstand his talent technique attack.” True Yan Knight grinned. “After that, he’ll be crushed.”

On Bauhinia Island. In Bark Mirror Emperor’s palace.

“Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!” Bark Mirror Emperor roared.

His voice echoed through his palace. No one outside could hear it. Hatefulness filled his heart.

“Damn you, True Yan!” Bark Mirror Emperor clenched his teeth. “I remember you, now. You dared attack me! You dared attack the great special organism! You’re seeking death! When I become a universe knight, I’ll crush you like a bug… Impressive, though, that you could withstand my talent technique. And that staff technique is terrifying.”

Bark Mirror Emperor shuddered as he recalled what had happened. True Yan had almost killed him with the black staff.

“If I didn’t have my true treasures. And if Wan Feng hadn’t arrived in time…”

Bark Mirror Emperor shivered at the thought. Although his protecting true treasure was mighty, True Yan Knight was apparently more advanced at law comprehension, and the staff technique was exceptional. Even though the protecting real treasure was significantly weakened, his godly body still deteriorated.

Bark Mirror Emperor was full of resentment, seething with insanity. He had never been so close to death before. The more he thought about it, the more he hated that human.

“Just you wait,” he muttered. “Someday, I’ll become a universe knight. Just you wait…”

In the world of Nine Remoteness Space.

Luo Feng’s mind had just come back from the virtual universe.

“Rumor has it a universe knight turned from an invincible emperor is more powerful than ordinary universe knights.” Luo Feng nodded. “That rumor, it seems, is far from baseless. Practice makes perfect. My teacher is an invincible emperor already, and after practicing for an eternity, his techniques are constantly being refined. Now that he’s made his breakthrough, he’s magnificent.”

Luo Feng smiled. Mosha body had finally reached the World Trees.

“As long as I get a leaf from the World Tree,” muttered Luo Feng, “I can breed my third body. Then I’ll become undying. You dare to rob me, Bark Mirror Emperor? I shall kill you after I become undying.”

Luo Feng had extra confidence in himself. Once he became undying, his targets would be several universe knights—and some unique organisms like Zhu Chong Emperor! As for Bark Mirror Emperor? He’d kill him directly.

“This shot determines whether or not I can get a leaf from the World Tree.”

Luo Feng considered his future for a moment. He concentrated on his Mosha body.

On Tree Island in Nine Remoteness Space.

Beautiful plants covered the serene landscape of Tree Island. Seeds floated through the air.

Mosha body’s seed cluster landed on the ground beside the sector lord-level World Tree.

“Arrived,” Mosha body said. “This is it.”

He had been looking forward to this for a long time. Through the tiny filaments of the seed cluster, he could see everything in the front of him. The World Tree towered over him, each of its leaves like emerald jades. Halos surrounded the crown and the trunk.

Meanwhile, in the cave of Rock Island.

A pinnacle emperor slave with a flame origin crystal teleported himself three times.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

After the second teleportation, he arrived in the sky of the ocean. After the third, he arrived at the center of Tree Island, the domain of World Trees.

He arrived in the crown of the sector lord-level World Tree nearest to Mosha body, around 300,000 miles away.

“Explode!”

The pinnacle emperor slave threw the flame origin crystal, then promptly teleported again, moving a 600,000 miles away. He arrived under a huge tree canopy. He started to attack the sector-lord-level World Tree.

The flame origin crystal exploded!

Hong, long, long!

This flame origin crystal was more powerful than the one that had exploded last time—and at a close enough range to kill a low emperor. And this was already a relatively weaker flame god crystal.

In the aftermath of the explosion, everything close to the crystal was annihilated. In the distance, a plethora of twigs were blasted away like arrows, and the shredded leaves shot out in all angles, carried by the shockwave of the blast.

“Twigs of World Trees,” said the pinnacle-emperor slave as it grabbed a twig 1,000 feet thick. “Break!”

The emperor slave tried to snap the twig.

The sector lord World Tree started to roar furiously. Its entire canopy trembled. Its twigs and leaves slashed at the pinnacle-emperor slave.

“Damn other races, damn other races!” it roared. “You dare to hurt me again! Die! Die!”


Chapter 985: Breed the Third Body!

Last time, the most powerful World Tree had intervened, but it was not the case this time. Apparently, he wanted his child to suffer losses and learn some lessons. Besides, his godly power already surrounded the trunk of the sector-lord-level World Tree, which guaranteed his child’s survival. In that case, he would rather his child fight for itself and gain some experience.

The pinnacle emperor slave burned its godly power like a star. The mighty, burning, godly power deterred all the twigs and leaves around him.

Snap!

With a crisp snap, like a jade being broken, a twig with a diameter of more than 1,000 feet was cut off by the pinnacle-emperor slave.

“Go!” The pinnacle emperor slave was ready to teleport and leave.

Following Luo Feng’s order, he had thrown a flame origin crystal. With his burning pinnacle-emperor undying body, he had easily cut off a branch of that World Tree. Then he’d grabbed a twig and fled.

“Halt!”

The most powerful World Tree, observing from a distance, intervened. An invisible force penetrated the pinnacle-emperor slave holding the offshoot. He trembled violently, then turned to dust that floated away on the breeze.

Dead! Barely half a second had passed between from the appearance of the pinnacle emperor slave and its death.

He was still killed, Mosha body thought from within the seed cluster. I assumed the pinnacle emperor slave throwing the flame god crystal would draw the universe knight World Tree’s attention. I knew it would kill him. I just didn’t expect it to give him a chance to break a twig first.

Mosha body was perplexed. The most powerful World Tree could have easily killed the slave the moment it detected him. Instead, it had waited. Luo Feng didn’t know what was going on between these World Trees.

Weng, weng, weng!

Countless broken twigs and leaves had been blasted into the sky and scattered everywhere. The shockwave caused some plants’ seeds to fly around, and some of the twigs and leaves fell to where Mosha body’s seed cluster lay.

“It’s coming!” Mosha body was expecting this, but he didn’t dare react. Instead, he allowed himself to float along with the shockwave like an ordinary seed cluster.

Hu!

There was only one leaf on one of the broken twigs, and it came toward Mosha body.

“This is the moment,” he realized. “Go!”

Mosha body hit a twig.

Zoom!

Silently, he teleported 50 light years away, instantly leaving Nine Remoteness Space.

At the center of Tree Island, within the domain of World Trees, the sector lord World Tree was trembling and roaring. “Me! It was me again! Why? Damn it!”

“Haha, poor Seven,” taunted its siblings.

“Seven, you told me to stay out of this,” said its father. “But if I had, your attacker would’ve gotten away.”

“I told you to stay out of this,” snarled the sector lord World Tree. “I’d rather my twigs be stolen. Why did you meddle, father?”

“Don’t kid yourself,” echoed the gentle voice of the strongest World Tree. He can breed a Life Tree with that offshoot. I won’t let another race steal a World Tree offshoot.”

“Humph.”

The sector lord World Tree started to recover, and the broken leaves and twigs were flying back to its crown. It didn’t even realize that a small twig was gone. The most powerful World Tree sensed this with its dominance over the time and space, but by the time it realized what had happened, Mosha body had already escaped Nine Remoteness Space.

It wasn’t strange for the sector-lord-level World Tree not to realize its missing twig. There were fundamental differences between sector lords and undying fighters. Once the tree became undying, each leaf would merge into its soul imprint, meaning it could distinctly sense them. However, for sector lord World Trees, they were still, in a way, mostly botanical; this one had no life imprint on any of its leaves. It couldn’t feel them at all.

The same rule applied to humans. If a human undying fighter lost his arm, and it was taken tens of light years away, he could sense the arm’s location. This was not the case for sector lords.

With so much of its surroundings in ruins after the explosion, the sector lord World Tree had no way of knowing that one of its twigs had been taken away.

Teleportation? thought the most powerful World Tree. Universe knight-level teleportation? He concealed his aura so well that even I didn’t notice it. It must be his talent technique. A universe knight who knows how to change his aura only stole a twig?

The most powerful World Tree was perplexed, but it didn’t dig into it, as its child losing a leaf was like a human losing some dandruff.

In the space outside Nine Remoteness Space.

Sou!

Luo Feng appeared dressed in black, holding the emerald leaf.

“Haha! Finally, I’ve got it.” He stared at the leaf on his hand and was extremely enlivened. “My third body! If I’m lucky, I can breed a World Tree body with it. It’ll be planted in my God Country, which will be stabilized and strengthened by it. Given its size, it will be larger than the godly body of Teacher Zuo Shan Ke and Teacher Primal Chaos City Leader. Even if my other bodies’ godly power was exhausted, they could be supplemented by the World Tree body.”

Godly power in the law ocean was the purest, and once it merged with a life imprint, it was godly power with a master. His original earthling body, Mosha body, Golden Horned Beast body, and the World Tree body would all be assembled by Luo Feng’s soul imprint. Even if the Golden Horned Beast body lost 80 percent of its godly body, it could draw from the World Tree body, as 80 percent of a Golden Horned Beast was less than 1/10,000 of that of a World Tree! “It can manipulate time and space too. If I can make it.” He grew nervous.

Weng!

Emerald light flashed through the area, and an ordinary undying servant walked out of the light. This slave had been sent by Golden Horned Beast in the Primal Secret Region.

“Master of my Master.” The slave saluted Mosha body.

“Go.”

Mosha body took the slave and cast God Country Transportation. He used that slave as the center of God Country Transportation and arrived at the Primal Secret Region.

In the towering palace of the Primal Secret Region.

Tian Chen Emperor stood in the palace, waiting.

When Tian Chen Emperor saw Mosha body and the undying slave walking out of the emerald light, he bowed. “Master.”

Mosha body nodded, but he couldn’t concern himself with anything else at the moment. He commanded, “From now on, nobody is allowed in my palace.”

Sou!

Mosha body disappeared.

In the core of his internal world.

Golden Horned Beast body and Mosha body stood on a boundless plain.

Golden Horned Beast’s mountainous head was drooping to look at the World Tree’s leaf which Mosha body carried.

“The final obstacle,” Mosha body muttered. “There’s a limit to my internal-world breeding, and it’s almost 100 times the life level of golden-horned beasts. The World Tree barely falls within the limit of my internal-world breeding. Will I succeed? Or fail…?”

He was nervous. After so much effort and suffering, and with his original earthling body trapped in the Nine Remoteness World, Luo Feng didn’t regret everything he had gone through—as long as he could have the third body! After all, it was difficult for him to have a powerful body suitable for him.

“One last plunge!” Luo Feng’s eyes were bloodshot. He had never felt so anxious before.

All his three bodies were looking forward to the result—the result that determined their fate!

Zoom!

A green light flew up in the sky, shining like an aurora. Both Mosha body and Golden Horned Beast body looked up. That leaf of the World Tree flew higher and higher. The internal world had a diameter of more than 60 million miles, and the leaf didn’t stop until it flew to the very core of the internal world.

Talent technique—clone, Luo Feng gave an order through his mind.

He had three clone opportunities. One bred the earthling original body, one bred Mosha body, and this was the final one.

Hong, long, long!

The entire internal world trembled, and endless world energies began to gather… All of a sudden, his internal world seemed to have met with the apocalypse. Meanwhile, a colossal golden sphere showed up in the sky.

“The critical moment.”

Mosha body, Golden Horned Beast body, and Luo Feng, trapped in Nine Remoteness World, were all high-strung.

Peng!

The golden sphere trembled, which frightened Luo Feng and his bodies.

Peng!

The golden sphere trembled again. It was as if flame god crystals were exploding inside.

Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

The golden sphere reverberated with incessant, powerful blasts. Luo Feng could feel the great pressure from the World Tree’s life imprint inside the golden sphere, and his internal world found it difficult to withstand it.

Bang!

Cracks appeared on that golden sphere. More of them gradually came into view.

“No!” Luo Feng was shaken with fright.

Peng!

After one last quiver, the golden sphere exploded, turning into scattered world energies. The leaf of the World Tree was annihilated. Luo Feng and the Golden Horned Beast watched quietly. In the aftermath of the explosion, the internal world was silent.

In Nine Remoteness World, Luo Feng’s heart skipped a beat. He clenched his fist as bitterness flashed in his eyes. The breeding… had failed!


Chapter 986: Travel through Nine Remoteness World

Luo Feng squeezed the grass in front him so hard that it vanished.

“I failed! I failed at breeding the third body!”

Luo Feng felt like he had been knocked senseless. He hadn’t even been this upset when his original earthling body was at an impasse. He had been improving himself ever since he stepped off Earth and entered the universe. He had made so many efforts had climbed higher and higher on the ladder to becoming a great being. However, Luo Feng had to admit that Mosha body and Golden Horned Beast body helped him dearly in this process. Talent was just as important as a strong will and perseverance.

“A third body is vital to my future development and my future status in the universe. Like Immortal Knight!”

Even though he’s only a universe knight, no universe masters look down upon him, as nobody is able to kill him so far, Luo Feng thought. If I have that World Tree body, even if my other bodies fall, the abundant amount of godly power from the World Tree can revive them in no time. By then, I’ll have the same ability as an undying knight. I’ll be immortal!

“God Country is the essence of an undying fighter. A World Tree in the God Country not only would stabilize it but also make it much stronger with its talent ‘manipulation of space and time.’”

Luo Feng felt wronged. This was the sector lord special life form he had chosen that was most suitable for him! Actually, since he had the Nine Volume Manual, he could’ve found a flesh-typed special life form which could improve his godly body better than World Trees. However, Luo Feng had enough access authority to know that the universe was limited. For instance, the limit of godly body amplification and soul amplification were both 100 times. Even the unique life forms were several thousand—or even 10,000 times— stronger than the ordinary ones.

I’ve already had a golden-horned beast body, and with my Nine Volume Manual, my golden-horned beast body can definitely rival those unique life forms, Luo Feng thought. Given that, I don’t need a flesh-type special life form. After all, flesh-type creatures generally don’t have large sizes.

The size determined the amount of godly power. The larger a body, the better it was. Take the sector lord World Tree, for example. The explosion of that powerful flame origin crystal damaged several million miles of its body, but compared to its crown, which had a diameter of hundreds of millions of miles, and a height of 40 million miles, it was nothing but a minor injury!

“That most powerful World Tree. Its enormous godly body alone can leave other universe knights in despair. Even if they were to self-destruct, it would be nothing but a bee sting. It doesn’t even need to care about law comprehension, with that enormous godly body, only universe masters can be a threat to it.”

The injustice of it all was almost too much.

“What should I do now? I didn’t succeed at breeding my World Tree body. Apparently, my internal world is unable to withhold it.” Luo Feng clenched his teeth. “What should I choose for my third body?”

It was okay to fail once. Talent technique determined that he could have three bodies. Of course, he had to breed all of them before becoming undying, as if he didn’t, he would lose his internal body after becoming undying and thus waste the opportunity.

Failure to breed his third body was a heavy blow to Luo Feng, yet he recovered quickly. Now that World Trees couldn’t be bred, what other options were there?

“What should I breed for my third body?”

One special life form after another flashed through Luo Feng’s mind. Flesh-typed special life forms? Even with the Nine Volume Manual, it could only be as powerful as golden-horned beasts. It was ruled out first!

Rock race? Plant race? There were several options for these two races.

“My first choice was World Tree, and my second choice is the Ancestral Star Tree. Both of them are plant-typed special life forms. Dawn Volcano is my third choice. ” Luo Feng shook his head. Compared to World Trees, Ancestral Star Trees were obviously inferior, while the third option, Dawn Volcano, was ranked further below.

Size was of the utmost importance to Luo Feng. World Trees, Ancestral Star Trees, and Dawn Volcano were all special life forms with gigantic bodies.

“I need to think carefully,” Luo Feng muttered. “I’m now stuck in Nine Remoteness World and carrying three true treasure. I can’t lose any of them, especially Tower Pearl. I’ll ask my Mosha body to get me out of here first.”

Inside a palace surrounded by Thousand-Treasure River in the Primal Secret Region.

Sou.

Mosha body showed up in the palace.

On Rock Island in Nine Remoteness Space.

Hong, long, long!

Mosha body showed up in the ocean. These depths were tempestuous. Each drop of water was as heavy as a mountain.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Mosha body kept teleporting himself, moving farther and farther below the ocean. The force emanating from it could rival that of universe knights, which intimidated Mosha body.

“I can’t teleport myself down there anymore.” Mosha body frowned. “The bloody steam suppresses the space ripple completely. According to the universe coordinates, I’m six light days away from the original body!”

Mosha body felt anxious. Six light days meant even light would take six days to travel that distance. With his talent technique “domain,” he could travel a maximum of 6,000 miles each time. Even moving forward 100 times per second would take him two to three days to arrive.

Assuming, of course… that there was no danger awaiting him in the bloody steam.

“But it doesn’t look safe.” Mosha body looked down at the raging, bloody steam. Although the water in Nine Remoteness Ocean was heavy, it couldn’t penetrate the bloody steam. “I must at least try. I’ll only lose some energies even if I fail.”

Mosha body stopped hesitating and dove into the bloody steam. He didn’t use his talent technique domain at the beginning. Instead, he flew normally.

Mosha body felt overwhelming resistance.

Chi, chi, chi!

Mosha body tried to fly inside, but the resistance was unbelievably strong. The deeper he went, the stronger the resistance became. After moving just six feet inside the bloody steam, Mosha body was completely stuck. He couldn’t even turn back.

“Terrifying resistance…!” Mosha body was in a panic. “I can get out with domain, but great beings without my talent technique wouldn’t be able to move a muscle if they got stuck in this bloody steam. Little wonder that there’s such danger in the Nine Remoteness Master’s territory. He’s invincible here.”

Mosha body performed domain.

Sou!

The universe was composed of the elements of time and space, and every inch of the universe contained space. Mosha body turned into space instantly and turned back to the original body, moving forward 6,000 miles.

Hu! Hu! Hu! Hu! Hu! Hu!

Mosha body kept performing his talent technique, moving forward 100 times per second. Everywhere he passed was filled with endless bloody steam, and the resistance was incredibly strong. Even Mosha body couldn’t shake it.

“The original body is right under me.” Mosha body could sense it clearly. “Quick, quick, quick!”

Mosha body continuously cast his talent technique, and even though he was tired, he only rested for 20 minutes after six hours of performing domain, after which he continued diving down.

Just when Mosha body tried to dive into Nine Remoteness World, three shadows with great force flew to the circular dragnet formed by countless indigenous warriors. The shadows were the prince and his two universe knights.

The universe knight general standing in the sky gave a salutation. “Your highness.”

“Yes!” the bloody-horned general answered respectfully.

Meanwhile, the prince gave the order to the other eight generals through the virtual world. With the orders from nine generals, the warriors in the encirclement initiated the plan of capture.


Chapter 987: Walking to His Own Death

After the prince gave his order, the circular dragnet began to narrow.

The circle had a diameter of only 200 million miles, and over 100 million indigenous warriors were involved. For every undying warrior, there were 1,000 sector lord warriors. Although it might be unlikely that the sector lord warriors could stop Luo Feng, they could serve as informants.

It would take Luo Feng two to three days to break through the circle, even if he traveled in sub-lightspeed. There were nine layers of the circle. The inner eight layers were all sector lord warriors. Undying warriors and universe knight generals were in the outermost layer.

“He won’t be able to make it,” said one of the generals.

“He’s already trapped,” said the prince. “Being caught will be his only destiny.”

The sector lord warriors were tens of thousands of miles away from each other as they started to advance toward Luo Feng. Their world energies were released and connected to Nine Remoteness World energies, sweeping across the entire area. No other races could hide themselves.

The circle narrowed, and the warriors advanced.

After around three hours, a sector lord warrior flying at high speed suddenly stopped, looked down at the ground, and cried out, “Another race! It’s the intruder of another race!”

Bang!

The dry land was torn apart, and a shadow in silver armor shot up swiftly, emanating a powerful force.

“Go!” the sector-lord warrior rushed to catch up with him, but he was too slow in comparison.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Dozens of sector lord warriors started chasing Luo Feng from all directions, yet they could only watch that silver-armored and silver-winged shadow rush toward the outside of the circle.

“He won’t be able to make it. We only make up the innermost layer of the circle. There are nine layers of us!”

The sector lord warriors started to retreat back to their positions.

Meanwhile, the warriors in the northern part of the circle had stopped advancing. The second to eighth layers of sector-lord warriors started to go after him.

Zoom!

A silver-armored, silver-winged shadow was absconding straight through the sector lord warriors.

“He is fast,” commented one warrior.

“So fast,” agreed another.

Undying fighters had already gathered in the outermost layer. The sector lord warriors in the inner eight layers were trying to locate the intruder, which could help the great beings in the outermost layer congregate beforehand at the crucial position.

From the first layer to the ninth layer, the silver-armored and silver-winged shadow flew for almost 30 minutes.

Almost 800 undying warriors were split into three teams and were ready to fight.

“He’s flown through the eighth layer,” one reported. “He’ll arrive soon.”

“Everyone needs to be extra careful,” said a general. “This one is extraordinarily fast, and based on previous intelligence, even the head of our race can’t catch up with him. One-on-one combat is out of the question. Each sub-team is going to besiege him.”

30 minutes was enough for the undying warriors to fly hundreds of millions of miles away. All the undying warriors, scattered across hundreds of millions of square feet, had gathered—almost 800 undying warriors.

The prince stood at the side of the circle.

“He flew in that direction.” The prince shook his head. “It’s a pity I can’t fight him. I hope he’s strong enough to preserve 20 or 30 percent of his godly body under the attack of 800 undying warriors of my race. Then I can finally glimpse him.”

“Your highness, this intruder is extraordinary,” the lanky universe knight general said respectfully. “He won’t escape being beleaguered by 800 of warriors of our race… but he can certainly survive.”

Light flashed through the prince’s eyes. He could see everything through synchronous transfer of the virtual universe.

…

Three armies. Almost 800 undying warriors.

Weng!

The visible red flow of air was primed, swirling above each of the undying fighters. The airflow formed blurry figures of blades above every undying warrior’s right arm. Overtop of the 200 undying warriors, 200 blurry red blade figures formed a single, giant bloody blade. A giant, bloody blade was concentrated above each of the three armies of undying warriors, attracting blood-red energy from throughout the world, thus empowering them to reach the power limit of undying warriors.

Zoom!

The silver-armored and silver-winged figure showed up, saw the undying-warrior team afar, and began fleeing in the exact opposite direction in a state of panic. Unfortunately, there were now teams of undying warriors in every direction. He could only retreat!

The order was given. “Attack!”

800 undying warriors waved their right arms at the same time.

Hua!

The giant, bloody blades shot out. Nothing could stop them.

The three enormous, bloody blades pursued the silver-armored and silver-winged figure. The figure emanated incredible force in its attempt to flee, but even his speed couldn’t compare to the bloody blades. The bloody blades flew hundreds of thousands of miles, and when they touched each other, they exploded simultaneously.

Boom!

The power was so vigorous it was as if it had come from the self-destruction of a super great being. The force swept into the silver-armored, silver-winged shadow.

He had expected him to be a force to be reckoned with.

It’s not surprising that the intruder was killed. If there are enough undying warriors to stimulate adequate world energies, even universe knights can be killed.”

800 undying warriors began to retreat. It took them 30 minutes to gather just now, and it would take them nearly 30 minutes longer to return to their positions. A full hour had been wasted because of that silver-armored, silver-winged shadow.

Two hours later.

“The intruder is found! The intruder is found!”

In the wilderness.

As Luo Feng hid, he thought about his plan. He frowned. As the prince had presumed, both of the intruders were imposters—undying slaves sent by Luo Feng.

Now, all of his undying slaves were traveling throughout the circle, attracting a good number of undying warriors to gather so he could kill them in the end. It would take the undying warriors one to two hours to gather each every time.

“Fortunately, several of my slaves are soul masters who have dozens or even over 100 slaves of their own, who also have slaves.”

Luo Feng wasn’t concerned with those slaves. They were not necessarily faster than the indigenous sector lords, yet if they burned their undying power, they would be more than 1,000 times stronger, making them far stronger than sector-lord warriors.

One undying slave after another walked to his death. And they kept stalling time.

“Quick, quick, quick,” Luo Feng said, still anxious. “The slaves I send out only slow down one side of the circle while the other three armies are still advancing fast. I need to slow down all four sides!”

Almost 100 slaves will be needed to stall them one more day, Luo Feng thought. Undying slaves are useful for God Country Transportation as bait. I can’t waste them recklessly like this.

Luo Feng looked up at the sky. Mosha body was using his talent technique “domain” deep in the bloody airflow over his head, drawing closer and closer.

“Come on,” Luo Feng muttered, his stomach in knots. “Hurry! My escape depends on whether Mosha body can get here before they finish narrowing the circle.”

His original plan had been to ask the slaves to escape so that the undying warriors in the outermost layer of the circle could gather together, after which he could break free. After giving the plan a second thought, he decided it was unlikely to succeed.

The circular dragnet was delicately formed. There were nine layers, and the last layer served almost like the teeth of a massive gear, with some of the undying warriors distributed in faraway areas as sentries. Even if most of the warriors were attracted by his ruse, a few of would still remain behind as sentries, tracking in turns. This made it easy for them to block Luo Feng from escaping for one or even two hours.

If my luck runs out, I’ll run into a universe knight, thought Luo Feng. Then I’ll be doomed.

“The safest way is to ask Mosha body to do the job,” he muttered under his breath. “He’s the best at disguising and breaking free.”

Luo Feng gazed nervously at the sky.

Chapter 988

A massive quantity of bloody air had gathered in the sky above Nine Remoteness World.

Even universe knights couldn’t venture in this place, the forbidden area of Nine Remoteness World. However, Mosha body teleported through it, his body flashing in the bloody air time and time again as he advanced toward the world below.

“I have to make it!”

As Mosha body rocketed through the layer of air, the giant circular dragnet searching for Luo Feng was steadily narrowing.

“Your highness, your intelligence is unquestioned,” complimented one of his generals.

Or the three slaves trying to strike different areas of the same defensive line all at once.”

Both of the universe knights nodded.

Indeed, as the circle being narrowed, the number of indigenous warriors soon appeared intimidating. With an order, half of the sector-lord warriors and undying warriors started to dash inward.

“No!”

Luo Feng, hiding in the wilderness, was stunned. He knew what was happening, thanks to the slaves he’d sent.

“They disregard my slaves and start to charge in?” he said. “What should I do…? What should I do now?”

For the first time, Luo Feng grew fearful. Based on his previous calculations, he had abundant time. The only problem was how many undying slaves he would waste. But now, the undying slaves weren’t able to slow down their advance, which meant big trouble.

“Come on!” Luo Feng looked up at the bloody air in the sky. “Hurry up!”

The dragnet was divided into an outer circle and an inner circle. Warriors in the outer circle were still following the original plan. Those in the inner circle, however, raced in, heedless of the intruder’s slaves.

“Onward! Onward! Charge!” cried the army.

One undying slave after another rushed out and broke from the circle easily. Barely any warriors even tried to stop them.

After a day, tens of millions of warriors in the inner circle finished gathering.

“Your highness, we’ve inspected every inch of the circle,” said the lanky general.

The prince gave the order, and the circle shrank even smaller. The warriors were more concentrated than ever.

Luo Feng was stuck in a trap.

“A pincer maneuver?” Luo Feng clenched his teeth. “I’ll fight to the very end and squeeze the last bit of time for my Mosha body. It’ll take him around three hours and 17 minutes to arrive, and I must make use of the time.”

Although that almighty Nine Remoteness Master owed Primal Chaos City Leader a favor, a favor from Nine Remoteness Master was not to be spent frivolously. Luo Feng wouldn’t use it unless he absolutely had to.

As long as I can escape from the junior ones, Nine Remoteness Master will be too proud to attack me, Luo Feng thought. I’ve never heard of Nine Remoteness Master attacking an heir.

He waved his hands, and six undying slaves appeared. They saluted Luo Feng and said, “Master of my master.”

“Follow my orders,” Luo Feng said.

“Yes.”

All of the slaves took on the shape of Luo Feng and departed, following Luo Feng’s command.

Luo Feng sighed. He felt like he was going crazy. Pincer maneuvers and killing all the enemies at the same time was a good idea, but the time that elapsed was now insignificant compared to their steady advance toward Luo Feng. It wouldn’t be long now.

“Your highness, two circles will meet soon, and the other race won’t be able to make it after that.”

The two universe knights were both looking forward to the result. The prince nodded mildly with a smile on his face.

Like a rat in the trap. This was the final struggle. The undying invader’s struggle pleased the prince.

You really don’t want to die, do you? the prince thought. Otherwise, you won’t be putting up such a fight, knowing you’re in a dead end.

“Alas, you’ll be in my hands in the end,” he muttered, “and I’ll see what skills you’ve got.”

The prince was eager for this moment. He hadn’t had this much fun in his long life.

Luo Feng looked up at the sky, and his fear turned to joy.

Sou!

A figure in the sky teleported and kept blinking. He dove down immediately and stopped. It was Mosha body.

“It finally arrived!”

Luo Feng felt relieved and went into Mosha body’s world ring. Mosha body shook, and black air surged. It transformed into an indigenous undying warrior with a red body and bloody horns. Even its aura was copied from one of the undying warriors that had chased Luo Feng when he first stepped into Nine Remoteness World.

Mosha indigenous warrior’s pressure was finally mitigated. He was too tired from the past day, as he hadn’t been able to rest in the slightest. Even a universe knight couldn’t stand such weariness.

Luo Feng had an unbending will, and together with his desire for survival, he was able to make it.

“It’ll take me around eleven minutes, and the inner encirclement will arrive sooner.” Mosha indigenous warrior smiled. “Unfortunately, you’re late.”

Warriors in the inner circle and outer circle were pretty close, and they squeezed in to complete the final stage of the chokehold.

Up in the sky, the prince floated, overlooking the boundless land. All the warriors bowed to the prince to show respect when they saw him.

“Haha! The final strangle. Each inch of this space will be occupied by my warriors soon. Let’s see where he runs!”

The prince was overjoyed.

Yet after only 20 minutes…

“Your highness, my team has already searched everywhere,” one of his generals reported. “We didn’t find that powerful other race.”

“My team didn’t find the other race either,” reported another.

“We… didn’t’ find him,” said the third.

The generals reported to the prince immediately.

“What! How?” the prince shouted at the generals in the virtual world.

Reports from the nine generals further infuriated the prince.

“Yes.”

“Yes, sir.”

The nine universe-knight generals could only comply with the furious prince’s order. However, no matter how carefully they inspected the circle made by their armies, they couldn’t find Luo Feng.

Of course you can’t find me, thought Mosha body, disguised as an indigenous undying warrior. I’m one of you now.

As the 100 million warriors continued searching under the order of the infuriated prince, Mosha body flew far away.

Each warrior was responsible for one area. The same rule applied to Mosha body’s indigenous warrior form. But instead of searching, he simply flew farther and farther away without turning back.

No matter how fiercely the prince roared, none of the warriors could find Luo Feng. In the end, the prince reluctantly ordered the warriors to go back to their original positions.

Mosha indigenous warrior was in no rush.

With Mosha body, I can conceal my aura and change my identity, he thought. They won’t be able to find me. Besides, even if they find me, my talent technique “domain” can escape from even universe knights.

Mosha body was confident for a reason, as universe knights couldn’t teleport themselves in Nine Remoteness World. The great beings couldn’t teleport themselves, but Mosha body could perform his talent technique domain. Who could possibly catch up with Mosha body?

Mosha body flew in the sky for a long time, eventually coming across some indigenous warriors on his way, but none of them suspected him. They had no reason to suspect anything out of the ordinary. He looked away.

There were plenty of buildings outside the city, where lived lots of indigenous creatures with red bodies and bloody horns. The only wall was one towering one separating an inner portion of the city from the rest of it. Luo Feng presumed that some seniors and great beings lived in the inner city.


Chapter 989: Father

Luo Feng walked calmly through Nine Remoteness World, a world filled with creatures looking for him. Many indigenous creatures lived in the buildings around him, and all of them had red bodies and bloody horns. Some were babies that only reached Luo Feng’s knees, running around on the ground. Some of the older children were already fighting.

The babies are at the star traveler level, and adults are automatically sector lords, Luo Feng thought, looking around. Almost all the indigenous creatures at normal height were sector lords. No wonder there were so many sector lords chasing me. This indigenous race is indeed powerful. Much more powerful than the Golden Horned race. It might be qualified as one of the most powerful races in the universe.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. Three indigenous babies were flying and frolicking. They flew quickly with their star traveler-level power, and those small, bloody horns were almost cute.

Luo Feng thought to himself, They look like babies, but they’re naturally intelligent, like Golden Horned Beasts. Perhaps they can rival human teenagers…

Born in the Ancestral Sea? Born in the Royal Sea? “Absorbed the essence” in the Ancestral Sea? Thoughts flooded Luo Feng’s mind. Does that mean those indigenous creatures were not born to mothers? That sounds right. They’re energy-based life forms, and energy life forms are quite different from others. It seems some indigenous creatures were born in the “Ancestral Sea” while some others were born in the “Royal Sea.” The Ancestral Sea sounds superior.

Royal Sea… On my way here, I came across other indigenous creatures. I’ve heard about this prince, leading over 100 million warriors, who is trying to capture me. The prince has such a high status already, there must be a king or emperor above him.

Questions flashed through Luo Feng’s mind.

Indigenous creatures saluted Luo Feng when they saw him. Luo Feng knew that in this indigenous world, undying great beings were highly respected.

In the towering ancient city where countless indigenous residents lived.

This ancient city was much larger than the one Luo Feng was touring. It was the home of the prince, as well as several universe knight-level generals who had palaces throughout the city, too.

The prince wandered into the great palace, frowned, and clenched his teeth.

All his servants quickly had fled, and he was the only one in the palace. They were frightened for their lives. They didn’t know why their prince was so furious, but he had already executed three servants.

“They dare to laugh at me! Just because you become a universe knight sooner than me? And they think that undying fighter from another race can’t get away—that I’m hallucinating?”

The prince gritted his teeth even harder. As the supreme being of this world, even universe knights revered him. Only his brothers dared provoke him. The 108 brothers constantly competed with each other, and his failure to encircle and trap the undying intruder couldn’t be kept a secret. Thus, he was mercilessly ridiculed.

The prince waved his hand.

Hong, long, long!

The door closed. The servants outside didn’t dare to make a sound.

In the palace, a red light dimmed on the huge pillar, soaking the entire palace in a red glow.

Hong, long, long!

Then he started to complain. “I led 100 million warriors to encircle and suppress an undying intruder from another race, and my warriors killed many undying slaves. Yet the undying intruder must still be alive. I even asked the 300 undying warriors who guard the Nine Remoteness Whirlpool at that time. Those who chased him said he was unbelievably fast. The slaves killed afterward were nothing like that. This confirms my suspicions. But—but…” The prince clenched his teeth to prevent himself from stuttering with frustration.

“You’re not wrong,” said the giant head. “But neither are they. Nine Remoteness World energies can’t detect this intruder, and that’s why they think you’re hallucinating.” The giant head stared at the prince. “But the intruder is indeed still alive.”

By all accounts, it would appear he has been killed already. You claim that he’s still alive, so let me ask you this: How do you surmise that he got away?”

The prince was bewildered.

“Because he can disguise himself,” said the giant head, looking down. “He can camouflage himself as any creature of my Nine Remoteness race.”

Aggression filled the prince’s eyes when he thought about this. It was a determination that came from an infinity of repression. None of the princes were allowed outside Nine Remoteness World unless they became universe knights.

Luo Feng walked among the buildings. He saw another group of babies playing in front of him.

Those born in the Royal Seas can’t compare to us. There are 108 Royal Seas, but even the largest Royal Sea is nothing compared to the Ancestral Sea.

The baby indulged in this grand verbiage and was obviously proud to be born in the Ancestral Sea. Luo Feng’s heart skipped a beat. The pieces were falling into place.

It must be the Nine Remoteness Ocean! Nine Remoteness Space is actually Nine Remoteness Ocean with some islands on it, and Nine Remoteness Ocean has bred indigenous life forms.

He can go there when he is stronger… It must be difficult for these indigenous warriors to leave this world to see the Ancestral Sea again. Since it is easier to see the Royal Seas, those must be located inside Nine Remoteness World.


Chapter 990: Strictly Confidential

108 princes? And 108 Royal Seas? Mosha body thought, standing still. Ancestral Sea and Royal sea. 108 Royal Seas and 108 princes. Do the Royal Seas have something to do with the princes?

108 princes, and based on my information, some of the princes are universe knights, some are undying fighters, and others are sector lords. The princes are of royal blood, and they even have universe-knight guards, which would make it difficult to get their genes. If a prince is, indeed, so gifted… then I’ll use the favor Nine Remoteness Master owes my teacher to acquire my third body.

Mosha body sorted out his mind instantly. Based on the information at hand, this seemed likely. The numbers matched perfectly. Besides, Nine Remoteness Master was undefeatable in Nine Remoteness Space. It was likely that these facts were related. The princes could be regarded as weaker versions of Nine Remoteness Master!

Those indigenous creatures did say the princes were immortal!

The more information Luo Feng gathered about the Emperor and the princes, the more curious he got. Eventually, he decided it was time to meet again with Primal Chaos City Leader.

In the virtual universe, at the apex of Thunder Island.

In that towering palace surrounded by haze, Luo Feng stepped in.

Luo Feng took a deep breath and said, “I obtained the leaf of the World Tree as planned. Unfortunately, I didn’t manage to breed my third body.”

“However, I’ve discovered something more interesting.” Luo Feng looked at Primal Chaos City Leader but hesitated.

Primal Chaos City Leader glanced at Luo Feng in shock, then said, “That is a top secret in the universe, but since you’ve already deduced part of it, I’ll tell you. Nine Remoteness Master is Nine Remoteness Ocean, and Nine Remoteness Ocean is Nine Remoteness Master!”

Luo Feng trembled. God! This was even more unbelievable than he thought.

“Nine Remoteness Master has always been a terrific being,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “He is my rival. Actually, in one-on-one combat, he’s weaker than me. So what makes him my rival? Because even if I kill him, he would be resurrected very soon after. In other words, he’s immortal!”

Luo Feng was startled.

That’s why even the Ancestral God School treats Nine Remoteness Master with respect. Lots of issues that the beast gods can’t deal with are left to him.”

After all, it should take a long time to resurrect such a powerful godly body. It has been discovered that each time he dies, Nine Remoteness Ocean gives birth to a new Nine Remoteness Master. Nine Remoteness Ocean is his endless source.”

Because of a certain true treasure, two universe knights of the demon race jointly hunted Nine Remoteness Master and chased him to Nine Remoteness Ocean. Within Nine Remoteness Ocean, he is invincible!”


Chapter 991: Arrival at the Royal Sea

“He has the ocean with a diameter of ten-something light years…” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “Who in the universe can rival him in terms of godly power? The size of his godly body is outrageous.”

Luo Feng nodded. It was indeed outrageous.

There were quite a few special organisms in the universe, and lots of them had colossal bodies, yet even the largest special life forms had the height of several hundred million miles, and most of them were of the plant race and rock race. As for Nine Remoteness Ocean, it had a diameter of over ten light years!

Several hundred million miles, compared to over ten light years, was like the most powerful World Tree being compared to Nine Remoteness Ocean; it was a drop in the bucket!

“Nobody has ever figured out why he has such an unbelievably enormous body.” Primal Chaos City Leader shook his head. “Nobody else’s godly body can compare to his. I’ve also heard that Nine Remoteness Master doesn’t have any talent techniques.”

“Huh?” Luo Feng was dazed. No talent techniques?

“Nine Remoteness Master is no doubt a special life form in the universe,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “However, even if he’s annihilated, and another godly body is bred, he has never mastered any talent techniques. It’s a fair universe, after all. He was already bestowed, by the universe, an outrageously large godly body. As such, he must be strictly limited in other fields.”

Primal Chaos City Leader suddenly looked at Luo Feng and asked, “Why are you here to ask about Nine Remoteness Master? Can you tell me the reason now?”

“I want to breed my third body,” answered Luo Feng. “A third body like the prince.”

“The prince?” Primal Chaos City Leader was dazed

“Yes,” said Luo Feng. “The princes in Nine Remoteness World. “Based on what I know, those princes have something akin to Nine Remoteness Ocean, but they’re called Royal Seas!”

“Yes. Three children. One of them is a universe overlord, and the other two are universe knights. However, they can be revived even if they’re killed.”

And there are 108 Royal Seas in Nine Remoteness World! But those princes are not equally powerful. There are three universe knights, dozens of undying fighters and dozens of sector lords.

“108?” Primal Chaos City Leader was startled. “If there are 108 of them, their life level won’t be too high. You’ll have a high chance of success.”

Luo Feng nodded. He had thought the same thing. There were nine World Trees, whereas Nine Remoteness Master had 108 children. The greater the number, the lower the life level. After all, the more powerful the life forms were, the rarer they were. Some special life forms were the only one of their kind.

“You want to acquire the water of a Royal Sea?” Primal Chaos City Leader asked.

“All the 108 Royal Seas are located at the center of Nine Remoteness World, and no indigenous armies are guarding them,” Luo Feng said.

“Wrong.” Primal Chaos City Leader shook his head. “Nine Remoteness Master will notice it, even without armies.”

Luo Feng was dazed, but he quickly realized Primal Chaos City Leader was right! Nine Remoteness Ocean part of Nine Remoteness Master himself, and the entire ocean was completely under his control. He would be aware of anything that happened there.

“I’ll only take a little water. I think it’s going to be okay.” Luo Feng was nervous.

“I wouldn’t be so sure,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “The water is part of his children’s godly bodies, after all. But even I can’t be sure what will happen. If Nine Remoteness Master finds out that you are taking the water, just tell him you’re my disciple. He owes me a huge favor, and some water will be fine.”

Luo Feng felt more grateful than ever for his teacher. Primal Chaos City Leader had, indeed, helped him a lot.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng contently. If Luo Feng’s future third body was like Nine Remoteness Master’s, he could be revived shortly after he died! And the energies were limitless! Then Luo Feng would certainly become an incredible immortal warrior of the human race!

Luo Feng could resist the urge no longer. “I’ll go and get the water now.”

“Go,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. He also looked forward to the result.

In Nine Remoteness World.

Mosha body’s eyes blazed. He flew up in the sky and raced towards the center of Nine Remoteness World. This world was so immense that Mosha body flew for over half a year until he finally reached his destination.

“The Royal Seas!”

Mosha body stood in the sky, looking out over the boundless ocean. It was a spectacular sight.

“I’ll examine the 108 Royal Seas first.”

Although he knew of the existence of the 108 Royal Seas, he didn’t have any details about them. The sizes of the oceans would make a huge difference to his future godly body, which was why Luo Feng needed to decide carefully. He spent another month flying around the seas for inspection.

56 of the 108 Royal Seas were red and were worthy of the name “Bloody Seas”! All 56 Bloody Seas were of the same size, with a diameter of around 50 million miles.

There were also 49 Royal Seas in which water tumbled inside. They looked like the other seas but had diameters of 600 million miles, and these were the so-called “Small Royal Seas” the indigenous creatures talked about.

There were also three Royal Seas with diameters ranging from 20 billion miles to 63 billion miles. These were the legendary “Large Royal Seas.”

“So many indigenous creatures come here for worship,” Mosha body said, looking down.

Around the 108 Royal Seas, especially around the Small Royal Seas and Large Royal Seas, many indigenous creatures groveled to show their veneration. As for the Bloody Seas, barely anyone was around them.

“Worship.” Mosha body nodded.

A great number of indigenous creatures were born in Small Royal Seas and Large Royal seas. That meant these Royal Seas were like their parents! “I can use this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship once I become undying.” Luo Feng nodded. “When I become much stronger in the future and able to drive Star Tower, that will be my trump card. After that, this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship will be my vehicle only on the surface. Silver Dragon Phantom Ship sounds redundant… I’ll just call you ‘Galaxy.'”

Luo Feng named it after its aura of silver light, glimmering like the stars in the galaxy. Treasures all had their own original names, but most of them sounded redundant. Purple clock was one such example. Its original name was Demon Note Flame God Clock, but Luo Feng called it “purple clock” instead.

Galaxy, you’ll be my partner until I can drive Star Tower, Luo Feng thought, looking at the ancient ship in his hand.


Chapter 994: Valuables! Valuables!

It had been 500 years since Luo Feng came back from Nine Remoteness Space.

In the Land of Valuables of the Ancestral God School.

The end of the mountain range was not visible. Mountains stood shoulder-to-shoulder. Some of them were towering, and some were precipitous. There were lakes of all sizes between the mountains.

A fighter stood using his snake tail to wipe clean the rock behind him. “I haven’t seen a new valuable for a long time. They say there are countless valuables here. It wouldn’t make sense if valuables showed up all the time! No matter how many valuables there are, they will be gone in the end. It’s boring if the valuables don’t appear. Valuables coming into sight, that view is thrilling.”

Expectation flashed through the triangular eyes of the snake-tailed other race.

“I really hope that view is for me.”

“Haha…!” someone laughed all of a sudden. “You’ve been here tens of millions of times. Stop dreaming.”

“It’s Blade River Emperor,” said a nearby heir.

“Blade River Emperor’s here!” another replied.

“Blade River hasn’t shown up after coming back from Nine Remoteness Space. The first place he chose to land is in the Land of Valuables.”

“Where is he? Where is Blade River Emperor?”

Many heirs were looking in all directions, some even flew up in the sky, and soon, they all turned in the same direction. A silver-armored human youngster was flying directly to the tallest mountain in the Land of Valuables.

Luo Feng looked around and rejoiced in his heart. “Looks like I’m famous among the heirs of Ancestral God School.”

What made Luo Feng overjoyed was the progress he had made in the past 500 years, especially the maturing of his third body.

“It’ll take around 100 more years for my third body to mature, after which I can become undying. I need to come here before turning into an undying fighter.” Luo Feng glanced at the mountain range where there were innumerable valuables. “I’m a sector lord now. Perhaps some supreme beings prepared valuables for sector lord-level heirs. If I become undying, I won’t be able to take them anymore.”

Sou!

His first target was the tallest of the mountains. Each of the 108 mountains stored one of the most precious of 108 valuables, and only 42 of them had been acquired by heirs. The others were still waiting for the suitable heirs.

“Look, Blade River Emperor went to the tallest mountains.”

“It seems Blade River Emperor came here for valuables, too. He came here once before, and after confronting Bei Shan Knight, he left instantly without taking a proper tour around the Land of Valuables. I thought he wasn’t interested in this place. Finally, he came.”

“108 most precious valuables are equally distributed among the 108 tallest mountains in the Land of Valuables. And his first target is the tallest one. He’s ambitious.”

Among the great beings of other races standing afar, some were jealous of or even hostile against Luo Feng.

With a loud snort, a figure with golden hair and eyes walked out from the apex of a mountain. His back was slightly bent, giving him the appearance of an aggressive beast. Bark Mirror Emperor!

“Bark Mirror Emperor, do you think Blade River Emperor can get a valuable?” asked an heir.

“He’s targeting the highest mountain,” several heirs beside him said.

Bark Mirror Emperor smirked. “The valuables on the highest mountains have been here ever since the Ancestral God School was founded. Rumor has it that they were placed by one of the ancestral gods. A few sector lord-level special life forms throughout the history have tried, but none of them could get a valuable. As for Blade River Emperor, he’s so unqualified for the Land of Valuables.”

The heirs around him nodded.

“Bark Mirror Emperor,” came a voice from a towering figure.

Bei Shan Knight’s eye went wide in surprise.

“Humph! Do you think you can be my ally just because both of us hold grudges against that Blade River Emperor? You damn one-eyed thing who bullied an undying heir from my Northern Territory Alliance! Get the hell away from me.”

Bark Mirror Emperor showed his fangs and stared at Bei Shan Knight coldly. Bei Shan Knight’s body trembled with anger. He was a universe knight who had heard that Bark Mirror Emperor was ruthless, greedy, and unapproachable, which was why he hadn’t approached him until now. Now that there was a feud between Bark Mirror Emperor and Blade River Emperor, he thought they could be closer because of their commonality.

He was willing to become friends with Bark Mirror Emperor, who was already his equal. Once Bark Mirror Emperor became a universe knight, he could become a universe overlord with some proper training very soon. But Bark Mirror Emperor clearly did not share this sentiment.

“Okay, okay,” said Bei Shan Knight, so furious that his face was twitching. “Bark Mirror Emperor, how ruthless you are.”

Bark Mirror Emperor clenched his teeth, snorted, and flew away. Bark Mirror Emperor simmered. “Just who does he think he is?”

The heirs around him gazed at each other with dismay. Heirs like Bark Mirror Emperor and Zhu Chong Emperor were so powerful that they didn’t need to respect universe knights! There were differences between universe knights. Those who were universe overlords could crush Bark Mirror Emperor without any problem.

Even Bark Mirror Emperor and Zhu Chong Emperor needed proper training to become universe overlords after becoming universe knights.

Without a doubt, these special life forms—whose life levels were thousands of times higher than ordinary life forms—had great potential to become universe overlords, which was why the top superpowers like the Northern Territory Alliance and the Ancestral God School all valued special life forms and even gave them true treasures.

Luo Feng didn’t see the confrontation between Bark Mirror Emperor and Bei Shan Knight. He landed on the tallest of the mountains.

“The tallest mountain means the most precious valuable,” he said. “Rumor has it that an ancestral god put the valuable here personally.”

Luo Feng stood on the top of the mountain and walked around, but nothing happened. The rule said the valuable would show itself if an heir was qualified and stood on the mountain.

If there was no change… Luo Feng was not qualified. He had failed!

The heirs standing afar began to gossip about what they had just seen. As for Bark Mirror Emperor, he had a rare smile on his face.

“It is 90 percent possible that Blade River Emperor is Luo Feng,” he muttered. “Luo Feng is True Yan’s disciple.”

Bark Mirror Emperor snorted and stared at Luo Feng. Although he had hunted Luo Feng before, he wasn’t quite as belligerent now as he had been. He had, after all, almost been killed by True Yan Knight! That encounter was the closest he had ever been to death!

Bark Mirror Emperor was infuriated! He hated True Yan Knight and swore that he would kill True Yan once he became a universe knight. Blade River Emperor was likely to be a disciple of True Yan, who went after him to avenge Blade River Emperor, which made Bark Mirror Emperor antagonistic against Blade River Emperor, too.

“True Yan. Blade River.” Bark Mirror said the two names in a low voice.

“Bark Mirror Emperor!” an heir called out. “Blade River Emperor failed again! This time, he went to the second tallest mountain, and he stopped by other mountains and lakes. Nothing happened!”

“He arrived at the second tallest mountain. Haha! Nothing happened at all.”

The heirs kept talking.

Bark Mirror Emperor smiled more and more broadly. He said, “It’s not that easy to get a valuable! The most precious 108 valuables here have been attracting heirs since the beginning of the universe, and only 42 of them have been taken. On average, the time elapsed between two valuables being taken is practically an eternity. The conditions are harsh.”

One mountain after another, one lake after another.

Luo Feng kept flying and landing, flying and landing…

Failed! Failed! Failed!

Luo Feng failed again and again, from the tallest mountain to the sixtieth tallest mountain. He also stopped by lots of other places along the route, which took him tens of hours. Meanwhile, undying fighters watched while drinking glasses of wine.

“It’s so difficult to open a valuable,” Luo Feng said.

However, he did not panic. He had come here, after all, simply to try. “It seems lots of other races hate me.”

Luo Feng flew to a canyon and glanced at the onlookers afar. In the past tens of hours, he had been watched. Most of the heirs were just watching him try for fun, while some were actually jealous or hostile toward him. In fact, most weren’t hostile toward Luo Feng personally; instead, they were hostile toward the whole human race. The human race was a peak race in the universe and had committed countless massacres in the universe. Other races wanted to kill them!

Humans were ruthless when it came to killing other races, and generation after generation, many races had learned to loathe humans.

“The peak races became peak races through killing! You can’t be a peak race if you’re merciful. You need resources to become a peak race, and you need to kill to get the resources!” This was what True Yan had told Luo Feng once when they were drinking together.

Presently, Luo Feng spotted some other races flying toward him, cursing the human race. However, Luo Feng just sneered.

Those who were not his kin were sure to be of a different heart. Everyone was fighting for their own race, and there was no right or wrong.

Humans needed to kill or enslave a plethora of animals to survive on earth. If humans were not pitiless enough, they might have been killed off by those other animals. The same rule applied.

Luo Feng had such a strong will that he disregarded all the curses. “This is the universe. The weak are the prey of the strong.”

Luo Feng arrived at the 106th tallest mountain. He didn’t have much hope by now. However, just as Luo Feng landed on the 106th tallest mountain…

Hong, long, long!

The entire mountain started to quiver, which attracted the attention of all the heirs present. Suddenly, hustle and bustle filled the Land of Valuables.


Chapter 995: Ancient Ship Galaxy

Luo Feng felt the mountain quivering right after he landed on its top, even before he moved. He was bewildered… Was this the sign that the treasure was opening?

The mountain kept trembling more and more fiercely.

The heirs who had been chatting casually or looking for treasures all shot up and looked toward the mountain Luo Feng stood on. Soon, the sky was filled with heirs from all races in every direction.

“The treasure!”

“The treasure will be opened.”

“He opened the treasure!”

Bark Mirror Emperor flew up too. “Impossible!” He opened his golden eyes wide and saw that there were seven heirs on the trembling mountain, including Luo Feng. “It has to be one of the other six heirs. It has to be!”

He hated Blade River Emperor from the bottom of his heart and was not willing to see him get the valuable. It was the 106th tallest mountain. Although it was only ranked 106th, it was still one of the top 108 valuables, and each was as valuable as a true treasure. Even the lower-ranked valuables were a match for most average true treasures.

Bark Mirror Emperor only had one ordinary true treasure and refused to believe that Blade River Emperor could also get one.

Unfortunately for Bark Mirror Emperor, that wasn’t his decision.

The Five-Colored Aurora Lake was right above the mountain, and suddenly, thousands of auroras started to swirl like whirlpools.

Xiu! Xiu! Xiu! Xiu! Xiu! Xiu!

Thousands of auroras dropped from the sky, each of them more than six thousand miles long and comprised of five colors. They dove like meteors and enveloped the mountain instantly—separating it from the outside world like an impossibly massive bead curtain.

The heirs felt an upwelling of emotions looking at the magnificent scene! Breathtaking! The thousands of auroras bore incredibly energy. Just a few of them was all it would take to kill a universe knight! It was, after all, the guarding true treasure of the first power of the universe, and also the most powerful true treasure in the universe.

Bark Mirror Emperor clenched his teeth and showed his fangs, watching furiously. But what could he do?

The heirs beside him looked at each other but didn’t dare to make a sound, as they knew that Bark Mirror Emperor was infuriated.

Bei Shan Knight looked at Bark Mirror Emperor afar and cursed him. “Imbecile. An idiotic, crazy, ferocious beast with no intelligence.”

Ferocious beasts were creatures in the universe with great power but limited intelligence.

Even though Luo Feng couldn’t see anything happening outside, he could guess what was happening. He smiled, feeling the mountain tremble under his feet.

“It’s me who gets the valuable.”

He had heard about the scene when a valuable within the land of valuables was triggered. Some of the supreme beings in the Ancestral God School had designed specific conditions for opening unlocking the valuables hidden there, and those conditions were managed by the Five-Colored Aurora Lake! It monitored everything it covered, and every move by the heirs was under careful surveillance.

For instance, when Luo Feng was assassinated and revived, he had the apparent aura of a sector lord. Five-Colored Aurora lake would then record information that he was a sector lord with clone technique, and the attributes were automatically collected and processed by the lake. Once the attributes matched the conditions of a certain valuable, it would reveal that valuable if a qualifying heir arrived at its location.

However, for the sake of confidentiality, it would blockade the area where the valuable was hidden to make sure that only the valuable contributor, the valuable opener, and the Five-Color Aurora Lake knew what the valuable was. When Seven Blade Emperor had gotten a valuable, nobody had known what valuable he had acquired.

There was only one object in the world ring. An ancient ship!

It was 75,000 miles long and 19,000 miles wide. Shining with silver light, the ship looked more like a seagoing warship than a spaceship.

“What is it?”

Luo Feng snuck his spiritual force into the ancient ship and merged a trace of spirit imprint into the ship. All of a sudden, a great amount of information flooded his mind, which amazed him.

Luo Feng reached out his hand.

Sou!

A flash of silver flight flew out and fell into his palm. It was an ancient ship the size of a glass marble.

“It is… It is the flying-palace type treasure!” Luo Feng’s eyes were blazing, and he gazed at the ancient ship with excitement. “It’s only a top-tier treasure, but it’s believed to be as precious as a true treasure. No wonder… It’s a flying-palace type, and there are definitely great beings willing to trade it with a true treasure.”

Luo Feng instantly knew everything about the ancient ship. It was called “Silver Dragon Phantom Ship,” and it was a top-tier treasure and functioned like Sky Wolf Palace. It would protect the user as long as he was inside the ship. Unless the enemy destroyed the ship, a material attack would be rendered almost useless, and a soul attack would also be significantly weakened. If Luo Feng had this ship when he was hunted by Bark Mirror Emperor, he couldn’t be hurt by Bark Mirror Emperor as long as he hid inside the ship, and he could get rid of Bark Mirror Emperor with the ship.

Similarly, Master of Sky Wolf had escaped the dreadful attack that came from entire burning Nine Remoteness Ocean with the help of his Sky Wolf Palace.

“Armor can only weaken a small portion of material attacks and soul attacks,” Luo Feng said, his eyes gleaming. “But this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship is enormous, and staying inside is like being protected by a huge fortress. It’s better even than the most expensive godly base of the automaton race.”

Though Silver Dragon Phantom Ship couldn’t change its direction flexibly, it was incredibly speedy running on a straight line and had mighty defending power.

“Haha! This is a top-tier treasure. Universe knights definitely won’t be able to destroy it. As for universe masters, even they might need to use significant energies to damage a top-tier treasure.” Luo Feng was overjoyed. Inside the Silver Dragon Phantom Ship, together with his Tower Pearl to protect his soul, once he became undying…

Luo Feng couldn’t help grinning.

Of course, a valuable needed adequate power to be utilized. Otherwise, it would be taken by a supreme being if the user couldn’t drive the ancient ship fast enough.

“I can use this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship once I become undying.” Luo Feng nodded. “When I become much stronger in the future and able to drive Star Tower, that will be my trump card. After that, this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship will be my vehicle only on the surface. Silver Dragon Phantom Ship sounds redundant… I’ll just call you ‘Galaxy.’”

Luo Feng named it after its aura of silver light, glimmering like the stars in the galaxy. Treasures all had their own original names, but most of them sounded redundant. Purple clock was one such example. Its original name was Demon Note Flame God Clock, but Luo Feng called it “purple clock” instead.

Galaxy, you’ll be my partner until I can drive Star Tower, Luo Feng thought, looking at the ancient ship in his hand.


Chapter 996: Inborn Beast God

Luo Feng waved his hands, and the Ancient Ship Galaxy merged into the skin of his arm.

“I got all my spaceships from the emperors, but I already feel that they’re inadequate. My original plan was to get a better spaceship after becoming undying, but this Ancient Ship Galaxy that can rival a true treasure is better than any spaceship built by humans or the automaton race.” Luo Feng was overjoyed.

Xiu!

A trace of shrinking aurora flew towards Luo Feng. This startled him, as the universe knight who had tried to assassinate him had been easily killed by the aurora. Luo Feng tried to dodge it, but the surrounding space seemed to be sealed, making it difficult for Luo Feng to move.

The aurora touched Luo Feng gently.

“Huh?” Luo Feng stood on the ground, dazed.

Hong!

The rocks that had begun to float when the treasure was revealed suddenly dropped back down into the hole, and the mountain reverted back to how it was originally. The thousands of auroras shrouding the mountain from sight shot up and flew back to the Five-Colored Aurora Lake.

“A treasure to recover his godly body?”

The moment the aurora touched his head, he received some information—a message from the valuable’s contributor to the future inheritor of the valuable. He heard a voice passing along the message.

“I don’t belong to any race, and I’ve been all alone since the beginning of the universe. The only friend I have is ‘Crane Knight,’ but Crane is blessed with good luck. Since the Ancestral God School set up a land of valuables, I’ll leave this Silver Dragon Phantom Ship to my juniors. Remember, it was Wine Master who gave you the valuable. Hahaha…”

Luo Feng immediately realized that it was a universe master who had given him the valuable, but his title was a bit bizarre.
