In the starry sky, Mosha body sat cross-legged on a meteorite. He transformed into a beam of light and rode off to roam the starry sky.

“To be able to kill a universe overload…” Luo Feng mused. “Luckily, this is Land of Extremis, where there is no way to contact the outside world and no way to call for help. Otherwise, how would a universe overlord perish so easily?”

Universe overlords were difficult to kill. When an unfavorable circumstance occurred, the first thing one should do would be to escape. Should one not manage to escape, then stalling for time to devise a plan—and immediately calling for help—would be the next step!

If Demon Sword Knight had been fighting against Luo Feng on the original star, the direst situation would be to sustain injuries, and he could count on the other great beings of the Nine Territory Alliance to come to his rescue immediately. But here in the Land of Extremis, there was simply no way to call for help. That was why Demon Sword Knight had to lose his life.

“Among the many universe overlords within my human race, there are some who have yet to kill universe overlords. Yet I have killed one now. Haha…!”

Luo Feng shook his head and laughed. Upon killing Demon Sword Knight, Golden Horned Beast’s godly body had merely fallen below 42 percent to 41.9 percent.

Hua!

Sitting cross-legged on the meteorite, he continued speeding through the star sky.

In the twinkling of an eye, two months passed. In Luo Feng’s God Country, in front of a golden palace in the vast sky above the Remote Ocean, Luo Feng stood up.

“Finally, a success.”

Spending one year or so on training, he had finally managed to accomplish the sixth and seventh volumes of the Nine Volume Manual. Of course, he had his original earthing godly body to thank for that, as its small size helped speed things up… Golden Horned Beast body must still be stuck at the sixth volume—and only at the beginning stage of the sixth volume. Obviously, its massive size would impede the evolution of its godly body.

“Back when I was training for the first five volumes, my godly body genes were 48 times stronger after merging with 100 blood river crystals. By default, blood river crystals should generate an increase of 100 times, but it seems like the more I advance, the more the multiplying effect starts to gradually weaken… Now, I have only achieved an increase of 3,000 times. I am now going to work on two more volumes. My godly body is around 9,800 times stronger. There is no attaining the perfect gene level.”

Luo Feng sighed. The blood river crystals would no doubt help to increase his life gene level, yet for his original earthling body, the increment—in theory and in actuality—did not correspond to 100 percent.

The first seven volumes of the Nine Volume Manual had brought his genes up 192 times… but with 100 blood river crystals, there was only an increase of 50 times more.

“9,800 times,” he said. “Out of all the unique life-forms that were unique in the universe, there were only a few who could get this strong. I should be satisfied. Moreover, there is still the eighth volume. And the ninth! I don’t believe that even after I reach the ninth volume I will still be unable to attain the perfect gene level. And my Golden Horned Beast body can take this opportunity to reach the perfect gene level in one stroke.”

Luo Feng had not lost hope. Golden Horned Beast body had already exceeded 6,000 times previously! The sixth and seventh volumes were strong, and the blood river crystals were compatible with Golden Horned Beast. So long as there were no accidents, he would be able to attain the perfect gene level.

“That is when Golden Horned Beast will become invincible. At least by that time I would be able to put my incredible talent technique ‘I Am the Universe’ to good use.” Luo Feng could not wait for that day to come. Calculating the time required, he estimated that Golden Horned Beast would take at least 100 years to complete the sixth and seventh volumes.

“Well, it is only 100 years. It will pass in the blink of an eye.”

In the vast, starry sky, black-robed Luo Feng sat cross-legged on the meteorite. It felt like he was moving very fast, but in contrast with the vastness of the sky, he might as well have been casually strolling.

Hua!

Suddenly, countless space ripples were seen.

“What?”

Luo Feng, sitting on the meteorite being driven by inertia, went right through the layer of ripples. There were no obstructions in his way, yet the moment his godly body grazed the ripples, he felt an intangible force brush past his godly body and permeate his world ring. There, it grazed his Golden Horned Beast godly body.

It was unstoppable. He had been completely grazed by the ripples.

The feeling that he got when being grazed by the ripples was unbearable. It felt like layers of knives slashing his godly body. When he made it past the layer of ripples, his Mosha body was left with only 30% of its godly being.

“Such frightening space ripples. What exactly is that? This… this starry sky has changed?”

Luo Feng was shocked to discover that after passing through the ripples, the space before him was completely different. The sky before had been like any other in the universe, where the distances between the stars were generally far, and the star traveler levels were average. Yet on this side of the sky, it had a beauty that was out of this world. The distance between stars was nearer. Together, they were connected to depict a beautiful picture.

Luo Feng was vaguely aware that the countless planets combined to paint a picture that contained some form of secret law engravings.

“A hidden starry sky exists in the Land of Extremis?” Luo Feng wondered aloud.

Sitting on the meteorite, he cruised along at a leisurely pace, and soon, he was nearing the first star traveler level, which was the one closest to him.

He was approaching a khaki-colored planet that appeared ordinary. But Luo Feng faintly sensed something…

“This khaki-colored planet with no signs of life and a diameter of 13,000 miles… Star Tear Gold! It actually contains the mineral veins of the Star Tear Gold!”

Luo Feng’s face turned pale. Looking at the star traveler level without any living beings, he was shocked.

“What an impressive energy reserve. If I were to swallow this star, my Golden Horned Beast’s massive godly body would be able to recover to 80 percent.”

Luo Feng could not help feeling incredulous.

Star Tear Gold, although it was only a G-grade metal, was unique… It was said that when a great star level collapsed to become a black hole, it would produce a piece of metal: Star Tear Gold. Star Tear Gold was, hence, a product of the tearing of the star level. Although it was only a G-grade metal, its functionality made it very precious.

Luo Feng had yet to come across such a thing, where a precious metal could form mineral veins that occupied almost an entire planet! Even the godly body of a universe overlord as big as 600 miles, upon swallowing this star, would be able to recover to 80 percent.

Hua!

Luo Feng disappeared in an instant, and Golden Horned Beast appeared.

Sou!

Golden Horned Beast flew off the meteorite and sped toward the khaki-colored planet.

A moment later, when he was about to arrive at the khaki-colored planet, Golden Horned Beast chanced upon another golden planet that that was quite close by. Casually, he exerted his godly power, and what he sensed gave him a shock.

“What? That golden planet contains Void Rock mineral veins. What an alarming reserve! In terms of value, it is definitely comparable to the Star Tear Gold of this planet.”

Hong!

Golden Horned Beast landed on the khaki-colored planet, raised his head to look at the countless planets, and decided, “I shall investigate these two planets, they have precious mineral veins. And this mysterious space has countless planets. Does it mean that all of them contain precious mineral veins?”


Chapter 1060: Space God Mountain

Silence.

It was dead silent in this mysterious space, and the Golden Horned Beast was the only living creature here.

“No matter what, I’ll recover my godly body first. I can only better handle the danger when I become stronger.”

The Golden Horned Beast was suddenly enlarged, and he became 60,000 miles long. He floated above the space, and the space only had a diameter of 12,000 miles. The Golden Horned Beast was much larger than the planet.

“Inherited technique, ‘Swallow’!”

The Golden Horned Beast opened his mouth, and the space around the planet was completely twisted. He was able to swallow the entire planet if he wanted, but he felt like it would be a waste if he just destroyed a star filled with Star Tear Gold. He controlled how fast he swallowed the Star Tear Gold. Masses of Star Tear Gold flew out and went into the mouth of the Golden Horned Beast. His gaping mouth swallowed the gold like a black hole.

Star Tear Gold and rocks kept being absorbed by the Golden Horned Beast, and the gold godly power kept recovering the Golden Horned Beast.

After a short while, half of the Star Tear Gold was swallowed by the Golden Horned Beast, and his godly body recovered to 60 percent. “I’ll go to another planet,” he said.

The Golden Horned Beast flew to the closest planet and started to swallow the void rocks floating in space. He finished half the void rocks. He started to go to the third planet…

And found that on the third planet was the precious “Bright Barium Swallowing Crystal Lake.” Bright Barium Swallowing Crystal was a black, liquid metal like mercury. There were three enormous lakes on the third planet, making up 90 percent of the planet. The Golden Horned Beast finished an entire lake, and his godly body was completely recovered.

“Incredible.” He floated around the third planet and gazed out into space. “I can sense the precious substances in the fourth planet… There’s some more! There are twelve planets in the galaxy, and there might be valuables on every planet.” The Golden Horned Beast gazed in the distance. “What about other galaxies?”

The galaxies were all close to each other. The images that were formed amazed Luo Feng; the space was like an enormous engraving in the sky.

Though it was mysterious and beautiful, it was quite boring here. There were no other creatures. The Golden Horned Beast flew to the fourth and fifth planets and started to inspect them… He wanted to dig out the secrets in this space.

Hong!

A powerful force emanated from the planet third closest to the star, and the force permeated at a speed of 20 million miles per second. After a short while, the Golden Horned Beast on the planet fifth closest to the star was alerted.

“Godly power! It’s very strong. It must be coming from a universe knight.”

The Golden Horned Beast raised his head and looked to the planet third closest to the star. He waved his wings and flew toward it. As he sped up, he saw another towering being flying toward him.

The Golden Horned Beast kept his godly body at 60,000 miles long. Another being with a godly body 60,000 miles long was flying toward him.

“This… This is…”

The Golden Horned Beast looked at the universe knight of other race in surprise. He was a being with black scales and six gigantic hooves —a space beast known as a “Tremble.” Trembles were at the second highest level among space beasts, only beneath the twelve pinnacle bloodlines.

The Golden Horned Beast and the Tremble were flying toward each other.

“Golden Horned Beast,” said the Tremble.

“Tremble,” the Golden Horned Beast replied.

They met each other halfway.

“Why are you also here?” the Golden Horned Beast asked.

“Because of you,” the Tremble growled. “I’m here under the orders of the Space Beast Alliance to receive you. Come with me.”

“What?” The Golden Horned Beast was dazed.

Luo Feng was completely bewildered. He had assumed that this space beast was also trapped in the Land of Extremis, but it sounded like he was here to retrieve him.

“Does this space belong to our Space Beast Alliance?” the Golden Horned Beast asked.

“Of course.” The Tremble nodded his head, which was covered in armor. “This space is used by our alliance to cultivate precious materials. I know that you’ve swallowed some mineral veins. They belong to our alliance, and they’re off-limits to individuals. But relax. The alliance won’t punish you, as you don’t know the rules. Besides, you’ve been wandering in the universe for so long and just came back. Our alliance won’t punish those of the same race.”

The Golden Horned Beast blinked. “So, that’s what the Land of Extremis is?”

“Yes. This is the space controlled by the greatest being in the Space Beast Alliance: ‘Ancestor.’ It’s the holy grail of all us space beasts,” the Tremble said. “Ancestor is one of the greatest beings in the universe, and he changed the operation law in this space.”

“Ancestor.” Luo Feng quickly inferred that the Ancestor was a universe supreme master. “We’re still in the original universe?”

“Yes,” the Tremble explained. “However, the space is isolated from the outside! Only those wormholes can be utilized for transportation. To keep other races out, there are two areas: outer space and inner space. The outer space is the area where the other races are trapped in for an eternity. As for the inner space, it’s hidden inside the outer space. You must’ve broken the space ripples before you got in. Only space beasts are able to get in without being killed. The other races aren’t even able to find this place, not to mention enter it.”

The Golden Horned Beast understood everything now. Land of Extremis was only the periphery of the sanctuary of the Space Beast Alliance.

“How did you get in?” the Golden Horned Beast asked. “Neither teleportation nor God Country Transportation is allowed here. How did you get here?”

“We space beasts rarely come here because we’re usually at the center of the space, the center of the sanctuary of our alliance, Space God Mountain,” the Tremble said. “I’ve got an order to receive you, and that’s why I was transported to that planet. One planet in every galaxy in this space has a wormhole inside, and they all lead to Space God Mountain.”

“There’s a wormhole in every galaxy?” The Golden Horned Beast was shocked.

“That’s right,” the Tremble said. “Ancestor is almighty, and it’s easy for him to create wormholes. Let’s go. The supreme beings in the Space Beast Alliance are waiting for you.”

“Okay.”

Sou! Sou!

The two towering beings flew toward the planet third closest to the star. The Tremble reduced his size to 60 miles long.

“Golden Horned Beast, can you make your godly body smaller?” the Tremble said.

“Sure.”

The Golden Horned Beast became 60 miles long, matching the size of the Tremble. They flew toward the planet while talking. Then they shrank to several feet long and entered the center of the planet.

“This is the wormhole,” the Tremble said. “We can get to Space God Mountain through it.”

“Let’s go,” the Golden Horned Beast answered expectantly.

He looked at the space whirlpool in front of him. It had a diameter of only a few dozen yards.

The Tremble and the Golden Horned Beast flew into the space whirlpool.

It was a vast space containing numerous space whirlpools. All the whirlpools had a diameter of dozens of yards. However, there were too many of them, and one couldn’t see the end of the space. At the center of those whirlpools was a towering mountain.

The Golden Horned Beast and the Tremble exited the space whirlpool at the same time.

“This…” The Golden Horned Beast was shocked by the scene before him. The space whirlpools were dispersed throughout this space, surrounding the gigantic mountain like flowers.

A black mountain! It was a mountain several light years tall—a gigantic mountain that could rival Star Tower and the Five-Color Aurora Lake. The black mountain was floating. He could sense the dimming force, and there were some space beasts flying around.

“See, the supreme beings of our alliance, universe masters, and the greatest Ancestor… They all live there!” the Tremble growled, and his eyes glinted with pride. “This is the sanctuary of our alliance, Space God Mountain!”

The Golden Horned Beast was amazed.

“There are countless great beings in Space God Mountain, as well as countless valuables and inheritances,” the Tremble growled. “It’s got everything, and it’s even connected to the universe. It’s a universe that only belongs to us space beasts.”

“A universe?” the Golden Horned Beast gasped in astonishment.

“Yes,” the Tremble answered proudly. “A universe! A universe that only belongs to us! Go! Go to Space God Mountain! Every space beast vagabonding in the universe needs to go to Space God Mountain. As long as you’re recognized by Space God Mountain, you’ll be one of us! The mountain will eliminate any other races… After all, some space beasts have had soul transfer done on them. It’s difficult to differentiate, but nothing can be hidden in Space God Mountain.”

No…! The Golden Horned Beast was terrified.

“Go, ” the Tremble urged him, looking at the towering mountain. “There are several universe masters waiting for you. See? Great beings are coming to receive you.”

More than ten powerful Golden Horned Beasts flew toward him from afar, emanating a powerful energy.

“They’re the great beings of you Golden Horned Beasts,” said the Tremble.


Chapter 1061: Golden Horn Master

Luo Feng had roamed the universe for close to 100,000 years, but this was the first time he had come across other golden horned beasts. It was also unique that ten of them were universe knights.

The dozen enormous golden horned beasts approached at high speed, their resounding voices were transmitted loud and clear.

“Brother.”

“Welcome home, my brother.”

“Our brother who has been roaming the universe! Welcome home.”

The Golden Horn Beast version of Luo Feng, along with his companion, “Tremble,” had no choice but to also approach them.

Tremble said in a low voice, “I have fulfilled my orders in bringing him here. Now that all of you are here, I will hand things over to you.”

“You may leave.”

“Leave it to us.”

“We will take care of everything,” the dozen golden horned beasts said in unison.

Tremble nodded slightly and smiled at Golden Horn Luo Feng before he transformed into light and took off. Golden Horn Luo Feng was then surrounded by the group of golden horned beasts who were all quite warm and friendly. “I am Mountain Engraving Knight.”

Each golden horned beast introduced itself. Every name was very different, as these golden horned beasts all had their fair share of life encounters. As they roamed the universe, they had chosen names to identify themselves. It was nothing uncommon, as knights often had different names.

Facing the group of golden horned beast knights who were all oozing with enthusiasm, Golden Horn Luo Feng could only reciprocate. “I am Golden Feng Knight,” he said.

“Haha, Golden Feng Knight! Welcome home! It is very rare for someone to only return to Alliance for the first time after attaining the universe knight level.”

“To be able to cultivate yourself independently to attain the universe knight level, Golden Feng Knight, my brother, your talent is impressive.”

“With the help of our Alliance, you will become stronger.”

Golden Horn Luo Feng listened on, replying with occasional responses. Inwardly, he was enjoying himself in this atmosphere. These golden horned beasts were supposedly cold and murderous, yet their so-called “murderous” nature was only displayed against hostile races. When they met with other space beasts, they were warm-hearted and affectionate; when they met with their own race, they would feel an even stronger cordiality for one another, as they all shared the same bloodline.

Rumor has it that the Space Beast Alliance is very mysterious, thought Luo Feng. Internally, they are all very united. No wonder. Golden Horn Luo Feng gave a discreet sigh. They have been alone for too long, so when they meet their own race, every one of them will treat each other like kin.

“Let’s go, go, go. Universe Master must be getting impatient.”

“Let’s talk no more.”

“We should hurry back.”

The dozen golden horned beasts led the way for Golden Horn Luo Feng, and one could see a group of golden horned beasts roaring at one another as they ascended into the star sky. Then they took off for the faraway Space God Mountain.

Golden Horn Luo Feng and the dozen golden horned beasts cruised through the sky together, but he was secretly worried.

Based on what Tremble told me, in Space God Mountain, everything hidden will be exposed. Will I be exposed too?

Luo Feng was also aware that this territory of the Space Beast Alliance was under the control of its noblest being: Ancestor. But there was no backing out now!

“Mercapto Gold Knight,” said Golden Horn Luo Feng as they flew in midair. “If I were to meet our universe master, which universe master would it be?”

“There are a number of universe masters who are curious about you,” one of them answered. “But, first and foremost, you must meet the two universe masters who are of the same bloodline as us, the golden-horned beasts. They are Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master.”

“Two of them?” Golden Horn Luo Feng was surprised.

“We golden horned beasts have a bloodline that is characterized by strong capabilities,” Fan Knight said proudly. “For the 12 pinnacle bloodlines, every one of them only has one universe master. But our golden horned race… We have two! Golden Horn Master is the most senior universe master of our golden horned race, while Xuan Mie Master is a newly-appointed universe master who has become a universe master 1,000 centuries ago.”

Golden Horn Luo Feng listened obediently. As they flew, they engaged in conversation while maintaining a speed that was 100 times the speed of light. Very quickly, they arrived at their destination, the vast and boundless Space God Mountain.

“Space God Mountain…”

Golden Horn Luo Feng gazed at the mountain attentively, but all he could see was a boundless mountain covered with pitch-black stones. It was not ordinary black but rather a hue that resembled a black hole, exuding a sense of emptiness. It was as though every stone represented a black hole… Space God Mountain was extensive beyond description, and it was divided into numerous domains. Constructing so many of these gigantic godly palaces would have been more tedious than constructing the godly palaces for humans.

“Space ripples?” It was the first time Golden Horn Luo Feng felt a space ripple here.

“Places with space ripples allow one to teleport,” one of the golden horn beasts answered. “This is how Ancestor enables us to get to different places quickly. However, there are many restricted lands that do not have space ripples.”

“Follow me.”

“We’re going to the palace of Golden Horn Master.”

The dozen golden horned beasts led the way with great enthusiasm as they flew in the sky of Space God Mountain. Space God Mountain towered at a height of countless light years… Even the huge body of a golden-horned beast, when compared to the Space God Mountain, was like comparing an earthworm to a star.

Sou!

Sometimes they teleported, but sometimes they advanced normally. This pattern went on for six minutes, and finally, they arrived at a towering, gigantic palace hall engraved with countless golden horned beasts’ embossments. This palace was around 60 million miles high. It emitted an intimidating vibe, which led Luo Feng to a verdict instantly… This should be a flying-palace type true treasure.

“This is Golden Horn Master’s flying-palace type true treasure. Its power is extremely strong,” Fan Knight said.

“Proceed. Let’s go in.”

There were several undying golden horned beasts flying and playing with one another in the open square before the palace. When they saw Golden Horn Luo Feng approaching, every one of them looked over with eyes filled with curiosity. Everyone knew the number of golden horned beasts in the Space Beast Alliance was small; practically everyone knew each other. But no one knew this newcomer brought in by the dozen golden horned beasts knights.

The undying golden horned beasts conversed among themselves in hushed tones.

“Could it be his first time coming to the Alliance?”

“He just got escorted in here?”

“The aura of his godly body is so strong. It is stronger than the godly bodies of many other universe knights.”

On the other hand, Mercapto Gold Knight, Fan Knight and the other golden horned beast knights led Luo Feng straight to the doors of the palace. This might be Golden Horn Master’s palace, but there were no guards at the doors.

“Come on in, my child,” a booming voice came from inside.

Golden Horn Luo Feng felt the tremors running through his veins. He obeyed… He suspected the voice would be that of Golden Horn Master. Golden Horn Master was the oldest and most senior universe master of the golden-horned beast race, so it was understandable for him to call the younger ones who were returning to the race his “children.” After all, Luo Feng was much younger by unknowable centuries.

“Go in.”

“Move.”

Fan Knight and the others went in with Golden Horn Luo Feng. Four hooves took great steps as they made their way into the spacious godly palace. Their footsteps were very fast; they could cover at least one million miles per second. They advanced straight to the center of the palace and stopped.

“We’re here to pay our respects, Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master,” Fan Knight and the dozen other golden horned beasts said, greeting them respectfully.

“I’m here to pay my respect, Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master,” Golden Horn Luo Feng said, followed suit. Then he lifted his head and saw that high above stood a towering golden horned beast with gigantic wings covered with scaled armor.

This was a most intimidating being, with an aura that could be likened to an endless universe. The being was looking down at him. On its left stood another golden horned beast. It wore dark red armor. The basic features of a golden-horned beast would be to have five sharp claws, but this beast in dark red armor sported an extremely long and golden middle claw. As it looked down at Luo Feng, there were indistinct traces of an endless whirlpool, as though its gaze could have annihilated the universe in a fleeting moment. Luo Feng immediately concluded that this noble being in the dark red armor was the newly appointed universe master known as Xuan Mie Master.

“Fan Knight, you all may take your leave,” Golden Horn Master ordered in a measured pace.

“Yes,” said the dozen golden horned beasts as they bowed in respect and flew off together.

In the great hall, there remained only Golden Horn Luo Feng and the two universe masters: Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master.

Golden Horn Master looked down and exclaimed in a resounding voice, “What a strong godly body! For you to have roamed the universe alone and achieved what you have now… That is quite unexpected.”

“You are even comparable to quite a number of universe overlords,” said Xuan Mie Master in a voice that was gentler.

Golden Horn Luo Feng listened submissively. On the surface, no one could tell that he was undying. Firstly, his godly body was indeed strong; secondly, the space law took metal, wood, water, fire, and earth as the upper law, so he was considered a space knight. Godly bodies could easily manifest themselves into any one of the five elements—metal, wood, water, fire, or earth—or even manifest into complete space. As for golden horned beasts, most would normally manifest their space godly powers into the gold element.

“To achieve the level you are at, all by yourself, you are indeed outstanding,” Golden Horn Master said with joyful eyes. “I was discussing with the other universe lords about how we could carry out some unique training for you. With the Alliance’s guidance, you have high hopes of becoming a universe master.”

Xuan Mie Master, standing beside Golden Horn Master, began to laugh. “Haha! If you become a universe master, then the Golden Horned Beast legacy shall have three universe masters. We will be ranked first on the Twelve Lineages, alongside Qiu He Beast.”

Qiu He Beast… One of the Twelve Pinnacle Lineages.

Luo Feng listened attentively. Inwardly, he sighed…

If I made it this far without any great beings’ guidance, then the elaborate training that the Space Beast Alliance could provide would certainly raise my chances of becoming a universe master! No wonder the Space Beast Alliance is giving me so much attention. What a pity… I am capable enough to hope to become a universe master, but I am a human! Not a golden-horned beast!

“Space God Mountain houses many inheritances and countless valuables,” said Golden Horn Master. “To boost your blood lineage, godly body amplification technique, or soul amplification technique! All are available.” Golden Horn Master gazed at Luo Feng and continued. “The Ancestral God School’s God inheritance token, the general inheritance token, and even the Beast God inheritance token are certainly available to you, too. Actually, the general inheritance token differs from the other amplification techniques only because it has an additional set of powerful and unique techniques. That’s all.” Luo Feng understood what he was trying to explain. He remembered that the demon note general inheritance token consisted of two aspects: one was the soul amplification type of technique, and the other was the demon note secret technique.

The Hong Alliance also had the godly body amplification technique and soul amplification technique… These required contributions, however, and Luo Feng did have enough to exchange for them. It would require a long time to cultivate and master the techniques, which was why Luo Feng intended to first obtain the fourth black metal board before returning for training.

“Huh?” Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master suddenly turned to look at one another.

Golden Horn Luo Feng also sensed something amiss. He raised his head to look at the two universe masters.

“My child, Ancestor has orders,” Golden Horn Master’s voice resounded loudly. “He beckons you.”

Gold Horn Master moved forward, stepping down from where he had previously stood.


Chapter 1062: Space Beast Ancestor

“Meet the Ancestor?”

Luo Feng was truly terrified. The nine superpowers were classified as superpowers because they had a universe supreme master, like Gigantic Axe Founder within the human race. Although Luo Feng belonged to the human race, he still hadn’t met him. The only universe supreme leader he had met was Zuo Shan Ke. And now, he was going to meet the greatest being in Space Beast Alliance?

Hong! Long!

Golden Horn Master stepped on the floor and walked to Luo Feng’s side.

“Don’t worry, and don’t be scared,” Golden Horn Master said, looking at Luo Feng gently. “There are many universe knights within our alliance, but most of them haven’t met the Ancestor! Yet you are to be received by the Ancestor right after you came back… You’re lucky.”

Xuan Mie Master also walked down. “If Ancestor values you,” he said, “you’ll get many more resources. Ancestor has the greatest power within our alliance.”

Then Golden Horn Master constrained Luo Feng by manipulating the surrounding time and space and flew out like a beam of light, followed by Xuan Mie Mater.

Flying, teleporting and flying. Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master led Luo Feng and reached the peak of Space God Mountain after almost 20 minutes. There was an independent mountain at the peak! Although it was inferior to Star Tower, it was definitely much more powerful than Thousand Treasures River.

They arrived at the deep of ‘Ancestor Mountain’ very soon. Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master lowered their heads almost at the same time to show respect.

“Ancestor.”

“Ancestor.”

“Ancestor?” said Golden Horned Luo Feng. He didn’t see him. He looked to the distance, and that was when he saw a dimming soft body showing up slowly. A gigantic head showed up from the mountain. It looked like a dragon’s head, but it was topped with nine horns like crowns.

The head itself was thousands of miles long, and a part of a claw showed up in the forest afar. Luo Feng could see that there were nine toes on the claw. Although he could only see a small part of Ancestor, he speculated that he was tens of thousands of miles long.

Ancestor raised his eyelids and glanced at Luo Feng. “Is this the exceptional talent you deem worthy of our alliance?”

“Ancestor,” Golden Horn Master said, raising his head, “although this child just came back, he has an incredibly powerful body. Besides, Flame Star told us before that this child was able to seize a component of Blade River Luo. Though we don’t care about that component, it still shows his power. Hahaha! There shall be a third universe master among us Golden Horned Beasts.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng kept his head low. The component of Blade River Luo? He had exchanged it for Nine Tiger River…

“You two can go back first,” Ancestor said.

“Okay,” Xuan Mie Master reply.

Golden Horn Master asked with thrill, “Ancestor, are you going to train him yourself? He’s an exceptional talent among the golden horned beasts. Don’t fool us!”

“Yes,” Ancestor replied.

Golden Horn Master was exhilarated. He turned his head to Luo Feng and said, “Golden Feng, Ancestor is going to train you himself. You’re fortunate enough to have that. Treasure this great opportunity.”

“Yes,” Golden Horned Luo Feng said, listening carefully.

“Let’s go.”

Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master left.

The giant head of Ancestor stared at Luo Feng. Luo Feng remained standing to one side.

“Impressive of you to kill Demon Blade Knight,” said Ancestor.

Luo Feng understood that Ancestor completely changed the operation law in the Land of Extremis, and naturally, nothing could be hidden from him. He said, “Just luck.”

“Do you really think you can fool me, human?” Ancestor’s voice resounded through in the space.

He was recognized.

“No wonder you’re peerless in the human race,” Ancestor said slowly. “Luo Feng, you’re a human, not a space beast. You cannot attain the resources of my race.”

“I understand.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng went into the world ring, and Mosha body appeared in his place. Ancestor must have known about his Mosha body since the Land of Extremis was under his control.

Luo Feng turned back into his human form and gave a salutation. “Ancestor! I was trapped in the Land of Extremis accidentally, and I couldn’t escape it. I could only wander around, and I was led here. I didn’t mean to deceive you. I did soul transfer on a golden horned beast body when I was weak. Please, forgive me.”

“Your hometown was almost destroyed by a golden horned beast,” Ancestor said. “It was lucky that you did the soul transfer. Indeed, you didn’t mean to come here, so I don’t care about that.”

Actually, before becoming undying, the Space Beast Alliance didn’t care about space beasts no matter what happened to them, and the alliance would only guide them home after they became undying.

Luo Feng was shocked by Ancestor’s insight. Even among humans, only a few knew about what had happened on Earth with the golden horned beast. How did Ancestor know about it?

“You didn’t come here by chance,” Ancestor said slowly. “Instead, you came here because of your master, Zuo Shan Ke.”

Luo Feng was dazed. Zuo Shan Ke?

“Zuo Shan Ke values you more than his second disciple Flame Emperor,” Ancestor said. “He asked me to open the center of my alliance… There’s no need to thank me. If you make efforts, there will be rewards. Your master Zuo Shan Ke has paid a sufficient price.”

Luo Feng now understood that everything had been planned by Master Zuo Shan Ke.

“You’re following the path of beast god,” Ancestor continued. “In the universe, I’m the best at cultivating great beings following the path of beast gods. As for the Ancestral God School… They only know a little about beast gods. Space beasts are the heirs of beast gods.”

“What?” Luo Feng was shocked.

Heirs? Luo Feng had already been baffled at how Golden Horned Beast was able to easily merge with so many blood river crystals and wield the power fully. And now, he knew that space beasts were the heirs of beast gods!

Wow! he thought. A secret! Definitely a top secret in the universe!

“I opened the most important place of my alliance to you,” said Ancestor. “I bet you can understand it.” He looked down at Luo Feng. “However, don’t think it’s easy. Your master has made a requirement, that if you can’t meet the requirement, you’ll be trapped forever.”

Luo Feng blinked his eyes.

“Zuo Shan Ke has a ridiculously high requirement.” Ancestor studied Luo Feng. “In my opinion, you won’t be able to do that. Even after billions of years.”

Luo Feng frowned. This came from Ancestor! A universe supreme master! A universe supreme master knew exactly how many miracles Luo Feng had achieved, and he knew that Luo Feng had only been practicing for less than 100,000 years. However, he still dared to say something like that Zuo Shan Ke’s requirement had was incredibly tough.

“I even bet him that if you can succeed within 100,000 eras, I’ll give you a true treasure series most suitable for those following the beast god path. However, if you fail, your Master will give me a pinnacle true treasure.” Again, Ancestor looked down at Luo Feng. “I can tell from your eyes that you’re determined and confident, and I know that you have always made miracles. However, you’ll be desperate when you know your Master’s requirement. I even think that you’ll be trapped forever. Unless you’re willing to self-destruct and leave.”

Luo Feng clenched his fist.

Just wait and see! Even if you are a universe supreme master, I’ll show you! You’re underestimating me by saying that I can’t succeed within 100,000 eras!

Luo Feng considered for a moment. But on second thought, what challenge has Master Zuo Shan Ke given me that he is willing to risk a pinnacle true treasure and Ancestor is willing to risk a set true treasure?

“Go in,” Ancestor’s voice boomed. “I bet you’re not going to succeed in 100,000 eras.”

Luo Feng disappeared.


Chapter 1063: Beast God Sector

Luo Feng felt the ever-changing nature of time velocity. It was as though he were passing through the universe path leading back to the primal universe.

Hua!

The surroundings zoomed into clarity.

“Where am I?”

Luo Feng looked around and saw towering trees and plants. Those ancient trees were at least 60 miles high.

Sou!

He shot up into the air and hovered above the forest. High up in the sky, he surveyed the surroundings. At first glance, there was a vast plain a distance away from this forest. Within his field of vision, he could only see two vast domains: the forest and the plain. On these two domains, he saw numerous enormous, towering sculptures representing the legendary Eight Natural Beast Gods. Every one of these Natural Beast Gods had its own set of sculptures that were doing various things like sleeping, roaring with their heads raised, playing, and in many other poses…

There were many different types of Natural Beast God sculptures, and each of these had an intimidating presence. It was as if the actual beast gods were present.

“Where am I?” Luo Feng said again. “The Space Beast Alliance’s Ancestor told me that he would grant me access to the Space Beast God Alliance’s restricted land. Is this it?” Luo Feng looked around. “Could this be their restricted land?”

Suddenly, Luo Feng’s face contorted in surprise. “No…! Time velocity!”

He had just connected with his original earthling body via his consciousness, and he quickly realized that there was a huge difference in time velocity between the different spaces the two consciousnesses were in. The magnitude of this difference was overwhelming, and it gave Luo Feng quite a shock.

Merely one second in the primal universe had gone by, yet Luo Feng had spent a good 100,081 seconds here, meaning to say that the ratio of time velocity was an alarming 1:10,081.

“How is that possible? How can the ratio of time velocity be so exaggerated?” Luo Feng found it unbelievable. “That means that spending 10,000 years here would only be spending one year in the primal universe! Even if I were able to purchase a ‘time palace’ from my human race, the normal ones can accelerate time velocity by ten times or several dozen times.”

Valuables like time palaces could only be made by universe masters who had complete space law comprehension, yet the time palaces created were no different from a place for cultivation. The only difference was that time velocities were much faster in time palaces. Ten years of cultivation in a time palace would equate to something like a month on the outside world. According to what Luo Feng knew, a time palace was very costly. Normal ones that accelerated time velocities by ten or a few dozen times were considered average, but those with acceleration of up to 100 times cost a fortune.

For those with an acceleration of 10,000 times… humans would not possess such time palaces.

an elderly voice resonated throughout the entire place: “Luo Feng!”

Luo Feng turned his head abruptly. In the distance, he saw some black clouds approaching, and the clouds gave off an overbearing force that suppressed the entire world. When these clouds neared him, they transformed into a golden horned beast, and this beast transformed again, now taking the form of an elderly human wearing a white robe and nine sharp horns on its head.

“Ancestor?” Luo Feng asked hesitantly.

“This is my other body,” Ancestor said, stepping out into midair. “The place you are in now is a universe owned solely by my Space Beast Alliance!”

“Another universe?” Luo Feng was taken aback.

He had learned during his chat with Tremble that the Space Beast Alliance owned a universe. Luo Feng found it likely, as the Space Beast Alliance was comparable to the Hong Alliance in terms of capabilities. Since the human race owned the primal universe, it would not be unheard of for the Space Beast Alliance to own one too.

“And here, right in the middle of this universe, is the Beast God Sector,” Ancestor continued, watching Luo Feng. “This is a place specially for training the great beings among beast gods.”

“Beast God Sector?” Luo Feng said.

He gazed into the vast, boundless world, thinking about how intimidating the numerous beast sculptures looked. They exuded a powerful energy that felt much more oppressive than the Xi Luo Duo sculpture had back then.

“This is the actual restricted ground of my Space Beast Alliance,” said Ancestor. “Even the geniuses of my Space Beast Alliance may not have the chance to enter. Your Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest has been very willing when it comes to you. He even approached me personally to ask for my help, but I doubt you will be able to succeed within 100,000 centuries. 100,000 centuries in the Beast God Sector is only 10,000 years on the primal universe.” Ancestor smiled. “One year in one century… I’m afraid you have yet to experience it.”

“Yes,” Luo Feng said. He was full of admiration for this form of time velocity.

“May I ask what request Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest asked of you?” Luo Feng pressed Ancestor for answers. “What do I need to achieve to make it out of here?”

“He gave a simple request.” Ancestor looked at Luo Feng, then revealed, “Defeat me, then you can go out!”

“De… Defeat… you…?” Luo Feng’s eyes widened.

How could he defeat the Ancestor of Space Beast Alliance? Defeat a universe supreme master?

You’ve got to be kidding!

Ancestor smiled. “I will maintain my power and strength at the same level as your godly body,” he said. “My godly body will be using the same strength as yours, so if you are able to defeat a similar godly body such as mine, you are able to make it out of here.”

“How is that possible?” Luo Feng shook his head vigorously. “You are a universe supreme master. Your techniques and methods are all out of this world… Even if a universe master were to be here, he would not be able to do this. Let’s not even mention universe masters at all —another universe supreme master might not even be able to do this.”

“Right. A universe master would not be able to do this,” Ancestor told Luo Feng. “But another universe supreme master would be able to. Because this is only another body of mine… The best he could do would be to suppress a universe master. But to suppress a universe supreme master, this body is not enough.”

“Does that mean I have to become a universe supreme master to get out of here?” Luo Feng shook his head. “Impossible! How outrageous could this possibly be?”

No matter how confident Luo Feng was, he would not dare to say that he could become a universe supreme master within 100,000 centuries! He had not expected Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest to be foolish to such an extent. Regardless of how conducive this restricted land of Space Beast Alliance might be, it did not have the conditions to groom him into a universe supreme master. Moreover, there was certainly no way a universe supreme master could be cultivated!

Cultivation of the beast god path, time space path, and many other such paths could only lead up to the universe master level. This was the limit. There was simply no proper way to become a universe supreme master! If one wanted to become a universe supreme master, the only way was to depend on oneself. This was what Sitting Mountain Guest had told Luo Feng in the past.

“Do not worry,” said Ancestor. “Your teacher has given you a glimmer of hope.” He smiled again.

Luo Feng let out a silent sigh of relief. Maybe the request would not be quite so outrageous.

“When you are at the undying level,” said Ancestor, “I can only utilize the ‘pinnacle technique at a universe master standard.’ When you have attained the universe knight level, I can use the ultimate technique at a universe master standard. When you have become a universe master, that is when I can use my most powerful technique.”

“Whether you are undying, a universe knight, or a universe master, this body of mine will maintain the same level of godly body as yours,” Ancestor reassured him. “I will also act according to the level of your law comprehension. The more it increases, the more techniques I will get to use.”

Luo Feng stood stock-still. The pinnacle technique at a universe master standard?

“Of course,” Ancestor said as if reading his thoughts. “Pinnacle technique… The pinnacle technique I will use is definitely the closest to ‘ultimate.’”

Luo Feng sank into despair. Ridiculous! Simply ridiculous!

He was merely an undying being, yet he had to battle the Space Beast Ancestor? Although Ancestor would only be using a pinnacle technique close to the ultimate technique at a universe master standard, it was nonetheless akin to an ultimate technique.

“Defeat? How could I, a mere undying being, create an ultimate technique of a universe master?” Luo Feng shook his head. “This must be a joke!”

Undying, to create an ultimate technique of a universe master? It was unheard of! Impossible!

If I were to achieve a breakthrough and become a universe knight, then Ancestor would be using the most powerful ultimate technique of a universe master, thought Luo Feng. Judging by Ancestor’s techniques… I’m afraid the most powerful ultimate technique of the universe master level that he will use would be much stronger than that of Primal Chaos City Leader.

Luo Feng could not help sinking deeper into despair. When I have become a universe master, Ancestor will not hold back anymore. He will give it his all. Hopeless.

Upon comparison, being at the undying level would have been more hopeful. As just an undying, he had to create an ultimate technique of a universe master? This must have just been a dream.

Ancestor was still smiling as he continued, “That is why I think you won’t be able to succeed, even if you have eons of time. That is why, when your Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest made a gamble with the stipulation of 100,000 centuries, I was full of confidence that I would not lose the bet. Hahaha…! If you want to achieve this, you have two paths to choose from. One, at an undying level, you can create an ultimate technique of a universe master. Two, you can stay in my Beast God Sector long enough to become a universe supreme master.”

“There are only two paths,” continued Ancestor, “so to become a universe knight or a universe master or anything else, don’t think anymore. The moment you lose focus on trying to increase your law comprehension, the amount of time you will require and use up will continue to accumulate! From undying to pinnacle universe knight, this law comprehension alone will take a long time… making it even less possible for you to succeed within 100,000 centuries. You only have two paths. Either of them is somewhat possible. To become a universe supreme master, there is a trace of possibility. To be an undying being that creates an ultimate technique of a universe master, there is also a trace of possibility.”

Ancestor never lost his smile while talking to Luo Feng. He added, “Of course, it will only be a trace of possibility. I, for one, think that you will not be able to achieve any of these at all. I think you will be trapped in the Beast God Sector forever.”

Luo Feng felt helpless. It was little wonder that Ancestor, who stood high at the pinnacle of the universe, would dare to take up such a gamble. It was no wonder he was so confident.

A trace of possibility? Perhaps. But only on a purely theoretical scale. In reality, the chances might not be more than one out of countless eons.

“Beast God Sector is open to you,” said Ancestor. “You can use it for your cultivation.”

Ancestor gestured to indicate the surroundings. In the distance, Luo Feng could see that the numerous sculptures and part of the plains were glowing brightly. A domain even further away was glowing so brightly that the rays seemed to shoot up into the sky.

“Sculptures, ground, faraway mountains, and cliffs,” said Ancestor. “Some of these have law engravings, and some have secret techniques. There are all kinds of techniques like the godly body amplification technique, soul amplification technique, battle technique, close combat technique, soul attack technique, spiritual force weapon technique… You can have everything you want under the sun. Power levels range from strong to strongest. We even have as many as dozens of sets of ultimate techniques of universe masters. Learn to your heart’s desire.”

“Everywhere in this Beast God Sector is open to you,” Ancestor reiterated with a smile. “You can research every secret technique, develop your talent, and then… create a miracle. Haha! If you want a challenge, I am ready to oblige anytime. Of course, if you do become a universe supreme master, there is no need for a challenge anymore. You have already succeeded. Enjoy looking around. Enjoy learning. I will be waiting for your challenge… Hahaha…! 100,000 centuries. Interesting, interesting…”

Ancestor laughed again, then vanished into thin air.


Chapter 1064: The Only Possibility

Luo Feng landed after Ancestor left. He landed beside a lake and sat down with his legs crossed. He calmed himself down. After which, he opened his eyes and started to think about the challenge.

“Master Zuo Shan Ke paid a huge price to get this chance for me! However, how can I beat Ancestor in any body? By becoming a universe supreme master? That’s too far from me. Creating universe-master-level ultimate techniques?” Luo Feng shook his head. “I have low law comprehension, and it’s barely at universe-knight level. I need law comprehension if I want to create techniques. How am I supposed to create them if I don’t even have that? Even if I use my beast god conception, it’s still only slightly better than my law comprehension.”

Luo Feng shook his head. Law comprehension and beast god conception were the two bases of techniques. He needed to complete the law comprehension. As for beast god conception, he had to at least memorize it.

“Unfortunately, I have both low law comprehension and beast god conception. How is it possible for me to create universe-master-level ultimate techniques?”

Luo Feng looked around.

“Master Zuo Shan Ke arranged for me to be here. Does that mean that the Beast God Sector can help me achieve that?”

Luo Feng got up and flew to the gold beast god sculpture beside him. Gold beast god was the manifestation of space law and gold law, and Luo Feng was following his path.

Hu.

Luo Feng landed in front of a towering gold beast god sculpture. It was a giant lizard with a horn on its head. He had four claws, and the one at top left was tearing the ground. His tail was lashing. There were complex engravings on his scales, and the engravings were different from those on Luo Feng’s beast god.

The engravings made the sculpture tranquil and peaceful, as if the gold beast god were taking a walk with his claw clenching on the ground.

“Huh?” Luo Feng looked at the sculpture, perplexed. “I feel like it must be the law, but why are the engravings different?”

Even after studying it for a while, Luo Feng couldn’t understand it.

Sou!

Luo Feng flew up in the sky and flew to another gold beast god sculpture. After all, gold beast god was the one he was most familiar with.

Another gold beast god sculpture also felt like the embodiment of law, but that gold beast god looked fierce, as if it were about to attack. And the engravings on the scale were also different.

One gold beast god sculpture after another, each one was different— angry, tranquil, joyful, crazy, indifferent, and roaring… The engravings on the scales were different based on their varying emotional statuses. Some of the beast god sculptures were using their claws to attack while others were using their tails or horns… Each part of their bodies seemed to be able to attack.

After he finished checking the many gold beast god sculptures, Luo Feng started to check the thunder beast gods and light beat gods… These sculptures were much more forceful than the ones left by Xi Luo Duo. Luo Feng even felt that those sculptures were in his small sculpture’s class.

“Eight inborn beast gods. Each of them has so many sculptures, and they seem to represent everything about the merge law.”

Luo Feng was amazed. After finishing all the sculptures, Luo Feng started to tour the beast god sector. On the plains, in the ancient trees, on the cliffs, on the peaks of mountains, at the bottom of lakes… There were engraving sculptures everywhere, and he could feel the power coming from the sculptures when he got close to them! Some of them were just basic engravings while some included detailed descriptions of the engravings.

They had been left by many generations of space beasts, strong and weak alike. There were even dozens of sets of universe-master-level ultimate techniques. As for universe-master-level pinnacle techniques and universe-knight-level techniques, these were present in innumerable quantities… Some were about close combat using weapons. Some were about spiritual force weapons. Some were about illusion. Some were about amplification. They dazzled Luo Feng.

“My soul amplification technique is only 32 times,” said Luo Feng. “Although the Golden Horned Beast has an amplification type technique, ‘Deities of the World.’ It is only an elementary technique with the limit of 36 times. Most of the limits in the amplification techniques here are over 80, and some are even over 100.”

Luo Feng was satisfied with those techniques. The more techniques he remembered, the less he needed to work. He could certainly hit the perfect limit in the Beast God Sector.

Of course, techniques didn’t guarantee success. Countless beings received the inheritance of deified generals, but only a few of them could finish it.

Inside the Beast God Sector.

The Beast God Sector was vast. Luo Feng looked in the distance and exclaimed, “The techniques are ingenious! The ultimate techniques of universe masters are indeed unfathomable, and these are the techniques of Primal Chaos City Leader. Unfortunately, I’m somewhat perplexed.”

Even with the explanations, Luo Feng’s law comprehension was so low that he was still baffled. He didn’t understand anything!

“I can’t even understand the ultimate techniques of universe masters with detailed descriptions!” he said. “How am I supposed to make them? Master Zuo Shan Ke, you’re too confident of me!”

Luo Feng felt helpless.

It was, however, a land full of valuables. As he read the conception of inborn beast gods under different sculptures, many of the questions Luo Feng had had for years were solved. He felt that different engravings had varying levels of power. All of them were the embodiment of laws. And all of them contained secrets.

“I think every sculpture is a set of supreme techniques,” Luo Feng murmured. “Besides, there should be connections among the sculptures. I’m just not strong enough to see through them.”

Luo Feng didn’t realize this until he had finished reading the adequate techniques. He soon discovered that most of the creators of the techniques had descriptions at the back that were inspired by the beast god sculptures. These sculptures were exceptional.

“How can I be inspired? Many of those who created these techniques are universe masters!”

Luo Feng shook his head.

“Master Zuo Shan Ke…” he whispered. “You may lose your pinnacle true treasure.”

But suddenly, he had a revelation.

“Wait!”

Luo Feng quickly stood up. “Although Ancestor is incredible, Master Zuo Shan Ke isn’t stupid,” he murmured. “He knows me much better than Ancestor does. If he was confident enough to make that bet, it means I must be likely to succeed. But how?”

There must have been a way, but he couldn’t think of anything.

After three days, Luo Feng still hadn’t come up with anything.

“For what it’s worth, I’ve got 100,000 eras, which equates to a billion years. I don’t need to rush! I’ll just practice the Nine Volume Manual…”

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed. “Yes. I can practice the Nine Volume Manual and let the Golden Horned Beast reach perfect life gene level! Last time, I got the inherited technique ‘I Am the Universe.’ Perhaps I can get another one this time. Even if I can’t, Golden Horned Beast will be able to perform I Am the Universe. The move consumes such a large godly body. Perhaps other ultimate techniques are not as demanding. Besides, it was bestowed through my mind, and that power is much more powerful than universe masters. I Am the Universe is supposed to be an ultimate technique of universe masters!”

Luo Feng rejoiced. Yes, of course! The inherited technique I Am the Universe!

“Ancestor only asked me to defeat his body, but he didn’t forbid me from using inherited techniques.” Luo Feng smiled. “Like that Bark Mirror Emperor who is only undying. His inherited technique is at the universe overlord level. I’ve reached a perfect life gene level, and I Am the Universe is much more impressive.”

“Hahaha…! 100,000 eras?” said Luo Feng. “I don’t need 100,000 eras! 100 years is all I need!”

Luo Feng looked forward to the result. He could sense that his inherited technique I Am the Universe was powerful enough to meet the criteria.

Heng! Heng!

“My Golden Horned Beast will perform I Am the Universe, and then he can definitely beat the Ancestor body who only performs universe-master-level pinnacle techniques.”

Luo Feng gained some confidence. He had read the details of many techniques in the Beast God Sector. Though they were too intricate for him to understand, he felt that I Am the Universe wasn’t weaker than any of them…

Luo Feng started to devote his time to this new pursuit. The tail, claws, wings, back, and head merged with at least 10 blood river crystals, and the amplification could reach 10 times. As for other parts, they had merged with 100 blood river crystals, and the amplification could reach 100 times.

After practicing, the life gene level of the Golden Horned Beast kept being improved.

7,000… 7,500… 8,000… 8,500… 9,000… 9,500…

After finishing the sixth volume, the life gene level of the Golden Horned Beast reached 9,000 times!

“Almost…” said Luo Feng. “Seventh volume!”

The Golden Horned Beast continued with the seventh volume and gradually improved his life gene. Eventually, after 62 years of being in the Beast God Sector, the Golden Horned Beast had reached the perfect life gene level.


Chapter 1065: Accident

Limpid water on the lake was flowing, and fog permeated above it. Luo Feng sat beside the lake with his legs crossed with a six-foot-tall Golden Horned Beast.

Perfect limit. Remote Ocean reached the level before, but when he became a boundless Remote Ocean… The new Remote Ocean body only has a life gene level of 1,000 times. Finally, the Golden Horned Beast body has reached that level.

Luo Feng smiled and waited for the sharp change. Once the life gene hit the perfect level, the body would experience a sharp change. Last time, the universe origin law arrived and led Luo Feng to a mysterious space, after which Remote Ocean body became 55,000 miles tall.

“What?”

Luo Feng frowned.

One second, two seconds… One minute, two minutes, five minutes…

“No change? Why is there no change at all?”

Luo Feng was dazed. His Golden Horned Beast had reached the perfect gene level, yet nothing had happened. There wasn’t any change to his godly body; neither was his mind led to the mysterious place.

Luo Feng stood up.

“Could it be because…?”

His eyes went wide, and his face fell.

Because… he realized. It is another universe here! Instead of the original universe!

Luo Feng knew that he was in a different universe, but the merge laws—gold, wood, water, fire, ground, wind, light, lightning, time and space—were all the same as those in the original universe. The law techniques were also similar. Universe-level, domain-level, and sector lords were the same in the primal universe as in the original universe.

The original universe was the largest universe. Billions of races resided within it. The primal universe and the universe of the Space Beast Alliance, meanwhile, were much smaller. However, the laws and the cultivation of great beings were the same here. Different universes only had differences in time flow and environment.

Luo Feng had assumed that once he reached perfect life gene level again, the Golden Horned Beast would evolve again! And he might enter the mysterious space in the universe again!

“I was wrong,” he concluded. “There are significant differences between the universes. There is no change at all in the universe of the Space Beast Alliance after reaching perfect life gene level.” Luo Feng shook his head. “What should I do?”

With each passing moment, he grew more and more upset. Although the Golden Horned Beast had reached the perfect life gene level—and quality-wise, he had reached the basic requirement for performing “I Am the Universe”—he still didn’t have enough quantity. A godly body that was more than 55,000 miles tall could only perform that ten times! The Golden Horned Beast was only 600 miles… almost 1/100th of 55,000 miles!

If the Golden Horned Beast body tried to perform I Am the Universe, his godly body might be completely consumed before he could even truly attempt it!

“I can’t use the inherited technique I Am the Universe to defeat the Ancestor body.” Luo Feng frowned. “So what should I do?”

This put Luo Feng in a quandary. His godly body was too small to perform the inherited technique. His only option was to create one. But how was he supposed to create universe-master-level ultimate techniques with nothing but his law comprehension and beast god conception level? It sounded ridiculous.

What should I do? Luo Feng kept thinking, but no answer came to mind.

He was not even a universe knight. How was he supposed to create universe-master-level ultimate techniques? The idea of becoming a universe supreme master? Ridiculous!

Inside the vast Beast God Sector.

At the peak of one of the mountains of a long mountain range sat Ancestor in a white cape. Beside him was an elderly being with transparent horns and wearing a cyan cape.

“Sitting Mountain Guest, it seems that your disciple has run into trouble,” Ancestor said with a smile.

“Don’t worry,” said Sitting Mountain Guest as he looked out into the distance.

Ancestor and Sitting Mountain Guest had put their bodies in the Beast God Sector. After all, it was the universe under Ancestor’s control, just as the primal universe was under Primal Chaos City Leader’s control.

Primal Chaos City Leader was invincible in the primal universe, and in this universe, a body of Ancestor could be invincible with the help of energy from the universe origin. When someone became a universe supreme master, he was able to make a body randomly. As such, Sitting Mountain Guest wouldn’t be trapped in this universe, as he could randomly make a body.

“You’re impressive!” Ancestor exclaimed. “Your second disciple’s life gene level reached almost 10,000 times with your help, and your third disciple has reached the perfect life gene level. You’re much better at cultivating disciples than me, especially when it comes to improving life gene level.”

Sitting Mountain Guest shook his head and smiled. “It’s against the universe operation law, and there’s a huge price to pay… I’m only able to cultivate two disciples.”

Ancestor nodded.

They were unrivaled in the universe; amplification and life gene level meant nothing to them, as they were perfect. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be called universe supreme masters.

“Everyone who reaches the perfect life gene level can be bestowed a gift from the universe origin!” Ancestor exclaimed. “After his godly body reaches the perfect level, his mind can be bestowed with an all-powerful inherited technique! Unfortunately for your disciple… this is my universe!”

Ancestor glanced at Sitting Mountain Guest and continued. “My universe is far inferior to the original universe. I can’t bestow on him an inherited technique or help his godly body evolve.” He sipped at some wine made from dew. “Without an evolved godly body, his godly body is not able to perform the most powerful inherited technique even if he’s bestowed one… Besides, he wasn’t even bestowed with the inherited technique. I might have actually lost the bet if he were in the original universe. But in my universe, I can control all the factors, and the only thing your disciple can rely on is the Beast God Sector!”

“You sound quite confident,” Sitting Mountain Guest said as he sipped the wine. “The wine is good. Could you give me a few bottles later?”

“I made the wine by devoting lots of energy and time by setting numerous special environments.” Ancestor looked at Sitting Mountain Guest and smiled. “Regardless, you’re going to lose a pinnacle true treasure to me. Some wine is the least I can do.”

Sitting Mountain Guest shook his head. “Remember, old beast god… 100,000 eras! It’s been less than a century. Don’t be too cocky.”

“So, you’re confident?” said Ancestor continued. “Do you think your disciple can become a universe supreme master within 100,000 eras? Or do you think he can create universe-master-level ultimate techniques as an undying fighter? Or do you think he can create universe-supreme-master-level techniques as a universe knight?”

According to the bet, once Luo Feng became a universe knight, Ancestor body could use the ultimate techniques of universe masters! The ultimate technique Ancestor body would use was definitely one of the best among the ultimate techniques used by universe masters. Only universe-supreme-master-level techniques could defeat that.

“The only thing I can tell you,” Sitting Mountain Guest said, “is that my disciple is likely to succeed. Of course, if he fails, that only demonstrates that he’s not strong enough.”

“Likely? What a joke.” Ancestor still refused to believe it.

“100,000 eras equate to only 100,000 years in the original universe,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. “Just wait and see. Don’t let anyone in during these years. I don’t want anyone to disturb him.”

“Rest assured, I won’t disturb him,” Ancestor said.

“Where’s the wine?” asked Sitting Mountain Guest.

Ancestor waved his hands, and exquisite wine bottles showed up and floated in the sky.

“This is half the wine I have,” Ancestor said.

“I’ll leave now,” said Sitting Mountain Guest, and he took all the wine, gazed for a moment at Luo Feng who was still contemplating, and disappeared.

“Likely?” Ancestor mumbled, looking down. “Sitting Mountain Guest says his disciple is likely to succeed? It is ridiculous if he thinks his disciple can become a universe supreme master! That means he believes that his disciple can create universe-master ultimate techniques as an undying fighter! Humph! I will have witnessed something truly remarkable if Luo Feng succeeds. If he doesn’t, I’ll have a pinnacle true treasure.”

Ancestor smiled, then disappeared also.

Luo Feng sat beside the lake for nine days. He even pondered what his master Sitting Mountain Guest and that Space Beast Ancestor were thinking about. However, he couldn’t come up with anything.

Both Ancestor and Sitting Mountain Guest are universe supreme masters. Their power and horizons are at the top of the universe. Ancestor doesn’t believe that I can do it. But if Master Sitting Mountain Guest made the bet, he must believe that I’ll be able to make it, at least in a billion years.

Luo Feng considered this.

“There’s a reason he has me in Beast God Sector,” Luo Feng muttered. “I need to explore the Beast God Sector.”

Luo Feng understood it. The first place he needed to explore was the Beast God Sector.

Plenty of great beings came to the Beast God Sector, he thought. After all, those techniques were left by the universe masters and universe knights from the Space Beast Alliance. However, those great beings weren’t able to create ultimate techniques for universe masters as undying. Ancestor would only have made the bet if someone succeeded.

Luo Feng nodded. He extrapolated from that that the Beast God Sector was far from enough!

Beast God Sector is the first asset I need to rely on. The second is some of my secrets. And, last but not least, time. Otherwise, Master Sitting Mountain Guest wouldn’t have specified a timeframe of 100,000 eras.

100,000 eras equated to a billion years! It was a very long time…!


Chapter 1066: Miniature Universe

Luo Feng knew that if he wanted to succeed, he needed to start from the Beast God Sector. Firstly, on one of the vast plains, he found some technique sculptures where he acquired two types of amplification techniques.

The other was a godly body amplification technique called “Golden Beast God.” When mastered to perfection, the amplification could reach 100 times.

Initially, Luo Feng thought it would be very difficult for him to master these techniques. He did not expect to be able to master Golden Beast God from beginning to the end without faltering. Whether it was his Mosha body, original earthling body, Remote Ocean body, or Golden Horned Beast body, all of these could put this godly body amplification technique to good use.

Nine Peak Lock was about mastering the ultimate control of blurring godly power. It had extremely high requirements of the will and consciousness. However, Luo Feng’s will and consciousness were already at a universe overlord’s standard! As universe overlords were almost perfect in terms of soul amplification, it would be a piece of cake for Luo Feng to master this technique.

Within just one month, he mastered Nine Peak Lock to perfection.

“My blurred godly power, my will, and my consciousness are all of universe overlord standard, so mastering this technique was a breeze,” Luo Feng said to himself.

This was how capability played a part in determining the level of difficulty of mastering techniques. Out of thousands of undying emperors, it was unlikely that even one could have mastered Nine Peak Lock to pristine perfection.

Mastering Golden Beast God took Luo Feng less than a month to master. Thereafter, he continued to look around the entire Beast God Sector.

In the Beast God Sector, there were 64 beast god sculptures. There were Eight Natural Beast Gods, each of which had eight sculptures. These informal secret techniques were mostly incomprehensible; only the thickest and thinnest engravings could be somewhat understood. After researching these techniques for over half a year, Luo Feng came to one of the Golden Beast God sculptures. Raising his head, he scrutinized the sculpture.

In my hands, the powers will be much weaker.” Luo Feng gazed at the beast god sculpture. “Many of the techniques I have come across mention that one must be able to comprehend these beast god sculptures to gain understanding. Luo Feng studied on.

In the Beast God sector, at the apex of one of its mountains.

Ancestor was carefree and at ease. He knew that there were many techniques in the Beast God sector that seemed precious but were actually worth little. The 64 beast god sculptures were the true treasures that were priceless!

Luo Feng stood before the eight sculptures of the Golden Beast God. Time spent on each sculpture varied. The 64 beast god sculptures took him a total of 52 years to study.

For any great being, just by looking at the 64 sculptures, there would be a feeling of merging as one with the sculptures! Judging from the power these different technique engravings left behind, they all seemed to match each other in strength. Obviously, the level of each technique would be similar. By combining all eight beast god sculptures to create a super-secret technique, this technique should outmatch all the others.

After acquiring two amplification techniques and studying the beast god sculptures, Luo Feng started to study himself as the subject.

Luo Feng analyzed his options. The Nine Volume Manual was one of a kind in the universe. Star Tower was one of the supreme true treasures of the universe. Other than Ancestor, the chances of other beings in the Space Beast Alliance possessing supreme true treasures were very low. Or at least, there were none that Luo Feng knew of.

The talent technique I Am the Universe had been bestowed by the universe for reaching the perfect life gene level. It could be assumed that many special life forms who were powerful and unique might only have reached a life gene level of thousands of times. Those close to tens of thousands of times were a rare sight. Let alone those who had attained perfection. Space Beasts were not special life forms… Unless they possessed techniques such as the Nine Volume Manual, they would never be able to make it this far.

The endless Remote Ocean represented limitless godly power. What a pity that he was in another universe. There was no way he could absorb godly power from the endless Remote Ocean.

In the primal universe, Luo Feng’s original earthling body headed first to Star Tower to study the secret engravings in the sculptures on the countless stars and Sky Pillars… Unfortunately, these were more profound than the ultimate techniques of the universe masters on the Beast God sector. He could not figure them out.

Then he placed the contents of the Nine Volume Manual under scrutiny and studied them with detail. This was a technique solely used for enhancing one’s life gene level. In terms of depth, it was comparable to the secret engravings on the Star Tower, which was far more profound than the ultimate techniques of universe masters. Similarly, he could not comprehend the profound knowledge, so he could only train in a methodical manner.

As for putting his talent technique I Am the Universe to use, Luo Feng and his other bodies were unable to use it unless enemies entered his God Country. Only then would the endless Remote Ocean within his God Country enable him to use I Am the Universe!

“Talent technique—I am the Universe!”

Hong! Long! Long!

At that moment, the endless godly power of ocean water went ablaze to produce limitless energy. In the sky above the endless Remote Ocean, a huge oval-shaped sphere with a diameter of tens of billions of miles appeared—it was a miniature universe!

Luo Feng used his consciousness to enter the miniature universe. He was filled with overwhelming excitement. It was almost as though once activated, the godly power of a golden horned beast’s godly body would be completely consumed. Luckily for him, his endless Remote Ocean was extensive enough.

“A miniature universe.”

This vast universe, with a diameter of tens of billions of miles, could contain anything. Within it was only vast nothingness. There was a subtle, chaotic airflow.

This miniature universe was none other than Luo Feng himself!
