The moment he transformed into this miniature universe, Luo Feng grasped the full understanding of his powers. He could divide out part of his godly body in this universe to fight his enemies… and in his own miniature universe, he could transfer the oppression from the outside into the miniature universe. His power would then be greatly increased while his opponent faced stronger suppression.

This was merely one of the attached abilities. The strongest one was…

“Explosion of Universe!”

Luo Feng could not help marveling. He only needed one thought to activate the “Explosion of Universe,” during which his miniature universe would collapse. The magnitude of this power was unbelievable.

“What a transcendental technique!” said Luo Feng. “To think that I possess such a powerful talent technique and can transform into a miniature universe.”

Luo Feng could not help but marvel. At the same time, his consciousness had started to study his miniature universe attentively.

On the thin membrane encompassing the huge oval-shaped sphere, boundless energy took the form of numerous law threads interlacing with one another to form an enormous picture of law engravings that was continuously undergoing transformation into a chaotic airflow. This chaotic airflow then circulated around the enormous picture of secret engravings and coagulated to form the membrane around the miniature universe. The remainder of the airflow would then waft off into the atmosphere and eventually diminish.

The enormous picture of law engravings… This was the basis for how Luo Feng could display his talent technique. But he was completely clueless, as this was the first time he had laid eyes on this picture of law engravings.

The picture of the law engravings transformed into an oval-shaped sphere formed by millions upon millions of law threads interlacing with one another. It was inconceivably complicated, forming the law of revolution of this miniature universe. And the amount of godly power that Luo Feng used would be used to supply this entire miniature universe with energy.

Technically speaking, it was not a real universe. In a real universe, energy was recyclable and should be inexhaustible. But Luo Feng’s energy was continuously used up. Obviously, this picture of law engravings was an extremely simplified version of the primal picture of engravings, which was the truest law of revolution of the primal universe. Yet, even so—it was impressive enough to render Luo Feng tongue-tied.

“It’s too… Too…”

But Luo Feng couldn’t complete his thought. He was completely taken aback by this picture of engravings. Its beauty was astounding. More astounding than any other ultimate techniques; it was even more beautiful than the secret engravings on the numerous beast god sculptures.

Chapter 1067

Luo Feng was filled with amazement. He thoroughly appreciated the intricate and delicate engraving picture of the miniature universe. Time passed, and the godly power consumed in 90 seconds was equal to that of the Remote Ocean body at the height of more than 55,000 miles. However, Remote Ocean body could withstand it easily.

“This… Is this?”

Luo Feng had made the shocking discovery that the engraving picture could be disintegrated, and small engraving pictures showed up after the disintegration. Each of the small engraving pictures was an engraving picture on the 64 beast god sculptures. After the disintegration, 92 small beast god engraving pictures showed up, and many of them were identical. However, they all came from the engraving pictures of the 64 beast god sculptures.

The 92 beast god engraving pictures were like components, making up a single mechanism after being combined. There were countless threads connecting all the pictures, and the connections were natural and perfect, comprising a miniature universe.

Luo Feng suddenly saw a new door open! If he didn’t know those 64 beast god engraving pictures, the miniature universe engraving picture would be too intricate for him to understand. “Incredible,” said Luo Feng.

He was mesmerized. He had not realized, until now, that there was another way to understand the incredible inherited technique.

Inside the original universe flew an ordinary spaceship.

As for supreme inherited techniques, they hold the top spot among all the techniques in the universe, and all of them are perfect. As for those 64 engraving pictures! They’re the perfect embodiment of eight inborn beast gods. The eight beast gods stand for eight merge laws. Universe operation laws can be classified into gold, wood, water, fire, ground, light, wind, lightning, time, and space… However, they can also be classified into eight merge laws.”

Sitting Mountain Guest smiled. He had already reached the pinnacle level possible in the universe, and he could see everything clearly.

“All of the highest-level techniques can be disintegrated into 64 engraving pictures. As for those that are inferior, they can’t even rival one beast god engraving picture. They do not qualify. Luo Feng is examining those 64 beast god sculptures, and he knows those 64 engraving pictures… Once he performs his supreme inherited technique, he’ll realize the connection between the supreme inherited techniques and the 64 engraving pictures. He’ll start with the engraving pictures and create techniques using those pictures.” He doesn’t even need to understand those engraving pictures, Sitting Mountain Guest thought. All he needs to do is remember those engraving pictures and their structures! And with the engraving picture he got from his own supreme inherited technique… he can totally try that! Once he succeeds, it will be possible for him to create a simplified technique of a supreme inherited technique. And if he can actually succeed, it means he’s a high achiever in engraving pictures. Using those 64 engraving pictures as elements, there were great beings who did that before the Grand Nirvana. If Luo Feng can also accomplish something in that field, and together with his ordinary law training, he’ll make many more improvements. Plus, he is able to better see the origin of the universe.

Sitting Mountain Guest was making a huge bet! No one had succeeded on the path of engraving pictures since the original universe came into being.

However… Before the Grand Nirvana, some great beings had succeeded, which meant that the method was possible. Different methods supported each other, but they all led to the same end, the origin mystery of the universe.

You’ve come so far after only 100,000 years, Sitting Mountain Guest thought. And you survived the life-or-death inheritance. Now, I’ll give you a billion years. Let’s see whether you can make some accomplishments on engraving pictures.

Engraving pictures training had always been a secret. After all, the time of the Grand Nirvana was immeasurable, and even before the Grand Nirvana, only a few practiced engraving pictures.

Obsessed… Luo Feng was completely obsessed.

He hadn’t expected those 64 engraving pictures to form such an incredible technique! He had always thought that “I Am the Universe” was so powerful and intricate that he couldn’t possibly understand it. However, he could now! It was the combination of those 64 engraving pictures, and some of them overlapped with each other, leading to 92 engraving pictures.

“Does that mean the combination of those 64 engraving pictures result in significant power?” Luo Feng immediately started to study it.

At the peak of one of the mountains in the Beast God Sector.

Ancestor appeared and looked down.

“Weird… Why does he keep drawing engraving pictures?”

Ancestor watched from a distance and saw one engraving picture after another forming around Luo Feng, who sat in front of a gold beast god sculpture with his legs crossed.

“He’s been drawing the engraving pictures for 10,000 years?” said Ancestor, thoroughly confused.

Luo Feng found the combination of the engraving pictures to be unpredictable and mysterious after studying all of them. If he made a mistake, the power would tumble. However, Luo Feng was randomly combining different engraving pictures based on the engraving picture of I Am the Universe, and he had created dozens of techniques. Most, however, were weak, and only one of them could rival an undying technique. It came close to the third move of Star Map.

This thrilled Luo Feng. He now understood that the engraving pictures were a new path! And it might be his only chance to defeat Ancestor body within a period of 100,000 eras.

Luo Feng started with a random drawing. There were billions of ways for law threads to be combined for I Am the Universe. He started by randomly copying and simulating without rules, but after 10,000 years of trying, he had successfully created some weak techniques. He also understood the differences between different combinations.

Based on his extensive practice, he extrapolated the possibilities, and from the possibilities, he extrapolated his theories.

In the first 100,000 years, Luo Feng worked by trial and error. He only created two techniques that could rival the third move of Star Map. He did, however, discover some patterns after all those trials.

Luo Feng decided to concentrate on the eight engraving pictures of the Gold Beast God while temporarily giving up the other 56 engraving pictures. Based on his 100,000 years of trial and error, Luo Feng was most accurate when randomly combing the eight engraving pictures of the Gold Beast God.

After a million years, Luo Feng started to understand the mysteries of the engraving pictures of the Gold Beast God. After ten million years, he completely understood the mysteries and power of the combinations of those engraving pictures. Of course, it was only the tip of the iceberg compared to the engraving picture of I Am the Universe… But finally, Luo Feng completely comprehended it.

During those ten million years, Luo Feng accidentally created an ultimate technique for universe knights. Although he didn’t understand the theories behind it, he remembered the way to perform it, just as he did with his inherited techniques. He memorized all the law threads and was able to perform it instantly, which was theoretically impossible!

Law threads required users to understand the fundamentals of them in order to be performed—unless they were sculpted in the mind, like inherited techniques. However, Luo Feng didn’t need to perform all the law threads. All he needed to do was perform several engraving pictures and combine them!

The implications were profound! Luo Feng found the engraving pictures to be mysterious. It might be a unique and unusual way, but it was a highway to the top!

“Did Master Sitting Mountain Guest know this before?” he wondered. “Is that why he led me into the Beast God Sector? Why haven’t I heard of anyone among us humans who has practiced it? Why have I never heard of this practice method?”

Luo Feng was sometimes baffled by these many questions.

“For what it’s worth, it’s an incredible practicing method.

Engraving pictures were like components. If the universe was a skyscraper, the components were the individual resources combined to create the whole… And there were many ways to build a skyscraper.

So far, Luo Feng had found 900 million ways to combine the engraving pictures, and he could perfectly manipulate more than 100,000 of them. It was a path that was completely new to him, so he could only explore it all by himself. The more he studied it, the more combinations he knew and manipulated.

Luo Feng forgot about the passage of time; he was immersed in the engraving pictures of the Gold Beast God.

Time flew by. Ten million years, followed by another ten million years. Luo Feng frequently went to watch the beast god pictures of the Gold Beast God and studied them.

At the peak of the tallest mountain in the Beast God Sector, Ancestor looked down, frowned.

Luo Feng had been in the Beast God Sector for 180 million years, and Ancestor could tell from the way Luo Feng trained that he was following the path of engraving pictures, a path that led to the top.

I might lose this time… thought Ancestor.

“Sitting Mountain Guest is indeed impressive,” he said. “He was aware of this way to practice, and he was certain that his disciple would succeed on that path.”

Ancestor also speculated that the disadvantage of that path was that it didn’t have a strong foundation. However, if one was lucky enough to have inspirations, he could create terrifically powerful techniques.

“Hmm…”

Ancestor’s face became grave.

Chapter 1068

“No way…” Ancestor was shocked as he looked down at a faraway spot. “How is it possible that he could comprehend the heart of the beast?”

Weeds grew all over the plain. There was a towering sculpture of a gigantic lizard positioned in a slight squat as though poised for takeoff. And at the back of the Gold Beast God sculpture, Luo Feng lay on a bed of scales, eyes squinting. He was looking in midair, where countless complicated gold threads of engravings flowed continuously.

His hundreds of millions of years of painstaking cultivation were no different from one another. In fact, Luo Feng had fallen into a unique state. He’d spent hundreds of millions of years studying the eight pictures of engravings of the Gold Beast God, where every picture of engravings represented a different aspect of the Gold Beast God. Eight pictures of engravings… Luo Feng felt as though he was looking at a different face of the Gold Beast God every day, and day after day, month after month, year after year…

The years went by. Luo Feng went on studying these eight pictures of engravings, and for a good many years, he felt as though he had the company of Gold Beast God every waking and sleeping moment of his life.

Currently, Luo Feng had lost himself to the 180 million years spent on studying these pictures of engravings. He forgot who he was.

Now… he felt as though he actually was a beast god!

Joy, happiness, anger, rage, insanity… He was roaming the universe! He was fighting his enemies in bloody battles stretching to endless voids. The fighting extended to other galaxies… until finally, he unwillingly breathed his last.

Luo Feng lay unmoving, his eyes gradually closing. Only the Gold Beast God was real! All else was fabricated.

His sleep went on for a whole millennium.

During this millennium, even Luo Feng’s original earthling body and his Remote Ocean body went into a deep slumber. No matter who tried, no one at all was able to contact Luo Feng! Over the course of 1,000 years, Luo Feng forgot his human memories; he forgot everything. In his deep slumber, he thought of himself as a beast god…

A millennium went by peacefully. Then Luo Feng opened his eyes.

“Is this the so-called ‘Transformation of Things’?” asked Luo Feng. “Was it my illusion or was it reality?”

The moment he opened his eyes, he was in a trance—stupefied and unable to differentiate whether he was Luo Feng or a beast god. But quickly, he sobered up. Hundreds of millions of years’ worth of human memories came flooding back and overrode the memories that he had collected while he was incarnated as the beast god.

“A beast god? What a magical feeling.”

Luo Feng lay on the back of the Gold Beast God sculpture, reminiscing about the feeling of being a beast god, which was still so vivid to him. He felt as though he could go back into that state easily.

A beast god was an entirely different existence from that of humans. It was in a state that was detached, free, and true to its own nature.

At the apex of the mountain, Ancestor watched the entire episode, shaking his head amidst sighs. He found it all so ironic.

“The final bottleneck of the beast god path,” he said. “‘Heart of Beast God.’ The most difficult stage to comprehend and the most difficult to find, yet he has mastered it?”

The beast god path, according to the Ancestral God School, was divided into a total of seven major inheritances. Upon figuring out the entire Beast God path, one would have attained the universe master level and become a pinnacle existence in the universe… Yet it was not that simple for one who wanted to become a universe master. Just as it was with the golden horned beasts’ lineage, after countless eras, they only had a total of two universe masters. Similarly, the flaming star beasts’ lineage had only one universe master.

All of these clearly reiterated the fact that becoming a universe master was difficult to the point of nearly being impossible! There were many levels to accomplish!

One of the Beast God path’s most difficult levels to figure out— because of its ethereal nature—was understanding the Heart of Beast God, upon achieving this level, one could truly become an incarnation of the Beast God! This had left many universe overlords wondering, like Xi Luo Duo and the many universe overlords, if they could only be incarnations of “pseudo beast gods” because they were unable to understand the Heart of Beast God.

Without a Heart of Beast God… there was no way one could truly become an incarnation of a beast god.

For Luo Feng, this was an unintentional reward, as he spent such a long time wholeheartedly studying the eight pictures of secret engravings. Tens of millions of years of dedicated work had led him into a deep slumber where he forgot everything. During his slumber, he dreamed about leading the life of a beast god for a long time.

“This Luo Feng made a resounding name of himself in less than 100,000 years!” said Ancestor. “In my Beast God sector, he has cultivated himself for around 180 million years… He has dedicated himself wholly to studying the secret engravings of ‘Golden Space.’ Without any guidance, solely based on his own experience, he has attained the highest level. At the tip of his fingers, he could create techniques at the universe knight level… Obviously, he will have become extremely familiar with the Gold Beast God’s eight pictures of secret engravings. And these eight pictures are the full representation of Gold Beast God.”

Moreover, thought Ancestor. Golden horned beasts are descendants of the Gold Beast God. They can easily understand the Heart of Beast God. For two to merge as one… accomplishing this is expected.

Ancestor quickly understood why it was the process of accumulating richly and breaking forth vastly. Luo Feng had waited patiently, so when he had everything he needed to know in place, he would achieve success.

After all, Luo Feng did spend 180 million years studying these pictures of secret engravings. It only took him thousands of years to attain the pinnacle emperor level—tens of thousands of years to develop his talent of creating three forms of ultimate technique… If he continued to study the laws, given 180 million years, Luo Feng would have cultivated himself to the level of a senior universe knight. All just to defeat Ancestor!

So, Luo Feng had not spent an inkling of effort on law comprehension. He gave his all to studying the pictures of secret engravings. Hence, he attained his achievements in this chosen studies… which far surpassed his achievements in law comprehension. After all, law comprehension required many tens of thousands of years to cultivate. Just studying the pictures of secret engravings, he spent 180 million years. That was simply incomparable!

“This is…”

Ancestor, who had calmed himself previously, suddenly revealed a sharp change in expression. He was unable to believe what he saw as he looked down at the beast god sculpture on the vast plain. Luo Feng was lying down on the sculpture. Even when he had previously comprehended the Heart of the Beast God, he had not shown such arrogance and rudeness.

On the back of the beast god sculpture.

After Luo Feng woke from a millennium of deep slumber, he started to study the eight pictures of engravings of the Gold Beast God all over again. With the picture of secret engravings of his miniature universe as the final template, he tried to create a technique of his own. He could still feel the aftermath of his thousand years of slumber, during which the Heart of Beast God possessed an indistinct influence over him.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Countless golden threads floated midair.

It must be by pure luck or coincidence, as Luo Feng himself was unclear of the underlying theories he used when he speedily combined all eight pictures of secret engravings. Other than the majority of the law threads being combined based on his strong foundation, there were a few law threads that were combined purely based on his unique instincts, where he was free of inhibitions and followed his heart’s desire without a second thought.

It was as though the Gold Beast God was wandering about the universe, following its heart, killing when it wanted to kill, eating when it wanted to eat, sleeping when it wanted to sleep… When it came to the method of combining the law threads he was still unsure of, he combined them with such an attitude—following his heart. The most important thing was to feel pleased and fulfilled in the moment.

Hong!

Suddenly, a golden ray appeared.

In an instant, the whole surface underwent a fundamental change. Then normality returned.

“I… I am left with such little godly power!” said Luo Feng.

Luo Feng could not believe he was so powerful. A few thousand years on law comprehension was enough for him to attain pinnacle undying level. If these 180 million years were spent devoted completely to studying law comprehension… for him to master the sixth, or even to the seventh stage of the beast god path was certainly achievable. Yet he had spent this long period of time studying only the pictures of secret engravings!

He was certainly successful, and now he could easily create techniques at the universe knight level, or, at times, he might even be able to create ultimate techniques at the universe overlord level. He was that powerful! Yet in terms of magnitude, his power was far less than that of the light ray.

“Could it be the ultimate technique of a universe master?”

Luo Feng still found it unbelievable. If he had not been mastering it, he would not have known. After all the studies on the pictures of secret engravings, he knew that while sometimes, with a stroke of luck, the pictures of secret engravings could allow one to miraculously create a set of technique… But the more powerful a technique was, the more it was impossible to depend solely on luck. Foundation was more important!

180 million years! Luo Feng was very accomplished in his studies of the pictures of secret engravings and could easily create techniques that were at the universe knight level. But the most powerful technique that he had created so far was merely the universe overlord ultimate technique, which was two levels higher than the ones he normally created. If he wanted to create a technique of a universe master level… he guessed he might need many hundreds of millions of years more.

If the day came when he could readily create techniques of universe overlord level however he pleased, then who knew? He might get lucky and happen to create a technique of the universe master level. The foundation required would be higher!

The most talented painter, with a stroke of inspiration, could paint a superior picture. But without a solid foundation, even with inspiration, one would not be able to produce a sensational piece of work.

Luo Feng had now built a very strong foundation for himself. As an individual in the context of the universe, he could be considered a master—a founder capable of creating techniques! However, if he was expected to create techniques of universe master level… then to him, it was still something unbelievable.

“Is it a technique of the universe master level?”

Sou!

Luo Feng jumped up from where he was and flew to a faraway spot on the mountain. On his shoulder was a golden horned beast.

After flying for a short while, he arrived at the mountain cliff where there were three technique sculptures, all of which had been left behind by space beast universe masters. These three were all techniques of the universe master level.

“I shall carve the engravings of my creation with the use of my power. I should be able to understand it.”

Luo Feng looked at the stone surface. Godly power was gushing out, and all he could see at that very moment was a huge picture of a technique that was complicated beyond comprehension. Even many universe knights would have felt as though they were reading a heavenly book. Even if Luo Feng were to spend 180 million years, he would still be unable to comprehend this.

This picture of technique was simply too deep to be fathomed. It exuded an endless wave of power that corresponded to the magnitude of power coming from the other three ultimate technique sculptures beside it. It was not the least bit weaker.

It represented hundreds of millions of years of hard work! Plus a Heart of Beast God… At any moment, Luo Feng spontaneously created such a technique.

This was a technique he had created with the picture of secret engravings of his miniature universe as a template; it might be considered a simplified version of it. It was simply a near-perfect combination of the eight Beast God pictures of the Gold Beast God that formed the attack-type technique: Ultimate Level Technique of Universe Master!

At the apex of the mountain, Ancestor watched.

“Tens of millions of years spent on experiencing, learning and creating,” he muttered. “And the Heart of Beast God. If at any point in time, the eight pictures of secret engravings of the Gold Beast God are almost perfectly combined, whether in a manner that makes sense or not… such a technique will emerge.”

At that moment, he transmitted a message to Sitting Mountain Guest who was in the primal universe.

“Sitting Mountain Guest!” he said. “Why are you still not on your way here?”


Chapter 1069: Fight Ancestor

After only a short while, Sitting Mountain Guest showed up at the peak of the mountain.

“Did you call me here for drinks?” Sitting Mountain Guest asked as he strolled toward Ancestor.

Ancestor pointed in the distance, standing beside the cliff. “Look at your disciple.”

“Luo Feng?” Sitting Mountain Guest looked in the direction Ancestor pointed and saw Luo Feng sitting beside a cliff. He appeared surprised and joyful after gazing for a while, then started to laugh, “Old Beast God, no one in the universe can rival you on the path of eight gods! However, this disciple of mine created a technique using the eight engraving pictures of gold beast god… Do you admit your defeat?”

“How can you say I’m going to lose before he even fights me?” Ancestor said.

Sitting Mountain Guest shook his head. “Stop quibbling.”

Ancestor didn’t continue about the upcoming fight. Instead, he exclaimed, “Your disciple is indeed impressive! It’s fair to say that he had some luck when creating the technique, but no one in history could practice the engraving pictures so well in only 180 million years without any instructions! Besides, he has comprehended the Heart of Beast God, and that’s why it’s easier for him to comprehend the eight engraving pictures of Gold Beast God. It’s easy for him to create universe-knight level techniques, and if he’s willing to devote his time and energy, he’ll be able to create the universe-overlord level ones as well.”

Even real universe overlords needed to spend an overwhelmingly long time to create universe-overlord level ultimate techniques. To some extent, even those on the engraving path were better at creating techniques. Luo Feng was at least at the senior-universe-knight level when it came to his accomplishments among those who were on the engraving path.

“The Heart of Beast God?” Sitting Mountain Guest looked pleased. Then he guffawed. “A pleasant surprise! What a pleasant surprise, indeed!”

“He’s a Golden Horned Beast, which makes him a descendant of beast gods!” Ancestor exclaimed. “His bloodline inheritance is close to Gold Beast God… And with his research into those eight engraving pictures, he can finally comprehend the Heart of Beast God. He is indeed lucky, but I can’t say it’s because of luck alone.”

“Hahaha…!” Sitting Mountain Guest laughed heartily.

“Look at you.” Ancestor shook his head.

No wonder Sitting Mountain Guest was so proud. The accomplishments on engraving path could help law comprehension to a great extent. There wouldn’t be many barriers until Luo Feng became a universe overlord… Especially with the Heart of Beast God… It would now be easier for him to proceed along the beast god path! Heart of Beast God was the greatest challenge to turn from a universe overlord into a universe master, and that problem was now solved. Although it was still extremely difficult for him to become a universe master, he at least had a much higher chance.

Sitting Mountain Guest glanced at Ancestor and rejoiced inside. Little do you know that this disciple of mine obtained inherited techniques before, and he can better study the engraving pictures with the instruction from the engraving picture of his supreme inherited technique. Regardless, it’s still impressive of him to create a supreme inherited technique and comprehend the Heart of Beast God in only 180 million years.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked down.

In front of the cliff.

The energy from the sculpture of the engraving picture was equivalent to that of the three ultimate techniques of universe masters.

“I did it,” said Luo Feng. “It’s an ultimate technique of universe masters.”

Luo Feng stood in front of the cliff for a long time. He felt like he was in a dream.

“I did it,” he repeated, “after 180 million years.”

Luo Feng was confident that he could create ultimate techniques of universe overlords. As for ultimate techniques of universe masters… It would involve some luck.

Luo Feng suddenly looked to the sky and transmitted his voice.

“Ancestor,” he said. “I challenge you.”

Ancestor, wearing in a white cape, quickly flew in from afar. He landed on the ground and smiled at Luo Feng.

“You’re going to challenge me?” he said.

“Yes,” answered Luo Feng.

Luo Feng knew that even if he lost, he could keep doing research and trying. After all, all he needed to do was to defeat Ancestor within 100,000 eras.

“What weapon should I use?” Luo Feng asked.

“Let’s use our bare hands, shall we?” Ancestor raised his left hand. This godly body of his had been transformed from other elements.

“Hands?” said Luo Feng.

He was taken aback. Hands as weapons?

“You’ve already comprehended the Heart of Beast God,” said Ancestor. “Don’t you think your hands are weapons?”

Luo Feng was startled. Thousands of years’ worth of memories flooded back. For beast gods traveling in the universe, their claws, tails, and horns all contained the beast god conception. Even the spiritual force weapons were the bodies of beast gods… At this moment, Luo Feng felt as though the enormous gap between close combat and spiritual force weapons had disappeared. The techniques he had created could be used both for close combat and as spiritual force weapons.

“Warrior path and spiritual force leader path… They’re the same.” Luo Feng was bewildered.

“You’ve comprehended the Heart of Beast God.” Ancestor smiled. “If you didn’t, you had to focus on either the warrior path or the spiritual force leader path… After all, mixing them together is bad for comprehending the Heart of Beast God. Besides, beast gods are naturally better at using their godly bodies to fight, which is why those on the warrior path are better at comprehending the Heart of Beast God and finally become beast gods.”

Luo Feng nodded.

Primal Chaos City Leader had told him this before and insisted that he concentrate on the warrior path! However, for the past 180 million years, he had set aside the warrior path and spiritual force leader path, instead focusing on the engraving picture path. Without realizing it, he had fully comprehended the Heart of Beast God.

“Do you still need weapons?” Ancestor asked.

Luo Feng smiled. “If beast gods can use their claws, then I can use my hands as well.”

Ancestor stood still. “Attack,” he commanded.

Luo Feng looked from afar and used the Mosha body for the combat. After all, Ancestor would also use the godly body at the same level.

Hong!

Countless engravings started to flow on Luo Feng’s godly body, and he dashed toward Ancestor like a beam of golden light. At this moment, Luo Feng felt the beast god in his body charging his competitor. The attack contained the beast god path and also contained ultimate techniques of universe masters. The attack was fierce and quick—faster than the Shi Wu Wings!

“Break!”

Luo Feng arrived at where Ancestor stood. He grabbed Ancestor as his left hand became a claw, and the engravings on its fingers started to connect with each other.

Peng!

Ancestor waved his hand, and they clashed. Ancestor took a step back.

“Hahaha…!” Luo Feng felt overjoyed. The memories of the beast god merged with him at this moment.

Charge!

Claws!

Legs!

Luo Feng was absorbed in the golden light, and the roaring of beast gods resounded around him.

Fast!

Sharp!

Ancestor was suppressed. Although he tried to resist it, Luo Feng was getting more and more skilled, as if he truly were a beast god.

Peng!

His fingers were sharp like claws.

Pu!

They pierced through Ancestor’s chest.

Ancestor looked down, smiled, and nodded. He took a step back, and his godly body recovered.

“You won,” he said.

Luo Feng, standing in the golden light, was dazed. Had he actually defeated Ancestor? Ancestor would only perform universe-master level pinnacle techniques, and though he could only maintain his godly body at the same level as Luo Feng’s, he was still Ancestor, after all… It was a surreal feeling to have defeated Ancestor!

“Thank you, Ancestor,” Luo Feng said respectfully.

Ancestor had focused on defense from the beginning of the combat, which was why Luo Feng had been able to make better and better attacks, and thus, fully understand the way Beast Gods fought.

“No need to thank me,” said Ancestor, shaking his head and smiling. “I performed the best defense pinnacle techniques of universe masters, but I still failed to defend against you. I might have won if I had attacked first, but you will still win over me after several challenges. There’s no need to waste time.”

Luo Feng was full of gratitude. He had benefited so much in the past 180 million years in the Beast God Sector.

The Heart of Beast God was a pleasant surprise, and the engraving picture path was a brand new path for him. Plus, he had created an ultimate technique of the universe master level.

“Hahaha…!” A guffaw resounded around him, followed by a shadow.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Luo Feng from afar. After 180 million years, this disciple of his had finally evolved! In the past, Luo Feng hadn’t had much time to practice. He stood among the great beings because of the enormous godly body and Force Armor, but when it came to laws and techniques, he was significantly weaker. Yet his law comprehension and techniques had now reached an incredibly eminent level—even better than many universe overlords.

“I’ve accumulated enough,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. “I believe this disciple of mine will have an easy time becoming a universe overlord. Perhaps the only difficulty he’s going to have is becoming a universe master.”

Sitting Mountain Guest was satisfied. Flame Emperor had disappointed him, which was why he had devoted all his resources and time to his third disciple. Fortunately, his third disciple hadn’t upset him.

The laughter attracted both Luo Feng and Ancestor.

“Master?” Luo Feng was dazed by the shadow flying toward him.

“Sitting Mountain Guest,” said Ancestor with a smile. “Don’t be smug. Your disciple is indeed impressive… However, don’t forget that he has a golden horned beast body, and his soul has completely merged with the godly body. It’s almost impossible to tell whether he’s a human or a golden horned beast. Who will say no if I insist that he’s a golden horned beast?”

“That’s between your alliance and the humans,” Sitting Mountain Guest said as he landed. “It has nothing to do with me. Whether this disciple of mine belongs to the human race or Space Beast Alliance doesn’t concern me at all.”

Luo Feng stepped forward and said, “Master.”

“Okay…” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled and nodded. He glanced at Ancestor. “Don’t forget our bet!”


Chapter 1070: It Was Named ‘Northern Rock’

Luo Feng’s face immediately registered a look of anticipation. Previously, he had heard from Ancestor that the get between Ancestor and Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest involved his wager—a set of true treasure series—and Teacher’s wager—a piece of a pinnacle true treasure. If Ancestor lost, then he would have to bestow this set of true treasure series to Luo Feng. This was definitely a great opportunity.

For them to use these items as wagers meant the true treasure series and the pinnacle true treasure must have been of comparable value. His Force Armor was one such pinnacle true treasure!

And Blade River Luo, a top-tier domain type true treasure with an extremely strong attacking power, was comparable to Force Armor. It was so massive that its entire birth process… had to be divided into several segments to reach completion. Thus, it was quite a sensation. It was little wonder that Flame Emperor had been so reluctant to give up Force Armor to Luo Feng back then… Such events went to show that true treasures such as Force Armor and Blade River Luo were very precious—so precious, in fact, that great beings like Flame Emperor and Primal Chaos City Leader covet them.

Yet only universe supreme beings such as Ancestor and Sitting Mountain Guest had the magnitude of boldness to use such precious treasures as the stakes in a bet!

“You are one of the top nine powers in the universe; Ancestor of Space Beast Alliance, you can’t be that petty!” teased Sitting Mountain Guest. “I am waiting for that true treasure series of yours.”

Ancestor cast a look at Sitting Mountain Guest. His expression revealed his heartache. Even a being as great as Ancestor would feel the sting of this loss. Previously, when he had been so confident that he would win the pinnacle true treasure from Sitting Mountain Guest, he had not expected that he would lose the gamble.

“Fair is fair,” Ancestor said. “This true treasure series is one I can still afford to lose. According to our agreement, I shall bestow this true treasure series to Luo Feng.”

“Yes.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled and nodded. “That’s right. Bestow it to my disciple.”

Ancestor turned to look at Luo Feng. “Luo Feng.”

“Ancestor.” Luo Feng replied respectfully.

He did not consider defeating Ancestor something to be proud of. It was, after all, only to fulfill a gamble. If Ancestor were to display his true power, his ability to ensure that whatever order he gave would be effectively enforced would have rendered Luo Feng powerless with no way to fight back. If one was willing to pay the price, he could even kill a universe master.

“Look.” Ancestor pointed in midair, and a black beast figure suddenly appeared.

“Huh?” Luo Feng looked carefully.

It was a wild beast that was black from head to toe. It had four powerful hooves and claws, as well as sharp fangs that pointed to the sky and a single horn on its forehead that gave off a shiny gleam… Its body was covered with layers of armor, as though it were filled with limitless magical power. Luo Feng was completely captivated at first glance. It was truly a stirring beauty.

The black wild beast was around 300 feet tall, and it landed right in front of Luo Feng. It was then that Luo Feng realized, to his astonishment, that this was a dead creature. It was lifeless.

Ancestor walked over and caressed the leg of the gigantic beast. “This is my true treasure series. I named it ‘Beast God Armor.’

Sitting Mountain Guest looked on with great pleasure, then laughed aloud.

Ancestor cast him a glance before turning to look at Luo Feng. “Your teacher is gloating, but it’s to be expected. Previously, because of this true treasure series… there was chaotic battling all over. Your teacher was so scheming. He launched a sneak attack and immediately fled the scene. I had to pay quite a sizable price to defeat that adverse universe, and finally, I managed to obtain this true treasure series.”

Listening on, Luo Feng felt his excitement rising… It was as though he had personally undergone this battle of universe supreme masters.

“This true treasure series consists of a total of 526 true treasures, of which 521 are ordinary true treasures, four are senior true treasures, and the remaining one is a top-tier true treasure,” Ancestor explained. “The sharp fangs and scales on its body, for instance, can be dismantled and used individually! Combining everything to form one body, its power is massive.”

Luo Feng was shocked. 526 true treasures to form one true treasure series? It was said that Primal Chaos City Leader’s Thousand Treasure River was formed by 1,000 true treasures put together, and this, in Luo Feng’s eyes, did not pale in comparison. Moreover, out of these 526 true treasures, one was at the top-tier level.

“Breaking this down, the horn alone is a top-tier true treasure,” said Ancestor. “And once combined with the power of a few hundred other true treasures… its power will skyrocket.” Ancestor gave a sentimental sigh. “By placing this true treasure series on one’s godly body, every part of the godly body becomes a weapon ready to attack. It is definitely the most suitable tool for a great being who wants to cultivate the beast god path and become a universe master. I named it Beast God Armor and had planned to bestow it to one of the universe masters from my Space Beast Alliance that I found to have great potential.” Ancestor looked at Luo Feng. “Now, it’s yours.”

Luo Feng felt his heart pounding faster.

Beast God Armor!

“Thank you, Ancestor,” Luo Feng said, showing his gratitude respectfully.

Ancestor smiled and nodded, and with one wave, the black beast figure flew over to Luo Feng.

A golden horned beast appeared on Luo Feng’s shoulder. At this moment, his Golden Horned Beast body had temporarily put away the Force Armor, Shi Wu Wings, the Nine Tiger River, and the other treasures, storing them in the World Ring. It swooped down while exerting its godly power, speedily encircled the black beast figure to brand the beast with its life imprints.

Hong!

The black beast figure was instantly broken up into several hundred true treasures, all black in color, which flew over to Golden Horned Beast at top speed and settled on him. There, the true treasures fully integrated into Golden Horned Beast’s body, covering every inch of him.

In an instant, Golden Horned Beast transformed into a gigantic beast that was jet black all over. The scales covering every inch of his godly body were like knife blades. Even his fangs grew tremendously. The five sharp horns originally on his forehead had become six! The middle horn was the longest, with a length of approximately one and a half feet! (At this juncture, Golden Horned Beast still maintained his miniaturized godly body, which was three feet long).

Luo Feng’s consciousness was cheering with joy. Wonderful!

Those sharp claws! That tail! That godly body! And those sharp horns! Everywhere—every part of it was a true treasure!

This true treasure series was truly deserving of being considered most compatible with the Beast God Path. Furthermore, Beast God Armor had incredible defensive power. It was essentially an attack-type true treasure, and its defensive power was comparatively weaker. Yet its defensive power would still be on par with ordinary treasures of a top-tier true treasure defense armor.

The instant Luo Feng branded the armor with his life imprints, Beast God Armor transmitted some ancient information, including its actual name. Luo Feng was secretly confused.

Huh? This Beast God Armor was originally named “Northern Rock”? What a strange name.

Many treasures had original names, such as “Silver Dragon Phantom” and “Golden King Armor.” However, their new users would normally give them other names, such as “Ancient Boat Galaxy” and “Golden Armor.” Beast God Armor’s original name had been “Northern Rock.”

Regardless of what its original name was, this Beast God Armor is indeed the most suitable one for my Golden Horned Beast body. Excellent!

“Roar!”

Golden Horned Beast got worked up and could not help letting out a roar of excitement. Ancestor nodded with satisfaction.

“Luo Feng, come here!” Sitting Mountain Guest shouted out.

Luo Feng obeyed immediately.

Sitting Mountain Guest took Luo Feng aside and changed the universe law of the surroundings. If Ancestor wanted to listen to their conversation, he could, of course, make use of the universe laws to forcibly suppress this… but Ancestor would not go to that extent. It was obvious that Sitting Mountain Guest had something to discuss with his disciple in private.

“Teacher?” Luo Feng said as he sat down beside Sitting Mountain Guest.

“Just a short 180 million years to succeed… Well done.” Sitting Mountain Guest nodded his approval. “You are stronger than your second brother.”

Luo Feng listened submissively.

“Back then, I made you the Star Map, but looking at you today, I’m afraid it will no longer be of much help,” Sitting Mountain Guest said. “Although you may only be a pinnacle undying now, you are highly accomplished in the studies of secret engravings! You are already at a strategically advantageous position. If you were to move on to studying the law path… in an extremely short period of time, you will be able to achieve a breakthrough and become a universe knight. Even if making your way past the threshold to be a universe knight may somewhat affect you, 1,000 years should be enough.”

Luo Feng nodded. He was also very confident. Studying the pictures of secret engravings had made him feel that studying the law path would be simple. It would be easy to understand! Previously, he had been restricted to only studying the engravings because of the gamble… so Luo Feng had simply refrained from studying the law path.

“When you have become a universe knight, you will be using Star Tower while being new to it, but you will already be able to activate the entire Star Tower,” Sitting Mountain Guest said. “By then, with Star Tower… this Star Map will be useless.”

Luo Feng nodded and could not help asking, “Teacher, does this mean that I have to undergo another ordeal to obtain the fifth black metal board of the Nine Volume Manual?”

To obtain the third black metal board, Luo Feng had sent himself to Ice Hell. To obtain the fourth, he had fallen into this Beast God Sector.

“No,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. Then he added with a smile, “If your teacher’s methods are all so easily fathomed, could I still be called a teacher?”

Luo Feng was taken by surprise.

“In terms of training through ordeals, this Beast God Sector has put you through enough,” Sitting Mountain Guest said. “180 million years… you can now create a universe master ultimate technique! Based on your studies on pictures of secret engravings and the law path… we have mutual confirmation. That’s enough.”

“What about the fifth black metal board?” asked Luo Feng. He could not wait to get his hands on the fifth black metal board right away.

“When the time comes, you will know.” Sitting Mountain Guest said.

Luo Feng was left with no other choice.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Luo Feng with a satisfied expression. “Continue to work hard! Your power is extremely strong now, but just wait until the day you use Star Tower. No one in this universe will be able to look down on you… As your teacher, I have hopes for you to become even stronger.”

“Yes, Teacher,” said Luo Feng.

He was expectant, too. Over the course of these 180 million years, he had undergone a total transformation. He was no longer a weakling unarmed with battling techniques who could only depend on setting his godly being ablaze to obtain power when facing his enemies, hoping that his enemies’ powers would be consumed before he was finished.

Consuming his opponents to death was only achievable in the Land of Extremis because that was a place where no one could send out calls for help to other great beings of their races. However, in other places, such as the Original Star, when one met with danger, it was always possible to obtain help from other great beings. After all, every supreme being was important.

Sitting Mountain Guest turned his head, transmitting his voice to Ancestor who stood in the distance. “Space Ancestor. Thank you for all these years. Now that he has met my expectations, I will take him and leave this place.”

“There’s no hurry. Wait a moment.” Ancestor was by their side in a flash.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Ancestor. “There is something else?”

“Nothing to do with you.” Ancestor looked at Luo Feng. “I have something to tell Luo Feng.”

“He is my disciple,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. “How is this unrelated to me? Luo Feng, from how I see it, I think you should still focus on staying within humans…” But Sitting Mountain Guest was still mid-sentence when he suddenly started laughing. “Luo Feng,” he said, “since Space Ancestor has something to tell you, you should stay and chat with him. I will wait for you here. Then we can head back to the primal universe.”

“Yes, Teacher,” Luo Feng replied.

Right. It was time to head back to the primal universe!

…

Sitting Mountain Guest walked off into the distance, and Luo Feng followed him. He bowed to show his respect, then addressed him. “Ancestor,” he said.

Ancestor looked at Luo Feng and asked directly, “Has the thought of leaving the human race ever crossed your mind?”


Chapter 1071: Back to the Original Universe

Luo Feng had known that Ancestor of the Space Beast Alliance wanted to admit him, but he hadn’t expected Ancestor to be so straightforward.

“No,” Luo Feng answered without hesitation.

It would have been ridiculous for him to say yes. The human race treated him with great generosity, and besides, after 100,000 years, earthlings had been spread across the entire Ganwu Universe, and they had blended in the human race family. Besides, Luo’s family had had people reach all the regions in the universe… How was it possible for him to break away from the human race like that? He needed to think about his parents and his wife.

Ancestor was dazed for a moment but then nodded. “Ah. I almost forgot that you’re still fairly new. Your family and friends are still alive.”

“Yes.” Luo Feng nodded.

“How about this?” Ancestor continued. “Your Golden Horned Beast can join my Space Beast Alliance. He can be known as Golden Mountain Knight. This won’t affect anything you have within the human race, just as you can call for help on the original stars as a human and you can also call for help as a space beast. From now on, you’ll have two powers to support you!”

“However,” said Luo Feng, “I’ll also bear responsibilities from both sides.”

It was beneficial for Luo Feng to join a new power. However, he would also bear new responsibilities!

He understood why Ancestor wanted him to join the alliance. Once he became a universe knight, his godly body would be close to some universe masters, as he had reached the perfect life gene level! And together with ultimate techniques of universe masters, a top-tier set of true treasures, and pinnacle true treasures, he would be much stronger. And once he became a universe master, he would rival the top-tier universe masters like Primal Chaos City Leader. Besides, he had Sitting Mountain Guest behind him to help! How could he not draw Luo Feng to his side?

“Yes, the alliance gives you assistance, and meanwhile, you will need to bear some responsibilities.” Ancestor looked at Luo Feng. “Great power comes with great responsibility. What you think?”

“No problem. I can bear them.” Luo Feng smiled and nodded.

“Wonderful.” Ancestor nodded with satisfaction.

It was better for him to have more help on the path of great beings. When he was trapped or in danger, and if the Hong Alliance couldn’t help him in time, he would now have the Space Beast Alliance. Besides, Luo Feng had gone to Space God Mountain once, and the members of the Space Beast Alliance were like brothers, contrary to the strict hierarchy in the human race.

Just when Ancestor and Luo Feng reached an agreement, Sitting Mountain Guest walked towards them.

“I didn’t hear your conversation,” he said, “but it seems that you’ve successfully admitted him, Space Beast Ancestor.”

“Master,” Luo Feng greeted Sitting Mountain Guest.

“Luo Feng, did that old man give you some benefits?” asked Sitting Mountain Guest. He was being quite blunt!

Luo Feng was smart enough to say, “Not yet.”

Sitting Mountain Guest turned around and glared at Sitting Mountain Guest. “Your alliance will definitely bestow a universe knight with great potential a true treasure if you find one. How come this disciple of mine didn’t get one? It’s lucky for you space beasts that my disciple has joined your alliance!”

Ancestor was dazed. “I just gave—”

“Don’t mention the Beast God Armor,” Sitting Mountain Guest scolded. “That was because of the bet you lost. That’s not something your alliance gave to Luo Feng.”

There was, indeed, a rule within the alliance that a universe knight with great potential would be bestowed with a true treasure if he didn’t have one! However, the alliance wouldn’t waste true treasures if the individual in question had already had one. They needed to earn them through their contributions to the race.

As for Luo Feng, he had a top-tier set true treasure, so obviously, he didn’t lack true treasures.

Ancestor looked at Luo Feng. “Haha! It makes sense. Luo Feng has already stood at the top among the universe overlords. It is indeed lucky for my alliance to have him. Luo Feng, you should know that no matter which power you join, you need to exchange true treasures with your contributions. Even if your great potential deserves true treasures, the one bestowed to you won’t be precious.”

Luo Feng nodded. It was like Bark Mirror Emperor. He only had an ordinary true treasure armor.

“Your Golden Horned Beast doesn’t need true treasures anymore,” said Ancestor, “but your original earthling body is better at close combat. I know that you’ve been using spiritual force weapons… I’ll give you a senior true treasure that’s a weapon for close combat.”

“Thank you, Ancestor,” Luo Feng responded.

He would definitely take a free true treasure. It was more than enough to have a senior true treasure weapon for close combat.

“So stingy of you,” Sitting Mountain Guest murmured.

“Sitting Mountain Guest, unlike you, I have an entire Space Beast Alliance to take care of,” Ancestor said with resignation. “If you think the true treasure I gave him is not good enough, you should give something better.”

“Rest assured, I’ll definitely give him a better one.” Sitting Mountain Guest glared at Ancestor jokingly.

“What kind of close-combat weapons do you need?” Ancestor asked Luo Feng.

“A sword,” said Luo Feng. “I’d like it to look like this.” He pointed to the sky, and his godly power concentrated, forming the shape of a ghost sword.

“I don’t have one that’s exactly like that. How about this one?” Ancestor waved his right hand and transported a true treasure from somewhere else.

The sword was slightly bent. The handle was purple, and there were complex patterns on it. It looked like a two-handed sword in the shape of a saber.

“The blade part is close to the one you want, but the handle is longer,” said Ancestor.

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed. “Great.”

“Take it.”

Ancestor smiled, and the ancient blade flew toward Luo Feng. He penetrated it with his godly power, and information flooded his mind.

The sword was called “Cutting Pearl Sword.”

“Cutting Pearl…” Luo Feng held the sword and slashed the space.

Si! La!

There were cuttings left in the space it touched, which satisfied Luo Feng. It was like the first time when he used the ghost blade on earth, which was exciting.

“This is the information about our Space Beat Alliance.” Ancestor threw a golden book towards Luo Feng. “There are many other gathering places for our alliance aside from Space God Mountain. Every gathering has a portal to Space God Mountain! You can leave some keepsakes in the gathering places and transport yourself there, and thus, to Space God Mountain any time. Be sure to come back to Space God Mountain sometimes, at least to get keepsakes from Golden Horn Master and Xuan Mie Master so that you can get some help from them when you’re in danger. Chapter 1072: Plight

The Golden Horned Beast stepped on the water of the boundless Remote Ocean. His hoofs were tens of thousands of miles tall, and his body was more than 55,000 miles long. Chapter 1073: Paying a Visit

Ganwu Country Master. Was he lucky? Or unlucky? Luo Feng was not able to tell for sure, but he could see that Ganwu Country Master was in a difficult position.

On the mountains of Thunder Island in the virtual universe, in the palace of Ganwu Country Master.

His older son, Luo Ping, and his wife, Xu Xin, were all at their family nest… His father, Luo Hong Guo, and mother, Gong Xin Lan, had indulged in virtual games for a good many years. Luckily, Luo Hai had found his way to the Ganwu Dojo, and thereafter, he had been taken under the wing of the dojo’s founder, Ganwu Country Master, who accepted him as a special disciple.

Luo Feng nodded in agreement. The talent of dividing bodies meant that even if one body was annihilated, the main body could still recover over time at its own pace. There was no need to reverse time and space just to be resurrected. The price to pay was small.

As for my debt to my clansmen accumulated until today, I can’t tell for sure how many eras it will take me to finally repay everything.”

I would have amassed an amount to completely recoup the loss I incurred from being annihilated. By then, it would not have been too late to move on to the next adventure.” Ganwu Country Master shook his head.

Luo Feng understood him. A clan was no charity. Its existence would help its own clansmen, but to do so, it needed the contributions from great beings of the clan! The privilege to enjoy benefits and the responsibility to contribute were interdependent. If Ganwu Country Master continued to owe his clan repeatedly in such a manner, the debt was bound to multiply. Luckily for him, his clan was not forcing him into a corner.

“How much do you owe?” Luo Feng asked.

“Huh?” Ganwu Country Master was stunned and looked at Luo Feng. He could roughly guess his intentions and was hence unable to suppress his agitated emotions.

Luo Feng was secretly taken aback. Ouch! No wonder he could not pay off everything. 3.8 true treasure points was enough to exchange for two to three ordinary true treasures. Such an amount could be worth the entire fortune of a universe overlord. Ganwu Country Master had accumulated an alarming debt.

Of course, Luo Feng did not really care. From killing Bark Mirror Emperor, he had obtained a true treasure armor. As of today, Luo Feng owned Tower Pearl, Star Map, Shi Wu Wings, Nine Tiger River, Golden King Armor, the heavenly sword and armor of Demon Sword Knight, top-tier true treasure series Beast God Armor, pinnacle true treasure Force Armor, the senior true treasure battle sword Cutting Pearl… and he would be getting the supreme true treasure Star Tower soon!

The quantity was plenty, and their quality was high. Of course, the top three were God Beast Armor, Force Armor, and Star Tower. Out of the three, Force Armor and Star Tower had both been bestowed to him by Sitting Mountain Guest. The Beast God Armor series had been won from Ancestor. These three all came from universe supreme masters.

Given Luo Feng’s techniques, getting hold of true treasures was no difficulty at all. The strong would always be strong! That was the underlying theory behind his success.

“I will lend you 1.6 true treasure points,” Luo Feng said. “As for the amount you owe your people, you’ll have to figure that out for yourself.”

“1.6 true treasure points?” Ganwu Country Master felt every cell of his godly roaring with joy. His emotions ran high. As a universe knight, he was very particular about pride. Yet in the face of all his good friends’ denunciation, all he could do was tolerate it.

Luo Feng disappeared the very next moment.

In the starry sky of the universe, amidst the darkness, there was an indistinct space whirlpool.

Chapter 1074: A Moving Treasure Vault

Towering mountain ranges stretched across the land, and above the mountains was a great space whirlpool. A silver-winged and silver-armored man walked out of the whirlpool. He stood in the sky and looked around. All was silent.

“Based on the information I have,” said Luo Feng, “during the first few hundred of years when the original stars were open, it was more likely for valuables to be born, and the great beings who had suppressed their desire for an eternity were more excited. This led to more killings. However, after that time, almost all the great beings have gone into hiding.”

Luo Feng shook his wing and started to fly. He looked down at the ground. Although he had arrived at another original star, there weren’t significant differences among the original stars.

After flying for half an hour, he saw a purple object in a lake in a mountain valley below.

“Huh?”

Luo Feng picked it up and examined it. It was a purple cloth that was about 30 square feet in size. Luo Feng penetrated it with a trace of his godly power, and the information contained in it flooded his mind.
