Although it was only a treasure, it was the first time that Luo Feng had seen a treasure that looked like a cloth. He sensed that it was a top-tier spiritual force weapon.

“Imitation of Purple Sky?” Luo Feng whispered. “The name is bizarre. Could there be a more powerful valuable named ‘Purple Sky’? Why would a valuable born in the original stars is called Imitation of Purple Sky?”

The more Luo Feng thought about it, the more mysterious he found the universe to be. He already stood among the supreme beings in the universe, but there were still many secrets waiting for him to uncover.

“This treasure might be worth thousands of treasure points. I’m really lucky.”

Luo Feng smiled. This was what usually happened in the original stars, and many great beings were aware that there were numerous valuables on the original stars. However, there were usually many great beings gathering here as well. No matter how many valuables one obtained, once he was killed, he was doing others a favor. Only those with great power could roam the original stars! Like Luo Feng…

Luo Feng didn’t need to be afraid of universe overlords anymore. As for universe masters, they couldn’t teleport themselves on the original stars. And if a universe master arrived, Luo Feng would have known about it through the virtual universe and hid himself away. Besides, with Luo Feng’s power, universe masters’ control over space and time didn’t intimidate him.

Luo Feng strolled on the original star as if he were in the garden of his own home. He was waiting for an opportunity, and his Remote Ocean body was connected to the virtual universe and waiting for the update about Tian Yang Knight. Once he got it, Luo Feng would immediately race to where Tian Yang Knight was.

29 hours after Luo Feng arrived at the original star, a giant, two-headed being lay in the forest. His skin looked like purple crystals. The armor on his godly body was dimming, and he was lying there, waiting for an opportunity…

He was an energy life form—a great being from the Purple Smelting race. The fact that he was walking alone on the original stars proved that he was a universe overlord! Energy life forms were one of the few races who were naturally immune to soul attacks, and the Purple Smelting race belonged to that category. They preferred to be closer to the ground. Many life forms loved to sit when they practiced, but great beings from the Purple Smelting race loved to lie down.

Flourishing Light Horde Leader lay with one of his heads’ eyes closed while the other had them open, fully alert.

“Hmm?” All his eyes suddenly opened, and he spotted a human shape flying across the sky between the leaves of the forest. “It’s a human?”

Flourishing Light Horde Leader stood up.

“A silver wing? And that look…” Flourishing Light Horde Leader looked shocked. “Isn’t that the legendary talent of the human race, Luo Feng? That true treasure wing… How is it possible? Though that human killed Bark Mirror Emperor, he is, after all, only undying. He is, at most, as powerful as a secondary universe knight, and those who dare to show up on the original stars are at least senior universe knights.”

Flourishing Light Horde Leader was thrilled to see Luo Feng. After all, Purple Smelting race was one of the numerous races that belonged to the Northern Territory Alliance, and Bark Mirror Emperor —who had been killed by Luo Feng—was from the Northern Territory Alliance. The great beings from the Northern Territory Alliance surely knew about Luo Feng.

Additionally, the great beings who had inside information had already extrapolated that this peerless genius had at least six true treasures! A soul type true treasure, a spiritual force weapon true treasure, a wing true treasure, and an armor true treasure. Plus, he had at least two true treasures from the Ancestral God School. Six true treasures were much more than all that many universe overlords had. Especially soul type true treasures, which were ardently desired by universe overlords.

They all perceived Luo Feng to be weak, as he was only undying! He was like a human-shaped, moving vault full of valuables available for the taking! There were even discussions within the Northern Territory Alliance that if Luo Feng entered original stars, it would be like giving true treasures away to those lucky great beings of other races.

However, all the races had assumed that Luo Feng wouldn’t be stupid enough to enter the original stars. Based on the information gathered, Luo Feng hadn’t gone to the original stars in the past 20,000 years.

“He’s here? And I haven’t got any news? Am I the first one to find him?” Both of Flourishing Light Horde Leader’ heads were raised up and looked at Luo Feng as he flew. “He’s a peerless genius in the human race. I didn’t think he’d be stupid enough to put himself in danger.”

He was both exhilarated and wary. Luo Feng surely had something to save himself. However, after hesitating for three seconds, Flourishing Light Horde Leader reached a conclusion.

“Humph! He’s only undying! Even if he has a trump card to save himself, can that kill me? Only universe masters are able to do that! It’s impossible for him to hide a universe master in his world ring.” Flourishing Light Horde Leader smirked. “I don’t need to worry about what he has. He can’t threaten my life.”

This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! thought Flourishing Light Horde Leader. A human-shaped moving vault full of valuables! I can get at least six true treasures if I kill him, and I can exchange one of his true treasures for a senior true treasure armor.

The soul type true treasure Luo Feng had was useless to him, as he was a life form from Purple Smelting race, but he could still exchange it for something he desired!

“It’s an opportunity I can’t miss! If I do, I’ll regret it for billions of years.”

The eyes on Flourishing Light Horde Leader glinted fiercely.

Sou!

He started to speed up in silence I the forest. As for Luo Feng, he was flying in the sky at a moderate speed and looking down at the ground, and Flourishing Light Horde Leader caught up with Luo Feng immediately.

Luo Feng didn’t notice Flourishing Light Horde Leader at the beginning, but Luo Feng saw him when he flew out of the forest.

“Human!”

Flourishing Light Horde Leader surged, and his purple-crystal skin was glowing. Both of his heads turned to face Luo Feng, and his eyes glared at him.

Luo Feng looked down and frowned. “Flourishing Light Horde Leader from the Northern Territory Alliance?” Luo Feng immediately identified him and took out his Cutting Pearl Sword.

“Die!” Flourishing Light Horde Leader shouted.

All six arms of Flourishing Light Horde Leader reached out, glowing with a cold light, and when they approached each other…

Hong! Long! Long!

Their surroundings were trapped in time law domain, which also affected Luo Feng. Flourishing Light Horde Leader took the chance and attacked him.

He puts all his efforts into fighting me—the legendary undying fighter, Luo Feng thought. He used law domain first, after which he is now going to start attacking me. No wonder he’s a universe overlord.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The sky started to glimmer as if stars were shining, but all the lights looked aggressive. It was as if they all sought to kill Luo Feng directly.

Luo Feng still held his Cutting Pearl Sword still after seeing this.

“Flourishing Light Horde Leader’s technique, Flourishing Light World?” Luo Feng nodded. “I’ll use you to test the training I’ve had in the past 180 million years.”

Luo Feng, who had already burned his godly power, started to move the sword in his hands. Meanwhile, engravings showed up on the blade. The engravings were delicate, elegant, and mesmerizing. When Luo Feng waved the sword, gold and space merge law were triggered.

“You dared to fight back?” said Flourishing Light Horde Leader. “Even if you have an ordinary true treasure armor, you’ll die under this attack!” And then, Flourishing Light Horde Leader was terrified. “What’s that?” he gasped.

A gleaming, golden light! Cold! Fierce!

It slashed through all the flourishing lights, and the technique of Flourishing Light Horde Leader was shattered—smashed like an ant. The golden light hit Flourishing Light Horde Leader’s armor, and the power was so strong that the ordinary true treasure armor could only weaken half the power from the attack. The rest of the attacking power was all taken by Flourishing Light Horde Leader’s body.

“Howl!”

A roaring sound from afar blasted the ears of Flourishing Light Horde Leader.

“I, I, I…” Flourishing Light Horde Leader still floated in the sky. And then, just like that, his godly body was annihilated and disappeared into thin air. Only his black armor and six lights were left.

Luo Feng stood in the sky and smiled.


Chapter 1075: It’s Luo Feng!

Under the control of his godly power, the black armor that was suspended in midair and the six, hovering lights made a turn and flew toward Luo Feng.

“An ordinary true treasure armor,” said Luo Feng. “Six ordinary true treasures weapons—should be considered as a series. It has a value that is comparable to a senior true treasure weapon.”

Luo Feng stored the true treasures and then summoned a World Ring to him from afar. This World Ring had fallen to the floor immediately after Flourishing Light Horde Leader was annihilated. Upon checking its contents, Luo Feng only found a dozen or more treasures and some other things. Their accumulated value was not even the value of an ordinary true treasure.

After killing Flourishing Light horde leader, Luo Feng gathered the loot from his victory. His human godly body was set ablaze to display his most powerful trump card and was hence greatly consumed. However, there was his Remote Ocean body to supplement whatever was lacking. Thus, he was able to maintain a pinnacle condition.

Sou!

The moment Luo Feng spread his wings, he transformed into a beam of light and took off. His speed was neither too fast nor too slow; he maintained his flying speed near to the speed of light.

His surroundings were quiet. There was no movement, no traces. No one would be able to tell that a universe overlord had just annihilated been at that very spot just moments before.

The Northern Territory Alliance had an immensely large territory under its control, and within the starry sky where the Purple Smelting race lived in, there was a life planet that was dark red all over. The palace of Flourishing Light Horde Leader could be found on that planet.

The palace was not big, but it was considered to be one of the sacred grounds of the Purple Smelting race. The Purple Smelting race had a total of six existing universe overlords. Universe overlords were by far the strongest beings within the race, which was why the entire race was divided into six different territories, each managed and cultivated by these six universe overlords.

From within the palace, several disciples and servants bowed in worship as they watched a faraway figure approaching. It was the body that Flourishing Light Horde Leader had left behind before he made his way to the Original Star.

This body was weak. But it was, after all, Flourishing Light horde leader’s consciousness, so it could still provide guidance to disciples and handle certain matters without a hitch.

“I—” Flourishing Light Horde Leader revealed a shocked expression.

Peng!

Suddenly, he was annihilated and dissipated into thin air.

“Huh?”

“Horde leader!”

“Teacher!”

Three disciples and a bunch of personal servants who were waiting in the distance were in great shock. The area surrounding this planet was in a sealed space, so even Flourishing Light Horde Leader could not teleport and leave the planet. So how did his body suddenly disappear?

“Don’t worry, there must be some very important matters that needed Teacher’s undivided attention, so he has retracted his godly consciousness. Then, of course, the body will disappear.”

“Let’s take a look at the tokens teacher gave us.”

“Let’s take a look at the tokens.”

The three disciples immediately took out the tokens. The tokens were all parts of a collection of Flourishing Light Horde Leader’s belongings. They were all items that had his life imprint. They were valuables that recognized their owners. Once these items were crushed, Flourishing Light Horde Leader would sense the urgency and go to his disciples’ rescue.

“The token has become an object without an owner!” A high-pitched voice suddenly shouted from among the disciples.

Two other voices corresponded with the same comment, adding to the bleak and grim atmosphere.

“An object without a master!”

“Mine too! An object without a master!”

The three disciples of the Purple Smelting race looked at one another, eyes filled with fear and uneasiness. They had no doubts about what this situation meant! For an object that recognizes its master, that were only two ways to reverse this recognition. One was for the master to personally remove his life imprint on the object, and the other was for the master to be killed.

Since Flourishing Light Horde Leader was not present, there was no way he could have personally removed his life imprints. Then the answer was undoubtedly… that Flourishing Light Horde Leader had been annihilated!

“Hurry up! We have to quickly notify the other horde leaders.”

“Quick! Immediately!”

“Notify the higher-ups!”

Six universe overlords oversaw the entire Purple Smelting race. If one got annihilated, it would be equivalent to the collapse of one of the race’s pillars of support. This, to the Purple Smelting race, was a very scary blow.

A short while later, three universe overlords of the Purple Smelting race who had not entered the Original Star came rushing over. First and foremost, they asked Flourishing Light Horde Leader’s disciples questions about what happened. Then they dismissed all the disciples and servants.

In the palace, the three universe overlords who took the form of purple-crystal skinned, two-headed life forms stood in their designated spots. The atmosphere was suffocating.

“Flourishing Light was annihilated!”

“Who could kill Flourishing Light? And to think he did not even have the chance to ask for help! Flourishing Light owns an ordinary true treasure armor, and his attack techniques were strong. To kill him… could it have been a universe master?”

“Even if it wasn’t a universe master, it must be one of the most powerful universe overlords.”

The three of them fell in silence. Flourishing Light Horde Leader, Jiu Feng Knight, Pei Feng Knight, and Qi Blood Palace Leader were all considered normal universe overlords. There were some other powerful ones. For instance, there were special life-forms of the universe overlord level with life genes level of 8,000 or 9,000 times. Their godly powers were purer those of normal universe overlords by 100 times! When launching attacks, their powers would be 100 times stronger, too!

Furthermore, these powerful universe overlords would be obtaining even stronger true treasures. Their combat powers would certainly be extremely strong. With godly bodies that were massive in size, even if they were to go head-on with universe masters… they would be able to hold out for a long time.

“Going into the Original Star, there is always a risk of being killed. We had better banish that thought… If someone is able to defeat Flourishing Light, we, the Purple Smelting race, really cannot afford to offend them.”

“Hmm.” The three universe overlords nodded in unison.

“We have to enlist help from the Northern Territory Alliance to resurrect Flourishing Light.”

“Flourishing Light is a universe overlord; his resurrection is only possible at the hands of Main Master of Alliance… But Main Master’s temperament is notorious. I’m afraid we have to wait for his mood to brighten up before we can ask him to help resurrect Flourishing Light.”

Elementary universe knights, secondary universe knights, senior universe knights… once they were annihilated, it would usually not take too long for them to be resurrected. It there was a delay, it would, at most, be 1,000 to 10,000 years.

But in the case of universe overlords, things were not that simple. In the whole of the Northern Territory Alliance, only Main Master of Alliance had the ability to resurrect a universe overlord! Other universe masters were unable to do so. Even if the Main Master of Alliance was caught up in some other matters for billions of years… no one would dare make a single utterance.

“Heck, let’s just submit our application to the Alliance. Then we will wait patiently.”

“Agreed. When Flourishing Light comes back, we will know how he was annihilated.”

The Original Star was closing up on the Land of Origin of the universe.

Cruising the sky of the Original Star… the feeling was wonderful. Luo Feng smiled while on the move, reminiscing about the battle earlier on.

“My first time going all out in a battle, the power is massive.” Luo Feng was extremely satisfied with his power. “It is unquestionably an ultimate technique of a universe master. The amount of godly power it consumes is alarming. If I did not have Remote Ocean body consistently supplementing me with energy, I think just that one stance alone would be enough to lose half of my godly body.”

Previously, in the Beast God sector, when Luo Feng and Ancestor were engaged in combat… he did not have to burn his godly body to become an undying body. When his body was not set ablaze, no matter how long he had to toil through a battle, he would not be consuming much of his godly power.

However, in the battle of life and death, Luo Feng had to burn his godly body! Like Qi Blood Palace Leader and Demon Sword Knight, when displaying their ultimate skills, they, too, would consume much of their godly bodies. And Luo Feng’s ultimate technique of a universe master, “Golden Light,” was on a much higher level compared to those of Qi Blood Palace Leader and Demon Sword Knight! Luo Feng’s consumption of energy was unintentional, but after the Golden Light absorbed his godly power… it consumed more than half his godly body! Of course, Remote Ocean body was rapidly supplementing him with what was lost.

What a large consumption! The force was insanely strong!

“Too strong!” said Luo Feng. “I could feel his ordinary true treasure armor becoming helplessly weak under my blade. If I were to just increase the strength of my attack by one level, I think I would have destroyed that true treasure.”

Luo Feng analyzed the situation himself. 9,800 times of the life genes level, 100 times of godly power amplification… Luo Feng’s godly body was not inferior to that of a general universe overlord! Even for the one and only special life forms—such as the World Tree in the Ancestral God Secret Region and the Cold Whale—they might be universe overlords, but their battling powers were comparable to those of universe masters. And their godly powers were purer than Luo Feng’s by just two levels!

But Luo Feng’s ultimate technique of a universe master was stronger than those of the World Tree and Cold Whale by two levels! The advantages he had in terms of his secret technique made up for the lack of godly power. The moment Luo Feng displayed his ultimate technique of a universe master, he would be comparable to the powerful special life forms of universe overlords!

“His true treasure armor was simply sub-standard, weakened to only half his power. Of course his godly body would be annihilated. If he had a senior true treasure armor, I guess, I might only have been able to injure him. To kill him, I would have needed a few more strikes.”

This exemplified the importance of armor. Even for universe masters, not many could achieve attacks that would bring Force Armor to its limit.

“180 million years of cultivation has indeed brought me great success.”

Luo Feng nodded with satisfaction. He was highly accomplished in the studies of pictures of secret engravings, making the mastering of space laws a breeze. Although it had only been a few days since he left the Beast God sector, he already comprehended the final space law, which was none other than the mysterious and complex “Strangulation.” Now, all he needed to do was combine three space laws, namely, “Teleportation,” “Space Sealing,” and “Strangulation,” into one. Then he would become a universe master.

However, the final stage posed a small challenge to Luo Feng. Just like how some great beings were highly accomplished in space laws, yet were stuck in the final stage of the gold laws, Luo Feng was highly successful until now. He was slightly affected at his current stage. Just like Sitting Mountain Guest had said, a breakthrough could happen anytime, regardless of how slow he was. 1,000 years would be more than enough to become a universe master.

“When I become a universe overlord, my godly body will be comparable to powerful special life forms like World Tree and Cold Whale. I will be even stronger in my techniques. By then, I will have to go all-out in becoming a universe master.”

Luo Feng was secretly looking forward to this.

“By then, I will be able to make use of Star Tower readily.”

Luo Feng smiled, then continued flying. He was waiting… Waiting for the next great being like Flourishing Light horde leader to make a move against him.

“Bring it on. I am the mobile treasury.” Luo Feng smirked.

In one of the hilly valleys amidst the deserted plains, three senior universe knights from the Thorn Ring Alliance were hiding. They were silently waiting for energy waves. Among them, Ji Qi Knight was appalled when he raised his head to look up at the sky. He immediately transmitted what he found aloud.

“Look, look! That is the human form of Luo Feng!”

“Luo Feng? Are you referring to the human fellow who is always so lucky?”

The other two universe knights looked up with a jerk. The three looked very carefully and tried to make out who the figure was. Silver armor, silver wings, and a black-haired human form…

“It is him! It’s the human form of Luo Feng.”

“It’s him. He has at least six true treasures on him! And that is definitely a soul type true treasure, and even possibly a flying-palace type true treasure.”

“He dares to come to the Original Star. This extraordinary genius really thinks he’s invincible? Such arrogance…”

“Arrogance is good. He is a mobile treasury in human form. But this human form of Luo Feng might have a strong backing.”

“What backing? Even if there is a universe overlord in the Word Ring protecting him in secret, what can he do?”

The weeds around them kept them hidden from view. As they looked up at the figure flying across the sky, all three felt their hearts burning…

The shortest yet sturdiest four-hoofed being transmitted his thoughts as the other two universe knights immediately lent him their undivided attention.

“We have to succeed. Our powers put together will be far stronger than his. Once he escapes, he will take off at a speed near light speed. Then we will not be able to catch up anymore. I have a plan, and I will make it a point to prevent him from escaping.”


Chapter 1076: Prey

The four-hoofed being started to transmit his voice, and the two universe knights listened to it carefully. The four-hoofed being finished the entire plan in less than one second, though they had been staring at Luo Feng, who was flying in the sky in silence… He was their prey, and it would be easy to get his true treasures!

“Get out!” The four-hoofed being gave an order, but he was shocked after that.

Hong! Hong!

Two beings flew toward Luo Feng from two different directions. The four-hoofed being and Ji Qi Knight could see clearly that one of the beings who dashed at Luo Feng was had a godly body that was more than 300 feet long with dozens of claws. His knees were covered with hair, and the green eye he had on his face was glinting with fierceness and greediness.

As for the other, he looked like a human, but he was of bug race. He was lanky with blade-shaped hands.

“They’re in the lead!” Ji Qi Knight opened his eyes wide.

“They’re from the Northern Territory Alliance! Our plan…” another knight said anxiously.

The four-hoofed being roared, “Forget the plan! Let’s attack him!”

Hong! Hong! Hong!

Threes beams of light shot to the sky and flew toward Luo Feng. Both of the universe knights from the Northern Territory Alliance were nervous as well. The strange beast knight transmitted his growling voice: “It’s the bastards from the Thorn Ring Alliance! We were the ones who found Luo Feng first! Don’t let them take him!”

“Luo Feng is ours,” shouted the lanky knight, clenching his teeth and looking fierce.

Luo Feng was the calmest one. He flew leisurely in the sky and saw universe knights of other races flying toward him. He immediately identified them.

“Ke Bi Knight and Ba Xiu Knight from the Northern Territory Alliance. Ba Xiu Knight has an enormous godly body, much larger than the body of Flourishing Light Horde Leader who I killed before. Flourishing Light Horde Leader is around 30 feet tall, but he’s over 300 feet tall… But I bet he doesn’t have a true treasure armor. I can kill him with one move.”

Universe overlords’ godly bodies were not much better at defense than senior universe knights… Usually, universe overlords relied on their true treasure armor! Ordinary true treasure armors were enough when it came to attacks from ordinary overlords. However, in the case of the World Tree, the Cold Whale, and Purple Rain Knight, ordinary true treasure armors wouldn’t help much. Only senior true treasure armors or their better could protect one from being killed after one move.

Of course, if one’s godly body was over 600 miles long, like that of Golden Horned Beast body, he could survive longer even if he only had an ordinary true treasure armor. But if one didn’t have an adequately sized godly body or senior true treasure armor, they would be walking toward their own demise if they were dealing with top-tier universe overlords like World Tree, Cold Whale, Purple Rain Knight, or Luo Feng. Of course, no one alive on the original stars knew of Luo Feng’s real power. The only one who knew about it was already dead. They still thought of him as a human-shaped moving treasure vault.

“Another three?” Luo Feng glanced around. “Ji Qi Knight, Zhu Ka Knight, and Xun Ya Knight from Thorn Ring Alliance. Are they all senior universe knights. Well, they’re not a threat to me.”

Hong!

Luo Feng waved his wing and sped up, starting to flee.

“He’s running away!”

“Don’t let him run away!”

“Quick! That direction!”

Ke Bi Knight and Ba Xiu Knight from the Northern Territory Alliance grew anxious. Though they were not afraid of the three great beings from the Thorn Ring Alliance, they only had two beings while the Northern Territory Alliance had three. Besides, their power was at the same level. Luo Feng might be seized by the great beings from the Thorn Ring Alliance.

“Chase him!”

“Hurry up!”

“Let’s separate and encircle him.”

The three knights from the Thorn Ring Alliance went three different ways and tried to outflank Luo Feng. Their speed surged.

Weng! Weng!

Both time law domain and space law domain arrived, and they started to stop Luo Feng.

“Want to run away? Hahaha… Luo Feng! You’re coming to the original stars for your death.” Ke Bi Knight grinned hideously, and a circle showed up around his hand. He threw it out, and the circle started to bulge. It dashed toward Luo Feng at lightspeed under the control of godly power.

The three universe knights from the Thorn Ring Alliance also grew anxious, but they couldn’t do anything, as the universe knight from Northern Territory Alliance had a spiritual force weapon.

“Don’t worry, that Luo Feng has a spiritual force weapon true treasure,” Ji Qi Knight said. They were relatively farther from Luo Feng, as they had taken off later.

“That’s right! Luo Feng has a spiritual force true treasure weapon.”

“Want to catch me?” Luo Feng roared.

Hua!

Luo Feng held his right first, and stars showed up in the sky. All the 1,000 stars had tightly carved engravings on them, and they formed a gigantic beast god under the godly power! The beast god roared and raced toward that circle.

The beast god’s tail slashed at the circle. The circle bounced away, and it tried to charge Luo Feng again under Ke Bi Knight’s control… It wanted to dodge Beast God, who splashed it away again.

Ke Bi Knight clenched his teeth. “No wonder it’s a spiritual force weapon true treasure. It’s so powerful.”

“Hahaha! You can’t run away!” Ba Xiu Knight made a rumbling voice and started to stop Luo Feng.

Luo Feng turned around. The three universe knights from the Thorn Ring Alliance also started to approach Luo Feng from three different directions.

Five universe knights were encircling Luo Feng in the sky, and Luo Feng was like prey trying to flee. He manipulated his spiritual force weapon to resist his enemies.

Hong! Hong!

The power from the clash between two spiritual force weapons spread.

“Energy ripple?”

“Fight?”

“It must be a set treasure or a true treasure! Quick, go there!”

The ripple attracted the great beings in distance, and Luo Feng was still trying to run away like a frightened bird.

“Quick! Stop him!”

Ba Xiu Knight transmitted his voice. “Beings from Thorn Ring Alliance… We’ve already attracted attention! Although the knights from other races are still far away from us, the longer we spend here, the more likely those other races will arrive here following the energy ripples. We won’t be able to get anything if everyone’s here. How about we cooperate with each other?”

“Damn it.”

The three universe knights from Thorn Ring Alliance were all nervous, but Luo Feng was too swift. He was able to turn his direction and change his speed at will! And with that spiritual force true treasure weapon, the five failed to encircle him. Another reason for the delay was that the beings from the Thorn Ring Alliance and the Northern Territory Alliance were not cooperating.

The four-hoofed knight transmitted his voice. “Okay, let’s cooperate. Let’s kill Luo Feng together, and as for his true treasures, we’ll see how powerful we are.”

“Okay,” Ba Xiu Knight agreed.

They wouldn’t divide the true treasures equally. After all, they were from different alliances. It would be a joke if they believed in equal distribution.

The five universe knights officially formed an alliance. They started to block Luo Feng from different directions by encircling him. He now had less and less space to change direction! Besides, Ke Bi Knight and Ji Qi Knight had spiritual force weapons, which put Luo Feng in a worse situation.

Hong!

Suddenly, golden, tumbling waves showed up in the sky. They covered an area with a diameter of 19 million miles, enveloping those universe knights.

“It’s a domain!”

“It’s a domain type valuable… We can’t catch him anymore!” Ji Qi Knight shouted with haste.

“The resistance from the domain is not strong. It might only be a domain type treasure, not even a top-tier treasure.”

“Quick, catch him!”

All five universe knights were stunned by the endless waves, and Luo Feng took the chance to escape their encirclement. However, they quickly found out that the waves didn’t have strong resistance, and it wasn’t even a top-tier domain type treasure! If it were a domain type top-tier treasure, it would have been more valuable than an ordinary true treasure…

“The resistance is not strong.”

“Catch him!”

All five universe knights returned to outflanking Luo Feng. Although the resistance was not strong, it made it much easier for Luo Feng to dodge and stall for him.

“Hahaha… Look! It’s the human, Luo Feng.”

“It’s Luo Feng.”

“Quick!”

Three teams flew from different directions. It was difficult for them to see clearly what was going on in the waves, yet Luo Feng was the one who moved the fiercest and most quickly… Although everything in the waves appeared blurry to them, they could tell which shadow was Luo Feng through the true treasure wing and the beast god formed by spiritual force weapons.

“The human Luo Feng came here as well.”

“Look, it’s the Thorn Ring Alliance! Hahaha…! And Ba Xiu Knight from the Northern Territory Alliance! No wonder they’re trying to encircle him. It’s the human, Luo Feng!”

“Quick! Luo Feng has at least six true treasures! And one of them is a soul type true treasure.”

“Go!”

There were now a total of eight universe knights in three teams. They rushed into the golden waves.

In the waves from Nine Tiger River, Luo Feng was peaceful inside even though he appeared to be in a panic.

Another eight, he thought. From the Demon Alliance, the Nine Territories Alliance, and the Bug Race Alliance. Oh? There’s a universe overlord among them. Luo Feng nodded. 12 senior universe knights and one universe overlord. Time to reel them in!

Luo Feng finally manifested all his power.

Hong!

He burned his godly power infused in the Nine Tiger River. Gold law domain arrived at the same time, merging with the Nine Tiger River.

Hong! Long! Long!

The resistance within the golden waves became much fiercer and denser, as if it had transformed from harmless stream to strong glue! The resistance surged threefold, making it incredibly difficult for the 12 senior universe knights to fly.


Chapter 1077: It’s a Trap!

Nine Tiger River was vast and mighty as it hovered in the area, occupying an area that was tens of millions of miles wide. With Luo Feng’s godly power giving it the ultimate boost—especially now that Luo Feng was so highly accomplished in his techniques—merely the secret engraving sculpture of this Nine Tiger River posed no difficulty. He could easily decode the engravings to boost it to its limits.

Its mighty power had ridiculously strong pressure, combined with Luo Feng’s life gene level that was increased by 9,800 times and his godly power, which had been amplified 100 times. If Nine Tiger River were to undergo a complete boost with such conditions…

If the Nine Great Beasts within the Nine Tiger River were to join forces, they could easily annihilate a secondary universe knight. Even if they were to attack as separate entities, one was more than enough to seriously injure a secondary universe knight.

Falling into Nine Tiger River, even a senior universe knight would find it arduous to fly or move about!

“True treasure!”

“It’s a domain type true treasure!”

“That human form Luo Feng hid his true powers earlier on. He concealed the power of this domain type true treasure.”

Ji Qi Knight used voice transmission to communicate with Zhu Ka Knight who was nearby. The four-hoofed Zhu Ka Knight tried his best to make his way to Ji Qi Knight but found his speed of flight absurdly slow. He used voice transmission out of anxiety, saying, “Why did that human form Luo Feng hide the power of his domain type true treasure? If he released its power earlier on, he would have been able to escape from us easily. Yet, he didn’t! What is his motive?”

Ji Qi Knight and the four-hoofed being were flustered. The sudden surge in power of Nine Tiger River made them feel uneasy. They sensed something amiss!

“It’s a trap!”

“Yes, it must be a trap! We have to leave this domain quickly! Within this domain, the speed we are flying at is laughably slow. If a strong enemy appears, we will be defeated!”

“Hurry!”

“Hurry up!”

They were not confident, but taking risks on a place like the Original Star kept the knights of other races vigilant. Every single one had been blinded by their greed into a frenzy as soon as they saw Luo Feng; out of 13 knights of other races, there were some who were still reluctant to give up or still sought his treasures by seeking his human form. However, for most of them, now that they realized something was amiss, the immediate decision was to leave right away!

In the middle of Nine Tiger River, Luo Feng stood in silence with his wings outspread. He had a bird’s eye view of the entire Nine Tiger River and knew every move the 13 knights of other races made. “Starting to panic?” said Luo Feng. “Maintaining great vigilance. What a pity. You are too late.”

Luo Feng grasped the handle of his Cutting Pearl Sword from behind and lightly drew it out. The cold blade met with no obstructions within the waters of the Nine Tiger River. He was in total control because… this was Luo Feng’s territory.

Hong!

By his side, a golden horned beast that was black all over was also hovering in midair.

“Golden Horned Beast body shall stay on the outside to attack while I kill from the inside… Let no one escape.” Luo Feng gave his orders silently. “God Beast, transform!”

Hua! Hua!

Luo Feng and Golden Horned Beast transformed at the same time. Golden Horned Beast’s hooves and claws grew bigger and bulkier. Its head also changed. Other than its pair of wings, it looked just like a Golden Beast God. Luo Feng’s human form was also changing. His godly body grew slightly taller. Scales began to appear on his skin, and his eyes glowed with a faint tinge of gold. Although his godly power amplification had reached the limit of 100 times, under the transformation to a Beast God form… he was even more at ease as he carried out a slaughter… with the “heart of Beast God.”

“Kill! Let’s begin!”

Luo Feng made his move and swooped directly at the strongest one of the group trapped in Nine Tiger River a universe overlord known as “Para-chopper Knight.”

Para-chopper Knight was the calmest of the group trapped in Nine Tiger River. He was from the Bug Clan Alliance, but he was not originally from the bug clan. He did, however, enjoy a most respectable status because he wielded great power! He was skilled in close combat and was very powerful. Plus, his soul was naturally strong in defense. The only weakness he had was that his godly body was small; his height was a mere two and a half feet. That was why he was very particular about defending his godly body. The most valuable thing on him was none other than a suit of senior true treasure armor!

Once he sensed the great surge of power of Nine Tiger River, Para-chopper Knight understood what was going on instantly. “We have been tricked! It’s a trap! Human form Luo Feng was the bait, purposely used to attract our attention to get us to move nearer. His world ring must have universe overlords or equivalent life forms hiding away… The situation is unfavorable to us here! We have got to leave right away!”

Para-chopper Knight held onto a gigantic sword. He sliced through every obstruction in his way and flew off. His speed was the fastest!

“Huh?”

Para-chopper Knight frowned. He sensed that the other races were near. Although he had unsettling feelings, he was not afraid. He did not sense that there were universe masters hidden in Luo Feng’s world ring. And if there were no universe masters, common universe overlords did not pose a great threat to him.

“Within the human race, the most fearsome universe overlord, ‘Heaven Erosion Palace Leader,’ has since been spending his time hidden deep within the human race secret region. He rarely makes appearances. There is no news about Star Prison Devil Master’s intentions to enter the Original Star. So other than two or three of the most powerful ones, universe overlords from the human race are nothing to fear.”

Para-chopper Knight had just finished analyzing the situation when a golden light appeared before him. Its beauty was so enticing that it was soul-awakening… This golden light came from the blade that sliced through the water surface of Nine Tiger River.

Seemingly slowly and with an unrivalled gracefulness, the blade found its way to Para-chopper Knight. With widening eyes, Para-chopper Knight grew shocked and increasingly furious. He waved his huge sword with all his might, using his strongest skill—Arbitration of Fate!

Peng!

His huge sword was cast into the air, where it tumbled about in the golden river water. Icy cold, razor sharp pain erupted as the golden blade hacked right through Para-chopper Knight’s godly body.

“This… What swordsmanship is this?” he gasped, paralyzed with fear. “This is… This is more fearsome than any other universe overlord I have met in a long time!”

The swordsmanship was so beautiful that it was earth-shattering… It could certainly bring the limit of the path to a whole new level! A new limit of the law!

Peng!

The power of this one strike reached the limit of a senior true treasure armor straight away. Where the true treasure armor was supposed to weaken the impact of attacks to 1/10,000th of their power… this one strike was weakened merely to 1/1,000th!

In an instant, 62 percent of Para-chopper Knight’s godly body was consumed. Barely scraping through this strike, Para-chopper was scared out of his wits.

“Even with my senior true treasure, more than half of my godly body was consumed,” he said. “Not good!”

He had no doubt that the next strike would take his life for sure. This poignant golden light from that blade would once again appear before him!

“Quick, escape!” Para-chopper knight transmitted a shrill voice with his godly power!

Peng!

But under the glowing blade’s next strike, Para-chopper Knight’s petite godly body was annihilated in an instant, leaving behind an exquisite true treasure armor that emitted a faint purple light suspended in midair. As for the world ring and huge sword, they had been cast into the distance a moment before.

Two strikes to kill him, thought Luo Feng. Seems like with my ultimate technique of a universe master, those universe overlords with senior true treasure armors will still be able to put up a tough fight… And this time, it was just a small godly body. If his godly body had been as big as the Golden Horned Beast’s, no matter how many thousands or tens of thousands of strikes I make, I’m afraid I still wouldn’t have been able to kill him.

Luo Feng was quick to realize his weak points. His swordsmanship was already very strong, but it barely surpassed the limit of a senior true treasure armor. Senior true treasure armors would still able to provide his enemies with an extremely strong defense.

“Oh? Starting to panic?” said Luo Feng, looking around. “Let’s continue then.”

Luo Feng held his Cutting Pearl Sword, his pair of wings spread wide open to form an arc shape as he charged toward another senior universe knight, his next kill.

Yes, panic! Out of the 13 knights of other races trapped in Nine Tiger River, when the most powerful of them, Para-chopper Knight, knew he was never going to make it past the second strike, his shrill transmission made the rest of the knights crazy with worry.

“Hurry up and escape!”

“It’s a trap!”

“Even Para-chopper Knight cannot ward off his strikes! Quick, quickly escape!”

“Ah!”

“It’s a great beast… Ah!”

Piercing shrieks were transmitted throughout Nine Tiger River with godly power as the medium.

Hong!

The aftermath of the fight came in rumbling waves. Compared to Luo Feng’s cold, decisive, clean-cut swordsmanship, the Golden Horned Beast was wild with fury—simply unstoppable!

“Roar!”

In sync with the looming roars, the hideous black beast god, the armored Golden Horned Beast, lowered his head and charged forward at high speed. With one single collision, the longest horn on his head rammed hard into Ji Qi Knight’s body. Ji Qi’s eyes widened in fear, then—bam! His godly body was annihilated. With only a single top-tier treasure armor on him, there was simply no way he could put up any resistance against such an attack from Golden Horned Beast.

“It’s a trap!”

“That human form of Luo Feng is only bait! There is a strong universe overlord who is much stronger than Para-chopper Knight! He is after our lives, hurry…!”

“Hateful humans!”

Bitter and forlorn, sad and shrill, reluctant and begrudging, all sorts of roars rang out. Yet, with his Cutting Pearl Sword in hand, Luo Feng, who had been beast-deified, was cold-blooded as he roamed the sky above the golden river. His Cutting Pearl Sword cut through the universe knights one at a time. Under the poignant golden light of his blade, senior universe knights were annihilated one by one. Most of them were from other races that did not even have any ordinary true treasure armors; they did not have a shred of hope of warding off Luo Feng’s advances.

Luo Feng attacked from the inside out, but Golden Horned Beast worked in the opposite direction, attacking from the outside in. There was no way any of the universe knights of other races could escape. It was clear that these senior universe knights were moving at a snail’s pace in Nine Tiger River, and the only one who was able to fly at a high speed—Para-chopper Knight—had been the first to be exterminated. As for the remaining ones, all hope was lost.

The number of knights of other races trapped in Nine Tiger River was consistently dropping. Eight, six, three, two, one…

Outside the mighty Nine Tiger River, the battle had attracted the attention of knights of various races who were slightly further away. As many as six teams of universe knights were already observing the situation within Nine Tiger River from a distance. Among these six teams of knights, there was a total of 15 knights and one universe overlord.

“It’s a trap!”

“He’s just the bait!”

“Quickly escape!”

Shrill voices were transmitted via godly power. A multitude of voices were transmitted all over, and the six teams of 15 knights of other races watching from a distance could not help but shudder.

They watched on from afar. Their view was obscured by the massive river waters, so they could not clearly see what was going on. Yet, they could sense the happenings within Nine Tiger River. In the beginning, there had been a very strong sources of energy, followed by piercing screams and begrudging roars shouting, “Luo Feng is bait! It’s a trap! Universe overlord!”

But a fleeting moment later, silence prevailed.

All was dead silence.

At this point, the six teams of knights of other races, all hovering in midair while watching the entire episode from afar, felt a hair-raising horror. They knew… every one of the knights trapped in there had lost their lives.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

A lone figure appeared in the middle of the golden, flowing river. He carried his battle sword on his back with a pair of wings outspread, and he sported a head of black hair. He was scanning the six teams of knights from thousands of miles away. At that moment, none of the knights dared make a sound.


Chapter 1078: Top-Tier Universe Overlord

A gigantic wolf with silver hair was floating in the sky.

“How brave you are, Luo Feng,” it said. “You dared to use your own body as bait to attract universe knights to attack you. Then you let a universe overlord out to trigger the domain type true treasure to trap the knights of other races and slaughter them.”

He had a godly body of around six miles, and he was staring at Luo Feng who stood in the golden waves.

“Thank you for your compliment, Bi Fa Knight,” Luo Feng said, nodding good-naturedly.

Bi Fa Knight would be more difficult to deal with than Para-chopper Knight, whom he just killed. First of all, Bi Fa Knight was actually from the demon race, and he had more true treasures. Besides, Bi Fa Knight had a much larger godly body… It would take more time to kill him.

“Humph!” Bi Fa Knight growled in anger. “Which universe overlord was it? It must not be an ordinary universe overlord if he can kill Para-chopper Knight that easily. Which one? Heaven Erosion Palace Leader? World Tree? Star Prison Devil Master? Any one of you has a great reputation! I respect all of you, but shame on you for using this Luo Feng as bait to attract and slaughter us!”

As Bi Fa Knight’s voice resounded through space, Luo Feng couldn’t help smiling. Heaven Erosion Palace Leader, World Tree, and Star Prison Devil Master… Interesting guesses.

There were quite a few universe overlords within the human race, but most of them were at the ordinary level like Bi Fa Knight and Qi Blood Palace Leader, as humans were only ordinary life forms. World Tree, Star Prison Devil Master, and Heaven Erosion Palace Leader had unique experience and clone techniques, which was why they stood at the top among the universe overlords!

Under normal circumstances, the number of top-tier universe overlords was equal to that of universe masters within each alliance. There were more than ten universe masters within the human race, but there were only three top-tier universe overlords, and it was because humans were only ordinary life forms.

As for the Ancestral God School, which gathered a large number of special life forms, it had more top-tier universe overlords. Also, the Northern Territory Alliance had numerous races and quite a few top-tier universe overlords.

The universe knights of other races were secretly discussing things among themselves, felt that the entire situation was unfair.

“This is outrageous.”

“Such a demeaning thing to do. The human race is a pinnacle race, and it’s shameless of any of them to do such a thing. Those knights would have avoided universe overlords if they saw him, but nobody expected them to play such a move—using Luo Feng as bait!”

Though the universe knights of other races were furious, they all remained in the distance, as they could leave instantly.

“World Tree? Star Prison Devil Master?” The silver Bi Fa Knight was still shouting. “Heaven Erosion Palace Leader?” He seemed to be trying to force the mysterious being show himself.

“Bi Fa Knight, none of them is here,” Luo Feng said with a smile, stepping on the golden waves. “I’m the only one here.”

“Humph! Only you?” The silver wolf grinned.

The other 15 knights assembled all shook their heads. They had all heard the shrill scream of a strange beast, and it clearly came from a top-tier universe overlord who could fight in the shape of a beast.

“Which universe overlord is it? Show yourself!” the silver wolf shouted again.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The golden waves disappeared.

Luo Feng broke into laughter. “Bi Fa Knight, I’ve already told you. Only me.”

“You dare to do something shameless like this even after gaining your reputation!” said Bi Fa Knight. “Such a deceitful human.”

“Bi Fa Knight, do you want to die?” Luo Feng shouted.

Sou!

He dashed at Bi Fa Knight like a beam of silver light, and Bi Fa Knight quickly sped up and flew away. He knew that he needed to stay away from that human Luo Feng. Otherwise, he would be trapped in the domain if Luo Feng let out that domain type true treasure. He was as powerful as Para-chopper Knight.

“Go! Go!”

Other universe knights followed Bi Fa Knight and flew away.

Luo Feng stopped and looked at the universe knights of the other races running away in fright, and he chuckled. “I wanted to have an actual conversation with you guys. Since you’re not interested, I have to leave now.”

Sou!

He flew away and stopped chasing those knights.

“Humph!” Bi Fa Knight growled. “He dared to be so rampant and arrogant. He’s nothing if he doesn’t have that top-tier universe overlord with him! And he would’ve been ripped into pieces if he acted alone.”

It was shocking that 13 universe knights of other races had been killed by Luo Feng. After all, under normal circumstances, only one or two universe knights would be killed if a single ordinary true treasure was born. And only senior true treasures or even top-tier true treasures could lead to such a massive quantity of deaths.

Inside the towering palace of the Thorn Ring Alliance, Ji Qi Knight stood at the bottom of the palace with veneration. He was one of the universe knights who had been killed.

“Universe master.”

“Ji Qi,” said an indifferent voice. “You said that 13 universe knights were killed?”

And one of them was a universe overlord from the Bug race Alliance. I am the only one who has a clone technique, which is why I reported what I happened instantly. As for other alliances, they may not have gotten the news yet.”

“It’s a black, strange beast, and he’s terrifically powerful,” answered Ji Qi Knight. “He must be a great being following the path of gold beast god. Besides, that strange beast is a high achiever on the path of gold beast god, and his power is close to that of a beast god. I was killed instantly.”

“Beast god path? Is it Star Prison Devil Master? But he doesn’t follow the path of gold beast god.” The voice sounded confused.

“I’m certain that it was a black, strange beast,” Ji Qi Knight continued. “His attacking technique is mysterious and far superior to mine.”

“You think that black, strange beast could really kill Para-chopper Knight?”

“Yes, he can.” Ji Qi Knight nodded. “I won’t have been that helpless even if Para-chopper tried to kill me himself! However, I wasn’t even able to defend myself against that black, strange beast. I was killed after only one attack. I felt that the strange beast didn’t even utilize all his power. He could surely kill Para-chopper Knight if he wants.”

“Weird. When did the human race have a strange-beast knight?” The voice sounded baffled.

A being walked down. It was a female universe master wearing purple armor with hundreds of horns on her head. She looked seductive yet apathetic, which intimidated Ji Qi Knight. It was Piercing Heart Master from the Thorn Ring Alliance, who was in charge of many issues within the Thorn Ring Alliance. Her level of authority within the Thorn Ring Alliance was equivalent to Primal Chaos City Leader of the Hong Alliance.

“Strange,” Piercing Heart Master whispered. “Is it Luo Feng who’s on the path of gold beast god? That doesn’t make sense either, as Luo Feng’s still weak. Even if he becomes a universe knight, he still has low law comprehension, and he should be at the fourth or fifth level of the beast god path! He can’t even create the ultimate techniques of universe overlords with such low law comprehension.”

Ji Qi Knight nodded. “It’s definitely not Luo Feng! Whether he has become a universe knight or not, he doesn’t have such law comprehension.”

“That’s right. There’s no news from Redbud Island telling us that he received a beast god inheritance.” Piercing Heart Master frowned. “Could it be that Primal Chaos City Leader arranged a supreme being to protect his disciple?”

“There are hidden supreme beings within the human race?” Ji Qi Knight murmured.

Piercing Heart Master glanced at him. “No. There are only three top-tier universe overlords within the human race, but there are more in the Hong Alliance.”

Ji Qi Knight now understood. Though the Hong Alliance was an alliance centered around the human race, many great beings from other races were also members.

Ji Qi Knight couldn’t help asking, “Universe master, are you going to deal with them? A top-tier universe overlord used such a demeaning move to trap us. Top-tier universe overlords are almost as powerful as universe masters, and he was basically slaughtering us.”

“How?” Piercing Heart Master chuckled. “You claim it was he who slaughtered you? On the contrary, you encircled him because of greed and were slaughtered as a result. If a universe master or a top-tier universe overlord goes to the original stars and slaughters groups of great beings deliberately, it would lead to public outrage. However, nobody can say anything if you provoke them in the first place.

The news of the slaughter spread like wildfire, but none of the powers treated it seriously. To them, it was just a group of knights who had foolishly gotten themselves killed because of their greed.

Besides, no other powers knew who this top-tier universe overlord was, aside from the Thorn Ring Alliance. After all… The task of reviving senior universe masters would be distributed to a universe master.

Inside the Hong Alliance Palace.

Six palace leaders sat on the thrones, talking and laughing.

“Interesting…”

“Interesting, indeed. They wanted to kill Luo Feng, yet they all got killed.”

“Primal Chaos City Leader, you must have arranged this. Without your arrangement, what top-tier universe overlord would be willing to stay in Luo Feng’s world ring? Tell us, which universe overlord Is it? We haven’t figured that out yet.”

Primal Chaos City Leader was smiling, but he was also baffled. He didn’t know either!

Has Luo Feng become friends with a top-tier universe overlord…? Primal Chaos City Leader wondered.


Chapter 1079: Reputation Gained

In the sky of another original star floated churning golden rivers, and nine strange beasts were swimming and roaring in the water. Three universe knights from the Northern Territory Alliance transmitted their voices using their godly power.

“It’s a domain type true treasure!”

“Such strong resistance! I can’t imagine that Luo Feng would have such a true treasure! No wonder he’s a super-talent from a pinnacle race; he has a domain type true treasure even if he’s this weak.”

“It seems that we won’t be able to kill that human Luo Feng this time. Let’s go.”

“Let’s go.”

The three universe knights tried to break the resistance from the water and fly out, but they could only fly slowly. All of them started to curse Luo Feng, as he was only undying. He was powerful enough to kill Bark Mirror Emperor, but they all thought he was only as powerful as a secondary universe knight. However, he had a domain type true treasure! And together with the soul type true treasure that was confirmed, he had much better true treasures than many universe overlords.

“He wouldn’t have gotten away if it weren’t for his domain type true treasure.”

“Lucky him.”

Suddenly, a blurry, black beast showed up in the churning golden water, and the fierceness in his dark, golden eyes immediately terrified the nearest universe knight. He transmitted his voice hurriedly, “Careful!”

Hou!

The black, strange beast hit the universe knight’s chest like a beam of golden light, followed by an ancient, low growl.

Hong! Long!

The top-tier treasure armor on that universe knight was instantly shattered, and his godly body was annihilated. The black, strange beast started to charge the second universe knight. He barreled over him like a steamroller.

“It’s a trap! A trap!” The only universe knight who still survived opened his eyes wide and started to roar with his godly power. “That human Luo Feng is bait! He’s bait!”

Hua!

The blade slashed him across the back. The third universe knight attempted to resist the strange beast and felt his godly body quiver. After which, he felt nothing.

“It’s too late for you to realize your mistake,” said a voice.

The silver-armored, silver-winged form of Luo Feng stepped forward, holding Cutting Pearl Sword. He took a glance at the true treasure shatters, weapons, and world rings, and he seized all of them. He put his Cutting Pearl Sword back into his scabbard, and the Golden Horned Beast went back to his world ring.

“They don’t have the most updated news,” Luo Feng whispered. “Other powers in the universe don’t have the virtual universe for real-time information sharing. Especially powers like the Northern Territory Alliance and the Nine Territories Alliance that have many races… Especially that Northern Territory Alliance… It has so many races. A third of the universe knights I killed came from it.”

Luo Feng had only realized how many members were there in the Northern Territory Alliance after adventuring the original stars. More than 1,000 candidates came from the Hong Alliance on Redbud Island, but there were hundreds of thousands of them who were from Northern Territory Alliance!

“Some universe knights already know they need to avoid me. But some haven’t heard the news.”

Luo Feng took back the golden waves and flew into the distance like a beam of silver light. Nothing was left in the sky where Luo Feng had fought the universe knights. He took everything.

In the open-air bar of the Hong Alliance.

Luo Feng came here two or three times a week by using Remote Ocean body to connect to the virtual universe. He had been waiting for news of Tian Yang Knight. However, those 10,081 original stars were too large, and Tian Yang Knight was a universe overlord who always acted alone. He might hide somewhere for hundreds or even thousands of years. It would take time—and luck—to find him.

“Luo Feng.”

“Blade River.”

Many universe knights greeted him warmly, and even universe overlords who rarely showed up were polite to Luo Feng. After all, he had a terrific record during his year spent on the Original Star, and the great beings in Hong Alliance all knew about it.

Quite a few universe knights and universe overlords had died because of him. Although they all believed that it was actually a top-tier universe overlord who had conducted the killings, it still showed Luo Feng’s status; a top-tier universe overlord was willing to stay in Luo Feng’s world ring! It would be a pleasure to all the great beings to be friends of a top-tier universe overlord.

Even universe masters valued top-tier universe overlords because they were almost as powerful as universe masters and could be resurrected. As for universe masters, they would stay dead forever if they fell! That made top-tier universe masters special.

“Luo Feng,” said a familiar voice.

Luo Feng turned his head and saw two great beings sitting in the corner. There were no other great beings beside them.

“Gui Yi Knight? Undying Knight?” Luo Feng was startled. He now understood why there were no other great beings around them, as they each had an extraordinary status. Gui Yi Knight was a disciple highly valued by Primal Chaos City Leader, and Undying Knight was a disciple of Gigantic Axe Founder.

Luo Feng walked toward them, grinning. Gui Yi Knight had a bald head and wore a fiery cape and was barefoot. It made one feel tranquil just to look at him, but Luo Feng, who had been through practice for 180 million years, had already significantly improved his willpower and could rival some universe masters. He wasn’t affected by it at all.

Undying Knight had met Luo Feng only once before, and it had been through the virtual universe. Undying Knight wore peculiar armor with tens of thousands of vines on it, and his face was covered by some of the vines. There was wickedness in his green eyes. Luo Feng had been defeated the first time they because he was still weak.

Both Undying Knight and Gui Yi Knight were universe overlords. Previously, Luo Feng and True Yan Emperor had thought of them as untouchable, but Luo Feng could now see their power clearly. Gui Yi Knight was an ordinary universe overlord with greater true treasures, and he was proficient in illusion and close combat. As for Undying Knight, he had a great reputation. His fighting power was also at the level of an ordinary universe overlord, but he had incredible surviving skills; no one had managed to kill him yet, which was why he had the title of “Undying.”

“Brother,” Luo Feng walked toward him and smiled. “Undying Knight.”

Gui Yi Knight smiled. “Sit.”

“You’ve grown so quickly,” Undying Knight said. He had a squeaky and bizarre voice, but Luo Feng was prepared for it, as he had spoken with him before. “You were still weak when I first met you and far from becoming undying. A single look from me could affect you. However, you are already able to shake that off. You’re indeed exceptional. I heard that dozens of universe knights were killed because of you. Incredible.”

“Luo Feng,” said Gui Yi Knight, “both Undying Knight and I are wondering how many universe knights and universe overlords died because of your friend.”

“Not that many.” Luo Feng smiled. “82 universe knights and five universe overlords.”

Both Gui Yi Knight and Undying Knight looked stunned, as they were just as powerful as the universe overlords who had been killed. Of course, they had solid backgrounds and better true treasures, which gave them better surviving skills. Regardless, they still found it unbelievable.

“At the start, those universe knights from other races tried to gang up on me because of their greed,” said Luo Feng, “but they were the ones who got killed in the end. In the first 15 days, many others got killed, too. However, as more and more learn about it, and have started to avoid me. It’s been three months, and I’ve only met one unlucky guy.”

The news was spreading more and more quickly, becoming increasingly widespread. Some universe knights of great fame were falling, which bolstered Luo Feng’s reputation. Even some universe overlords of other races would now avoid Luo Feng.

“Who’s your friend?” Gui Yi Knight asked with a smile. “Can you tell us?”

Luo Feng smiled. “He’s Luo Feng.”

“Stop joking around.” Gui Yi Knight smiled widely. “If you can’t tell us, just don’t.”

Luo Feng was secretly amazing. It seemed nobody believed that it was him who had done all the killings! After all, in the eyes of those great beings, even if he became a universe knight and could complete law comprehension quickly, it would still normally take someone hundreds of millions of years to advance from the fourth-level beast god inheritance to the seven-level. It had only been 20,000 years. He should have been at a low level in techniques—at least, from those great beings’ perspective. He had a powerful godly body, but he was far inferior to top-tier universe overlords like World Tree, Purple Rain Knight, and Heavenly Erosion Palace Leader.

“If you really want to know his name… he is Golden Mountain Knight,” answered Luo Feng.

“Golden Mountain Knight?” said Gui Yi Knight.

Gui Yi Knight and Undying Knight exchanged eye contact. Both were clearly confused. They hadn’t heard of that name.

“Are you joking?” Undying Knight asked.

“Of course not. You’ll know soon.” Luo Feng smiled.

“Is he from another race?” Gui Yi Knight asked.

Luo Feng nodded. “Kind of.”

At the same time, Luo Feng noticed a being who kept looking at him. It was Kuang Zhou Knight.

“Brother, Undying Knight, I’m going to meet my friend.” Luo Feng stood up and walked towards Kuang Zhou Knight.

When they met, Kuang Zhou Knight immediately isolated them from the surroundings and said, “Blade River, I’ve found Tian Yang Knight.”

Tian Yang Knight…

Luo Feng was thrilled. His eyes gleamed.


Chapter 1080: The Runaway Tian Yang Knight

Luo Feng tried his best to control his emotions as he asked immediately, “Where?”

Kuang Zhou Knight told him every single detail he knew, including which original star Tian Yang Knight was on and its coordinates.

“Thank you,” Luo Feng said. He was exceedingly grateful.

“A small matter,” Kuang Zhou Knight said, then asked out of curiosity, “Why are you so concerned about Tian Yang Knight? Is there bad blood between you two? He is a universe overlord…”

“A favor for a friend,” Luo Feng replied with a single sentence.

“Oh,” Kuang Zhou Knight said and nodded, content with this reason.

In the sky of the Original Star, Luo Feng, who had transformed into a beam of light, flew forward. Without warning, he drew an arc with his wings in the air and changed his course to another direction.

I have waited for so many years, he thought. I sought the fourth black metal board to increase my power just for this very day!

With his silver armor and wings, Luo Feng waited with eyes filled with anticipation. The strong beckoning of the Shi Wu Wings was unforgettable. He believed that once Shi Wu Wings and Black Wings were combined, there would be qualitative changes.

Everyone knew that the strength of a true treasure was what determined the ease of finding it. In the course of just under a year, Luo Feng had killed 82 senior universe knights and five universe overlords. However, from the 82 senior universe knights, he only managed to obtain a total of six ordinary true treasures; from the five universe overlords, he only managed to obtain 18 ordinary true treasures and four senior true treasures (ordinary true treasure series could be considered equivalent to senior true treasures). Even if he were to add in the several treasures in their world rings, the total value, upon calculation, would only be 60 to 70 true treasure points.

This was still insufficient to exchange for a top-tier true treasure! And universe masters were all eyeing the top-tier true treasures greedily.

Under normal circumstances, only universe masters would be armed with top-tier true treasure weapons! As for pinnacle true treasures like Force Armor, these might as well be once-in-a-lifetime opportunities, where even someone like True Yan Emperor would have difficulty obtaining them.

I have killed five universe overlords, although they were killed because they attacked me out of greed. But now that the news is widespread, it will be impossible to shun universe overlords, who are always well-informed. I am considered quite wealthy among all the universe overlords, but a top-tier true treasure… I am still a little far from it. Once I have the other pair of wings, however… And once they are combined…

Luo Feng’s anticipation surged. A single acquisition would far surpass close to a year’s worth of killing.

Sou!

Luo Feng sped toward the path of a whirlpool leading to Original Star Number 02881.

In Original Star Number 02881.

“I think a universe knight from the Hong Alliance has just discovered my location,” said a voice.

A bald man with eight arms—a great being from the automaton clan —suddenly emerged from nestled within the bed of weeds. Tian Yang Knight’s godly body was armed with unique technological weapons. For instance, his head was able to turn 360 degrees, providing a high degree of alertness.

“For now, my whereabouts cannot be divulged,” he said. “Just in case, I had better leave here as soon as possible.”

Tian Yang Knight’s eyes revealed a cold glimmer, and with a great shrug of his black wings, he sped up and soared into the sky.

As darkness fell, Golden Horned Beast hovered high in the night sky, surveying the surroundings.

“This is it. Based on the tip-off Kuang Zhou Knight provided, it should be this area.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng scanned the land below. His original earthling body had become so famous that even universe overlords would make a detour if they ran into him, so in order to ensure that Tian Yang Knight would not catch wind of his arrival and have the chance to escape, Luo Feng had rushed over in his Golden Horned Beast body. Also, his Golden Horned Beast body did not make use of Shi Wu Wings. This way… Tian Yang Knight would have no means of knowing that he had arrived.

“Not here…! He’s not here?”

Golden Horned Luo Feng was slightly confused. He had carefully perused the deserted plains filled with weeds. The weeds were very tall. If he did not look carefully, he might not be able to find a great being hiding there.

Hong! Long!

A vast sea of golden waves spread out in an instant, enveloping everything it touched, permeating every inch of the bed of weeds. Without using godly power or domain to search, just by using the naked eye alone, one would not be able to discover any trace of him.

Chapter 1081: Why is it Dark?

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was a supreme being in the Thorn Ring Alliance, and he was one of the top-tier universe overlords. He was a supreme being who could rival the most powerful World Tree. Chapter 1082: The Wings Were a True Treasure

The miniature universe was vast and mighty, too, with a diameter of 19 million miles. Chaotic airflow spread and filled the entire miniature universe. It was a picture of chaos.

Golden Horned Beast was stationed in the middle of the miniature universe, and its godly body supplied the energy required by the miniature universe to revolve.

Something strange is going on, thought Luo Feng. There is another presence here. A knight of another other race… it’s Evil Fog Knight from the Thorn Ring Alliance. He is extremely skilled in illusions. He seems to be still looking around at his surroundings, unaware of the situation he is in.

The moment Golden Horned Beast successfully brought out the miniature universe, it sensed that there was an additional knight of another race present within the boundaries of the miniature universe. Unquestionably, this unlucky fellow who was about to become a victim.

Luo Feng had shrunk the miniature universe on purpose. The miniature universe was able to reach a diameter as big as 600 million miles but could also shrink to a diameter as small as six million miles! If its diameter shrank, its universe membrane would gradually thicken; if its diameter expanded, the membrane would gradually thin down. This was the fundamental theory of why Luo Feng maintained the same amount of godly power supply to the miniature universe. If he increased the amount of godly power supply, the universe membrane would naturally become thicker, and its power would grow stronger.

With a smaller diameter of merely 19 million miles, a being of another race could still enter.

“Seems to me he must have seen it all,” Luo Feng said to himself.

Indeed, Evil Fog Knight had been observing for a long time from a long distance away. He had witnessed the fight between Golden Horned Beast and Tian Yang Knight at the border of their respective domain type true treasures, and he clearly saw that it was the Golden Horned Beast who was hunting down Tian Yang Knight by watching the two enter the space whirlpool one after the other. Based on this information, Luo Feng easily came up with some quick inferences.

You can consider yourself to be unlucky.

Luo Feng’s thought flashed through his mind in a split second— maybe not even 1/10,000th of a second—and the next moment, Golden Horned Beast rushed at Tian Yang Knight.

“This… What place is this?” said Tian Yang Knight. He looked at his surroundings with fear. There was an endless chaotic airflow all around him. “Is it Universe Ocean? No, I was on the Original Star. How would I suddenly fall into this place? Could this be a domain type true treasure? He already owns a domain type true treasure, so how could he be using another domain type true treasure?”

Hong!

Waves of the golden river came surging from afar. From the front of the golden river, a stampede of nine great beasts was seen rushing to the fore, and behind them was the Golden Horned Beast.

“Have to block it!” said Tian Yang Knight.

His eyes were filled with crazed panic. He wanted to block the vast darkness, but it useless. It was like a giant truck rolling over a small car. With the universe laws empowering the entire miniature universe, the power of the golden river soared by one level in an instant. And Tian Yang Knight’s domain type true treasure was, in turn, suppressed by the universe laws of the miniature universe. Thus, its power was lowered by one level.

This come-and-go cycle brought about a vast difference between the two domain type true treasures, which were actually not so different from each other at the start.

Peng! Peng! Peng!

Like cracking icebergs, the vast blackness was easily shattered. It was unable to protect Tian Yang Knight at all.

“What?” Tian Yang Knight was shocked. “I must escape!”

Tian Yang Knight turned and attempted to make a speedy escape. However, the moment the mighty golden waves collided with the darkness, Tian Yang Knight was shrouded by the golden waves. After Nine Tiger River increased its power by one level, flying within its domain would be extremely difficult even for someone like Tian Yang Knight. At that moment, Golden Horned Beast managed to close the distance and appeared before Tian Yang Knight.

“Golden Horned Beast!” Tian Yang Knight roared with rage as he waved the light shuttles his eight arms were holding.

“It’s useless,” Golden Horned Beast growled.

Golden rays lit up once again. Under these sharp and unsympathetic golden rays, the eight black light shuttles that looked so beautiful were cast away like paper. Tian Yang Knight’s godly body seemed so helpless in the face of the long, sharp horns of Golden Horned Beast.

Following the fearsome impact of the collision between both knight and beast, the entire space shook with tremors. With eyes still filled with unwillingness to resign to his fate, Tian Yang Knight’s godly body was annihilated, and he wordlessly vanished into thin air.

Pity, Luo Feng reflected silently. The moment I use the ultimate technique of a universe master, I will not be able to reduce his power accurately. If I could grasp a better control of accuracy, I might have been able to put Tian Yang Knight into a deep slumber.

The stronger the great being, the more difficult it was to put it into a deep slumber. Normally, when the godly bodies of undying emperors were consumed to slightly more than 10 percent remaining, they would need to go into a deep slumber. However, the willpower of universe overlords was incomparably strong; their godly powers were much purer, so even if they were left with only 5 percent or even 3 percent of their godly bodies, they might still be able to maintain a clear consciousness for a split second to self-destruct their remaining godly bodies… Most would avoid fighting a universe overlord until only 1 percent of its godly body was left before it could be put to a deep slumber.

But this was much too difficult in a battle of life and death. It was tough to use all the ultimate techniques to put up a good fight, yet without the confidence to fight an opponent till its godly body was left with exactly 1 percent—especially when the opponent was a great being with a horribly fearsome consciousness… A universe master, even when his godly body was down to 1 percent, was able to maintain a moment of consciousness. Such universe masters would rather self-destruct than risk subjecting themselves to a lifetime of slavery.

The more powerful a being was, the more difficult it would be to enslave it. The only way to have a strong slave was to enslave it during its weak periods. Then, when the being grew in power, they would naturally find themselves with stronger slaves.

Hong!

Under the impact of the collision, Tian Yang Knight’s black armor, silver wings, weapons, world ring, and some other valuable items scattered in all directions…

All come here, commanded Luo Feng.

With a single thought, everything within the control of the miniature universe that had once belonged to the annihilated Tian Yang Knight was speedily manipulated and flew right up to Golden Horned Beast. Upon infusing his godly power… the items quickly started to recognize their new master, one after the other. This led Luo Feng to realize that Tian Yang Knight certainly did not have the talent of dividing bodies.

“Keep!” Luo Feng stored every item in his World Ring right away.

Then he turned and looked off into the distance. About six million miles away a black, misty figure stood surveying its surroundings with due diligence.
