Hong! Long! Long!

A great volume of chaotic airflow rolled over the black, misty figure in a frenzied manner. The airflow seemed to separate into two parts. One part revolved in a clockwise direction while the other revolved counterclockwise—just like a gigantic grinder. And right in the middle, was the black, misty figure.

“Universe grinder, roll and crush!” Luo Feng commanded in a cold demeanor.

The miniature universe was the most powerful talent technique, more powerful than Golden Light, which he had created by one whole level. It consisted of many different tactics. For example, there were normal ones like the “Suppression by Universe Laws” and “Rolling and Crushing by Universe Grinder.” Plus, there were also ultimate tactics that were the most powerful ones, like “Explosion of Universe.”

The ordinary tactics were not considered powerful. For instance, using the tactic Rolling and Crushing by Universe Grinder would not have been enough to kill Tian Yang Knight. However, to a senior universe knight who did not have a single ordinary true treasure armor to speak of, using the Universe Grinder with a power level that was one notch higher than that of Nine Tiger River—let alone the power of a miniature universe—would be more than enough to grind him to death.

Evil Fog Knight was surveying his surroundings carefully when suddenly, he felt an upheaval between heaven and earth, and the two great airflows seemed to enshroud him. Like a grinder moving in opposite directions, the airflow closed in around him, rolling and crushing his body in a frenzied manner.

“Ah! Ah! Ah!” Evil Fog Knight screamed in pain. The rolling and crushing consumed his godly body quickly—from 90 percent to 70 percent and then to 50 percent… The loss was happening at an alarming rate.

“Let me go! I bear no enmity!” Evil Fog Knight was so fearful that he shouted repeatedly. “Let me go!”

But there was no stopping it in this vast, chaotic world. Evil Fog Knight was in despair, and could only bear hatred in his heart. He had not expected to meet his end by obeying Fan Nuo Fortress Master’s command.

“Ah! Ah! Ah!” Evil Fog Knight roared. “Damn it!”

With only 30 percent of his godly body left, Evil Fog Knight roared his reluctance but decided to choose self-destruction.

Hong! Long! Long!

Hong! Long!

The miniature universe was put away and disappeared in the blink of the eye. Peace returned between heaven and earth. Hovering in midair, only the Golden Horned Beast remained. All valuables left behind by Tian Yang Knight and Evil Fog Knight after they were annihilated had been claimed.

“I had not expected to lose almost 10 percent of my godly body in such a short fight,” Luo Feng mused to himself.

Opening his miniature universe and charging at Tian Yang Knight had taken nearly three seconds. Killing Tian Yang Knight and taking away his treasures had not taken him more than two seconds. Using the Universe Grinder to roll and crush Evil Fog Knight, however, had taken close to three seconds. Collecting all the treasures also used up almost a second. All in all, it had taken close to nine seconds.

“Go!” Golden Horned Beast spread its wings, shot up into the sky at high speed, and departed.

Luo Feng spent almost a day’s worth of traveling before he finally made it out the original star, and shortly after, he made it back to his god country.

In his god country, the vast place was expanding gradually and continuously. Similarly, the limitless Remote Ocean was also growing bigger every minute.

“In nearly 20,000 years, my Remote Ocean has grown quite a bit.” Donning his suit of silver armor, Luo Feng looked down at everything with a smile. “True treasures!” He commanded with a wave.

The next moment, many true treasures started emerging in midair, one after the other. Many of these hanging in midair were loot he had gained from his victories on the original stars in the past year. The majority were merely ordinary true treasures, and the number of senior true treasures were extremely few. However, killing Tian Yang Knight had been quite rewarding. Other than what he really sought—the pair of wings that was a true treasure—the others that he collected included an ordinary true treasure series (the eight shuttles), a senior true treasure armor, and an ordinary domain type true treasure. Tian Yang Knight certainly did live up to his identity as a knight of the automaton clan.

“This pair of wings is the most important true treasure I have gained,” Luo Feng whispered as he held the pair of wings.

Originally, he had thought that the true treasure was a pair of black wings. However, following the death of Tian Yang Knight, the wings returned to their original color, which was silver—the exact same color as his Shi Wu Wings.

The true treasure pair of wings shook gently as Luo Feng held it, as though it was trying to break free from his grasp and fly away.

“Roar!” Golden Horned Beast was approaching from afar. At the same time, a beautiful pair of silver wings detached itself from him.

“Go.”

Luo Feng let go of the wings.

Instantly, the true treasure pair of wings flew away and approached the Shi Wu Wings, which were also drawing close at high speed. The moment the two pairs of silver wings, equally beautiful, touched…

Ka! Ka! Ka!

The feathers on the wings, which were sharp as blades, started bouncing at high speed. The bottom sections of both pairs of wings sported silver rays of light that were flashing quickly. The two pairs of wings, both true treasures, were under a continuous integration process.

Qualitative changes started to emerge. A gargantuan burst of power was released and spread through the surroundings. The burst of power given out at that moment was the real deal!

This combination was the moment when this mysterious true treasure made an appearance in its truest form.

“So strong… Such awesome power!” marveled Luo Feng, suspended in midair.

He felt dumbfounded by it, yet at the same time, he was increasingly anticipating the result. His emotions were running high.


Chapter 1083: Change in the Wing

The two true treasure wings started to merge with each other like two incredibly delicate instruments, and the engravings on the true treasures formed a larger and more mysterious engraving. The energy permeated… It felt like a long time to watch the scene, but it actually only took less than a minute.

Then everything went back to normal.

The giant Silver Wing was still open in the stillness, and it was mesmerizing. Unlike the other seemingly plain true treasures Luo Feng had, it was as if it were actively showcasing its beauty.

“Four wings?” Luo Feng looked at the Silver-Winged true treasure. The two sets of wings had connected to produce four wings. “Come, Shi Wu Wing, let me feel your power.”

He still called it “Shi Wu,” but the Silver Wing flew toward Luo Feng and merged with him. Luo Feng immediately opened the Silver Wing, which continued emanating endless power. The wing opened, resulting in changes in the space and time around it.

“Space and time?” said Luo Feng. “The engravings on the true treasure wing I got from Tian Yang Knight were of time law, and my original Shi Wu Wings had engravings of time law. Combined, they can affect the space and time around them.”

Luo Feng felt the wings on his back trembling. He kept infusing the wings with his godly power so that he could carefully study the engraving on it. Though he had never studied time law before, he was still studying into the time-law engravings on the Wing. After only half an hour of studying, he grasped the elementary power of the new Wing.

Hu!

Hu!

All four wings on Luo Feng’s back started to move swiftly.

Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou!

Xiu!

The dark turquoise fortress flew toward Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress while he flew toward the fortress as well. He stopped caring about the human Luo Feng as he knew that if the Golden Horned Beast got close to him, he would be in deep trouble.

“Want to flee?” Luo Feng shook his wings, and the space and time were in complete disorder. Shadows of Luo Feng showed up around Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress.

“What?” Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was terrified, and he immediately cursed the one who had given him the information. He had heard that Luo Feng was following the Beast God Path, but the Luo Feng in front of him already had exceptional control over the space and time. Even if Luo Feng was using his true treasure, he needed adequately thorough comprehension. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress didn’t know about the engraving-picture path.

“Go away!” Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress growled and lashed at Luo Feng.

A cold and sharp golden light shone! It was irresistible!

Peng!

The lash was bent, and Cutting-Pearl Blade hit the head of Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. The armor withstood the attack, but Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress fell because of it.

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress looked up at Luo Feng, terrified. “Impossible!”

How was it possible that Luo Feng could be this powerful? That blade technique! The blade technique Luo Feng had just used was the same as the one the Golden Horned Beast used… Was it possible that the peerless genius Luo Feng’s soul was already transferred to the Golden Horned Beast? That was why the human Luo Feng was able to wield the incredible technique the Golden Horned Beast used.

Of course, realized Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. Luo Feng had extraordinary potential, and many supreme beings craved to enslave him—to make him a body for themselves. However, the human race must have given him strict protection. How did the Golden Horned Beast take his soul? This is incredible.

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress tried to flee.

Hua!

Luo Feng moved his wings, and his acceleration reached a new level through the top-tier true treasure Shi Wu Wings. Several shadows immediately blocked Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress.

“You can’t run away,” said Luo Feng, and he attacked with his blade again.

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress tried to use his whip to resist it, but he bounced away again. He wasn’t able to escape Luo Feng in a short time, and he had to trigger the flying fortress to save him! Although the fortress was flying toward him, the Golden Horned Beast was flying at him as well. However, the fortress was apparently faster than the Golden Horned Beast.

“Scram, human!”

Giant vines spread from the fortress.

“Humph!” Luo Feng snorted, and the wings on his back immediately grew larger. They became almost 60 miles wide. “Break!”

The wings were like blades, and Luo Feng was like the handle. The blades slashed through the vines like a knife through butter.

“Damn it!” Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress shouted, growing anxious. He growled.

Hong! Long!

All the vines went back to the flying fortress, and at the same time, the fortress hit the giant set of Shi Wu Wings on Luo Feng’s back. Luo Feng trembled.

The moment the fortress hit Shi Wu Wing, countless vines spread out from the fortress. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress touched a vine, and his godly whip, true treasure armor, and other valuables all went into the godly body of Blossoming Snow Vine. As for his original body, it was annihilated. All the vines went back to the palace, and it started to fly away.

Hou!

The Golden Horned Beast ran through the space. The longest horn on his head hit the flying fortress, which bounced away. The flying fortress then sped up and tried to flee like a beam of light.

Above the ocean on an original star flew a flying fortress, and a giant man walked out of the fortress. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress still felt terrified.

“What a powerful Golden Horned Beast! He robbed the human Luo Feng’s soul! And he’s so mighty! Although they used the same technique, that Golden Horned Beast is apparently more skilled! It must have an incredible attack type true treasure!”

The more he thought about it, the more shocked he became.

“That Golden Horned Beast is a handful.”

Luo Feng was also recalling that fight.

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress has a life gene level of 1,000 times, which is inferior to that of the World Tree, he thought. Besides, the inherited technique “Control over Space and Time” the World Tree has is more helpful for fighting, while the inherited technique Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress has is two more bodies.

He concluded that Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was slightly weaker than the World Tree.

Luo Feng’s godly power was weaker than that of Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress, yet his technique was much more powerful! He must have been at the same level as the World Tree, which was why he could suppress Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress!

However, I could only suppress him, not defeat him. I’m only slightly more powerful than him, and his weapon weakened my attack to a large extent. I only injured him a little bit when it hit his godly body.

Luo Feng understood that because the Golden Horned Beast had a top-tier set true treasure Beast God Armor, even Blossoming Snow Vine—which was over 600,000 miles long—could only run.

That was all he could do, even though he had a flying fortress as well. His fortress was like a turtle shell, strong enough to withstand an attack from a universe master. Even his technique “I Am the Universe” might not have been able to injure the godly body hidden inside the flying fortress.

The more powerful it gets, the more difficult it is to kill, Luo Feng thought. However, it’s so weird this time. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress wants my metal? And he’s willing to fight me for it? The metal might be as valuable as a true treasure.

The Northern Territory Alliance.

Inside the towering palaces surrounded by black fire lived numerous undying servants and universe knights. The palaces in the Northern Territory Alliance all had undying servants and universe knights, and all were looking at the main palace in the center with humble veneration. At the periphery of the palace was endless light. That was where Star River Master lived.

Star River Master was a revered being in the universe and was equally as renowned as Primal Chaos City Leader! The powers in the universe respected Star River Master even more than Primal Chaos City Leader!

Inside the main palace, a shadow that looked like a black hole sat on the throne. All the light that touched it was swallowed by the shadow.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The space and time in the palace were being reversed. The scenes kept turning back. Group after group of universe knights came here to see Star River Master, and some other great beings also met Star River Master here. Even supreme universe masters had come here before.

“Stop!”

Suddenly, two universe knights who had come here were frozen in place, in the middle of giving salutations. Time kept being reversed, and the scene kept changing, but the two shadows remained frozen.

“Stop! Stop! Stop!”

One shadow after another was fixed. They were universe knights of all kinds. Soon, 39 universe knights stood there still like sculptures.

“Time, go back.”

The time that was being reversed went back. The backlash from operation law was transferred to the emptiness of the black hole on the throne. It shivered and tried to recover. It was clearly a burden for him to resurrect 39 senior universe knights.

After a while, everything went back normal. All 39 universe knights regained consciousness. They looked at each other in shock, and their memories flooded back to them.

“Thank you, Star River Master,” they said. All of them saluted.

A voice came from Star River Master. “22 or 23 of you died because of that human Luo Feng. Answer me! Who is his helper?”

“It’s a black Golden Horned Beast.”

“A strange beast that looks like a Golden Horned Beast but has six horns, and one of them is extremely long.”

“A black, strange beast.”

They all answered one by one. However, a squeaky voice spoke up and said, “Were all of you killed by the black, strange beast? Am I the only one who got killed by the human Luo Feng?”

“Killed by Luo Feng?” someone called out. “Do you even know of his power? Are you kidding me?”

“What a joke,” another knight said. But soon, three more universe knights spoke up.

“I was killed by Luo Feng too,” someone said.

“Me too.”

“I thought I had an illusion, but I was killed by Luo Feng too.”

The palace went silent. It was possible that one senior universe knight was mistaken, but all were terrified when four senior universe knights said the same thing.

Inside the Primal Chaos City.

Luo Feng walked into the Primal Chaos City Leader’s palace, and all the guards greeted him respectfully.

“Master.”

“Master.”

Luo Feng nodded and walked to the side palace where the beings of the race contributed their true treasures. That Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress interested Luo Feng. So did the Evil Fog Knight, who had been killed by his technique “I Am the Universe.”

Both Evil Fog Knight and Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress come from Thorn Ring Alliance, thought Luo Feng. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress knows of my Golden Horned Beast, and he wants my metal.

Luo Feng speculated that there might be some unknown valuables in his metal, which was why he had temporarily left the original stars and came back to his god country, bringing with him the metal he couldn’t identify. He had brought it to Primal Chaos City to identify it.

“What is it?” Luo Feng was confused. He arrived at the side palace.

Hong! Long! Long!

The bronze door opened, and Luo Feng walked in.


Chapter 1087: The Disambiguation Temple

The quiet and ancient temple hall was very spacious. Only the stone plate in the middle was conspicuous. This was the location where one could place items, and the virtual universe system would conduct an examination and arrive at a verdict regarding their value. This was the only place that Luo Feng could think of to easily identify a piece of an unnamed valuable.

“Previously, based on what my access rights allowed,” Luo Feng said to himself, “I made use of the virtual universe network to make comparisons with the metals that I couldn’t identify. Now, I could confirm almost every unknown metal. Although some of them are rare, it was better than seeing Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress beat his brains out trying to figure out the metals. Now, I’m down to the last three types.”

Purely through his own investigative work on the network, he was now left with only three types of metal that could not be identified. Based on his conjecture, there were valuables to be found from within.

Luo Feng flipped his hand, and a green crystal stone the size of a sesame seed appeared in the middle of his palm. He gently placed it on the stone plate.

Weng!

Green threads started rising from the middle of the stone plate in a winding path to envelop the green crystal stone. Then the stone plate started to process the stone meticulously. A short while later, a voice rang out an analysis.

“Metal. ‘Wood in research crystals.’ One piece. If given to race as a contribution, one can receive 18 treasure points. Luo Feng, are you willing to contribute this treasure to your race?”

“Oh? It is truly a treasure.” Luo Feng’s expression revealed a trace of surprise. “No wonder I couldn’t find any information on this metal with my access rights on the network. Just this little stone that is the size of a sesame seed is worth 18 treasure points. It seems the universe overlords and knights that I have killed did indeed have quite a fair number of valuables hidden among their possessions. However, only 18 treasure points… That’s not even worth one fight against Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress.”

Luo Feng shook his head and dismissed this piece of treasure. With one hand outstretched, the crystal stone that was the size of a sesame seed flew back to rest on his palm and was immediately stored back in his world ring.

Then, with another flip, another piece of metal appeared in his palm. This black metal was around the size of a human head, and its surface was divided into a total of 360 facets. The facet was smooth and shiny beyond comparison, to the extent that they were as reflective as mirrors. This was another one of the three great metals Luo Feng failed to identify.

“Go.”

The black metal floated off his palm and made its way over to the stone plate. Countless green threads rose up in a winding path again to envelop this piece of black metal stone…

“Huh?” Luo Feng frowned. “Why is this taking such a long time?”

It had never taken this long before, even when he brought his true treasure to be examined.

Eventually, the gentle voice sounded again. This time, it resonated throughout the entire hall, creating an echo. “‘Disambiguation Mirror Stone.’ An item belonging to the Disambiguation Temple. If contributed to the race, one could earn 20 true treasure points. Luo Feng, are you willing to contribute this treasure to your race?”

Luo Feng’s eyes lit up! 20 true treasure points? That was even more expensive than Nine Tiger River!

“This is it!”

Luo Feng looked at the Disambiguation Mirror Stone with amazement. At the same time, he summoned it back to his palm very quickly by stretching out his hand. With sparkling eyes, he stared at the Disambiguation Mirror Stone.

“No wonder… No wonder Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was willing to go to any means to obtain it. He initiated a fair trade of metals on purpose. Such a bully. He must be taking advantage of the fact that I was unaware of the wonders of this Disambiguation Mirror Stone.”

Luo Feng felt adrenaline coursing through his veins. Although it had been close to 20,000 years since he had first entered an original star, during this period, Luo Feng’s consciousness occasionally entered the virtual universe, so the major events on the original stars were nothing novel to him. Undoubtedly, he knew them all.

For close to 20,000 years, on the 10,081 original stars, if there was one such event that was most shockingly soul-stirring, it was none other than the tumult in the Disambiguation Temple.

This occurrence had driven the races of the universe into a frenzy. In the first 600 years after the paths to the original stars appeared, various universe laws befell Original Star Number 02892. All of a sudden, various laws and origins had appeared on this original star at the same time. There were elements like gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder and lightning, light, time, and space. The combined power was overwhelming. At one point in time, it felt as though the entire planet had fallen into shackles, and every single one of the universe knights and universe overlords had difficulty moving. At the same time, a temple started to emerge gradually from beneath ground…

The entire process took close to a full 100 years, and during this time, various major powers of the universe sent forth their super beings to this temple. At one point, this temple was surrounded by many universe masters, and only universe overlords with top-tier universe overlord capabilities would dare to venture near it.

After a period of 100 years later, the Disambiguation Temple fully emerged. Before it was erected a black stone tablet. The stone tablet had ancient engravings that were easily deciphered. Any great being would understand the moment they laid eyes on them. The content was very simple. It read:

The birth of Disambiguation Temple. A stone tablet appears; the moment the stone tablet disintegrates, on the 10,081 original stars, during a certain time and place, a single or many Disambiguation Mirror Stones will appear at random! There are a total of 36 Disambiguation Mirror Stones… and they all resemble ordinary stones. During birth, their dynamics are comparable to that of senior true treasures. When all 36 have fully emerged, the Disambiguation Temple will open. Those possessing Disambiguation Mirror Stones may enter. Any great beings without the stones will be considered as trespassing and will be annihilated without exception…

One year later, the stone tablet disintegrated. That was when various rumors started circulating; there were sayings like the Disambiguation Mirror Stones had been born on a certain original star. The rumors gave rise to many disputes. However, no one knew the exact time and place where the stones could be. This required a touch of luck. Even if a great being had strong powers, it would still be a challenging feat to obtain a Disambiguation Mirror Stone!

News of the stone tablet was disseminated early… Of course, Luo Feng knew of it.

“So, this is the Disambiguation Mirror Stone. I have been so oblivious to the treasure I have.” Luo Feng looked at the piece of black crystal stone. “During the birth of the Disambiguation Mirror Stones, there was an aura so overwhelming that it was like the birth of a senior true treasure, which was why it would have been best to find this Disambiguation Mirror Stone during its birth. Then, the unique characteristics of this stone could be observed and acquired.”

The birth of a stone possessed a power that was comparable to a senior true treasure. Every great being would be able to guess that this was not an ordinary stone. However—just like how Luo Feng killed other strong beings, then simply gathered and collected all the valuables that they once possessed—even if one possessed these Disambiguation Mirror Stones, they might not be able to identify them correctly.

“The befalling of various laws and origins of the universe…” said Luo Feng. “The Disambiguation Temple seems to be the greatest treasure during the opening of the Original Stars this time around.”

The Original Stars usually took a limitless period of waiting before they opened once. When they did open, they would only remain open for 1,000 eras. During this period of 1,000 eras, top-tier domain type true treasures, top-tier soul type true treasures, top-tier flying palace type true treasures, and pinnacle weapon type true treasures showed up quite frequently. The only concern was that these would all come with imperfections and would be scattered all over the place.

During the 1,000 eras that the Original Stars remained open, there was bound to be one true treasure that was most fearsome of all— one that would dominate all other true treasures. Usually, the predominant one would be a pinnacle domain type true treasure, a pinnacle flying palace type true treasure, or a pinnacle soul type true treasure. And they would normally also possess other functions too.

Force Armor, for instance, also had the power of soul defense; Beast God Armor had powers of attack and defense; supreme true treasure Star Tower was a fusion of soul defense, flying palace, suppression, attack, and many other functions.

Every time the Original Stars open, the most powerful true treasure that appeared, would usually be a combination of numerous abilities. For instance, the main function of a pinnacle soul type true treasure would be soul defense, but it would also have the function of partial godly body defense, or even the function of creating illusions.

In short, a pinnacle soul type true treasure would only be second to a supreme true treasure! And supreme true treasures were especially uncommon!

Even the nine greatest supreme beings in the universe did not own any supreme true treasures to reign dominance over the others. So pinnacle true treasures of the various types like domains, soul, flying palaces were more than enough to send various races in the universe into a frenzy.

“It will be an eternity before the Original Stars open again,” Luo Feng said to himself. “Every pinnacle soul type true treasure or true treasures of the same level would be known as a predominant clan true treasure! Once a strong and powerful universe master possessed such a true treasure and used it with other true treasures, the possibility of being annihilated would be nearly zero. Even if the opponent possessed a supreme true treasure… escape would always be possible when defeat was not.”

No wonder Tian Yang Knight hid this stone all this time, thought Luo Feng. He would not have dared to reveal this. Once word had spread that he owned it, this Disambiguation Mirror Stone would naturally have fallen into the hands of the universe masters in the automaton clan for their own uses. He was fortunate enough to obtain one senior true treasure. And if he went into the temple… only 36 great beings in the entire universe could enter the Disambiguation Temple through the many different doors, so there was no way he could fail to survive. Should a great being make it out alive, then the trip in would be extremely rewarding. Even if one failed—resurrection would always be the next course of action.

Luo Feng clearly understood what had gone through the minds of Tian Yang Knight and Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. Tian Yang Knight hid the news. And Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress had been unwilling to reveal the news that Tian Yang Knight had a Disambiguation Mirror Stone. If word spread, Tian Yang Knight would have had to pay his respects and surrender the stone to his race.

Tian Yang Knight would keep mum about the secret he held against Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress held a high status—having three great bodies, with each one comparable to that of a top-tier universe overlord. His status could almost match up to a universe master, so even if word spread and the Thorn Ring Alliance found out that he had a Disambiguation Mirror Stone, no one would be able to forcefully take it from him.

If he was backed into a corner, a special life-form such as Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress could always choose to leave the Thorn Ring Alliance and join other alliances.

Both had their own plans. Tian Yang Knight was not afraid of Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress hunting him down. He was confident he would stay alive. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was also confident that he would be able to get his hands on the Disambiguation Mirror Stone, and hence, the situation maintained the status quo…

But no one expected Luo Feng’s intervention!

Tian Yang Knight was skilled in escaping with his domain type true treasure combined with his senior true treasure armor, Flowing Light Wings. Even Luo Feng had been unable to give chase and eventually had to depend on his “I Am the Universe” technique to achieve the kill at last, which was how this Disambiguation Mirror Stone had fallen into the hands of Luo Feng.

“With this Disambiguation Mirror Stone, I also qualify to enter the Disambiguation Temple,” Luo Feng said, his emotions running high. “This kind of opportunity only comes once in the passage of many countless eras. Within 1,000 years, I will be able to become a universe overlord! Once I attain the level of universe overlord, my godly body will grow even bigger and stronger. My power will increase… I will be equipped with more resources to pursue other valuables.”

Luo Feng nodded as he finished his analysis of the situation. Then he put the third piece of metal to test. It was a small metal piece worth 31 treasure points. Although Luo Feng was quite surprised to learn of the value, he dismissed it with a laugh. Thereafter, Luo Feng made his way out of Primal Chaos City and left the primal universe. He returned to the original universe.

Within the territory of the Thorn Ring Alliance.

For a life planet to gain unparalleled prosperity, the prevalence of technology must never be underestimated, even if the planet did not depend on that technology. The majority of life planets in the universe—especially those with life forms that were inherently weak —relied more on the use of technology to create an ideally comfortable living environment. Towering skyscrapers, speeding cars, aerial parking berths… All these would be common sights.

At the top of a skyscraper, Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress had transformed into a godly body that was around nine feet tall. Sitting in his armchair, he overlooked the city. As he was a special life-form, he preferred the way these ordinary and weaker life forms lived.

“Luo Feng. Golden Horned Beast…” he muttered. “This Disambiguation Mirror Stone must have fallen into his possession. Failing in my mission this time around must have roused his suspicions. He has probably made use of human race’s information system to identify the Disambiguation Mirror Stone by now…”

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress frowned as he fell into deep thoughts.


Chapter 1088: Decision

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was sitting in the penthouse hall of a skyscraper. Suddenly, the doorbell rang.

“Come in,” Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress said.

Hua!

The door opened automatically, and a man with four hoofs, two hands, and numerous antennae on his face walked in.

“Boss, these are the financial statements for this year,” the man said and handed in the documents respectfully.

Characters of other races lined the documents. Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress took the documents and skimmed through them. It was a corporation he had established when disguising himself as an ordinary life form on this planet. Though it may have sounded ridiculous for a mighty, top-tier universe overlord to do such a thing, he enjoyed being close to most ordinary beings of the universe. Sometimes, he might gain new inspiration in laws when feeling the competition among the ordinary.

“Leave me first,” ordered Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. “I’ll hold a meeting later.”

“Yes, sir.”

The ordinary life forms working for this corporation would never have guessed how terrific their boss was. Even the so-called great beings—a great being at the universe level—was a joke to Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. He had secretly manipulated several power struggles on the planet, and it was like the blink of an eye to him. He could annihilate the double stars in the sky with a thought if he so desired…

The Golden Horned Beast had transferred Luo Feng’s soul to himself, thought Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress. Undying fighters’ souls can’t be robbed. Does that mean Luo Feng’s soul was transferred when he was a sector lord? Luo Feng gained such fame on Redbud Island, but is it possible that his soul was already transferred to the Golden Horned Beast? No wonder Luo Feng could be revived right after he died. He must be a new body of that Golden Horned Beast.

Soul transfer meant entering the original soul into a new body. The Golden Horned Beast had his original body and three other bodies, and the mind of a body had to leave and abandon the original body to occupy a new body. However, soul transfer could only be done on beings beneath the level of undying…

“Hmm?” Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress stood up abruptly. “Something’s wrong.”

Luo Feng was able to kill a pinnacle emperor when he was only a sector lord, thought Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress, and he killed Bark Mirror Emperor as an undying fighter. His body is as powerful as those unique life forms. Regardless, a sector-lord level body is not able to withhold the soul of a universe knight, even if his body has a life gene level of thousands of times! Was the Golden Horned Beast only undying when he did soul transfer on Luo Feng?

“That’s right,” he muttered. “This is the only explanation! That is how he succeeded! And that is why I can’t recognize him even with such fame! But how did he perform such a powerful technique? Even inherited techniques of unique life forms aren’t that strong.”

It was impossible for Luo Feng to get the Golden Horned Beast’s soul! It had only been a short while since Luo Feng started training, and he wasn’t able to create techniques that terrific.

It was also impossible for the Golden Horned Beast to get Luo Feng’s soul! Luo Feng, when he was only a sector-lord, wasn’t able to withhold the soul of a universe knight, and the Golden Horned Beast must have still been undying before… It was also impossible for the Golden Horned Beast to have created techniques at that level.

But they used the same technique! Which means they had the same mind! Soul transfer must’ve happened! How? What happened?

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress couldn’t figure it out after pondering the secret for a long while. He was amazed at how mysterious the universe was, and there were many inexplicable matters in the universe.

Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress was living on that ordinary planet while Luo Feng went back to his god country and continued the comprehension. He wanted to make a breakthrough and became a universe knight.

At the same time, in the palace surrounded by endless chaos airflow, at the apex of Thunder Island of the virtual universe, Primal Chaos City Leader sat at the edge of the cliff with his legs crossed and his eyes closed. Suddenly, a light shone beside him, and a picture with detailed descriptions showed up on the screen.

“Huh? It was sent by the virtual universe. What’s the information?” Primal Chaos City Leader looked at the screen, confused. The moment he saw the screen, he grew surprised. “Luo Feng got the disambiguation mirror stone?”

“Chaos!” A sound rang in the space.

“Huge Axe,” Primal Chaos City Leader responded respectfully. Only two beings in the human race could talk to him without application, and Huge Axe Creator was one of them.

“Chaos, did you know that Luo Feng used the virtual universe system to appraise the disambiguation mirror stone?” boomed the voice. “The other universe masters know it, too. I decided to hold a meeting to decide who that stone belongs to. Do you agree?”

“Yes.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded.

Primal Chaos City Leader knew that Disambiguation Stone had to do with the most important true treasure since the original stars opened! Universe masters didn’t care about ordinary true treasures at all. However, as for the pinnacle true treasures that were able to be born in The Disambiguation Temple, all the powers in the universe craved them.

It was already generous of Huge Axe Creator to hold a meeting instead of asking for it from Luo Feng directly. After all, the virtual universe system belonged to the human race! And the most senior beings in the human race were Huge Axe Creator, Primal Chaos City Leader, Void Gold Master, Spread Mountain Master, Long Yan Master, and those who were their equals. After Luo Feng appraised the disambiguation mirror stone, the virtual universe transferred the message to the seniors.

In a dimension in the virtual universe where there was dimming starlight in the dark, a godly palace floated in the sky.

There was a long stone bench in front of the godly palace with stone chairs on both sides. At one end of the bench was located only one stone chair, and a wild man sat in it. Suddenly, more beings showed up on the chairs on both sides of the bench. They were universe masters of the human race. Everyone arrived in no time.

“Everyone’s here,” the wild man said, looking sideways, but all the universe masters looked at him respectfully… Huge Axe Creator was a universe supreme master!

“Luo Feng obtained the disambiguation mirror stone,” he went on, “and it’s related to a valuable that can possibly be a pinnacle true treasure. It’s vital to our race, but it was obtained by Luo Feng through his own power, which means we can’t ask for it directly. How are we supposed to get it?”

Huge Axe Creator gave the first prerequisite: that they couldn’t ask for it directly.

“The disambiguation mirror stone…” said a cold voice. “It’s related to the Disambiguation Temple! Luo Feng is nothing compared to that! Just ask him to give us the stone, and we’ll pay him back. Is it enough to give him a senior true treasure? We can give him more if he thinks it’s not enough.”

“Yes,” some universe masters said, nodding. “I agree.”

“Though he obtained it by himself, it would be a waste to let him keep it! After the Disambiguation Temple opens, the stone will be useless. However, that stone might bring us humans a pinnacle true treasure.”

“I agree.”

“I do, too.”

The universe masters voiced their opinions one after another.

“Although what you said makes sense,” said a gentle voice, “I need you all to remember that Luo Feng is a timeless and peerless talent of our race! And it’s easy to imagine him to be proud! The disambiguation mirror stone is important, but it’s also important not to damage our relationship with Luo Feng. We need to be careful, and we must learn from what happened with Flame Emperor. Luo Feng’s potential is not inferior to that of Flame Emperor, and chances are that he might become a universe master in the future.”

“That’s different!”

“Luo Feng is completely different from Flame Emperor. Flame Emperor is extremely selfish, and he didn’t even know what it meant to protect his own race. I don’t feel sorry for losing him at all. Instead, I felt great about it! It would be an insult to me if I had to fight along with him!”

“Flame Emperor is different from Luo Feng.”

The gentle voice continued, “For what it’s worth, we all know the pride of those super talents. The more talented they are, the more pride they have! And they’ll be upset if we can’t deal with it appropriately. Technically, the stone belongs to Luo Feng, and he has a right even to waste it. It’ll be the best if Huge Axe brings the stone into the Temple, and it’s likely for him to get the true treasure with Huge Axe’s power.”

“Yes.”

“I agree with what Qing Dong Master said.”

“We need to be careful.”

“It’ll be a waste to leave it with Luo Feng, but we need to come up with a good way to persuade him.”

“It’ll be a bit difficult to persuade Luo Feng.”

Only Primal Chaos City Leader remained silent. All the universe masters agreed that it would better to placate Luo Feng. They all valued Luo Feng highly even though they were universe masters who ruled the human race.

“What do you think, Chaos?” one of them urged.

Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “I won’t disagree with you guys. We should take the disambiguation mirror stone back, but we can’t damage our relationship with Luo Feng. We can’t let Luo Feng proceed in the footsteps of Flame Emperor.”

All the universe masters nodded. It was not unusual for great beings to join other powers. For one thing, in general, the families of great beings all fell. For another, the more powerful great beings became, the more confident they got, and they could be stubborn on some issues. Once they were infuriated, they would break away from the powers they belonged to.

“I’ll leave this to you, Chaos,” the wild man said with a grin. “You’re his teacher, and he’ll listen to you.”

“Haha! Chaos, please take care of this.”

“Haha…!”

The universe masters all broke into laughter. Primal Chaos City Leader could only nod.

“Please try everything to persuade Luo Feng,” the wild man said. “The disambiguation mirror stone is related to the super true treasure in the Disambiguation Temple, after all.”

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “I’ll try my best.”


Chapter 1089: Luo Feng’s Resolution

In the vast sky of Remote Ocean, a godly light could be seen, emitted by the golden sanctuary.

Luo Feng sat cross-legged in front of the sanctuary, but his eyes were looking at the limitless god country, with pictures of secret engravings running through his mind. These recollections were constantly at the back of his mind, and occasionally, he would recall the three mysterious yet marvelous techniques of teleportation, strangulation, and space sealing… Being accomplished in the studies of pictures of secret engravings had led Luo Feng’s creation of technique to contain a complete set of space laws, which was why whenever he thought of those sculptures with secret engravings… he would be slightly astir with emotions.

“A little bit. Just a little bit. The feeling is getting nearer and nearer. It feels like I can gain full comprehension to achieve a breakthrough anytime. I just need a little more.”

Luo Feng’s brows were slightly furrowed as he stopped midway through his cultivation session. He had connected to the virtual universe with his consciousness and had received a message of high importance.

In his mail settings, messages from ordinary friends were set as “do not disturb.” Only mail from important people like his wife, sons, and teacher would pass the screening test by a virtual assistant and reach him even if it would be disrupting his cultivation progress. “Teacher Primal Chaos City Leader wants to see me?” said Luo Feng. “He wants to see me? Could it be…?”

A thought suddenly arose in Luo Feng’s mind, and he could not help but start to worry.

In the virtual universe, an endless chaotic airflow enshrouded Thunder Island. On a winding corridor behind the palace, Luo Feng walked alongside Primal Chaos City Leader. After a few moments, Luo Feng broke the silence.

“Teacher, you summoned me here, and yet you are not saying anything. This is making me very unsettled.”

“I am not saying anything because I am thinking about how I should go about convincing you. Luo Feng, you should be able to guess what I am driving at.” Primal Chaos City Leader cast his gaze at Luo Feng.

Luo Feng nodded when he heard this. “I was at Primal Chaos City, and when the virtual universe system identified a disambiguation mirror stone… I knew that you were bound to call on me regarding this. Earlier on, I was still wishfully hoping that the virtual universe system would keep the secret for me and not let this news go public.”

Prior to the identification, it had never crossed Luo Feng’s mind that Lord of Fan Nuo Fortress coveted the disambiguation mirror stone. If he had guessed the degree of importance of this item, then the result would not have brought about such an uproar. After the identification process was completed, when Luo Feng found out it was a disambiguation mirror stone, it was all too late.

“The virtual universe system normally maintains confidentiality,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “After applying a thorough and logical judgment on the results, it must have reached a final confirmation… that this matter will affect the entire race. Therefore, it chose to forward the information to every one of us universe masters.”

Luo Feng nodded.

“Now the situation is very simple,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. He walked to the dining table outside the corridor and casually summoned his servants. Two servants soon entered in a reverent manner and lined the table with a delectable spread of fine cuisine. “Luo Feng, sit. Sit while we talk.”

Luo Feng followed suit and sat down. The moment he saw that there were food and drinks laid out, he knew that Primal Chaos City Leader, his teacher, was taking this matter very seriously. At the very least, he had made exquisite arrangements just for their meetup. In the past, whenever teacher and student had conversations, it was always chatting by the cliff in front of the palace or within the palace hall. This time, it was at the back of the corridor—and even called for sitting down for a conversation? This was unprecedented.

“The situation is simple, because when you were at Primal Chaos City to identify the valuable, the virtual universe system sent the information to the Huge Axe Creator and all the other universe masters of our human race.” Looking at Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader added, “Which means that… every great being of the human race who is a higher-up will know. How should we handle this matter? Let’s make a decision.”

Luo Feng’s cheek twitched. Decision? He glanced over at his teacher,

Primal Chaos City Leader saw his reaction and said, “I believe you can guess the outcome.”

“What outcome?” Luo Feng could not help but exclaim.

“Our race really needs this disambiguation mirror stone,” Primal Chaos City Leader solemnly informed him. “The disambiguation mirror stone involves a super true treasure. The Disambiguation Temple is one of the greatest treasure vaults that has emerged during the opening of the entire Original Star. It is vital to our race! The human race may be strong and powerful, but we do not have a single supreme true treasure to reign dominance over the others. With one more domain type true treasure of a pinnacle level… it would greatly benefit our race.”

“No supreme true treasure to reign dominance over the others?” Luo Feng was stunned for a moment.

The human race… had no supreme true treasures.

“We humans really do not have any supreme true treasures?” Luo Feng could not help asking.

Primal Chaos City Leader hesitated for a while, then shook his head and replied, “No. We used to. But not now.”

“Used to?”

Luo Feng grew increasingly suspicious. There seemed to be more than met the eyes. Yet, according to the information he had found on the virtual universe network—especially now that his status allowed him access to much more important information—he realized that supreme true treasures were indeed an extremely rare sight in the universe.

Based on what Sitting Mountain Guest had told him, even for universe supreme beings, there were a few of them who did not own any supreme true treasures! Universe supreme beings would go crazy over supreme true treasures without fail. The predominant treasure of the universe’s greatest power, the Ancestral God School… was none other than a piece of a supreme true treasure.

Through all this coveting and all the information, Luo Feng could discern the rarity of supreme true treasures, but what he had not expected was that, as strong and comparatively powerful as they were, even the Hong Alliance and the human race did not own any supreme true treasures.

“Yes, indeed, there are none.” Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng and said, “Out of the top nine powers in the universe, five of them possess a supreme true treasure, but our human race certainly doesn’t.”

Luo Feng felt a twinge of anxiety. This was one of the shortcomings of the human race.

“The true treasure that the disambiguation mirror stone involves should be comparable to the most important true treasure that we human race possess.” Primal Chaos City Leader gazed at Luo Feng. “And all the universe masters are in consensus that… the disambiguation mirror stone is in your hands; thus you should be allowed to venture into Disambiguation Temple. But the outcome may not be ideal. If it were given to Huge Axe Creator instead, the chances of succeeding would be much higher.

“Huge Axe Creator?” Luo Feng’s heart lurched. That was a universe supreme being!

“Of course, I won’t force you.” Primal Chaos City Leader held up his wine glass, looked at the wine through the transparent glass and continued. “The decision is yours to make.” Then he looked Luo Feng straight in his eyes and said, “I hope that you will help our race this once.”

Luo Feng was taken aback. Help? He was no fool, having attained the level of cultivation of today. Besides, he had led the life of a vagrant roaming the universe for 50,000 years, which had widened his horizons and allowed him a penetrating view of all the deception and dishonesty common in the universe. There were many things that he could have figured out on his own. He could have guessed why Primal Chaos City Leader summoned him here.

The negotiation tactic that Primal Chaos City Leader deployed was considerably dignified and aboveboard. There was no other method than to come up with a detailed analysis of the entire situation and present all the facts to Luo Feng outright. Then in his capacity as an honorable universe master, as well as his position of a teacher to Luo Feng, he would ask Luo Feng to help their race this once!

This put Luo Feng in a spot. He was not mentally prepared for this. He found it difficult to reject him then and there.

“Teacher…” Luo Feng began.

Primal Chaos City Leader was still looking at Luo Feng.

“This time around,” Luo Feng continued, “there are 36 disambiguation mirror stones scattered all over the 10,081 original starts, yet our human race does not own a single one at all?”

“Not one.” Primal Chaos City Leader raised his head to down his wine. Based on Luo Feng’s question, he could already detect his unwillingness. Putting down his wine glass, he said, “The number of great beings within the human race is one of the fewest in the universe. We form the minority. Take the Northern Territory Alliance, for instance. It is the alliance with the greatest number of great beings on the universe. The number of universe knights that they have is more than 100 times that of our Hong Alliance! The more the number of great beings dispersed in the various primal stars, the higher the chances of obtaining these ambiguation mirror stones. My speculation of the situation at present is that the Northern Territory Alliance would, at most, have obtained one or two disambiguation mirror stones. After all, in contrast to the entire universe, the Northern Territory Alliance only constitutes a small portion. If even they are unlikely to own more than one, then how many can we humans possibly obtain?”

“That few?” Luo Feng was dumbfounded.

The number of heirs and universe knights of the Hong Alliance was a far cry from that of the Northern Territory Alliance. This time, in the Original Stars, the number of universe knights from the Northern Territory Alliance who had died at his hands exceeded 20.

“There is still a large batch of top-tier powers within the universe that are in the lead, like the Nine Territories Alliance and the Thorn Ring Alliance, and also some other allied powers that are much weaker… Although they are weak, their numbers are many, which is why most of the 36 disambiguation mirror stones were taken by these powers. When the time comes, they will enter Disambiguation Temple through the 36 different paths… These powers will then get the chance to obtain even more powerful true treasures. Maybe this was a balancing method of the universe.”

Luo Feng nodded his head as he listened on.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng and said, “Give me an answer. Are you willing or not?”

Luo Feng gave a straightforward reply. “Teacher, I am unwilling to.”

Primal Chaos City Leader gave a slight frown, but his expression softened thereafter, and he said, “You are unwilling to? Out of 36 great beings entering the Disambiguation Temple this time around, there may be a few great beings who have obtained these disambiguation mirror stones that we are not acquainted with. But those going in… more than half of them range from universe masters to universe supreme beings. Others will most likely be top-tier universe overlords and universe overlords. If you do not have the capability of a universe overlord, then you do not qualify to enter! This is the rule that countless generations have observed whenever it comes to vying for the greatest treasure each time the Original Stars open. And ultimately, the ones who obtain the supreme true treasures… are almost always universe masters or universe supreme beings!”

Primal Chaos City Leader stared at Luo Feng and added, “Do you even know… what a universe supreme being is? Even for someone of my level, meeting a supreme being means doomsday has arrived. They are the most powerful and fearsome life forms within the universe.” Primal Chaos City Leader was starting to sound anxious. “And you still want to go?”

Luo Feng nodded. “Yes.”

It was precisely because he knew the details of the entire situation; and also, he knew that the disambiguation mirror stone was not distributed according to how capable or how strong the great beings were, but rather, distributed at random. Therefore, strong and weak alike might stand a chance of obtaining these mirror stones. Besides, every one of these great beings would be entering through a different path, so it was all a gamble one had to take.

From a historical point of view, since countless generations before, during every opening of the Original Stars, the greatest treasure— according to what Primal Chaos City Leader knew—was most likely to be claimed by a universe master or a universe supreme being.

If I were to attain the level of a universe knight, thought Luo Feng, my godly body would become much bigger and stronger. Then Force Armor would be able to muster its third form! I might even be able to try to obtain the fifth black metal board. From what I heard from Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest, the fifth black metal board may present me with an accidental surprise. Regardless, by that time, I will already be able to mobilize Star Tower. Even if I were to face a universe supreme being, I would be able to hide in Star Tower, and he could not do anything to me!

After all, Star Tower… was a supreme true treasure!

The human race did not owe any supreme true treasure; Star Tower did not have a master to control it and was placed out of any territory and on the battlefield. This had brought about war among the four pinnacle races, where universe supreme beings went crazy for them but no one could claim it. This was power!

Luo Feng counted upon Star Tower… Naturally, he was fearless of any other being. He was brimming with confidence.

The Disambiguation Temple… of course he would be the one going in! If he got stronger, his race would get stronger likewise.

“Don’t you feel that your abilities may not make the grade?” Primal Chaos City Leader could not help but ask. “Going there is too dangerous for you.”

“Teacher,” Luo Feng said, looking at Primal Chaos City Leader. “Your disciple now possess the power of a top-tier universe overlord.”


Chapter 1090: My Home Planet: Earth

There were all sorts of delicious dishes from different territories in the universe, but Luo Feng hadn’t touched any of them. Primal Chaos City Leader poured the wine and looked at Luo Feng.

“Top-tier universe overlord?” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “I know that your godly body can rival that of a universe knight, and you have your Remote Ocean body to serve as an endless godly power source. And your Golden Horned Beast body is also 600 miles long. And with your senior true treasure armor… Even a top-tier universe overlord will find it difficult to kill you, but that doesn’t mean you’re at that level.”

However, Luo Feng gazed at his teacher firmly.

Primal Chaos City Leader gazed right back at Luo Feng. “Are you sure?” he asked.

Luo Feng nodded. “Yes.”

“Did you kill all those universe knights of other races?” Primal Chaos City Leader couldn’t help asking.

Luo Feng nodded.

Primal Chaos City Leader kept staring at Luo Feng. He was a witness to Luo Feng’s rise in power, and it was beyond his imagination how quickly he had improved. What Luo Feng had just said was terrifying, yet Primal Chaos City Leader found it almost convincing based on their relationship for 100,000 years.

“We’ll talk about it later!” Primal Chaos City Leader shook his head. “Luo Feng, I’m your teacher, so trust me, I’m doing it for your best interest.”

“Please continue, teacher,” said Luo Feng.

“The disambiguation mirror stone is related to the most important true treasure ever—since the original stars have opened,” Primal Chaos City Leader said solemnly. “The universe masters and Huge Axe Creator know that you have a disambiguation mirror stone. Although they won’t force you to give them the stone, they’ll be upset with you if you don’t. You’re meant to be one of the top seniors of us humans, and it would be unwise for you to upset them now.”

Luo Feng nodded.

“Even if you have the power of a top-tier universe overlord,” Primal Chaos City Leader went on, “it’s not going to help you much. Half the beings who will enter the Disambiguation Temple are universe overlords, and there might even be one or two universe supreme masters! Though the 36 portals give special consideration to the weak, power is all that matters in the end. It must be universe masters or even universe supreme masters who fight for the true treasure! Even you, someone as strong as a top-tier universe overlord, will have to back down.”

Primal Chaos City Leader gazed at Luo Feng. Luo Feng said nothing.

“If you insist on going,” said Primal Chaos City Leader, “not only will you upset universe overlords, but you won’t be able to get the true treasure either. Why do that?”

He had begun this conversation from the perspective of the race, and now he was trying to sway Luo Feng from the perspective of costs and benefits. He only had one goal: to persuade Luo Feng to hand over the disambiguation mirror stone.

“Besides,” he continued, “our race will make it up to you. After all, you’re the owner of the disambiguation mirror stone. How much do you think a disambiguation mirror stone is worth? 20 true treasure points? 30 true treasure points? Our race will definitely give you compensation if you give it up.”

Luo Feng couldn’t help sighing. If it had been a universe master who gained the stone, there wouldn’t have been this much trouble. The race was talking to him politely because he had the potential to become one of the top-tier seniors. If Luo Feng were only an ordinary universe knight, their attitude at the moment might have been completely different. However, he had obtained the disambiguation mirror stone by himself! The stone belonged to him!

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng. “I hope that you will hand it in.”

Luo Feng wouldn’t have given a darn if it were any other universe masters trying to persuade him, but Primal Chaos City Leader had been generous to him by leading him and guiding him.

“Teacher, did you just say that our race will compensate me if I contribute it to our race?” Luo Feng took a deep breath. “I don’t have high requirements… I’ll hand in the disambiguation mirror stone if I can get half the ownership of Earth back! Which means I want Earth, my home planet, back!”

“Is this the only condition?”

“If you say yes,” said Luo Feng, “I’ll hand in the disambiguation mirror stone to our race. I want nothing more than the other half of ownership of Earth. If you say no, then I won’t give away the stone.”

Primal Chaos City Leader was dazed. “Earth?”

“Yes, Earth.” Luo Feng nodded.

Silence. Both supreme beings sitting at two sides of the dining table both had gone silent.

“You want Earth back?” Primal Chaos City Leader said gradually after staying silent for a long while. “What are you going to do about the immigrants from foreign planets?”

“When I lost half my ownership to 50 billion mixed elements,” Luo Feng said solemnly. “I also allowed in lots of immigrants from other planets to live in the oceans and floating cities in the sky above the oceans. However, they’re after immigrants instead of earthlings! The Earth is the origin place of us earthlings, and it’s my home planet. I’ll ask those immigrants from foreign planets. Mainland and oceans. They all belong to earthlings!”

He could only give away half the ownership of the Earth under pressure from his race! However, Luo Feng had been waiting to get Earth back! In the past years, the immigrants had been arrogant, and Luo Feng could only try to stop them from behaving recklessly. However, the immigrants looked down upon the earthlings from the bottom of their hearts. The blue planet belonged to earthlings, after all!

“You want to chase them out?” Primal Chaos City Leader whispered.

“Teacher, I gave it away for 50 billion mixed elements only.” Luo Feng smiled. “50 billion mixed elements isn’t even worthy of a treasure. I’m offering the disambiguation mirror stone now! If you calculate the benefits, it’s millions of times more valuable!”

“I understand.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “I can’t decide on this issue, but I’ll give you an answer soon.”

“Okay.” Luo Feng nodded.

Luo Feng wasn’t a fool, and neither was he a fool who would buy into something like making a “sacrifice” for the race. He wouldn’t give away a valuable to make another great being stronger!

Ever since Luo Feng first stepped off his home planet, he had been carrying the responsibility of the Earth! The fate and future of the earthlings depended on him, which was why he wouldn’t give up any opportunities to become more powerful. Besides, he had obtained the disambiguation mirror stone by himself!

The Disambiguation Temple was the most important valuable since the original stars opened! Luo Feng really wanted to go there. But his teacher had asked him personally, and his teacher was sincere. Taking back Earth was a more important dream to Luo Feng! Compared to taking back Earth, disambiguation mirror stone was much less significant.

Taking back Earth is not an easy task in my plan, thought Luo Feng. If I can take this opportunity to take back Earth, I won’t care about the disambiguation mirror stone.

The race and the Earth. Though Luo Feng had a sense of belonging to the human race, he had much stronger ties to Earth! He was, first and foremost, the leader of the earthlings and carried the fate of Earth! He was a member of the human race second. Besides, the disambiguation mirror stone was only something that could make the humans stronger. It had nothing to do with the destiny of the human race… He didn’t need to worry about that.

Starlight shone brightly in space as the universe masters sat on both sides of the bench.

“Has he agreed, Chaos?”

“Is there an issue? Did Luo Feng say no to you, his teacher?”

“How can he say no? It will be a waste to leave him with the disambiguation mirror stone! I’ll go talk to him if you failed.”

Huge Axe Creator glanced around, and all the universe masters went silent.

“Chaos, tell them,” Huge Axe Creator said.

“Luo Feng said yes.” Primal Chaos City Leader looked around at the other universe masters. “But he gave one condition.”

“Nice.”

“He agreed?”

“It’s good that he agreed! As for the condition, we’ll compensate him.”

“What is his condition?”

Some universe masters asked while others simply stared at Primal Chaos City Leader said. He wouldn’t have summoned them if the issue were simple.

Primal Chaos City Leader continued, “His condition is straightforward… He wants the other half of ownership of Earth. The Earth is his home planet! We bought the Earth for 50 billion mixed elements, and after that, all the powers were able to send their candidates to Earth. Now, he wants Earth back.”

“But what about the candidates of other clans?” said a cold voice.

“Luo Feng wants to drive out all the candidates from foreign planets and leave only the earthlings,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

“No way!”

“Certainly unthinkable.”

“Not possible!”

The universe masters voiced their opinions one by one, irritated at the very idea. Earth had drawn special attention when it was discovered… However, when Huge Axe Creator deemed that Earth was a special planet created by Sitting Mountain Guest, the universe masters were only curious. They hadn’t realized how precious Earth was.

However, after 100,000 years, generations of candidates from foreign planets were born on Earth. And all the candidates born there were more likely to have better comprehension, which led to better dispositions, and higher chances of becoming great beings and talents!

“Disposition” was an attribute that appeared unimportant at the start of training, but the more powerful one got, the more important it became! This amazed the universe masters. What an amazing planet —Earth! What an amazing achievement by Mountain Sitting Guest!

The descendants born on Earth had completely different souls, which made them more likely to have better dispositions. For 100,000 years, there had been a large group of geniuses and great beings, and there were numerous sector lords. As time went by, Earth might become a mighty clan within the human race, like the Flame God Race! And compared to Flame God Race, the earthlings had higher potential!

“No way!” the universe masters said.

“That’s a specially made planet by Mountain Sitting Guest. It’s priceless!”

“Ask him to change a condition.”


Chapter 1091: Turmoil

“Earth? No way.”

“The disambiguation mirror stones. There are 36 of them. There is no way that one can replace Earth!”

Seeing how the other universe masters were disagreeing, Primal Chaos City Leader could not help but frown as he spoke. “Back when I came forward in the capacity of the Virtual Universe Company, I spent a mere 50 billion mixed elements to buy Earth’s ocean ownership rights. Those 50 billion mixed elements were not a one-time payment; it was split into three installments. Now that I am using this disambiguation mirror stone to trade… I think the amount should be about the same.”

“Primal Chaos City Leader!”

“Primal Chaos City Leader!”

Two universe masters called out at the same time. They looked at each other, then one of them—a giant with three sharp horns and a body covered with a scaly armor—said in a deep, low voice, “Back then, Luo Feng was a mere nobody. 50 billion mixed elements was a sky-high amount. Although you signed a contract in the name of the Virtual Universe Company… you also have an agreement with us, the Universe Mercenary Alliance, and some other parties! The Earth’s ocean ownership rights and ocean high-altitude ownership rights are shared among the five of us! All five of us have sent our descendants down to dwell on Earth. It has been 100,000 years since then, due to the unique characteristics of Earth, which you all should already know.

“What an amazing planet! The children who are born on Earth could be so much stronger in their ability to learn and acquire power. While their initial speed of improvement matches that of descendants on other planets, as time goes by, with continual learning and acquisition, the rate at which they improve far surpasses descendants on other planets. Sitting Mountain Guest is unbelievably remarkable. To think he could create such a planet! Who knows how many years he spent creating a planet where the souls of babies could undergo evolutionary changes? This is really too incredible for words.” The giant sighed in awe. “Sitting Mountain Guest really lives up to his status as the most senior of all universe supreme beings.”

Positioned at the highest societal level of the human race, they all knew about Sitting Mountain Guest. The human race might have universe supreme beings, but during the time when the universe was just emerging, humans were like toddlers stumbling about as they learned how to walk, slowly and unsteadily multiplying in numbers. At that time, the special life forms that ran rampant in the universe were the invincible beings. These special life forms were naturally endowed with strength and power, like the Eight Natural Beast Gods…

As for Sitting Mountain Guest, during the most ancient period following the birth of the universe, he had already become a loner among the universe supreme beings.

“Earth is continually creating great beings,” the giant continued in his low, deep voice. “It can create such a huge branch like the human race, giving it value not inferior to that of a pinnacle domain type true treasure. There is no way I will agree to trade it for anything that easily!”

“I disagree, too.”

“Disagreed.”

Authoritative figures of the two major powers, the Universe First Bank and the Universe Star River Bank, voiced their disagreements together. This worried Primal Chaos City Leader. He gave a slight frown.

“So, the disambiguation mirror stone. What should be done about it?” Huge Axe Creator’s booming voice sounded from his throne. “If no one is willing to return Earth, then Luo Feng will not be handing over the disambiguation mirror stone.”

“What our human race lacks is a supreme true treasure!” the giant continued. “As for the pinnacle domain type true treasure… considering this level, the human race already owns quite a few pieces. Besides, the disambiguation mirror stone only represents a chance of obtaining a true treasure of a pinnacle level. Haven’t we met with quite a number of similar chances so far? Like the Universe Ocean… If we dared to go all-out, it is possible to obtain a pinnacle domain type true treasure anytime.”

“With a one in 36 chance of obtaining a pinnacle domain type true treasure! Using this to trade for Earth is out of the question.”

“That’s right.”

“I agree with Deserted Mirror.”

The authoritative figures of the Universe Mercenary Alliance, Universe First Bank, and Universe Star River Bank voiced their opinions.

“Dear all. My disciple, Luo Feng,” Primal Chaos City Leader began. “His ability has reached that of a top-tier universe overlord standard.”

Hua!

All the universe masters, including Huge Axe Creator, looked over.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, you are not kidding?”

“Luo Feng just started cultivation not long ago. A top-tier universe overlord?”

“Have you witnessed it personally?”

“It can’t be true.”

“Impossible.”

Not a single one of the universe masters could believe that Luo Feng, who had only 10,000 years’ worth of cultivation and had only become undying 20,000 years ago was now at the top-tier universe overlord level. In the entire universe, almost no one would have found such a claim believable.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, is it true?” Huge Axe Creator could not help asking.

Primal Chaos City Leader scanned his surroundings. Then, with a slight nod, he replied, “I have yet to test it for myself. However, we have been teacher and disciple for 10,000 years, and based on my understanding of him… if he dares say so, it must be true!”

“You have yet to test him personally.”

“So, this claim is not tested or proven yet.”

The universe masters who had not really crossed paths with Luo Feng laughed and shook their heads.

Deserted Mirror, the authoritative figure of the Universe Mercenary Alliance laughed aloud. “Primal Chaos City Leader, Luo Feng may be using the disambiguation mirror stone and matters on Earth to add to his capital. He is taking advantage of his relationship with you. He may be saying it on purpose because he has faith that you, his teacher, will believe him.”

“Deserted Mirror, you think my disciple is like yours?” Primal Chaos City Leader said, his eyes burning with a trace of anger.

Deserted Mirror smiled but did not dare say anything further. After all, Primal Chaos City Leader wielded the highest authority in the Virtual Universe Company. In terms of ability or status, no one else present, other than Huge Axe Creator, was qualified to oppress him! Furthermore, even the primal universe was under his jurisdiction… All of these accolades raised Primal Chaos City Leader’s status by leaps and bounds.

Out of the five major powers within the human race, Huge Axe Dojo and the Virtual Universe Company were the strongest; the Universe Mercenary Alliance, the Universe First Bank, and the Universe Star River Bank were one notch lower.

“If Luo Feng claims to be a top-tier universe overlord and wants to try his hand at entering the Disambiguation Temple, let him be. He needs to taste a little suffering. As for trading back Earth… the disambiguation mirror stone is a far cry from sufficient.”

“A disambiguation mirror stone in exchange for the Earth’s ownership rights is definitely unacceptable.”

Primal Chaos City Leader suppressed a sigh as he noted the circumstances. Noble beings such as these universe masters… How strange their temperaments were! Cold and arrogant, obstinate and unruly, kind to look at but ruthless in heart. These beings had so many faces! They could steer clear from touching the bottom line, so humans naturally would tolerate their presence. These super beings enjoyed special privileges, so long as they did not touch the bottom line!

Out of all the universe masters, Primal Chaos City Leader was usually the one who presided major events pertaining to issues of the human race. He was also the one who always held such issues in the highest regard.

From his point of view, Earth might be important, but regardless of whether geniuses were cultivated by other major powers, or cultivated by human dwellers living on Earth—weren’t they all essentially part of the human race? Overall, the human race was still strong and powerful and able to earn Luo Feng’s gratitude and loyalty. Furthermore, the humans’ territory was vast… even if there was a branch of Earth that was comparable to the Yan Shen race, it was still only a small part of the overall power of the human race.

The current matter concerns their own benefits, so none of them are willing to relent easily, thought Primal Chaos City Leader and sighed inwardly.

From his throne, Huge Axe Creator shouted his orders. “This discussion shall end here!”

The other universe masters fell silent as they looked toward him.

“Primal Chaos City Leader,” Huge Axe Creator said, looking at him.

With a slight bow to indicate his respect, Primal Chaos City Leader was on all ears.

“You have to inform Luo Feng that using the disambiguation mirror stone to exchange for Earth’s ownership rights is impossible. If he is unwilling to accept our other proposals, the race will not force him to.” Huge Axe Creator smiled. “As for Earth’s ownership rights… do tell him that so long as his ability and power could attain a certain level that is considered sufficient, then of course, nothing is impossible.”

Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “I understand.”

On the contrary, the other universe masters were a little caught by surprise.

Chapter 1093: The Foundation Is Built

Above the boundless Remote Ocean was a gigantic five-colored whirlpool with a diameter of tens of billions of miles. It covered the sky above the Remote Ocean. As for those who had other bodies, like Luo Feng, the universe origin would arrive on top of the largest body with the most energy so that it could swallow godly power more efficiently.

Luo Feng’s original earthling body, Golden Horned Beast body, and Mosha body were scattered across the universe.
