They knew that quite a fair number of several universe overlords had been annihilated by Luo Feng.

Luo Feng simply smiled and returned the greetings in a leisurely manner. When he walked out of sight, the group of brothers immediately began a heated discussion.

“Brother Luo Feng is simply too powerful! Even universe overlords were annihilated by him. Doesn’t that mean he is close to becoming a universe master?”

“Hmm. He has far surpassed our teacher! I believe the Hong Alliance palace master… will have a place for brother Luo Feng in future.”

Luo Feng could hear all the content of their discussions from afar, but he maintained his inner peace, staying still as undisturbed waters as he walked to where True Yan Knight resided.

“Teacher,” Luo Feng said. He stood outside the door and waited.

“Come in.”

The doors opened automatically. True Yan Knight was seated at the far end of the table, which was laid out with a fine spread of food and wine.

“Tsk tsk, Teacher,” said Luo Feng. “This is some fine-quality wine you have here. You must have spent quite a fortune.” Luo Feng reached the table in two steps and sat across from True Yan Knight. He reached for a flat vessel containing some wine and took a close look. “Is this the era-aged ‘Zhe Gui Wine’?”

“My disciple has gained such great fame among the 100 million races in the universe that there could be no one who has not heard of you,” said True Yan Knight. “Everyone sees you as a super being. If you were part of another race, you could lead the entire race with your power. You could go rampant roaming the universe.” True Yan Knight caressed his golden beard. With a mildly triumphant tone, he continued, “Even a few universe overlords have been annihilated by my disciple! How is that not worth celebrating? At such a time, would I be so stingy over wine?”

Luo Feng blinked and said, “Teacher, if you flatter me too much, I might fly off to cloud nine.”

“You are already capable of flying!” True Yan Knight joked.

This brought some warmth to Luo Feng. He felt as though he had gone back in time to the past. True Yan Knight was a very straightforward and candid character, and he would commonly jest with his disciples. He simply had no regard for social status.

“Aren’t you going to drink?” True Yan Knight filled his own glass.

“I am. Of course, I will,” Luo Feng replied immediately.

“Haha…! Come, let me fill your glass.”

“I will help myself.”

Luo Feng and True Yan Knight drank and chatted about the recent happenings in the outside world. While Luo Feng had been spending time on cultivation recently, the outside world had undergone many great changes.

“You definitely gave the races of the universe a good scare this time around.” True Yan Knight put down his wine glass and sighed. “The rate of your growth was so fast that even I, as your teacher, was pretty shocked, let alone the other races. There is all kinds of news circulating around in the universe, saying that at the rate you are progressing, you’ll likely attain Primal Chaos City Leader’s level in the future. Spies from other races are all over! We have caught and killed a large number of spies. Some have tried to infiltrate Primal Chaos City, or even reach my very doorstep.”

True Yan Knight looked towards Luo Feng and continued, “We have killed many of these spies, but the killing is never-ending. It seems like the other races are no longer concerned about the price they have to pay. They would rather sacrifice the many spies they have sent out as they get exposed… and still search frantically for news about you.”

“Oh?” Luo Feng nodded slightly.

“All those spies who waited in ambush,” said True Yan Knight. “The loss for one is actually quite a sizable amount. Yet now, races are willing to lose them one after the other. I speculate that other races are already aware that you are cultivating in your god country. They are in the midst of locating the whereabouts of your god country. Bug soldiers, the automaton clan, demons… All of them are finding ways to enter the human territory to kill you.”

True Yan Knight paused, then warned, “If it were not for them, there would be no rush at all. You have to be very careful.”

“Ha…!” Luo Feng laughed. “Teacher, let’s not talk about this. I am well-prepared for it. My purpose in coming here to see Teacher today is for some other matter.”

With a wave of Luo Feng’s hand, three true treasures instantly appeared and hung suspended in midair. They were an earth-yellow wooden boat, a crystal ball, and a piece of black armor.

The wooden boat was a flying-palace type true treasure. The crystal ball was a domain type true treasure named “Numerous Worlds.” And the piece of black armor was a senior true treasure armor! With these three true treasures, True Yan Knight’s survival ability would reach a new high. The only pity was that a soul type ordinary true treasure would require at least 36 true treasure points. Luo Feng could not afford that amount.

“You, this is…” True Yan Knight got to his feet and looked at the three true treasures, stupefied.

“Teacher, I am going to leave the human territory on an adventure,” Luo Feng said reverentially. “If everything happens as I anticipate it will, some major bloodshed will likely take place. You are my teacher, so I am afraid trouble may find its way to you. These three true treasures may be helpful to you, so it is my hope that you will accept them.”

Luo Feng was worried that True Yan Knight might not accept the treasures because they were too valuable! So he did not reveal the actual value of these three true treasures.

“You want to leave the human territory?” True Yan Knight was taken aback.

Luo Feng nodded. “Yes.”

He had to go claim Star Tower and obtain the fifth black metal board. Of course, he had to go.

“But you are aware that the automaton clan, bug soldiers, and demons alike… They are all looking to eliminating you,” said True Yan Knight. “Even if you are in the human territory, there are chances of assassination attempts. Yet you want to head out? Once you are out there, there are no human great beings who can give you timely protection. You will be exposed to danger.” True Yan Knight started to panic at the thought.

“Yes, I am aware of that,” said Luo Feng. “This time, when I head out, there is bound to be a bloodbath.” Luo Feng smiled. “But please rest assured, Teacher.” He bowed slightly. “I shall take my leave now.”

Turning around, Luo Feng took a step and vanished.

True Yan Knight looked to where Luo Feng had vanished. He kept silent for a long time. He understood… Luo Feng had reached an even higher level.

“Three true treasures. A universe overlord. Three true treasures are all that he got!”

True Yan Knight thought these were ordinary true treasures, so with an extended finger, he shot out threads of godly power, and speedily penetrated the three true treasures. That very moment, a surge of information was transmitted… Flying-palace type, domain type, senior true treasure armor… This information had True Yan Knight rooted on the spot for a long while.

“He did not tell me,” he whispered. “He left immediately because he was worried I might accept these if I knew. This disciple of mine…”


Chapter 1095: Star Tower Disappeared

Inside the Palace of Primal Chaos Ruins.

Luo Feng went to visit Primal Chaos City Leader after leaving the palace of True Yan Knight. He was not content with trading his disambiguation mirror stone for half the ownership of Earth! However, he knew that Primal Chaos City Leader was only one of the dozens of universe masters in the human race. Though he was powerful, he wasn’t at Huge Axe Creator’s level. Besides, Primal Chaos City Leader had been guiding him patiently, and Luo Feng admired the character of his teacher.

True Yan Knight and Primal Chaos City Leader had completely different personalities. True Yan Knight was frank and forthright, and he would do anything for those he cared about. When Luo Feng was chased by Bark Mirror Emperor, True Yan Knight went to fight him even though he wasn’t sure whether he was going to win or not.

As for Primal Chaos City Leader, he was responsible for the entire human race, and many important issues concerning the human race were determined by him. The rise and fall of the humans were all under his consideration. He had always been fair, and his principle was to “put the race first” when he was treating his disciples, which made Luo Feng respect him.

“Teacher.” Luo Feng gave a salutation.

Garnet armor with complex patterns and a scaled tail spread out from a set of battle gear. Under several fiery horns was a fierce face with engravings on it. It was another body of Primal Chaos City Leader. The eyes were broad like the sky and intimidating.

“Why are you here to see me?” asked Primal Chaos City Leader.

“I plan to leave the human territory, and I wanted to tell you before I left,” answered Luo Feng.

“Oh? It seems that you went to visit True Yan about this, too.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. He was the guard of the primal universe, which meant he knew everything going on in the primal universe. However, he hadn’t eavesdropped on the conversation between Luo Feng and True Yan Knight.

“Do you know how dangerous it is for you on the outside?” asked Primal Chaos City Leader.

“I do.” Luo Feng nodded. “The bug race, the demon race, and the automaton race all want me dead.”

“But you’re still going out?” Primal Chaos City Leader continued.

Luo Feng nodded.

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Then go. You’re not weak in any aspect, which means you should be the one who makes all your own decisions. But remember, you’re not only representing yourself. You’re still representing your family and your earthling bloodline. Just remember this.”

“Yes.” Luo Feng nodded and bowed. “Then I’ll leave now.”

“Go,” Primal Chaos City Leader said, then added, “If you can’t handle the danger by yourself, crush the keepsake I left you.”

Luo Feng nodded, and with the space ripple, he disappeared.

Primal Chaos City Leader was left alone in Primal Chaos Ruins.

This disciple of mine manifests such power after hiding for almost 20,000 years, Primal Chaos City Leader thought. And now, he’s leaving the human territory. He must have some peculiar experiences, and they happened at some place in the universe.

Primal Chaos City Leader had figured this out a long time ago, but he wouldn’t try to influence Luo Feng. From his perspective, if Luo Feng had Remote Ocean body, then even he was killed outside, he could easily resurrect himself. The true treasures would be the only things lost.

Bug race, demon race, automaton race? thought Primal Chaos City Leader. They would be desperate if they knew Luo Feng has a Remote Ocean body. All they can get is the true treasures he carries.

Primal Chaos City Leader was confident. Although he was more proficient in close combat, he was also a master in souls, and in the primal universe—which was under his control—he could tell that Luo Feng’s mind and willpower were already at the universe master level!

Godly power determined minds. Minds affected willpower as well! After 180 million years of training and becoming a universe knight, Luo Feng’s mind and willpower had already reached the universe master level.

However, Primal Chaos City Leader was wrong about one thing. If those other races killed Luo Feng’s body, they would get exceptional true treasures: Force Armor, Shi Wu Wings, and Beast God Armor.

After leaving Primal Chaos City, Luo Feng first went back to his god country. Then he went to Star Tower by god country transportation!

In the center palace of the Star Tower, the light started to dim. Luo Feng walked out.

“Star Tower,” Luo Feng said as he looked around the palace where he received life or death inheritance. “My godly power should be enough to drive Star Tower.”

Hong!

The godly power on Luo Feng started to burn and spread along the ground. It went into the center of Star Tower like electricity, transferred to the pillars and seal stars. The burning godly power flowed like water in the river, channeled through the pillars and seal stars, however. Those engravings were too difficult; Luo Feng was only able to understand the easiest ones.

After only a short while, the burning godly power merged with every inch of Star Tower.

“Rise!” Luo Feng growled.

Weng!

Star Tower rose eight inches and fell eight inches slowly. Such a tiny ripple was imperceptible.

Luo Feng took back his godly power, and the Golden Horned Beast in the world ring started to transfer the godly power to his original earthling body.

“My original earthling body is also a universe knight with a life gene level of 9,800 times, and it’s strong enough to drive Star Tower. However, the godly power consumed is too much. If it weren’t for the Golden Horned Beast, that move would have consumed 30 percent of my godly body. My understanding of the engravings in Star Tower is too limited.”

He was able to drive it with his godly power if he wanted, but it consumed too much power. If he were able to fully comprehend the engravings, it would be much easier.

Luo Feng left the center palace and started to wander through Star Tower. He went to various locations via the internal transportation. He couldn’t even see the end of the heavenly pillars.

Luo Feng perused the engravings on the heavenly pillars and couldn’t help exclaiming, “Incredible! Even the simplest engravings are so amazing. The engravings in Star Tower are even more complex and complete than those of the miniature universe. No wonder it’s a supreme true treasure.”

He walked around and saw the heavenly pillars and seal stars. He even went to tour the spaces in Star Tower where lots of other races were adventuring and fighting. Luo Feng was able to see the mysteries formed by those spaces.

After 32 days of walking through Star Tower, Luo Feng went back to the center palace and sat down with his legs crossed. His consciousness was fully integrated with Star Tower, and all the engraving sculptures flooded his mind… He started to study them carefully. The deeper he understood those engravings, the more power he could wield.

Mysterious! Complicated! Space, time, gold, wood, water, fire, ground, wind, lightning, and light… All law threads were mixed together perfectly, and they were 10,000 times more complicated than the miniature universe engraving picture. After all, the miniature universe only had a diameter of six billion miles while Star Tower was nine light years tall! If the miniature universe was a small room, the Star Tower was a skyscraper comprised of countless small rooms.

Fortunately, I’m on the engraving-picture path, thought Luo Feng. Otherwise, it would take me forever to reach full comprehension if I only know of space law and gold law.

He sat with his legs crossed for three years before he opened his eyes.

“Finally,” he said, “I’ve finished understanding the first level of mysteries.

However, after understanding the first level, Luo Feng better grasped how incredible Star Tower truly was.

“I’m only able to fully comprehend the first level.” He looked up at the center palace. “It should be easier to drive now.”

Hong!

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed, and his godly power started to burn. Endless godly power immediately infused Star Tower, and the easiest engravings at the periphery were completely driven. Luo Feng felt much more comfortable.

I need to drive those warriors out before taking it back, he thought.

Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong!

Beings of different races were being driven out through the portals at the bottom, and millions of beings showed up outside Star Tower. They were all in shock.

“What happened?”

“I was adventuring there, but I was driven out.”

“Me too!”

“Why did Star Tower drive us out?”

All the other races were astounded. This had never happened in all the time since Star Tower showed up in the outer-domain battlefield.

All of them had been driven out today? It was bizarre!

“Look! The nine whirlpool nebulas disappeared!”

“They disappeared!”

All the undying fighters were shocked to their very core.

“Look! Star Tower is shrinking!”

“It’s shrinking!”

Star Tower, which was nine light years tall, was quickly contracting. After only a short while, it became half a mile tall, and then, it disappeared completely.

“Star Tower disappeared!”

“How is that possible?”

Everyone was terrified.

The news spread like wildfire. No one exaggerated anything this time, but the news that Star Tower had disappeared was thousands of times more shocking than Luo Feng killing a universe overlord! A supreme true treasure craved by billions of races in the universe… had just vanished!


Chapter 1096: Looking for Star Tower

The virtual universe, in the space belonging to Huge Axe Creator.

Amidst the darkness, flashes of starlight could be seen from afar where a plain-looking palace was suspended in the core of the dark space. There were long stone benches in front of the palace where figures were appearing out of nowhere, one after the other.

In just a short time, many had arrived, including Huge Axe Creator, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Deserted Mirror Master, who were all unable to conceal their shock expressions.

“I believe everyone has heard,” Huge Axe Creator said, scanning his surroundings. “Star Tower has disappeared!”

“Hmm.”

“We all just heard.”

“How could Star Tower disappear? It has been standing firmly in the void space for an eternity. Even universe supreme masters are unable to take it down by force, so how can it disappear so suddenly?”

This breaking news had all the higher-ups, even the most strong-hearted ones, in shock and disbelief.

“Look.” Huge Axe Creator pointed far into space.

Hua!

A scene played before them in the faraway, dark sky. Star Tower was throwing millions of undying soldiers out of it, followed closely by the dispersion of the nine whirlpool nebulas. Then Star Tower shrunk, teleported, and vanished from its spot.

“Undoubtedly,” Primal Chaos City Leader whispered, “there must be some great being controlling Star Tower. That is how the undying fighters of various races could be thrown out of every plane of Star Tower within such a short time! This great being caused the nine whirlpool nebulas to disperse and Star Tower to shrink and teleport away.”

“But who?”

“Who wields such power?” said a universe master wearing elegant, golden armor with purple engravings between his brows. “Back then, the automaton race, the bug soldiers, the demons, and us—we all fought for this supreme true treasure that suddenly appeared. We fought and killed like crazy, yet in the end, all four pinnacle races were unable to do anything to Star Tower. Even when Huge Axe Creator entered personally, he too was unable to take Star Tower.”

“Void Gold Master is right,” someone else spoke up. “Purely based on power, who could have done it?”

There was incessant chattering all over as the universe masters of the human race voiced their opinions.

Huge Axe Creator nodded and said, “We all have reached a consensus that purely based on power, it is indeed impossible to take Star Tower! After all, in the countless years that Star Tower has been out in the battlefield, not only have the four pinnacle races tried and failed; even other great powers of the universe like the Ancestral God School, the Space Beast Alliance, the Northern Territory Alliance, and some other weaker powers have all tried discreetly, but no one has succeeded.”

All the universe masters nodded.

“Including myself,” added Huge Axe Creator. “I’m afraid all of the universe supreme masters have already tried.” He shook his head. “All have failed! With power alone, it is indeed impossible. Taking Star Tower requires an opportunity with a touch of luck! My guess is, a certain great being has gotten lucky and managed to take Star Tower in a stroke of good fortune. Many true super beings in the universe have been trying since long, long ago but have not succeeded. This time, the one who has managed to take Star Tower must be a very powerful being.”

“A weakling?”

“An undying? Universe knight?” Universe masters instantly started shouting.

“Regardless of who he is, so long as he can control Star Tower… he is no weakling.” Huge Axe Creator scanned everyone. “Hiding within Star Tower? Even I cannot achieve that.”

The other universe masters nodded with envy in their eyes. Star Tower was a supreme true treasure, indeed! Even a pinnacle race like the humans did not have a supreme true treasure to reign dominance! Every supreme true treasure had unbelievably strong power… to the extent of having strange characteristics; universe supreme masters coveted them, but universe supreme masters were very rare. There were only a few of them. However, there were still a number who did not possess any supreme true treasures. Huge Axe Creator, for one, did not own any!

“We must get to the bottom of it!” Huge Axe Creator ordered, “Make use of the resources from my Hong Alliance and conduct a thorough search for information. We must get to the bottom of the matter… Whose hands have Star Tower fallen into? If he is a weakling, then he won’t be able to hide inside Star Tower forever. We can still find the chance to take Star Tower from away him or even find out how he managed to control it.”

“Yes, sir.”

“Yes!”

All the universe masters accepted his order.

Huge Axe Creator emphasized with solemnity, “We humans lack such a supreme true treasure. We must find a way to get it.”

In the universe that belonged to automaton race, a voice representing the noblest being of the automaton race sounded and was transmitted to every corner.

“My children, go look into it! Find out who has taken Star Tower! Even if he has the supreme true treasure, he will not be able to hide inside Star Tower forever. If he is a weakling, we definitely have a chance to take Star Tower away from him.”

“Yes, Father God.”

“Yes, Father God.”

All universe masters of automaton race received the order.

Hua!

In the vast, starry sky, a giant being whose body was entirely covered with black scales made a gradual appearance. The surroundings within a radius of a few light years instantly fell into a world of endless, dark flames, and within this area, all levels of stars seemed to disintegrate into nothing and vanish from sight. This towering presence was all that existed.

“How long since I have been back in the primal universe,” said the figure. “How familiar it feels. This is my homeland. If not for Star Tower, I cannot imagine how long it would have taken for me to make it back here from Universe Ocean. Back then, I was unable to take Star Tower away! Yet there was some fellow in the primal universe who actually succeeded… I must find Star Tower and find that fellow. I must find out how he controlled Star Tower. If not for the lack of a supreme true treasure, would I have been defeated by that old Beast God from the Space Beast Alliance…?”

The figure in black scales moved slowly.

Hua.

It vanished into thin air.

The top nine powers in the universe were all eager to take action, as a supreme true treasure was simply too tempting! Even the few great beings who were universe supreme masters that roamed about as loners had taken action, let alone the universe masters who had clans under their leadership. There were some clans with merely one universe master. Those were the ones who greatly desired to own the Star Tower.

“If I manage to get the Star Tower, then I won’t even have to fear universe supreme masters.”

“By that time, my Tamar Race will have hopes of being a pinnacle race.”

The shocking news of the human known as Luo Feng killing a universe overlord was nothing compared to the breaking news that the supreme true treasure, Star Tower, had disappeared! It was enough to shake the foundation of a pinnacle race.

Star Tower was the most precious existence within the entire universe! With hundreds of billions of people from various clans looking for it, those who had been concerned about Luo Feng dwindled in number. Even if there were any, they were most likely the most persistent ones among the demons, automaton race, and bug soldiers, so keen on eliminating Luo Feng that they would never let their guard down.

Ancestral God Secret Region, Redbud Island.

The commotion that arose from the disappearance of Star Tower caused quite a stir, thought Luo Feng. The excitement has boiled over.

Luo Feng appeared at Redbud Island in the residence that belonged to him. This was the third day since he had taken Star Tower, and since then, he had been following everything that happened on the outside through the virtual universe.

All was turmoil! The Hong Alliance’s universe masters and all those undying beings who had made their way to the battlefields were engaged in heated discussion. And that was only within the Hong Alliance. There were also other powers in the universe… but through the information being disseminated within the Hong Alliance, it could be seen that everyone had gone mad over this news.

No wonder Sitting Mountain Guest Teacher strictly commanded me not to divulge the news about Star Tower, Luo Feng thought. He was appalled. If I had been exposed, and the outside world found out I could control Star Tower… Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest alone would certainly not be able to protect me. Luckily, I can protect myself now, so I can make a foothold independently in this turbulent universe.

He took a step forward, opened the doors of his mansion, and flew off in the direction of the palace in front of the public square, where the island master of Redbud Island resided.

“Look, it’s Luo Feng.”

“It’s the human, Luo Feng.”

“He is back on Redbud Island. It has been 200,000 years since he last appeared!”

“Luo Feng has power that matches that of a top-tier universe overlord, so rarely coming to Redbud Island is nothing strange at all.”

There were many cultivators from various races on Redbud Island, and this discussion started when a team of candidates spotted him while they were flying.

Luo Feng, on the other hand, was flying toward the public square. Passing through the water curtain of a fountain, he arrived at the “land of inheritance.” There were clearly a great many opportunities for inheritance.

A while later, Luo Feng made his exit and flew directly back to his mansion. There, Luo Feng stayed in isolation for five days before he once again made his way to the land of inheritance to accept his share.

Retreat! Inherit! Retreat! Inherit! Almost every other day, Luo Feng would enter once to accept his inheritance. This quickly aroused the attention of many cultivators on Redbud Island. There were many such discussions about this.

“After all those battles that Luo Feng welcomed with untamed abandon, he has since earned a humongous amount of opportunities for inheritance. But even if he has that many opportunities, is there a need to be so wasteful?”

“Without feeling what it’s like to undergo cultivation, accepting all those inheritances would be totally pointless.”

“What a waste.”

However, Luo Feng simply paid no heed to all the things others were saying, shaking his head to himself.

I am highly accomplished in the studies of pictures of secret engravings and can comprehend by analogy. Every time I make my way in to accept my inheritance, I can quickly comprehend a large quantity of content pertaining to the beast god path. How fast is my speed of cultivation?

Without the ability to comprehend, a beast god inheritance would mean nothing. Yet Luo Feng was able to feel and comprehend a large amount of information because he was highly accomplished in the studies of pictures of secret engravings, so every time he went for another round of inheritance, he would be able to make additional progress.

After all, in terms of level, Luo Feng had already created a technique that matched the level of an ultimate technique of a universe master. With the “heart of Beast God,” he had attained an extremely high level of comprehension, so naturally, accepting the beast god path was a piece of cake.

Once every five days, he would accept one Beast God inheritance; when he was only at his third round of inheritances, Luo Feng could already grasp full comprehension of the fourth stage of the beast god path. It was like a university student studying doing elementary school homework.

There was also “Inheriting,” a rapid method to boost the speed of comprehension. However, he was much slower in progressing at the fifth stage of the beast god path.

Bug soldiers, demons, and members of the automaton race were all racking their brains in search of a solution.

“Hurry! Report to the race! Luo Feng is here on Redbud Island!”

“That annoying Luo Feng… The guts he has to come here to Redbud Island.”

“If you want to kill Luo Feng, you would have to get a universe master involved. However, the moment any of our universe masters showed up at Redbud Island… they will be annihilated right away by the Five-Color Aurora Lake. As for us, we do not even own the qualifications or the rights to enter the island.”

“If we are disguised within the human territory, we could still have a shot! But given the Ancestral God School’s power, which is much stronger than that of humans, if Luo Feng decides to hide on Redbud Island, there is really nothing we can do.”

Luo Feng remained on Redbud Island, cultivating at his leisure.

“My golden horned beast body has gone through two months of traveling among the stars. It has finally arrived at the destination of the fifth black metal board.”

Luo Feng revealed a trace of a smile.


Chapter 1097: Ancient Chin Secret Region

Two months before, just after taking Star Tower, Luo Feng had separated his bodies. The original earthling body went to Redbud Island with his Mosha body to attract the attention of other races. He practiced in public, and he even flew to the land of inheritance instead of teleporting himself there every time he went because he wanted the other races to know where he was.

As for Golden Horned Beast body, he arrived at a faraway territory in the universe through god country transportation and then flew to his destination, the Ancient Chin Secret Region, by spaceship

“I’m a high-achiever on the engraving-picture path. If it weren’t for the bet with Ancestor, I would’ve reached an extremely high level on laws. Perhaps I would’ve finished the sixth level of beast god path by now. But concentrating on the engraving-picture path did help me a lot.”

Still, the beast god inheritance from the Ancestral God School is also beneficial, thought Luo Feng. Without beast god inheritance, I’ll need ten years to complete the fourth level, and it might take me 100,000 years to finish the fifth level. And this is with the help of advances on the engraving-picture path. Those beast god inheritances give me maximum efficiency. As long as I want, I can receive those inheritances as much as I can. It seems that I need to stay on Redbud Island for a while longer.

Luo Feng flew out of his palace and flew toward the Island Leader’s palace. Many onlookers took notice.

“Luo Feng’s here.”

“He goes to receive beast god inheritance once every several days.”

Some other races kept careful records of Luo Feng’s activities, as they had been ordered to gather as much information about him as possible. It was important to gather such information if they wanted to kill that supreme being Luo Feng.

Go ahead and take records, thought Luo Feng. Take records of all my moves. You’ve miscalculated my power, and you’ll miss everything. I’ll show you what “going for wool and coming home shorn” means.

Luo Feng flew into the spring and went to the land of inheritance.

The Ancient Chin Secret Region was a region that had a diameter of 1.2 million light years. Though it was much smaller than Ancestral God Secret Region, it was still extremely dangerous.

A seeming ordinary garnet spaceship flew through space. Inside the control room, a lovely Golden Horned Beast at on the couch and gazed outside.

“Based on the information from Master Mountain Sitting Guest, the fifth black metal is in this region! The Ancient Chin Secret Region…”

Information about the Ancient Chin Secret Region from the virtual universe immediately flooded Golden Horned Beast’s mind. This ancient region had been born when the universe first came into being. There had been several wars fought here for the valuables.

Gradually, the number of valuables in the secret region had lessened, and because it was extremely dangerous, supreme beings stopped coming. However, some undying fighters and universe knights would occasionally come here and try their luck. It was extremely dangerous, and most of the valuables had been taken! That made the region highly unattractive. Even many special life forms left, and it became desolate.

“A desolate secret region. Dangerous and containing almost no valuables. The fifth black metal is here? Master Mountain Sitting Guest really knows how to find places to hide things. I sensed it!”

The Golden Horned Beast’s eyes gleamed, and all every cell in his godly body was thrilled. He could sense the powerful summoning.

Shua!

Golden Horned Beast teleported himself outside and put the spaceship back in his world ring.

“That direction!”

Golden Horned Luo Feng teleported himself toward the source.

It was hazardous, but Golden Horned Beast, who was much more powerful than top-tier universe overlords, easily passed across all of them.

The fifth black metal… thought Golden Horned Luo Feng as he gazed into the distance.

Endless black mist permeated the space. Everything was dark. However, Luo Feng was certain that the fifth black metal was there! Though his Golden Horned Beast body didn’t need it anymore, the original earthling body did need it. One the earthling body reached the perfect life gene level, he could also have a godly body 55,000 miles tall. Then he would be able to perform “I Am the Universe” as well.

“Be careful,” he told himself. “Nine Tiger River.”

Hong!

Golden water started to churn in the space, covering an area with a radius of 19 million miles. Nine strange beasts were frolicking in the golden waves, surrounding a black Golden Horned Beast.

“Move forward.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng flew slowly in the dark while Nine Tiger River checked for dangers. After a short while, he had flown a hundred million miles.

Hua! La!

A giant being flew past him, glaring at the black Golden Horned Beast in the golden waves.

Golden Horned Beast kept flying into the deep. He had performed space seal and kept Nine Tiger River running. He felt like he was being watched by a great being.

I know Teacher wouldn’t let me have the fifth black metal so easily, he thought.

Golden Horned Luo Feng was careful. Suddenly…

Hong!

A gigantic being showed up in the dark and dashed toward his Nine Tiger River domain.

Hong! Long!

Nine Tiger River tried to stop him, but the efforts were rendered useless. The giant being slashed through the waves and raced at Luo Feng.

“Huh?”

Golden Horned Beast saw a black-crystal giant a million miles tall. He was waving all six of his thick arms and held a red hammer in each of his hands.

“Black Sky Horde Leader?”

The Golden Horned Beast was startled. There lived some extremely powerful special life forms in the Ancient Chin Secret Region, and Black Sky Horde Leader was a top-tier universe overlord who could rival the most powerful World Tree. He was a unique mountain giant! And he had a life gene level of 8,000 times. All six hammers he wielded were senior true treasures, and he was invincible with his inherited techniques.

I’m in trouble, Golden Horned Beast thought as he stared at the mountain giant. I can defeat him, but that giant body… It’s too difficult to kill him!

“Get out! Get out!” Black Sky Horde Leader roared.

“Black Sky Horde Leader, I don’t mean to offend you, but don’t try to stop me,” said the Golden Horned Beast as he grew to a million miles long. With his black scales on, and he gazed at Black Sky Horde Leader in the distance.

“Golden Horned Beast, you can’t come here,” Black Sky Horde Leader said.

In no time, Black Sky Horde Leader had cut through all the obstacles in the Nine Tiger River with a radius of 19 million miles.

“Get away!” the Golden Horned Beast roared and became a beam of golden light.

Sharp and cold, his giant, scaled wings slashed at Black Sky Horde Leader. Black Sky Horde Leader was also a renowned being in the universe. He rarely showed himself, as he had been living in the Ancient Chin Secret Region, but he was as powerful as Heavenly Erosion Palace Leader and the most powerful World Tree.

“Damn it!” Black Sky Horde Leader roared. Golden engravings showed up on his black crystals. Countless engravings covered his entire godly body, and the space around him was torn.

The Golden Horned Beast felt a black hole being formed!

Six hammers smashed at the Golden Horned Beast, and six black space whirlpools were formed under the special techniques mixed with his inherited techniques. All went dark. Light was totally swallowed under the move by Black Sky Horde Leader, and Luo Feng, in the domain of Nine Tiger River, sensed six whirlpools racing toward him.

Peng!

Under the wing, all six space whirlpools crumbled, and the wing hit the chest of Black Sky Horde Leader.

Hua!

Black Sky Horde Leader bounced away and rolled through Nine Tiger River. Everything around them was annihilated before it started to recover slowly.

“Amazing, Golden Horned Beast,” said Black Sky Horde Leader. “I’m not your match.”

Black Sky Horde Leader roared and flew outside. Golden Horned Beast didn’t stop him. Because of the Beast God Armor, Luo Feng was able to use every part of his body to fight, and the most powerful part was the horn. However, he knew that it was almost impossible to kill Black Sky Horde Leader, who had the same quality of godly body as he did. All he needed to do was to intimidate him. Black Sky Horde Leader turned his head and transmitted the voice the second he exited the domain of Nine Tiger River. “Golden Horned Beast, you’re not supposed to be here. I admire your power since you’re stronger than me. But leave if you want to survive. Otherwise, my master will kill you.”

Black Sky Horde Leader flew off into the dark.

Black Sky Horde Leader’s words shocked Luo Feng.

“His master?” muttered Luo Feng. “Black Sky Horde Master is a top-tier universe overlord, and he’s difficult to kill even by universe masters… but he has a master? Just where have you hidden the fifth black metal, Teacher?”

Luo Feng understood that this was not an easy task.

“Just wait and see. I’ll see who the master of this Black Sky Horde Leader is. I’m not afraid even of universe supreme masters!”

Luo Feng kept moving forward, stepping on the golden waves. The Golden Horned Beast was at the center of Nine Tiger River, and he kept going, moving deeper into the secret region.


Chapter 1098: Blood Cloud Palace

Surrounded by the rolling Nine Tiger River, Golden Horned Beast advanced and penetrated his way through carefully.

In the faraway darkness…

“That golden horned beast is making its way to Master’s palace! We have to stop him. We cannot let him bother Master!”

“Silver Dragon, not even I am able to stop him. It’s the same for you.”

“I may not be able to stop him, but Black Sky… you are definitely able. Our powers may be comparable, but your godly body is much bigger than mine! With such a massive godly body, you may be able to pester him persistently and hold him back for a long time! But you are retreating after your first defeat. Don’t you know that Master’s stateliness should never be compromised? Yet you condoned the Golden Horned Beast’s act of intruding into Master’s palace!”

“No, Silver Dragon. His power is much stronger than you think. If he had really wanted to shake me off his tracks, there would have been no way I could stop him.”

“What? You can’t stop him? Could he possibly be a universe master?”

“Even if he isn’t, his powers are comparable,” Black Sky Horde Leader said. “We shall take things a step at a time. Let him meet with Master for now! Since he does not want to heed my advice, if he gets annihilated, we are not to blame… If he meets our Master and causes a disturbance, his only end will be to face annihilation!”

“That’s right,” another cold voice said. “That Golden Horned Beast is going to regret this.”

“Let’s go.”

Black Sky Horde Leader, together with the other small figure on his body, disappeared quickly into the darkness.

Golden waves surged forward rapidly and swept through the void space, clearing all obstacles in its way.

Golden Horned Beast cast his gaze into the distance. Black Sky Horde Leader’s words made him cautious. After all, this was the place Sitting Mountain Guest Teacher had arranged. Earlier, the third black metal board had been found to be with the Green Knight and Purple Knight; those were definitely universe overlords! As for the fourth black metal board, he’d had to meet with Craftsman Master. Now, for the fifth piece—the final black metal board—this would probably be an extraordinary experience, too.

“If he can enslave Black Sky Horde Leader, this ‘Master’ must be at least a universe master,” Luo Feng speculated.

Following the intense beckoning of the black metal board, Golden Horned Beast advanced progressively.

Half an hour later, there were no longer any obstructions in the way. Obviously, all the other special life forms were apprehensive after witnessing the loss Black Sky Horde Leader had suffered. They gave up trying to stop this Golden Horned Beast.

“That annoying Golden Horned Beast. How dare he bother Master!”

“He is indeed very powerful; Sir Black Sky was defeated by him.”

“We shall see. When he meets with Master, he is going to regret it. But by then, it will be too late for regrets.”

Golden Horned Beast could faintly feel the other special life forms secretly watching him from afar, but they were not bothering him, so he did not feel like paying them any attention. Half an hour after he started out, amidst the dark mist ahead, the corner of the large palace started to show up indistinctly.

This towering palace was fully cloaked with a coat of blood red, and the single corner that was revealed was simply unbelievable.

“A palace?”

Golden Horned Beast manipulated Nine Tiger River to advance at a rapid speed, and soon, he arrived at the main doors of the palace. The doors seemed ordinary, but they exuded an overwhelming amount of power. Above the doors, there were three extremely complicated sets of secret engravings. Though they were indecipherable, the meanings of the three words were directly transmitted into his mind: Blood Cloud Palace!

“Blood Cloud Palace…?” Riding the rolling, golden waves in front of the palace, Golden Horned Beast’s face registered a shocked expression. “The legendary Blood Cloud Palace? The… the fifth black metal board is here in Blood Cloud Palace.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng was thunderstruck. At the same time, on the faraway Redbud Island, the moment his original earthling body got this news, it connected with the virtual universe without delay and started a deliberate investigation.

Luo Feng was no stranger to Blood Cloud Palace. It was very prominent among the billions of super great beings of various races in the universe. Yet wherever Blood Cloud Palace traversed became a sea of bloody massacres!

Blood Cloud Master was a strangely wicked character. Whenever he found a certain great being to be an eyesore, he would kill without a second thought, and the killing extended to the home of the great being. At times, he would even attack the core of a race’s territory… When he had a target in mind, he killed without mercy!

However, as far as his background, identity, what race was he from, and his true power… all of these were unknown!

All that was known about him was that his Blood Cloud Palace was a flying-palace type true treasure. Back when it had run rampant in the universe, it killed countless and made enemies with almost 99 percent of all the powers in the universe! There were many universe masters who wanted him dead, but although Blood Cloud Palace Master was a loner, he was powerful to the extent of annihilating two universe masters single-handedly! The number of universe overlords who had fallen at his hands was even more alarming. Moreover, the moment he sensed that the situation might not be favorable to him, he would flee the scene in his Blood Cloud Palace at top speed.

Over the course of many long years, there had been no great being who could contain this Blood Cloud Palace Master! And if there was some power who went head-on with Blood Cloud Palace Master, he would react like a raving lunatic and conjure up all sorts of retaliation methods to deal with his opponent.

An evil lunatic, powerful and mysterious! This was Blood Cloud Palace Master!

No one knew where his home was, what the true threshold of his power was, whether he was a special life-form, or if he belonged to a certain race. Everything about him was a mystery. Because he was always dressed in a blood-red battle robe and wore a blood-red mask, his true appearance was also a mystery. During his craziest moments, he once made the entire universe hate him while he continued living at ease and comfort and even annihilated two universe masters.

Battles between universe masters were always close; the victor was always difficult to predict. Yet he had killed two! This was strong evidence of how overpowering he was.

Rumors had it that Blood Cloud Palace Master was of human origins! Because no matter how perverse Blood Cloud Palace Master was— killing and annihilating countless lives, including great beings from the Ancestral God School, the Northern Territory Alliance, the crystal clan, the prison clan, the bug clan, the demon clan, the automaton race, and the Space Beast Alliance—the human race was always free from harm…

As for the Nine Territories Alliance and others, which were one notch lower in strength, they would undoubtedly suffer a great deal.

If a universe overlord of a certain race was killed by Blood Could Palace Master, it was best to let the matter go. If the race decided to continue fighting on, they would suffer greater losses. After all, even the various top powers in the Ancestral God School were unsuccessful in dealing with this Blood Cloud Palace Master.

“Blood Cloud Palace,” Golden Horned Beast said. It raised its head to look at the three engraved words on the top of the palace doors.

Back when Blood Cloud Palace Master ran rampant in the universe, so full of arrogance as if nobody could beat him, he was definitely a mysteriously overpowering presence. However, since that glorious period, rumors of him have dwindled. He eventually started to disappear from the scene. Thereafter, he only emerged twice. The last time he made an appearance was about three million eras ago. He has disappeared for much too long.

There has been no news at all, and various powers of the universe have speculated that Blood Cloud Palace Master must be one of the universe masters in disguise, assuming another identity. But there is no longer any need for this disguise now. So he has yet to make another appearance.

Luo Feng finished looking into the relevant detailed information that he found within the virtual universe. He only had one thought in mind. This was a lunatic! A powerful lunatic! He was a loner free of all constraints and attachments. Even top powers who fought him suffered in the end. Whoever came forth to provoke him… would simply have to fight!

Who would have known that the Blood Cloud Palace was hiding here? And with Black Sky Horde Leader guarding it!

Luo Feng was dumbfounded.

No wonder not a single great being could find it. After all, the universe masters do not really care much about visiting ancient secret regions, and the ordinary universe knights wouldn’t even be able to make it to the doors with Black Sky Horde Leader standing guard. Various races of the universe only know that this is Black Sky Horde Leader’s territory. What they didn’t know… is that this is actually the home of Blood Cloud Palace Master.

“What should I do? Should I go in or not?”

Blood Cloud Palace Master’s fame was overwhelming, his strength was overpowering, and he had killed two universe masters single-handedly. Based on calculated estimations, his power had to be a close match to Primal Chaos City Leader! No wonder Black Sky horde leader had been so confident earlier on. Moreover, Blood Cloud Palace was a flying-palace type true treasure. However, based on what he could sense, that black metal board was within this palace type true treasure.

“How about I enter this true treasure?” Golden Horned Beast hesitated for a while but was quick to come to a decision. “A flying-palace type true treasure’s main purpose is to protect its owner! I have never heard of this Blood Cloud Palace being able to trap a great being.”

Sou!

The palace doors were open. No more hesitation. Golden Horned Beast shrank the size of Nine Tiger River right away while flying straight for the palace doors.

Flying through the doors, he reached a gigantic and spacious public square from which he had a clear of three faraway palaces. The main palace was in the middle, while the other two were side palaces. Indistinctly, he could see that there seemed to be other palaces behind the main palace.

“It must be in the main palace.”

Golden Horned Beast could clearly sense the intense beckoning from where he was, so at top speed, he flew in the direction of the main palace.

The main palace exuded a murderous and overbearing aura that seemed to know no limit. As Golden Horned Beast entered, a blood-red throne in the main palace was the first sight that greeted him. But there was no one on the throne.

“Where is Blood Cloud Palace Master? Could it be that he is not here?”

He is the master of Blood Cloud Palace. The moment I entered, he should have been able to sense my presence. Why is he not showing himself?

Such thoughts were running through Golden Horned Beast’s mind, but he did not show signs of hesitation. He had to act. Following the beckoning, he speedily arrived at the rear chamber of the main palace! The palace was divided into the main palace, several other side palaces, and many rear chambers. Golden Horned Beast moved at an alarming speed along the corridors.

“Here it is.”

He rammed his way through the doors and entered and found his way into a secret room.

Upon entering, the sight that greeted Golden Horned Beast was mildly startling. In this room, there was a large quantity of valuables that exuded various kinds of powerful auras. Judging by their auras, there must have been a large amount of precious materials among them… There was a startling number of treasures in the room. Even at one quick glance, he could see at least several tens of thousands of treasures, of which there must be as many as 100 true treasures. Based on Luo Feng’s assessment, these should only be ordinary true treasures!

“Is this a treasure vault?” Luo Feng wondered. “But the doors were pushed open so easily. No… This is Blood Cloud Palace, how can its master be so confident? Just laying everything out in the open? My guess is, to Blood Cloud Palace Master, these may not be precious after all.”

Hundreds of true treasures, tens of thousands of treasures, vast amounts of materials… All of them gave this treasure vault a boundless breath of life. Yet Golden Horned Beast only had eyes for that one item placed directly in the middle of the materials—a piece of black metal board that seemed to be incomplete.

“The fifth piece!”

However, Golden Horned Beast felt strange. Could it really be this easy?

Sou!

A thread of godly power shot out from the sharp pointed tip of Golden Horned Beast’s horns and intruded on the metal board. Very quickly, the last section of information from the Nine Volume Manual surged into Luo Feng’s consciousness in a frenzied, unrestrained manner.


Chapter 1099: Palace Leader Shows Himself

Luo Feng had already gotten four black metals, and after getting the information of the fifth one, the Nine Volume Manual became complete. Only after he successfully got the complete Nine Volume Manual did he realize how extraordinary the manual was.

“Incredible.” The Golden Horned Beast closed his eyes.

The words on Nine Volume Manual kept floating in his mind, and the combination of the words themselves formed a giant engraving picture! Each letter was a part of the engraving picture, and combining them made an engraving picture more complex than that of the miniature universe!

“How incredible! The letters in the manual constitute an engraving picture? I’ve never heard of such a thing.”

Luo Feng was amazed. He understood that it was because the Nine Volume Manual had reached an extremely high level! The closer it was to the universe origin, the more mysterious it would be.

Like beast gods, their shapes were the manifestations of laws. The Nine Volume Manual was even rejected by universe operation law, and it couldn’t be taught. Fortunately, Sitting Mountain Guest used Heavenly Soul Crystal to pass it, but he was only able to pass it on to one life. Others, like supreme inherited techniques, were bestowed by the universe directly! But Nine Volume Manual was rejected by the universe, which meant the manual was more powerful than supreme inherited techniques! And it couldn’t be created by universe masters.

Golden Horned Beast was dazed in front of the black metal. He was thrilled at the sight of the complete manual, but he recovered shortly.

“I can’t stay here for long. I need to leave now.”

Golden Horned Beast put the black metal into his world ring using his godly power and glanced across the valuables beside it.

Hong!

A powerful force arrived and permeated the entire Blood Cloud Palace. The time and space in Blood Cloud Palace were completely controlled. Space ripples were paused.

“No!” Golden Horned Beast was startled. “It’s a universe master!”

The Golden Horned Beast turned his head around and saw a ferocious being walking in. He wore a fiery cape and had two golden horns on his head. He also wore a mask, and his tail showed at the back of his armor. He stopped and stared at Golden Horned Beast.

“Blood Cloud Palace Leader,” Golden Horned Beast said, turning around.

A universe master… thought Luo Feng. So what?

“Golden Horned Beast!” Blood Cloud Palace Leader gazed at him, then walked toward him. “You’re right. I am Blood Cloud Palace Leader. However…”

His godly body started to change. The fiery cape became ordinary cyan armor. His aura changed. Fierceness became tranquility. The golden horns transformed into crystal, and the mask disappeared, revealing a familiar face.

“T—Teacher?” Golden Horned Beast blurted, baffled by the sight. Blood Cloud Palace Leader had turned into the shape of Master Sitting Mountain Guest! The aura was exactly the same as Sitting Mountain Guest, and aside from his aura, the power he emitted was stronger than that of Primal Chaos City Leader; that couldn’t be replicated.

“Luo Feng.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled and said, “Did you expect this to happen?”

Golden Horned Beast blinked and recalled his conversation with Sitting Mountain Guest in the Beast God Sector. Luo Feng had asked whether it would take a trial for him to get the fifth black metal, and Sitting Mountain Guest had given him an ambiguous answer.

Luo Feng had been curious and kept asking, but Sitting Mountain Guest refused to answer him.

Outside the main palace of Blood Cloud Palace.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked at the endless black airflow in the space in the distance. Golden Horned Beast adjusted to the size of Sitting Mountain Guest and stood before him like a lion.

“Teacher, I didn’t expect Blood Cloud Palace Leader to be you,” said Golden Horned Beast body. “No wonder no one can deal with the Blood Cloud Palace.”

“Blood Cloud Palace is only a body I made.” Sitting Mountain Guest looked out into space and sighed. “Although it’s only a body, it’s as powerful as Primal Chaos City Leader. It’s enough to roam the universe.”

“Why were you posing as Blood Cloud Palace Leader?” Golden Horned Beast’s eyes glinted with confusion. Sitting Mountain Guest didn’t need any disguise, given his power.

“Because of you!” said Sitting Mountain Guest.

“Me?” The Golden Horned Beast was dazed.

Sitting Mountain Guest nodded. “Yes. To be exact, this is an identity I prepared specially for my third disciple. Whoever meets my requirement will inherit this position.”

“Blood Cloud Palace Leader…? Inherit it?” Golden Horned Beast was stupefied.

Damn! thought Luo Feng. Teacher is bringing me trouble! Blood Cloud Palace Leader is a maniac who has enemies all over creation! All the powers want nothing but his demise! And Teacher seems to want to have me inherit that position.

“Just as I cultivated your second brother,” Sitting Mountain Guest exclaimed, “I created another identity, Northern Prison Master! When your second brother is powerful enough, I’ll have him inherit that position.”

“What?” Golden Horned Beast was even more shocked.

Blood Cloud Palace Leader and Northern Prison Master! Both of them were bodies made by Sitting Mountain Guest?

Northern Prison Master was an evil supreme being who was as infamous as Blood Cloud Palace Leader. He had a flying-palace type true treasure, “Northern Prison,” that had the powers of sealing and suppression. When he fought his enemies, he liked trapping them inside the prison, and if they didn’t have the clone technique, they would have to resort to self-destruction! He was even more ancient than Blood Cloud Palace Leader—an evil being well-known at the beginning of the universe, but he disappeared afterward.

“I meant to have your second brother inherit the position of Northern Prison Master.” Sitting Mountain Guest shook his head. “However, he still fails to satisfy me after an eternity, which is why I made Northern Prison Master vanish. Your second brother is not qualified to be him.”

Luo Feng was startled. Made him vanish?

“I don’t have much hope for your second brother, which is why I devoted all my time and energies to you.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled and looked at Luo Feng.

“If second brother disappointed you, I might disappoint you someday,” Golden Horned Beast said and lowered his head.

Sitting Mountain Guest smiled. “You already proved that you’re better than your second brother when you successfully drove Star Tower. Star Tower is extremely powerful. Universe knights, universe masters, and even universe supreme masters don’t have a chance of using it. The weaker ones don’t have a strong enough willpower. It’s impressive of you to survive life or death inheritance as a sector lord. That said, although you are better than your second brother, you still haven’t met my goal.”

“Goal?” Golden Horned Beast looked at his teacher.

“Universe supreme master!” Sitting Mountain Guest said. This was the first time that he expressed his true will in front of Luo Feng. “When you become a universe supreme master, I’ll succeed. If your second brother becomes a universe supreme master, I’ll succeed as well. However, I don’t think it’s possible that he can become a universe supreme master, as he’s walked in a wrong path.”

Luo Feng was shocked. Both his oldest brother and second brother were universe masters, yet Sitting Mountain Guest was still disappointed and cultivated the third disciple. It turned out that Sitting Mountain Guest would like his disciple to become a universe supreme master! What a crazy idea!

There were only few universe supreme masters in the universe. A race would be a pinnacle race if it had just one universe supreme master! And a power would be a superpower if it had one! Even those universe supreme masters that roamed the universe alone were the greatest and eternal beings! It was already incredible that Sitting Mountain Guest could reach the level himself, but he wanted to make his disciple a universe supreme master! Crazy!

However, Luo Feng couldn’t help admiring his teacher. Sitting Mountain Guest did a wonderful job. He had cultivated the bloodline of the Flame God Race and earthlings, and he even made incredible true treasures like Force Armor and Original Soul, which were easy for him to create. He even created a supreme true treasure: Star Tower!

“It is extremely difficult to become a universe supreme master,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. “You’ll never become a universe supreme master if you keep practicing all by yourself! Each universe supreme master became one because of their experience and luck, but all of them became universe supreme masters through blood and fire! You can’t train yourself by excessive killings because of the bond you have with your race. Which is why I give you the identity of Blood Cloud Palace Leader! No one will know who you are, and your enemies are all around the universe… Once you show yourself up in the universe, all your enemies will race toward you.”

Sitting Mountain Guest gazed at Luo Feng. “You’ll grow with all the training you have from your enemies. This is the best way I know to cultivate a universe supreme master.”

“They’ll recognize me!” Golden Horne Beast blinked his eyes and was dazed.

“They won’t!” Sitting Mountain Guest waved his hands, and a bloody pearl showed up. “This is a special true treasure called ‘Blood Cloud Pearl.’ It can change your aura and even camouflage your armor. No one will be able to recognize you, and the flying-palace type true treasure Blood Cloud Palace will be yours too. Of course, if you disappoint me, I’ll take back Blood Cloud Palace and Blood Cloud Pearl as I did to your second brother.”

Sitting Mountain Guest gazed at Golden Horned Beast. “My disciple! It’ll be a new journey for you when you become Blood Cloud Palace Leader! Do you dare to accept it?”


Chapter 1100: Promise

The golden eyes of Golden Horned Beast glinted fiercely, “I do!”

Killing? A path of great beings? A new journey? It all sounded interesting!

“You crave for killing innately.” Sitting Mountain Guest gazed at Golden Horned Beast and nodded contently. “You’re a fit for Blood Cloud Palace Leader.” He threw out the Blood Cloud Pearl. “Seal your life imprint in it and control the pearl.”

Golden Horned Beast immediately penetrated Blood Cloud Pearl in the sky with a trace of his godly power, and the pearl recognized Luo Feng as its master instantly. Blood Cloud Pearl, a true treasure specially coined by Sitting Mountain Guest, had no information contained on it, and its function was peculiar.

Actually, many true treasures coined by Sitting Mountain Guest had peculiar attributes, like Original Soul and Force Armor. They all had strict conditions for users, and those who failed to meet the conditions were not able to use them, which showed the ability of Sitting Mountain Guest to coin true treasures.

Hu!

Golden Horned Beast opened his mouth, and the Blood Cloud Pearl flew inside.

Suddenly, the godly body of Golden Horned Beast started to change. His hind legs became longer and stronger while his chest and belly had more strength. The previously crouched creature became a standing one! There was a silver mask on his face, and there were two golden horns on his forehead. The scaled wings on his back immediately disappeared, and even the color of the Beast God Armor started to change slowly. It became a fiery cape, and a scaled tail extended out.

Endless killing power emanated from its body! Wicked! Mad! He became the shape of Blood Cloud Palace Leader.

“Hahaha! This Blood Cloud Pearl of mine. Isn’t it fantastic?” Mountain Sitting Guest stood aside and looked at the transformed body as if it were an exquisite piece of artwork.

“Incredible!” Luo Feng couldn’t help exclaiming. “Both my power and my aura are given out by Blood Cloud Pearl! It’s even able to change the structure of my godly body, but my power isn’t affected at all after turning from a Golden Horned Beast! It’s also able to camouflage my Beast God Armor. It’s magical.”

“I needed to kill a universe master to create the Blood Cloud Pearl,” Sitting Mountain Guest continued. “And I had to kill him by soul to preserve his godly body! Then, I used a large amount of material on his godly body to transform it into a Blood Cloud Pearl so that it could give out special power and aura! It’s even able to change your godly body into the structure I designed and camouflage a true treasure…”

Luo Feng was dazed.

Blood Cloud Pearl was a peculiar true treasure. It didn’t have any combat power, but it was desired by many supreme beings. However, Luo Feng didn’t expect it to require a universe master to be killed by soul before it could be created. Perhaps only universe supreme masters were able to do that.

“Remember!” Sitting Mountain Guest said. “Be careful when you use Star Tower. If you use Star Tower for attacks, it might not be identified by other great beings, but if you use it to flee, it’ll definitely be exposed.”

“I understand.” Luo Feng nodded.

Star Tower shrank to the size of a palm, taking the shape of a cone. It could be used as a horn. However, Luo Feng would need to enlarge Star Tower if he used it to run, and then it would be exposed.

“You’ll definitely expose yourself if you use it to save your life.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled. “Whether you use Star Tower as Blood Cloud Palace Leader or Luo Feng depends on you.”

Luo Feng nodded. If Luo Feng used Star Tower exposed and Blood Cloud Palace Leader used Star Tower exposed, he would basically be telling the universe that Luo Feng was Blood Cloud Palace Leader!

“There’s another valuable for you to save yourself, Blood Cloud Palace. I just took back my life imprint.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled. “And from now on, it belongs to you.”

“Blood Cloud Palace?”

Luo Feng turned around and looked at the towering palace. He immediately infused his godly power to the ground and sealed his life imprint in the palace. Blood Cloud Palace became a part of him, and everything inside the palace was under his control. He could even see the treasure vault inside.

“Blood Cloud Palace is a top-tier flying-palace type true treasure.” Sitting Mountain Guest said. “It’s extremely precious. Remember, you can use it only when you disguise yourself as Blood Cloud Palace Leader. Otherwise, your identity will be exposed.”

Luo Feng nodded.

“I hope I will not take it back someday.” Sitting Mountain Guest grinned.

“I am not my second brother,” Luo Feng replied.

“I’ll make you a promise, just as I did with your second brother. ”

“A promise?” Luo Feng listened carefully.

Sitting Mountain Guest smiled. “If you can kill ten top-tier universe overlords or one universe master when you’re a universe knight, I’ll coin a pinnacle true treasure for you with the material you give me. The material needed to make a pinnacle true treasure is one-tenth the worth of a pinnacle true treasure itself.”

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed. Pinnacle true treasures were desired even by Primal Chaos City Leader and Huge Axe Creator. Ancestor and Sitting Mountain Guest bet on valuables at this level as well.

“However, if you become a universe master, the conditions will be much demanding. You’ll need to kill at least 100 top-tier universe overlords or 10 universe masters before I make a pinnacle true treasure for you.” Sitting Mountain Guest smiled strangely. “When I say ‘pinnacle true treasures,’ that includes domain type true treasures and flying-palace type true treasures.”

Luo Feng’s eyes shone. Damn! The best true treasures currently owned by the human race were pinnacle domain type true treasures.

“I’ll make a list of the materials needed for the true treasure you want,” said Sitting Mountain Guest. “Don’t expect too much. The materials needed for pinnacle domain type true treasures are so scarce that even your race might not be able to gather it all.”

“They will,” Luo Feng said, feeling motivated.

“Remember, you need to kill 10 top-tier universe overlords or one universe master when you’re a universe knight, and if you become a universe master, the number will be tenfold.” Sitting Mountain Guest sighed. “I gave the promise to your second brother as well. He was already a universe master when he inherited the identity of Northern Prison Master, but he never met my conditions.”

Luo Feng was rendered speechless. Killing 10 universe masters? How demanding was that!

Power wasn’t all that mattered. Universe masters were experts at surviving. Even when it came to universe overlords, they were able to stall and call for help so that a supreme being or even a universe supreme master could arrive! After all, all of them had powers supporting them, and they would call for help if they knew their lives were at risk.

Even universe supreme masters would find it difficult to kill 10 top-tier universe masters. No wonder Flame Emperor had failed!

“I need to kill 10 top-tier universe overlords or one universe master?” Luo Feng exclaimed. “None of the top-tier universe overlords are easy to deal with, and they might even summon universe masters to save them. As for universe masters, the best I can do is to fight them. Kill them?”

The conditions Sitting Mountain Guest put forward were incredibly difficult to meet, but the promise enticed Luo Feng.

“My teacher just wants me to kill.” Luo Feng saw through Sitting Mountain Guest.

“This is Blood Cloud Token.” Sitting Mountain Guest threw out a red token.

“Servants?” Luo Feng was curious.

“When I created Blood Cloud Palace Leader, I saved some special life forms during my adventure in the universe. They all begged to recognize me as their master. I’m a special life form myself, so I wanted to protect them. The more time I spent, the more life forms I saved. 18 of them became universe knights under my instructions, and three of them are top-tier universe overlords. You can use the token to learn the basic information about the 18 universe knights. I’ve been protecting them for an eternity, and now, it’s your turn. Take care of them when you can.”

Sitting Mountain Guest paused for a moment. “Star Tower, Force Armor, and Blood Cloud Palace… You’ve got everything. And I’ve done everything I can. And now, you’re the one who can shape your future.”

Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Luo Feng, and then, he disappeared.

Luo Feng remained standing where he was. He felt the expectations in the look Sitting Mountain Guest gave him. Sitting Mountain Guest had cultivated Flame Emperor, and he was cultivating Luo Feng now. Apparently, he wanted a disciple who was a universe supreme master.

Perhaps there’s a secret behind this, Luo Feng thought.

Luo Feng immediately took up Blood Cloud Token. Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest asked him to take care of those special life forms as much as he could. He should definitely devote some effort to this. Luo Feng gave an order to the 18 servants through the token; he asked them to bring all the special life forms under them to see him in Blood Cloud Palace.

“Master wants to see us.”

“Quick.”

“You’re lucky, little one. Master is seeing you.”

“Ah! We’re only sector lords. Can we really see our master?”

Teams of special life forms in Ancient Chin Secret Region started to rush toward Blood Cloud Palace. It was like a pilgrimage to them. After all, Blood Cloud Palace Leader only stayed in contact with those 18 knights. Other special life forms had no way to contact the palace leader.

Blood Cloud Palace Master sat in his bloody throne, looking down upon them


Chapter 1101: The Bottleneck of Life Genes

Luo Feng sat on his throne and looked down at the numerous black figures kneeling before him. Thousands of special life forms were looking at him with surging emotions and worship… At that moment, a realization dawned on Luo Feng. These special life forms that seemed so uncommonly big and powerful shared a common grief… they were too weak and insignificant.

Because of the lures of high levels of life and talent techniques, billions of races within the universe were taking matters into their hands—to either enslave or soul transfer! A group of special life-forms without a strong protector would be quickly torn apart by the vast numbers of races in the universe who were blinded by greed! Devoured!

Back when Blood Cloud Palace Master ran rampant about the universe, there was still a substantial number of special life forms. When he saw these special life forms being hunted down and killed, his heart went out to them. So, group after group of special life-forms he rescued, until finally, he had gathered a group that amounted to a few thousand special life-forms! After countless years of growth, with Sitting Mountain Guest’s guidance, there were the births of top-tier universe lords such as Black Sky Horde Leader, Silver Dragon Knight, and Black Thorn Devil Master.

Back then, they would have probably met the fate of being hunted and killed. Of course, since that time long ago, any races of special life-forms without protectors had long vanished along the historical river of the universe—which was why some ancient beings like Primal Chaos City Leader owned quite a few special life form bodies. However, as time passed, during the times of later generations such as Luo Feng’s, it was rare to see special life forms due to soul transfer.

“Sitting Mountain Guest protected them, guarded them, guided them. He was just like a father to them…” Luo Feng said to himself. “No wonder they all call him ‘Master.’ They really respected and worshipped him from the bottoms of their hearts.”

As of today! thought Luo Feng. I am thus, Blood Cloud Palace Master. I may have gained a new power, but I have also rid a part of Earth’s. I have a new responsibility to take on.

Three top-tier universe overlords… This was indeed a force that many powers of the universe would covet! Especially Black Sky Horde Leader, whose godly powers were almost 100 times purer than those of Heavenly Yang Knight. Though both were senior true treasure armors, Luo Feng needed a force that was two levels higher than what he used to kill Tian Yang Knight in order to bring about the same attack power… and Black Sky Horde Leader’s godly body was millions of miles larger! That was billions of times bigger than the godly body of Tian Yang knight, which was not even 30 feet tall…

As for Silver Dragon Knight and Dark Thorn Devil Master, thought Luo Feng, their godly bodies were not as outrageously big, but neither were they small. With the three of them around, this force of special life-forms they make up—so long as they do not cross paths with universe masters—will be able to ward off attacks from any other opponents.

Luo Feng nodded as he analyzed the situation. Protecting such a force would not be as difficult as protecting his own kind on Earth. After all, this bloodline of special life forms had matured over countless years. They could protect themselves.

A sudden realization dawned upon Luo Feng. The reason the treasure vault contained so many precious materials, treasures, and ordinary true treasures, was because Luo Feng’s future opponents would be universe masters. If he used ordinary true treasures in a battle against a universe master, they would be shattered right away! Obviously, these ordinary true treasures were not what Sitting Mountain Guest had left for Luo Feng, but for this group of special life forms.

“Black Sky,” Luo Feng spoke.

“Master,” Black Sky Horde Leader replied politely.

Luo Feng looked down. “The true treasures that all 18 of you possess. Tell me about them.”

“Yes, Master. I have a senior true treasure armor, six senior true treasures heavenly hammers!” Black Sky Horde Leader then joked good-naturedly, saying, “Master, are you going to bestow me with a top-tier true treasure armor? Previously, you even said… the next time around, you would find a way to get me a top-tier true treasure, and you told me that if I owned a top-tier true treasure armor, even universe masters will find it difficult to kill me.”

Luo Feng was taken aback. Top-tier true treasure armor? Teacher had left him with a treasure vault that only contained about 100 ordinary true treasures.

Sitting Mountain Guest Teacher is so scheming, thought Luo Feng, grumbling to himself, but there was nothing he could do. Now that I have succeeded in the title of Blood Cloud Palace Master, the responsibility of designating valuables for the great beings under my command is also mine?

“I am thinking of a solution,” Luo Feng answered. “Top-tier true treasure armor is not easy to obtain.”

“Yes, but Master will be able to make that happen,” Black Sky Horde Leader said.

Luo Feng quickly moved on. “Next.”

Silver Dragon Knight, Dark Thorn Devil Master and the rest gave respective reports about their own true treasures, and Luo Feng discovered that these 18 universe knights all possessed true treasures, which were obviously obtained based on their personal capabilities. For instance, the three top-tier universe overlords owned senior true treasures, and each of them owned a few true treasures! Luo Feng had initial plans to bestow true treasures to them. Thus, he had to banish those plans. In the end, he could only bestow some other undying special life-forms with treasures before he concluded the meeting.

“This is a form of power,” Luo Feng said to himself. “Although I shoulder the responsibility of leading and guarding them, they can also help me with a lot of things. In the future, for my kind living on Earth, I would certainly be the one to protect them. Black Sky Horde Leader, together with this group of special life forms and the branch of life forms on Earth, should be able to complement each other.”

That very day, Luo Feng ordered all these special life-forms to retreat. And to Black Sky Horde Leader, Silver Dragon Knight, and Dark Thorn Devil Master, he commanded, “Black Sky, Silver Dragon, Dark Thorn, I need to make a trip out. Matters regarding those children in the ancient secret region. Please take care of them. If you all are unable to settle them, inform me.”
