“The power of a top-tier universe overlord’s godly body would probably be comparable to the rare special life forms, and he has the talent technique of dividing bodies,” the black sphere continued. “Just annihilating one of his godly bodies is useless. You need to penetrate the soul… and bring all the godly bodies to complete destruction. Or you can make use of soul control! But the difficulty of using soul control is obviously much higher. Stone, you are a universe supreme master of the school of illusions! If you are unable to succeed… then no other great being in this primal universe would be able to.”

“All right, I will set off now,” said the old man. “I know all of you must be waiting so impatiently.”

“I will be waiting for good news then.” The elliptical black sphere replied.

Hua!

The two disappeared together one after the other. A slight tremor shook the surrounding space, then everything resumed normality. The ordinary humans of this city were completely unaware of everything that had just happened.

In the Ancestral God secret region, in the void space surrounding Five-Color Aurora Lake, an entirely black life form was standing in the void space. There was a black aura surrounding it in winding paths, enveloping his entire being. Only a pair of black eyes could be seen, albeit indistinctly.

“The human Luo Feng? Meriting a universe supreme master to engage another universe supreme master to kill you… You should be proud of yourself.”

Redbud Island.

Luo Feng’s mansion was designed like a Jiang Nan garden, boasting features like small bridges and rivers, airy pavilions, and pagodas. Luo Feng was seated at the table of one of the pagodas, sipping wine as he pondered the beast god path. He really enjoyed the peaceful days where he could devote himself to cultivation wholeheartedly, yet he knew that in the Ancestral God School, he only appeared to be safe and sound.

But as time passed, bug soldiers, demons, and the automaton race alike were losing patience! As they watched him grow continuously, how would the other three pinnacle races take it lying down? They would definitely find a way to take him down.

As for him, he had the talent technique of dividing bodies, and if it was only a material attack on one of his bodies to annihilate it, they would not achieve the result they wanted. If they wanted to attack… they would definitely focus on his soul. They could either permeate his soul and perish as one with it—like how Soaring Star Master had died—or they could try controlling his soul.

With his original earthling body making such an apparent appearance, Luo Feng did not dare to act rashly. The soul type true treasure Tower Pearl and the pinnacle true treasure Force Armor were always with him. Force Armor also had the ability to weaken attacks on his soul. Most importantly, ordinary weaker kinds of soul type true treasures would shatter when being attacked by other soul type treasures. But Tower Pearl was the core control center of Star Tower, and it could recognize its master; even supreme true treasures could not cause it to shatter. Its defense level merely matched up to an ordinary true treasure, but it was definitely trustworthy.

Tower Pearl and Force Armor, in addition to my willpower and consciousness which were at the level of a universe master, Luo Feng calculated to himself.

His massive godly body and limitless godly power had given him a powerful consciousness! Countless ordeals, changes of life-and-death inheritances, and 180 million years of cultivation had brought his willpower to the level of a universe master! He could count on these advantages! Luo Feng was certainly confident enough!

While holding his wine glass, Luo Feng pondered the beast god path. Suddenly, he looked up at the sky and became aware that something was not quite right.

“Huh?”

The moment he looked up at the area in the sky that was enveloped by the Five-Color Aurora Lake, a figure surrounded by a limitless black airflow suddenly appeared.

Shrouded as the figure was by the airflow, Luo Feng’s view of him obscured. Only a pair of eyes could be seen. And what a pair of eyes it was! Just one look at them was enough to make Luo Feng shudder.

Not good…!

The shudders ran deep within him, right down to his very soul… and Luo Feng understood in an instant that this was a feeling of powerlessness he had only felt in the face of Star Ancestor and Sitting Mountain Guest.

“It’s a universe supreme being!” Luo Feng realized.

Hua!

Intangible attacks were launched!

Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

300 feet above Luo Feng, a gigantic crack suddenly appeared in the sky.

Wrong—it was not a crack. It was an impact brought about by the collision of two spaces!

All time and space in the surroundings of the figure enveloped by the black airflow fell under his control. Even the universe laws were dismissed. The figure enveloped by black airflow was in total control over everything. And similarly, the lower space was also being controlled. One up, one down; these two spaces collided at a mere 300 feet away from Luo Feng. It was a scene more frightening than the collisions of planets!

When the two spaces collided with one another, the two strong powers manipulated their own space. Wherever the two spaces collided, a crack would appear.

“What?” Luo Feng gasped.

Luo Feng was stupefied. His power far surpassed that of top-tier universe overlords and was comparable to universe masters. His willpower and consciousness were also extremely strong, so he could instantly conclude that in the lower space, there was another universe supreme master.

“Two universe supreme masters? Fighting each other?”

Luo Feng was at a loss for a reaction.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The skies above the Five-Color Aurora Lake were in a furious frenzy. It was Luo Feng’s first time witnessing how turbulent the lake could become. What was happening to the vast Five-Color Aurora Lake was a sight resembling that of heavenly lakes collapsing in an instant.

Hong! Long! Long!

Abundant rays of light came swooping down toward the space below, surging at the black, misty figure.

The black, misty figure did not budge an inch. Instead, a furious roar of rage was heard.

“Ancestor God!” the figure roared. “Are you going to stop me?”

“Virtual-Real Devil Master!” a booming voice replied. “This is the territory of my Ancestral God School!”


Chapter 1104: Ancestral God Fights Devil God

“Ancestral God?” Luo Feng looked to where the voice came from. A being flew up from an ordinary palace close to his palace. It was a great being of another race that was dozens of feet tall and had six arms. He was in human form with thick legs, but he had a face on each side of his head. The face at the front looked amiable with a smiled, yet the one at the back was dark and fierce.

Each of his six arms was grasping a short stick, and there were four sections on each stick, making them look like parrying daggers from Earth. Three of the parrying daggers were black while the other three were white, and power flowed around each parrying dagger.

“Ancestral God is living beside me?” Luo Feng was started. He had been practicing on Redbud Island for 62 years and hadn’t known that the Ancestral God was living beside him until now.

The amiable face of Ancestral God looked at the sky, and his voice was transmitted from the space and time under his control to the space and time under Virtual-Real Devil Master’s control.

“Virtual-Real Devil Master, get out!” he said. “I’ll pretend that you were never here.”

“Haha! It’s Double-Face Ancestral God!” said Virtual-Real Devil Master. “You dare to be so arrogant in front of me! Humph! I’ve never given a damn about your so-called Ancestral God School, and I always go wherever I want! Who can stop me? I’ll kill that human Luo Feng today, and you won’t be able to stop me!”

The space and time controlled by the being in the black mist were pushed down after his gloating.

Hong! Long!

The power from the space and time controlled by Devil Master was stronger.

Peng!

Double-Face Ancestral God looked up, and the space under his control also surged.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

When the two universe spaces clashed against each other, the Five-color Aurora Lake started to launch attacks. All the auroras shrank and merged together, forming a golden pillar. The universe space controlled by Virtual-Real Devil Master was slashed as if there were a gully.

“No wonder it’s a supreme true treasure.” Luo Feng looked up and was awed. “That universe space is completely under the control of Virtual-Real Devil Master, and even universe operation law has backed off! It’s more incredible than the control on time and space by universe masters, and it’s still powerless under a supreme true treasure.”

The golden pillar dashed down, and a dark space gully extended toward Virtual-Real Devil Master.

“Ha!” Virtual-Real Devil Master suddenly looked up, and black mist permeated. “Five-color Aurora Lake? Scram!”

Virtual-Real Devil master roared, and armor appeared that trembled the surrounding space. It was a mysterious suit of armor with blood stains on it. The armor integrated with each inch of the sky of Virtual-Real Devil Master.

A dark hollow that was more than 30 square feet appeared. The golden pillar kept bombarding Virtual-Real Devil Master, but the armor withstood it!

Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

Each inch of the space sparked like fireworks. The universe space controlled by Virtual-Real Devil Master crumbled into particles, yet the space controlled by the Ancestral God was stable.

Luo Feng saw Virtual-Real Devil Master clearly. Virtual-Real Devil Master fell a little bit, and the golden pillar was dissipated.

“Hahaha! I have a supreme true treasure to protect me!” Virtual-Real Devil Master said. “Nobody in the universe oceans can kill me! Let alone you, Double-Face Ancestral God!” He followed this sentiment by recklessly roaring, “Universe space, break!”

Hong!

The being in black mist dove, and his right foot stamped and ground! His right foot wore an ancient boot, which obviously was a component of a supreme true treasure. The ancient boot twisted the time and space under its impact. The flow of time was in disorder, and space was cracked.

Peng! Peng! Peng!

The space controlled by Ancestral God was also cracked, as he wasn’t able to resist that attack.

“Virtual-Real Devil Master, you’re being outrageous!”

Double-Face Ancestral God switched faces. The dark black face moved to the forefront and glared at Virtual-Real Devil Master. He roared in anger and flew up. Each of his arms was carrying a parrying dagger. With the daggers being waved, three black airflows and three white airflows were formed. They were combined and formed a complex black-and-white airflow picture!

The picture gushed, and the right foot stamped down!

Hong!

The moment they touched, the power of the supreme true treasure Virtual-Real Devil Master was carrying and the power all the six pinnacle true treasures carried by Ancestral God was merged… The attacking ability of the protection true treasure Virtual-Real Devil Master had was only an accessory, and the attacking power of it was not much different from the true treasures Ancestral God had.

“Virtual-Real, get the hell out!”

All six arms of Double-Face Ancestral God waved, and the attacks from each parrying dagger overlaid with each other, making them more powerful! The universe spaces controlled by them were trembling.

Luo Feng could feel the space around him trembling. He wanted secretly to run away. However, it was safest for him to stay in the time and space controlled by Ancestral God. Besides, two universe supreme masters were fighting, and the space and time controlled by them were unstable. He wasn’t able to leave using god country transportation!

I can’t even run away, he thought. There’s a universe supreme master trying to kill me.

Luo Feng gazed at the fight between the two universe supreme masters in the sky. Although the fight only affected the spaces controlled by them, the spaces were sometimes dismantled and became particles. And sometimes, the particles gathered again. He could feel how terrific it was. Virtual-Real Devil Master was using a supreme true treasure! Ancestral God was using six black-and-white parrying daggers! Perhaps universe masters could be killed!

“Virtual-Real Devil Master, don’t blame me! Five-color Aurora Lake!” Ancestral God roared.

Five-color Aurora Lake, which had been only partly utilized, immediately shrank. It was the guarding true treasure of the Ancestral God School that covered several square light years. But now, it was shrinking. All the auroras shrank to the size of rice grains, then formed a giant, five-colored blade.

“Cut!”

The five-color giant blade slashed down! The six parrying blades slashed at Virtual-Real Devil Master again…

“Damn Ancestral God! Damn you!” Virtual-Real Devil master bellowed.

He needed to defend himself from attacks from the five-color giant blade and the six parrying daggers from Ancestral God at once. He wasn’t able to handle them at the same time and got hit several times, which consumed his godly body.

“You’re pushing me!” Virtual-Real Devil Master raised his head and roared. “Ahhhhh!” The space around him cracked.

Ancestral God bounced away. The giant blade couldn’t get close.

Neither Ancestral God nor the five-color giant blade could get close, and the force from Virtual-Real Devil Master was inconceivably strong, which stunned Luo Feng who was watching down there. Rumor had it that universe supreme masters were restricted by the universe operation, and thus, they could only show power that was slightly stronger than universe masters. How could they be that strong! Neither Ancestral God nor the supreme true treasure could get close.

“Virtual-Real Devil Master, this is the original universe!” Ancestral God shouted.

“Ya!”

Virtual-Real Devil Master looked omnipotent. He disregarded the five-color giant blade and dove down. At the same time, a golden chain showed up in the space, and it bound the arm of Virtual-Real Devil Master, making it difficult for him to hit down.

“No!” Virtual-Real Devil Master was terrified.

Another green chain extended from space and entangled the other arm of Virtual-Real Devil Master. A navy blue chain extended from space… Chains continued to come out of space, bearing down Virtual-Real Devil Master.

“Damn it!” Virtual-Real Devil master roared, exasperated. However, his force got weaker and weaker, and the chains stopped giving out power as he grew weaker.

Virtual-Real Devil Master looked down. “Double-Face Ancestral God, this is the original universe! You’re not my match in Universe Ocean!”

Double-Face Ancestral God looked up. “Unfortunately for you, you’re in the original universe now! Each of us three Ancestral Gods can outpower you! In the original universe, nobody can challenge us! We’re the guardians of universe operation law, and we’re given grace by the universe origin. Give up! Do you want to challenge the universe origin?”

Virtual-Real Devil Master glared down. Double-Face Ancestral God glared up.

“Good,” Virtual-Real Devil Master snorted. “You’ll learn the consequences in Universe Ocean.”

“We never go to Universe Ocean!” said Double-Face Ancestral God.

Virtual-Real Devil Master clenched his teeth. The Ancestral God School couldn’t roam the Universe Ocean, but it was sitting in the crown in the original universe.

“Little one,” said Virtual-Real Devil Master. He glanced at Luo Feng, who was in shock. “You got lucky today!”

Hong!

Virtual-Real Devil Master surged much faster than light. He broke out of the Five-Color Aurora Lake and disappeared.

The shattered universe space went back to being peaceful, and nothing on Redbud Island was damaged. Other candidates only felt the space trembling. They had no idea what had just happened.

Luo Feng stared at the sky. Both Ancestral God and Virtual-Real Devil Master had disappeared.

Then Luo Feng heard the voice of Ancestral God. “Come here, Luo Feng.”


Chapter 1105: Virtual-Real Devil Master

By the side of the railings of the pagoda, Luo Feng turned to look down. There, he saw, right in the middle of his courtyard, Double-Face Ancestor God.

“Ancestor God.” With a flash, Luo Feng reached the side of the other party.

Double-Face Ancestor God was fair-skinned and benevolent-looking. As he looked at Luo Feng, Luo Feng felt as though he were basking in a spring breeze, and he started to thank Ancestor God repeatedly, “Thank you for coming to my rescue, Ancestor God.”

Five-Color Aurora Lake enveloped the core ground of the entire Ancestral God School. When it suddenly disappeared, many islands, Eight Beast God Palace, Guarding Beast God Palace, 72 General Continent, and many others were quick to notice its absence. When a predominating treasure like Five-Color Aurora Lake went missing, wouldn’t it consider that a major event?

Even though everything returned back to normal very quickly, it still sparked an endless debate. The Ancestral God School had many peripheral members who normally lived on other islands. They were all discussing this proactively. At the same time, they were secretly sending news back to the powers behind them!

“Five-Color Aurora Lake is a supreme true treasure. Barring a critical moment, it would be impossible to get it to unleash its full potential. Normally, just a little aurora is enough to annihilate enemies.”

“For it to instantly disappear, Five-Color Aurora Lake must be putting in its all and doing everything it can.”

“Who could cause this?”

“Who provoked Five-Color Aurora Lake into retaliation at full might?”

Though they were peripheral members, the possibilities included Jiu Feng Knight, who might be a candidate for the post of Heavenly General. But such individuals would definitely pledge their loyalty to their human race! Who would have provoked Five-Color Aurora Lake?

With Ancestral God School as the core grounds, the news was secretly and rapidly disseminated.

“The predominating treasure of Ancestral God School, Five-Color Aurora Lake, was activated once, then it disappeared within an instant, but was recovered to original state within a fleeting moment.”

“Something major must have happened.”

“Pushed to such extremes, could it be a universe supreme being has barged its way into the core grounds of Ancestral God School?”

The other eight of the top nine powers of the universe were no fools. Each came to a conclusion quickly, especially the top three powers—the bug soldiers, the demons, and the automaton race— who were waiting quietly and expectantly. Upon enlisting the help of Virtual-Real Devil Master, Father God of the automaton race had notified the demons and bug soldiers that he had invited a universe supreme being to take up the matter.

“It must be the killing of Luo Feng that incurred the wrath of the Ancestral God School.”

“Haha! So long as Luo Feng is eliminated, with that hard stone’s ability, it would be able to take its leave easily.”

News spread to the outside world rapidly, but Luo Feng was oblivious. He did not have an inkling of what was going on because Redbud Island was within the universe that was under the control of Double-Face Ancestor God, so the candidates on Redbud Island were unaware of the sudden, momentary disappearance and reappearance of the Five-Color Aurora Lake.

“What!” Luo Feng could not suppress his shout of surprise. “Ancestor God, you—you have been protecting me…?”

“Hahaha…” Double-Face Ancestor God smiled and said, “I was the undying demon staying next to you, I transformed into that appearance so no one on Redbud Island would discover my true identity.”

Images of an undying demon in the form of a two-headed white wolf immediately sprang up in Luo Feng’s mind. That was him?

“If I were not staying next to you and you were to meet with sudden danger, how would I be able to come to your rescue in time? I couldn’t have done it from my Ancestor God Palace.” Double-Face Ancestor God smiled. “Virtual-Real Devil Master has extremely strong powers. He could appear on Redbud Island in an instant. If I had been at Ancestor God Palace, by the time I realized he was here, even if I did my best to rush here… I’m afraid I still would have been too late to save you from annihilation—or to save you from being controlled by another soul.”

“Being controlled by a soul?” Luo Feng’s brow twitched.

Based on what he knew, a universe supreme being was merely one notch stronger than the strongest universe master. The difference was not all that far apart. Luo Feng’s willpower and consciousness were at the universe master level. Furthermore, he had Force Armor to reduce attacks on his soul, and he had one of the components of his supreme true treasure Star Tower, “Tower Pearl,” to guard his soul. With those, he assumed he would not be that weak.

“Don’t believe me?” Double-Face Ancestor God said. He looked at Luo Feng and shook his head laughingly. “He is called Virtual-Real Devil Master. The ‘virtual-real’ part of his name comes from the fact that he possesses the skill of creating illusions which are identical to reality.”

“Illusions? Identical to reality?” Luo Feng was secretly in shock.

“The moment you fall into an illusion he created, you will still feel the universe laws in motion, you can still cultivate… and in the process of cultivation, you can still master the skill of law comprehension. Everything is perfectly real.” Double-Face Ancestor God smiled at Luo Feng, “Of course, once you are able to break free from the illusion, you will realize that you have not undergone any change, only your willpower and memory will have some changes. Of course, the laws that you have cultivated within the illusion must be one of those that he personally knew of. If he didn’t know the laws, he wouldn’t have enabled you to cultivate.”

Luo Feng was stunned.

Cultivating laws within an illusion? This bore a resemblance to the virtual universe.

Actually, the virtual universe allowed countless life forms to enter at any one point in time, and within the virtual universe, any kind of law could be cultivated; there was almost no difference from the real world. A true super great being could clearly differentiate the virtual world from the real world without confusion. Only the ordinary humans who were weaker, and who were immersed in virtual games on a long-term basis would confuse the real and virtual worlds as time passed. However, the moment one’s willpower got stronger, the confusion would stop.

There was a fundamental difference between the virtual universe and an illusion. The virtual universe was open and aboveboard, like another universe—the universe of consciousness.

“Once you fall into his illusion, you may feel as though a short instant in the actual, real world was equivalent to tens of thousands of years, or even more, in the illusionary world,” Double-Face Ancestor God explained.

Luo Feng was appalled and commented, “Could this time be used for cultivation? This would be a very smart way of saving time.”

“No.” Double-Face Ancestor God walked along the stoned pavement encircling the pond and said, “Sustaining an illusion consumes a large amount of godly power. Besides, he has to give his best; getting an ordinary human to fall into an illusion and sustaining it for a long time is easy. But, getting a universe master to fall into an illusion and make him feel as though 10,000 years have passed within the blink of an eye… The amount of godly power needed is truly unbelievable. How can it be used for cultivation? Moreover, the path of your choice may not be familiar to Virtual-Real Devil Master. His strongest ability is illusion. I have lived by your side for 62 years. Having observed you for so long, I can also judge that your willpower and consciousness must have already reached the level of a universe master; your godly body is probably comparable to the special life forms that were one of a kind.”

Luo Feng was in great shock. How frightening! He had not engaged in any battle and was only observing, completely in the dark. After a long period of watching Luo Feng, Double-Face Ancestor God had been able to make a judgment about his level of power. Even Primal Chaos City Leader Teacher could only make a judgment if Luo Feng was in the primal universe.

“For a soul to kill you would be as difficult as trying to kill a universe master,” said Double-Face Ancestor God. “But Virtual-Real Devil Master can achieve that. His ability to create illusions is horrifying. Given the willpower and consciousness of a universe master, at the very least, he would have to possess a top-tier soul type true treasure in order to not be fearful of Virtual-Real Devil Master. This is the strength of his ability under a certain amount of restraint upon being suppressed by the universe origins.”

“A top-tier soul type true treasure?” Luo Feng held his breath.

A top-tier soul type true treasure was comparable to the value of a pinnacle true treasure. Among all the universe masters, a great majority did not own one.

“You have to know that among the universe supreme beings, he has the most frightening skills when it comes to illusions.” Double-Face Ancestor God looked at Luo Feng. “In the case of an ordinary soul type true treasure, his blurry godly power can tear it apart any moment; as for a senior soul type true treasure, they are also defenseless against him. These victorious moments are proven proved by his credentials.”

Luo Feng nodded and made sure he remembered all this information well. This information was considered confidential. For Double-Face Ancestor God to tell him all this was indeed an act of great kindness. Actually, for Double-Face Ancestor God to be willing to stay in solitude beside him for 62 years meant that, during the times when he gained fame—leading to him being hunted down by bug soldiers, demons, and the automaton race—Double-Face Ancestor God had already been living a secluded life beside him.

“Force Armor can only weaken the force by one level; with Tower Pearl alone, is it not enough?”

Seems to me I must bring Star Tower with me at all times, Luo Feng told himself.

The moment Tower Pearl returned to Star Tower, the latter would shrink and park itself within Luo Feng’s godly body. Then, it would naturally be guarding his soul!

Star Tower consisted of various functional components like attacking, soul type, flying palace type, sealing type, and many more. He might only have the soul type component, but with the entire Star Tower within his body, according to Luo Feng’s assessment, it should be comparable to a pinnacle soul type true treasure. Or, at the very least, Luo Feng felt it would make a difference.

Just as what Sitting Mountain Guest said, with Star Tower, he would fear no one! The best form of defense would be to hide within Star Tower!

Regardless of material or soul attack, Star Tower would be able to ward off everything! If he hid within it, even a universe supreme master would not be able to do anything to him! But of course, doing so would only reveal the fact that he owned Star Tower, which would arouse the greed of the group of universe pinnacle great beings. There was no way one could be on guard against theft day in and day out. Once a universe supreme being started eyeing him, there was no way he could possibly remain within Star Tower all the time. Any moment of carelessness would spell danger.

Next time around, I have to put Star Tower within my godly body, to guard and protect my soul. I have underestimated the universe supreme beings. It was said that a universe supreme being was only slightly stronger than the most powerful universe master—just a hit stronger. But I did not expect them to be so powerful. Seems like… I have also underestimated the powers of universe masters.

Luo Feng had always thought that after he became a universe knight, he would be able to compete head-to-head with a universe master.

A sudden realization dawned on Luo Feng. Among universe masters, there were stronger ones and weaker ones, too! He could probably stand against the weaker ones. However, for the strong ones like Primal Chaos City Leader—who was only a small fraction less powerful than Virtual-Real Devil Master, judging from Virtual-real Devil Master’s showcase of skills—the strongest of all top-tier universe masters was certainly much stronger than he was.

The supreme true treasure Star Tower guards the soul, thought Luo Feng. Force Armor protects the body. With a godly body more than 55,000 miles tall, even a universe supreme being should not be able to harm me. Hmm. I have to hurriedly get Star Tower back.

Luo Feng had gotten too complacent. The showcase of power by a universe supreme being this time around had sobered him up.

Double-Face Ancestor God turned to look at Luo Feng. “Word of you killing Flourishing Light Horde Leader and Para-chopper Knight has spread, especially when you turned up at Redbud Island. I proceeded to discuss your situation with two other ancestor gods. The bug soldiers, the automaton race, and the demons would stay away for the moment, but as time passed, we knew they would probably close in on you. Therefore, the second day after you arrived at Redbud Island, I started living in the palace next to your mansion.”

“Thank you Ancestor God.” Luo Feng expressed his gratitude.

This kind sentiment… He had to put it to heart! Kindness begot kindness!

“It has been a long time since a promising being such as yourself has turned up at the Ancestral God School,” said Double-Face Ancestor God. “Your potential is much stronger than Purple Knight.” He smiled at Luo Feng, then added, “We at the Ancestral God School hope that you will grow and mature to a stage where you are comparable to your teacher, Primal Chaos City Leader. At that time, the Ancestral God School will bestow you with the title of Guarding Godly Master.”


Chapter 1106: Universe’s Favor

“Guarding Godly Master?”

Luo Feng was startled. Nine Remoteness Master was a Guarding Godly Master of Ancestral God School. Guarding Godly Masters were the top seniors among the sub-members of the Ancestral God School, and they were at the same level as Beast Gods.

No wonder they’ve been helping me like that. It’s because they want me to be a Guarding Godly Master, Luo Feng thought. I still need a supreme true treasure to protect me when I am dealing with universe supreme masters! However, if I become a universe master, my godly power will surge again, and so will my willpower. After that, I won’t need a soul type true treasure to defend myself against an illusion by Virtual-Real Devil Master.

Luo Feng was indeed powerful, and he wanted to fight universe masters. However, he still needed Star Tower to protect his life when he came across universe supreme masters. Sitting Mountain Guest was indeed accurate about him. He had said that Luo Feng could roam the universe as long as he had Star Tower, and a different translation of that was that Luo Feng did still have to fear some beings without it.

Though Luo Feng understood that the Ancestral God School had protected him for their own benefit, he was still grateful. After all, they did this because they thought highly of Luo Feng. Besides, based on the information he collected, there were no confrontations between the Ancestral God School and the human race, and the Ancestral God School promised before that human sub-members wouldn’t be required to fight the human race, and sub-members could refuse to accept a particular task.

“Virtual-Real Devil Master came after you once, so you know how much the bug race, automaton race, and demon race want you dead.” Double-Face Ancestral God gazed at Luo Feng. “Think carefully about what you should do.”

“I know.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Of course, don’t be worried, either,” said Double-Face Ancestral God. “Virtual-Real Devil Master is a universe supreme master. Since he failed, at least we know he won’t come here and try to kill you again. As for asking another universe supreme master, that’s not easy. The bug race, automaton race, and demon race might not be willing to. They failed the first time, and if they try it and fail again, it’s like giving out true treasures for free.” Double-Face Ancestral God smiled. “Think about what you should do. I’ll go back to the Ancestral God Palace.”

Double-Face Ancestral God turned around and walked away.

After three steps, his shape was blurred.

“Back to Ancestral God Palace?” Luo Feng nodded. Of course. He was an Ancestral God, and he had been doing him a large favor by disguising himself beside him. He couldn’t be his spy forever.

“I’ll go back to my god country first.”

Luo Feng turned around and walked back to his palace. Then he left Redbud Island and went back to his god country.

In his god country, the boundless Remote Ocean was sensing the universe origin and absorbing godly power. After all, only one-eighth of the ocean had finished being transformed when turning to a universe knight…

“Star Tower,” said Luo Feng. He wore his silver armor and silver wings and was standing atop the ocean.

Golden Horned Beast flew toward him. It became a Golden Horned Beast a million miles long with a huge Star Tower on its head. The Golden Horned Beast had been studying the engravings on Star Tower for all these years. The engravings were extremely intricate, which baffled people! Luo Feng was only able to recognize three levels and fully comprehend the first level.

“Come.” Luo Feng reached out his hands.

Hua!

Star Tower flew toward him, shrinking, and fell into his palm.

“Guard the soul.”

Star Tower went into Luo Feng’s body and floated at the center of Luo Feng’s chest. Tower Pearl flew back to Star Tower. The Tower Pearl itself was able to guard the soul. As for the complete Star Tower, it was much more efficient at guarding the soul.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Countless threads spread from Star Tower like a net coming from Star Tower. They covered Luo Feng, and each trace of godly power had its life imprint protected. Luo Feng was awed. Tower Pearl was like a giant boulder guarding the soul, yet Star Tower was more like a towering mountain. Even now, it felt much more stable.

“No wonder it’s a supreme true treasure.”

Luo Feng was pleased. It was known that a supreme true treasure could be a guarding treasure, but even some universe supreme masters didn’t have supreme true treasures.

“I still need to be careful even if the first universe supreme master failed.” Luo Feng immediately connected to the virtual universe with his mind. “I tried to search for the information about universe supreme masters before, but I couldn’t. Now that I’ve been deemed a top-tier universe overlord, my access authority should be higher.”

Inside Luo Feng’s habitation on Thunder Island, in a quiet palace.

Luo Feng stared at the screen in front of his desk.

“My access authority is indeed high.”

Luo Feng smiled. Last time, he had the access authority of a secondary universe knight. This time, Luo Feng had the access authority of a seven-star universe overlord.

“Master,” Babata replied. This was, of course, a subsidiary intelligent part of Babata, while the original body was training on the earth. Babata had become undying with the resources provided by Luo Feng. However, undying fighters were too weak to meddle in the sort of the fights Luo Feng was dealing with. That was why he still stayed on the earth. Babata did, however, provide a great deal of help for Luo Feng’s family.

“Search for universe masters and universe supreme masters,” said Luo Feng.

“Yes.”

Hua!

Information showed up on the screen. Luo Feng clicked on the first result, as it usually contained the most information.

“It’s indeed different to have the access authority of a seven-star universe overlord. I can learn many top-tier secrets.” Luo Feng smiled and kept reading.

All the creatures in the universe were children of the universe, and the universe loved them. Special life forms had eternal lives when they were first born. Ordinary life forms, however, had to become undying before they had eternal lives. Otherwise, they would die. There was no need to elaborate on non-undying. Undying fighters were those who fully comprehended the easiest laws and gained eternal lives with the help of law ocean.

Universe knights were those who had fully comprehended space law or time law. They had stronger godly bodies and had high law comprehension.

As for universe masters, they had fully comprehended one of the merge laws… Once becoming a universe master, they would be able to control space and time.

These were all gifts from the universe. Undying fighters, universe knights, and universe masters… The universe origin was bestowing them with endless godly power! And perhaps inherited techniques, complete control over space and time, and the power to turn back time. The universe origin would still treat universe masters as their children and take care of them. And it wouldn’t disturb their training.

However, there was no clear way to become a universe supreme master! All the methods they tried before would be rendered useless! Other great beings couldn’t follow the same path to become universe supreme masters.

Besides, after all the efforts, wisdom, and luck, universe supreme masters were able to control the law. They could even make their own laws! As such, they would be suppressed and constrained by the universe.

The universe would take care of a being when it became a universe master from a weaker one. However, universe supreme masters were constrained by the universe—so constrained that they could only wield power slightly stronger than the most powerful universe masters! Regardless, they were so powerful that it was easy for them to resurrect universe overlords.

Besides, if a universe supreme master killed a universe knight or a universe master, they would be punished because universe knights and universe masters were protected by the universe. And the more powerful the knight or master they killed, the more severe the punishment would be.

The punishment of killing a universe overlord was nothing to a universe supreme master. Killing a universe master would be costly.

As for universe masters like Primal Chaos City Leader or Nine Remoteness Master, even universe supreme masters could try to kill them without worrying about the punishment. They wouldn’t be able to do so, as they could only wield limited power.

Luo Feng was dazed. “The universe favors and nourishes everything,” he murmured. “However, after becoming a universe supreme master, one will be suppressed and constrained. And killing universe knights and universe masters is punishable… So bizarre. They’re all lives born in the primal universe, and they’re all nourished and cared for. However, once someone becomes a universe supreme master, he will be suppressed. And each universe supreme master needs to find his own way to make a breakthrough?”

Luo Feng realized that universe supreme masters must have a bigger secret—a secret regarding why the original universe tried to suppress them. However, his access authority was not yet high enough for him to know about this secret.


Chapter 1107: Disguise

Luo Feng leaned back and put his legs on the desk. He kept his eyes closed and reviewed what he had just read about universe masters and universe supreme masters.

“There are differences between the power of universe masters, and it’s difficult for a universe master to kill another one unless there is a huge gap of power between them. As for universe supreme masters, they’re slightly stronger even than the most powerful universe masters, but they’re rare. There is only one universe supreme master within our race, and he is Huge Axe Creator! Besides, if they kill universe masters, they’ll be punished by the universe… Which makes it extremely difficult for universe masters to die!”

Luo Feng nodded. It didn’t necessarily mean that their power prevented them from dying. But apparently, this was one of the reasons it was unlikely. Aside from that, some supreme beings weren’t willing to act on something unless the valuables were attractive enough—such as the fights for true treasures on the original stars. Those were some of the only scenarios that would lead to the deaths of universe masters.

“What should I do? The automaton race, demon race, and bug race asked a universe supreme master to kill me. What should I do?”

Luo Feng kept thinking. Even a fool could tell that Virtual-Real Devil Master had been hired by the bug race, demon race, and automaton race.

“Ancestral God defended me this time. However, he can’t keep being my bodyguard. What am I going to do next time? Although it’s almost impossible for the three races to invite a universe supreme master to attack me again, they might be more well-prepared next time. It’s certainly not outside the realm of possibility.”

Luo Feng frowned. It was tricky. He had a supreme true treasure, Star Tower, and he didn’t need to be afraid of universe supreme masters! But it was also a problem for him! How could he defend himself against a universe supreme master? Was a top-tier universe overlord able to resist a universe supreme master? What a joke! If he did, everyone would be able to figure out that he must own an incredible true treasure; otherwise, there would be no way he could survive against a universe supreme master.

“If a universe supreme master comes to kill me and Ancestral God can’t stop him in time, my secret will be exposed.”

Luo Feng kept thinking. He wouldn’t just die that easily. If pressed, he would fight! And if he survived against a universe supreme master, everyone would figure out that he had an incredible valuable. Besides, the disappearance of Star Tower had led to turmoil in the universe, and if Luo Feng could survive against a universe supreme master, many would surmise that Luo Feng had something to do Star Tower.

“If that happens, I’ll be in deep trouble,” he mumbled. “Perhaps there are quite a few universe supreme masters who have their eyes on Star Tower, and if they speculate that I took it, they’ll come after me. They won’t need the request of the bug race, demon race, or automaton race. Then what would I do? Hide? I’m not going to live in Star Tower forever!”

Luo Feng kept contemplating with his eyes closed.

There are two ways, he decided. One, I hide in the original universe until I become a universe master. However, it is extremely difficult to turn into a universe master from a universe knight. I might not be able to make it even if I spend another 180 million years. Besides, the longer it takes, the more anxious and angrier those three alliances will get. They might even attack my family.

The fight among great beings rarely involved families, but this guideline only applied to the human race! However, killings among races were ruthless, as the ultimate goal was to annihilate the enemy races! They would go to any lengths! Remote Ocean body, who was more powerful than top-tier universe overlords, was guarding Earth, and it was heavily defended. Unless a universe master was sent out…

Second, I can trick them into thinking that I’m a universe master! Luo Feng thought. Why are they so keen to kill me? Because they’re afraid I’ll become a universe master… If they believe I already am a universe master, they’ll regret that they didn’t kill me earlier. Even if they want to ask a universe supreme leader to kill me, they won’t agree to do so as easily, as the punishment for killing a universe master is really heavy.

Two options… Luo Feng immediately eliminated the first possibility, as he didn’t know how long it would take him to become a universe master… Plenty of universe knights remained stuck at the universe-overlord level for an eternity! Besides, he hadn’t even completed the fifth level of the beast god path yet! It’d take him a very long time to complete the seventh level of the beast god path. Besides, Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest also didn’t want him to hide and train himself. Instead, he wanted him to fight to improve himself. He might never become a universe master if he just kept practicing in a safe place.

“I can only choose the second option,” said Luo Feng. “Okay. I’ll disguise myself as a universe master.”

My godly body is very close to that of a universe master.

Based on the information he gathered, a godly body would surge 100 times when someone turned from a universe knight to a universe master, which meant the weakest universe masters’ godly bodies were as powerful as universe knights with life gene level of 10,000 times!

Godly bodies are equal, thought Luo Feng. And my mind and willpower are at universe-master level. So are my techniques. He nodded. I have a pinnacle technique of universe masters, Golden Mountain, and an ultimate technique of universe masters, Golden Light. If I perform these two techniques often, I’ll demonstrate that I have the power of a universe-master! The only weakness is that I’m not able to control a space and time.

Control over space and time could both suppress enemies. And it could also be used to reverse time to resurrect some universe knights and undying fighters.

The fights between universe masters are so intense that control over space and time is useless. It’s only used to restrain the weak. No one will force me to resurrect anyone by turning back time.

“Okay,” Luo Feng said with a nod.

It was completely feasible. The most convincing one was his techniques. He needed to perform his universe-master level techniques Golden Mountain and Golden Light more often to let more supreme beings know. They would quickly see that they were techniques of the universe master level, and engraving-picture path was obviously a secret! Only universe masters were able to create ultimate techniques of universe masters; this was common sense in the original universe—without knowledge of engraving-picture path.

“I can totally do it!” Luo Feng nodded. “I just need to prove it by fighting.”

Since Luo Feng was determined to make all the races in the universe believe that he was a universe master, he needed to prove it in battle! And the fights needed to be credible!

“Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest wanted me to kill ten universe overlords or one universe master, and if I can accomplish that, he’ll make me a pinnacle true treasure. I can’t guarantee that I can kill a universe master, as I’ve never fought one, and I might not be able to control it. I can’t make any mistakes. It needs to be a perfect fight! I need to thrill all the races and convince them that I’m a universe master! I need to let the bug race, the demon race, and the automaton race believe that I’ve become a universe master and that it will be costly to kill me!”

Luo Feng stood up immediately. “Babata!” he shouted.

The intelligent life form answered, “Master?”

“Gather all the information on the top-tier universe overlords from demon race, the automaton race, and the bug race, and the top-tier universe overlords of the alliances they belonged to. I’ll read all the information and pick some to fight.” He had decided to pick from the three races.

“Yes, Master!”

Hua!

After only a short while…

“All the information has been gathered,” said Babata. “The information is very detailed. It includes their past, their fighting records, their power, and the true treasures they have.”

“I’ll read them one by one,” said Luo Feng.

Just when Luo Feng was choosing his prey, he received an email from Primal Chaos City Leader. It simply read, “Come!”

Luo Feng immediately stopped and rushed to the godly palace where Primal Chaos City Leader was staying.

Endless air permeated, and a round table that looked like jade was placed in front of the godly palace. There were two beings sitting there. One of them was Primal Chaos City Leader while the other was a giant man with a dragon tail who wore baggy armor. He sat there like a mountain.

Luo Feng immediately realized that he was also a universe master.

“Luo Feng, this is Long Yan Master,” Primal Chaos City Leader said when he saw Luo Feng.

“Teacher, Long Yan Master.” Luo Feng gave a salutation.

“Luo Feng.” Primal Chaos City Leader turned around. “I called you here for something vital. Based on our intelligence, something big happened in the Ancestral God School. The supreme true treasure Five-Color Aurora Lake suddenly disappeared before it showed itself again, yet no candidates on Redbud Island know what happened. Do you know what that means? That means a space and time were controlled, and none of the great beings knew what happened.”

“Though universe masters are able to control space and time, they’re not capable of doing that,” continued Primal Chaos City Leader. “Only universe supreme masters can! Universe supreme masters cover everything, and that Five-Color Aurora Lake disappeared. It’s likely that a universe supreme master trespassed in the center of the Ancestral God School.”

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng. “Did that universe supreme master go after you?”


Chapter 1108: Sky Flower Knight

The moment the higher-ups of the human race like Primal Chaos City Leader caught wind of the news, they deduced that the intruder on Redbud Island must have been a universe supreme being, that was the first thought that immediately came to their minds… The bug clan, demon clan, and automaton race already wanted to eliminate Luo Feng, and he was on Redbud Island all this while. When backed into a corner, the three pinnacle races would go for the most reliable method—getting a universe supreme being to do the killing. This was a possibility!

Once they arrived at this conclusion, Primal Chaos City Leader was quite shaken. Fortunately, Luo Feng’s consciousness was always connected to the virtual universe, so Primal Chaos City Leader was aware that Luo Feng was alive! That was when he could calm himself down.

However, Primal Chaos City Leader was also confused… If a universe supreme being was there to kill Luo Feng, then there should not have been any chance of failure unless Luo Feng was fast enough to self-destruct! If killing Luo Feng was not the motive, then what was going on?

“That universe supreme being was Virtual-Real Devil Master,” Luo Feng said in a respectful manner.

“Virtual-real Devil Master?” Long Yan Master and Primal Chaos City Leader were flustered.

“Indeed, he came to Redbud Island to kill me.”

Luo Feng considered for a short while, then decided to tell them the truth. After all, from a normal perspective, he was an up-and-coming great being among the humans; if the bug soldiers, demons, and automaton race were doing all they could to eliminate him, then naturally, the human race would do all they could to protect him.

He was a target for assassination by a universe supreme being, so by right, the human race should be doing something to help him. To depend solely on himself for a hard fight should not be necessary. He would first see what the race would do.

“He was there to kill you?” Primal Chaos City Leader asked with a trace of fervor in his eyes.

“If Virtual-Real Devil Master made a trip personally, how did you manage to escape?” Long Yan Master could not help asking.

Primal Chaos City Leader said, “If Virtual-Real Master was there, given his power, the island master of Redbud Island would not have been able to stop him. As for your Ancestor God from the Ancestral God School, he may not be able to make it in time to stop him… How could you…?”

“Teacher, it was Ancestor God who saved my life,” Luo Feng informed them.

Long Yan Master and Primal Chaos City Leader exchanged eye contact. Both of them had reached a conclusion based on the information they received. Being able to make use of the Five-Color Aurora Lake without being discovered by any of the candidates on Bauhinia Island was a feat that only Ancestor God could achieve. What neither could comprehend was how Ancestor God could have made it there in time to intervene. Battles among the great always happened at breakneck speed!

“If it wasn’t for Ancestor God, I’m afraid…” Luo Feng shook his head as he recalled. “Since the time I gained recognition as a top-tier universe overlord and first arrived at Redbud Island, Ancestor God has been secretly staying in seclusion by my side. For 62 years, he has been my neighbor.”

“Ah.”

“Neighbor?”

Long Yan Master and Primal Chaos City Leader were taken aback, shocked that Ancestor God held Luo Feng with such high regard and was willing to be his bodyguard. He was, after all, the greatest authority in the entire Ancestral God School… This was such a beautiful gesture, for the highest being of the top power of the universe to stay by his side for so long, just to protect him in the dark. It was a gesture that would touch anyone’s heart.

“Where are you now?” Primal Chaos City Leader asked right away.

“For now, I am temporarily out of Redbud Island,” Luo Feng replied.

“You had better not go back yet. The bug soldiers, automaton race, and demons may have failed this time around, but it is hard to say. They may be back anytime.” Primal Chaos City Leader ordered solemnly, “You may go for a silent retreat for now. As to how we should deal with your problems, I need some time to ponder.”

“Noted.”

Luo Feng bowed before the two and within a blink of the eye, vanished into thin air.

Long Yan Master and Primal Chaos City Leader contemplated the problem in silence for some time.

“Primal Chaos City Leader,” Long Yan Master said, finally breaking the silence, “Redbud Island is no safe ground. The three races are determined to kill Luo Feng. Their desire is so strong that it is frightening. Previously, we were just making conjectures, but we had not expected everything to come true. Especially when the opponent was Virtual-Real Devil Master, the one who was most highly-skilled in creating illusions; when used against someone like Luo Feng, who has the talent technique of dividing bodies, his skills would be a most frightening threat.”

“I will inform Huge Axe and gather the universe masters to discuss this matter.” Primal Chaos City Leader could not contain his anxiety any longer.

When all the universe masters of the human race were once again gathered together for a discussion, Luo Feng was back in one of the chambers of his palace, continuing to browse through information on the numerous top-tier universe overlords.

“In my human race, if I count myself, then there will only be four top-tier universe overlords,” he mumbled to himself. “Automaton race has four top-tier universe overlords. The demon clan has a total of 21 top-tier universe overlords. After all, within the demon clan, there are different bloodlines that are ranked on different levels. There are quite a few with the talent technique of dividing bodies, so the number of top-tier universe overlords is quite a lot. The bug clan… it has 81 universe overlords, of which only two are top-tier universe overlords. However, the moment universe overlords of the bug clan make use of the Bug Ocean Combat Tactic, they are comparable to top-tier universe overlords of other races.”

Luo Feng nodded to himself. The bug clan was a frightening presence. The bug Mother Queen alone would only have the combat power at the level of a universe overlord. But she would do all she could to create a clan of bug warriors that were of universe knight level. Although she only had a massive godly body, she could distribute consciously to every warrior, allowing every single one of them to possess extremely powerful combat skills.

“Alliance clan of the automaton race: a total of 12 top-tier universe overlords. Alliance clan of the demon race: a total of 16 top-tier universe overlords. Alliance clan of the bug race: a total of 9 top-tier universe overlords. Who should I choose?”

Luo Feng eliminated the bug clan first. Mother Queen overlord of the bug clan was not a fearsome figure individually, but she could control and manipulate a massive number of bug warriors! Even if he could kill those bug warriors one by one, their queen would still be able to make an unhurried but speedy escape with her warriors warding her off.

The automaton race? It had a total of four top-tier universe overlords, just like the human race previously had a total of three. The true treasures under their possession were extremely powerful! And they were all positioned in restricted grounds of the automaton race, just like how Heaven Erosion Palace Master and Star Prison Devil Master of the human race were in restricted grounds within the human domain.

“Demon clan it shall be,” said Luo Feng. “The demon clan has a great number of top-tier universe overlords, and they are very scattered.” Luo Feng looked at all the information suspended in mid-air and suddenly looked to one set of information, “This is the one. Sky Flower Knight!”

Sky Flower Knight was a top-tier universe overlord of the demon clan. Within the Sky Wolf Clan, he was only second to Sky Wolf Master; he was the pride of the Sky Wolf Clan and was the special disciple of Sky Wolf Master. He was also the disciple of the clan’s “Dream Demon Ancestor.”

“Sky Flower Knight? Sky Wolf Master?” Luo Feng laughed lightheartedly.

He recalled that unforgettable time where he had attempted to make it out of Ice Hell. That almighty Sky Wolf Master had attempted to kill him. Fortunately, Primal Chaos City Leader Teacher had appeared and had come to his rescue!

“Sky Flower Knight, just your luck,” said Luo Feng. “You are the chosen one.”

After he had decided on his prey, Sky Flower Knight, Luo Feng started searching for various detailed information to devise his plot. He looked into the true treasures, techniques, and related information to understand his own powers, and also, he looked into possible places of residence!

While Luo Feng was planning, he received a call from Primal Chaos City Leader.

“Luo Feng. Come to primal chaos ruins to meet me.”

“Yes, Teacher.”

Luo Feng put everything aside. Since it was a command from his teacher, he wasted no time in making a speedy departure from his god country. He arrived at the headquarters of the Virtual Universe Company, boarded a planet ship, and traveled through the universe tunnel to arrive at Primal Chaos City.

Walking within the palace, every guard that he met along the way was very respectful.

In the middle of the vast primal chaos ruins, Primal Chaos City Leader sat cross-legged as he waited for Luo Feng. When Luo Feng was near him, he opened his eyes.

“Teacher.” Luo Feng gave a slight bow.

Hua.

With a wave, Primal Chaos City Leader threw something in the form of a ray of light that flew toward Luo Feng. Luo Feng caught the ray with one hand and looked down to see a triangular crystal in his palm. It was like an amethyst, with beautiful, ancient yet simple floral patterns; the crystal exuded a strangely attractive charm.

“This is a senior soul type true treasure that is more superior than those on the same level,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “Its original name is ‘Afterimage.’”

“Afterimage?” said Luo Feng.

Luo Feng was stunned. Previously, when he traded for the top-tier true treasure blade, “Ghost Blade,” he had scanned the catalog of items for trade. With his photographic memory, he would have naturally remembered everything that he had seen on the list after just one look. He clearly recalled that within one of the columns for soul type true treasures, Afterimage had been worth a total of 620 true treasure points!

Senior soul type true treasures were much more valuable than the ordinary top-tier true treasure weapons. For top-tier true treasure blades, normally 80 true treasure points would suffice. However, senior soul type true treasures would at least require 200 to 300 true treasure points. Afterimage was a notch higher than them all, reaching a value of 620 true treasure points. Of course, if it were a top-tier soul type true treasure, its value would be much higher, as it was equivalent to weapons like Thousand Treasure River and Blade River Luo, which would usually require a few thousand true treasure points.

“Teacher…” Luo Feng raised his head to look at Primal Chaos City Leader.

Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “This is not from me. It is what our entire race is giving you. Of all our senior soul type true treasures, this is the best of the best. Afterimage. Its value is worth a few pieces of top-tier true treasure weapons! This is a final decision the race made upon learning that Virtual-Real Devil Master is hunting you down. We are giving you Afterimage to guard your soul.”

“Your willpower and consciousness have reached the level of a universe master,” Primal Chaos City Leader continued, “while Afterimage is one of the best senior soul type true treasures. Even if you were to cross paths with Virtual-Real Devil Master again, with Afterimage to guard your soul, at least your soul cannot be permeated and thereby controlled by another soul. You can still calmly self-destruct.”

Luo Feng nodded. Indeed, if it was a true top-tier universe overlord —and even if his soul was protected by a true treasure—in the face of a universe supreme being, there was still no means of escape. Normally, universe overlords in such a situation would choose to self-destruct. Being able to self-destruct was considered a form of success…

But Luo Feng was different. He had the supreme true treasure Star Tower and the pinnacle true treasure Force Armor to protect his body.

Luo Feng was still filled with gratitude. “Thank you, Teacher,” he said. He was indeed short of a soul type true treasure.

He might have Star Tower, but… both his original earthling body and his Golden Horned Beast body required a soul type true treasure. Upon gaining Afterimage, Luo Feng decided right away.

Afterimage shall be used by my original earthling body, who used to have Force Armor, which in turn has the efficacy of weakening soul attacks. Afterimage and Force Armor shall work together… This would make them comparable to a top-tier soul type true treasure! Then, even if I’m being attacked by Virtual-Real Devil Master, I will not be afraid of being unable to ward off his attacks.

Golden Horned Beast body has Star Tower. It has more than enough clout. If I were to venture out in the name of Blood Cloud Palace Master, at least I won’t be putting the great name of Blood Cloud Palace Master to shame.

Luo Feng secretly made this decision. This treasure’s arrival was timely.

Afterimage required 620 true treasure points. If Luo Feng were to contribute all of his remaining true treasures, he would still only have been able to obtain a fraction of this amount.

“With this true treasure, you can venture out to roam the universe,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “After all, it will not be that easy for the other three races like the bug soldiers to enlist the help of a universe supreme being again. You need not be overly worried.” He continued solemnly. “With the level of power you have now, you should be honing your skills through combat; the birth of universe masters has always been achieved through the tough training from battles. Just working hard in cultivation does not help one in becoming a universe master. You should go now.”

“Understood.” Luo Feng bowed and left right away.


Chapter 1109: Start

Luo Feng went back to his god country after leaving the original universe. The waves were churning. Above the boundless Remote Ocean floated a godly palace enveloped by a dim light.

Luo Feng stood on the square in front of the godly palace with the towering Golden Horned Beast beside him. A nine-story ancient tower showed up on his hand and flew toward Golden Horned Beast.

“From now on, Golden Horned Beast will use Star Tower!” he said. “The original earthling body uses Shi Wu Wings, Force Armor, and Afterimage.”

Luo Feng nodded. This was indeed the best arrangement, as Golden Horned Beast had a second identity, “Blood Cloud Palace Leader,’ and had the Blood Cloud Pearl to disguise himself. Blood Cloud Palace was able to change someone’s aura, along with the shape of true treasures. Although it was difficult to determine its level, it took Sitting Mountain Guest a long time and lots of energy to make it.

Star Tower would shrink during regular fights, but anyone who paid attention could tell the secret if it was enlarged. However, Blood Cloud Tower was able to completely change the look of Star Tower, so nobody would be able to identify it.

“Teacher Primal Chaos City Leader also said that training alone won’t make a universe master, and he also wants me to sharpen myself in combat as Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest does.” Luo Feng nodded.

In a pavilion in the virtual universe, the servants of Luo’s family prepared delicious meals. Luo Feng and Kuang Zhou Knight sat face-to-face with each other.

Kuang Zhou Knight felt a bit awkward, and he said, “Blade River, you don’t need to prepare the wine or meals if you want my help. Just tell me what you want. I’ll do everything.”

Kuang Zhou Knight was not stupid. Luo Feng could already rival Heavenly Erosion Palace Leader, Ancestral Tree Knight, and Star Prison Devil Master. All the universe knights in the race wanted to be friends with him.

“Indeed, I need to ask you a favor.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Just tell me,” said Kuang Zhou Knight. “I’m just afraid that I might not do a good job.”

“It’s simple,” said Luo Feng. “Help me find the coordinates of Sky Flower Knight from the demon race.”

Beings like Heavenly Erosion Palace Leader and Star Prison Devil Master rarely showed up on the open-air bar, and neither did Luo Feng, as he didn’t have much time for such things.

“Find him?” Kuang Zhou Knight’s eyes gleamed. “Rest assured. I’m the best at gathering information.”

Luo Feng smiled and nodded. Usually, great beings would block their conversations if they were talking about important issues, which was why it was difficult to gather information. And this was when connections came in handy. Kuang Zhou Knight was known for his ability to gather information, as he had a tremendous number of friends.

“Sky Flower Knight should be on the original stars.” Kuang Zhou Knight smiled. “Actually, most of the top-tier universe overlords of the demon race are adventuring the original stars. I heard that Sky Flower Knight showed up on Original Star Number 02002 more than 1,000 years ago. However, you should know that top-tier universe overlords usually act alone, and he left very quickly. I didn’t collect any information on him after that. I guess he’s on one of the original stars.”

Luo Feng nodded. “Thank you so much.”

“Not at all. Just come and find me whenever you need more information.”

Kuang Zhou Knight knew that the more favors he did for Luo Feng, the closer they would be! All the universe knights knew that Ganwu Universe Country Master’s debts were automatically paid off because he was the teacher of Luo Feng’s son.

“I’ll go collect other information.” Kuang Zhou Knight smiled.

Luo Feng nodded, and Kuang Zhou Knight disappeared.

Luo Feng knew that it was difficult to track down a supreme being. If he kept hiding—like Luo Feng hid from the demon race, the automaton race, and the bug race—it would take forever to find him. Fortunately, Sky Flower Knight wasn’t hiding deliberately. Instead, he was still adventuring the original stars… It might take a while to find him, but it would take that long.

“I’ll keep training on Redbud Island,” said Luo Feng.

He was calm and confident, and his original earthling body went back to Redbud Island and started to train himself. He went to the land of inheritance after more than two months.

On Redbud Island.

“Look.”

“It’s Luo Feng.”

“Luo Feng’s going to land of inheritance again.

The candidates immediately took notes and reported them back to their races.

Three beings arrived at a starry sky and twisted the space around it as if they were in another dimension: a giant, oval-shaped phantom, a breathtaking being, and a gigantic, silver snake head surrounded by countless snake-like shadows.

“What happened, Automaton?” the breathtaking being grunted.

“Didn’t you ask Virtual-Real Devil Master to kill him?” The silver snake head also said in anger

After Virtual-Real Devil Master failed to kill Luo Feng in the center of the Ancestral God School, he had never contacted Father God of the Automaton race. Father God was patient enough as a universe supreme master, and he didn’t push him. Instead, he tried to figure out what information the human race had.

In the past two months… Luo Feng had shown up in Primal Chaos City and entered City Leader Palace, and almost no one knew it. Although there were spies of the automaton race in PrimalChaos City, nobody had noticed that Luo Feng had entered the City Leader Palace and left.

No one had been certain of his fate until this time… When Luo Feng showed up on Redbud Island, that was when all the three pinnacle races knew that Luo Feng was still alive!

“I asked Virtual-Real Devil Master to kill him,” the phantom said. “You all know Virtual-Real Devil Master. He’ll be upset if I keep pushing him. I just went to ask him what happened after learning that Luo Feng was still alive.”

“What happened?” asked the silver snake head.

The breathtaking being also stared at the black oval.

The four pinnacle races had been fighting each other for an eternity, and the three other races had formed a temporary alliance because of their common enemy: Luo Feng. The relationship among them was sour.

Chapter 1112: When the Wind Blows

When two beings of comparable powers were pitted against one another, the rebound force during a head-on confrontation would normally cause Luo Feng to reduce speed or fall backward. Yet, at that very moment, the difference was extreme!

Luo Feng was using his ultimate technique of a universe master level as though he was truly a universe master. After one strike, he was hot on Sky Flower Knight’s heels right away, dealing another strike to the godly body of his opponent, which was already thrown a distance away!

Not good, thought Sky Flower Knight. One strike after the another, in nine strikes, I will be completely annihilated.

This is the technique of a universe master, and I’m afraid it might be the ultimate technique of a universe master. Nine Tiger River was mighty and majestic. Luo Feng stood on its golden waves and looked afar at the white, flying shuttle that was hovering in mid-air. His expression changed involuntarily. “A flying-palace type true treasure!”

You are absolutely a genius, and out of all the billions of races in this vast universe, you are indeed the cream of the crop. If not for this flying-palace type true treasure, I think today would have been my last. Hahaha…! But now, I think it is just your luck!”

“Just my luck?” Luo Feng said, glaring at that white flying shuttle. “Furious? Even if you were tens or hundreds of times stronger, the most you could do would be to stare helplessly.”

Luo Feng did feel that he had made a blunder! He had made elaborate preparations for the “Battle to Fame” this time. He had devised counteractions for various possible unforeseen circumstances. Sky Flower Knight owned a flying-palace type true treasure.

In summation, there was no way he could make a clean kill and get rid of Sky Flower Knight! This battle would not end conclusively!

As for the question of whether he could force open the white flying shuttle? Luo Feng had no intentions of trying. A flying-palace type true treasure was the sturdiest type out of all treasures of the same level. Such treasures were the best at warding off material attacks! An ordinary flying-palace type true treasure, in terms of its degree of sturdiness, was comparable to that of a senior true treasure armor. A senior flying-palace type true treasure was thus comparable to a top-tier true treasure armor!

Like Sky Wolf Master’s Sky Wolf Palace, which was also a senior flying-palace type true treasure, it belonged to the minority of top-notch treasures, which, by the human race’s exchange rates, was worth about 800 to 900 true treasure points. With it, Sky Wolf Master was able to run rampant about the universe. Even Primal Chaos City Leader and Nine Remoteness Master were unable to force Sky Wolf Palace apart.

This flying shuttle was only slightly inferior to Sky Wolf Palace, but it was enough to run rampant in the universe. The majority of universe masters would not be able to do anything to it.

Sky Flower Knight, who owned such a flying-palace type true treasure, usually could only depend on soul attacks! But Luo Feng was not skilled in launching soul attacks.

“Humph!”

Sou!

Luo Feng put Nine Tiger River right away, transformed into light, and accelerated into space.

“Trying to escape?” said Sky Flower Knight.

The white flying shuttle followed closely and quickly.

Luo Feng and the white flying shuttle dashed through the sky, one after the other, while knights of different races watched from afar, dumbfounded.

“He actually had a flying-palace type true treasure.”

“Sky Flower Knight, are you sure you want to shadow me like this?” Luo Feng said, looking behind him.

Luo Feng swept one look at the gigantic white flying shuttle behind him, which was really something that he could not tackle. Playing big? thought Luo Feng. I’m afraid it is time to depend on the ninth volume now.

Luo Feng’s eyes flashed with traces of murderous intention.

At the territory of demon clan, in the Dream Ancestors secret region.

The body that Sky Flower Knight left within his race was rapidly brought back to the Dream Ancestors secret region by a servant of god country transportation. Upon arriving at Dream Ancestor’s secret region, he immediately connected to “virtual space” with his consciousness.

Like the automaton race, the demon clan also created a virtual world of their own. Even for Earth, a simple virtual space, “palace of war gods,” was previously created, and it was merely based on a simple thought. To achieve the far-reaching influence that spread throughout the universe like the virtual universe, where all the laws were adhered to was a difficult feat. The demon clan had such a virtual space. It was an area that enveloped the Dream Ancestors secret region.

Within the virtual space of the demon clan, amidst the clouds and mist, a group of towering white palaces were in continuous sequence. These were the residences of the Dream Ancestors.

Among the clouds and mist, a long table was occupied by nine figures; above eight of them was a large silvery-white snake that was coiled up into a pan-shaped position. “Yes.” Sky Flower Knight replied.

At that point in time, most of the other eight universe masters seated around the table started voicing their thoughts loudly.

“Liar!”

“That human Luo Feng cannot possibly have become a universe master so quickly.”

“Impossible!”

“Impossible.”

“To kill you, he must definitely have the power of a universe master. How long has he been cultivating himself? It seems impossible.”

The universe masters were still unwilling to believe what they had just heard. Only Dream Demon Ancestor remained silent as he observed their reactions.

With that, Sky Flower Knight looked toward the sky and recalled everything that he had undergone. The scenes reenacted in his memory and were replayed as a simulation of the actual event from the beginning to end. From the start of his fight against Zha Wei Horde Leader and Thousand Shadow Knight…

Silence.

All the universe masters watched with undivided attention. Billions of years of common knowledge told them that it was impossible to become a universe master in such a short cultivation period. Otherwise, one would be impossibly powerful.

The simulation ended. All the universe masters remained silent for a moment. They all could tell the truth from the blows exchanged between Luo Feng and Sky Flower Knight. For the first strike, the difference between the power of the two was not obvious. However, when Luo Feng served up his second attack, he brought forth such an immediate upsurge of power so strong that it caused Sky Flower Knight to lose 10 percent of his godly body right away. The only missing detail that they could not see from the simulated scenes was how the incredible yet mysterious strike was dealt. Sky Flower Knight did not know how Luo Feng had done it, so naturally, he was unable to replicate the exact nature of the move.

One strike that could cause a split straightaway! Just by posture alone, it was impossible to create a 100 percent simulation. That would be totally pointless. The true essence lay with the beast god path—the path that could stir up and actuate countless law engravings! This was a scene from memory that could not be simulated.

Chapter 1113: Encirclement

Luo Feng was flying on Original Star Number 02933, and a white shuttle was following him.

Hong!

Lost him!

Hu!

I have to use it, thought Luo Feng. I need to show my skill.

Luo Feng stood still and stared at the three universe knights of other races in the distance. “I didn’t want to kill you,” he said. “Don’t blame me. You kept following me.”

“Not our concern. We’re more relaxed if he doesn’t run.”

Just when the three bearded guys transmitted their voices to speak to one another—

Hua!

A being shone at the edge of golden waves and disappeared, then reappeared in a flash 6,000 miles away again.

Shua! Shua! Shua! Shua!

Hundreds of shadows shone and approached those three universe knights, which terrified them.
