Sou!

Luo Feng teleported himself 1,000 light years away, and instantly, he had already traveled a million light years.

Suddenly, a boundless land appeared before him. It was one of the 12 lands that belonged to Yuan Ao Master.

“This must be Jue An Land.”


Chapter 1140: The Dark Continent

There was a seven-color light membrane that was as thin as a piece of film high up in the sky covering the vast continent. It had an extremely strong resistance, but Luo Feng could easily pass through it.

“This resistance, I think only a sector lord will be able to penetrate.”

Luo Feng nodded slightly, then headed downward to the ground. Just being high up in the sky, Luo Feng could feel an extremely strong “suction force” from beneath. It was so strong that Luo Feng was taken aback.

“Such a strong force,” he said. “I think only those of universe level would be able to keep flying under such force.”

He only flashed about in midair for a short moment before he landed on the vast grounds. The moment his feet touched the ground as he landed, the strong suction force weakened to be almost negligible, all within an instant.

Luo Feng commented lightly, “Yuan Ao Master really put in a lot of thought and effort when he created these twelve continents. One great continent and one seven-color light membrane. There must be a repulsive force between the two so as not to feel such a strong repulsive force upon landing.”

Luo Feng could not help but marvel at the capability of Yuan Ao Master, who came to existence during the earliest period after the birth of the universe. At the very least, his efforts were evident in the creation of these twelve continents.

Luo Feng scanned his surroundings. This was a deserted plain in pitch-black darkness. At first glance, there were countless skeletons left lying on the grounds, and many were already decomposing. There were some that were still sturdy and whole; obviously, the death was not too long ago.

“This battlefield occupies a space around 6,000 miles wide,” Luo Feng said to himself. “Among the corpses lying around, there are some who were highly skilled, while the others were mediocre. The best around here is merely a sector lord.”

With his godly power, he investigated the entire battlefield and discovered the corpses of three sector lords. One was buried deep underground while the other two were hidden deep within the mountains.

On either side of the battlefield, there was an incomparably majestic ancient city. On the wall surrounding both cities, for a distance of at least 6,000 miles, there were large numbers of warriors on patrol. These warriors looked like they all came from different races, and the cities’ walls reeked of blood, as though they were telling the cruelest stories found in the history of war.

“Battlefield? Impregnable passes on both sides?”

Luo Feng underwent a rapid transformation where his wings became a dark green color, and his hairstyle became a cropped short and fiery red. His skin also turned dark green. This look resembled the soldiers of one of the races he managed to detect when he investigated the place with his godly power.

“I cannot identify this race at all.” He conducted his investigation with his consciousness, rapidly scanning through the virtual universe, but what he found gave him a good shock. “Ka Vulture clan? This weak little race disappeared from the universe a long time ago. Only some remnants of it are left in the Yuan Ao region.” Luo Feng sighed. “Previously, when Yuan Ao Master rampantly plundered about, who would have expected him to leave behind a trace of this Ka Vulture clan?”

Shua!

With one step, Luo Feng crossed the majestic frontier of the city, which was more than 6,000 miles away from where he was. Luo Feng appeared in the sky above the incomparably luxurious and vast city where thousands of people were bustling with excitement. Luo Feng was positioned high up in the sky, so naturally, those ordinary life forms would not be able to see him.

Luo Feng checked the golden toad that he held in his left palm. Both eyes were still gray.

“Still gray. Every continent is immeasurably massive. This toad with its gray eyes will only be able to detect if I am within a distance of 60 million miles away from my target. How long will that take?”

Luo Feng took another step forward. He would continue investigating until he reached the 60-million-mile range.

Luo Feng embarked on a long period of investigative works. Out of these twelve continents, the one of the smallest diameter would be around one light year, and the biggest could be as big as eight light years!

Every time Luo Feng teleported, he made sure to maintain 60 million miles, so if he were to teleport 10,000 times a day… it would take ten days for him to pass through a continent with a diameter of one light year. And the width itself was already one light year…

“If I had to look into twelve such continents, I’m afraid I would need several tens of thousands of years. Fortunately, the investigative works would only require some efforts on my part.”

Therefore, Luo Feng only took out a trace of his consciousness to begin on this long journey of investigative works. The bulk of his consciousness was completely devoted to studying the beast god path and pictures of secret engravings.

In the twinkling of an eye, Luo Feng had spent half a year on this continent.

“Nothing. There is nothing here, either. Here… Huh? It’s red now!”

After teleporting repeatedly, Luo Feng suddenly stopped. The eyes of the golden toad in his hand turned fiery red. After half a year of probing around, this was the first time the eyes of the golden toad had turned red. Naturally, Luo Feng was so overwhelmed with emotions that his other bodies temporarily stopped cultivating too.

“In that direction.”

Luo Feng looked up into the distance. With one teleportation, he reached around one million miles away from his target. Thereafter, Luo Feng started flying…

“One million miles. I can make it there in a split moment. I have to see for myself what the situation is around the target. What could be so highly regarded by Ancestral God of the Ancestral God School— the universe’s top power—who even mentioned that something terrible might happen to the primal universe?”

Luo Feng did not dare to be the least bit careless and maintained due vigilance. After all, Ancestral God mentioned that something “bodes ill for the primal universe,” so it would be no simple affair, after all.

Flying high in the air, Luo Feng’s godly power investigated within 6,000 miles of his surroundings as he did not dare to probe too far away, lest he alerted his target unnecessarily and gave it the chance for escape.

This was Luo Feng’s first time investigating a vast continent so meticulously. This task showed him scenes depicting snippets of life on this continent where various events of love and hatred unfolded before him. “Interesting fellow, unlucky fellow.”

“Mighty Flame family, just you wait! I, Bu Ah, will become the great Holy One, and then I will raze the entire Mighty Flame fortress to the ground!”

A burly rider was seen on the back of his gigantic demon beast with tusks. He was tall, bulky, and his entire body was covered with sturdy armor. To be a worthy opponent of a fire pterosaur, one needed to be a “ninth-grade rider,” which was just second to the level of a Holy One. He was merely a fifth-grade rider… Combining the efforts of 1,000 riders of his level would still be unable to defeat one fire pterosaur!

Hong!

Bu Ah, holding on to his gigantic rifle, grinned. He was like a crazy demon as he stared at the handsome rider. He was aware that before the Mighty Flame family, he was a puny nobody, even though he knew that putting up a resistance would cost him his life, he was not going to take it lying down.

A lone figure approached him slowly, a smile on his face as he looked at Bu Ah.

“You shall do,” said the man with his dark green wings. He looked at Bu Ah, and an invisible force held Bu Ah captive.

Shua!

Around 600 miles away, in the middle of a deserted plain, Bu Ah was released and fell onto the ground. He immediately stood up, while continuing to blabber, “I must have encountered a ghost. The big, burly man looked at the figure standing in front of him with great terror. The figure wore a black robe that looked harmlessly simple. With his dark green wings and skin and his fiery red, cropped hair, his entire being seemed to exude a faint, mysterious aura.

“Sir.” Bu Ah bowed immediately.

Luo Feng looked at Bu Ah. “After arriving at your world, I needed to find a life form to ask about certain things. You are the chosen one. I know you are fearful of that Mighty Flame family. Fret not. The troop that was after you will think you have escaped far away. Oh? You are guessing who I am? A Holy One? A legendary being? A demigod?”

Bu Ah’s fear intensified. This being before him knew all the thoughts that were going through his mind.

Luo Feng laughed. Being at universe level, he could easily conduct a soul-search on another being at a star traveler level, given his current power… There was no way the thoughts of such a weak little fellow could escape investigation. Luo Feng teased this fellow for fun, but at the same time, he was speedily scanning through his memories to conduct a meticulous search.

“Interesting world. Interesting young fellow.” Luo Feng looked at Bu Ah. I admire your character, but I am curious to know what you will become if you own great power.”

Luo Feng studied Bu Ah, who was in a mixed state of fear and uneasiness. Suddenly, a kiwi fruit seed—something ordinary that came from the universe—appeared on Luo Feng’s palm. “Ah!” Bu Ah was in great shock. Within an instant, he was entirely enveloped in that green light.

Under the subtle control of Luo Feng’s godly power, Bu Ah’s body continuously absorbed the essence of energy and achieved breakthroughs repeatedly. His life gene level was soaring at a frightening speed, almost instantaneously… Within a short moment, a ninth-grade universe level being was born.

Luo Feng smiled as he watched everything happened. Since he had already obtained the information he needed, then what he had done to Bu Ah was merely out of randomness to appease his earlier curiosity. To a great universe master… the value of a small seed taken from the universe could most probably be neglected.

Turning around, Luo Feng stepped forward and left.


Chapter 1141: Povah God

Bu Ah felt endless pain permeating his body. It came from the improvement of his life gene. He couldn’t even think straight. He could barely open his eyes. All of a sudden, even the mountain range in the distance became clear.

“I—I…” Bu Ah felt that his hearing and sight were thousands of times better. “So powerful. Impressive!” The scars on Bu Ah’s face had already disappeared, and his face became clear.

He extended his thick arms and swung them.

Pa!

The armor on his body cracked. Bu Ah felt that the armor on his body was as fragile as paper. It could be destroyed if he simply tightened his muscles, which dazed him.

“I—I…” Bu Ah immediately started to search himself, and he was totally shocked. “Is—is this real?”

Bu Ah floated in the sky, and the original power in his body made him growl.

Hong!

He surged like a trace of light, then flew in an S-shaped curve. He dove and stopped when just one inch away from the ground. “Hahaha! Haha! It’s real! I became a saint! And I’m a pinnacle saint now! It’s only one step away from a legend! Hahaha! The Yuan Ao Supreme God! The great Po Vah God…”

Bu Ah was exhilarated. There were billions of billions of life forms on Jue An Land, and it was a long way from level one to level nine. Bu Ah, as an example, had become an apprentice of a knight, and all he had done was to deal with minor issues for a second-level knight. He could grow only after being instructed. After becoming a knight, he would need to go through one war after another—wars among horde leaders and even wars among empires… He had been to armies and slave camps, and he had survived all of them. He successfully passed level three and level four and entered Mighty Flame Family, becoming one of its knights.

Mighty Flame Family was a family that ruled a large area, and there was a saint in the family! It was extremely difficult to progress from level three to level four! And this was the case from level six to level seven, as well!

As for becoming a saint from level nine, it was even more difficult! Once someone became a saint, he would be able to travel the sky and land and to become a great being on Jue An Land. When someone became a legend, it was an incredible achievement. It would be easy for them to establish a horde leader kingdom, and once someone became a half god, he would be able to establish an empire!

Those who were under level three didn’t matter at all. It had taken Bu Ah decades to become a fifth-level knight.

“Saint! I’m now a pinnacle saint, and I’m one step away from becoming a legend.” Bu Ah was thrilled. “I heard that only being blessed by God can make someone’s power surge like this. Otherwise, it might take me thousands of years to become a pinnacle saint. That great being must be a god! Isn’t that Povah God…?”

Bu Ah’s body trembled. There were hundreds of gods on Jue An Land, and each of them ruled areas of trillions of square miles.

“Other God?” Bu Ah was terrified.

Godly wars were the norm on Jue An Land.

“I can’t tell anyone, not even my wife and children. It’ll be a disaster if I do so.” Bu Ah clenched his teeth and smirked. He looked toward Mighty Flame Castle. “Mighty Flame Castle. The leader only became a saint around 100 years ago, and it’s a long way to go for him to become a pinnacle saint. My joyful days have come. I’ll rule a land, build a castle, and have tens of thousands of women living in my castle…”

Bu Ah shook his body, and the armor turned into ashes. He gathered his original power and made new armor, then flew toward that Mighty Flame Castle.

Luo Feng stood in the sky and overlooked the mountains in the distance.

“Furious Flame Mountain. The target is there.” Luo Feng looked in the distance. “The Ancestral God from the Ancestral God School showed up, is it a life or a valuable?”

Luo Feng had already completely forgotten about Bu Ah who he just rescued. He only needed to get to know the world, which was why he had chosen Bu Ah, and he had compensated him by improving his life gene level.

According to the memories of Bu Ah, the mountain in front of Luo Feng was called Furious Flame Mountain, and a legend lived in there!

“A legend?” Luo Feng shook his head and smiled.

Although Jue An Land was in a universe secret region, Yuan Ao Master put too many life forms in the land, which led to overpopulation. They were only able to get a tiny portion of universe energies. Besides, Yuan Ao Master only seized life forms from weak races who had limited potential, so most of the individuals on Jue An Land were not more powerful than adult earthlings.

Level one to level three were under star traveler level. Level four to level six were star traveler level, and level seven to level nine were star level. Saints were at universe level! Legends were at domain-lord level! Half deities were sector lords! As for deities, they were undying.

More than one legend lives in this Angry Flame Mountain, Luo Feng thought as he was able to sense the power ripple. I can’t let anyone go.

Luo Feng became solemn.

Angry Flame Mountain was over 600,000 miles long, and there were powerful demon beasts living in it, so no civilians were living around the mountain.

Deep inside Angry Flame Mountain, in a black castle surrounded by mountains, boiling magma flowed under the castle, and there were strange beasts living in the magma. There were golden-armored knights around the castle, and all of them were at the ninth level.

The castle was surrounded by magma. A black metal bridge was connecting the door and the outside.

A white-caped elder approached from the distance, and each step took him over 300 feet. There was white light glowing around him, and Luo Feng could tell that he was a legend. Soon, that legend walked onto the bridge.

“Open the door,” shouted the elder.

“Yes.”

The door opened slowly, and a flamed knight stood in front of the door. That knight was also a legend.

“Why are you here?” asked the flamed knight. “Don’t you know you can’t come here unless you have something urgent?”

“I do have something urgent to tell the great Povah God,” said the white-caped elder as he walked inside the black castle.

Inside a palace of the castle, a gleaming undying fighter sat on the throne. Povah God looked down at the servants and was listening to his servants report to him. He felt superior. After all, he manipulated the wars and the slaughtering in his territory, making the empires more and more hostile toward each other. He would only show himself when everything went out of his control.

“You’ve done well,” said Povah God.

The white-caped elder began to tear up from the great deity’s compliment. The white-caped elder was waiting for instructions for the next step. However, he saw a blurry, golden light. He raised his head and found that…

“Where’s Povah God?”

Povah God, who had previously been on the throne and emanating golden light, had disappeared. The servants and the three half deities were all dazed. Then a half deity said, “Povah God is resting now.”

“I need instructions for the next step.” The white-caped elder was anxious, but he answered, “Sure.”

Those in the palace all left, including the half deities, as they all thought that Povah God had left for something important. What they didn’t know was that Povah God was sitting on the throne all the time, but those sector lords and domain lords weren’t able to see him anymore.

“Who… who are you?” Povah God gazed at the man in front of him, terrified as never before.

The dimming golden light covered an area of 300 square feet, and the power contained in the golden light petrified Povah God.

Luo Feng looked at Povah God in front of him and couldn’t help laughing at himself inside.

I was so careful and performed the most powerful binding skill I have, Golden Country. I didn’t expect my target to be a weak undying fighter.

Luo Feng had performed Golden Country in the sky above Angry Flame Mountain, and he immediately narrowed the range when he found that his target was too weak, which was why those half deities saw a golden flash.

“Tell me everything important in your life,” said Luo Feng.

“Sure, sure,” said Povah God. “I was born in…”

Luo Feng seemed to be listening, but actually, he had performed an illusion. After all, his mind and willpower were at the universe master level, and he was a spiritual force leader even though he was not good at illusion. He was a great being following the engraving path, he had created several illusion skills, which easily trapped Povah God. Luo Feng easily searched his memories.

Luo Feng could tell from the golden toad that his target was Povah God in front of him! However, he couldn’t believe that a mere undying fighter could be harmful to the original universe or that Ancestral God sent him just for this! Luo Feng felt that something wrong. He could sense that Povah God was only a part of the whole.


Chapter 1142: Torch Smelting

An undying fighter who had lived for an eternity had enormous memories. Fortunately, Luo Feng’s brain worked incredibly fast, though it still took him around five minutes to categorize all the memories of Povah God. Still, the result dazed Luo Feng a little bit.

“I… I didn’t find anything special or worth hesitating.” Luo Feng was a bit surprised.

“I became a general after becoming a saint…” said Povah God, speaking like a robot. He had lost all the light in his eyes.

Luo Feng looked at Povah God, frowning. Povah God was an undying fighter born on Jue An Empire, and he had started from the bottom. After becoming a half deity, he had established an empire. He led the empire to join wars upon wars, and after the empire fell, he started to adventure in Jue An Land alone. Eventually, he became an undying fighter.

Povah God’s soul was then controlled by Torch Smelting Master God, and then he joined Torch Smelting Master God. Based on Povah God’s memories, the hundreds of undying fighters on Jue An land were divided into two teams; one of them was on the Torch Smelting team, and the other was on the Mo He team. When the teams fought each other, they were led by top-tier great beings from different empires, and they were led by undying fighters.

That’s all! There’s nothing special in Povah God’s memories. Luo Feng was confused as the memories of Povah God were normal.

Now that I know his memories…

Luo Feng looked at Povah God sitting in front of him.

“Following Ancestral God’s order, everyone who makes the eyes of golden toad turn red should be killed.”

The dimming golden light was surrounding Povah God as well. Luo Feng moved his mind, and the power from Golden Country annihilated Povah God’s godly body.

The power of Golden Country was much stronger than a universe master’s control over space and time, and it was at the same level as a top-tier domain type true treasure. If it was fully utilized, top-tier universe overlords would be executed. As for a mere undying fighter… a mere slice of power could annihilate him.

There was a vast desert on the vast Jue An Land, and at the end of the dessert was a huge forest at the end of a boundless swamp bordered by mountain ranges rimmed with volcanoes. A towering palace stood at the center of the volcanoes. This was the top godly palace of the Torch Smelting camp. It was where Torch Smelting Master God lived.

The sinister aura of the godly palace and the sector lord-level demon beasts were enough to stop countless great beings.

Torch Smelting Master God was holding a scepter and standing at the high of the godly palace. He looked confused.

“Povah God died… Based on the information Povah God gave me, the enemy is someone too powerful for him to fight, and he can emanate golden domain, which was strong enough to terrify him.”

Can it be other master gods? Torch Smelting Master God wondered. He didn’t expect it to be a being from the outside, as Yuan Ao Secret Region belonged to Yuan Ao Master, who had a high status in the universe. Yuan Ao Master had become a universe master at the start of the universe, and he wasn’t easy to contend with. No powers were willing to mess with Yuan Ao Master.

Torch Smelting Master God found it impossible for Yuan Ao Master to have killed that one. That power must have at least come from a master god.

“Based on the descriptions, he looks like someone from Ka Vulture clan, but Ka Vulture clan doesn’t have a master god. Was he turned from my enemies? Also, that golden domain is so powerful. Is that from a domain type true treasure? Or a domain type treasure!”

There were only a few dozen universe knights under Yuan Ao Master, and only three of them had been bestowed true treasures.

“Why didn’t he kill Povah God right away?”

Torch Smelting Master God was irritated. Although he controlled Povah God’s soul, Povah God had stopped sending messages after first contact with the mysterious being, and he couldn’t get in touch with Povah God.

As for god country transportation, Torch Smelting Master God hadn’t even thought of that, as he didn’t want to fight a master god.

“Humph! I’ll wait and see. There are over 100 undying fighters under me, and I won’t take revenge this time. If you do that again, don’t blame me for starting a war between master gods.”

The red eyes of Torch Smelting Master God glinted fiercely.

Luo Feng floated above Angry Flame Mountain. His Golden Horned Beast body and Mosha body were checking the objects in Povah God’s world ring, but none of those objects made the toad’s eyes turn red.

Luo Feng waved his hand, and a golden token showed up in his hands.

“Ancestral God.” Luo Feng used it with familiarity, as it was exactly like the token given by Master Sitting Mountain Guest.

Ancestral God gave a response quickly. “What is it, Luo Feng?”

“I found a target who was an ordinary undying fighter. He was the one who made the eyes turn red. I’ve inspected his memories, and that undying fighter has always been living on Jue An Land. There was nothing special about him.” Luo Feng reported. “Did I finish the task?”

“Hahaha! It’s only been a short while, Luo Feng! You’ve only killed an ordinary undying fighter who was in no way harmful to the original universe! Keep killing! Kill all those who turn the eyes red.”

“Then when should I stop?” asked Luo Feng, as he didn’t want to keep killing.

“I’ll tell you when it’s done, and the universe origin will tell me, too! Go, Luo Feng! According to the instructions given by the universe origin, that Povah God is only a foot soldier. Keep searching.”

The communications were cut off.

Luo Feng put away the golden token and shook his head. “The golden toad can only inspect an area of 100 million square kilometers. Jue An Land is so large, and I’ve only searched a small part of it after half a year! If I keep doing that, I might alert someone. Fortunately, no one on Jue An Lan can escape me, unless there are some hidden supreme beings. I might as well begin!”

Luo Feng infused his Shi Wu Wings with his burning godly power.

Hong! Long!

Dimming golden light enveloped everywhere on Jue An Land—the magma, the abyss, and the islands where demon beasts lived or death ocean. They were all covered by the golden light. Even the apex of Jue An Land was covered. This was Golden Country!

Golden Country could cover an area with a diameter of 80 light years at most, and Jue An Land was obviously much smaller, so it was incredibly easy to encompass the whole land.

“Even top-tier universe overlords can be killed in my Golden Country, and even a universe master will be slowed down significantly here.”

Luo Feng immediately stopped the space ripples so that no great beings could teleport themselves! It was easy to manipulate time and space in Golden Country, so a space seal was easy.

Luo Feng stood above Angry Flame Mountain and sensed everywhere on Jue An Land carefully.

“Huh?”

“Why is there a trace of gold on the sky?”

“Look! It’s like the ocean is covered with a golden yarn.”

Everyone on Jue An Land was thrilled. Fortunately, the golden light was inconspicuous. It covered an enormous area, so one could only distinguish the golden light by looking carefully.

“What is that?”

“Is it a master god?”

All the undying fighters on Jue An Land were shocked. The weaker ones couldn’t feel it, but undying fighters could tell that there was boundless power contained in the dim glow—as if they would all be annihilated if it was let out a little bit. Little did they know, the two master gods, Torch Smelting Master God and Mo He Master, were also terrified.

Torch Smelting Master God held a scepter, and the golden light was binding him like ropes. He couldn’t move at all. His eyes were filled with terror.

“How is it so powerful?” he said. “I can’t even move a bit! And the space around me is sealed.”

“Ah! Damn it!” Mu He Master God’s scorpion tail was slashing, but the golden light didn’t even give him a chance to fight. His triangular head roar. “Yuan Ao Supreme God! Are you punishing me?”

Luo Feng nodded. “Good. No hidden beings. The most powerful beings are those two universe knights, Torch Smelting Master God and Mo He Master God.”

Luo Feng freed other areas and only kept the space seal around Torch Smelting Master God and Mo He Master God.

Shua!

Shua!

Luo Feng teleported twice and showed up ten million kilometers away from Torch Smelting Master God and Mo He Master God, inspecting the area using the golden toad.

“Mo He Master God didn’t make the eyes red, but Torch Smelting Master God… This is the origin.”

Luo Feng stood above a volcano around ten million kilometers away from Torch Smelting Master God, and the eyes of the golden toad turned red even from a distance.


Chapter 1143: The Beginning of the Plot

Standing in midair above the mouth of the volcano, Luo Feng disappeared suddenly. Then, one after another, domains connected to the Dark Continent started appearing, but Luo Feng would always appear within one million miles of a place where undying spirits could be found.

“Not red.”

“Not red.”

“Red!”

“Not red.”

After teleporting for a few hundred times, within an extremely short time, he finished surveying the few hundred undying spirits. Out of these undying spirits, there was a total of 12 who could cause both eyes of the golden toad to turn red. Being prudent, Luo Feng immediately put all 12 undying spirits within a dim, sealed space around them to ensure that all 12 undying spirits were unable to move an inch.

“Now, it is time to go meet Torch Smelting Master God.”

Luo Feng trod ahead in midair. One step forward, and he arrived directly above the towering godly palace, which was completely surrounded by volcanoes.

“Huh?” Luo Feng frowned. “There are two targets within this godly palace?”

With the golden toad, he could detect that there were two targets beneath him.

Within the godly palace, in a quiet palace hall, Torch Smelting Master God held onto his scepter as he stood in one spot. He was unable to break free from the invisible golden light restraining him.

Suddenly, there was absolute silence.

A man with dark green wings was slowly descending from the sky and landed in this palace hall, which was in the highest point of this godly palace. Yet he was completely unnoticed by the guards stationed around the entire godly palace. Torch Smelting Master God was a little intimidated when he saw the man before him.

He said, “If I may ask, why is my lord here at Yuan Ao secret region? If I am clear of your purpose of visit, I can request an audience for you with Yuan Ao Master.”

“Why not address him as Yuan Ao Supreme God?” Luo Feng jested.

At the same time, he made a speedy judgment that this Torch Smelting Master God was the cause of the eyes of that golden toad turning red, and not some strange object.

“My lord, you possess such power,” Torch Smelting Master God said reverentially. “You must be a universe master from other powers of the universe.”

Luo Feng made no denial.

“My lord, please feel free to give me your orders,” Torch Smelting Master God said. “I, Torch Smelting, will do my best to serve you.”

“Let me ask you,” Luo Feng began.

“Please speak your mind,” Torch Smelting Master God had barely started when his eyes darkened as though he had already entered an illusion.

Luo Feng frowned as he looked at Torch Smelting Master God before him. I suppose he is only an elementary knight. Yet, I could only manage to make him fall into an illusion, I am unable to search his memory.

To search memories, firstly, one had to be good in the skill itself; secondly, both parties must be very far apart. This Torch Smelting Master God was also a universe knight, albeit a very weak one, but he was very good with aspects involving souls, so Luo Feng could at most push him into an illusion but was unable to search his memories. Luo Feng stood where he was, waiting silently for a moment.

“Finally, he cannot hold out any longer.” Luo Feng smiled and nodded.

Torch Smelting Knight had finally fallen into the illusion. Of course, this merely meant that Luo Feng could carry out his interrogation. He was still unable to search his memories.

“Let me ask you, what special secret do you have?” Luo Feng asked.

With his scepter in his hands, Torch Smelting knight started speaking in a mechanical manner. “I sneak-attacked ‘Stoic God’ and killed him…”

Luo Feng listened with furrowed brows. Something was not right.

It did not sound as though there was anything threatening the primal universe. The primal universe was impregnated with hundreds of millions of races… Even the invincible existence, human form “Teacher Origin,” was suppressed by the universe origin. To be able to be termed as something that boded ill against the primal universe, where even Teacher Origin was mobilized, this was definitely no trivial matter.

“Have you ever left Yuan Ao secret region? Has Yuan Ao Master ever ordered you to handle some important matters? Have you ever obtained any unique treasures, or met with any unique encounters? What makes you stand out from the other knights? What is special about you?”

Luo Feng interrogated Torch Smelting Master God without pause. Completely immersed within his illusionary world, Torch Smelting Master God answered all Luo Feng’s questions with everything he knew. The more Luo Feng heard, the more confused he got. Then, he was struck by a sudden thought…

Shua!

A figure encased in golden light flew over. This was the other target found within the godly palace that caused the eyes of the golden toad to turn red—an undying spirit. This tall and burly life form was black all over. He merely stood in one spot with lifeless eyes. He had already fallen under Luo Feng’s control, wordlessly and without any warning.

“Search his memories.”

Luo Feng was unable to search Torch Smelting Master God, but he was able to search those of this undying. A moment later…

“Huh?” Luo Feng looked at the black and burly undying life form and Torch Smelting Master God. “So coincidental? This undying spirit and the one I killed previously, Povah God, are all soul servants of this Torch Smelting Master God?”

Combining the two memories, Luo Feng discovered this common ground. With a thought in mind, Luo Feng made his move.

In certain faraway lands within the Dark Continent, there were 12 “undying spirits” who could also cause the eyes of the golden toad to become red. With a single thought, Luo Feng released them from the sealed space. Then, by switching time and space, he shifted all of them into this towering palace hall.

Within this palace hall, 15 figures suddenly gathered. Now, Luo Feng was with Torch Smelting Master God and 13 undying spirits.

“Every one of them here are targets.”

“Search!”

Immediately, Luo Feng went to the trouble of painstakingly searching the memories of every undying spirit present. Apart from Torch Smelting Master God, he searched the memories of all the other 13 undying spirits… Then he carefully carried out comparisons.

“There is nothing out of the norm. They are all very ordinary undying! And they crawled out step-by-step from the Dark Continent.” Luo Feng analyzed this. “The only common thing was… all 13 of them are soul servants of Torch Smelting Master God.”

“Torch Smelting.” Luo Feng looked at Torch Smelting, “how many soul servants do you have?”

“A total of 20,” Torch Smelting Master God replied. “Four have been annihilated. 16 left.”

Luo Feng took one look at the 13 undying spirits standing there expressionlessly, as though they were in a coma, and asked, “All are undying?”

“There are three demigods,” Torch Smelting Master God replied.

“Under the command of which undying spirit, from which empire?” Luo Feng asked.

Since he had already searched the memories of these 13 undying spirits, he was naturally familiar with the geographical location of the entire Dark Continent. According to what Torch Smelting Master God said, Luo Feng was able to locate the three soul servant of Torch Smelting Master God, who were sector lords! He searched their memories… but the results were surprising. These three sector lords were unable to cause the eyes of the golden toad to turn red, so obviously, they were not the targets he was looking for.

These three sector lords were not targets. But—out of all the soul servants of Torch Smelting Master God—every single one of the undying servants are targets. Even Torch Smelting Master God himself is a target.

Luo Feng pondered this. But Torch Smelting Master God himself does not seem to present any problems. Could it be…?

“Torch Smelting, is Yuan Ao your master?” Luo Feng asked.

“Yes,” Torch Smelting Master God replied in a mechanical manner.

Luo Feng laughed suddenly. “So, it is really him…” Luo Feng continued pressing him for more information. “Do you know whether Yuan Ao Master has other soul servants?”

“Yes, there are two that I know of,” Torch Smelting Master God replied in his mechanical voice again.

“Tell me their names. Where are they?” Luo Feng asked.

A short while later…

Including Torch Smelting Master God, all 14 targets were annihilated without a second thought. Luo Feng retreated from this golden kingdom and immediately teleported away from the Dark Continent. Then he proceeded to an even wider continent out of the twelve large continents: Towering Continent.

Within the mezzanine spaces corresponding to the universe space of the Yuan Ao secret region, in the depths of the limitless space debris, there was a vast, towering god country. This god country was mighty and boundless.

Suspended in midair above this god country was a gigantic continent. This suspended continent had many black chains that were all at least 60 million miles long, plunged straight into the bottomless ocean. The entire suspended continent seemed unable to float away because of these few hundred huge black chains connected to it.

Right in the core of this suspended continent, there was a vast lake. Within the lake, there was a boiling-hot black fluid. If any universe knight were to fall within this black fluid, he would be burned and annihilated within an instant.

There was an incomparably towering figure lying over there. This towering figure was like a giant sculpted out of a gigantic mountain, and it lay within the vast lake brimming with that boiling-hot black fluid.

Hua!

The giant sat up suddenly. His head was squarish with only one large eye and a mouth. His godly body wore gray armor covered with a layer of mercury-like liquid set into a continuous motion. The moment he sat up, it was as though a towering mountain were emerging out of a lake filled with black fluid. The black fluid continuously flowed from his body to return to the lake.

He was none other than the famous Yuan Ao Master!

“The misty, golden domain,” Yuan Ao Master said in a low voice. “Even Torch Smelting is unable to resist? Looks resembling that of the Ka Vulture clan with an invincible power. Oh… He has fallen into an illusion.”

Torch Smelting Master God was his soul servant, so naturally, they could communicate via their souls even if they were very far away from one another. Even at the very instant, he knew he had fallen into an illusion; Torch Smelting Master God was quick at providing Yuan Ao Master with information immediately.

What a pity. He quickly fell into enemy’s hands and was no longer able to transmit information.

“What strong power. A top-tier universe overlord? No. He must be a universe master.”

Yuan Ao Master waited in silence. Only a short moment later, Yuan Ao Master felt his servant, Torch Smelting Master God, being annihilated.

“He really is dead.” Yuan Ao Master affirmed the fact in a low voice, his eyes burning with a strange emotion. “Everything is happening as expected. Once the plan is activated… the Ancestral God School— the self-proclaimed guardians of the primal universe origin—will be sure to make a move. Indeed, this move came pretty quickly. The Ancestral God School must have sent a universe master. Bring it on.”

“What a great sacrifice,” he continued, “but Ancestral God School coming here doesn’t really mean much. Since the great being from the Ancestral God School has arrived… I should also move on to my next step: the demons… The Space Beast Alliance… The Northern Territory Alliance… They should all make their way here one after the other.”

Luo Feng was oblivious to everything that was happening.

Strange, he thought. It is understandable if Yuan Ao Master did not know about me killing Povah God. But I killed his soul servant, Torch Smelting Master God. Yuan Ao Master would surely learn of it almost immediately. Luo Feng stood high up in the sky of the vast Tower Continent, with slightly furrowed brows as he considered. But Yuan Ao Master has not made a single move at all.

Yuan Ao Master might have very strong power, but Luo Feng had no fear for him.

But Yuan Ao Master did not appear…

Luo Feng felt that something was not right. If there was someone slaughtering great beings in the human territory, then universe masters of the human race would have reacted and appeared quickly. Besides, based on the information obtained from earlier investigations, Torch Smelting Master God and the other undying soul servants were already confirmed as targets. Since Yuan Ao Master was the master of Torch Smelting Master God, it was very likely that the source might be found with Yuan Ao Master!

“We shall see. I am very interested to know what tricks he has up his sleeves and what could mean harm to the primal universe.”

With a thought in mind, Luo Feng made his move.

Hong! Long!

An endless, misty, golden light—bringing with it the power of Milky Way Horde Leader—landed directly on this Towering Continent with a maximum diameter of 5.1 light years. At this very moment, not one of those great beings on Towering Continent would ever hold hopes of eluding Luo Feng’s control.


Chapter 1144: Yuan Ao Supreme God

Towering Continent was a relatively huge continent out of the 12 continents. There were countless beings living on the continent, and hundreds of millions of lives died during the horde leader wars, empire wars, and godly wars. These wars had resulted in generations of great beings. There were six master gods in total on Towering Continent, around 1,000 undying fighters, and countless half deities and legends.

“Seal!”

Luo Feng stood under the seven-color light membrane. His wings were open, and he looked down at the land.

The dimming golden light covered the entire Towering Continent and everyone on it… Under the boundless golden light, those half deities, legends, and saints were still able to move, but undying fighters and master gods couldn’t move even a bit. Under space seal, they couldn’t teleport themselves.

“Such a strong binding!”

“So powerful. Ah! The great Yuan Ao Supreme God!”

More than half of the undying fighters on Towering Continent shouted the name Yuan Ao Supreme God. These undying fighters had soul servants as well, and they could determine from their servants that the golden light was covering a vast area.

Those undying fighters had made contact with their master gods, and they knew that those master gods were this powerful. Master gods were only able to put pressure on individual undying fighters, but they wouldn’t be able to affect an area of ten billion square kilometers. Only Yuan Ao Supreme God was able to do that.

“Ah, my 22 servants are distributed on different areas on Towering Continent, and all of them are covered by golden light. How large the area is! It’s over one square light year. This is what a universe master is capable of.”

A gleaming godly palace floated in the mist, and there were white-caped and golden-caped servants in the palace. This was the godly palace of Glorious Master God, and it was the honor of saints, legends, and half deities to serve the great Glorious Master God “Ta Wo.” However, their Glorious Master God now sat on the throne and couldn’t even move a muscle. He was terrified.

“It isn’t Yuan Ao Supreme God… Who is it? Who is it?” Glorious Master God was horrified. “This is a universe master!”

Undying fighters were yelling, “Yuan Ao Supreme God!”

The half-deity guards were also shouting, “Yuan Ao Supreme God!”

The legend servants were also shouting, “Yuan Ao Supreme God!”

Glorious Master God Ta Wo sat on the throne, scared stiff. He couldn’t scold the great beings under him. After all, those undying fighters didn’t have much to do with Yuan Ao Supreme Master, but he was a soul servant of Yuan Ao Supreme God, so naturally, he knew that it didn’t come from Yuan Ao Supreme God.

“Yuan Ao Supreme God.”

“Yuan Ao Supreme God.”

The great beings kept shouting.

Suddenly, space and time were frozen, while those undying fighters and half deities stopped talking under the increasing pressure.

In the distance, a man with four teal-blue wings soaked in golden light walked in. All the undying fighters, half deities, legends, and Glorious Master God gazed at him.

“Ta Wo,” said the winged man as he approached Glorious Master God. His voice resounded in the palace. “You’re a soul slave of Yuan Ao?”

“How dare you disrespect Yuan Ao Supreme God!” a legend servant screamed. “How dare you call Yuan Ao Supreme God by his name!”

Although he was afraid of this individual, he had been indoctrinated that Yuan Ao Supreme God was the almighty being deserving of awe; his belief was stronger than his fear of death, which was why he was infuriated by this stranger using the name “Yuan Ao” directly.

“How dare you call Yuan Ao Supreme God by name!”

“You!”

Peng! Peng! Peng!

All of a sudden, those who had spoken were turned to ashes. Luo Feng didn’t even look at them… Those domain lords and sector lords just hadn’t wanted to live, as they had dared to defy a universe master.

On the contrary, the undying fighters in the palace and Glorious Master God Ta Wo didn’t say anything.

“No answer?” whispered Luo Feng. “Answer me. Are you a soul servant of Yuan Ao?”

Suddenly, Ta Wo’s eyes lost all the light, and he answered, “Yes, I’m a soul slave of Yuan Ao Supreme God.”

The undying fighters looked at Ta Wo in shock. They took note of his dismal eyes and stiff voice. They all understood now that Ta Wo was being controlled. They knew that Ta Wo Master God was a universe knight, and he was a great being who was able to roam the earth. Who would able to control a universe knight so easily?

“It is! I thought Torch Smelting’s news was fake.” Luo Feng smiled. “Give me the names of your soul slaves.”

“Ke Ya, Bu Si, Luo Ma Qi…” Glorious Master God Ta Wo answered repeatedly.

“All your undying soul slaves are targets.” Luo Feng looked to the undying fighters down there. “Time to kill you all.”

Luo Feng had teleported on Towering Continent before arriving at the palace. He found out that two universe knights and 49 undying fighters were targets! He searched the memories of undying fighters. There were thousands of undying fighters on the 12 continents, and they all knew each other.

Since Luo Feng had searched their memories, he knew the undying fighters and their names. He also heard the names revealed to him by Glorious Master God, and all those undying soul slaves were the targets!

The undying fighters started to beg Luo Feng for mercy upon seeing him decide to kill them.

“No, please spare our lives!”

“Great being, please spare our lives.”

“Great being, we have no intention to be your enemy. Please spare our lives—we’ll be grateful for your mercy forever.”

“Hmm?” Luo Feng turned his head and looked into the distance. He could see that a being that had just arrived at Towering Continent.

Above an ocean, a giant arm tore the seven-color light membrane, and a being walked into Towering Continent. He was a towering being, and the sole eye on his head gazed into the distance. He was Yuan Ao Master! The legendary Yuan Ao Supreme God of the 12 continents.

Heng!

After a snort, his armor started to burn with flames, and the golden light couldn’t affect him at all.

“So powerful,” he said. “Even I can’t control the space and time. It might be a top-tier domain type true treasure. Fortunately, I have a top-tier domain type true treasure as well. Otherwise, I would be at a disadvantage.”

Yuan Ao Master’s godly body started to glow.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

All of a sudden, endless flames appeared on Towering Continent.

“Ah! Flames!”

“Fire!”

“Ah! Danger!”

“Incredible!”

Just when all the lives on Towering Continent were horrified, they soon realized that those flames weren’t powerful at all. Even a baby wouldn’t be harmed by the flames; the golden flames were like a breeze.

“Look.”

“Nothing happened.”

“It’s so weird.”

Everyone on Towering Continent was thrilled. Even the wars were paused. Under those incredible flames, they couldn’t see things in the distance. It was a miracle!

The dimming golden light didn’t affect the wars on the continent, but the flames significantly narrowed the residents’ vision.

Glorious God Palace.

“Please, spare our lives!”

“Mercy, please.”

Just when the undying fighters were begging for their lives, endless flames arrived.

The Golden Country formed by Shi Wu Wings was fundamentally different from domain type true treasures. Domain type true treasures would clash with each other if their power were let out, as Thousand Treasures River and Floating Mountain Ocean clashed with each other on the original stars. However, if the powers were different, it would not happen.

Master of Banfu’s E Luo Sector still existed in Luo Feng’s miniature universe, as they had contrasting types of power. Golden Country a control over space and time, like that of a universe master, but much more powerful because it came from Shi Wu Wing’s secret techniques! That was why Yuan Ao Master wasn’t able to control the space and time.

“I’ll kill all the targets.” Luo Feng glanced around.

“How dare you!” roared the voice of Yuan Ao Master came from the endless golden flames.

The flames immediately put Ta Wo and those undying fighters under their protection. Although the domain type true treasure wasn’t able to extend as far as Golden Country, it was almost as powerful.

“Yuan Ao, you can’t protect them,” said Luo Feng calmly.

Luo Feng’s words dazed everyone in the palace. This being wasn’t even afraid of Yuan Ao Supreme God? They had been indoctrinated that Yuan Ao Supreme God was supreme since they were born!

“Help us, Yuan Ao Supreme God!” yelled Glorious Master God.

“Save us, Yuan Ao Supreme God!” yelled the undying fighters.

“He won’t be able to kill you,” said Yuan Ao Supreme God.

Luo Feng shook his head. “What a joke.”

Hong! Hong! Hong!

A golden river surged from Luo Feng’s body. The flames crumbled beneath Nine Tiger River, and Glorious Master God and his three soul slaves were annihilated immediately.

“Damn you!” roared the voice from the endless flames.


Chapter 1145: A New Route

Luo Feng took a last look at the surviving undying spirits, demigods, and legendary beings who looked lifeless, shocked, and fearful. Then he turned and took a step forward… and left this Glorious God Palace.

Within the hall of the Glorious God Palace, there were two undying spirits (not soul servants), a group of demigod guards, and a group of legendary servants.

“In the presence of Supreme God, how dare he? How dare he…?”

“He—he actually killed Glorious Master God who was under the protection of our Supreme God!”

“Who is he?”

A rolling sea of waves was upheaved in the minds of this group of legendary beings, demigods, and two undying spirits. As the two undying spirits were not strangers to the vast universe out of Yuan Ao secret region, their brief understanding allowed them to guess that this enemy must be a universe master who came from the vast universe. But the demigods and legendary beings were different. They were oblivious. They had always been instilled with various beliefs like, “no one can disobey Supreme God’s commands,” and, “Supreme God is invincible.”

“To think, to think…”

In the hearts of these legendary beings (domain masters) and demigods (sector lords), a new seed was sprouting. They had banished all such thoughts about the Supreme God being invincible as a sudden realization dawned on them… In the vast universe, the 12 large continents were never the core. There was an even larger world beyond their continents.

“That enemy was able to match up to Supreme God. Why can’t I?”

The seed had been sown, so now, there was hope of bearing fruit.

Luo Feng took a step out of Glorious God Palace. Out in the surroundings, rolling waves of Nine Tiger River were surging. With the empowerment of Golden Kingdom, the weaker Nine Tiger River was still able to cause that endless flame to disperse to naught.

“Yuan Ao Master.” Luo Feng looked at the towering figure standing amidst the endless flame from afar. The towering figure from afar was glaring furiously at Luo Feng with its single eye. “Who are you? Don’t sneak around. You are not from the Ka Vulture clan!”

“Haha…” Luo Feng laughed, and instantly, his fiery-red hair changed to black, while his armor and wings transformed back to their original color. This was a black-haired man with silver armor and wings.

“And you are?” Yuan Ao Master revealed a trace of uncertainty.

“Luo Feng,” Luo Feng answered immediately.

Yuan Ao Master’s eye was filled with shock. “The extraordinary genius from humanity that became a universe master? It has not been that long, has it? You… When did you become a universe master?”

Yuan Ao Master did not belong to any top power because he had quickly become a universe master soon after the birth of the universe. For countless years, his power naturally became very strong, so he did not need to be part of any top power and could roam the universe as a lone wanderer. Yet, because he was a lone wanderer, he was always behind time and uninformed of the latest news.

“Not too long ago,” Luo Feng replied.

“Oh…” Yuan Ao Master pondered for a slight moment as a complicated look flashed in his single eye. After a short while, he said, “So, you are Milky Way Horde Leader, Luo Feng! Demon race territory in the distance.

Peng!

Luo Feng was in one of the void spaces of the Yuan Ao secret region.

Using Star Tower was not a consuming process for his godly power, but Miniature Universe used up a good one-tenth of his godly body!

If I had not executed Miniature Universe just now, I would have been at an absolute disadvantage! thought Luo Feng. I would probably have been blown away from a distance, and my godly body would have sustained severe injuries.

With the empowerment of Miniature Universe, he was able to alleviate his disadvantage by a little.

Keeping each attack at maximum force, every execution would consume ten percent of my godly body. Just a few executions and I will be a goner.

Luo Feng shook his head in silence. Not a match.

Chapter 1148: Nine Remoteness, Ocean Eye

Luo Feng nodded. He was only able to use the second level of Star Tower, but the second level of Star Tower was already mighty enough.

Luo Feng nodded.

The pinnacle set true treasure that Double-Face Ancestral God used and the pinnacle true treasure maces that Star River Master used were both inferior to that strange object. Even the second level of Star Tower was barely at the same level as that black wood, and the black wood could be wielded at its strongest immediately. Who wouldn’t want that?

“However, there’s a downside to strange objects,” said You Nan Master. “They are rejected by the universe. Both the original universe and miniature universe rejected strange objects. It seems the strange objects can affect the stability of the universe origin once they’re in one. They seem to be aligned naturally against the universe origin.”

Luo Feng now understood. Naturally against the universe origin… No wonder Ancestral God said something harmful to the original universe was going on here.

“Unfortunately for Yuan Ao Master, he’s a loner,” said You Nan Master. “Although he’s free to be a loner, nobody shares secrets with him. Besides, it’s rare that strange objects are born, so even for me, I just learned the secret from Ancestral God.” He smiled. “Yuan Ao Master doesn’t know that the black wood is rejected by the original universe, which is why he brought it back to the original universe. It’s okay that he doesn’t use it, but if he uses it, the power from that black wood clashes with the universe origin. Other great beings aren’t able to sense that, but universe supreme masters can clearly sense the existence of that black object.”

Luo Feng nodded.

Apparently, they are already second-class supreme true treasures, how can the powers not go mad for them? The universe supreme masters will come here by themselves if they don’t know that other powers know about this secret.”

Luo Feng now fully understood the story.

It was almost impossible to get a supreme true treasure, and no universe masters in the universe were known to have supreme true treasures, not even Primal Chaos City Leader and Star River Master. Even some supreme masters didn’t have supreme true treasures! Who didn’t want a strange object that was only slightly inferior to a supreme true treasure?

Luo Feng was unable to suppress a laugh.

Sou!

The four supreme beings disappeared.

Four beings stood in the space and looked at the 12 floating continents.

The easiest way is to use godly power to cause an explosion on one of the continents, and then Yuan Ao Master would come. However, You Nan Master and the others were all of high status, and they wouldn’t do such a thing if those ordinary lives didn’t mess with them.

Chapter 1149: Being Trampled On

Being able to cause Yuan Ao Master to lose 1/1,000th of his godly body was considered quite a feat. Since becoming Milky Way Horde Leader, Luo Feng would engage in idle chats occasionally with his teacher, Primal Chaos City Leader, to obtain a deeper understanding of the powers of universe masters. As for Nine Remoteness Master, every time he divided out another body, its life gene level would likely only be able to reach 1,000 times, but as for the supreme technique that he could execute… Once he self-destructed, he was able to converge all the energy of his entire godly being to bring about a mass explosion in an instant! That was why Star River Master, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Nine Remoteness Master were considered the cream of the crop—and could be regarded as the most powerful universe masters within the universe today!

Above the rank of a supreme universe master was the universe supreme being!

Ice Mountain Master. He was one of the three disciples of Teacher Origin, and all the three disciples of Teacher Origins were incredible. Ice Mountain Master might have been slightly weaker than Primal Chaos City Leader, but the gap wasn’t significant.

Chapter 1151: Black Universe Creator

“The only way to stop Yuan Ao Master is to seal him,” said Nine Remoteness Master to all the other universe masters. “However, Yuan Ao Master isn’t stupid. He must be alert, as he knows this is the only way to kill him, so he won’t just let us seal him. We need a plan to do that.”

“I have a pinnacle domain type true treasure, and it can cover an area of tens of square light years. It’ll be impossible for Yuan Ao Master to escape.”

“I have a seal type true treasure, and it’s top-tier level. It can seal him.”

All the universe masters voiced their opinions and announced their true treasures. No wonder they were the representatives from all the superpowers. Three of them had pinnacle domain type true treasures. They were Golden Horn Master, Sea Lotus Master, and Cantus Devil Master… As for the pinnacle seal type true treasure, it was carried by Ice Mountain Master.

“Okay.”

“Of course.”

“Your plan sounds good, but are you sure you can seal that Yuan Ao Master, even with all of you?” A cold voice resounded in the space, which attracted all the universe masters.

Chapter 1154: Crazy Battles of Contention

Teacher’s deity form had the exact same look as the image that often appeared within the virtual universe. The body in charge of matters within Primal Chaos City was ferocious-looking, while the body in the primal universe had to be a special life-form.

Shua!

In a deserted land in the primal universe, there was a gigantic black hole. This black hole had long caused the vast surrounding starfield to fall into darkness, but two figures appeared in a flash. They were none other than Primal Chaos City Leader and Luo Feng.

Universe Ocean is shockingly big. Even the primal universe is only a fraction of the vast Universe Ocean. There are also some other journeys that will require teleportation. Once you lost your way… If you think to teleport to get back on the right track, you will more likely find yourself moving further away with each teleportation. Thereafter, you will be forever lost within Universe Ocean. If you are lucky enough, you may be able to find your way back… after countless eras.”

The very idea made Luo Feng’s heart tremble.

With an avatar around, at least you are still able to obtain a map. However, even if you do obtain a map, if you get lost somewhere too far away— where you cannot find a reference object on the map—it’s also game over for you. That’s why, when you are in Universe Ocean, you had better not run about as you please. Luo Feng nodded his head repeatedly. He understood.

“The places on the map with clear markings are where you can teleport,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. The two flew straight toward the depths of Toya Black Hole and quickly vanished from sight.

Chapter 1160

1160 Broken Universe

Toya Black Hole was the most powerful black hole in the original universe.

That’s the original universe? thought Luo Feng. The cradle that breeds billions of races? The cradle that bred me?

He didn’t feel the pressure from the original universe, but he felt it was untouchable, just as an ordinary person felt the sun was untouchable.

Primal Chaos City Leader took Luo Feng and teleported them. There were 39 space holes in total, all of which were natural wormholes.

Natural wormholes! Teleportation! Teleportation! Teleportation!

Chapter 1161
