Roach Prison Master and Firestone Master were talking in the space of the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector.

“Firestone, why were you so mean just now? Luo Feng isn’t that weak.”

“Why? Why do I have to be less mean? Just because of Primal Chaos City Leader? Besides, I wasn’t wrong.” Firestone Master’s nose exhaled fire. “Luo Feng fought Master of Banff before. Master of Banff is good at illusions and bad at material attack, and he doesn’t even have a supreme technique. How did Luo Feng do? He was suppressed, and he could barely rival Master of Banff with that miniature universe.”

“That miniature universe killed all those universe knights with one shot,” Roach Prison Master said.

“Humph! He can only kill the weaker ones,” said Firestone Master. “A miniature universe is like a domain type true treasure. It can only kill the weak, but what about the strong? It can only aid, and that kind of supreme technique requires a lot of energy. It consumes godly power, and it can only add some power. Even so, he only has material attack skills equivalent to Master of Banff. Without that miniature universe, anyone can crush him.”

Firestone Master was breathing fire again as he continued, “Humph! I was being too nice. He is one of the weakest. Those ancient guys from the first universe era are all mad, and everyone from the two sanctuaries can crush him. Was I wrong? If he dies, the true treasures will be seized. How long has he practiced? The true treasures might be bestowed by the human race. We have to make great efforts to get a good universe master, yet he has so many after just becoming a universe master. Just wait and see. He’ll be crushed.”

“Yes, he is indeed weak.” Roach Prison Master lowered his giant head.

“Humph!” said Firestone Master. “He’s human, so his teacher Primal Chaos City Leader will go rescue him every time he’s in danger. Without his teacher, he’ll definitely be killed in Tilted Peak Sector.”

Only Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader were left in the palace. “Luo Feng, I’ll go adventure, as well,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Contact me through the virtual universe.”

“Yes, teacher.” Luo Feng nodded.

“Okay.” Primal Chaos City Leader glanced at Luo Feng, smiled, and disappeared.

Luo Feng looked back to the godly palace. He was the only one here now. It seemed that great beings in Universe Ocean were indeed sharpening themselves.

“I need to study the information on Tilted Peak Sector and great beings.”

On a rock outside the godly palace, Luo Feng closed his eyes with his legs crossed and started to organize the information and highlight the important parts.

Hua!

The rocks were flying at a speed several times the speed of light, but Luo Feng looked tranquil. He didn’t rush to adventure the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector.

“Huh?” Luo Feng took a token out. “Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest is contacting me? No wonder it’s a true treasure communications token. I can make contact even in Universe Ocean.” Luo Feng penetrated the token with a trace of his mind.

“Luo Feng, are you in Universe Ocean?” Sitting Mountain Guest passed on a piece of information.

“Yes,” answered Luo Feng.

“Which Lands of Extremis?” asked Sitting Mountain Guest.

“Tilted Peak Sector. How do you know I am in one of the Lands of Extremis?”

“Because they have the most true treasures. Where else would you go? Some remote and dangerous places with few valuables? The human race is not stupid. Okay, if you run into danger, you can call for help, but I hope you won’t do so.”

“I understand,” answered Luo Feng.

Universe Ocean, deep in the chaos airflow, in a dangerous place known as “Bei Hua Xue Lan Domain.”

A palace was floating. There were servants in the palaces; all of them were universe knights. This was where Sitting Mountain Guest really lived, and Bei Hua Xue Lan Domain represented him.

There were almost 100 powers in Universe Ocean, but no power wanted to mess with Sitting Mountain Guest. Everyone knew he was a handful.

Inside the palace, a towering elder sat on the throne, and a human with a snake’s tail and a human body was serving him.

“Haha, Pu Ti, your little brother entered Universe Ocean as well,” Sitting Mountain Guest’s voice rumbled.

“Congratulations, teacher,” said Pu Ti.

“It’s too early to congratulate me now. He’s not powerful enough.” Sitting Mountain Guest looked down at Pu Ti. “Pu Ti, you’ve been following me the longest, so you know me the best. Your second brother disappoints me, so I have almost given up on him now. You’re the most hard-working one, but I know that Luo Feng has the greatest potential, followed by your second brother. You have the least potential, but now, you’re the strongest.”

Pu Ti bowed. “I’ve been practicing for the longest time, and I’ve been by your side. I’ve seen a lot, so I comprehended more.”

He was low-key and never showed off. Even Flame Emperor looked down on Pu Ti, as he only viewed him as a servant. He didn’t know that Pu Ti had surpassed him.

“I’ll give you a chance. The same chance your second and third brother have. Go to Universe Ocean.” Sitting Mountain Guest looked at Pu Ti and took out a piece of blue wood. “I can’t give you the true treasure that suits you best, so I’ll give you this strange object. Godly wood… I’ve had it for an eternity, but I just view it as a collectible. You should be able to wield its power.”

Pu Ti’s godly body trembled. The same chance his second and third brother had? He’d been waiting for this for so long.

“Yes, teacher, I’ll try my best not to disappoint you.” Pu Ti bowed, but his voice was filled with faith.

Sitting Mountain Guest nodded. “Go.”

Pu Ti bowed again before leaving the palace.

Sitting Mountain Guest looked through the palace door ward Tilted Peak Sector in the distance, and he said slowly, “I’ve been waiting for too long…”


Chapter 1163: Calling for Help

On the surface of the celestial rock was a soul that looked as big as a speck of dust—standing at a height of thousands of kilometers was the human form of Luo Feng.

“Tilted Peak Sector!”

Luo Feng stood on the celestial rock and looked around the vast void space that surrounded him. From afar, he could see the lofty and boundless main mountain with a gigantic waterfall cascading from its peak. It exuded endless power without restraint; this power attracted countless celestial rocks to circulate it while in flight, and it also forced a great amount of chaotic airflow to break apart.

“From today onward, I, Luo Feng, shall start to roam Universe Ocean.”

Radiant rays surged in Luo Feng’s eyes, making them sparkle like crystals.

Shua!

He disappeared from the celestial rock right away and reappeared amidst the faraway void space. Thereafter, he repeatedly teleported himself and charged down toward the boundless water domain that took form upon repeated impact by the cascading waterfall.

Tilted Peak Sector’s external domain could be divided into space domain and water domain. Space domain referred to the void space where many gigantic celestial rocks flew about randomly. The danger level here was extremely low, as only some celestial rocks would occasionally pose a degree of danger. The majority of these countless celestial rocks had already been explored over a long period of time. That was why great beings would more often refer to the external domain of Tilted Peak to the water domain.

The water domain that took form under the impact of the cascading waterfall spread out to encircle the entire main mountain. There were jagged rocks of distorted forms fraught with danger. Many areas would deter even universe masters from teleporting about. Universe masters had to be extremely careful even when they were flying forward. They would only dare teleport when they were by the area near the edge of the water domain and had carefully inspected with a domain type true treasure to ensure that the coast was clear.

“The most common yet most terrifying danger found within the water domain in the external domain of Tilted Peak Region would be… ‘water flow spirit.’”

Luo Feng stood high up in the sky and overlooked the vast water domain beneath him. The water domain was massive, with a diameter of a couple hundred million light years. It was even bigger than an entire human universe kingdom! And bigger than the Ancestral God secret region!

“Water flow spirits have no intelligence, nor do they bear any consciousness,” Luo Feng said to himself. “They only have basic instincts. They will only attack you if you get close to them… A water flow spirit in this water domain will be able to rely on its surroundings for power, and such power is comparable to that of a universe master.”

Thereafter, he was extremely careful as he directly rushed into the water domain below him, causing splashes of water as he landed.

In Universe Ocean, even undying godly spirits would be annihilated the moment they entered. Yet this endless water domain was able to exist. Clearly, there must have been something extraordinary about this “water;” every drop was like a star, and when waves of this water surged, the impact was extremely frightening. However, universe masters would still be able to block off this impact without difficulty.

“The water domain is fraught with danger but loaded with treasures.” Luo Feng was also aware that the treasures within the water domain existed in various forms. To obtain a treasure, one needed luck, power, and guts.

When Luo Feng entered the water domain, the depths of the vast and limitless water domain was around 100 million light years. With such a large quantity of undulating rocks, and the water pressure reaching such a frighteningly suppressive degree, even a universe knight could have turned to powder in an instant.

Hong! Long! Long! Long!

One celestial stone slowly rose from beneath, causing the surrounding stones to start vibrating as it continued its gradual emergence… Slowly, it continued.

The entire process took quite a while before coming to a halt. The celestial stone was already jutting out at an approximate height of close to a million kilometers. Then peace resumed.

Being 100 million light years away, Luo Feng did not detect anything amiss. He continued to explore the water domain with extreme care, and he was only at the shallowest region of the water domain.

Three million light years away from Luo Feng.

Firestone Master, with his towering godly body vaguely encircled by flames, flew slowly within the water domain. As a matter of course, he had parted ways with Roach Prison Master. After all, while roaming the Universe Ocean, the chances of finding treasures would be higher if one was traveling alone.

“Humph! Humanity sent Luo Feng into Universe Ocean, probably for him to hone his skills and steel himself. They want to cultivate his ability well. We, the non-human races from the Hong Alliance, did not have such opportunities.” Firestone Master was filled with bitterness. “He was able to gain so many true treasures without having to take any risks. It was said that, at the sector lord level, he already owned a few true treasures. We shall see. See how much trouble this fellow can create. I think it won’t take him long to start calling various parties for help.”

Firestone Master was filled with disdain. Such occurrences of great beings seeking help were not unprecedented. Way back when the demons of the primal universe wanted to cultivate and train Chang Vulture Master, who was an extraordinary genius with staggering powers and extremely high potential, they sent him into Universe Ocean to enable him to hone his skills. They bestowed him with some formidable true treasures for self-protection. When he met with dangers that he could not ward off or resist, other great beings from the demon race would send help immediately.

After a long period of training and cultivation, Chang Vulture Master eventually became a universe master known to be the cream of the crop and a most frightening figure! He was high in the ranks, only second to Dream Demon Ancestor and Shock Demon Ancestor. Apparently, Dream Demon Ancestor and Shock Demon Ancestor were incredibly sharp in identifying Chang Vulture Master’s potential.

But… this did not conceal the fact that Chang Vulture Master had sent out calls for help on several occasions, and those calls for help had created quite a commotion among the entire demon alliance. “Luo Feng has great potential. Definitely an extraordinary genius with astounding power but obviously still at the bottom of the ranks. If he were to run into the older universe masters, he would be at a great disadvantage and would probably have to send out calls for help.” Firestone Master shook his head. “Make a scene, just go ahead and make a scene. There is only one thing that I don’t know. Will he be able to reach the level of Chang Vulture Master of the demon race in the future?”

Although he was displeased, Firestone Master knew that the moment Luo Feng asked for help, if he was nearby, he would immediately dash over to wherever Luo Feng was to render help.

“If he asks for help and I provide him with help, I’ll be able to give him a piece of my mind,” Firestone Master said to himself.

He knew that this would make Luo Feng unhappy, but he was a universe master who had undergone an immeasurable period of cultivation. Why should he allow himself to be bound by any rules— or anything else at all? If he wanted to laugh, he would; if he felt like scolding, he should; he was die-hard stubborn. So what?

I am unhappy with you, he thought. I would curse at you. I simply cannot find anything pleasing about you, Luo Feng. So what can you do?

Firestone Master was in the depth of the water domain, careful to avoid the water flow spirits in the distance. The water flow spirits were all white. At times, they took the form of white airflows. Other times, they took the form of humans, and other times, they were in the form of beasts. They were always in different strange forms as they drifted about the water domain.

This area was already considered quite deep and extremely dangerous. The speed of flight was way much slower. And teleporting? It was impossible to teleport at all! After all, once a water flow spirit attached itself to any being, the results were scary to imagine.

“Huh?” A sudden realization gave Firestone Master a good shock, “A sealed space?”

The space waves within the surroundings of the water domain ceased in a split-second. Firestone Master knew there was trouble looming. He looked around carefully and saw a spot of light in the distance.

The spot of light laughed. Its laughter was transmitted via the water domain, and almost within an instant, it reached Firestone Master.

“Hahaha, Firestone Master from the human alliance of the primal universe?”

That spot of light… It was a life form taking the form of a human. His entire body gave off a hazy, white light, and at the back of his head, there was a circular white light. Amidst the white light, was a vague form of a gigantic, single-eyed shadow.

“Divine Eye race!” Firestone Master immediately transformed into a beam of light and fled.

The Divine Eye race was one of the pinnacle races from the first universe era and was said to be the strongest pinnacle race during that era, with a total of seven universe supreme beings within the race! The Divine Eye race was a very secretive and scary race. They could have emerged in the first universe reincarnation era possibly due to certain unique accidents that happened during the evolution of the primal universe, and they possessed astounding power.

“You think you can escape us?” he great being from the Divine Eye race said.

Hong! Long!

Countless grains of sand appeared out of nowhere, and these countless grains filled the surrounding area with a radius of three light years within an instant. The surrounding space was earlier sealed, but even if it had not been sealed, no one would have dared to teleport through it without inhibitions. After all, this area was a dangerous land located deep within.

A radius of three light years… How could Firestone Master possibly fly out of it within a short time?

“Ice Sand Ocean!” Firestone Master gritted his teeth and looked back at that human form life-being dazzling with white light. With a furious hum, he spurted flames out of his nostrils. “An Yong Master, I have not gained any incredible true treasure. And I escaped the moment I saw you. Must you chase after me so relentlessly?”

“Life is limited,” the human form dazzling with white light slowly articulated. “Eternity is hard to find. Through endless killings, I seek the path to eternity. This is my only path now. Firestone Master… meet your doom.”

Hua!

Enshrouded in white light, with circular white rays at the back of his head, the single-eyed shadow of An Yong Master approached at an extremely high speed and charged towards Firestone Master at full force.

“Damn,” said Firestone Master, then he roared in rage, “Want to kill me? In your dreams!”

Yet he continued fleeing at full throttle, trying his very best to stall for time… At the same time, in the primal universe, his other body was speedily calling for help within the virtual universe.

“Previously, I was still commenting about Luo Feng’s pleas for help. Who would have thought that, in the blink of an eye, I would become the one asking for help? This lunatic from the first universe era, he truly is insane! How unlucky I am, to have bumped into An Yong Master.”

Firestone Master was filled with anxiety. He knew that he was facing true danger now.

“I only have a hope of surviving if either Primal Chaos City Leader or Peng Gong Master rushes over now.”

Firestone Master was also aware that those who were able to make it over to him within the shortest time possible were those few he had met up with earlier at the gathering point: Remote Lord Master, Roach Prison Master, and Absolute Darkness Master. But they were not powerful enough, and Luo Feng was not even worth a mention…

Only Primal Chaos City Leader and Peng Gong Master could save him. But those two were so powerful that they would most probably be at the internal domain of Tilted Peak Sector, and if they were really at the internal domain, then rushing over here would take a long time.

The call for help was sent, and the virtual universe system transferred the call to the universe masters of the human alliance who were within Universe Ocean at that very moment right away.

Within the deep mountain region of Tilted Peak Sector’s main mountain.

“Firestone Master is calling for help? An Yong Master of the Divine Eye race from the first universe era is hunting him down?”

Hong! Long! Long!

Flames shot up into the sky. Every flame exerted an impact that was strong enough to annihilate a universe master. A barbaric giant whose every step was elusive like that of a phantom, flashed past the erratic outburst of flames.

“I am too deep inside. Even rushing back will take a long time. I won’t be able to make it on time.”

“Firestone, you have to depend on your luck.”

“An Yong Master?”

At that moment, Roach Prison Master was considered the nearest to Firestone Master; it was somewhere within the water domain, more than one million light years away from Firestone Master. On its gigantic head, its eyes blinked.

“Big trouble. I’m afraid my presence will not make much of a difference, but I will try my best and see if I can be of any help.”

Hua!

Roach Prison Master sped up and charged into the sky. With a single teleportation, he was in the upper skies of the water domain. Thereafter, he repeatedly teleported through the void space to get to his intended destination in the fastest time possible.

Luo Feng also received the call for help.

“Huh? A call for help? Firestone Master is calling out for help? The address indicates that the place is only slightly more than three million light years away from me.”

Luo Feng did feel some resentment toward Firestone Master, but they both were, after all, fellow members of the human alliance.

“An Yong Master… is not one to be trifled with.”

Shua!

Luo Feng teleported out of the water domain right away and thereafter teleported repeatedly and speedily, rushing toward his destination.


Chapter 1164: An Yong Master and Luo Feng

Two towering beings fought each other in the water area of Tilted Peak Sector. An Yong Master held a golden scepter, sometimes using it as a long staff, sometimes as a hammer. Constantly, he performed a supreme technique. Besides, An Yong Master didn’t defend himself against Firestone Master at all!

“Maniac…! The beings from the first universe era are all maniacs, and An Yong Master is a maniac even compared to those other maniacs.”

“Aaah!” Firestone Master roared.

He tried to stay away to buy some more time. However, in Ice Sand Ocean, he was significantly slower, and he was at an absolute disadvantage, which was why he was caught up to by An Yong Master time and time again.

“Firestone from the human alliance, die and become a sacrifice on the path of my eternity,” said An Yong Master.

He had a gentle voice, but that scepter was piercing the universe space.

Hong! Long! Long!

The golden scepter had an oval head, and the head of the oval was like a gourd.

Si! La!

The scepter avoided the shuttle from Firestone Master, and the head hit the chest of Firestone Master. Without a true treasure weapon to resist it, the power of An Yong Master hit the chest of Firestone Master.

Crash!

The armor trembled, and his chest trembled as well. His godly body cracked, and he bounced away. Just when he bounced away, his shuttle hit An Yong Master as well.

Peng!

There was a deep sound. An Yong Master’s godly body was weakened after getting hit, but it quickly recovered. He only paused for a second before charging again.

Firestone Master was indignant. “Maniac! He is insane! Why did I have to run into him? I would have at least been better off if I’d run into others.”

Actually, he was a pinnacle universe master like Flame Emperor. An Yong had better true treasures and a stronger godly body, so he was one level superior to Firestone Master.

Firestone Master was at pinnacle level while An Yong Master was at the top-tier level, rivaling Ice Mountain Master. Firestone Master’s life should’ve been in danger, as he was only one level inferior. However, An Yong Master was trading his own injuries for his enemy’s injuries and was utilizing his speed and consuming his godly body. Even those at his level would be in trouble, not to mention Firestone Master, who was one level beneath him.

When Luo Feng was fighting Star River Master, Star River’s supreme technique “River in Darkness” had been first resisted by Star Tower, but Luo Feng’s godly body was still consumed. If it weren’t for Star Tower, Luo Feng might have been annihilated with one move. Injuries for injuries… It wasn’t easy to implement. If Firestone Master had been as powerful as Huge Axe Creator and able to resist the scepter, An Yong Master wouldn’t have been able to implement that move. However, An Yong Master was better at techniques, and he used several supreme techniques interchangeably. Sometimes, he used it as a hammer, sometimes a staff, and sometimes as a bayonet… Each move had terrific power, and Firestone Master wasn’t able to resist most of them.

To trade injuries for injuries, one needed to have enough confidence in his godly body. After all, he was hurting himself while hurting others, if he didn’t have a strong enough godly body, he would die before killing his enemy.

A voice was transmitted through the water area. “Firestone, I don’t dare to venture into Ice Sand Ocean, so I can’t help you. You’re on your own now.”

“Roach Prison Master?”

Firestone Master felt happy first, but then was let down. It was useless. Roach Prison Master was at his level. That Ice Sand Ocean covered an area of several square light years, and it would take him a long time to fly here. Besides, even if he made it, Roach Prison Master wasn’t strong enough.

“Nobody can save you,” said An Yong Master, holding his scepter. “You only have 50 percent of your godly body left, and I can kill you within ten moves.”

“Damn it… You just have your armor and body!” Firestone Master roared.

He ran away when he saw An Yong Master, as he knew how An Yong Master fought. An Yong Master’s armor was a top-tier pinnacle true treasure armor, and it was able to weaken the attack to 1/100,000th. The godly body of An Yong Master had a life gene level of almost 10,000 times! He had a plant body, and it had a godly body several million kilometers tall. Even if he were trading injuries for injuries, he could implement it smoothly with that huge body constantly supplying power.

“My godly body is also a special life form, and it’s 100,000 kilometers tall. Under my weapon, it might take him a long time to kill me. But he’s trading injuries for injuries; it consumes my godly body hundreds of times faster.”

Firestone Master was still hit no matter how hard he tried.

Hong! Long!

His godly body was being weakened. 42 percent… 37 percent… 31 percent…

An Yong Master smiled. “Die.”

“No! No!” said Firestone Master.

He had tried everything to dodge the attacks or to use his weapon to resist them, but it was no use! An Yong Master used his techniques alternatively, and Firestone Master couldn’t defend himself against them at all.

Roach Prison Master was at the shallow water area. He looked at the endless Ice Sand Ocean and sighed.

“Firestone, only Peng Gong Master and Primal Chaos City Leader can get there to save you. Otherwise, nobody can help you now.”

Hong!

A being showed up.

“Roach Prison Master,” said a familiar voice.

Roach Prison Master turned his giant head and he a black-haired human in silver armor.

“Luo Feng?” Roach Prison Master was disappointed. He transmitted his voice: “Luo Feng, Firestone Master is being hunted by An Yong Master, and only Peng Gong Master and Primal Chaos City Leader can save him. We can’t do anything about it. Don’t go in. You’ll be in danger if you enter that Ice Sand Ocean.”

“Perhaps I can’t defeat An Yong Master,” said the black-haired human, “but I’m not afraid of him, either.”

“Huh?” Roach Prison Master was dazed.

And then, a dimming golden light appeared in the water area. At the same time…

Hong! Long! Long!

Golden flames extended and crushed Ice Sand Ocean with the help of Golden Country.

Shi Wu Wings and Fire Sand Cup… A combination of the two!

Helpless! Firestone Master felt helpless. He only had 20 percent of his godly body left, so he couldn’t even resist anymore.

An Yong Master smiled and moved forward. “Die!”

But suddenly, An Yong Master grew angry. “Who—?” he roared.

Hong! Long!

Ice Mountain Ocean, which had trapped and slowed down Firestone Master, was dismantled. The water became an ocean of flames. The sight thrilled Firestone Master. Suddenly, he heard a voice.

“Still not going, Firestone Master?”

“This voice…” Firestone Master was dazed.

Wasn’t that Luo Feng?

“Quick! Go!” Luo Feng urged.

Sou!

Firestone Master ran away. He felt unhindered. While in Ice Sand Ocean, he felt like he was trapped in the swamp. However, he didn’t feel any resistance in the golden flames; instead, the flames were boosting him and making him faster.

It was the opposite for An Yong Master. He immediately slowed down.

“Who is it?” An Yong Master roared. “This is the Flame Sand Cup of Yuan Ao Master! And that golden light domain can control the space and time! Who are you?”

He had a stronger godly power than Luo Feng, but he was at a disadvantage. True treasures and techniques had different requirements for godly power.

True treasures and techniques had thresholds and limits. When it came to “Miniature Universe,” becoming undying was the basic requirement, and it would take 10 percent of the godly body. However, when Luo Feng got stronger, he would hit the limit. If Luo Feng became a universe master and improved his godly body 100 times, Miniature Universe wouldn’t take 10 percent of his godly body, because when universe masters performed supreme techniques, it only took them a limited amount of godly power.

Ultimate techniques were also different from supreme techniques. The same rule applied to true treasures. The user needed to be strong enough to drive it.

The more powerful one got, the more powerful true treasures he was able to wield. However, there was a limit to true treasures, which was why ordinary true treasures were abandoned by universe masters. They craved pinnacle true treasures and even supreme true treasures.

Top-tier true treasures, pinnacle true treasures, and supreme true treasures…

“I won’t let you run away if I have a pinnacle domain type true treasure,” said An Yong Master. He was exasperated and rescinded the space seal.

Hua!

Firestone Master was thrilled. He teleported himself to the shallow water.

“I see how it is,” said An Yong Master.

He sensed that Firestone Master was only several light years away… He teleported himself there as well.

Luo Feng and Roach Prison Master were both in the water area when Firestone Master showed up.

Firestone Master felt awkward. “Luo…” he said.

Luo Feng’s facial expression changed. “Wait.”

A being appeared near them,—a being with a scepter. There were halos behind his head, and a single-eyed phantom was in the halo. It was An Yong Master!

An Yong Master’s eye glinted with anger. He glared at Luo Feng.

“Human, I’ve never seen you!” An Yong Master said furiously.

Luo Feng glanced at An Yong Master. “Now you do.”

Shua!

Luo Feng and the two universe masters teleported themselves, and they got out of the water area and fled away.

“Human! Silver-armored and black-haired human!” An Yong Master shouted with madness and indignation.


Chapter 1165: Divine Eye Clan

An Yong Master stood in the shallow water. His solitary eye looked ferocious.

“That silver-armored and black-haired human! He came here to rescue Firestone Master, and he’s with Roach Prison Master. He must be a human from the original universe.”

An Yong Master was thinking. The human race was bred in all the three universe eras, and humanity was a pinnacle race in both the first and the third universe eras. Only in the second era were the humans relatively weak, as only one universe supreme master had been born.

In the original universe, any race with one universe supreme master could be called a pinnacle race. However, for the first and second universe eras that went through the complete incarnations, they had quite a few universe supreme masters. The human race of the second universe era was as powerful as the one in the original universe, yet it wasn’t a pinnacle race.

I haven’t seen him. And he’s not in the database of Divine Eye race, An Yong Master thought. He must be a new great being, and he’s using the Flame Sand Cup of Yuan Ao Master. I saw Yuan Ao Master use that last time. Apparently, he got it recently. Did Yuan Ao Master die? Otherwise, the Flame Sand Cup wouldn’t have fallen into the hands of that human.

An Yong Master was baffled.

The Divine Eye clan had seven universe supreme masters, so it had seven miniature universes. In one of the miniature universes…

“Seventh True Master.”

An Yong Master’s avatar walked out of the gleaming and half-transparent palace and looked up at the sky. “Was a new universe supreme master born in the human race of the original universe? I was trying to kill that Firestone Master, but I was stopped by a silver-armored and black-haired man. I want his information.”

A voice came from the sky. “Stopped? Is he stronger than you?”

“No, he’s far weaker than me.” An Yong Master raised his head. “However, he has the Flame Sand Cup and a special valuable to control space and time, so he suppressed my Ice Sand Ocean. Besides, he, Roach Prison Master, and Firestone Master were all there. I can’t defeat them all.”

An Yong had teleported himself and found Luo Feng and the other two. If he had been confident enough, he would have performed space seal and fought them. However, he knew that his enemy had a domain to suppress him, and there were three of them, so he watched Luo Feng leave.

“Wait a moment, and I’ll make contact and ask about it,” said the voice from the sky.

“Please, Seventh True Master.” An Yong Master bowed.

After a short while…

Actually, there were had been trades among the powers in Universe Ocean. Some related to valuables, while some had to do with information sharing. As long as there were benefits, there would be trades. The Divine Eye clan was a superpower from the first universe era, so there were many powers who wanted to fawn over the Divine Eye race.

“I’ve got the result,” said the voice from the sky.

An Yong Master immediately raised his head.

“Silver armor and black hair,” the voice continued. “You haven’t met him, but he’s a new universe master of the human race. Milky Way Horde Leader, Luo Feng. He’s just an ordinary master, and he has the same level of material attack as Master of Banff. The only supreme technique he knows is like a miniature chaos world.”

“Oh? A new guy?” An Yong Master smiled. “Master of Banff is proficient in soul attack, but he’s weak at material attack. It seems this guy is weak.”

“There are six levels of universe masters, and he must be at the second level,” said the voice from the sky.

“He seems to have a special true treasure, the human race gives him some precious true treasures to protect him.” An Yong Master smiled. He was only a young guy who was good at fleeing, which meant there was nothing for him to be afraid of. “Only at the second level…”

The first universe era divided universe masters into six levels. The first level was the elementary universe masters with a life gene level of 100 times, and they didn’t even create ultimate techniques.

The second level had a life gene level of 1,000 times, and they created ultimate techniques and had good true treasures. They were the ordinary level.

The third level was the pinnacle level, like Flame Emperor and Firestone Master.

The fourth level was the top-tier level, like Ice Mountain Master, An Yong Master, and Star River Master who didn’t perform his trump technique.

The fifth level, the top-tier of the top-tier, consisted of those like Star River Master and Primal Chaos City Leader. They usually had merged supreme techniques or had gained strange objects.

The sixth level, which didn’t exist in the original universe, was for those who had supreme true treasures.

“Only at the second level…”

An Yong Master sneered. He was at the fourth level. He had a plant life body at a life gene level of almost 10,000 times, and his armor was able to weaken attacks to 1/100,000th. Even Luo Feng was only able to rival him after becoming a universe master. If he repaid injuries for injuries, even Ice Mountain Master would have needed to avoid him.

“Humph! There are only few pinnacle domain type true treasures,” said An Yong Master. “The Divine Eye Race has almost 100 universe masters. The most powerful universe masters have all the pinnacle domain type true treasures. If I can have one, you, Milky Way Horde Leader, will die!”

An Yong Master looked forward to it. After all, the Divine Eye Race was the most powerful pinnacle race in the first universe era! They had seven universe supreme masters and almost 100 universe masters! They had all lived for an eternity. An Yong Master was only a middle universe master.

“Just wait and see, Milky Way Horde Leader,” said An Yong Master. “This was only our first meeting. We have plenty of time to fight each other.”

Three beings stood on the rock in the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector.

“Firestone Master, you don’t need to…” said Luo Feng.

“You’ve saved my life, so I owe you big time,” said Firestone Master. “No need to be humble. If you need anything, just tell me. I’ll be there as soon as I can, no matter what I’m doing.”

Luo Feng couldn’t help laughing. This was Firestone Master. Stubborn! Incredibly stubborn! He would scold you no matter how much you’d accomplished, but once he made a promise, he would fulfill it no matter how high the cost.

“Firestone Master, even you’re not able to deal with the danger?” Luo Feng couldn’t help asking.

He was confused, as he thought that someone who had survived Universe Ocean for such a long time would at least have some survival skills.

“Even if I run into a universe supreme master, I can defend myself against him for a long time, as long as he doesn’t use a supreme true treasure. I’ll use my true treasure weapon to resist it, and it can weaken the power by more than 90 percent, and with my armor, the threat will be very small! Unfortunately, the fighting style of An Yong Master can suppress me exactly. He has a variety of moves, yet I just make attacks directly. And he exchanges injuries for injuries.”

“Actually,” continued Firestone Master, “I have a strong godly body, too. I have a godly body of 100,000 kilometers, so normally, I’m not afraid of that. However, An Yong Master is better than me. He knows several supreme techniques, and he can change his moves at any time. It’s already rare for someone to be capable of that. And there are fewer whom I can’t defend against. On top of that, those with better godly bodies… basically don’t exist. There are only a few of them in Universe Ocean, so I usually avoid them.”

Luo Feng nodded. He was right. Several supreme techniques, change of moves, and a fast and better godly body than Firestone Master… It was indeed rare for someone to possess all three of those.

“I’ve decided after this time,” said Firestone Master. “I’ve lost a great portion of my godly body, so I’ll study defensive technique during this time. I’m a Firestone special life form, so I’m not flexible enough. I need to create a shield technique. If I can have both a shield and a shuttle, I’ll be much safer.”

“You should’ve done so a long time ago,” Roach Prison Master said.

“Yes.” Luo Feng nodded as well.

Different life forms had different ways of fighting. Yuan Ao Master was like that. He had an enormous body and wasn’t flexible enough, so he used a shield. Of course, humans were naturally flexible. Luo Feng was able to resist with a blade.

“I’m too overconfident, ” the voice of Firestone Master rumbled. “Luo Feng, I owe you forever. Just ask me anytime you need something. I’ll go back to the original universe first. Next time, I’ll bring a shield.”

“Have a safe trip,” said Luo Feng.

Firestone Master told Roach Prison Master, too, and then they left.

“Although my armor is ten times stronger than that of Firestone Master, his godly power is tens of times better than mine, so he has better defensive power than me. And he has a bigger godly body.”

Luo Feng sighed. The good thing was, he was more flexible, so he could resist An Yong Master. With his Shi Wu Wings and the Flame Sand Cup, he could fight and run whenever he wanted.

“I need to sharpen myself,” said Luo Feng. “My weakness is that my attacking technique is only at the ultimate level. Those such as Firestone Master and Roach Prison Master have created a supreme technique. As for An Yong Master, he has several supreme techniques.”

Luo Feng and Roach Prison Master separated, and he kept adventuring through the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector.

Time flew. Luo Feng could sometimes run into the great beings before the incarnation, but with Shi Wu Wings and Flame Sand Cup, he didn’t encounter any real danger. After all, the top-tier universe masters and universe supreme masters were in the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector.

One year. Two years. Three years…

Luo Feng was gradually made known to the great beings from the other two universe eras, and they knew that although Luo Feng had mediocre power, he was a handful.


Chapter 1166: Annihilation

In the twinkling of an eye, it was already Luo Feng’s sixteenth year in Universe Ocean.

Amidst the deep end of Tilted Peak Sector’s water domain.

“I have been here at Tilted Peak Sector for sixteen years, but I have not seen any true treasure around.”

Luo Feng leaned against a mountain rock and looked at the white water flow spirits that were tens of thousands of kilometers away. White streaks fluttered and drifted about—be it white human form or white beast form—the strangely-shaped water flow spirits were attracted to their own kind based on pure instinct. They were playing together within the deep region of the water domain where, occasionally, high-frequency piercing cries could be heard.

The celestial rocks within the water domain were all equally huge. Each and every one of these rocks resembled a towering mountain range, where every sunken area was like a grand canyon, every protruding part was like a gigantic mountain peak, and every gently sloping surface was like a vast plain. At least, that was how it looked to Luo Feng, whose godly body was hovering at least one thousand kilometers away…

“I have encountered more than 100 battles these past sixteen years, and these battles have allowed me to greatly improve in my cultivation of beast god path.”

Luo Feng was quite satisfied. Over 100 times, he had fought hand-to-hand with great beings from the first and second universe eras. The primal universe (third universe era) was very weak, so great beings from its top nine powers and top-tier twelve powers, regardless of being in the primal universe or in the Universe Ocean— unless there were attractions such as treasures—would be highly unlikely to fight and kill one another.

However, during the first universe era and second universe era… Even if there were no true treasures, great beings would fight and kill one another the moment they crossed paths!

During his time in Universe Ocean, Luo Feng had the chance to get in touch with novel styles of combat! Also, the novel ways of making use of universe laws were real eye-openers for him, as he could then comprehend by analogy. This allowed him to improve tremendously when it came to the cultivation of beast god path. It was many times faster than diligently training for it in the primal universe. Even his accomplishments in the study of secret engravings were also improved by leaps and bounds…

“What a pity I am still unable to create a strongest technique,” Luo Feng lamented. “When can I attain the third level of Star Tower is still an unknown with no definite future. Just wait. Roaming Tilted Peak Sector is always as such. The majority of the time, there will be peace, but the moment an opportunity arrives, everyone will go all out to fight for it.”

Luo Feng transformed into a beam of light and took flight quietly, where he began to explore again. The water domain was simply immense.

Countless great beings from the three universe eras had spent endless time exploring the water domain, but no one was able to explore all of it. Now, Luo Feng was also exploring the water domain at his own pace…

“Previously when I discovered Firestone Master, I secretly followed him,” said An Yong Master. “When I was near enough, I immediately released a domain type true treasure and sealed space.” An Yong Master, positioned in the void space, shook his head with a sigh. “Firestone Master was such a silly one; just when I managed to exercise some self-restraint and was so close to being able to kill him, this human form Luo Feng from the primal universe had to appear out of nowhere and foil my plan. If I had succeeded in killing Firestone Master, I would have obtained many true treasures, and with those treasures that I already owned… I suppose I would be able to exchange for a pinnacle domain true treasure.”

Again, An Yong Master shook his head and sighed. He was full of resentment. By his side was another great being from the Divine Eye clan. The circular light behind its head also had a single-eyed shadow—this was a characteristic that was unique to great beings of the Divine Eye clan.

“An Yong, any gains from your trip to the internal domain?” the other great being asked.

“The internal domain is much too dangerous,” said An Yong Master. “I merely wandered about the considerably safer areas within the internal domain. These places had already been thoroughly searched before. Although I fought quite a fair number of battles here, and there was even once where I managed to corner my opponent, the other party was crazy enough to dash into the dangerous region within the internal domain. I was not daring enough to follow suit.” An Yong Master was filled with a sense of helplessness. “Therefore, nothing gained.”

“I think it is still better to explore the water domain at one’s own pace,” the great being of the Divine Eye clan said. “The danger level is low, and occasionally, a treasure may be up for grabs. Who knows? You may even be able to cross paths with some weaker universe masters who you can kill easily.”

“Imperial, your trip was rewarding?” An Yong Master asked.

“Slightly.” Imperial Master smiled.

This was the only conversation that Imperial Master and An Yong Master shared. Thereafter, they parted ways. It was always lonelier within Tilted Peak Sector, so great beings of the same clan would usually engage in conversations, albeit briefly, when they met with one another.

In the blink of an eye, another two years flew by.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Imperial Master was handsome, and his entire being dazzled with a misty, white light. At the back of his head was the same circular light, and within this circular light was a single-eyed shadow. He flew slowly at the lowest region of the water domain.

He did his best to explore the various mountain peaks at the lowest region of the water domain (naturally protruding mountain rocks), as well as the numerous valleys. He did this without a trace of impatience. He was a super great being of endless life, and even if he were to spend tens of thousands of eras exploring, it would still be very peaceful.

“A cave.”

A seemingly ordinary mountain cave appeared ahead, and Imperial Master flew in right away.

The cave had an approximate diameter of several tens of thousands of kilometers, its depth was tens of millions kilometers. Imperial Master flew within the cave with great caution… At times, within the water domain, caves and valleys that seemed ordinary might possibly house hidden treasures.

“Huh?” Imperial Master felt a faint and weak trace of energy ripples. “Energy ripples! Could it be…”

Imperial Master’s eyes lit up in an instant. His face changed to one filled with vigor as his eyes swept every inch of the cave before him. He even used his godly power to scan the surroundings.

He advanced at an extremely slow pace. The cave was dark, deep, and winding. Imperial Master suppressed his raging emotions; his speed went even slower.

After close to six hours…

“That is it!”

Imperial Master had just completed a bend in the cave when he saw, at the far end, a screen of bright light. This got him even more worked up.

“Haha! It might be possible that there are hidden treasures within the water domain, probably even unique gains to claim.”

Imperial Master was moving at a very slow speed, but he soon arrived at the screen of bright light.

“Valuables. Great treasures!”

Imperial Master raised his head and saw that there was a bright screen blocking the path ahead. This bright screen was giving off an extremely weak energy ripple. Even stranger, Imperial Master had previously used his godly power to scan his surroundings, but he had not discovered this bright screen.

“A bright screen… Only if there were some extremely strong true treasures in Tilted Peak Sector would such a unique situation surface. For example, if there was a dangerous land in the surroundings, or there were bright screens such as this one that went undetected.”

Imperial Master was now running high on emotions. As a great being from the first universe era, he had no lack of experience. Based on his previous experiences, the bright screen by itself posed no threat.

“Still better to exercise more caution,” Imperial Master said with a wave.

Hua!

A blue sphere appeared out of thin air and started to expand rapidly. It soon reached a height of thousands of kilometers. Imperial Master’s godly body stood at a height of 1,000 kilometers. Thus, with one step, he had made his way into the sphere.

“This must be a top-tier sealed palace type true treasure. If I were to hide within it, even if a universe supreme master were to launch a full-scale attack, he would not be able to kill me.”

Imperial Master grew increasingly excited. He might have roamed about for countless period and encountered unique situations due to appearances of certain treasures, but those were times that he was with the other great beings of Divine Eye clan. This was the very first time he could have such a valuable treasure all to himself.

“Judging from this level of activity, this would, at the very least, be at the level of a pinnacle domain type true treasure. Who knows? It may be a strange object or even some unique object that is extraordinary.”

Imperial Master was controlling the top-tier sealed-palace type true treasure.

Hua!

Flying slowly, when he came into contact with that bright screen, it felt as though he was breaking through a layer of water. There was not a trace of obstruction at all.

“Huh? Another bright screen?” Imperial Master was shocked to discover that there was another layer of the bright screen behind the first one.

Hua!

Again, he broke through another layer of bright screen.

“A third layer!” Imperial Master was getting more excited and expectant as he continued breaking past layers.

A fourth layer! A fifth layer! A sixth layer…! There was a total of nine layers!

“This must be some incredible treasure land. Haha! Seems like, I, Imperial Master, have quite good luck.”

Imperial Master had just passed through the ninth layer of the bright screen…

Hong!

“No!”

Everything resumed a state of silence.

The dark, deep and winding cave went back to its normal quiet serenity. The bright screen was still there; there was not a trace of difference or change. It was as though Imperial Master had never entered.

The Divine Eye race from the first universe era owned seven miniature universes. In the middle of one. Before his avatar appeared, Imperial Master was filled with excitement and expectation, but what closely followed was a look of fear and panic.

“No!”

Peng!

His avatar was annihilated

The instant when his avatar was annihilated, the master of that entire miniature universe, which was the third true master of the Divine Eye clan, discovered right away.

“Imperial… has been annihilated!” His sighs resonated throughout the entire miniature universe.

On the supreme land of the miniature universe, the avatars of a dozen universe masters residing at different places started to arrive.

“Third True Master, Imperial Master has been annihilated?”

“How did he come to be annihilated?”

“Who killed him?”

“How did he die?”

Within an instant, everyone was shooting questions out of anxiety. After all, according to their clan’s method of division, Imperial Master was a fourth-tier universe master (considered to be at the top-tier level), so even if he was exchanging blows with a universe supreme being, if the fight lasted for a short period of time, he could still hope for chances of survival. To the entire Divine Eye clan, the annihilation of a universe master was an occurrence that would only happen once in a blue moon.

A sound was heard from the sky. “Imperial was annihilated within a split-second; his avatar was not able to leave behind any information at all. The speed at which he was annihilated did not even give him time to leave any information. The moment one meets with an extremely dangerous situation, the foremost thing to do should be to establish contact with other great beings to call for help.” The voice articulated these words slowly. “That means… Imperial Master must not have detected any trace of danger beforehand. And when he realized how frighteningly close danger was, it was time for him to face annihilation.”

“He didn’t even get to find out why he was annihilated?”

“Even a universe supreme master would not be able to achieve this.”

“What can be so fearsome?”

“Seems like it was purely Tilted Peak Sector in its truest form creating such fearsome danger. Solely a great being’s power alone will not be able to achieve something of this degree.”

The avatars of these universe masters all knew.

The Divine Eye clan was divided into seven major miniature universes, and naturally, all of them kept close contact with one another. News of the annihilation of Imperial Master was rapidly spread to the higher-ups of the Divine Eye clan.

“Imperial was exploring the water domain.”

“Danger must have reached him from a certain area within the water domain.”

“For something to create the danger of instant annihilation for Imperial even within its water domain… There is something quite extraordinary about this place.”

“According to the final information related to this situation that could be found, shortly before his annihilation, Imperial ought to have been at the 193,293rd frame of reference shortly before his fall… Now, I am ordering the three universe masters from my clan who are in the water domain of Tilted Peak Sector—An Yong Master, Replenishment Master, and Time Banishing Master—to head to this frame of reference within the water domain to conduct investigations. You all must be very careful… If you find something amiss or detect a trace of danger, you cannot dash in there on your own.”

“Understood!”

“Understood!”

“Understood!”

An Yong Master, Replenishment Master, and Time Banishing Master responded to the order without further ado, then teleported within the void space of Tilted Peak Sector at a very high speed. They ventured deep into the water domain and advanced to the 193,293rd frame of reference for detailed exploration.


Chapter 1167: Attraction from the Wing

On top of Tilted Peak Sector, the giant rocks flew several times faster than light, and three beings gathered, all of them glowing.

“Imperial didn’t leave any message when he died,” said a great being of Divine Eye clan. “I can’t even imagine the danger he ran into. Even if it’s in the inner area, few places could render Imperial Master unable to leave a message. It’s normal only at the center of Tilted Peak Sector.”

“Yes, it’s indeed very dangerous this time.”

“We shall follow the order from the first true master, and once we find somewhere dangerous or strange, we’ll report it immediately.”

“I’m just afraid that our efforts will be in vain. Chances are Imperial didn’t even die in the area specified.”

“That’s right.”

“That’s the area that was specified days before Imperial died. He might have died in the area around it, and chances are he died in the inner area.”

“Doesn’t matter. Just follow the order. I’ll be responsible for this area; An Yong, that one; Time Banishing, that one.”

“Okay.”

Hua! Hua! Hua!

They dispersed.

The area was too large, and there were countless creatures such as water flow spirits. None of the powers dared to claim that they had inspected the entire water area, and the water area would change as time went by.

After six days…

“I’ve finished.”

“Me too.”

“No one.”

Three universe masters met. They looked at each other, but no one had found anything. What should they do?

“One reference area is too large. We use domain type true treasure for inspection, and each time, we can inspect several light years,” said An Yong Master. “Though it’s fast, we can’t find the real lands of valuables.”

“Of course we know. Then what should we do? Go in there one by one?”

“However? It’ll take forever to walk one light year. An area one light year long, one light year wide, and one light year tall… how long will it take?”

The inspection wasn’t flying. Imperial inspected those caves carefully and got out if he didn’t find any valuables. He walked slowly across the caves, cracks, and woods. It would take more than 10,000 eras to finish one light year. And it would take far more than 100 million eras to finish the entire era.

“We can’t do a detailed inspection. We can only do a brief one.”

“Let’s report it back.”

“Okay.”

They reported.

“Keep inspecting!” ordered First True Master. “It’s been a long time since Imperial died in that reference area. And he might have left the area before he died. Keep searching. Inspect all the areas around reference area 193293.”

“Yes,” replied An Yong Master obediently.

They wouldn’t resist, not even for a brief inspection. It took another few years for them to inspect the 100 nearby areas. They acquired senior true treasure weapons by luck and found two strange places. However, when the Sixth True Master arrived, he didn’t find anything.

“What a waste of time.”

“Who knows where Imperial died? Perhaps in the inner area!”

It was in vain. The Divine Eye clan did thorough research as well. They first inspected the water area, then researched whether the true treasure Imperial Master had appeared in the hands of the great beings of other races. The Sixth True Master went there directly… However, they could only admit failure in the end. They didn’t gain anything.

Usually, the Divine Eye race wouldn’t just give up if its great beings were killed! However, they couldn’t find anything this time, so they could only deal with it. An Yong Master, Time Banishing Master, and Replenishment Master separated from one another.

Time Banishing Master and Replenishment Master left while An Yong Master kept going deeper in the water area.

“I met Imperial before he died, and he seemed to have gotten something in the water area,” said An Yong Master. “It’s likely that he died in the water area, I’ll keep inspecting in reference system 193293.”

12 years had passed since Imperial Master died. Luo Feng flew in the space, and he looked at the waterfall on the towering Tilted Peak Sector.

“Tilted Peak Sector is said to be one of the three Lands of Extremis. It’s been 30 years since I came here, and I haven’t run into any danger.”

Hong! Long! Long!

The giant waterfall was tens of millions of light years high, and each drop of water could rival a star. How powerful the entire waterfall was! If all the water was concentrated to one point, even universe supreme masters could be killed! While separated, the water at the bottom kept changing under the churning and crashing.

“I’ll go to the main mountain of Tilted Peak Sector. I’ll just stay on top. It’s not going to be dangerous if I don’t go in.”

Luo Feng kept teleporting himself.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

He kept approaching that mountain… And it was the first time he arrived at the main body of Tilted Peak Sector.

After 30 million light years of teleportation, Luo Feng was pretty close to the main mountain.

“Huh?”

Shua!

Luo Feng stopped in the sky. In front of him was the main mountain of Tilted Peak Sector. However, Luo Feng frowned and looked down. “How? My Shi Wu Wings?”

He looked back at his Shi Wu Wings, which were intermittently trembling.

Summoning!

It was like magnets attracting each other. His Shi Wu Wings seemed to be attracted toward something.

“It’s a weak call. Which direction is it? The deep of water area?”

Luo Feng looked down and frowned. He wasn’t inexperienced. Tian Yang Knight’s “Light Wings” had previously attracted his wing, but that attraction had been incredibly strong. This attraction, however, was feeble.

Is the third wing down there? Luo Feng wondered. I’ll go check.

Sou!

Luo Feng teleported himself ten light years.

“Much stronger.” Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed, and his Shi Wu Wings started to tremble heavily. Apparently, the summon was strong. “Down.”

Luo Feng teleported himself again.

Hong!

He entered the shallow water.

Hong! Long! Long!

His Shi Wu Wings started to shake intensely.

“Such strong summoning!”

Luo Feng was exhilarated. He performed Golden Country. The dim light permeated and formed a blurry golden light area with a diameter of 10 light years. Of course, this wasn’t the limit of Golden Country, but Luo Feng didn’t dare teleport himself too far in the dangerous water area.

Shua!

Luo Feng moved three light years forward and entered the danger zone. He could only teleport himself a little bit farther in the deep water zone.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

Following the summoning, he went forward. However, he moved 100 million kilometers forward each time.

“It has to be a component of the Shi Wu Wings,” said Luo Feng. “Hahaha! I knew it. I know there were other components. I didn’t expect to find them in the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector.”

Luo Feng was exhilarated. When he found the true treasure wing of Tian Yang Knight, the found that the third level of engravings wasn’t complete. Apparently, there were other components.

He’d thought that they may have been taken by other great beings in Universe Ocean. After all, many great beings had wing valuables, and chances were, the great beings who acquired a true treasure wing might give it to a universe knight, as they thought it wasn’t powerful enough. Another possibility was that it had been left in Tilted Peak Sector…

I can’t believe I sense it so easily, thought Luo Feng. Is it on a great being, or just resting in place somewhere?

Luo Feng flew quickly, and he landed in front of a cave.

“It’s inside. It’s coming from the inside.”

Luo Feng looked at the cave and started to move inside carefully. The cave was enormous.

Weng! Weng! Weng!

Shi Wu Wing trembled intensely, and Luo Feng even needed to suppress it with his godly power.

“The summoning power is too strong… much stronger than last time,” Luo Feng whispered. “Is it because my Shi Wu Wings are complete?”

Luo Feng felt confused. After more than three hours, Luo Feng saw the screen of light in the distance.

“A light screen?”

Luo Feng got close carefully and looked at the light screen in the distance. Although the Shi Wu Wings on his back were trying to fly off of him, Luo Feng was still calm and cautious.

“Something’s wrong. Very wrong.”

Luo Feng frowned. “If Shi Wu Wings have another component, and that component doesn’t have an owner, it should fly toward me. On the other hand, if the component has an owner, he should also be able to feel the attraction. Isn’t he curious?” Luo Feng looked to the light screen. “Based on what I know about Tilted Peak Sector, only special valuables will lead to light screens like this one.”

As for ordinary to top-tier true treasures, they would be randomly placed in a corner.

“A light screen and a summoning from Shi Wu Wings,” said Luo Feng. “That component isn’t flying toward me.”

Although Luo Feng desperately wanted to get this component, he didn’t dare to venture forward. He knew how dangerous Tilted Peak Sector was.

“This is so strange. I’ll let my Mosha body get in first.”

Luo Feng decided quickly. In the past years, every time he ran into something weird, he let his Mosha body go first.

Shua!

Mosha body appeared and flew forward. He touched the light screen and entered.


Chapter 1168: Space of the Wings

The Mosha godly body was small. The purity of its godly power was low, and it did not own any true treasure. Even if a Mosha body had been sacrificed, the godly bodies of Golden Horned Beast and the original earthling body could easily recover this minuscule loss by breathing for a short moment. That was the reason why, for the past 30 years, Mosha body was stationed at the external domain of Tilted Peak Sector to deal with areas that involved uncertainties.

Going through the bright screen…

Hua!

“Huh?” Mosha body looked ahead, feeling confused. It was still a tunnel ahead of him, and there was a new bright screen. “Two layers of the bright screens? The three most dangerous lands are the scariest places of Universe Ocean. Unique situations will only arise under certain extremely unique regions.” Mosha body was confused. “Now, there are two bright screens in a row… What could possibly be in there?”

Sou!

Moving forth with agility, he easily passed through that bright screen. The screens on their own would not be able to obstruct the way of intruders… but they could cause all sorts of exploration, even those by godly powers, to fail.

“My god! A third layer of the bright screen?” Mosha body was in great shock.

He continued drilling! The fourth layer! The fifth layer! The sixth layer!

Mosha body was in total shock by then. From the information regarding Tilted Peak Sector, Flowing Countless Mountains, and Universe Boat that the human race had provided, there were descriptions of scenarios of scary true treasures being born. And also, records of scenarios involving the birth of supreme true treasures. But of course, every scenario was different.

There was a total of twelve records on bright screens, of which three were related to true treasures and nine were related to rare treasures. The former three scenarios about true treasures involved a pinnacle true treasure with one layer of the bright screen, a superb pinnacle true treasure with three layers of the bright screens, and a superb pinnacle true treasure with three layers of the bright screens, respectively.

“The seventh layer, the eighth layer… There is… There is actually a ninth layer! A great hidden treasure. This is definitely a super, great hidden treasure. If a great being told me that there was a supreme true treasure within it, I would believe without a doubt!” Mosha body was worked up as he looked at the ninth layer of the bright screen before him. “Judging by the way the Shi Wu Wings put up such a crazy struggle in their efforts to fly into this cave, it is possible that there is another component of Shi Wu Wings inside…”

“Even if it was a component of a supreme true treasure, it would not possibly be so overwhelmingly powerful. It would not be able to wield nine layers of the bright screens.”

Mosha body did not know what to make out of the situation.

Luo Feng was filled with confusion. Firstly, that missing component did not fly out on its own. Secondly, the beckoning was intense. It far surpassed the time when he first encountered Flowing Light Wings. Thirdly, nine layers of the bright screens was unbelievable. “Could it be that in there is not only a component of Shi Wu Wings, but also another true treasure? For instance, a supreme true treasure?”

Mosha body tried to suppress the many thoughts running through his mind. When it came to hidden treasures, if one held on to overly beautified expectations, the greater the disappointment would be; reality could, at times, be very cruel.

“Whatever. I shall find out for myself.”

Hua!

He drilled passed the ninth layer of the bright screen easily.

“This is—!”

But no matter how close they were, it was unlikely that Blood Cloud Palace Master would have followed him so closely, unless—”

An Yong Master’s eyes flashed with realization as he gritted his teeth.

“I knew it! The humans want to protect Luo Feng, and Blood Cloud Palace Master’s help is all part of their arrangement. No wonder… No wonder Blood Cloud Palace Master has never taken any action against the human race and is always wearing a mask. Blood Cloud Palace Master must be human!”


Chapter 1171: Toy

“Blood Cloud Palace Leader is human, and he’s been secretly protecting Luo Feng? Are you kidding?”

“Who knows? The news is spread among the universe masters, and chances are it’s genuine.”

“Haha… No wonder that Blood Cloud Palace Leader has never attacked humans. Now I know the reason. Goddamn human race! It secretly tells Blood Cloud Palace Leader to attack us Northern Territory Alliance.”

The news kept being spread. The Divine Eye clan and some powers in the original universe had information-sharing agreements. When An Yong Master spread the news, some of the powers that had suffered under Blood Cloud Palace Leader went to question the great beings in the human race.

“Is Blood Cloud Palace Leader human?”

“Why do you humans let Blood Cloud Palace Leader slaughter all those beings?”

“No? You’re not admitting it?”

“Okay, good for you.”

All those who went to question the human race got a similar response. Clearly, the human race wouldn’t admit that Blood Cloud Palace was human, and it didn’t care.

When some great beings of other races asked whether they knew human the Luo Feng was with Blood Cloud Palace Leader, the human race replied indifferently, “We don’t care who Luo Feng makes friends with. We don’t have any restrictions for who human universe masters to make friends with. If he’s really a friend of Blood Cloud Palace Leader, we won’t do anything about it. Sorry. We don’t need to tell you anything.”

The human race didn’t care about other powers. However, though Primal Chaos City Leader and Void Gold Master were tough to others, they were still surprised inside. They asked Luo Feng about it through the virtual universe.

Luo Feng’s answer was simple. “I met Blood Cloud Palace Leader in the water area of Tilted Peak Sector. We got along very well, so we decided to adventure through the area together.”

Everything had been planned by An Yong Master, who had been beaten by Luo Feng and Blood Cloud Palace Leader. Thus far, his plan had failed, which upset An Yong Master. If he couldn’t kill Luo Feng, at least he could cause trouble for him! That was why he had started to spread the news.

“Blood Cloud Palace Leader has lots of enemies,” said An Yong Master. “His enemies will be hostile against you, Luo Feng. Humph! The more enemies you have, the more likely you’ll be kicked when you’re down. Just wait and see.” An Yong Master was patient. As a supreme being, he’d had a long life, and he’d made himself an enemy of lots of other great beings. They had been hostile toward each other for an eternity.

“You dare to bully me?” muttered An Yong Master. “And as a nobody? I won’t let you get away with that so easily. I won’t…”

An Yong Master would take revenge for everything. When the great incarnation came, he would die as a great being from the first universe era. Also, he hadn’t found any hope to survive the great incarnation. This was the true source of his anger.

An Yong Master only made some more enemies of Luo Feng, but Luo Feng didn’t care much about it.

“Normal great beings won’t make enemies, as they’re afraid of having too many of them.”

“I have Star Tower, and it seems I can get another supreme true treasure, which means I’m destined to be exceptional. The more enemies I have, the more chances I have to sharpen myself.”

Luo Feng was inside the cave between the first and the second light screen. He feared that it would be like last time. He went through the first light screen, and with the light screen, other great beings couldn’t find him at all.

“The 100th time!”

Mosha body had tried to get to that mysterious wing space 100 times. However, it had died every time as soon as he barely even entered the space.

“100 times, and Mosha body only got to observe the surroundings twice.” Luo Feng nodded.

Twice. Aside from that gigantic light wing, a storm surrounded it. Luo Feng made up his mind.

“I’ll use Star Tower now.”

He sat on the cold rock between the first light screen and the second light screen. He kept his eyes closed and tried to calm himself down. After all, it wasn’t easy to get a supreme true treasure—not to mention, to make one recognize him as its owner. He couldn’t be arrogant or careless.

He spent five minutes calming himself down and forgot about all the anxiety and excitement.

“Let’s go.” Luo Feng moved his mind.

Hua!

A man in bloody armor showed up. It was Blood Cloud Palace Leader.

Golden Horned Beast will stay here, and I’ll go in, Luo Feng thought.

He let his original earthling body get in, as he was the one wearing the Shi Wu Wings; Luo Feng thought that might aid in getting those supreme true treasure light wings.

“Bigger! Bigger! Bigger!” Luo Feng held Star Tower.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Star Tower bulged and grew into a tower 10,000 kilometers tall. Luo Feng stepped into the tower.

Inside the control room of the tower, the metal ground was transparent. Luo Feng stood there.

“I can see everything outside.”

His mind was connected to Star Tower’s core mind. Star Tower had a certain level of intelligence, but it was highly limited. It might be able to do calculations incredibly fast, but emotionally, it was equivalent to a baby.

Everything out there showed up. It was like eternal simulation in which Luo Feng was able to see the rocks and the light screen on the outside.

“Move forward.”

Luo Feng controlled Star Tower, which started to fly.

Shua!

“Second light screen,” Luo Feng whispered and kept controlling Star Tower.

Star Tower flew slowly, but it went through one light screen after another. Before long, it reached the ninth light screen.

“I’ll now arrive in the mysterious space.”

Luo Feng gritted his teeth. He was bringing Star Tower, Shi Wu Wings, and Force Armor along with him. He couldn’t afford to lose.

“I have to succeed.”

Luo Feng clenched his teeth and entered the ninth light screen.

In the dark space, the blade formed a storm that swept across everything, and when Star Tower showed up, it was hit by the blade storm. It bounced away like a small boat in a tsunami.

“Damn it!” Luo Feng felt a terrific shock wave attacking Star Tower.

Hong! Long! Long!

One blade of light after another attacked Star Tower. Each time, it was like hundreds of blades striking at once, which blasted Star Tower away like a toy. Star Tower was completely defenseless.

Hit! Hit! The blades of light kept hitting Star Tower, which rolled like a soccer ball.

“Oh my god…!” said Luo Feng.

He stayed in the control room. Although Star Tower kept bouncing away, he didn’t feel anything in the control room. He couldn’t feel it, but he could see everything around it—including how Star Tower kept being blast away like a toy. He couldn’t resist such powerful shock waves.

“Powerful… Too powerful! The blade light is terrifically powerful.”

Luo Feng had his godly power infused everywhere in Star Tower, so he could clearly sense the shock wave. The blades of light were much stronger than the techniques from Star River Master! Hundreds of times more powerful!

The blades of light are incredibly powerful, Luo Feng thought. Possibly more powerful than attacks from universe supreme masters.

Although he had never fought a universe supreme master, even universe supreme masters were only stronger than Star River Master to a limited extent. Yet the blades of light… Each one made Luo Feng feel that it was much stronger than the ultimate technique of Star River Master.

Too powerful—if not for Star Tower, I would be killed instantly, Luo Feng thought.

When he’d fought Star River Master, he had been slightly injured using the shuttle of Star Tower, so it was unsurprising that he would have been killed instantly by these blades, which were hundreds of times stronger.

Luo Feng was right. Imperial Master had been in a top-tier palace type true treasure, which couldn’t even be destroyed by a universe supreme master. However, he had been annihilated instantly. Apparently, the blade storm was stronger than attacks from universe supreme masters.

The blade storm was extremely powerful. Even Luo Feng, who was incredibly strong, couldn’t control Star Tower. It bounced away time and time again.

“Smaller! Smaller! Smaller!”

Luo Feng kept controlling it.

Shua!

Star Tower shrank to the size of a grain of sand immediately. The original body of Star Tower was nine light years tall, and it could get larger! It could also become as small as a tiny particle… This was the ability of a supreme true treasure.

Star Tower had many interior spaces, but even when Star Tower shrank, and spaces weren’t affected. Normal treasures could also shrink, but not to the size of tiny particles.

When it got smaller, Star Tower was only hit once in a while, as the blades of the storm were enormous.

“One blade alone won’t affect Star Tower.”

Luo Feng felt he could fully control Star Tower now. Before, it had been flung about like a toy and couldn’t be controlled. Now, it wouldn’t be affected. After all, it was a supreme type true treasure.

“The light wing!”

Luo Feng stayed in the particle-sized Star Tower. He looked at the endless storms outside and that glowing light wing. He flew Star Tower toward it immediately.


Chapter 1172: Scram

The speed of Star Tower kept surging while the space was filled with blade storms, each of which was enormous. There were so many that Star Tower was hit once in a while, and it couldn’t fly on a straight line.

“So far.” Luo Feng looked at the giant light wing in the distance. “This mysterious space might have a diameter of over ten light years, and the light wing is several light years away from me. However, space and time have been completely crushed so I can’t do teleportation.”

Teleportation needed space ripples—only a little bit. However, the blades were more terrifying than attacks from universe supreme masters, so they would annihilate space, which left no ripples at all. Luo Feng had to fly to the white wings.

Fortunately, I’m in Universe Ocean, where the speed limit is much higher than in the original universe, Luo Feng thought. The speed limit in Universe Ocean is 100 times faster than light speed, but because of the blade storm, Star Tower isn’t able to hit the highest speed. Fortunately, it can still maintain an average speed of 50 times faster than light speed.

Flying! Star Tower swiftly flew through the blade storms.

Time flew. After a month, Star Tower had already flown more than five light years, and it was very close to those giant white wings.

“All those blade storms come from that white pair of wings!” Luo Feng exclaimed, looking at the outside.

He saw the edge of the white wings emanating endless light, sweeping in the mysterious space. Some of the blade storms were absorbed by the white wings when they touched it. Erupting and absorbing!

Erupt and absorb? Conversation of energy? Luo Feng thought. It looks almighty, but it actually only consumes little energy. Incredible, how incredible! Much more powerful than Five-Color Aurora Lake.

Five-Color Aurora Lade was a supreme domain type true treasure, so it was weaker in attacking power. Besides, when Double-Face Ancestral God was fighting Virtual-Real Devil Master, Five-Color Aurora Lake hadn’t been fully utilized. It wasn’t deliberately conserved, but Double-Face hadn’t fully comprehended that… After all, it wasn’t an easy task the wield the maximum power of a supreme true treasure.

After another three days, Luo Feng was very close to the giant white wings.

“This…”

Luo Feng’s facial expressions changed. He looked amazed before, but now, he was shocked.

“This—this—this is… It isn’t a wing! No…”

From a distance, it had indeed appeared to be extremely breathtaking white wings more dazzling than billions of stars combined. However, when Luo Feng got close enough, he saw that it wasn’t a wing at all, but a phantom formed by the overlapping of countless blade lights!

“Gosh!”

Luo Feng looked at everything with a thrill. In the distance, blade light overlapped with each other. On the edge, the blade light was thin, and the blade storms spread everywhere and enveloped the entire space. The closer it got to the center, the denser it was.

“A light wing formed by countless blades?” Luo Feng exclaimed. “Where did all the blade lights come from? There must be a terrific true treasure.”

Luo Feng was exhilarated. He kept flying.
