“What extravagance in the use of threads of pulling traces to be able to make such a big piece,” Luo Feng mused. “So extravagant that perhaps only a universe supreme master could afford to do this.”

Mosha body stretched out to grab the Pulling Traces Diagram.

A thread of godly power penetrated the cloth, his consciousness also entered the Pulling Traces Diagram. Instantly, he seemed to enter a virtual space.

Within this virtual space… was a virtual, gigantic Universe Boat. A strand of red thread strung together certain regions within the Universe Boat. In this virtual space, the dangers within each region were simulated as though they were real, and descriptions of how to avoid these dangers and the ways to traverse these dangerous lands were shown.

“This… this is part of the map of the Universe Boat?”

Mosha body immediately retracted his godly power. He gained an understanding almost instantly. He became delirious with joy.

The three most dangerous lands were on par with one another. Tilted Peak Sector, Universe Boat, and Flowing Countless Mountains were places that could give birth to numerous supreme true treasures, where pinnacle treasures were more commonly seen. Of course, precious treasures always went hand-in-hand with terrifying environments… Therefore, the more detailed and comprehensive a map was, the more precious it would be.

This map… was as good as the one that Yuan Ao Master had previously taken out. In terms of value, it was no less than a strange godly wood. And it belonged solely to Luo Feng!

Hong!

A bout of waves suddenly burst out from the rock wall before him. Luo Feng, who had just picked up the green token, could not help looking up.

A scene was unfolding on the rock wall before him. Two vague figures began to appear. One was an immeasurable beauty whose entire body was covered with countless green leaves. Looking at her was like looking at the most exuberant existence of the universe. Luo Feng felt immeasurable comfort.

The other figure was wearing a long, gray robe. At first glance, he looked like a piece of dead wood, and his head bore some resemblance to crystal. He was bald and did not have ears or a nose —only three eyes and a mouth.

“I am Jie Fanzi,” the gray-robed figure said.

“I am Zhen Lin,” said the beautiful lady wrapped in countless green leaves, also introducing herself.

The gray-robed figure continued, “Because you picked up the two items I left behind, you are able to see these images taken as a memento! What we cannot know… is, by the time you see this, which reincarnation era it will be.”

As the gray-robed figure’s mouth moved, strange waves formed. It spoke in a language Luo Feng was not familiar with, but when the waves were transmitted to his brain, he seemed to naturally understand everything the figure was saying.

To a certain extent, there was no need for language. The waves of one another’s willpower enabled them to establish mutual understanding.

“Which reincarnation era…” Luo Feng was secretly in shock.

These two fellows… The human databank had already provided Luo Feng with information on some terrifying figures from the three major universe eras and two holy lands, yet apparently, there was no information about these two—Jie Fanzi and Zhen Lin. He had never heard of them before. Clearly, they were not life forms from any of the three major universe reincarnation eras.

“I am a lone supreme master,” the gray-robed figure continued. “Before my last fight, my inheritance, my countless efforts—I do not wish for them to go to waste. So, on my way to try for that breakthrough in reincarnation, I left a token and a map of the Universe Ocean here. That token represents an isolated space within the Universe Boat. Other than my supreme true treasure that I brought along with me, I have left the rest of what I own there. I only hope that… successors shall bring glory to my legacy. And, if possible, hand down the various techniques and knowledge I have created to later generations, thus providing them with meaning to live on.”

“This is not a demand,” the grey-robed figure clarified. “I am in no position to ask too much of a great being from numerous reincarnation eras in the future.”

Luo Feng’s heart started to beat faster.

Damn!

Pulling Traces Diagram and the green token from Universe Boat were actually just keys. A lone universe supreme master only took his supreme true treasure with him and left the rest of his belongings there. The riches of a universe supreme master could be incomparably intimidating—like how much Huge Axe Creator had contributed to the human race.

The lone wanderer Sitting Mountain Guest, for instance, did not bother himself with pinnacle true treasures at all. And Dark Universe Creator had immediately said he wanted the strange object godly wood and was willing to use his pinnacle true treasures to compensate the various parties in exchange for it.

To the lone universe supreme masters… some of these pinnacle true treasures were worthless.

Another wave that sounded full of vitality was transmitted to Luo Feng. “Junior.” The beautiful lady had spoken up, too. “I, Zhen Lin, left behind my inheritance, too. As for the token and the map, they are kept at a distance of around 300 light years away from here. If you are capable enough, there is no harm looking around. Whether you are able to find it or not depends on your luck.”

“Don’t listen to her,” said the gray-robed figure. “This is already the core of Tilted Peak Sector, where danger lurks all over. Where even universe supreme masters are highly likely to be annihilated. It is said that some universe supreme masters who succeeded in breaking through reincarnations left tokens within their surroundings, but to be able to obtain those tokens, one would need luck, as scouring around for these tokens would be far too dangerous. We have lived for almost three reincarnation eras. Our limits are nearing. We only have one last gamble to make to breakthrough this round of reincarnation. If we achieve a breakthrough… then we can become eternal existences and even establish a sacred universe.”

“The Universe Ocean of today only has one sacred universe,” said the lady wrapped in green leaves. “I am going to see to it that Universe Ocean has two sacred universes.”

“Haha! Zhen Lin, let’s go.”

“Let’s go.”

The gray-robed figure and lady covered with green leaves vanished in a flash and were closely followed by the images that were kept as mementos. These gradually dispersed from sight too.

Luo Feng stood before the rock wall but was motionless for quite some time.


Chapter 1180: Huge Axe

“If I survive the incarnation, I can live forever?” Luo Feng whispered.

This so-called incarnation might be a huge secret in Universe Ocean.

“However, it’s too far from me. There are three incarnation eras in total, and I’ve only lived a short while.”

Luo Feng then put everything away, but he didn’t find anything using Golden Country. Then Luo Feng left the space on Star Tower.

He inspected the karst cave for a long time, but he couldn’t find anything else. Besides, based on the message left by Jie Fanzi and Zhen Lin, the karst cave was already the core area of Tilted Peak Sector, where even universe supreme masters could be killed.

“I found some stuff left by Jie Fanzi by luck. I can’t adventure in the core area. I’ll regret it forever if Star Tower gets trapped somewhere.”

Luo Feng turned Star Tower around and went back.

It had been an easy trip. He had recorded the path before, so he arrived back to the wing space quickly. After another two months, he arrived back in the cave where he had been.

Luo Feng didn’t search for valuables. Instead, he went back to the original universe.

One month later, in the original universe: human territory, Earth.

In a city in Asia, in the corner of a restaurant, a black-haired man in casual clothing sat with a teapot and a teacup. There were all sorts of conversations in the restaurant.

“The investment in the Mo Ya system this time is a huge mistake! We cooperated with the emperor of that system because we want the make things smoother, which is why we gave him 10 percent of the shares! That emperor is too greedy and tried to gain from the investment… Humph! He thinks we can’t do anything to him just because it’s far from our Ganwu Universe Country… Humph! It’s all too easy for us to crush him!”

“I almost became a domain lord.”

“Easy. I gave three life planets to have a baby on Earth.”

Luo Feng couldn’t help laughing. Those who could live on Earth were the big families and elites of the earthling bloodline.

“Ah, Feng,” said a voice.

Luo Feng raised his head. A seemingly humble man walked toward Luo Feng and smiled at him. He sat down across from Luo Feng.

Luo Feng smiled. “Wei Weng.”

“They can’t hear us?” Wei Weng looked around.

“They won’t remember anything,” said Luo Feng.

“Impressive.” Wei Weng gave a thumbs up.

“Who do you think I am?” Luo Feng asked with a smile.

“You’re good,” said Wei Weng. “Everyone knows you’re incredible. Why did you pick this place?”

“To listen and observe more,” said Luo Feng. “Those who live on Earth are the elites of the earthlings. I can find out more about the earthlings by listening to their conversations.”

Wei Weng nodded.

“Why’re you still at the ninth level of domain lord?” asked Luo Feng. “With the resources I gave you, it should be very easy for you to become undying.”

Wei Weng had been friends with Luo Feng forever, and Luo Feng was as close to Wei Weng as to Luo Hua. When he was the envoy of Ganwu, Wei Weng was already at star level, and he had turned universe level soon after that. Luo Feng had provided as many resources as possible to his parents, his wife, his brother Luo Hua, and Wei Weng; he needed to make sure that they became undying. As for his sons Luo Ping and Luo Hai, he was stricter.

And as for his grandchildren and other descendants, they needed to take care of themselves. He wasn’t able to supply endless resources to them, just like those other friends on Earth.

“I still have a long time to go,” said Wei Weng. “I can live as a domain lord for another several million years. Fine. I’ll practice and become a sector lord.”

“That’s more like it.”

Although his status was surging, Luo Feng had never shown any superiority in front of his brother Wei Weng, which was why Wei Weng still treated Luo Feng as an ordinary person.

They talked until dark, and thoughts flooded Luo Feng’s mind.

I have three things on hand that I need to deal with, thought Luo Feng. I need to take the white wing, but I need to sharpen my willpower and get it to reach the universe supreme master level. There are plenty of places in the Lands of Extremis for me to do that.

Second, the object left by Jie Fanzi. Jie Fanzi, I know you’re powerful, but you left your valuables in Universe Boat. Aren’t you torturing me?

And third, Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest… I can tell from the white wing, Jie Fanzi, and Zhen Lin that even universe supreme masters have things to worry about. Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest still devoted so much energy cultivating disciples, and he even gives a supreme true treasure to his disciples. I don’t believe there aren’t any other plans behind this.

Luo Feng remembered Sitting Mountain Guest’s plan. Although he respected and trusted Sitting Mountain Guest, he still needed to be careful.

I don’t have time to think about teacher Sitting Mountain Guest. The more powerful I get, the more ways I have to deal with those difficulties. I’ll improve my power now. As far as getting the white wing back, it is broken and needs lots of precious materials. The valuables left by Jie Fanzi are enough to recover the white wing.

Luo Feng had a good plan, but neither the white wing nor the valuables were easy to acquire. He had located the valuables in Tilted Peak Sector by luck. However, it wasn’t that easy to get the valuables in Universe Boat. He had the map, but he needed to venture in personally!

Hmm… I’ll choose Universe Boat as the place to sharpen my willpower, Luo Feng thought. I need more information about Universe Boat. After all, that’s one of the three Lands of Extremis. Even Teacher Primal Chaos City Leader could die there. I must be cautious.

The valuables left by Jie Fanzi were clearly not for his disciples. Even those at the same level as Primal Chaos City Leader couldn’t guarantee they could get such valuables.

Incarnation… It seems there’s an incarnation in Tilted Peak Sector. There might be lots of valuables left by universe supreme masters.

Luo Feng could extrapolate that there might be lots of valuables left by generations of universe supreme masters, but he didn’t dare look for them without a careful plan.

Luo Feng started to gather information about Universe Boat.

There were two beings in the space of the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector.

A being with three faces, eight arms, and hammers in each of its hands triggered a technique, and a huge phantom of a giant hammer showed up.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, you’ll have to fight me today,” it said.

“Phantom?” Primal Chaos City Leader looked at it. “You’re from Purple Moon Holy Land. I’ve never heard of you. This must be the first time you have come out. Do you want me as your competitor?”

There were two holy land universes. The smaller one was called Purple Moon Holy Land.

“Yes, you’re my competitor, Primal Chaos City Leader.” The golden-armored being had three faces—fierce, gentle, and indifferent. The fierce one was facing City Chaos City Leader. “I pick the stronger ones.”

“Do it,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

“Okay, I’ll see how powerful this Primal Chaos City Leader is.”

The golden-armored being started to make attacks.

Hong! Long! Long!

The hammers became blurry and merged with the phantom. They became a giant godly hammer! The space around the hammer was annihilated.

“A supreme technique.” Primal Chaos City Leader shook his head. “Chaos, move.”

Primal Chaos City Leader slapped at it. His palm became larger, turning golden. A universe was formed in the palm, and all sorts of energies were born.

Peng!

The giant golden palm hit the godly hammer.

Hong! Long!

The hammer crumbled, and the golden-armored great being bounced back. The wind in the distance froze him. And then, the ice broke, and the great being went out.

“No wonder you’re Primal Chaos City Leader!” he roared. “Ancestor said you have the highest chance of becoming a universe supreme master. One palm and you defeated me. I’m being too arrogant!”

Hong!

The great being disappeared.

“The highest chance to become a universe supreme master?” Primal Chaos City Leader whispered. “The ancestors of the two holy lands are never seen by anyone. That ancestor from Purple Moon Holy Land said something like that about me so lots of universe masters from that holy land would come to fight me.”

It was all too common that Primal Chaos City Leader ran into beings from the holy land who wanted to fight him. His godly power was far inferior to Star River Master. However, he was known for being powerful!

Huge Axe Founder sent Primal Chaos City Leader a message: “Chaos, Chaos. Haha! I got extremely lucky and acquired a ‘huge axe’ supreme true treasure. Tell the other universe masters of us humans that it’s something to celebrate…”

“A supreme true treasure? Huge Axe got a supreme true treasure?”

Primal Chaos City Leader was exhilarated. This was something for the entire human race to celebrate. He immediately told the other universe masters of the human race.

Soon, Luo Feng, Darkness Master, and Void Gold Master all knew about it.


Chapter 1181: Race Contribution

A supreme true treasure was a guarding treasure of a race. Lots of supreme beings felt insecure, as the human race never had a supreme true treasure. However, Huge Axe Founder had gotten a supreme true treasure, and it was something that thrilled all the great beings of the human race.

In the virtual universe, all the supreme beings of the human race gathered.

“Since Teacher Origin was suppressed, we humans have been low-key. Now that Huge Axe Founder has a supreme true treasure, our status in the original universe will be stabilized.”

“I was shocked by the news.”

“Since Teacher Origin was suppressed, the demon race, bug race, and automaton race all try to outpower us—especially the demon race! Now that Huge Axe has a supreme true treasure, the two demon ancestors won’t be reckless.”

There were dishes and wine on the long bench. Huge Axe Founder and the 19 universe masters were talking in excitement.

“Keep it a secret first,” said Huge Axe Founder. “I’m still in the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector, and it’ll take me some time to get back. No one else knows that I got a supreme true treasure, so we must keep it a secret. I’ll reveal it when the time comes.”

“Yes.”

“Okay.”

The universe masters all nodded. The news would be made known. After all, one couldn’t hide a supreme true treasure forever.

Huge Axe Founder wasn’t like Luo Feng. Luo Feng was only a universe knight, and even though he accomplished much on the engraving picture, he wasn’t a top-tier universe master even with Star Tower. He was, at most, good at surviving. Huge Axe Founder was completely different.

It was a fiesta, as this news was worth celebrating by the entire human race, showing another milestone of the power of the human race.

“Luo Feng.”

Primal Chaos City Leader walked toward Luo Feng with a black wine cup.

“Luo Feng.”

“So happy today. Huge Axe is best at axe techniques, and he became universe supreme master with an axe,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “He got an axe supreme true treasure, and with that, Huge Axe will become much more powerful.”

Luo Feng nodded. He was right. Supreme true treasures needed to be suitable. An axe was much better than a sword to someone who used an axe. Of course, that axe type supreme true treasure had lots of other functions.

“Luo Feng, you asked me for the information on Universe Boat.” Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “I gave you a piece before. I just talked to Huge Axe, and he had something more detailed. I’ll send it to you now.”

“Thank you, Teacher.” Luo Feng was overjoyed.

Huge Axe Founder had the map? The more detailed the information was, the better. After all, the Pulling Traces Diagram left by Jie Fanzi only recorded a tiny area of Universe Boat. No one had the full map of the Lands of Extremis.

“Teacher, I have a map of Universe Boat,” said Luo Feng. “I got it by luck in Tilted Peak Sector. I’ll send it to you now.”

“Which? Which power?” The smile on Primal Chaos City Leader’s face froze.

He gazed at Luo Feng in amazement. “Good. It’s a record of the inner area of Universe Boat? The maps we humans have can barely rival the one you have. Did you get it from the great beings of the first universe era?”

“Normally, great beings will burn the maps after reading it.” Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng. “Just like we told you to burn the map last time. Only those who are extremely confident dare to carry the maps. Like me, Huge Axe, other universe masters who are good at surviving, and other universe supreme masters.”

Luo Feng nodded. Maps of the Lands of Extremis were secrets of a race, and only the top seniors in a race could read them.

Huge Axe Founder would give it to other universe masters when he got one, and Luo Feng would surely give it to the race. It was contribution within the race, and the human race wouldn’t trade it with other races under almost all circumstances. Trades could only happen after a discussion among the seniors or if Huge Axe Founder did it himself.

“I’m not able to kill those who dare to carry maps.” Luo Feng shook his head. “I got the Pulling Traces Diagram in the water area of Tilted Peak Sector by luck.”

“Pulling Traces Diagram?” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “How luxurious. It should be left by a universe supreme master. Lots of universe supreme masters died during the incarnations, and lots of their valuables or maps are left in the Lands of Extremis.”

The universe masters were talking.

“Come here.”

“More good news!” Huge Axe Founder yelled.

Some universe masters immediately sat back down in their chairs with their eyes gleaming. Some shouted, “What?”

“Did someone get another supreme true treasure?”

“Do you really think it’s that easy to get a supreme true treasure, Peng Gong?”

Huge Axe Founder looked at Luo Feng and said, “Luo Feng found a Pulling Traces Diagram of Universe Boat in Tilted Peak Sector.”

Hua!

“Pulling Traces Diagram?”

“Of Universe Boat?”

“How large is the area?”

“Usually, it’s a large area for a Pulling Traces Diagram.”

All the universe masters were thrilled.

Huge Axe Founder nodded. “We now know twice as much as we knew about Universe Boat now, and some core areas are recorded.” Lots of universe masters went to congratulate or thank Luo Feng… Luo Feng could feel the unity within the human race. Everyone wanted the best for the race.

“Luo Feng.” Huge Axe walked to Luo Feng.

“Huge Axe Founder,” said Luo Feng.

“You contributed the map of the Land of Extremis,” Huge Axe said. “It’s a great contribution. The race needs contributions from great beings. I should give you more than 10,000 true treasure points for that map.”

“However, there are only a limited number of valuables.”

“If your contribution is too large, the race can’t give something equivalent back.” Huge Axe looked at Luo Feng.

Luo Feng smiled. He understood that there were only a limited number of valuables, and they were mainly contributed by Huge Axe Founder. Huge Axe Founder put lots of valuables in the race without asking anything back. He gave the maps to the race, and he nurtured the race like a father.

“I can only give you 5,000 true treasure points,” said Huge Axe Founder.

“You give them for free…” said Luo Feng.

“You need to be powerful.” Huge Axe Founder glanced at Luo Feng. “No need to say no. 5,000 true treasures it is. You need to have it. Become a universe master as soon as possible.”

Luo Feng nodded. He felt that the human race depended on the 20 people. 19 universe masters and Huge Axe Founder! And, of course, Teacher Origin. Huge Axe and Primal Chaos City Leader were the leaders.

I’ll make more contributions, Luo Feng thought.

Based on the information he got about Universe Boat and the map he got…

“Please.”

Luo Feng sat in a restaurant close to his home. The light poured on his body, and Luo Feng frowned.

“Based on the information, the keepsakes have different levels. From lower to higher, black, green, and silver. Only powerful universe masters can get the keepsakes. The green keepsakes are in the hands of universe supreme masters. As for silver keepsakes, only the great beings from the holy lands have them.”

Luo Feng frowned. Green keepsakes were in the inner area of Universe Boat and bordered the core area. It was extremely dangerous. Only universe supreme masters could get the green keepsakes.

“Oh, Jie Fanzi. Why did you have to keep the valuables somewhere so dangerous? Even my Primal Chaos City Leader teacher can’t guarantee to get there. And me?” Luo Feng exclaimed.

Within three months after he went back to Earth, Luo Feng left the original universe and left for Universe Ocean. He was going to Universe Boat this time!


Chapter 1182: The Black-Striped Stone Pillar

In the vast Universe Ocean, endless chaotic airflow filled the atmosphere.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

A black-haired man with silver wings left scattered streaks of shadows as he teleported repeatedly across vast distances within the Universe Ocean… This was Luo Feng, who was just leaving the primal universe and making his way toward Universe Boat all by himself.

This was different from the first time he went to Tilted Peak Sector. Although it took only slightly more than 1,000 years, after absorbing a large amount of energy from the origin during the time spent in the space of the wings, the once heavily damaged Shi Wu Wings were able to restore their original form to become almost perfect again. Once the hazy golden light spread to fill the surroundings, the force was so powerful that even Luo Feng was breathless with wonder. Sometimes, an unknown occurrence could bring a bigger surprise than all the other known ones combined!

Other great beings could be strong in attack, defense, godly body, techniques, and much more…

For him, regardless of how many flaws or how lacking he was, merely by relying on the combination of the perfect Shi Wu Wings, Flame Sand Cup, and Miniature Universe, he could at least wipe out all the other pinnacle domain true treasures! He could fight if he wanted to or leave if he needed to; he was in total control of what would be done.

“I’m so looking forward to it. I will make use of this journey to hone my willpower to the level of a universe supreme master. Then I will go back to Tilted Peak Sector and claim that pair of white wings.”

Luo Feng was filled with anticipation. On the one hand, he allowed his mind to run wild with its thoughts. On the other hand, he maintained a high frequency of long-distance teleportation.

Hua.

Suddenly, he stopped.

“A natural wormhole.”

Luo Feng looked far into the distance at the gigantic, distorted space whirlpool. He revealed a trace of a smile. It had been a pretty dull journey rushing about Universe Ocean. There were chaotic airflows everywhere. At times, he would make a single teleportation that would last over a span of one to two days; other times, he would maintain a high or almost maximum frequency of repeated teleportation. Everywhere he passed, there was no direction to speak of. The only constant was that chaotic airflow…

Indeed, how dull it was. So when he saw that natural wormhole, it was like seeing a ray of hope amidst helplessness.

“My trip to Universe Boat this time will probably take a long, long time,” Luo Feng commented lightly.

Prior to setting off, he had looked up a large quantity of information on Universe Boat so that he would be clear on where he should go to hone his willpower. The Universe Boat was massive, and its internal domain was fraught with dangers with many places where he would never dare to teleport. The destination he had set his sights on was none other than the land for honing willpower.

Universe Boat, one of the three most dangerous lands, was fraught with danger. Based on ready information found within the human race’s databank, there were quite a few lands for honing willpower within the internal domain, and every single one had a different environment. Within one of these environments, the “Black-Striped Stone Pillar” could be found—or, according to what Luo Feng and the humans called it, the “Celestial Magic Pillar.” It was one of the countless strange objects found within Universe Boat.

There was a total of 16 Celestial Magic Pillars (black-striped stone pillars)! These 16 Celestial Magic Pillars all stood at a towering height of more than 1,000 light years and were all extremely powerful. No attack was strong enough to cause damage or take them away. They were the supporting pillars of a certain strange space. Within that strange space were numerous gigantic secret chambers. Within each secret chamber, there was an isolated space, and each one had a corresponding black token. Anyone who wanted to enter the isolated space of this secret chamber would have to possess the corresponding black token.

What Jie Fanzi had left behind was a green token that was of a higher grade. Similarly, the green token corresponded to one of the secret chambers with an isolated space that was even deeper within the internal domain. It was so deep that it could be the end of the internal domain, where the edge of the core region was. Even universe supreme masters were extremely cautious when they were located there. Great beings like Primal Chaos City Leader would not even dare venture so far in…

The Celestial Magic Pillars were located in a space that was not so deep in. Thus, the difficulty level was much lower, so great beings like Primal Chaos City Leader, Star River Master, Ice Mountain Master, and An Yong Master would at least dare to take a shot at entering the region. Spending a couple hundred or 1,000 years within the internal domain ought to have been more than enough to reach the space with the Celestial Magic Pillars.

These Celestial Magic Pillars were magical and exerted the impact of endless willpower. The closer they were, the more intimidating the impact of their willpower could get. And the closer to these Celestial Magic Pillars, the faster the time velocity was! Time velocity could reach a ratio of 100 to 1. Or even 1000 to 1.

This time velocity was the reason why Luo Feng decided to head to this space with the Celestial Magic Pillars! After all, just by venturing deeper and deeper into the internal region to arrive at a land for honing willpower was a long process that could take a couple hundred or 1,000 years. The process of traveling back and forth would take an extremely long time.

One also had to consider the time spent on attaining the willpower of a universe supreme master… If going to the space with the Celestial Magic Pillars was more time-saving, then naturally, it would be Luo Feng’s first choice.

“The largest hidden treasure within Original Star was within the Disambiguation Temple; so within the Disambiguation Temple, there must be various components of a pinnacle domain type true treasure.”

Luo Feng had to make a choice. He had already obtained one Disambiguation Mirror Stone, so he was qualified to enter the temple. Yet he might not be able to make it on time. After all, once all 36 Disambiguation Mirror Stones had been born, Disambiguation Temple would open. Those with the Disambiguation Mirror Stones would be granted entry.

Suppose the Disambiguation Temple opened, but he was over at where the Celestial Magic Pillars were. By the time he made it back, a couple hundred or 1,000 years would have passed. Then the fight for treasures at the Disambiguation Temple would have ended!

“The Disambiguation Mirror Stones. I have left them in God Country. Should Disambiguation Temple open, I would be able to rush back within the shortest time possible—that is, if I made the trip personally. Otherwise, I could hand the stones over to Teacher and company. Then at least the Disambiguation Mirror Stones will not go to waste.”

Luo Feng valued this Disambiguation Mirror Stones, but upon consideration, he valued the pair of damaged white wings more than he did the stones.

Hua!

Luo Feng transformed into a beam of light, flew into the natural wormhole, and soon, was transmitted an extremely far distance away.

Time passed.

After using up almost 12 days within the vast Universe Ocean, Luo Feng finally arrived at one of the three most dangerous lands, Universe Boat.

“That, ahead of us, is Universe Boat.”

Luo Feng continued to teleport repeatedly for a few minutes.

Suddenly, the scenery before him changed. Chaotic airflow suddenly thinned out substantially. From afar, a more astounding scene unfolded.

“This, this…”

Luo Feng stood in void space as he looked at the unbelievable scene billions of light years away. Even though he had witnessed this scene before when he was going through the information he’d found, this was the first time he had laid eyes on the true Universe Boat, and he felt an overwhelming shock.

The immeasurable towering Universe Boat… was a damaged, incomparably gigantic naval vessel. It was as tall as several tens of millions of light years, and as long as billions of light years. It was a complex mix of deep black and bewildering purple, and its body… even from a couple billion light years away, Luo Feng could see the dense spots of damaged areas that were full of cracks and holes.

It was like a naval vessel that had been shot by a barrage of lasers, then hacked by many gigantic blades… It was utterly damaged!

Hong! Long! Long!

An overpowering gravitational force was released from within the Universe Boat, swallowing the surrounding chaotic airflow in a frantic manner, causing the chaotic airflow in its surroundings to always be maintained at a thinned condition.

Upon swallowing the chaotic airflow, the entire Universe Boat was able to maintain a constant release of its endless power. A circular, gigantic river of flames surrounded the Universe Boat while the vast Cold Sea enshrouded it with cold air. Amidst the cold air, one could vaguely see glittering and translucent icebergs that resembled mirrors… At the same time, a huge wind whirlpool was raging in the surroundings.

Pi! Pa!

A gigantic electric snake that was several tens of thousands light years long was raging and roaring. Streaks of resplendent light rays of various colors dazzled Luo Feng. Huge, lush green vines climbed and twined around the surface of the vessel, appearing to be so quiet.

Flames, cold air, wind, electricity, vines, rays…

In the outermost boundary, a large number of broken segments were constantly circulating the bulk of Universe Boat while flying at high speed; these were likely segments that had broken off the body of Universe Boat, and they were constantly flying around at high speeds.

Luo Feng did not find all these most shocking at all. What shocked him most was that at the lower region of the Universe Boat, there was a thick chaotic air mass. He could see a faint array of colorful electric lights flashing; there were colors like gold, red, blue, and green. And within that chaotic airflow, there was a huge, damaged miniature universe!

A miniature universe!

“Swallowed a miniature universe… it has actually swallowed a miniature universe.” Luo Feng was truly taken aback. “The top half of the miniature universe is gone. Could it be because it was partially swallowed?”

The miniature universe by itself was as long as billions of light years. It was damaged, but it still had a diameter of billions of light years. If its height was taken into consideration, the size of the miniature universe would have been even bigger.

I really wonder what the background of the Universe Boat is. Luo Feng could not help the thoughts that were thronging his mind. Directly swallowing the chaotic airflow is not something that just any great being would be capable of. Only a miniature universe would be able to absorb and transform this chaotic airflow into energy of universe laws. However—not only can Universe Boat constantly swallow the chaotic airflow, but it can even swallow the whole miniature universe. And it can transform everything it has absorbed into gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder and lightning, light rays, time, space, and various kinds of energy. Within the Universe Boat, not only are there secret chambers that contain isolated spaces aplenty, but there are also quite a handful of places with strange time velocity.

To be able to achieve all of the above, it is practically comparable to the universe laws of a miniature universe. This Universe Boat. How was it made in the first place? And how did it get so severely damaged?

“It’s just that, according to the legends of the three most dangerous lands… we have already lost count of the number of reincarnation eras that have passed,” Luo Feng said to himself.

Countless great beings often discovered items left behind by some universe supreme masters known from history. They often discovered some information, yet regardless of which reincarnation era these were from, all seemed to involve records of the three most dangerous lands. The eternal nature of the three most dangerous lands was comparable to the endless generations of reincarnations of the primal universe. No one knew how the three most dangerous lands had been born.

Luo Feng was quite appalled when he actually saw Universe Boat with his own eyes; he had spent quite some time teleporting before he finally arrived at the region of the Universe Boat where a great number of broken segments were flying at high speeds. There were countless broken segments. The small ones were as big as tens of billions of kilometers, and the big ones were as big as a couple hundreds of light years.

Sou!

Luo Feng teleported himself to land on a piece of a broken segment of the Universe Boat. This segment’s largest diameter was around 0.6 light years. Other than some patterns that were purple, the rest of it was all a deep black color, resulting in the entire broken segment exuding an oppressive force that made Luo Feng’s heart tremble… And this broken segment shared a vague connection to the Universe Boat that was quite a distance away.

Since time immemorial, countless great beings had tried, but none had been able to take away a single piece of Universe Boat’s broken segments. Even if they were to attack a Universe Boat broken segment at full force, they would still not be able to throw the broken segment into chaos. It was as though an invisible rope tied the broken segment and Universe Boat together.

“I have arrived on Universe Boat,” Luo Feng said to himself. “I shall head over to the gathering place of my fellow human race first.”

With that, a human figure could be seen flashing about in the void space.

After spending about five minutes, Luo Feng teleported and appeared on a fast-flying, distorted piece of Universe Boat broken segment. This was the gathering place for humans from the primal universe.

On the three most dangerous lands—be it Tilted Peak Sector, Universe Boat, or Flowing Countless Mountains—the human race would always designate a gathering place. As the exploration process required constant vigilance and caution, if one felt tired after spending a long time exploring dangerous lands, they could return to these designated gathering places to rest.


Chapter 1183: Huan Jie Emperor

The fragments of Universe Boat were close to the wind whirlpool. Even though it was only a small part of the wind, it hit Luo Feng everywhere, crashing into him like blades. But to Luo Feng, they were like a light breeze.

A being showed up. “Luo Feng!”

“Uncle.” Luo Feng looked at Ice Mountain Master in surprise. “Why are you here?”

After the fight with Yuan Ao Master, Ice Mountain Master was very close to Luo Feng as they tried to get the Pulling Traces Diagram and defended themselves against the enemies together.

“Why can’t I come here?” said Ice Mountain Master.

“That’s not what I meant,” said Luo Feng. “I thought the human race was in Tilted Peak Sector. I thought you were in Tilted Peak Sector.”

“That’s true,” said Ice Mountain Master. “You just contributed a huge map of Universe Boat, so we can get more the first time. Lots of great beings of the human race will come here. Besides, Huge Axe Founder wanted a supreme true treasure, which is why he came here. It’ll take him around 100 years to arrive here.”

Luo Feng flew side by side with Ice Mountain Master. “He’s not in Tilted Peak Sector anymore?”

“He might still go in the future,” Ice Mountain Master explained. “We got some pictures of the inner area, but Huge Axe Founder never arrived there. He was lucky enough to find a special place and got a supreme true treasure there.”

“In the inner area?” Luo Feng was shocked.

Supreme true treasures were usually in the core areas. Of course, there were exceptions, just like those white wings.

“It’s in the inner area, so he came out fast,” said Ice Mountain Master. “The concentration of the human race in Universe Boat. As for Tilted Peak Sector, we’ll leave that for later.”

Luo Feng understood. The map he contributed was much larger. After all, he only got several pieces from Yuan Ao Master, and none of them showed the path to the core area.

After a short while…

On a fragment of Universe Boat, a white godly palace was located on a great canyon.

Ice Mountain Master walked to the white godly palace. “We need to venture into the inner areas of Universe Boat. The top beings of the human race will come here one by one. There are three of us here. Me, Void Gold Master, and Zhen Ma Master. Four if we count you.”

“Zhen Ma Master?” Luo Feng was surprised.

“The Hong Alliance is an alliance, after all,” said Ice Mountain Master. “We’ll give a part of our map to them. But remember, they are other races, so we can’t share everything even if we’re in the same alliance. These secrets are all obtained by us humans.”

Luo Feng nodded. Some other races would trade something under temptations, and they couldn’t be tracked as long as they kept it clean. Some beings left the Hong Alliance and joined other alliances, like Flame Emperor.

Luo Feng and Ice Mountain Master transmitted their voices using godly power.

“Luo Feng, Ice Mountain.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader, Ice Mountain Master.”

Two beings showed up in front of the godly palace and greeted Luo Feng and Ice Mountain Master.

“Void Gold Master, Zhen Ma Master!” Luo Feng shouted.

Luo Feng didn’t rush it, as Ice Mountain Master and Void Gold Master were waiting outside. Time flew, and great beings came one after another, such as Peng Gong Master and Huang Jian Master.

One day, Luo Feng and Void Gold Master stood beside the cliff.

Void Gold Master lowered his eyebrows. “Do you have something to say to me?”

“Void Gold Master,” said Luo Feng. “Three of us came from Earth. Hong is the big brother while I’m the third brother. My big brother went to you after. I could still get in contact with big brother before, but I can’t anymore. How is he doing now?”

“You mean Hong?” Void Gold Master smiled. “He’s your big brother, after all, and he is a genius. He didn’t make much improvement at the start. However, he’s a special one. Normally, great beings make less improvement later, but he is exactly the opposite. He didn’t improve quickly at the beginning but keeps making breakthrough later.”

Shi Huo Knight was a disciple of Void Gold Master, and Shi Huo Master improved really fast. Comparatively, Hong indeed didn’t improve quickly enough.

“He’s really mediocre aside from willpower and illusions, and he was the worst at the beginning,” said Void Gold Master. “However, he’s already been able to catch up with the average level of my disciples. Tens of thousands of years ago, he went to Star Prison. He became undying there and became an emperor called Huan Jie Emperor… He was then taught by Huge Axe, and after that, I lost track of him. You can go ask Huge Axe.”

“In the universe of Huge Axe?” Luo Feng nodded. “No wonder I can’t get in contact.

There were two small universes. One of them was the primal universe and the other was Huge Axe universe. Teacher Universe performed the supreme technique “Virtual Universe” that could cover the entire original universe! But it couldn’t get to the Universe Ocean… It couldn’t get to other miniature universes as well. As for the original universe, it was an exception. After all, the primal universe belonged to Teacher Origin.

The virtual universe could only cover the original universe and primal universe. Hong was in the universe of Huge Axe, so he couldn’t contact him.

“He can’t compare with you.” Void Gold Master looked at Luo Feng. “You became a universe master after only a short while.”

Luo Feng smiled.

“Perhaps Universe Boat isn’t the best place for you,” said Void Gold Master. “You’re adventuring in the outer area of Tilted Peak Sector, and even Primal Chaos City Leader won’t go too deep in the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector. He’ll go and rescue you if you run into danger. However, this is a new map, and many great beings will inspect the inner area. If you run into dangers in the outer area, they won’t even be able to make it to rescue you.”

“No worries,” said Luo Feng.

“I know you have the wings that can control the space and time.” Void Gold Master shook his head. “However, if you run into an enemy that has a pinnacle domain type true treasure, you’ll be dangerous. Though you have multiple bodies, your true treasures will be seized. I won’t say much. After all, they’re your true treasures, and you should be responsible for them.”

Shua!

Void Gold Master dove, and Luo Feng stood beside the cliff, speechless.

After a month, 16 universe masters of the Hong Alliance gathered, and they took off. Some of them ventured in the outer area. Some of them entered the inner area.

“The inner area is extremely dangerous. Even I can be killed if I’m not careful enough.” Great beings flew out of the godly palace, and Primal Chaos City Leader alerted Luo Feng. “You need to be at least as powerful as Ice Mountain and Void Gold if you want to go to the inner area. Unless you have super surviving skills, don’t go.”

Luo Feng was speechless. He needed to go to the heavenly pillars to sharpen his willpower. He didn’t even say that he would go to the green keepsake area. Primal Chaos City Leader would be furious if he said he was going there.

“Chaos, Luo Feng isn’t stupid,” said Void Gold Master. “He runs into dangers in the outer area sometimes. For the inner area, he will die if he goes. He knows what to do.”

Primal Chaos City Leader frowned. “He’s my disciple.”

Void Gold Master smiled. “He’s one of us humans, and I want the best for him as well.”

“Let’s go!” said Peng Gong Master.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

They teleported and left. Primal Chaos City Leader took a look at Luo Feng and left.

Void Gold Master said, “Be careful. Your teacher and I are in the inner area. We won’t be able to help you.” Then he left.

Some called Luo Feng to come with them.

“No, I’ll act alone.”

Luo Feng teleported and left.

It took him 20 minutes to get to the surface. Based on the maps left by Jie Fanzi and the human race, there were 100 ways to get to the inner area. The great beings of the human race separated, and Luo Feng’s destination was the heavenly demon pillar. He would certainly choose a route with fewer dangers.

“There are 892 dangerous areas in total.”

“Some safe places allow teleportation, and some only allow slow flying. It might take me 500 to 600 years to get to the pillar.

“Move!”

Luo Feng flew to a crack down there. It was a huge crack 280,000 light years long and 92 light years wide. There were vines around it, and lots of ice crystals, too. Luo Feng went into the huge crack.


Chapter 1184: God-Destroying Valley

He just flew in, and at one glance, all he could see was endless, cold darkness. There were only faint traces of refracted rays caused by the ice crystals.

“So cold,” said Luo Feng.

He shot up into the sky and flew at high speed while putting his Golden Kingdom into play.

Hazy golden light spread out instantly, enveloping an area with a radius of 80 light years. However, some areas deep among the ice crystals were impenetrable and thus inexplorable. The 80 light years contained thousands of regions, yet certain regions were anomalous, so the golden light was unable to probe into them. Only the more ordinary regions could be explored more thoroughly. Of course, Luo Feng restrained the amount of power exerted by Golden Kingdom; he only needed enough to maintain its exploratory function.

After flying for a while…

Rip! Pull!

A blade of ice sliced through the void from afar without warning. It swept its way over and seemed as though it would extend to Luo Feng’s location.

“Humph!” Luo Feng put his mind to work, and the original restraint power of Golden Kingdom erupted in an instant.

Hong! Long!

The erupted power crashed into that ice blade, which immediately changed its direction upon receiving such a strong impact. It quickly flew past Luo Feng, sailing above him.

Luo Feng was already traveling at high speed—90 times the speed of light. The deeper he ventured, the more soundless ice blades he came across. As the number increased, the more trouble Luo Feng felt was brewing.

“Blazing Flames Ocean!” Luo Feng put his mind to work to activate Flame Sand Cup.

Hong! Long!

Dazzling golden flames spread out instantly, but the power of Blazing Flames Ocean was a far cry from that of Golden Kingdom! Even as a supplementation, it did not bring about much improvement in Luo Feng’s situation.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Countless ice blades sliced across the length of the sky, colliding with one another, shattering into countless small ice blades and sweeping directly into Luo Feng’s vicinity. Even if Blazing Flame Ocean and Golden Kingdom were to join forces, the most they could do would be to cause this dense pack of countless ice blades to encounter a slight change in direction. The area covered was too vast, so even a slight change in direction would still affect Luo Feng.

Luo Feng frowned as he put his mind to work.

“Blazing Flames, form my blade.”

Hua!

The core power of the endless flame gathered rapidly. In the blink of an eye, everything had converged into a golden blade that was as long as 100 million kilometers! The golden blade was surrounded by blazing flames… This was certainly one of the ways the blade could be utilized, just like how many domain type true treasures could gather power to restrain and attack enemies. Nine Tiger River was one such example. So was the top-tier domain type true treasure Blade River Luo, which converged its power to form a blade that was comparable to a pinnacle true treasure weapon.

Flame Sand Cup was not good in this aspect, but it was, nonetheless, a top-tier domain type true treasure. Thus, when its power converged, it could still form a top-quality weapon with the power of a top-tier true treasure.

“Break!”

Luo Feng started manipulating the flaming golden blade that was 100 million kilometers long while executing his ultimate technique Golden Light. He manipulated this gigantic blade with his godly power, which was controlled by his powerful willpower and consciousness. After over 1,000 years of honing and sharpening within the space of the wings, Luo Feng’s willpower was now much stronger than when he’d first entered Universe Ocean.

Hua!

Quick like lightning, a beautiful, golden blade-ray was formed with full empowerment of Golden Kingdom. It was certainly comparable to a strike from a top-tier universe master. The gigantic blade-ray hacked into the middle of the sea of countless ice-blades where a violent shock caused the blades in the middle to shatter. Many ice-blades within the region of the explosion collided into one another and shattered into even smaller fragments. Thereafter, they were tossed in random directions. At the core of this entire ice-blade storm, a large cavity of about 10 million kilometers appeared.

Sou!

Luo Feng went through this hole, and in a flash, he had made it through the region of the explosion.

“This is only the first region on my route,” Luo Feng whispered, “and it stretches over a span of 2,100 light years. The only trouble was the ice-blades. The nearer I get to the core, the more ice-blades there are. Every ice-blade was comparable to a full-force strike by an ordinary universe master. If I were to be surrounded and attacked by a large number of ice-blades, I would definitely be in danger of sustaining heavy injuries. And yet, this was not even considered to be a dangerous land.”

There were 892 extremely dangerous lands on his route. Based on a simple categorization of normal, dangerous, and extremely dangerous, he had just entered a region considered to be normal. Firstly, its natural power was not intimidating enough; secondly, Luo Feng could probe into this territory to understand the situation within and could teleport away to avoid any possible danger.

After flying about for three days for a brief experience, Luo Feng started to advance with high efficiency. ,,.

Where he could teleport, he would; if there was a need to use his blazing flame blade over an extremely long distance to create a path for advancing, he would. Even when he needed Star Tower to overcome a problematic situation, he would.

His journey was fraught with danger! Within Luo Feng’s world ring, his Golden Horned Beast body was constantly standing guard within Star Tower. Even if Luo Feng were to suddenly meet with danger and original earthling body was instantly annihilated, at least Golden Horned Beast hiding within Star Tower would be able to pull through the dangerous situation and thus be able to reclaim Luo Feng’s true treasures like his Shi Wu Wings.

In the blink of an eye, 21 years had passed.

Throughout those 21 years, Luo Feng considered himself to have experienced how terrifying the internal domain could truly be. Comparing it with some of the extremely terrifying and dangerous regions, the ice-blades region at the entrance to the internal domain was like a vacation zone. The various dangerous lands thereafter were inescapable. Techniques such as Golden Kingdom and Blazing Flames Blade proved useless when he tried to use them to save himself. He was forced to use Star Tower—which he did—in more than a couple dozen occasions to defend himself against the terrifying dangers.

Wandering about the internal domain, having a palace true treasure was a must, Luo Feng thought. Even to the extent of a top-tier palace type true treasure.

When it came to top-tier palace type true treasures, even universe supreme masters would not be able to cause damage to them. Palace type true treasures of this level were sturdy enough to tide through many kinds of dangers.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Huge, jade green ropes could be seen flying out of that endless black ocean toward Luo Feng. This black ocean was a nightmarish area, but Luo Feng was extremely at ease. Relying on Golden Kingdom, he could accurately locate certain safe grounds and teleport instantly when needed. Within this black ocean, he had teleported repeatedly like flashes of lightning, occasionally depending on Golden Kingdom to suppress those huge ropes…

At the border of the black ocean was a vast, black, rocky land. The sky above this land was filled with molten lava. This suspended lava ocean often fell. At the same time, a large quantity of strange, huge, blazing rocks would rain from the lava ocean and crash onto the land beneath.

“The black ocean zone ahead is a breeze. But such relaxing days are hard to come by… The land beneath is the real trouble.”

Luo Feng stood at the edge of the vast black rocky land, then raised his head to look at the endless lava ocean suspended high up above. This region was named “God-Destroying Valley.” Along the route he had chosen, there were 892 extremely dangerous lands. Their danger levels rated near the top, and the danger level of this valley was enough to be ranked among the top three!

God-Destroying Valley was divided into two parts. The top consisted of the endless lava ocean, and the bottom consisted of the vast, black, rocky land. To break through, one had to proceed between the two. The entire journey was fraught with various dangers.

Whatever danger it was, did not really matter to Luo Feng, as he believed that Golden Kingdom, Blazing Flames Blade, and Star Tower combined could see him through any danger along the way. Yet, the scariest part of God-Destroying Valley was none other than… Molten Lava Devil God!

Molten Lava Devil God was a lofty figure tens of billions of kilometers in height. Its entire body was composed of sturdy rocks and limitless lava, and it had four gigantic arms. It had three eyes and a hideous fang sticking out of its mouth. Its level of intelligence was extremely low. It might even be considered to have no intelligence at all. But its power was incomparably terrifying…

Molten Lava Devil God merely used that massive body of his. He fought the battle with his fists and legs. But his punches and kicks were unbelievably marvelous. When he started to fight and attack, even universe supreme masters who possessed supreme true treasures would have to bow to his superiority and concede defeat! Its body suffered no damage. Up to that very day, no one had been able to injure Molten Lava Devil God.

Once engaged in battle, even a universe supreme master would barely escape from it, and universe masters and others exchanging blows with it were bound for annihilation! Information that Jie Fanzi and the human race had left behind provided introductions about God-Destroying Valley, of which, Jie Fanzi’s information was more detailed. Nonetheless, both had a common consensus—it didn’t matter who it was if Molten Lava Devil God got its hands on them!

If the other party was not a universe supreme master, it would be game over.

Even if I hide inside Star Tower, so long as Molten Lava Devil God has its grasp on me, no matter how Star Tower attempts to take flight, it will not be able to fly away, thought Luo Feng. Star Tower will fall into an eternal predicament… and history has provided evidence that even for great beings hiding in pinnacle palace true treasures, once caught, would soon be annihilated.

Luo Feng sighed inwardly.

How had Molten Lava Devil God been born? No one knew. Many great beings had even guessed that Molten Lava Devil God might be formed from the corpses of an early group of users of the Universe Boat. Was this why, no matter how many universe supreme masters attacked, it was not the least bit damaged? However, everything was purely speculative. The only concrete fact was that Molten Lava Devil God was practically witless but extremely powerful.

Fortunately, it was faithfully territorial, so it would never leave God-Destroying Valley.

Within God-Destroying Valley, there were a total of nine Molten Lava Devil Gods!

A Molten Lava Devil God is tens of billions of kilometers tall, Luo Feng thought, and its reflexes are extremely fast. The moment I fall within ten billion kilometers of it, Star Tower will no longer be able to escape. Even Huge Axe Creator has to hide from it. Nine Molten Lava Devil Gods… I hope I am lucky enough and can hide from them.

God-Destroying Valley occupied an area of tens of thousands of light years. There was a portion of it where space and time seemed to be completely frozen, without even a trace of ripple. There were very few regions that allowed teleportation, and there were many places that were unable to be probed by Golden Light.

“Advance.”

Luo Feng flapped his wings, giving rise to a hazy, golden light that spread its rays over a radius of 80 light years. Thereafter, he flew straight into God-Destroying Valley.

The burning temperature brought a slight frown to Luo Feng’s face. This was enough to annihilate a universe knight.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

From time to time, a large amount of lava would fall from a great height and come crashing to earth. Luo Feng had to be careful when dodging and avoiding the falling lava. It was a common occurrence, and the danger it posed was quite small. The most dangerous obstacles were the huge rocks within the lava ocean that were not melted. These huge rocks fell at high speeds, and the impact they produced when they landed onto solid earth was enough to crush a universe master to death. Yet the fortunate thing about these rocks was that they were, after all, lifeless objects, so avoiding them was possible.

“Break!”

Occupying an area of at least hundreds of millions of kilometers, the golden Blazing Flames Blade suddenly hacked into a falling, gigantic rock that was tens of thousands of kilometers wide, causing the huge rock to fly to one side.

Falling lava and also the occasional falling of large celestial rocks… Luo Feng had to be extremely careful as he advanced.

On the eleventh day after Luo Feng entered God-Destroying Valley, in a certain corner of a territory that he was unable to explore, a head popped out from one of the caves of the black, rocky land. It had sparse, messy, and fiery-red hair. A single roving eye looked at the rapidly advancing silver-winged figure in the air.

“Huh? Someone has the guts to break into God-Destroying Valley? Eh? isn’t that the new universe master from the human race of the primal universe—Silver Wings Horde Leader?”

The face on that head registered a slight frown as it muttered to itself. The human race had announced publicly that Luo Feng would be named “Milky Way Horde Leader,” but in Tilted Peak Sector, Luo Feng had earned his reputation by his silver wings. Thus, the other races had preferred to call him Silver Wings Horde Leader.

“Young fellow, you just became a universe master not too long ago. You have silver wings that can control time and space and are so full of yourself that you dare to try your hand at breaking through the internal region? Especially at God-Destroying Valley? Hehe! Seems like your silver wings will fall into my possession very soon.”

A fiery red figure that looked like a human child flew straight out of the cave in one swift movement.


Chapter 1185: Yin Tuo

It was the eleventh day after Luo Feng had entered God-Destroying Valley, and Luo Feng had become more careful. It was definitely the most dangerous place in Universe Boat, even without that Molten Lava Devil God. He couldn’t afford to be careless in the slightest in God-Destroying Valley.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

Lava sometimes dropped from the sky, which made God-Destroying Valley incredibly hot, and the space was twisted. Occasionally, huge rocks also fell from the sky.

“Huh?” Luo Feng frowned. His golden country detected a great being behind him. “Is… is he Yin Tuo from the first universe incarnation era?”

He immediately matched the aura and look of the great being with the database he had.

Yin Tuo: A great being from the Ancestral God School in the first incarnation era. He is a special life form that looks like a child. He is a special life form who wasn’t born in the universe era Luo Feng lives in. He is extremely powerful.

Also, he followed the path of golden beast god. He was proficient in close combat and spiritual force weapons, too. The spiritual force weapon he used was a pinnacle true treasure known as “Golden Sulphone Armor”! He was a top-tier universe master who could rival Ice Mountain Master and Void Gold Master. He was a special life form with a unique godly body, and it was almost impossible to kill him.

The Ancestral God School represented the origin law of the original universe. After one incarnation, the Ancestral God School from the first universe era escaped, and they couldn’t get back to the original universe. Without the help of the universe origin, the advantages the Ancestral God School had were gone. It became a loose alliance. However, Yin Tuo himself was a handful—worse than An Yong Master.

“It’s him?” Luo Feng frowned. “Even Void Gold Master is easier to deal with than him. It’s impossible to kill him.”

Yin Tuo tried to get the control over space and time, yet he was rejected by the dim golden light. Luo Feng’s control over space and time had already surpassed that of universe masters even before going to the wing space, not to mention now.

“Hahaha! Human!” a squeaky voice said. “How dare you come to God-Destroying Valley. This silver true treasure of yours is indeed special, and that golden domain is indeed powerful. I’ll spare your life if you give me those silver wings. Deal?”

Luo Feng sneered. “In your dreams, Yin Tuo!”

Hong!

Through his golden country, a huge rock dropped from the lava ocean behind him. The rock had a diameter of more than 300 million kilometers. It plummeted at a terrifically high speed. That rock could have killed most universe masters if it had a diameter of more than 100 million kilometers, and with Golden Country, the power of the rock surged. It flew toward Yin Tuo.

Hong! Long! Long!

The rock twisted the space, and it plummeted like a streak of light.

“Humph.”

Yin Tuo yelled, and golden fragments burst out of his body. Billions of golden fragments showed up in the sky and surrounded him as if the fragments were connected. Many law threads connected them immediately, and the golden fragments started to merge with each other.

Ka-cha! Chi! Hua!

A ferocious, single-horned golden lizard 100 thousand kilometers long appeared. It was a golden beast god. The single-horned lizard was forceful just like a beast god, and Yin Tuo was staying in the body of the lizard.

“How impressive the technique is!” Luo Feng couldn’t help exclaiming. It was just like a rebirth of a beast god. He couldn’t do that yet.

Hou!

The golden lizard roared, and it raced toward that rock. It didn’t dodge it; instead, it hit the rock like a freight train.

Peng!

The moment they collided, the golden lizard changed its shape, and its tail slashed the rock. The rock was derailed and kept plummeting. The power from the rock also burst outward when it hit the tail.

Hong!

The golden lizard changed its direction and flew toward Luo Feng.

“It borrowed the energy?” Luo Feng was shocked. “No wonder Yin Tuo is unkillable!”

“Human, you’ve angered me!” the golden lizard said.

“Haha! Then you’ll soon be infuriated,” said Luo Feng.

He looked back. The golden lizard lashed his tail and changed its direction easily. It dodged the lava, and it was fully utilizing the power of golden beast god. Luo Feng was thrilled, as it was like watching the rebirth of a beast god.

A joyful thought went across Luo Feng’s mind. I can’t believe I get to fight a beast god now.

Suddenly, a whirlpool was formed in the lava ocean in the distance.

“Lava whirlpool?”

Luo Feng felt intimidated, as lava whirlpools represented one of the most terrifying threats in God-Destroying Valley—one of the seven most terrifying threats under Molten Lava Devil God. The records in the human race were rare. However, Jie Fanzi had detailed records, including some of the circumstances when individuals had been trapped by lava whirlpools. Apparently, Jie Fanzi had adventured in on such whirlpool before.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

Horrendous wind was formed, and some of the giant rocks on the ground flew out and started to spin in the sky. They spun faster and faster.

“A lava whirlpool right in front of you!” a voice from the golden lizard said. “It’ll get larger and larger as time passes. It’ll definitely expand faster than you can run away. The space around us was already clotted, and there are no space ripples. Haha! You dare come here! I’ve adventured in this place for hundreds of eras, and it’s like my home. You dare fight me here? Haha…”

“Like your home?” said Luo Feng. “Do you think Molten Lava Devil God will show mercy to you?”

Luo Feng rendered that golden lizard speechless for a while.

“You won’t be able to talk later.”

The lava whirlpool kept spinning, and the whirlpool kept getting larger. It reached Luo Feng instantly.

Hong!

The wind was almighty. If someone was trapped in that wind, it would be like being hit by an elementary universe master every 0.01 seconds! Although attacks from an elementary universe master weren’t that strong, the frequency would be able to at least severely injure a universe masters who didn’t have good defending abilities.

Luo Feng was able to resist it, but it sharply slowed him down.

“Hahaha…” laughed the golden lizard. “I’ve been here for hundreds of eras. Human, you’re dead.”

The golden lizard moved in the wind and kept spinning. At the same time, his tail was lashing, making him move easily in the wind.

Hua!

The golden lizard flew to the surface of the rock.

Ka-cha! Ka-cha!

He extended his hoofs and stuck them into the rock. Then he infused his godly power into it… The rock flew toward Luo Feng. It flew in curves and was suppressed by Luo Feng’s Golden Country, but it was still much faster than Luo Feng.

Hong!

The celestial rock got quicker and quicker, and it was impossible to slow it down. It at dashed Luo Feng.

Luo Feng shook his wing and flew toward another rock. He landed on a rock with a diameter of 300 million kilometers.

“You know how to hide!”

The golden lizard controlled the rock. Luo Feng was on a slightly smaller rock.

Hong!

Hong!

It was billions of times stronger than Mars hitting Earth.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

Under that wind, and rocks hit each other, and they all broke down into a multitude of shards. Luo Feng still trembled.

Hua!

A giant golden hoof slashed toward Luo Feng.


Chapter 1186: Unearthed

Shattered rocks were scattered all over in random directions, distorting the surrounding space. That golden hoof drove through many scattered rocks to appear before Luo Feng in a flash.

“Get lost!” Luo Feng’s body made a slight movement.

Hua!

Dazzling silver blade-rays flashed instantly. The four silver wings on Luo Feng’s back expanded suddenly, and the edges of his wings became incredibly sharp… Right away, he executed his blade technique, “Golden Light,” striking hard against the scales of the golden hoof. He was going head-on and confronting the golden hoof with a toughness that matched its own!

Pa!

Silver blades collided with the scales! A loud crash resounded. The golden horned lizard only swayed a tiny bit to the side but was thrown into the air upon colliding with the flying rocks. It was forced to retreat, but it was the same case for Luo Feng, who also retreated due to the impact of collision.

The golden horned lizard roared before it charged towards Luo Feng again. “Good wings! They can be so powerful when used as a blade!”

Luo Feng merely gave an indifferent smile. What a joke.

Since the spirit of his Shi Wu Wings had been born, through the snippets of memories that it had, Luo Feng had gotten to know the true colors of his Shi Wu Wings. Although they had various functions, the most important function was that once used to fight, it was like a battle blade… The other five pairs of wings were only to support the back of the blade; the topmost pair of wings was the blade itself.

That damaged pair of white wings was the blade! Of course, one would be the edge of the blade while the other would be the hilt. But that was not to say that the other wings of Shi Wu were inferior. In terms of tenacity, Shi Wu Wings had an advantage. The pair of white wings was stronger due to its sharpness, but after going through a battle, while the other wings were unharmed, this pair of white wings was damaged.

This sharpness was why the white wings were so important. The edges of Shi Wu Wings were sharp, too, but they were nothing compared to the white wings. Upon transformation by the origin, then undergoing the penetration of the cutting-edge power of the white wings, the resulting power was intense. And if the pair of white wings were to strike a blow alone, the force would be even more intimidating.

Shi Wu Wings were not as powerful. Yet they were still a part of the original wing type true treasure and had absorbed energy from the origin to facilitate its self-restoration process. Therefore, they had also attained the level of a unique object. When used as a standalone blade during battles, it was comparable to a pinnacle true treasure blade!

Clang!

Luo Feng pulled out his blade from behind instantly.

“Yin Tuo, you think I am afraid of you? You are merely an undying fighter. Trampling on you is easy.”

Luo Feng held Absolute Guest Blade. In an instant, he had become a beam of light and was coursing through the countless, shattered rocks flying about haphazardly. Then, with both legs, he stomped hard onto a 10,000-kilometer shattered rock flying about randomly.

Sou!

And he charged directly toward the golden horned lizard.

“What arrogance!” said the golden horned lizard, flying into a fury. Lowering its head, it directed its horn at Luo Feng and charged toward him. Yet he was first greeted by a burning, endless flame…

Blazing Flames Ocean and Golden Kingdom had superimposed!

Hu!

The golden blade-ray lit up. A silver light shone!

Luo Feng’s Absolute Guest and the edge of his left wing executed the Golden Light technique simultaneously. Together with the double empowerment of Blazing Flames Ocean and Golden Kingdom, he rained attacks on the golden horned lizard’s hardy skull; wherever the hits landed, faint cracks of black spaces would appear. The golden horned lizard and Luo Feng were both tossed away by the shocking impact. Along the way, they might even be hit by the shattered rocks flying all over the place at 100 times the speed of light.

“You have to use time and space,” the golden horned lizard roared, “as well as the double empowerment of your domain true treasures before you can break even with me! Obviously, your godly body and techniques are still very weak. I don’t believe you cannot be killed here at God-Destroying Valley!”

“Humph!” Luo Feng took one look at the golden horned lizard. Having fought until then, he had yet to reveal his trump card. Under his control, Golden Kingdom had been consistent with its degree of power outburst within Universe Ocean since entering the region, yet he had never really propelled it to reveal its current limit, which was a truly high degree of power outburst.

Golden Kingdom and Blazing Flames Ocean put together were enough to suppress An Yong Master’s top-tier domain type true treasure. Under normal circumstances, maintaining it at such a level should suffice.

As for its limit, Golden Kingdom—once pushed to its limit—would reach the level of a unique object. Golden Kingdom alone, even if Luo Feng’s godly power was lacking, would still be comparable to a pinnacle domain type true treasure used by a universe master, and it was not just any other universe master of subpar ability like Sky Wolf Master but universe masters of absolute top-tier presences like Primal Chaos City Leader and Star River Master.

If I pushed Golden Kingdom to execute its maximum power, given how strong Shi Wu Wings are, news will spread further, and more great beings will covet it even more, Luo Feng thought. So long as there is no need to, I shall not use this trump card of mine.

Luo Feng was not afraid of revealing it. So what if he needed to do so? Who would be able to snatch it away from him? It was just that one Yin Tuo was not enough to force him to show his ace in the hole.

“Yin Tuo, with that little capability of yours… exchanging blows with you once is enough,” said Luo Feng. “I cannot be bothered wasting my time here with you.”

Luo Feng stood afar, suspended in midair. Then, with one focused look, a gigantic blazing blade of flames emerged from the endless Blazing Flames Ocean. The blazing blade wasted no time in executing its technique and charged toward the golden horned lizard. Luo Feng, on the other hand, turned around and flew away at high speed. Peng! Peng!

Blazing Flames Blade was comparable to a top-tier true treasure. Furthermore, it had the empowerment of Golden Kingdom, putting aside the fact that it was relatively weaker when it came to killing prowess, which was only the level of a third-grade universe master. Sou!

Luo Feng continued flying off at lightning speed. Behind him, the golden horned lizard was exchanging blows with the blazing flames blade, though it persevered in its relentless chase after him.

“You know you will never be able to catch up with me,” said Luo Feng. “Nor will you be able to do anything to me at all, yet you are still so persistent?”

Luo Feng’s brows furrowed as he gave a slight frown. Looking far ahead, the power of the lava whirlpool was terrifying. The black, rocky land was breaking apart, and many gigantic rocks were revolving at high speed in midair, looking as though they were dancing to a very fast rhythm.

Luo Feng looked on and laughed, “This old fellow! He wanted to bully me, as he thought that I did not know the true secret of the lava whirlpool. He wanted to see me falter there.”

No matter how many times the blazing flames blade struck, the golden horned lizard persevered, relentlessly giving chase.

“Yin Tuo, did you think that… I would not have known about the dangers of the middle region of that lava whirlpool—the Annihilation Whirlwind?” Luo Feng’s voice resonated in the surroundings of the golden horned lizard.

The golden horned lizard was taken aback and became motionless for some time.

How did he know? He—he… impossible! That Annihilation Whirlwind is invisible, and it was at the core of the lava whirlpool, so exploring it is impossible. Ordinary great beings would run and hide from this central region of the lava sea. They would not be so silly as to try breaking through the core. Such highly confidential information! Even the current reincarnation era of my Ancestral God School just learned of it.

Yin Tuo was truly shocked. Originally, I intended to execute my technique right at the moment he when he made a detour about the central core region; then I would stimulate the core of the Annihilation Whirlwind and let it spread its influence over him! Humph! My godly body is massive with a unique gift, and I was barely able to evade that Annihilation Whirlwind; a large portion of universe masters, once they have fallen into that Annihilation Whirlwind, would instantly be strangulated to annihilation. There was no escape at all. Yet he—

Since Luo Feng knew, naturally he would not fall for Yin Tuo’s ploy. Besides, Luo Feng controlled the domain; there was no chance for Yin Tuo to execute his technique to stimulate the Annihilation Whirlwind.

How did he know? This, this… Even among various figures of top powers from the second reincarnation era, very few know of it. And the top power figures from the primal universe do not really explore much of the three most dangerous lands. This classified information… How…?

Yin Tuo was in rage and fury.

It was common knowledge that although universe masters would fight against one another, it was hard to kill one another. However, within the three most dangerous lands, if one’s survival ability was stronger, and if he had more understanding about the lurking dangers, he could make use of the terrifying dangers to arrange the death of his opponent.

“Hahaha…”

Luo Feng was bowling over with laughter. Then he transformed into a streak of light and flew off into the distance.

At this juncture—

A large number of rocks from the middle region of the vast black rocky land, brought about by the lava whirlpool, had been shattered and scattered off in all directions. A deep blue planet ship previously concealed by the many black rocks was revealed. This deep blue planet ship was severely damaged. At that moment, with a fierce and forceful wind blowing, the ship gradually started to take off from the ground. It slowly began to emerge from the vast, rocky land.

“True treasure!” golden horned lizard cried, dashing over right away.

Even Luo Feng was slightly taken aback and quickly dashed over too. The three most dangerous lands were originally the birthplaces of many true treasures. Even Huge Axe Creator had been able to obtain a supreme true treasure when he was in the Tilted Peak Sector. For Luo Feng, however, although he had been in the Universe Boat for so many years, it was his first time seeing a true treasure. Although it is a damaged true treasure, its aura is still very powerful, thought Luo Feng. The harsh environment of God-Destroying Valley is filled with a variety of dangerous conditions. True treasures that are less powerful have already been shattered; as for this damaged true treasure, judging by its aura, it has to be a top-tier palace type true treasure.

Luo Feng made a speedy judgement. It doesn’t matter if there are slight damages. Sitting Mountain Guest Teacher would be able to restore the damaged parts easily. Even if I allowed it to be swallowed by the white wings to help it in their self-restoration in the future, that would be good, too.

An ordinary true treasure and senior true treasure would never be able to exist within the environment of God-Destroying Valley.
