Relying on the white pair of wings, he barely made it to the sixth tier, so he needed to execute Extermination to achieve an outburst of power at a sixth tier as the top level.

Chapter 1288: Practice

The human team had come up with many plans before the war regarding how powerful the humans were, relative to the united forces alliance. When they were fighting, the human team immediately realized how powerful the united forces alliance was, and the human team was at a disadvantage. The human race tried to keep showing their weakness so that the real body of Father God would come out.

The united forces alliance was terrified. Father God was also scared. They had been at an absolute advantage at first. As for Luo Feng, he was afraid that the universe masters of his own team wouldn’t be able to resist the attacks much longer, which was why they had enacted the backup plan so soon.

As for the united forces alliance, they knew that they would be totally crushed if they kept fighting!

Inside Star Tower, the 16 universe masters from the united forces alliance were separated. Two were from demon race, one was from the automaton race, and one was from the bug race. As for Luo Feng, Darkness Master, and Peng Gong Master, they temporarily forgot about the united forces alliance’s unwillingness to compromise and celebrated the victory.

Another plan was to drive a wedge between them!

Most universe masters in the united forces alliance were from other races. They didn’t hold absolute loyalty to the three races, and they certainly weren’t about to die for them. “How about the universe masters from the three races?” asked Primal Chaos City Leader?

After all, only when Luo Feng killed a universe master would Sitting Mountain Guest made him a true treasure.


Chapter 1289: Meeting

“Rest assured, Milky Way Horde Leader. Demon race territory, an ordinary planet Blood Tooth Star.

He was to Northern Territory Alliance what Primal Chaos City Leader was to the human race. He was just and respected by many lesser races, and he represented the alliance of special life forms and lesser races.

They represented the three major streams in the Northern Territory Alliance, so if they agreed, it meant 95 percent of the members in the Northern Territory Alliance agreed. This was how a loose alliance operated; the unity wasn’t as strong as that within the human race or the demon race…

Luo Feng gained a lot from Duan Dong River, and we can already see how much it contributes to the human race. Three times as strong? Everyone went quiet.

The seven supreme masters from the Divine Eye clan occupied a large territory in the first universe era. Three times stronger? 21 universe supreme masters? Three times the territory?

“That’s right.”

“They’re too powerful.”

Those lone universe supreme masters don’t need territories, either.”

“Territories are what bring us together. As for the lone universe supreme masters, The Space Beast Alliance, and the Ancestral God School, they don’t care about it. Some powerful ones have one or two universe masters, and all of them combined make up hundreds of universe masters. We need to get as many of them on our side as possible.”

Although Ancient God Eye was a real threat, a trump card worked best only when it was not exposed. Now that everyone knew about it, however, they were coming up with methods to minimize its harm.

“The billions of races are all weak. However, all of them combined represent a very large territory in total. If the humans expand their territory in the future, they’ll be annihilated as well. We can draw lots of idle races to our side.”

The six powers kept discussing with each other. They were trying everything to strengthen their power and weaken the humans’ power.


Chapter 1290: Turbulent Dark Flow

Light rays from the glowing Gemini Star far in the distance penetrated the clouds to shine upon Earth. This gave a beautiful orange hue to the layer of clouds.

The land beneath was occupied by many green-skinned life forms of the Yan Ya race. The Yan Ya race was composed of blood and flesh life-forms. They had the lower bodies of wild, four-hoofed beasts, but their upper bodies resembled humans, other than the fact that they had four arms instead of two. They were born to be lovers of peace, but the moment they got angry, they would become crazed warriors.

Peace! Tranquility! Happiness! These were the main tones of life on the planet occupied by the Yan Ya race.

In a little, elegant, wooden building, a Yan Ya lady kneeled on her four-hooved legs, looking around in a leisurely manner.

Hong!

A streak of light suddenly fell from the sky above and landed right before her. A burly figure took form. His entire body seemed to be made of metal, and he wore purple armor. With his icy eyes, he looked at the Yan Ya lady who was kneeling and said, “Yan Ya Master!”

The Yan Ya lady revealed a hint of a smile and replied, “Balance String of the automaton race. My friend, what brings you here? Such a rare sight.”

“The fate of your Yan Ya race is implicated, too. This involves the rise and fall of your Yan Ya race. You and I have pulled each other through life-and-death experiences in Universe Ocean before. How could I not notify you the moment I hear of this?” Balance String Master made himself at home.

“The fate of my race?” The Yan Ya lady looked at Balance String Master.

“My automaton race, the bug clan, and the demons have jointly formed a united force of the three races,” Balance String Master said. “We were involved in crossfire with the human camp. You must have heard about it.”

The Yan Ya lady smiled and said, “Of course, I have heard about it. The news spread extensively throughout the entire primal universe. For any universe master to not know anything about it would be a rare sight. Crossfire between the united force of the three races and the human camp, and ultimately, the three races were defeated… This was such shocking news that many other races were in disbelief when they caught wind of it. Come, try some of this green fruit wine that is brewed by my people.”

With a wave, a wine glass appeared and floated before the two of them. The wine glass had both height and depth. The wine it contained was faintly green and emanated a flurry of aromas. A dark gray, exquisitely sculptured flagon appeared on the ground beside them.

Balance String Master got hold of the wine glass and, in a solemn tone, said, “The humans have the inheritance of an ancient civilization. They just obtained it, but they are already so powerful. If we allow them more time… they will develop into a race that is more terrifying than the Divine Eye clan of the first reincarnation era. That’s for sure. If they can already defeat the united force of the three races, what will happen in the future? I’m afraid that even if the major groups of powers within the primal universe combine forces, they will still not be a match for the humans. Once the humans become that strong, how could they not try to expand? As you know, the human race is quite invasive.”

The Yan Ya lady gave small nods. True. In fact, all six pinnacle races —the bug clan, the demons, the automaton race, the human race, the prison clan, and the crystal clan—were extremely invasive and aggressive! The laws of reproduction for these races were related to their strength and the amount of territory they could possess. The stronger a race, the more territory it could occupy.

“In the primal universe, who occupies the greatest territory?” Balance String Master continued. “Not any of us, the various pinnacle races, but you: the billions of scattered races. Individually, you are all weak, and your lands are small, but when everything is totaled up, you all own a vast chunk of territory. If the humans truly become powerful and invincible, do you think they will let you all off? This war is not only a battle for the inheritance of an ancient civilization; it is also a battle of survival for you and us, the countless other races!”

The Yan Ya lady stared at Balance String Master. “The humans have their original universe. No matter what, there is no way we can exterminate them all.”

“Yes, we are unable to exterminate them,” Balance String Master said. “A race with universe supreme masters is blessed with a fate freed from extermination, but… even if we cannot exterminate them all, we can still suppress them. We can hold their universe masters captive as though they are our reward. Or, even if we are unable to capture them, we can at least take over their territories and force them to retreat into that original universe of theirs.

“Hiding in a small universe and being suppressed by the major groups of powers in the primal universe… The other major powers in the Universe Ocean will be coveting the same thing. They will also be threatening the humans to hand over the inheritance! In this way, the human race will not be able to advance a single step. The moment humans appear in the primal universe, or within Universe Ocean, they will be besieged and captured! Even if there are a few more supreme masters added, what good does it do for the various top powers? If they are trapped in one place without being able to breed more people and talents, then the human race will be destined to wield limited power… They will no longer be a threat to us!”

Balance String Master looked at Yan Ya Master. “This is why some of us—races who own territory—must fight the humans in this war or make them hand over the inheritance or even suppress them so they cannot execute their power! As for the supreme masters who travel alone, in the future, even if the humans get more powerful, there is nothing for them to fear. But this might mean that in the future, they may have no chance to threaten the humans into handing over the inheritance, which is why, if they want to transcend reincarnation, they need to grab hold of this opportunity!”

“In short,” Balance String Master said solemnly, “be it supreme masters who travel alone or the various races like us who have territories, everyone will be laying siege on the humans. Our automaton race, the bug clan, the demons, the prison clan, the crystal clan, and the Northern Territory Alliance—even the various scattered groups of powers—have all started to join alliances. I believe, if you probe around, you will learn more. If you do not join anyone, you will be ostracized! This time around, if you join a camp, then surely, it will form a highly beneficial interest… You should know. You should know what to do.”

Yan Ya Master frowned and said, “Actually, the human race has already sent an envoy to speak with me.”

“An envoy from the human race?” Balance String King was shocked. So fast!

“They said, so long as we do not get involved, they promise never to invade our lands,” Yan Ya Master said.

Actually, she had refrained from saying something: If the Yan Ya race joined the human camp, the humans would share information on the experiences of the ancient civilization about how universe masters could cultivate to become universe supreme masters.

“And you believe them?” Balance String Master snorted. “This time around, the war has swept across the whole primal universe. You are my friend, so I shall tell you outright. If you do not take any side at all… when this war is over, your race will come to a most tragic end. And unquestionably, the united force camp consisting of major groups of powers is bound for victory.” Balance String Master held the wine glass in his hand. “To join the victorious party or the losing one—the decision lies with you, Yan Ya Master.”

Then he tilted his head backward and downed the glass of green fruit wine.

Gurgle. Gurgle.

Hong!

Balance String Master immediately transformed into a streak of light and disappeared in the clouds high in the sky.

Yan Ya Master was a very influential universe master within the Three Mountains Alliance, which was a secondary group of power. That was why Balance String Master was specially sent over to Yan Ya race to persuade her. If he succeeded in persuading Yan Ya Master, then the possibility of influencing the entire Three Mountains Alliance was much higher.

Even if great beings from the numerous races within Three Mountains Alliance, as well as myself, join the united force, we would just be like icing on the cake. Even if they managed to get some little part of that inheritance from the humans, after much difficulty, with those pinnacle races and supreme masters in the picture, would the united force give all that inheritance to them, the inconspicuous groups?

“If we were to join the human camp, we would get some guidance. That is for sure. By that time, we must combine forces—that is, the many scattered races within the human camp must form an alliance to deal with the attacks… This situation would be equally terrible.”

The universe masters were no fools. All of them were aware of the advantages and disadvantages of joining either of the two camps. The united forces camp was almost a sure-fire win! But there were no benefits to reap, and they had to risk their lives for them. After all, there were already quite a few universe masters being annihilated.

The human camp represented almost certain death! But there were also the benefits of gaining the guidance of an ancient civilization. The problem was, after the war, there would be troublesome repercussions.

How should they choose?

When the united forces camp was persuading the various scattered races, supreme masters who traveled alone, the Ancestral God School, and the Space Beast Alliance within the primal universe… the human camp was doing likewise, brainstorming ways to rope in other groups of races and forces. The human camp also promised never to invade any other territory that did not belong to them.

This condition, as reasoned by the united forces camp, was meant to exercise some restraint over the humans just in case the expansion of the human race, and them gaining more power, caused them to infringe on the territories and domains of other races.

The two camps were thinking of all sorts of ways and methods. However, the decision of the countless great beings of these scattered races would implicate the fate of their entire race. How could they not think it through carefully?

This was why, regardless of choosing the human camp or the united forces camp, there was not much to gain initially. Obviously, those scattered races had already started to interact and discuss among themselves just how should they address the question of joining the two great camps. There was even a new viewpoint being voiced: they would not join either of the two camps!

In short, everything was in a mess! Be it underhanded or aboveboard, the two camps were deploying all sorts of methods—for instance, buying over a universe master with a multitude of benefits and thereafter making use of that universe master to lead its group to one’s own camp. In short, no one had the intention to scrimp on the various methods they could come up with. They were desperately roping in powers to their side!

If one side gained ten universe masters, it would mean the opponent would have ten less. To and from. Every exchange would be equivalent to the combat power of 20 universe masters put together. In such a situation, how could they not give it their all?

Amidst the endless, deserted starfield, no life form could possibly proliferate. Yet this starfield was where Sitting Mountain Guest laid his territorial rights.

“Teacher, Teacher.”

Seems like you have a favor to ask of me.” Sitting Mountain Guest was holding a crystal stone as he made his way down step by step along the stairs. “You never come to visit unless you need something from me.”

You can meet up with him and discuss matters. Whether the negotiations go through or not, do not worry about me. In this so-called battle of camps and such, I have no intentions of getting involved at all.”

“Old Beast God?” Luo Feng was shocked.


Chapter 1291: Ancestral God

Sitting Mountain Guest had left and started making another Ancient God Eye.

Old beast god… Luo Feng sat in a quiet palace with his legs crossed, thinking. I can’t believe he came to find me first before we went to ask him.

There were three types of powers the humans needed. The first type was the universe masters from lots of idle races. Individually, they were all weak, yet combining them all made them the most important power!

The second type consisted of powers like the Ancestral God School and the Space Beast Alliance, who weren’t demanding on territories.

The last type were those lone universe supreme masters!

Humans were willing to pay a price to draw idle universe masters to their side! After all, it was not going to affect humans’ future plans! However, for universe supreme masters, the Ancestral God School, and the Space Beast Alliance, it would be tricky. The humans knew exactly what they wanted: incarnation transcendence.

For one thing, the humans couldn’t guarantee they would be able to transcend incarnation, as the advanced information was covered by the original mind. For another, those lone universe supreme masters would ask for experience in becoming limit universe supreme masters even if they couldn’t get the methods to transcend incarnations. And this experience would be the key to training pinnacle powers in the human race—which was Teacher Origin’s level.

If some beings from the other races and lone universe supreme masters became as powerful as Teacher Origin, the humans wouldn’t have an advantage over pinnacle powers; then the humans wouldn’t become the first power in Universe Ocean.

The humans were waiting—waiting to see how many universe masters they could draw to their side! And they were also waiting to see how many of their enemies they could draw and who would stay neutral!

If the humans were able to resist the alliance, they wouldn’t need the Space Beast Alliance! After all, the humans needed to consider the future.

That day, the old beast god arrived around three hours after Luo Feng arrived.

“Luo Feng!” His voice echoed in the palace.

Sou!

Luo Feng flew out. He looked at the giant being in space. It had a giant dragon’s head bearing nine horns. The horns were in the shape of crowns, and his long body wielded enormous claws mounted on nine toes.

It’s the real body, Luo Feng thought. Apparently, Space Beast Ancestor is sincere.

Luo Feng’s heart skipped a beat. It was exactly what he had expected. Actually, different powers had different requirements based on their roles. Those weak powers didn’t even dare to think about transcending incarnations. Space Beast Ancestor gazed at Luo Feng.

Luo Feng went silent.

Did he have a choice?

Actually, the lone universe supreme masters, the Space Beast Alliance, and the Ancestral God School couldn’t have cared less about humans’ power, as they didn’t care about territories at all! As for another power thriving in Universe Ocean and a power stronger than the holy land? They didn’t care about that either. Space Beast Ancestor gazed at Luo Feng.

The three ancestral gods were universe masters?

Chapter 1292: Urgent

If we can draw enough of them to our side, we don’t need to worry about those lone universe supreme masters anymore.”

From undying fighters to universe supreme masters, the systematic way from the ancient civilization cultivated pillars of power—like lots of universe masters and universe supreme masters. As for pinnacle powers, they were those like Teacher Origin.

“Nobody in Universe Ocean is as powerful as Teacher Origin,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “If one or two humans become as powerful as Teacher Origin in the future and we have enough pillar powers, we’ll become invincible.”

“Yes.” Luo Feng nodded.

Everyone wished that their races would become stronger! Nobody wanted to share the secret to pinnacle powers with other powers. If their powers became stronger, like lone universe supreme masters, they would roam Universe Ocean without caring about humans.

They might be in conflict with humans, and if they were fighting, even if the humans were relatively stronger, they wouldn’t win, as the lone universe supreme masters didn’t have anything to care about. They were as powerful as Teacher Origin as well.

“Wait! Wait until everything becomes clearer.” Primal Chaos City Leader sounded excited.

After three days, Luo Feng took another Ancient God Eye from Sitting Mountain Guest and went back to the human territory. He tried to persuade some lesser powers to join them.

“As you see, none of the universe masters who joined us died!” Luo Feng said, trying to convince a gigantic rock being. “Perhaps we don’t have a great chance to win, and I won’t brag about our power, but they don’t have that much of a chance to win either. However, I can guarantee that you’ll be safe. We have Boat of Mausoleum, Black Prison Tower, and Star Tower. If you join us, your safety will be absolutely guaranteed!

“You’re afraid that you’ll be attacked? Don’t worry about that! We have many universe masters on our side, and if any race dares to take vengeance on you, we’ll annihilate that race with Star Tower and Boat of Mausoleum.”

“You’ll definitely win if you join the alliance! As you can see, there are six powers already in our alliance, and the unity is strong. These six powers alone have already had around 300 universe masters! And some idle races have joined as well, so we’ll have many more universe masters. Besides, we have more universe supreme masters and supreme true treasures as well.

“What? Mind-shock valuables? That’s a joke! I have to admit that such a valuable is indeed impressive, but look at how many universe masters we have! The six powers alone have 300 universe masters already. If we divide them into teams of 50, there’ll be six teams! No matter how powerful those valuables are, it can only attack one team! After all, the mind-shock valuable depends on distance, and the farther we are from the valuable, the weaker its power will be. You know the black-striped stone pillar and how it works.

“All we need to do is to be farther away from those humans—about ten million kilometers away from them. Which means that mind-shock valuable won’t affect us much during the war. Besides, if we divide the universe masters into small teams, the effect will be smaller!

“To summarize, our team is definitely winning! Besides, the feud between us and the humans will last a long time. If they don’t give us the inheritance, we’ll suppress them forever so that they’ll never prosper, and those who seek the humans will regret it.”

Both sides were trying to recruit more members.

The humans were relatively weak, yet the united forces alliance was stronger. (After all, the Northern Territory Alliance alone had around 100 universe masters already).

Days passed. All the powers in the original universe were observing the situation, and the powers in Universe Ocean were doing the same thing as well.

“Damn it!”

“We can only stay in Universe Ocean! Damn it! If we can enter the original universe, we can force the humans to give us the experience on incarnation transcendence.”

“Why can’t we join?”

The powers in Universe Ocean were all anxious, but they felt helpless as well. Both the first universe era and the second universe era were much more powerful than the original universe era! Several pinnacle races from these two universe eras were powerful enough to crush all the powers in the original universe. However, they couldn’t enter the original universe.

Luo Feng took out a token.

“Milky Way Horde Leader!”

“The memory stone you gave me last time is indeed useless! If you give me one more, and that memory stone is indeed useful, I’ll give you eight supreme true treasures for the third memory stone. What do you think? Unless you’re trying to deceive me, you should give me the second memory stone.”

“Eastern Emperor Ancestor, if you want to get the second memory stone, give me four supreme true treasures.”

In the current conversation, Luo Feng was still being tough!

Apparently, Eastern Emperor Holy Land knew what was happening in the original universe. After the trade last time, the ancestor assumed Luo Feng wasn’t deliberately trying to deceive him because Luo Feng couldn’t read the more advanced information, which was why he still wanted the second one.

However, the ancestors didn’t want to give up any more supreme true treasures. He understood that the humans were in a difficult situation, so he went to Luo Feng directly!

“I still insist. If you’re not giving me supreme true treasures, then there’s no deal.”

It was not that Luo Feng didn’t want to do it. Instead, he understood that the first memory stone he had given to Eastern Emperor Ancestor was already the best option. Even though he couldn’t read the information, he knew how precious those memory stones were and what type of experiences the stones contained. If the first one was useless, then the following two would only be worse.

That was why Luo Feng couldn’t give him the memory stones. And besides, Luo Feng was the only one who had the memory stones, so he had a monopoly over them. Eastern Emperor Ancestor couldn’t do anything about it.

With time going by, the war was drawing near as well. The whole original universe was under terrific pressure. And the powers in Universe Ocean were also concerned about the situation, as they wanted to join the fight. Unfortunately, they couldn’t.

Suddenly, Luo Feng heard the voice of Primal Chaos City Leader. “Luo Feng, Luo Feng, come!”

“Huh?” Luo Feng sensed that something was wrong.

Sou!

He teleported to the main palace where Primal Chaos City Leader was, and all the universe masters showed up one by one.


Chapter 1293: The Great Change

Luo Feng teleported himself to appear within the hall and looked around him, where various figures were appearing successively after teleportation. A short moment later—including Primal Chaos City Leader, who was standing high above—a total of 19 universe masters appeared. All the human universe masters were present. Not even one was absent.

Luo Feng was in awe. There were a few universe masters who had remained in the original universe. But now, the “avatars sustained by godly powers” of these few universe masters had all rushed over.

“What is going on? Teacher has actually summoned all the universe masters of the human race.” Luo Feng was feeling the pressure. Even when they were out battling against the united force of the three races, this was something that had never happened before—all the human universe masters gathering together in one place.

At that time, within the hall, everyone wore heavy expressions. Silence. None of the universe masters spoke.

An invisible pressure caused every single universe master to feel heavy-hearted as they looked toward Primal Chaos City Leader.

“Everyone!” Primal Chaos City Leader said. He walked down the stairs, looked around at the numerous universe masters, and slowly said, “The situation has undergone a great change.”

“What change?” Long Yan Master could not help asking.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, what has happened?”

“What is the exact situation now?”

“Teacher!”

One by one, the universe masters spoke up. Even Luo Feng was asking persistently. This scene apparently had all the universe masters on pins and needles.

Primal Chaos City Leader said solemnly, “I just received news that a large number of scattered races…”

Luo Feng and the rest suddenly felt knots in their stomachs. The universe masters of the scattered races were the key to the final battle this time around! The human camp and the united force camp… Who could obtain enough support? The winner would be in a more advantageous position. Judging by the situation, could it be that most of the scattered races were turning to the united force camp?

“A total of 282 powerful races, close to 10,000 ordinary races, and a tremendous number of weak races…” Primal Chaos City Leader said in a solemn tone. “They must be forming an alliance secretly!”

“What!”

“An alliance?”

“The scattered races are forming an alliance?”

Suddenly, the hall was in an uproar. Luo Feng and everyone else was shocked.

Those billions of scattered races—the so-called “ordinary races” and “weak races”—all lacked strength. Like the golden horned race that was living in the human territory in great numbers, none of these races had a single universe master. This was why they lived precariously within the universe. Most lived as vassal races, relying on the stronger races or even relying on pinnacle races for survival. So even though it was said to have a total of billions of races, the actual total was mainly composed of the alliances of the 282 powerful races!

“How did it turn out to be like this?”

“How can such a thing happen?”

“The scattered races. These—these scattered races! How dare they form an alliance? They think they can actually combine forces?”

At that moment, there was chaos in the hall. Everyone was shocked and flustered.

This was earth-shattering news for them all! Previously, there were nine top powers in the primal universe. Every top power, like the Hong Alliance and the Bug Clan Alliance, had a total of around 40 universe masters. The Northern Territory Alliance had the greatest number of universe masters, but it was, at most, around 100, and they were dispersed all over! This was why it was always considered relatively quiet in the primal universe.

A combination of the various scattered races was difficult to fathom. Their territories were scattered in all corners of the primal universe, and some bore extreme hatred for one another. Combining forces?

The human camp and the united forces camp had never considered this before! After all, within such an extremely short period of time, for countless scattered races to combine forces… That would be something very difficult to achieve.

“282 powerful races. Just… just how many universe masters would there be?” Ice Mountain Master could not help asking.

“How is that even possible?” Luo Feng was also in disbelief.

Forming an alliance was easier said than done. It implicated many races, as well as their grudges, benefits, interests, and conflicts. Who had higher status? Who was lower? Who would be the leader?

Primal Chaos City Leader said in a solemn tone, “This has already happened, and it will be made public soon. Previously, the scattered races were not under such great pressure, but now, under the influence of the two camps forcing them to choose sides… Naturally, some of these universe masters do not wish to take particular sides but were worried that if they choose to stand alone, they would be too weak. That is why races start to rope in universe masters to form cliques.

“Although these signs appeared earlier, I didn’t take them seriously. Who would have thought that within such a short time, an entire alliance could take shape? And… the alliance master of this alliance is none other than Shi Hua Island Leader!”

The moment this was said, everyone within the hall was shocked into a daze.

Shi Hua Island Leader?

Shi Hua Island Leader was one of the supreme masters who traveled alone and had always been so mysterious. Out of all the supreme masters, Shi Hua Island Leader, Sitting Mountain Guest, and Northern Territory Alliance Master were known as the three most mysterious ones. And the human camp and united forces camp have seen a number of universe masters leaving us to join that super alliance.”

“Leaving the camps?” Luo Feng and the other universe masters’ expressions became more twisted.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, how many universe masters have left the human camp?” Deserted Mirror Master quickly asked.

With a nod, Primal Chaos City Leader replied, “As you all know, the vassal races that turned to us were, after all, reliant on us! During a war, we can reasonably detain a number of these universe masters as hostages in our original universe. But when the war ended with the united force of the three races, we certainly had no reason to not allow them back into the primal universe.

“Previously… they were faced with two tough choices, but after many struggles, they finally decided to turn to us. But when this alliance was secretly being built up, it also got in touch with the universe masters who turned to us and the united force camp, respectively. Just a little persuasion was enough to get these universe masters to turn their backs on us.

“Some time ago, the total number of universe masters in our human camp had risen to over 180. But now, including myself, we only have 162, and there are still universe masters coming forward to bid farewell.” Primal Chaos City added with a sigh, “When they choose to leave, how is the human camp able to stop them?”

Dead silence.

Luo Feng and the other universe masters were all devastated.

Earlier on, when the scattered races chose to support the human camp, they were merely turning to the humans as the humans had given them certain promises. But it was not possible for them to sell themselves to the humans forever! These scattered races had already fought a battle for the humans, and without even asking for any benefits, they left. Even if they were not allowed to leave, they would fly out from the ‘original universe’ and into the Universe Ocean.

Now it seems like the humans wanted to kill them all. If the humans really dared to do so, this would blow up into an even greater furor.

There was only silence within the hall. Not one of the 19 universe masters spoke a word. Everyone was at a loss for words.

Finally, it was once again Primal Chaos City Leader who got the ball rolling.

“Within the past few days, major groups of powers from Universe Ocean have gotten in touch with us.” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “They were all asking for the guidance from the ancient civilization to learn about how they could cultivate to transcend reincarnation. Among them, many knew about the influence of the willpower of the origin of the primal universe. So they are requesting the cultivation experiences to learn about how they could cultivate to reach the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master. And they are all willing to trade these experiences with supreme true treasures.”

The various top groups within the Universe Ocean were all very powerful. Like the Divine Eye Clan, the Skeleton Clan, and many others—all of them had several universe supreme masters. For them to take out a supreme true treasure to trade for the cultivation experiences on how to cultivate to reach the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master, they would be most willing to oblige! After all, when confronted with doomsday, who would still be unwilling to give up their true treasures?

“Those loathsome powers of Universe Ocean just have to choose this most critical moment to negotiate with us,” Void Gold Master said coldly. “They know that we are in a difficult situation now.”

“This is precisely why they are here to tempt us, because we are in such a predicament,” Darkness Master said in a low voice.

“Not only them…” Luo Feng started to say. “Not too long ago, that East Emperor Holy Land contacted me again.”

“East Emperor Holy Land?”

Suddenly, everyone looked at Luo Feng.

The humans were unwilling to strike deals with other groups of powers because giving out part of their inheritance to these other groups of powers, they would most probably be shaping a powerful opponent for themselves in future! But East Emperor Holy Land was different. Because East Emperor Holy Land already had an existence that transcended reincarnation. He already had the experience of cultivating to the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master.

Even if the humans were to give snippets of a part of that experience, it would just be icing on the cake for them! And there was no influence or effect on the human race at all.

“East Emperor Ancestor is very sly and greedy.” Luo Feng sighed and shook his head. “It is not going to be easy trying to get another supreme true treasure from him.”

“He is just doing this because he knows that we humans are in a predicament now,” Remote Lord Master said through gritted teeth.

Every top power within the Universe Ocean was coveting after the same thing. It was just that they could not get themselves involved, so they could only wait for the critical opportunity at that right moment when the humans were stuck in a predicament. Then they would make use of the temptation of a supreme true treasure! After all, most of the top powers within the Universe Ocean mainly sought to form a coalition with the humans. The others like the united forces camp were completely off their lists.

As for loaning the united forces camp with a supreme true treasure? They were worried that would be the last time they set eyes on their treasures!

“We’ll wait!” Primal Chaos City Leader said in a low tone. “We can only wait.”

“Wait for the response when this super alliance is formed by all those scattered races put together! Before that, just a single race alone will certainly lack the clout to demand anything from us. “Now they have enough clout. Especially that Shi Hua Island Leader. So soundlessly he became an alliance master of a super alliance. For this mysterious Shi Hua Island Leader to make it this far, it will be impossible for him to want nothing more. What does he want? He must have a goal in mind.”

“So—this super alliance will make a move very soon,” Primal Chaos City Leader said with much solemness.

Luo Feng and the others all nodded with heavy hearts. Actually, everyone could guess that, with enough influence, their opponents would definitely have requirements of extremely high expectations! Must the humans really oblige? If they did not give what was requested, what if more than 400 universe masters joined the united forces camp instead? To the human race, this would be a great catastrophe!

Within the demons’ territory, Blood Tooth Star.

Bouts of intentions were falling upon this star, and the avatar of Black Lotus Master, who was from the Northern Territory Alliance, was here.

“Loathsome. How dare they, these weak little groups of powers— inferior groups of powers—how dare they combine forces! Forming such a super alliance and causing some universe masters who have originally turned to our united forces camp to detach themselves from our camp. They cannot be stopped, nor can they be persuaded!

“Shi Hua, Shi Hua, this fellow, Shi Hua… I should have realized that he had such extraordinary methods. I would never have expected him to be able to come up with such a super alliance. Coming up with such a super alliance is an extraordinary feat. My guess is, with Huge Axe’s annihilation, he may have foreseen the imminent situations, so he must have started planning this in the dark for quite some time.”

“Now, the initiative lies in the hands of this super alliance.”

“Let’s just wait and see.”

“Let’s wait to see what this super alliance is up to.”

The united force camp and the human camp were both caught off guard.

Half a month later, the super alliance was established, and formal news was publicly announced to the entire primal universe. This super alliance was named “Freedom Alliance,” and once established, it would become the leading power within the primal universe right away.


Chapter 1294: Left by Teacher Origin

The bug race, the demon race, and the automaton race… Although the six powers formed an alliance, it was a very loose alliance. It was, after all, divided into six powers.

However, the Freedom Alliance was different. This new superpower was consolidated, and it planned to be a superpower that would exist forever. It was kind of like the Northern Territory Alliance, but it was much larger! It planned to exist forever, so the unity inside the alliance was much stronger.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The golden waves were tumbling in the sky and sweeping across everything. The stars and planets were like grains of sand, but they were well protected.

There was an island in the golden waves. On the island, thrones were arranged to form the shape of a ring. Various life forms sat on the thrones—flesh and blood type, energy type, metal type, rock type, and plant type—and they were all powerful.

“Everyone!” A towering purple being sat on a purple throne, and his voice echoed through each inch of space and time around it. “From now on, the Freedom Alliance will rise in the original universe!”

“Freedom Alliance! For survival, for freedom!”

“All the races present are idle races, and even the most powerful one only has six universe masters. Most of the races here only have one universe master. If we join the humans, the united forces alliance might take revenge on us.”

“We’re also from a race.”

“We’re also a part of the original universe.”

“We can’t even be neutral and live our lives in peace and quiet!”

“Nobody wants to live like this!”

Shi Hua Island Leader looked around. The universe masters were all nodding. Apparently, they were in a dilemma.

“Even though I’m a universe supreme master, this is a fight between two large teams. One universe supreme master can’t change anything,” said Shi Hua Island Leader. “I’m not happy about that either. Why do we even fight in this universe? Because we want to get what we want and guard the most important things to us! To advance! To guard the things we love! And to fulfill that, we first need to be free! If we can’t even make our own choice, what are we even guarding? That is why we formed the Freedom Alliance!”

Shi Hua Island Leader’s eyes gleamed, and he went on saying, “Those universe masters who can’t come here sent their avatars. Our alliance has 298 races, and there are 433 universe masters! Once we’re united, neither the united forces alliance nor the human team can sway us! The humans have mind-shock valuables, and both teams have supreme true treasure palaces. But they can’t sway us!

“The mind shock valuable is already exposed, so everyone knows its weakness. As for palace type supreme true treasures? 20 universe masters combined are enough to resist the swallowing power from Black Prison Tower, Empress Tower, and Star Tower. Even if the humans get more powerful in the future, they have fewer than 20 universe masters. Even if they have 100 in the future—and even if they have 300 with the help of ancient inheritance—we have more than more than 4,000 universe masters! As time goes by, there will be more. We can defend ourselves against the humans even if they prosper in the future! As long as we stand together, nobody can sway us! Present or future! This is not a crisis for us! Instead, it’s an opportunity! An opportunity to become stronger!”

The voice of Shi Hua Island Leader resounded in the ears of every universe master and inflamed their desire. However, they had been too weak to fulfill them before. Now, as they looked around and saw the thrones and the shadows of more than 400 universe masters, they felt confident! It was an enormous power! And they would surely get more!

As time passed, some universe masters left the human race and the united forces alliance. After half a month, no universe masters tried to switch sides anymore. There were 298 races and 433 universe masters in the Freedom Alliance. It was a power that placed excessive pressure on the united forces alliance and the human team.

Blood Tooth Star, demon race territory.

The minds of the six universe supreme masters and the avatars of Star River Master, Black Lotus Master, and Liu Lan Star Master were all present.

“The alliance of our six powers—even if we count the universe masters who come to us, many universe masters are leaving our alliance these days, and we have fewer than 400 universe masters now! Even if we count the universe supreme masters, it might only match the Freedom Alliance.”

“Which is why our actual power will be weaker than the Freedom Alliance.”

“What should we do?”

“Agree with their terms?”

The top seniors looked at each other. The Freedom Alliance had indeed named their terms.

One: The inheritance from the ancient civilization would be shared equally, without a doubt. And two: Two supreme true treasures would be given to the Freedom Alliance. If the united forces alliance did so, the Freedom Alliance would join the united forces alliance immediately.

“Two supreme true treasures. How greedy! The war against the humans will not only benefit us but them as well, yet they want two supreme true treasures!”

Besides, the humans can give them the inheritance experience from the ancient civilization… Of course, they’re more willing to join the human team. They named their terms on purpose!”

“They must have given the humans the conditions, and now they’re waiting for a response as well.”

“A supreme true treasure… The Northern Territory Alliance, the prison race, and the crystal race don’t have supreme true treasures. As for the demon race, the bug race, and the automaton race, we have four in total. Yet we’re supposed to give them two? Are they serious?”

“Don’t worry.”

“The humans will give them an answer. If the humans say no, the negotiations will be much easier. We can negotiate the conditions!”

The human team was facing a tough decision as well.

“I need to talk about it with other human universe masters, and I’ll get back to you as soon as possible,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

“Then we’ll wait for your response, Primal Chaos City Leader.”

A phantom-like spring of water flew out of the primal secret region. After a while, the human universe masters gathered in the main palace.

“The representatives from the Freedom Alliance came here before,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Their terms are precisely what we expected: the experience of how to advance from universe masters to universe supreme masters and to limit universe supreme masters. “This is the first situation. As for the second situation, we need to give them the experience from universe masters to universe supreme masters for them, at least, to stay neutral. Otherwise, they’ll join the united forces alliance.”

Some universe masters cursed after hearing this.

“They’re so greedy.”

“So bold.”

All the human universe masters were upset. However, they couldn’t do anything about it, as the Freedom Alliance was making the choice!

“I won’t reply to them first,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Let’s wait and see if there’s a third way!”

The humans didn’t want to share the experience. After all, they needed to share at least some of the experience with the universe masters no matter how simple the inheritance was. They would only come to their aid if they thought the experience was useful. This was actually helping the Freedom Alliance to grow stronger than it already was.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked around the universe masters. “There’s no need to rush. It’s a crucial moment, and it’s time to share the final secret of the human race.”

“The final secret?”

Everyone became quiet. They were all shocked.

“Chaos, what secret do we have?”

“Brother!”

“Chaos!”

They were all in a daze. They were, after all, already the top beings within the human race.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at the human universe masters and said, “Teacher Origin roamed Universe Ocean and was invincible. After that, he went on to a difficult path. He knew it would be difficult, so he waited until Huge Axe became a universe supreme master to start it. Then he left us a valuable to guard the race. After that, he followed his chosen path, and eventually, he was suppressed by the mind of the original universe.”

Their eyes gleamed.

“I’ve been guarding the primal secret region, and this is our last defense,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Luo Feng, Darkness, Peng Gong… You are fighting the other races, and I’ve been standing guard here. If I don’t have anything, how am I supposed to guard it? It’s time for you to know exactly what it is I do have.” Primal Chaos City Leader turned around. “Follow me.”

Luo Feng and the others looked at each other, then followed Primal Chaos City Leader.


Chapter 1295: Guarding Valuable

Luo Feng and the other universe masters followed Primal Chaos City Leader and walked through the hallway. They could see Boat of Mausoleum floating in Thousand Treasures River in the space behind the palaces.

“Where are we going, brother?” asked Darkness Master. Even he didn’t know about the guarding valuable left by Teacher Origin.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked back and said, “Let’s get into Boat of Mausoleum. Even though this is the central area of Primal Secret Region, there are lots of universe masters from other races. I don’t want the information leaked. Let’s get into Boat of Mausoleum first so you all can see it.”

Luo Feng was curious.

After a while, they entered Boat of Mausoleum, which was 100 billion kilometers long, floating on Thousand Treasures River.

“Boat of Mausoleum is indeed exceptional.” Primal Chaos City Leader couldn’t help complimenting it. “Although it can’t make attacks itself, it can easily resist the attacks from universe supreme masters. Even supreme true treasures can’t do that. With this boat, the last universe portal of our race can be safe.”

Darkness Master, Peng Gong Master, Long Yan Master, and the others all nodded. Luo Feng smiled as well.

It was true. Teacher Origin was suppressed eternally, so the universe portals from the original universe to the primal universe would be fewer and fewer if they were broken, and they couldn’t be rebuilt. Even if there were Black Prison Tower and Star Tower, they would still be blasted away and couldn’t protect that universe portal. However, Boat of Mausoleum was much more stable.

Luo Feng was confident. “In Universe Ocean, even those level-seven and level-eight universe supreme masters can’t damage Boat of Mausoleum, not to mention those in the original universe.”

Boat of Mausoleum was 100 billion kilometers long. The universe portal was well protected in a huge room in the boat, making it absolutely safe.

In a palace of Boat of Mausoleum, the human universe masters all gathered.

Primal Chaos City Leader smiled. “I’ll show you here.”

Luo Feng and the universe masters were all looking forward to what Primal Chaos City Leader was about to show them. It was a guarding valuable left by Teacher, so it must have been exceptional.

“Look at it.” Primal Chaos City Leader glanced at all the universe masters and stretched out his palm.

They all stared at the palm of Primal Chaos City Leader. Suddenly, an object appeared in his palm, and the force of a true treasure permeated from it. Everyone looked bewildered.

“This—this is…” Luo Feng opened his eyes wide.

“Huh?” Peng Gong Master was confused.

“What is this?” Darkness Master was confused as well.

An object like a sculpture sat in the right palm of Primal Chaos City Leader. There was an artificial hill, a lake, and a wooden house! The hill, the water, and the house seemed to coexist in harmony, but it appeared to be just a piece of art; the force was ordinary although it had the force of a true treasure. It was, at most, a top-tier true treasure. If it was indeed a supreme true treasure, the force should be suppressing.

Luo Feng couldn’t help looking at Primal Chaos City Leader. “Teacher?”

The others looked at Primal Chaos City Leader, confused. “What is this, Chaos?”

“Is this the guarding valuable left by Teacher Origin?”

“No, this is definitely not a supreme true treasure! How can it guard the race?”

Primal Chaos City Leader glanced at Luo Feng and the universe masters with a smile, then said, “I need to infuse it with my godly power before you know the power of this valuable.”

Godly power burned in his palm, and it infused the valuable immediately. The valuable floated and became much larger. Then a mountain 10,000 kilometers tall showed up in the palace. On the mountainside was a wooden house 100 kilometers tall, and there was a lake with a diameter of 1,000 kilometers in front of the wooden house.

“Come,” said Primal Chaos City Leader, and he shrank his body to ten kilometers tall.

The others shrank their godly bodies as well. They followed Primal Chaos City Leader and walked along the lake to the wooden house. “Chaos, what about the power of this valuable?” Peng Gong Master asked.

“I haven’t triggered the engravings yet,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Of course, it can’t wield the power.”

He stood beside the lake, and suddenly, a being showed up. It was a barefoot body carrying a rugged stick.

“A body!”

Luo Feng was shocked.

“This is a complicated valuable,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Both me and this body of mine need to work together to have enough godly power to drive this valuable.”

The barefoot body walked to the mountain. It merged with the mountain as soon as it touched it.

Primal Chaos City Leader stepped out onto the lake and walked to the center of it.

Weng! Weng! Weng!

Mountains started to tremble under powerful ripples, and blurry engravings appeared, flashing across space. A green hue extended from the mountain to the sky, covering the sky above it.

Hong! Long! Long!

The lake and the ground trembled. The blurry engravings flowed and disappeared. The ground extended, forming a gray tract of land. The green sky and the gray land met at that wooden house.

Ang!

The wooden house started to gleam brightly! Light covered every inch of the sky and land, and the green sky and gray land kept intersecting with each other, exerting power, forming endless light. Beneath it, Luo Feng, Darkness Master, Long Yan Master, and the others were all amazed. They could feel an enormous source of power.

“So powerful!”

“My teacher devoted a lot to create this valuable.” Primal Chaos City Leader stood on the lake and recalled events from the past. “The mountains, the lands, the lakes, and the wooden houses are formed by 36,200 components. The materials are exquisite, yet the techniques are simple. Only after they’re combined can they be structured. Mountains, lakes, and wooden houses—these three elements form this sky and land. Teacher said before that this is the primal rule of universe operation. This valuable is called ‘palm universe.’ It’s a simplified version of a miniature universe. The palm universe can create two top-tier level-six attacks immediately in the area it controls. Plus, it covers an area of one square light year.”

Everyone was stupefied. This was more incredible than a domain type supreme true treasure! Ordinary domain supreme true treasures could attack within their domains, but universe masters couldn’t make attacks at top-tier level six when using them! After all, domain true treasures were used more often for suppression! Only universe supreme masters could use their techniques to make the true treasures reach top-tier level six, and only one at a time.

However, Primal Chaos City Leader could perform it twice as if two universe supreme masters were making attacks. And they could appear anywhere within the range.

“This is a simplified miniature universe,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Once someone is in this area, it’s like being in a miniature universe. I control it. I can attack the target with a single thought! I can even make universe supreme masters feel agonizing pain, and they can’t get away from this area in a short time. However, this ‘palm universe’ can only reach top-tier level six even in Universe Ocean, so it’s more useful in the original universe. Teacher Origin made it to guard our race, and with this valuable, even two or three universe supreme masters will suffer losses if they try to attack us. Teacher Origin could only create a top-tier true treasure, but when he combined all the true treasures, he had a valuable that was beyond imagination.”

Darkness Master, Long Yan Master, Huang Jian Master, and the universe masters were all dazed. He had made a valuable better than a domain supreme true treasure?

Of course, it was weaker than a domain supreme true treasure in Universe Ocean.

“Machine type!” Luo Feng was shocked. “This is machine type! The small components form three systems—like Shi Wu Wing! Shi Wu Wing is also made of lots of components. A pair of white wings, five pairs of other wings, and an origin! This palm universe is also made of different components, and the core is that wooden house.”

“It’s even more complicated than Shi Wu Wing!” Luo Feng exclaimed.

Of course, palm universe was still a low-tier machine type valuable. The civilization level of the origin was far superior to palm universe. However, in terms of structure, Shi Wu Wing was very simple, while palm universe was far more complicated. It needed both bodies of Primal Chaos City Leader to use it. However, it was still much simpler than Boat of Mausoleum and Universe Boat.

One thing was for certain: This was of machine type, which was why it had such an ordinary appearance but extraordinary power. It had power at top-tier level six.

“One is the sky, one is the land, and one is the heart of sky and land,” said Peng Gong Master slowly.

“Dark, Light, and the origin,” said Darkness Master.

All the universe masters looked at the simplified universe, as did Luo Feng. Although it was machine type, the technique contained in the palm universe had universe operation law, and it was much more advanced than his miniature universe.

“Time and space combined, and a universe is born…” Luo Feng looked at the sky and land—the green sky, the gray land, and the gleaming, golden light, all of which contained the universe operation law. He was mesmerized.

After hitting the limit universe knight level, he couldn’t make the breakthrough. However, inspiration now flooded his mind.

Luo Feng looked up, and he smiled.


Chapter 1296: The Breakthrough, A Universe Master!

The mountain range, lake, and wooden house were all suspended in the air.

With it as the center, everything within the vast space and spread around its surroundings fell within its area of control. This mountain, lake, and wooden house… The greatest area under the influence of its control was a diameter as wide as one light year! How vast this region was! And within this region, a single thought could execute the power of a sixth tier as the top level.

The various universe masters were all in awe.

“Impressive. Simply too, too impressive!”

“In the primal universe, it is even more powerful than a supreme true treasure. The only downside of it is that controlling it is a tad more complex. It requires both bodies of Primal Chaos City Leader to control it together.”

“A simplified miniature universe? How did Teacher Origin achieve that?”

“I cannot fathom it. I simply cannot fathom any of it! Indeed, that’s Teacher Origin for you. Only Teacher Origin can create a virtual universe, which has reached a stupefying level on the way the universe revolves. I suppose this must be the reason why he can create this unique treasure, ‘Palm Universe.’”

The part of time and space that was under the influence of this Palm Universe was completely isolated from the outside world. All the universe masters were shocked yet intoxicated by what they saw.

“Luo Feng.”

“Luo Feng?”

Suddenly, someone realized that there was something not quite right with Luo Feng. Earlier, he was still smiling; but later, he shut his eyes and his entire being started to exude a strange aura.

“Do not disturb Luo Feng!” Darkness Master immediately shouted to stop the others.

Within the human race, the majority were not aware that Luo Feng was merely a universe knight. But Darkness Master knew.

Could it be that he was going to achieve a breakthrough soon? Darkness Master wondered to himself.

Not only him—Primal Chaos City Leader, who was standing above a lake quite a distance away, also saw the seemingly unique state that Luo Feng was in. In his heart, he could not help looking forward with much eagerness.

This disciple of mine is going to have a breakthrough soon?

Luo Feng was already capable of creating secret techniques at a universe supreme master level, and his law comprehension had already reached the ultimate limit of its bottleneck, whereby he had comprehended heart of beast god long ago. He could be said to have met the various expectations, and his avatar was consistently cultivating in a cultivation space within the space of inheritance.

With a rate of 10,000 times of time velocity, he had been cultivating for many years.

What Luo Feng had accumulated was more than abundant. So even if he was slower, upon enduring a few more years in the outside world, he would be able to break through; that was for sure. If he was fast, the breakthrough could be anytime.

This breakthrough… It could occur at a time when he was getting emotional or feeling touched or just looking at the revolving, starlit sky or even in a life-or-death battle. In short, no one knew when it would happen because at any point in time, with a little touch of his gifted talent, he might be enlightened and thus be able to achieve the breakthrough.

Palm universe was a unique treasure. Luo Feng could not comprehend Shi Wu Wings and the Boat of Mausoleum because they were both too profound. However, Palm Universe was very close by. Since he could create a secret technique at a universe supreme master level—and what this Palm Universe contained was also at the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master—Luo Feng could, therefore, vaguely comprehend it. Just one touch of this Palm Universe, and the bottleneck that he was stuck at for so long seemed to disappear soundlessly. He had, thus, broken through this bottleneck.

Luo Feng suddenly opened his eyes. “Teacher.”

Primal Chaos City Leader looked over.

Teacher and disciple exchanged glances, and mutual understanding traversed the space between them. The look of excitement on Primal Chaos City Leader’s face was hard to conceal. This disciple of his was beyond formidable. Even though he had yet to achieve his breakthrough, he was already so powerful. Once he achieved his breakthrough… he would be a great help in the final battle that was drawing close.

“I will first make a trip out,” Luo Feng said.

“Go.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. At the same time, he stopped the execution of Palm Universe right away for Luo Feng to exit.

Shua!

With a single teleportation, Luo Feng disappeared wordlessly.

Luo Feng’s god country was so endlessly vast that it could be described as inexhaustible.

Hua!

The endless Remote Ocean was always filled with ripples, and even without any wind, it had waves that rose up to three feet high. This endless Remote Ocean stretched over a diameter of 80 billion kilometers. It was deep and vast, and its normal waves were so big that they were astounding. With this endless Remote Ocean, together with the additional support from his god country, even if other universe supreme masters were to barge their way in, they would be in for a great loss.

The god country that was originally peaceful underwent a change. Just as Luo Feng broke through the bottleneck while he was inside the Boat of Mausoleum—

Hong!

The origin laws of the primal universe fell right away. An endless oppressive force enveloped the entire god country. The endless Remote Ocean that was originally considerably peaceful was suddenly surging with mighty waves.

“Huh?”

Amidst the endless Remote Ocean, a figure suddenly emerged. This was Remote Ocean body. It was looking up into the sky where immeasurably huge, black and white whirlpools were appearing. These rotating whirlpools were enormous, and they carried with them an inexhaustible amount of power.

Upon discovering his breakthrough, Luo Feng destroyed his previous Remote Ocean body and bred a new one right away. It was the fastest method to get back to god country.

“Breakthrough!”

Luo Feng’s Remote Ocean body teleported out into the sky beyond the edge of the entire Remote Ocean in a flash.

“This tremendous momentum is so, so imposing.”

Luo Feng looked up into the sky to see that huge whirlpool which had a diameter greater than tens of billions of kilometers. This was different from the previous five-colored whirlpool that had appeared when he achieved his breakthrough to become a universe knight. This time, it was composed of alternating black and white ones. Within a large black whirlpool, there was a white one, and within this white one, there was another black one.

Black whirlpool, then white whirlpool. Black whirlpool, then white whirlpool. Round after round.

While exuding a formidable oppressive force, there was a passageway at the center of this huge whirlpool. It was the link between the universe law ocean and Luo Feng’s god country.

“The critical moment!”

Luo Feng suddenly understood what was happening. It was the most critical moment of his breakthrough—the swallowing of godly power!

The endless Remote Ocean was massive. To increase his godly power, he would need a long, long time! And the bigger his godly body, the stronger the ability to recover. Even if a universe master were to self-destruct suddenly, the speed at which his godly power was consumed during this instant self-destruction was nothing compared to the speed of auto-recovery of Remote Ocean! The greater the volume, the greater the power. As a result, the speed of recovery would be even more alarming.

This was why the endless Remote Ocean progressed at a very slow pace during its initial stage of growth. For its diameter to double from 10 billion kilometers to 20 billion kilometers, a long time was required. For the diameter to expand from 20 billion kilometers to 80 billion kilometers, it would be much faster. But when the latter was compared to the speed attainable in future expansions, it was still considered to be much slower. Further down the road, the speed would soar to a figure that was exponentially faster. That was how Nine Remoteness Master had been able to create that massive Nine Remoteness Ocean.

Luo Feng was about to become a universe master. His endless Remote Ocean was still far inferior to Nine Remoteness Ocean. Therefore, Luo Feng would cherish this opportunity even more.

“The time for swallowing godly power is limited,” Luo Feng said to himself. “The swallowing must occur at the most efficient rate possible.”

Hong! Long! Long!

From the alternating black and white circles that were intertwined at the center of the whirlpool—that whirlpool passageway with a diameter of few tens of billions of kilometers—was pouring out ocean water that was empowered by a formidable godly power. Torrential ocean waters surged out in a frenzied manner.

Hong! Long! Long!

Like an ocean collapsing, the water poured out at a speed so fast that it was simply terrifying. Compared to when Luo Feng achieved a breakthrough to become a universe knight, everything was much faster this time around.

“Inhale, suck, absorb!”

Luo Feng used his willpower to the best of his ability and tried hard to control his endless Remote Ocean. He was absorbing like crazy, and the transformation took place immediately.

His godly power that was originally 10,000 times the life genes of knight soared up 100 times to hit a godly level of 10,000 times life genes—a universe master level!

Swallow, then transform… The rate at which that whirlpool passageway was pouring out godly power empowered the ocean water totally in sync with the rate at which Luo Feng’s endless Remote Ocean absorbed it. The faster he absorbed, the faster the pouring of ocean water would be.

“Transform! Transform! Transform!” Luo Feng was doing his best to keep everything, and he also noticed that after his willpower got stronger, it brought him more benefits.

The powerful willpower also greatly increased the efficiency of the transformation happening under his control. But no matter how great the increase was… it was still not enough.

A moment later, peace and quiet resumed in the god country. The oppressive force of the primal universe origin laws was gone, and for a short moment, Luo Feng could swallow godly power to his heart’s content.

“My endless Remote Ocean has a diameter of 80 billion kilometers.” Luo Feng stood in the sky above the Remote Ocean. “Just a while ago, the godly power transformed reached around 15 percent of the size of my endless Remote Ocean!”

Luo Feng estimated that the entire Remote Ocean must have had an approximate diameter of 80 billion kilometers, of which, more than 40 billion kilometers along its whole diameter was successfully transformed. That was approximately 15 percent of its entirety. In terms of efficiency, this rate was considered high. After all, the endless Remote Ocean was massive.

“When I became a universe knight previously, the rate of transformation was 12 percent. This time around, the rate has increased a little. I was lucky that my willpower also reached a breakthrough point. If my willpower had not reached the level of a universe supreme master, I’m afraid the transformation of godly power this time around would have been far lesser.”

Luo Feng continued his descent.

Pu! Tong!

He sank down into the endless Remote Ocean, where his body naturally fell apart and blended into the Remote Ocean.

Soon, a new Remote Ocean body was formed within the endless Remote Ocean. This Remote Ocean body was a lofty figure that was close to 10,000 kilometers tall. Its godly power was 1,000 times that of a universe master life gene level, and it was also ten times higher than the godly power of Luo Feng himself when he was still at the universe knight level.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The entire endless Remote Ocean was still resonating with the faraway universe origin law ocean, absorbing its godly power and trying hard to transform the entire Remote Ocean. The only pity was that now, the speed had slowed down considerably compared to before.

Xiu! Xiu! Xiu!

Three light rays appeared at the same time within his god country and transformed into three streaks of light high up in the sky. They flew about freely. Bouts of godly power rapidly shot out from the Remote Ocean below to quickly envelop the three godly bodies within their influence. These three godly bodies were none other than the original earthling body, Golden Horned Beast body, and Mosha body.

In an instant, the three godly bodies started to transform. The original earthling body and Golden Horned Beast body’s godly powers soared to 100 times, reaching a godly power level of 10,000 times that of a universe master life gene. Mosha body’s godly power also soared by 100 times, reaching a godly power level of 100 times that of a universe master life gene.

“My Mosha body, in terms of godly power, is comparable to my previous original body.”

The original earthling body, Golden Horned Beast body, Mosha body, and Remote Ocean body were all full of fighting spirit. His original earthling body and Golden Horned Beast body, with their pinnacle true treasure in hand, could both display an outburst of combat power up to the sixth tier as the top level! Mosha body, with its Blood Ghost Blade, would also be able to display an outburst of combat power up to the sixth-tier. Remote Ocean body was equipped with even more methods.

“Now, I have to address two things.”

Four different bodies of Luo Feng flew to the core of his god country. At the public square before his godly palace, the four bodies found scattered spots to settle down, where Golden Horned Beast body lay sprawled on the ground.

“The first thing will be my Mosha body!” Luo Feng whispered. “After becoming a universe master, the bottleneck of 100 times life genes will no longer be imposed on my Mosha body, which means I can bring the increase to as high as 1,000 times life level—or even 10,000 times of life level. Regarding the materials required to increase the life genes, I have already prepared them all.”

His Mosha body was not a flesh and blood life form, so it could not cultivate the Nine Volume Manual. Just like any ordinary universe master, it had to reach the level of a universe master before its current 100 times life gene level could increase further.

“The second thing will be my god country. If I achieve a breakthrough to become a universe master, my god country will become even more complete.”

Luo Feng looked at his own vast god country.

At that moment, his god country was slowly transforming. The expansion of its area was secondary. More importantly, the structure was beginning to stabilize toward an ultimate limit. Once the perfect transformation was completed this time around, the next breakthrough would be that of his god country’s “miniature universe,” which meant that this time, it was already the ultimate level of his god country.


Chapter 1297: The Humans’ Response

Human territory, primal secret region.

“Freedom Alliance!”

“Ancestral God School, Space Beast Alliance, lone universe supreme masters.” Primal Chaos City Leader stood against the railing and looked at Thousand Treasures River. “They’re all waiting for our response, and they want to know more information about how to become a universe supreme master and a limit universe supreme master. If we actually give them that, the inheritance of the ancient civilization will be widespread. Then all the powers will know about it. Why did Luo Feng even strive for it in the first place?”

It was indeed difficult for Primal Chaos City Leader. The inheritance of ancient civilization was divided into two parts. The first part was to cultivate the weaker beings into universe masters more efficiently, and the second part was to cultivate universe masters into universe supreme masters or even limit universe supreme masters!

The powers wanted the second part! However, humans needed territories to boom, so it would be good for the humans if they had hundreds of universe masters. If they didn’t have enough territories, 100 was a good amount. There were already around 1,000 universe masters from other powers, and once they had the inheritance, there would be more and more universe supreme masters. Some might even become as powerful as Teacher Origin. Then the inheritance would make no difference to the humans! In that case, other races would reap the benefits!

“We might as well just fight them!”

Don’t even think about getting the inheritance, not even a little bit, thought Primal Chaos City Leader. Even if we go back to the primal universe, Luo Feng will have much more power after becoming a universe master. All his bodies have power at top-tier level six, and that so-called alliance won’t be together forever. Luo Feng’s four bodies, Peng Gong, Darkness, and me… We can totally make the humans great again. We’ll only be weak for a while. Then we’ll thrive again!

Just as Primal Chaos City Leader was thinking, a being walked down the hallway. He wore a white cape, which made Primal Chaos City Leader’s eyes gleam.

“Luo Feng!” Primal Chaos City Leader said.

“Teacher.” The man in the distance looked up, took a step, and walked to beside Primal Chaos City Leader.

Primal Chaos City Leader looked at Luo Feng and nodded contently. “Breakthrough?” he asked.

Luo Feng had a smile on his face. “Yes.”

He was indeed happy. Both his original earthling body and Golden Horned Beast body had reached the limit godly power of a universe master! Even universe supreme masters couldn’t wield power greater than him in Universe Ocean, which meant these two bodies were not weaker than anyone. As for Mosha body, its life gene level had reached more than 3,000 times, and his godly body was 10,000 kilometers tall!

However, it was difficult for Mosha body to reach the perfect life gene level now! After all, Mosha body needed many precious valuables to improve its life gene level, but it didn’t have much in storage. However, a life gene level at more than 3,000 times had already made Mosha body incredibly powerful. Remote Ocean body was the weakest at 1,000 times of life gene level but was still much stronger than before.

For what was worth, they were all able to wield power at top-tier level six in the original universe! In Universe Ocean, Luo Feng was much stronger, especially with his technique “Duan Mie,” which meant Luo Feng already stood among the top-tier beings both in the original universe and Universe Ocean. Even if he was weaker in laws, he could make up for it with his Blood Shadow Blade and Duan Mie —the technique left by the three ancestral teachers!

“Fantastic.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Wonderful!”

“Teacher, I can tell you’re worried. Is it about the upcoming final war?” asked Luo Feng.

Primal Chaos City Leader sighed. “How could I not be worried? The Freedom Alliance formed so suddenly and already has much more bargaining power. They’re waiting for our response… The Ancestral God School, the Space Beast Alliance, and the lone universe supreme masters have all come to us and named their terms, and are waiting for our response.”

“What do you want to do, teacher?” asked Luo Feng.

“If we say yes to them and give them all the inheritance, they’ll be the ones who gain the most, so what would be the point of us going through all this effort? We might as well just fight them, and if we lose, we’ll just return to the primal universe. If anyone dares to destroy the human territory, we’ll destroy their territory with Boat of Mausoleum as well! It’s better to give them all the inheritance.”

Luo Feng nodded and said, “Teacher, I have an idea.”

“An idea?” Primal Chaos City Leader gazed at Luo Feng.

“Teacher, I’ve become much stronger after becoming a universe master, especially my Remote Ocean body…”

Luo Feng started to elaborate on his plan, and Primal Chaos City Leader’s eyes gleamed as he listened.

After a while, Luo Feng finished describing his idea.

Primal Chaos City Leader was still anxious. “That would be much better,” he said. “However, can your Remote Ocean body actually resist it?”

“Don’t worry, teacher. If we really need to consume our godly power, that’ll be my biggest advantage. Even if they consume all their godly power, my Remote Ocean body will still have left,” said Luo Feng confidently. “As for other factors, I haven’t taken them into account yet, but I have Star Tower, so I believe I can perform it!”

Primal Chaos City Leader was still frowning and worried. Luo Feng’s plan was too crazy. He could die!

“No need to rush it. We need to test it first,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “We’ll test it first. If you think it’s okay, we’ll implement it.”

In Primal Chaos City Leader’s mind, he had the best chance to become a universe supreme master, followed by Luo Feng. And Luo Feng was the only inheritor of Duan Dong River inheritance, so he might have had a better chance to transcend incarnations in the future! He couldn’t put Luo Feng’s life in danger, even if that meant retreating back to the primal universe.

“Okay, let’s test it first.”

“I’ll call the other universe masters.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded.

All the universe masters from the human team gathered on the same day. There were over 100 universe masters there, and they took part in the test. Afterward, Primal Chaos City Leader went to talk to Teacher Origin, and he confirmed with Luo Feng again.

“Great! We’ve tested it, you’re confident enough, and Teacher Origin thinks it’s a good idea!” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. His eyes were gleaming. “These days, the Ancestral God School, the Space Beast Alliance, the lone universe supreme masters, and the Freedom Alliance are being too greedy—especially the Freedom Alliance. They want a response? We’ll give them a response.” Primal Chaos City Leader smiled.

Luo Feng smiled, too. “Teacher, it could get better.”
