“We’ll let them choose whether they want to help us or the alliance,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

He had been hesitant before. After all, if they actually retreated back to the primal universe, the human race would develop much more slowly in the future. It was a tough choice to make.

Even though Luo Feng’s plan sounded crazy, it was achievable in the original universe! They had tested it with the 100 universe masters, and they had talked about it with Teacher Origin and other universe masters from the human race. Everyone had agreed with the new plan in the end!

They would fight to the end!

Ancestral God Secret Region, inside Ancestral God Palace.

Three ancestral gods, eight beast gods, guarding beast gods, and guarding godly masters had gathered. None of them belonged to the human team, the united forces alliance, or the Freedom Alliance; instead, they all belonged to the Ancestral God School, and almost everyone was a special life form.

“Everyone.”

Three ancestral gods sat in the thrones in the palace. The one in the middle had a ferocious beast head, and his hair—each strand as thick as a finger—drooped. His eyes were green, and he said, “The humans gave us a response.”

The universe masters, including Nine Remoteness Master, were all looking forward to the response.

“The response is simple. They’ll only give us the guide to become universe supreme masters! That’s the only price they’re willing to pay.”

All the universe masters were shocked that the humans were still so stubborn even in a situation as difficult as this.

“We had two requirements,” said a giant fish with a black body. “The first one is the inheritance on how universe masters can become universe supreme masters! The second is how to reach the limit of universe supreme masters. The humans don’t agree to the second one?”

“Ancestral gods,” said Nine Remoteness Master. “The humans only agreed to the first one? With no further negotiations?”

“That is their bottom line,” said the central ancestral god.

Everyone grew quiet.

“Decide whether we’re joining the humans or not,” said the central ancestral god.

On the same day…

An island floated on the golden waves. On the island, more than 400 universe masters sat on thrones. The beings who had gathered were all powerful, and space and time twisted around them as they gathered. This was the first power of the original universe: the Freedom Alliance!

They were waiting for humans’ response as well. The representative from the human race had just left.

The response was very straightforward. “We’re willing to give you the inheritance about how to advance from universe masters to universe supreme masters, and this is the best we can offer. There should be no more negotiation.”

This was the only response. And it was up to the Freedom Alliance to decide whether they were going to join the humans or not.


Chapter 1298: Arrangement

More than 400 great beings from the Freedom Alliance gathered at the center of the alliance.

“I bet you’ve all learned about the humans’ response,” Shi Hua Island Leader said. “Even those who weren’t there when the representative came must have heard about it now, after talking with other universe masters. Now that we know their response, I am open to suggestions as to how we should proceed.”

Some of the ill-tempered universe masters roared in response.

“The humans are too reckless and arrogant. They didn’t even show any respect for us! The Freedom Alliance is the most powerful alliance in the universe! Without our help, they can’t survive in the original universe!”

“What do they gain for being so reckless? They don’t even have a way open to retreat.”

“Don’t they want to survive?”

Since the formation of Freedom Alliance, the members had felt that they were in a different status in the original universe. They weren’t as weak as before; instead, they were the powerful Freedom Alliance. They thought that humans would definitely agree to their terms, so they all got furious when the humans rejected them.

Some universe masters started to talk with each other.

“Night Flame, what do you think?”

“Actually, we’ve been stuck at the level of universe masters for a long time, so becoming universe supreme masters is what we most desire. As for limit universe supreme masters? That’s too far from us… Actually, Shi Hua Island Leader is the one who most desires to become a limit universe supreme master! To us, the conditions offered by humans are satisfying already.”

“I think so, but Shi Hua has a huge influence on our alliance, so he won’t just say yes easily.”

“True.”

“Besides, some of the races that were bullied by pinnacle races and those really confident also stand by Shi Hua Island Leader.”

Shi Hua Island Leader sat listening to the debate. He glanced across all the 400-something universe masters sitting close to each other and thought, The Freedom Alliance is huge, but lots of races are actually enemies of one another! The only reason they came together is that they were pressured by both sides. Actually, there are too many races and divisions in the alliance…

Some of the races are too progressive and confident! Some are fearful, and they still look up to pinnacle races like before and don’t want to wrong them. Some are mature… Some are sneaky… It’s difficult for them to follow me. I need to get them on my side this time, and we have to force the humans to give us the inheritance to become limit universe supreme masters.

They talked about it for half a month, yet nobody could convince anybody. Universe masters all had long lives, and this was a crucial time for them. There were way too many races in the Freedom Alliance, and some had been enemies for a long time. Even Shi Hua Island Leader couldn’t keep them under control.

Shi Hua Island Leader rarely spoke during this time. Instead, he’d been observing.

Many universe masters are ambitious. The Freedom Alliance is a powerful alliance, so lots of universe masters want to control this power.

Like the Northern Territory Alliance. The alliance master didn’t have any rights. Instead, Star River Master, Black Lotus Master, and Xuan Lan Star Master had the executive power.

Some universe masters were ambitious and wanted to marginalize Shi Hua Island Leader so he would be a leader in name only. Shi Hua Island Leader wouldn’t just let his power go like that. The debate showed how serious the power struggle was among the divisions and races within the Freedom Alliance.

There was an independent mountain at the top of Space God Mountain named Ancestral Mountain. There, space and time were twisted, and the electric snake was crawling.

Hong! Long! Long!

A giant being showed up on Ancestral Mountain.

“Humans, how ambitious they are!” Space Beast Ancestor said in a furious voice.

“How should we decide, Ancestor?”

“Ancestor, we’ll force those humans to give us the inheritance. We need to show them what we’re capable of!”

The universe masters gathered, and they were all furious. They hadn’t expected that the humans would dare to give a response like that!

“Teacher Origin was born among the humans, so they’re proud of themselves,” said Space Beast Ancestor slowly. “And now, Luo Feng has received the inheritance from Duan Dong River. How can they not be ambitious? Do you really think they’ll give away the inheritance to the limit power that easily? I thought they would have given us because they’re in a desperate situation. Yet they still refused to give us!”

Space Beast Ancestor was furious. He thought he was no stranger to Luo Feng, and Luo Feng was one of the top seniors in the human race. On top of that, he had gone to talk to Luo Feng directly. He had thought the humans would definitely give him the experience of how to become limit universe supreme masters.

However, the humans had still refused, and they were only willing to give them the experience of how to become universe supreme masters.

“What should we do, Ancestor?”

“We can’t let the humans off the hook like that!”

“Ancestor…”

The space beasts were all roaring. They were naturally bloodthirsty with great pride, and they were very disappointed that the humans wouldn’t agree to all the requirements they made.

“No need to rush yet,” said Space Beast Ancestor. “It’s not the time to make a choice yet. I know humans. Even if they resort to retreating back to the original universe, they won’t give out the inheritance. We need to wait for our chance. When the humans are finally in despair, they’ll panic, and if they still refuse to give us the inheritance, we’ll join the alliance and make things worse for them!”

“Okay.”

“Humans, humans!” roared the space beasts.

They may have been friends with some universe masters from other races, but when it came to the benefits of an entire race, they would definitely stand by their race’s side! Luo Feng had lots of friends as well, yet he still stood by the humans. Survival in wars could be cruel.

The human race gave a response to the Freedom Alliance, the Ancestral God School, the Space Beast Alliance, and the lone universe supreme masters.

No powers were completely satisfied.

Human territory, primal secret region.

Luo Feng stood above Thousand Treasures River, and Darkness Master was beside him.

“Some of them must be very disappointed at our responses,” said Luo Feng. “However, they’re facing a choice. If they choose the united forces alliance, they might not get any inheritance even if they win the war. If they choose us, they can at least get part of the inheritance.”

Darkness Master nodded. “That’s right, so it won’t be too bad. Some powers will choose us, at least.”

“Yes.” Luo Feng nodded. “If we actually lose the war, even if we slow down, we’ll prosper after a time.”

“That’s right.” Primal Chaos City Leader was confident.

“Go.”

Luo Feng waved his hands, and a nine-level tower flew out from his palm in the center of Thousand Treasures River.

“Larger, larger, larger!” commanded Luo Feng, controlling Star Tower.

Hong! Long! Long!

Star Tower grew larger and larger, taller and taller. 100 million kilometers, a billion kilometers, ten billion kilometers. It stopped expanding after it nearly hit the palace where Luo Feng lived.

“Let’s begin the arrangements,” said Luo Feng.

“Let’s go. I need to see it as well. This might be the only chance, as I see it.” Darkness Master smiled.

Luo Feng smiled. “Let’s go!”

They walked to the edge of the bottom of Star Tower. It bordered Luo Feng’s palace. They flew into the palace and entered a quiet secret chamber. Inside, there was an exquisite sculpture on a wall that stood about 100,000 kilometers tall. These palaces were, after all, the homes of universe masters, so the palaces were massive. This quiet chamber for training was quite large; it was not unheard of for a wall to be 100,000 kilometers tall. The exquisite sculpture on it was actually a portal.

“The god country portal was already established.” Luo Feng pointed at the sculpture. “This is the entry to my god country.”

“Let’s go!”

Luo Feng took a step and touched the wall. After a ripple, Luo Feng entered, and Darkness Master entered as well.

Mosha body was guarding Star Tower, so it could easily control Star Tower.

In the vast god country.

Hong! Long! Long!

Remote Ocean was tumbling, and above it was a light screen. Two beings walked out: Luo Feng and Darkness Master.

“Is this your god country?” Darkness Master looked around and exclaimed, “Impressive!”

Luo Feng smiled and nodded. His god country had already hit its limit! It would become a miniature universe if it progressed a step further. There was no need for him to hide his god country anymore.

“This Remote Ocean body of yours…” Darkness Master looked down at the endless remote ocean, and admiration flashed through his eyes. “Impressive. With such a godly body, there will never be a shortage of godly power.”

“It’s just luck.” Luo Feng smiled.

For one thing, he transferred the soul of Golden Horned Beast to himself, and the blood he had chosen was the limit of what a golden horned beast could bear. It wouldn’t be able to breed it if it exceeded the limit. Also, he had the Nine Volume Manual, so he could gradually improve the genes of his bloody sea from the prince level all the way to Nine Remoteness Master’s level.

Darkness Master shook his head. “It’s not just luck.”

Luo Feng smiled. “I’ll begin.”

Luo Feng looked at the endless Remote Ocean, and his mind started to control it. Suddenly, Remote Ocean started to tumble. The water surged and flew toward the light screen like a dragon.

Hong! Long! Long!

The tumbling Remote Ocean rushed toward the other end of the portal. Meanwhile, in the primal secret region, water from Remote Ocean flooded out from the sculpture in Luo Feng’s training room.


Chapter 1299: Division of the Camps

In the core ground of the primal secret region, the palaces of Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader were scattered all over the area. Thousand Treasure River was rippling, and a nine-story tower that was several tens of billions of kilometers tall was being suspended right in the middle of Thousand Treasure River.

“Eh?” A figure suddenly flew out from within the tower. He wore black all over and was looking down at the sight before him.

“Snow Sand Ocean!”

Mosha Luo Feng quickly took control of the situation. At one time, the boundless Snow Sand Ocean was rapidly moving to enshroud the surrounding area of around ten billion kilometers, so naturally, the palace where Luo Feng resided, along with part of the base of Star Tower, would be enshrouded.

Hong!

The turbulent waters of Remote Ocean directly surged out of the palace where Luo Feng resided like a water dragon—at a speed that was almost as fast as the speed of light. At the base of Star Tower, a side door adjacent to Luo Feng’s palace opened. This side door was around one billion kilometers tall, so jets of ocean water columns surged in easily.

Mosha Luo Feng was drifting about amidst the icy, snow-white sand grains with brows slightly furrowed. “The water column has a diameter of 100,000 kilometers. Even if it charges over almost as fast as the light of speed… to turn the entire endless Remote Ocean around, I will still need a long, long time.”

Indeed, it would take an extremely long time. Until today, the diameter of the water column was only 100,000 kilometers, while the endless Remote Ocean was a massive ocean with a diameter of 80 billion kilometers.

This water column continued erupting at the speed of light, yet even if the eruptions were still consistent after one year, it was still only a small part of the entire endless Remote Ocean. There were many universe masters whose godly bodies were not even 10,000 kilometers tall, but for this column of the ocean water of Luo Feng’s endless Remote Ocean, even after one year of transportation, the Remote Ocean showed no trace of movement at all. This showed how vast it truly was.

“I still need to continue establishing god country transportation passageways,” Mosha body said to himself.

Hong!

Mosha body was here while the original earthling body was in god country. They both worked single-mindedly to start establishing stationary god country transportation passageways. Stationary god country transportation passageways were very common sights. Ordinary undying fighters such as the emperor of Black Dragon Mountain empire could also construct such stationary passageways. Or perhaps, to an ordinary undying, this might not be a small price. But to Luo Feng? Even if he were to construct 10,000 or even one million of such stationary transportation passageways. It would be something so simple and casual to him.

“Rise. Fix!” Mosha Luo Feng pointed to one of the empty grounds on the courtyard of his palace. That area had an approximate diameter of one million kilometers, and the entire passageway speedily fixed and stabilized.

A god country transportation passageway could be big or small. The smaller it was, the easier it was to construct; the bigger it was, the more stable it had to be, so the more difficult it was to construct. Especially when the god country transportation passageway continued to expand, the price to pay would soar accordingly. Luo Feng might own quite a sizable fortune, so it did not affect him at all, but he was also unwilling to waste too much of his fortune. When he was constructing the entrances of these god country transportation passageways, the largest diameter would normally be one million kilometers, and the smallest would be a few tens of thousands of kilometers.

One after the other, passageways were established!

Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong!

Numerous water columns of Remote Ocean—be it immeasurably thick or extremely fine—surged and gushed toward that side door like thousands of horses galloping together at a high speed that could almost match the speed of light. That side door was, after all, as tall as 100 billion kilometers, so it could easily accommodate the impact of so many water columns of the Remote Ocean. However, as the number of passageways continued to increase, Star Tower was forced to expand further, and this expansion took place in all other directions possible.

That was still acceptable. The space of the core ground was enormous. After all, Thousand Treasure River spread over an area of a few light years, which was a good measure of how vast and wide that space was.

Star Tower continued to expand to hundreds of billions of kilometers tall, then continued expanding. Eventually, all the side doors and the deep abyss at the base of Star Tower opened to accommodate more and more ocean water flowing in from the Remote Ocean.

“Construct, construct, construct.” Luo Feng was constructing without restraint. “Too slow, too slow, too slow.”

He was also frustrated over how massive the endless Remote Ocean was. However, he could only continue to construct god country passageways painstakingly. As many as one million passageways fully occupied the surroundings of Luo Feng’s palace grounds, and their total surface area added up to a diameter of 100 billion kilometers.

Even so, within three days, the endless Remote Ocean was fully transported into Star Tower from god country.

Within these three days, many great beings from various races, and even some undying fighters, sector lords, and guards of the human race were filled with doubts. Why would that endless Snow Sand Ocean envelop such a great piece of domain? Yet, even if they were dying of curiosity, there was no way they could seek comprehension.

Within Star Tower. In a vast, individual space, the water of the endless Remote Ocean was flowing out. Luo Feng, Darkness Master, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Peng Gong Master were positioned above this space.

“I consider myself to have truly experienced this.” Darkness Master sighed. “These three days, I have stayed around and truly felt how massive this endless Remote Ocean is! With a passageway with a diameter as wide as 10,000 kilometers, even if you take one to ten years to transport, or even up to 100 years, it would still be very far behind. If this was the transportation of my godly body, I don’t even need the time for a blink of an eye.

Primal Chaos City Leader laughed and said, “Otherwise, how could Nine Remoteness Master’s Nine Remoteness Ocean be considered comparable to a supreme true treasure? Because the other races were completely helpless against his Nine Remoteness Ocean… that’s why it is worthy enough to be compared to a supreme true treasure.”

Peng Gong Master looked down with great envy. Such a massive godly body!

“It’s overly massive. Moving it is tedious and difficult,” Luo Feng said, mocking himself. “You see, just moving it here from my god country has consumed so much of my strength. I’ve been constructing transportation passageways like crazy because I can only depend on these transportation passageways to gradually channel over the ocean water of the endless Remote Ocean.”

In fact, Luo Feng had been racking his brains for a solution on how to transfer the endless Remote Ocean over.

Because the endless Remote Ocean could only move about in its entirety, and it moved so slowly that it was almost tortoise-like speed. In the beginning, Luo Feng had to bring Star Tower into god country. Then Star Tower was expanded to a massive size so that ocean water from the endless Remote Ocean could gush into Star Tower all at once. This would facilitate the transfer well. This was earlier on, when Luo Feng was still quite weak.

He once had to depend on Star Tower to achieve such a transfer! However, that was when Remote Ocean was still small! And the level of its godly power was weak! But now…everything was different.

Upon bearing the entire endless Remote Ocean, the speed at which Star Tower moved became ridiculously slow! Luo Feng felt overwhelmed by exhaustion. Even if the speed of movement was slow, making use of god country transportation passageway, it should be able to move fast. Yet the truth was, when Star Tower barely made it to the entrance of the god country transportation passageway, it caused the entire god country transportation passageway to collapse!

The oppressive force exerted on Star Tower after bearing the endless Remote Ocean was simply overwhelming! God country transportation passageway was too weak and fragile by comparison; there was no way it could accommodate a Star Tower that was bearing the endless Remote Ocean.

Luo Feng was dumbfounded, too. Could it be there was no way he could transfer Star Tower that was bearing the endless Remote Ocean?

Fortunately, Luo Feng recalled that he could establish more god country transportation passageways so that the ocean water from the endless Remote Ocean water could directly flow through. This ocean water from the Remote Ocean was well-suited for flowing. Naturally, it was fast and efficient. This made Luo Feng sigh in relief. Luckily, this took the form of ocean water. If this was a massive mountain range or a world tree or the likes of it, he would have worries such as whether he was able to construct a god country transportation passageway that was so massive!

No matter what, after painstakingly going through various hardships, he finally managed to move endless Remote Ocean from the primal secret region into Star Tower with the use of god country transportation. Then Luo Feng stored Snow Sand Ocean and everything resumed peace and quiet. Those great beings from various other races were filled with doubts, but still, they were unaware of what happened over the past three days.

Following this, the human race started a long and slow wait. Various methods were in place. They were just pending the replies of the various groups of powers.

“The Ancestral God School has promised to join the human camp!”

“The Ancestral God School has requested that we give them a part of that guidance first. Then, after the war, we will give the other part.”

“All right.”

“Haha…! With the Ancestral God School joining the human camp, it will be equivalent to gaining three more ‘sixth-tier as the top level’ combat powers. And the Ancestral God School has two supreme true treasures.”

The moment they heard this piece of news, the sea of humans was a scene of jubilation. On the contrary, the united forces camp was in a rage when they learned of the news. The internal disagreements within the Freedom Alliance went on. When they heard that Ancestral God School had chosen to join the human camp, these disagreements within the Alliance grew even more heated!

Updates arrived successively.

“Black Universe Creator has decided to join the united force camp!”

“Northern Territory Alliance Master has decided to join the united force camp!”

“E Zhou is joining united force camp!”

“Virtual Real Devil God is joining united force camp!”

The humans might be feeling bouts of pressure, but they continued to prepare themselves. Since the humans had no intentions of giving out information on cultivating to reach the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master, it was a fact that these supreme masters who traveled alone were not going to help the humans. On the other hand, the united force camp was rejoicing.

At that very moment, the division of powers between the two sides was gradually coming to light. Other than Sitting Mountain Guest, Demon Beast Ancestor, and a few other great beings who had not made their stand yet, the majority of the groups of powers had already announced their decisions. Now, only the Space Beast Alliance and Freedom Alliance had yet to make their final choice.

“The Space Beast Alliance has sent its envoy here again. Quite an eloquent one, he even said that imparting them information on cultivating to reach the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master will not affect the overall situation that the primal universe is in… Through the conversation, it is so obvious that there is a hint of a threat, and apparently, this Space Beast Alliance is also contemplating whether or not it should join the united force camp.”

“There is no need to bother about him. Now, the Freedom Alliance’s decision is our greatest concern.”

Right now, within the entire primal universe, various groups of races were all looking toward the Freedom Alliance. It was the most important source of strength, especially with the united forces camp’s increase in ability, which had already surpassed the human camp’s power by leaps and bounds. But the moment the Freedom Alliance decided to help the humans, then no matter what, the united forces camp was destined for failure.

Fight! The internal disagreements within the Freedom Alliance were severe.

The majority wanted to join the human camp. At least they could obtain the guidance from the cultivation experience of the ancient civilization on how they could cultivate to achieve the universe supreme master level.

The other part of the Freedom Alliance—including Shi Hua Island Leader—wanted to pressure the humans into acquiescing to their demands. Otherwise, they would join the united forces camp as a way of threatening the humans.

The differences between both parties, especially when the situation within the entire primal universe eventually depended on their decisions, became even more serious. The more aggressive party headed by Shi Hua Island Leader and the more stable party that consisted of the various other groups were engaged in an extremely intense fight against one another.

It was the third month since the endless Remote Ocean had entered Star Tower.

“Luo Feng.”

“Teacher.”

Luo Feng met with Primal Chaos City Leader.

“Come over to Earth as fast as you can,” Primal Chaos City Leader requested. “The avatar of the alliance master of the Freedom Alliance, ‘Shi Hua Island Leader,’ has landed on Earth this very moment.”

“Landed on Earth?” Luo Feng frowned.

“Yes. He is here alone to negotiate with us humans.” Primal Chaos City Leader was very solemn as he continued. “Because we have many great beings of various races in our primal secret region right now, he is unwilling to disclose his identity… Therefore, the venue for negotiations will be on Earth. Seems like Shi Hua Island Leader intends to help the human camp.”

“Alone?” Luo Feng seemed to have an inkling of what was going on. “What Teacher means to say is that he is not representing the Freedom Alliance… but representing only himself?”

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded slightly.

“All right, I will go and meet up with him.” Luo Feng nodded.

The individual being sent for negotiations was a clear reflection of the degree of importance. Currently, within the human camp, the ones of the highest status would be Primal Chaos City Leader, Luo Feng, Darkness, and Peng Gong. Out of these four, the status of Primal Chaos City Leader and Luo Feng were of higher importance.


Chapter 1300: The Final Choice of Freedom Alliance

Life on Earth was as peaceful as ever. The war between the two major camps in the primal universe had not aroused the slightest trace of disruption to the populace living on the countless life planets. This populace was made up of the common people.

Strolling along the wide and spacious pavements, it was common to see warriors walking out of dojos in their training uniforms, and there would be many universe businessmen walking down the streets while discussing business matters.

“Luo Family?”

A purple-robed figure stood before the door of an old mansion.

This old mansion was the house of the Luo Family. Even on Earth, it had a unique significance. By the doorstep, there were guards to stop intruders or simply the common public who were trying to satisfy their curiosity. But where the purple-robed figure stood, it seemed like the people walking past him—or even the guards at the doors—could not see him at all.

“Mama, is this Luo Feng’s house?”

“Yes, this is Luo Feng’s house. Haven’t you been making a racket about coming to Earth to see the noblest leader of the pulse of us Earthlings? Mama has fulfilled my promise and brought you here. When we get back to Jade Birch Star, you must train hard at the dojo.”

“Yes, Mama. I heard that Luo Feng was born in a distant base city era of our Earth, and at that time, there were many cities that were in ruins or desolate waste. I want to see them all.”

“Don’t worry. This time around, we have ample time on Earth. We can go to many attractions.”

A pair of mother and son, who both had black hair and black eyes with yellow skin, were walking along a sidewalk a distance away from Luo Family’s mansion. After a brief discussion, they left shortly after.

Every day, there would be many people coming to this place even during the base city era. Since the time when Luo Feng and company did not hesitate to risk their lives to fight that swallowing beast, his status had already soared to the level of an absolute hero. Thereafter, when the Nuolan Shan family clan descended on Earth, Luo Feng had once again stepped out to ward off their attacks.

Luo Feng’s status got higher and higher, and the publicity on Earth would naturally praise him to even higher elevations. There were also earthlings roaming about the universe who had benefited greatly from Luo Feng’s help. This made them even more thankful for Luo Feng… Therefore, over the past tens of thousands of years, generations of earthlings had passed on the heroic deeds of Luo Feng, and this was how Luo Feng became the greatest leader and godly spirit in the eyes of all earthlings entering the universe era.

A voice resounded: “Shi Hua Island Leader.”

The purple-robed figure turned around to look. On a bustling sidewalk crowded with people, there was a black-haired youth garbed in a silver-white robe approaching from a distance away. The people around him could not see him at all. It was as though they were in a different dimension altogether. On the pavement, there were many earthlings who specially came from other faraway planets to learn about how Luo Feng grew up through traces that were found all over his homeland. Yet no one was the slightest bit aware that Luo Feng was walking alongside them.

“Luo Feng!” the purple-robed figure greeted with a smile.

“I did not expect Shi Hua Island Leader to choose to meet here.” Luo Feng walked to the front of the mansion, then raised his head to take a look.

“I wanted to come and see the extraordinary great being from the talented young generation who rose from the human race at such a tremendous rate…” Shi Hua Island Leader said in a gentle tone. “Exactly how did he manage to rise? And what kind of environment could have cultivated this talent?”

Luo Feng smiled. He took one look at this Shi Hua Island Master, who was so handsome that he could be an epitome of perfection but seemed to be more of a neutral gender. However, this Shi Hua Island Leader was a unique life form, so it was also possible that he did not have any gender at all.

“Out of all you humans, the one I respect the most is Teacher Origin,” Shi Hua Master said softly with a sigh. “Especially the virtual universe Teacher Origin created. This virtual universe instantly made your culture 1,000—a million times more splendid! Even for faraway cultures that were scattered all over the universe, colliding with one another in the virtual universe could create new sparks. Various imaginations could become tangible within the virtual universe… Even I myself often get to experience your human culture within the virtual universe.”

Luo Feng nodded. With or without the virtual universe, it was indeed a world of difference.

“When I was in the virtual universe, I have seen quite a few rounds of the War of Talents of you humans. Only that particular year of the War of Talents that you participated in… I was wandering on an adventure in Universe Ocean and could not dare get distracted. Therefore, I clean forgot about watching it.” Shi Hua Island Leader shook his head while lamenting. “If I had watched it, I would be tempted to take you under my wing, taking you in as my disciple. How wonderful that would have been. This inheritance of Duan Dong River… How easy would it be for me to lay hands on it?”

“Even if Shi Hua Island Leader had watched that particular round of War of Talents earlier on, you would not want me as your disciple,” Luo Feng said. “At that time, I was not the most outstanding one.”

“True.” Shi Hua Island Master shook his head and lamented again. “No one will dare proclaim to know what will happen in the future. Even if I had seen your performance that day, I would not have guessed your fate. I would never have expected a young chap from an indigenous race to be able to rise to be my equal when he matured.”

Luo Feng gave a slight frown and said, “Shi Hua Island Leader’s purpose in coming here is not merely to have a chat with me, right?”

Shi Hua Island Leader’s expression changed instantly. “Luo Feng!” Shi Hua Island Leader stared at Luo Feng. “My purpose here is simple… Now, all the major groups of powers within the entire primal universe are paying close attention to the final choice of my Freedom Alliance. In other words, whichever side my Freedom Alliance chooses to join, that side will be determined as the winner.”

Luo Feng nodded slightly.

“And now, there are split opinions within my Freedom Alliance,” said Shi Hua Island Leader said. “One part wants to join your human camp. The other part wants even more! I belong to the latter part. My purpose in coming here is that I only have one goal: that you humans will impart to me the cultivation experiences of that ancient civilization on how I can cultivate the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master.”

Shi Hua Island Leader looked at Luo Feng. Luo Feng instantly let out a hint of a sneer.

“Don’t rush to reject me,” Shi Hua Master said. “I come here representing myself. In other words… the cultivation experiences to be able to cultivate to the ultimate limit that you humans give me are solely mine to own. If you give me this inheritance, I will not impart it to any other being of the Freedom Alliance. And I will lead and persuade all those under my influence in the Freedom Alliance to join your human camp.”

Luo Feng’s eyes lit up. “You mean to say…”

“Yes. That is exactly what I mean. You humans only need to fulfill an insignificant condition that the Freedom Alliance demands! As for the cultivation experiences to achieve an ultimate limit… you only need to give it to me! I will help you humans now that the Freedom Alliance is split in two internally and I have much influence over one of these two groups. If I help you, the stalemate will soon come to an end, and the Freedom Alliance will join your human camp. Besides, I am no fool. After I get what I am after, I will not be so silly as to share it with other great beings. Wouldn’t that be the same as training my enemy?” Shi Hua Island Leader looked at Luo Feng. “What do you think of my proposal?”

Luo Feng was tempted. If the experiences of the ancient civilization on how to cultivate to achieve the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master were only imparted to Shi Hua Island Leader, the humans would not need to worry about him spreading it to outsiders. Unless Shi Hua Island Leader was, indeed, a fool.

By only giving it to him, I can get over 400 universe masters to join my human camp?

Luo Feng nodded discreetly. Previously, his plan might have been impressive, but there were still risks attached. If the Freedom Alliance joined his human camp, they would truly be freed from any possible risk.

“Give me a moment,” Luo Feng said.

At that moment, in the virtual universe, Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, Peng Gong Master, and Darkness Master met on the apex of Thunder Island.

“This was what he demanded: to give him the experiences of the ancient civilization on how to cultivate to achieve the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master,” Luo Feng said. “Then he will help us! Teacher, Darkness, Peng Gong, what do you all think about his demands?”

“Only giving it to him alone?” Darkness muttered to himself pensively.

Peng Gong also nodded slightly. “Now there are two voices within the Freedom Alliance. One is willing to join us; the other is reluctant to do so and demands that we give them more. Shi Hua Island Leader is the leader of the group with the second voice. If he helps us… it is indeed possible to achieve a united voice within the Freedom Alliance as soon as possible.”

“Just giving it to him alone is possible,” Primal Chaos City Leader said slowly. “A single universe supreme master does not affect the big picture.”

“True. And when we give him the information about the inheritance, we can be as brief as possible!” Darkness Master sneered. “He doesn’t even know what the inheritance we have is like. We can give him simplified information… then tell him that it’s what we got. What can he do?”

Luo Feng also nodded. The four highest-ranked great beings of the human race all felt that giving the information to Shi Hua Island Leader alone—in exchange for over 400 universe masters joining the human camp—was a feasible deal.

“And we must give him a portion before the war and the other portion after the war.” Luo Feng smiled. “The portion before the war will have him coveting for more. After the war, when we give him the other portion, he may find it too brief… but the war will have ended. So what if he has regrets?”

“Mm.”

“True.”

“We can accede to his request.”

The higher-ups of the humans all nodded their agreements; Primal Chaos City Leader even contacted Teacher Origin once to consult him about this matter. Teacher Origin was also in agreement.

Firstly, they only had to give information to Shi Hua Island Leader. Secondly, even if he managed to get his hands on that simplified information on that inheritance, it would still be extremely tough for Shi Hua Island Leader to achieve a breakthrough and cultivate to reach the ultimate limit.

Earth.

“Internally, the human race has finished this discussion.” Luo Feng looked at Shi Hua Island Leader. “And all agreed.”

Shi Hua Island Leader heaved a sigh of relief and revealed a smile. “Before the war, we humans will give you a third of the information,” said Luo Feng. “If the Freedom Alliance joins the human camp in this war, then after the war has ended, we will give you the other two-thirds of the information.”

“Deal.” Shi Hua Island Leader nodded. “When will you give me the information?”

“Very soon.” Luo Feng replied. “The human race has held an internal discussion.” Luo Feng looked at Shi Hua Island Leader. “And we have agreed to accede to your request.”

“After your human camp gives me part of the information, I will act fast and urge the Freedom Alliance to join your camp,” Shi Hua Island Leader said without further ado.

The human camp, indeed, prepared a set of information on the inheritance that very same day and handed it over to Shi Hua Island Leader, who was excited and overjoyed to see it. This partial information alone was able to stir up his desire for more… and he was already yearning to lay hands on the remaining two-thirds. The only thing was, he had to wait until after the war.

The humans were all waiting anxiously.

“Shi Hua Island Leader wouldn’t go back on his word after receiving the information and not help us as promised, would he?”

“Fret not. Shi Hua Island Leader put so much effort into creating that Freedom Alliance, and even became an Alliance Master, for what? All of it was just for the inheritance, wasn’t it? It will do him no good at all if any of the universe masters from the Freedom Alliance also gets a part of it. Getting it all for himself is enough… He will handle this appropriately.”

Luo Feng, Darkness Master, Primal Chaos City Leader, and the rest were waiting anxiously. They were all worried that an accident might happen midway. After all, the Freedom Alliance was brimming with great beings. Even if Shi Hua Island Leader were to help, he was also unable to give a 100 percent guarantee that he would succeed in his persuasion.

Half a month after being given a third of the information on cultivation experiences from the inheritance, Shi Hua Island Leader finally sent a piece of news:

“Internally, the Freedom Alliance has arrived at a consensus. The Alliance has decided to… join the human camp!”


Chapter 1301: The Sudden Outburst

The vast primal universe was divided into two major camps. The human camp’s meeting point was the primal secret region while the meeting point for the united forces camp was Blood Tooth Star.

90 percent of Blood Tooth Star was composed of a vast ocean; at that moment, there was an old ship adrift on the Blood Tooth Star ocean where a group of supreme existences from all over the entire primal universe had gathered. Together, they were making merry to their hearts’ content, drinking the most precious wine and dining on the finest cuisine.

“With our combined strength, what can those puny little humans do to us?”

“Freedom Alliance? It’s so scattered. It only became united because the two major camps were pressuring it. Wait for the exchange of blows during this war… You all will see this happening. That Freedom Alliance is definitely going to have internal conflicts, and then they will be split up for sure. They are not going to be our match at all.”

The ten noble existences were seated in a dispersed manner as they talked about it brazenly. They were Shock Demon Ancestor from the demons, Father God of the automaton race, Empress of the bug clan, Devil Ancestor of the prison clan, Holy Master of the crystal clan, Black Universe Creator, E Zhou, Virtual Real Devil God, Northern Territory Alliance Master, and Space Ancestor. All of them put together represented half the number of universe supreme masters in the entire primal universe.

“If we all join forces, the marvelous combination of the various supreme true treasures will definitely unleash the strongest combat power. Even if the Freedom Alliance and human camp combine forces, we still have a chance of beating them.”

“True.”

“What a pity! That old fellow, Sitting Mountain Guest, refuses to join us—or rather, refuses to take any side at all! Just what is going through the mind of Sitting Mountain Guest? If he joins us, given his secretive and endless stream of methods, together with the numerous universe masters under our command, we can definitely come up with more methods. Then our chances of winning will increase by leaps and bounds.”

“You are gravely mistaken if you really think so.” Space Ancestor was seated within the ship while his tail extended all the way out and directly into the large ocean. “Sitting Mountain Guest and Luo Feng share a deep relationship, much deeper than any of you presume to know.”

“Oh?”

“Sitting Mountain Guest and Luo Feng?”

“What relationship?”

Everyone was surprised as they looked toward Space Ancestor.

“Teacher and disciple!” Space Ancestor’s eyes swept around his surroundings as he revealed these two words.

This sudden revelation shocked all the universe supreme masters. Previously, Sitting Mountain Guest had certainly disallowed Space Ancestor from divulging his actual relationship with Luo Feng to the outside world—unless Luo Feng gained the ability to protect himself. Now that Luo Feng could protect himself, even if Space Ancestor were to reveal their true relationship, he would not be considered as offending Sitting Mountain Guest. After all, deep down in his heart, the more Space Ancestor interacted with Sitting Mountain Guest, the more fearful he was of him.

However, this time around, he was filled with dissatisfaction. He was furious! He felt that Sitting Mountain Guest, being Luo Feng’s Teacher, must have gained some benefits from this arrangement! After all, in this vast universe, a teacher-disciple relationship was the most important kind! How could Space Ancestor not feel any jealousy for Sitting Mountain Guest?

“I see.”

“That Sitting Mountain Guest. Previously, he brought up that disciple, Flame Emperor, and now, he had cultivated this Milky Way Horde Leader, who was much more impressive than Flame Emperor.”

“How loathsome Sitting Mountain Guest is! He must have gotten the inheritance from his disciple way back then! No wonder he simply refused to join us when I invited him!”

“That fellow is always the first in line for all sorts of benefits.”

“Humph.”

These supreme masters were the top-level beings of the primal universe. For countless years, they had their fair shares of fights against one another, and at the very least, they had some understanding of one another. But toward Sitting Mountain Guest, they harbored… complex emotions. They were jealous and envious of him, but at the same time, they were fearful and cautious of him. There were even times when they had to beg him for help.

No one knew how powerful Sitting Mountain Guest was; what they knew was that he had never fought anyone in a head-on confrontation. He was more inclined toward the use of other supplementary methods to tease his opponents.

On the big ship, this group of top-level existences of the primal universe was brazenly voicing their opinions about various matters. One moment, they could be discussing the war between the two major camps, the next they could be talking about Universe Ocean, and the next moment, they could be discussing other supreme masters.

Just as they were pouring out their thoughts, without warning—the streamlined, towering body of Father God of the automaton race rose to his feet suddenly.

Father God of the automaton race might always have stayed within that black sphere body, but just like the rest, he had a godly body. However, his approach involved a machine type combat method, so he usually stayed within his black sphere where it was safer and where he could unleash a much more powerful combat ability. But in the primal universe, the greatest amount of power these universe supreme masters could unleash was limited to sixth-tier as the top level, so it was normal for him to appear in his original body.

“Everyone!”

The Empress of the bug clan let out a shocked expression.

“What is it?”

“What happened?”

Black Universe Creator, Virtual Real Devil God, and the others all looked over. All of them were very baffled over what could have caused the Empress of the bug clan and Father God of automaton race to lose their composure.

“I just received the news,” Father God of the automaton race announced in his strong and powerful voice. “The Freedom Alliance has reached a consensus internally and decided to join the human camp.”

“What?”

“Join the human camp?”

“Not good!”

One by one, their expressions changed drastically.

Previously, before the various supreme masters who traveled alone joined them, the united forces camp would never have been able to fight against the combined power of the Freedom Alliance and the human camp. However, after the various lone supreme masters joined them with their supreme true treasures—and with the Space Beast Alliance’s help—they had a fighting chance. However, this battle would be extremely trying because both sides were equally powerful.

Space Master suddenly let out a low growl. “We need to act quickly. No, we need to act now. Let’s set out now! There is nothing much to think about. We, the united forces camp, must set off right away and charge toward the human’s core ground—the primal secret region.”

“Old Beast God…”

The other supreme masters looked in the direction of Space Ancestor.

“Yes, what Old Beast Master said was right.”

“Yes.”

“Yes. We should act right away.”

They were all highly intelligent, even if Space Ancestor had not spelled it out, they would have figured things out on their own.

“Freedom Alliance has just reached a consensus, so they may not have obtained the part of the information of the inheritance from the humans… We should take the chance and strike before the two parties gather as one. If we charge our way into the human’s primal secret region right away, the crossfire between our two camps will only last for an extremely short time. By the time the Freedom Alliance rushes over, maybe the war will already have ended.”

“Right.”

“We need to make full use of all the time we have.”

Everyone was of one mind, one thought. They were all aware that the alliance between the humans and the Freedom Alliance would bring them an agonizing war to fight. Who knew? It might even become a prolonged war—a war of attrition! The outcome would be unpredictable! After all, the humans and Freedom Alliance merged; that would mean the two most mysterious beings of the primal universe, Sitting Mountain Guest and Shi Hua Island Leader, would be there. In addition, there was also Luo Feng, who had received the inheritance of the pulse of Duan Dong River.

This war was filled with variables. No one was willing to fight such a war of attrition or a war filled with so many variables. They had to win this once and for all and as soon as possible!

“We must be fast, fast, fast, and end this war as early as we can.”

They were all very anxious. They knew that, in fact, Freedom Alliance traveled fast. One trip via god country transportation, followed by another teleportation, and they would arrive. They wanted to make it there before the Freedom Alliance. If not, ending this war was going to be extremely tough. But, they had to do this. It was the only way of settling this war that would be relatively easier and faster.

“Old Beast God, your Space Beast Alliance is going to act as planned, or…” Shock Demon Ancestor looked toward Space Ancestor.

“We can’t be bothered about other plans,” Space Ancestor decided in his low voice. “Now, we must focus all our strength and try to wipe out those humans in one swift stroke. In the end, we must capture the whole group of human universe masters.”

“Let’s go!”

“Let’s go!”

“Let’s go!”

The moment they started to act, they would act fast.

Old Beast God, Shock Demon Ancestor and the rest of the supreme masters seemed to remain on the big ship as though nothing much had changed, but those were just their avatars. Their original bodies had already started returning to their own races to give commands as they all prepared to take their troops out for war.

Merely three minutes later, in the outer space of Blood Tooth Star, within the vast starlit sky, many massive objects were gathering. At first look, there were 11 gigantic palace type true treasures belonging to the eleven universe supreme masters who were controlling them from the inside. Each of them was leading a troop of around 40 universe masters. Every palace true treasure would fetch a troop of one supreme master and 40 universe masters!

These 11 universe supreme masters were Shock Demon Ancestor, Dream Demon Ancestor, Father God of the automaton race, the Empress of the bug clan, Devil Ancestor of the prison clan, Holy Master of the crystal clan, Northern Territory Alliance Master, Space Ancestor, Black Universe Creator, E Zhou, and Virtual Real Devil God.

Previously, when the united forces of the three races fought against the humans, why had Luo Feng not captured the group of universe masters under Father God’s protection? Because Father God of the automaton race had remained hidden within his black sphere with the troop, which was also where he could keep on protecting them. So even if those universe masters were attacked by the impact of willpower of that Ancient God Eye and did not have much strength to resist it, Father God of the automaton race could use his own body to resist all of it.

Now, the united forces camp would be doing likewise, and they had divided themselves into 11 troops. Each troop would be headed by a universe supreme master! The most Ancient God Eye could attack at any one time would be one troop. Even if it were to launch an attack, with a supreme master by their side to protect them, the troop would be safe.

“This war!”

“What we all have to do is charge into the humans’ primal secret region. Then we will execute all our techniques together, and with one swift move, we are going to bring the human camp to total destruction. Then we have to rely on Empress Palace—belonging to the Empress of the bug clan—to swallow up the entire human camp of universe masters. Do not hold back. Act to your heart’s content.”

“All the universe masters.”

“For our races!”

“For our future!”

“Let’s go, humans’ primal secret region!”

Following Father God’s booming voice resounded in every corner, and the 11 massive objects representing the entire united forces camp took off. Almost at the same time, they all executed their god country transportation and left successively.

Previously, the united forces camp did not attack proactively because they were waiting for the response of the Freedom Alliance. If the Freedom Alliance had not made its choice after waiting for some time, they would have attacked the humans right away. That would anger the Freedom Alliance because if the united forces camp had really attacked the humans, the Freedom Alliance would not stand to gain anything at all. This was why the united forces camp was certain that the Freedom Alliance would join the human camp as fast as they could.

Previously, they were afraid that they would be pushing the Freedom Alliance to join the human camp, so they did not dare to make reckless moves.

Now, the moment they received this confidential information confirming about the internal consensus that the Freedom Alliance had reached—that they would be joining the human camp—the united forces camp would hold back no more.

At the same moment, in the primal secret region of the human territory, in the main palace, a group of human universe masters had gathered. They were all chatting and laughing among themselves. All of them were filled with joy.

“The Freedom Alliance has reached a consensus. Very soon, the entire Alliance will arrive. Once they arrive, we will reallocate all our universe masters. Then the united forces camp will have no chance of winning at all.”

“Haha…”

They were all waiting for the group of universe masters from the Freedom Alliance to arrive.

“The united forces camp would not have received the news already, would they? They may make use of the minor time lapse where the Freedom Alliance has to travel over to launch their attack right away, right?” Remote Lord Master suddenly said.

Chapter 1302: The Surprise Attack

Upon hearing Primal Chaos City Leader’s voice, Luo Feng, Peng Gong Master, Darkness Master, and the others all knew that something was terribly wrong. All their expressions changed drastically.

Hong!

Hua!

A while later, over 100 universe masters were launching joint attacks focused on one of the eleven palace true treasures.

A pinnacle palace true treasure was not a supreme true treasure, so it was incapable of warding off a soul attack.

Hong! Long! Long!

A big group of universe masters in his surroundings were oblivious at the beginning, but as the soul attack closed in on them, naturally they started to sense it. They, too, executed soul attack techniques with their blurred godly power and threw their attacks at their opponent.

However, it was a force of 139 universe masters on the other side while they only had around 40 universe masters with a single universe supreme master. The difference was much too vast.

This was one disadvantage of dividing forces. By dividing themselves into 11 teams, indeed, the effect of Ancient God Eye would be greatly reduced, but at the same time, once any one team was attacked by the humans, it would almost be impossible to put up a resistance over such a terrifying attack.

So the ideal situation was for 11 troops to throw out attacks together and to rain down attacks until the humans were struggling to defend themselves, eventually reaching their breakdown point. This way, their opponents would not be able to attack and, of course, they were no longer threatening.

But judging by the exchange of blows earlier on, the joint soul attack by the humans was intangible, so by the time the united forces detected it, it was already too close to them. There was no way the other teams could make it in time to render help or block the attack.

Hong!

The mighty soul attack, upon breaking apart the resistance put up by Devil Ancestor of the prison clan and his team, immediately fell and hit them hard.

Devil Ancestor of the prison clan and around 40 universe masters in his team were all hit by the impact of the soul attack.

The universe masters under his command who had made it through this ordeal immediately roared in rage and started to execute their attacks in a frenzied manner. They threw their attacks at Black Tower Prison in the distance.

Universe masters were naturally extremely strong in soul defense; thus, only one unlucky universe master was unable to bear the force of the impact. As for the rest, though it was exhausting, they were all able to bear the impact and pull through to the end.

11 palace true treasures from the united force camp launched an overpowering attack capable of inundating everything between heaven and earth. Then, at the same time, they swept toward Black Prison Tower. Their might was so powerful that it threw the humans into a state of shock.

Previously, when the human camp exchanged blows with the united force of the three races, the humans had suppressed to such a great extent that it was on the verge of collapsing. And at that time, the difference in power of both parties was much smaller than it was now.

This time around, it was 11 universe supreme masters and around 400 universe masters. The other party had over 100 universe masters. The difference in power was far too vast.

“Darkness Master continued with his report. “That palace true treasure that we attacked is now unleashing an outburst of powerful attacks, and the teams in the other palace true treasures were all comparable to one another. Chapter 1303: Who Let the Cat out of the Bag?

Amidst the quiet, starlit sky of the universe, an island was erected right in the middle of the mighty golden waves. This was none other than the core ground of the Freedom Alliance.

Over 400 universe masters had gathered here and were seated on numerous thrones. They had come to a consensus not long ago and were waiting for the humans to hand over part of the information of the inheritance.

Shi Hua Island Leader was seated on the king’s throne as he gently swirled the wine glass in his hand. Lowering his gaze to look at the wine glass, he was smiling as he felt pleased with how things were progressing.

The great momentum at which the Freedom Alliance is progressing can be used to threaten the humans. Thereafter, I can get in touch with the humans without anyone from the Freedom Alliance knowing about it. Merely giving the information of inheritance to me as the condition in exchange for the entire Freedom Alliance to join the human camp… Oh, how easy it is to get hold of that information on cultivating to achieve the ultimate limit of a universe supreme master.

With these thoughts, Shi Hua Island Leader could not help but feel satisfied. He even started to develop feelings of self-admiration.

In fact, right at the beginning, when Luo Feng had received the inheritance of the pulse of Duan Dong River, Shi Hua Island Leader had already known that within the primal universe, there might be chaos! With the human race gaining strength and power, the conflicts with other races of the primal universe would intensify to such an extreme that there might even be the possibility of a brewing storm. Since then, he had started to devise his plan of action, albeit discreetly, and had tried to get himself acquainted with universe masters of various scattered races.

Those scattered races had low social statuses. Therefore, they would ask for nothing more if they were able to form acquaintances with supreme masters who traveled alone! This was how he had managed to get acquainted with a large group of universe masters so quickly.

The moment he caught wind of Huge Axe Creator’s annihilation, Shi Hua Island Leader had been immediately aware that this was a catalyst for an imminent war, and it had been ignited long before expected! If Huge Axe Creator was annihilated… the other races would most likely start communicating with one another to prepare in the dark. Or maybe they would not react quite so soon, so he had to quicken his pace and react right away.

Everything was developing as expected…

The pressure the two major camps exerted on the scattered races had created the perfect opportunity. Shi Hua Island Master immediately made use of his social skills and relationships with the other great beings to start a round of persuasions. Soon enough, he had gathered a sizable group of powers on his side. Relying on those he had roped in, he went on to further persuade other groups of powers. Finally, he combined everyone he had roped in and established a super alliance: the Freedom Alliance.

“Be an alliance master? To me, it is pointless. What I am after is… to be truly invincible! To transcend reincarnation! The first thing I want to do is to attain what Teacher Origin has achieved. Then I will aim to transcend reincarnation like East Emperor Ancestor and Purple Moon Ancestor.”

Shi Hua Island Leader’s chest ballooned up with his overwhelming desire. As a supreme master who traveled alone, he was never one to be bothered by the so-called “power of alliance.” He had established one because he needed to make use of it.

He had waited casually all the while, with his consciousness kept connected to the virtual universe as he waited for the humans to reply. He might have connected to the virtual universe before, but previously, he had done so via a hidden identity. However, since the negotiations between the Freedom Alliance and the humans took place, all universe masters and supreme masters from the Freedom Alliance had permission to connect to the virtual universe. This would facilitate efficient communication between both sides.

Suddenly, the leisurely and carefree expression on Shi Hua Island Master’s face disappeared to reveal a heavy and furious mix of emotions. Right away, his eyes swept his surroundings as he shouted out in anger, “Everyone! Just a moment ago, we came to a consensus, yet now, the united forces camp has already charged their way into the humans’ primal secret region!”

The sudden shout of anger resonated throughout every inch of space on the entire island. Over 400 universe masters who were still chatting merrily while waiting for the information about the inheritance a moment before were instantly dumbstruck.

“How could it be?”

“Why would the united forces attack the humans at this point in time?”

“We have just reached a compromise internally. How could the united forces attack the humans so soon?”

“Who leaked the news?”

The universe masters on the island were all in rage instantly. The most infuriated one was none other than Shi Hua Island Leader. This could possibly foil all his fine plans.

“Obviously, there is someone amongst us who has leaked the news.” Shi Hua Island Leader’s stern gaze swept across the numerous universe masters. “This… This is dashing the hopes for the future of all our universe masters! This is unpardonable! Of course, I won’t rule out the possibility of an accidental slip of the tongue while conversing with a disciple or friend… but right now, obsessing about trying to find the culprit is pointless. The humans are all in hiding, and the united forces camp can do nothing to them, so the situation is not worsening. What we must do now is head to the human territory right away to join forces with the human camp.”

“All right.”

“True.”

“We will set off now!”

“Not a single universe master here can be left out. Anyone who refuses to go shall cast the most suspicion on himself.”

Some of the universe masters were worried that their hopes of achieving a breakthrough to become universe supreme masters had been dashed. Indeed, they were so mad that they were gritting their teeth to contain their anger. Exactly who was the one who had spilled the beans to the united force camp?

“Setting off.”

“Setting off.”

Soon, six palace true treasures made a mighty appearance up in the sky above the island. Then they made a speedy departure via their god country transportation.

Although they were all from the same alliance, the internal struggles among the cliques formed within the alliance were quite serious. Some scattered races were sworn enemies of one another, so of course, they did not want to work together. As a result, the over 400 universe masters were split into six teams. And with around 70 universe masters in one team, the amount of power they wielded justified their arrogance.

In the primal secret region within human territory.

The nine-story tower stood erected amidst the void space, and in the distance, 11 palace true treasures were attacking in an unrestrained frenzy. They were causing widespread destruction by reducing everything within that void space to an uncountable flow of particles, which then rained onto Star Tower with a rumble.

Peng! Long! Long!

Hong!

The united forces camp was angry, yet they were also anxious. Very soon, the attacks came to a halt because they were all aware that the attacks were a complete waste of their godly powers. The humans were successful in their surprise attack previously because what they were attacking was a pinnacle palace true treasure. Where a pinnacle palace true treasure was concerned, it had close to negligible soul defense ability. But a supreme true treasure was different. If their opponent was hiding within Star Tower and Black Prison Tower, those were completely capable of blocking all kinds of material and soul attacks.

Behind one of the side doors within Star Tower were Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Peng Gong Master.

Even though I had transferred it into Star Tower where I can personally control it, getting it to budge an inch is a challenge to my limits… Now that the endless Remote Ocean is within Star Tower, how heavy is Star Tower now? I really have no idea. And they seek to bombard it away?”

“The united forces camp must be extremely angry,” Peng Gong Master commented while shaking his head. “I’m afraid up until now, they are still oblivious to the fact that every move they make, Teacher Origin is watching, and we will always be a step ahead.”

Even within the human race itself, prior to this, Luo Feng and the rest had also been unaware that Teacher Origin was able to see almost every situation happening to them in every inch of the primal universe—not to mention the other races within the primal universe.

“Let’s wait for the Freedom Universe to arrive,” Primal Chaos City Leader said. “Then things will get so much easier.”

If there was no Freedom Alliance, the united force camp could have bound the humans quite effortlessly, and they could have sustained such bondage for eternity! All that was required of them was to leave behind over 200 universe masters and a portion of their supreme masters as permanent residents. Then the humans would have been completely suppressed. The other universe masters could then take turns to enter Universe Ocean for adventures anytime they pleased.

Seizing all the human territories, then binding the entire human camp were ways to deprive the humans of any room for development.

Very soon—the other races within the human camp would break away because those other races had to think of their own people as well. Yet this would cause the humans to get weaker and weaker, and eventually, it would be hard for them to establish a firm foothold in the primal universe. They might even have to retreat back into their original universe.

“Luo Feng, how could you be so daring as to…?” Primal Chaos City Leader took one look at Luo Feng as he sighed inwardly.

That plan was much too dangerous. Of course, the humans were in no danger at all. The one in danger was Luo Feng—only Luo Feng.

“We cannot do that. With the Freedom Alliance joining us, we definitely have an edge over the united forces camp. Luo Feng doesn’t need to take such a risk… The united force camps will never be able to realize their goal. It is their fate.” Primal Chaos City Leader was still waiting. He was still keeping in touch with Shi Hua Island Leader via the virtual universe, who had, in turn, informed him that the Freedom Alliance would make their way over without delay.

“Huh?”

From within Star Tower, Luo Feng, Peng Gong Master, and Primal Chaos City Leader looked out far into the distance and saw six massive objects making a sudden appearance.

“They have arrived!”

“They have arrived!”

Luo Feng instantly expressed his joy, while everyone else—from Primal Chaos City Leader to the numerous universe masters within Black Prison Tower—were all very excited.

Amidst the void space, 11 palace true treasures of the united forces camp were dangerously near. They had been conversing in secret because they knew that their opponent seemed aware of their plan of a sudden attack prior to their arrival and had managed to make a clean escape before they arrived. Thus, they had been unable to achieve their goal. As a result, they were forced to carry out a most insane war of attrition.

“They are coming.”

“The Freedom Alliance has arrived.”

They all saw the six massive palace true treasures appearing from afar, and those six palace true treasures exuded such a formidable oppressive force that it was obvious that the universe masters inside were doing it on purpose.

The Freedom Alliance’s six palace true treasures arrived in a mighty manner, unleashing such an endless, oppressive force that seemed to proclaim their status as the top group of power in the primal universe through the exhibition of such might.

“Humans, we have arrived.”

“We have arrived!”

This particular area in space might have been under the influence of those supreme masters who were forcing the virtual universe to remain open. All of them had avatars within their own race’s territory. Naturally, they were still able to connect to the virtual universe. This was how the six palace true treasures—apparently each with one representative from the six major factions—remained in touch with the humans.

“Freedom Alliance, what are you waiting for?” Primal Chaos City Leader responded. “Hurry over and help us humans. With both of us joining forces, we can definitely defeat our enemy, the united forces.”

“No hurry.”

“Primal Chaos City Leader, don’t get too anxious yet.”

“You humans must hand the information of the inheritance over to us first! As agreed, before the war, you must give us a portion of it. After the war, you will give us the remaining part. So, you all must first hand over part of the information of the inheritance… After we have seen, verified, and confirmed it, we will help you without reservation. Otherwise, we are in no position to attack anyone.”

“Yes.”

“Give us our share of the information on the inheritance first.”

The leaders of each of the six major factions were of one mind.

Chapter 1304

On an individual plane surface of the virtual universe, within an elegant and quiet hall, there were four stone chairs on one side, and six stone chairs on the other.

The side with four stone chairs had Primal Chaos City Leader, Luo Feng, Darkness Master, and Peng Gong Master. While on the other side, the six representatives from Freedom Alliance were seated on the other six stone chairs. They were also the representatives from the six major factions.

After we have seen and confirmed that you are not messing around with us, we will promise to join your human camp and help you deal with the united forces camp.”

“Dear all from Freedom Alliance, do not worry.” Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Now, I will be giving every one of you here a portion of information of the inheritance.”

“All right.”

“All right.”

From the Freedom Alliance, other than the six representatives who were seated inside the hall, over 400 universe masters waited outside. They could all hear the negotiation going on inside, and the moment they heard that they would be getting the information of the inheritance, everyone grew eager and excited.

“Now, let’s begin.” Primal Chaos City Leader laughed. “Everyone, please look and study this carefully.”

Thereafter, through the virtual universe system, a message was sent out to over 400 universe masters! It contained a large amount of information. The moment these 400-plus universe masters—who had been waiting eagerly while conversing with one another— received this message, everyone instantly quietened down to look through the information carefully. Even Shi Hua Island Master was so filled with curiosity that he had to take a look for himself. Although he was a universe supreme master, he had achieved his breakthrough in a most aimless manner; he had no systematic experience to speak off.

Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, Darkness Master, and Peng Gong Master locked eyes with one another and nodded. They were very confident. Especially Luo Feng! Because this was information on the inheritance he had prepared meticulously. To make it much simpler, many important key points were omitted. Yet no matter what, even after the simplification—and some slight adjustments made by Luo Feng—what the universe masters would get to see would definitely shock them. Because this information on the inheritance was so subversive, it would make this group of universe masters from the Freedom Alliance yearn for the next part of the information even more. Luo Feng was not worried that they would not want to help the humans in this war.

“There is a lot of information,” Luo Feng relayed via voice transmission. “Even if we are to go through the virtual universe to try to achieve the fastest rate of information transmission possible, and even if it was the speed of acceptance of a universe master, it would still take quite a while.”

“Then we just have to wait for a little while longer,” Primal Chaos City Leader said with a smile. “We are inside Star Tower now. There is nothing the united forces camp can do to us… Just wait for a while. Nothing will go wrong.”

“When the Freedom Alliance joins forces with our camp, things will be so much easier for us.” Peng Gong grinned so widely that his eyes curved into smiles, too.

“Yes.” Darkness Master also nodded.

The humans were all waiting.

Time passed.

A lofty, nine-story tower stood erected amidst the void space. Surrounding it were 11 massive palace true treasures of the united force camp and the six palace true treasures of Freedom Alliance.

Hu!

A streak of light dashed across space to arrive at the same place.

“Eh?”

Suddenly, all eyes—be they of the human camp, which was earnestly waiting for the Freedom Alliance’s final reply, or the united forces camp—fell upon this streak of light. Mightily and speedily, this streak of light, which was traveling at a speed that far exceeded the speed of light, dashed into this void space and quickly came to a halt. This was a bizarre true treasure that had eight legs and looked somewhat like the shape of an altar.

This bizarre true treasure was the remarkable Ancestral God Altar.

Ancestral God Altar was a treasure that the primal universe had bestowed upon the Ancestral God School. It might not have been a supreme true treasure and was, thus, nonaggressive, but in terms of its defensive ability alone, it was not inferior to any other supreme true treasure. Being a power that the primal universe was biased toward, the Ancestral God School had certainly received a wide variety of preferential treatment.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, we have arrived.”

“We have arrived.”

“Milky Way, we have arrived.”

“We are a tad slower, but upon receiving the message you transmitted, we gathered and made our way here right away. Now, we have arrived.

One after another, news was being transmitted through the virtual universe.

“Haha! Dear all from Ancestral God School, no one is late at all! The war has yet to truly begin… We are inside Star Tower now. Dear all from Ancestral God School, some of you should come into Star Tower, too. This will be better for our combined force.”

“All right.”

“No problem. Some universe masters of our Ancestral God School shall make their way into Star Tower now.”

Looking up into the void space, the Ancestral God Altar could be seen flying toward Star Tower without a moment’s pause.

In an instant, the two closed up the distance between them. A side door of Star Tower opened while a side door from Ancestral God Altar did likewise. Soon, a black ship was seen flying out of Ancestral God Altar and into Star Tower.

Inside the tower…

“Primal Chaos City Leader, Milky Way Horde Leader, Darkness Master, Peng Gong Master, Long Yan Master…”

The handful of great beings from Ancestral God School that had joined the human camp inside Star Tower all seemed to be very passionate. So, naturally, the humans welcomed them with a passion that matched theirs. Both sides seemed amicable, however…

“This Ancestral God School is quite the sly one.” Peng Gong Master was smiling, but, in his heart, he was transmitting messages to Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and a few others. “They have already gained the part of the information of the inheritance that we have given out. They promised to join our side quite some time ago. Previously, we sent out the news to both the Freedom Alliance and the Ancestral God School at the same time.
