“What should we do?”

“If we had known this earlier, we would not have divided ourselves into six teams. If we were all combined in one team, with over 400 universe masters gathered together, I think at least a few dozen universe masters would be able to resist the impact of being hit by that willpower. Also, with Shi Hua Island Leader around, we would not be taking such a passive approach.”

“Who could have expected Luo Feng would come up with this endless godly ocean water to trap us?”

The Freedom Alliance was filled with apprehension. Earlier, they had decided on splitting up into six teams for two reasons. For one thing, there would be six major factions to deal with the human camp; for another, if they planned to join the united forces alliance, even if any of these six teams were hit by the impactful willpower, at least only part of the alliance would be affected. If they all congregated at the same place, it would mean that their combat power was straight away reduced by 90 percent.

“Hahaha!”

At that moment, even Darkness Master, who was usually so composed and aloof, could not contain his emotions any further. He broke into hearty laughter. That huge, black pyramid shrank rapidly to land within his palm.

“Over 70 universe masters, all captured in one swift move!” Darkness Master stood amidst the mighty godly ocean water and could not help gloating. “Comparing all the universe supreme masters in Universe Ocean, I suppose there won’t be many who have achieved such a great feat.”

Then he looked toward Luo Feng, who was by his side.

He knew that to be able to achieve something so great, there were, of course, many unique factors. For one, they had a strange object like the Ancient God Eye. With its impactful willpower, they could deprive opponents of the advantage of greater numbers. Secondly, with the godly ocean waters and the Five-Color Aurora Lake intertwining and surrounding the enemy, there was no way the opponent could escape. Thirdly, Luo Feng had been—unexpectedly— capable of blocking a soul attack that was jointly launched by over 800 universe masters and over ten supreme masters! This had rendered the united forces alliance helpless before Luo Feng, so they could only struggle within his Remote Ocean.

Darkness Master looked at Luo Feng. “Luo Feng, we have you to thank this time around.”

“Luck,” said Luo Feng. He shook his head. “A combination of various factors allowed us to make it this far. Not one could have been left out. As for my Remote Ocean… moving it about is extremely tough. If the united forces alliance had been able to escape, I think it would have been very difficult to come by another opportunity like this.”

Moving the vast Remote Ocean was indeed extremely tough. If enemies were far off, there wasn’t much Remote Ocean could do. If they had managed to escape this time, they would have had no trouble making it further than this area—a few light years away— unless the humans remained hidden within this area under the influence of the Remote Ocean. If not, once they left this area of influence, without the protection of Remote Ocean, they were bound to be trampled on!

“That’s why!” Darkness Master said in his cold voice, “we need to make good use of this opportunity. Make them fall into your remote ocean, then, in one swift move, capture as many as we can! That way, the number of universe masters in our human camp will greatly increase.”

“True.” Luo Feng nodded with a solemn expression. “Such an opportunity is hard to come by. We must capture as many universe masters as we can.”

Within Black Prison Tower.

Upon being captured, the 72 universe masters from various races heard a voice the moment they fell into that endless dark space, “Dear all from Freedom Alliance, do not worry. So long as you do not treat us as your enemies, and express your willingness to help us, we, humans, will not harm any of you.”

“We are willing to help the humans.”

“We are willing to help!”

“We are willing to join the human camp.”

Many universe masters of the various races were already in great despair, which was why, when they heard the voice, they immediately shouted to express their willingness. Joining the humans’ side was what they had originally intended to do in the past; it was just that Purple Moon Holy Land had offered them more appealing terms. This was why they had decided to help the united forces alliance. Yet, no matter how great the potential benefit, nothing mattered more than being alive.

All of them surrendered. Even those who had other bodies and were thus not facing any life-threatening danger were willing to surrender to the humans! After all, they were unwilling to give up the godly bodies that were mainly used in war. Furthermore, they were also unwilling to give up on the various true treasures they had spent countless years accumulating!

Because Five-Color Aurora Lake and Golden Country were joining forces to keep Xi Qu Starlight River suppressed, the united forces alliance and the Freedom Alliance were unable to promptly learn of each other’s situation. Northern Territory Alliance Master then crossed the distance to directly contact Shi Hua Island Leader, who updated him on the situation.

“The humans have combined the powers of a treasure with impactful willpower, Black Prison Tower, godly ocean water, and Five-Color Aurora Lake when fighting us. They have already captured one of the Freedom Alliance’s teams.”

“What…?”

This piece of news shocked Northern Territory Alliance Master. The humans’ main power was still fighting the united forces alliance. Godly powers were bombarding one another as the battle raged on. So, what was happening here was only for show. The real deal was over at the other side.

Northern Alliance Master quickly transmitted a voice message. “Everyone! The human camp is using a combination of various true treasures, the treasure with impactful willpower, Black Prison Tower, godly ocean water, and several others. They have already captured one of the teams from our Freedom Alliance. Proceed with the utmost caution. Do not let the humans get their way.”

With a move of intention, he transmitted the message via the conscious mind. He had to send the information to every other universe supreme master.

A move of intention was a unique method used by a universe supreme master. To reach the level of a universe master from a normal ordinary great being, they all had to rely on the primal universe origin. Everything about them—for instance, their godly powers—was dependent on what the primal universe origin bestowed upon them, which was why there were numerous laws of the universe origin that they were unable to resist no matter how strong they were. The reason was simply because the source of their strength originated from the primal universe origin.

As for universe supreme masters, they would have their own universe! They relied on themselves! As a result, they could easily resist the beckoning of the dark universe and easily exceed the speed of light to continue to remain within the space of the primal universe. They could also glide across vast stretches of time and space to land somewhere far away.

Of course, they had weaknesses too. For instance, the talent technique given by the primal universe, the ability to divide bodies, along with some other talent techniques, would all be taken away. The primal universe would no longer bestow any kindness to them. They would have to depend on themselves in all aspects.

“Not good!” Father God of automaton race also transmitted his thoughts. Anxiously, he said, “We cannot allow the humans to capture universe masters from the Freedom Alliance as they please. There are many universe masters in the Freedom Alliance. If they are captured by the humans, I’m afraid they will quickly switch sides over to the human camp. By then, the human camp will increase in strength. Even without this godly power of ocean water or any other devious means, they will not fear us at all.”

“Hurry.”

“We shall leave this area under the influence of the remote ocean right away. And we will do our best to help the Freedom Alliance, one team at a time. The more teams we help, the fewer teams the humans capture! The Freedom Alliance has a total of six teams, and one of them is headed by Shi Hua Island Leader, which means the humans will be able to capture as many as five teams. That means over 300 universe masters… Once they are all captured, the number of universe masters in the human camp will soar to more than 500, which makes up more than half the number of universe masters in the entire primal universe! By then, for all eternity, we will no longer be able to suppress the humans.”

“Hurry.”

The united forces alliance was growing anxious, but they were also clear that understanding what to do was one thing; whether they could achieve it or not was another story altogether.

Chapter 1311 - Last-Ditch

Struggle

“Get in, everyone.”

“Get in.”

Father God from the automaton race, Shock Demon Ancestor, Dream Demon Ancestor, Prison Race Devil Ancestor, Holy Master from the crystal race, Bug Empress, Northern Territory Alliance Master, Space Beast Ancestor, Black Universe Creator, E Zhou, Virtual-Real Devil Master, and Shi Hua Island Leader all gathered the universe masters under them back to their world rings or true treasure palaces.

For what it was worth, the united forces alliance team didn’t count on winning anymore. They just wanted to get away while preserving as much power as possible! As long as they could escape Remote Ocean, the humans were still at a disadvantage. However, if the humans captured a group of universe masters, the united forces alliance would lose that group of universe masters, who could add to the humans’ power. The effect was significant.

“Quick!”

Luo Feng transmitted his voice in Remote Ocean. “Uncle Darkness, we need to act now. The united forces alliance is making a last-ditch struggle.”

“Okay.” Darkness Master was nervous.

Mosha body, beside Star Tower, was holding Ancient God Eye, standing on top of the ocean. He turned around and looked at Star Tower, saying, “Teacher, the united forces alliance is making a last -struggle. We need to capture as many universe masters as possible. I’ll go use Star Tower.”

“We have more than a100 universe masters here. We don’t need Star Tower,” Primal Chaos City Leader urged. “Go and capture those universe masters.”

“Okay.”

Mosha Luo Feng waved his hand, and Star Tower shrank and fell into his hands.

Mosha body reached light speed and entered the dark universe, trying to capture the universe masters as quickly as possible.

…

“Larger! Larger! Larger!” A giant silver snake was swimming in the endless ocean, enlarging itself.

Dream Demon Ancestor controlled the true treasure palace. However, when the pinnacle true treasure tried to enlarge itself, it was suppressed by the godly power ocean and couldn’t get larger! It put back his true treasure palace and showed its original body. Its godly body became larger. The ocean’s binding power couldn’t match that of universe supreme master Dream Demon Ancestor. It couldn’t enlarge itself infinitely.

Without restraint, it could enlarge itself like Star Tower. However, if it was confined to a small area, and area would decide how much it could bulge. If it was in a cave on an ordinary planet, it could easily become larger and crash through the resistance! However, in a room in Boat of Mausoleum, even a supreme true treasure couldn’t break through it.

When Luo Feng was encircled by the universe supreme masters in Universe Ocean, of Mausoleum had been devoured by the eternal true god of Divine Eye clan, yet it could still bulge and crash through that eternal true treasure! Ordinary supreme true treasures couldn’t do that.

“Damn godly power ocean.”

Northern Territory Alliance Master, Father God, Shock Demon Ancestor, and Virtual-Real Devil Master were all furious yet helpless. They couldn’t even control true treasure palaces, so they would rather control their own godly bodies. They all revealed their true bodies and started to grow larger.

Although the power of their bodies was stronger than Luo Feng’s godly power ocean, the ocean was performing Duan Mie; the resistance was still strong, and it was only slightly weak than them! Their godly bodies couldn’t be enlarged quickly enough. Generally, they could become ten billion kilometers long immediately, but at the moment, the rate was much slower—a million kilometers, ten million kilometers, 50 million kilometers, 100 million kilometers…

“Larger, larger, larger.” Bug Empress’s Empress Palace was becoming larger at a normal speed.

Empress Palace was a supreme true treasure, so it was strong enough. All the 12 giant objects were bulging, including Empress Palace and the original bodies of the 11 universe supreme masters. Those original bodies—whether they be a silver snake, a wicked giant, a beast, or a beauty—were all growing. 100 million kilometers, 500 million kilometers, a billion kilometers…

The ocean water tried to suppress the bodies, making them slower and slower. Empress Palace, however, was still fast and was already tens of billions of kilometers tall.

The human team watched the 12 giant objects becoming larger and larger in Remote Ocean water.

“They want to enlarge their godly bodies to draw closer to each other so that they can help the Freedom Alliance?” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

He watched the universe supreme masters from the united forces alliance growing. He waved his right hand, and an art valuable floated on the water, quickly becoming larger. A mountain, a lake, and a wooden house!

The mountain, the peaceful lake, and the wooden house floated on the tumbling godly power ocean, which confused all the universe masters from the other races. What was Primal Chaos City Leader doing?

One of Primal Chaos City Leader’s bodies appeared and walked to the mountain while another body walked to the lake.

Weng!

A green sky covered the godly power ocean, and gray land stretched out under it.

Hong!

The wooden house was like the center of the universe, gleaming and covering an area of one square light year! The green sky and the gray land were like two lids, combining into a universe whose center was the wooden house.

The 11 universe supreme masters and Empress Palace all slowed down immediately and sharply. Palm Universe and Five-Color Aurora Lake combined were dissipating the Golden Country of Luo Feng. After all, Golden Country overlapped with Palm Universe.

Palm Universe and Five-Color Aurora Lake. The two of them combined were so powerful that Xi Qu Starlight Lake was annihilated as well.

Father God, Prison Race Devil Ancestor, Shock Demon Ancestor, and the other supreme masters were all nervous. They were struggling and burning their godly bodies, trying to become larger.

The human team only has Star Tower and Black Prison Tower, so they can’t be that efficient. Separate now so that the humans can’t capture many universe masters.”

Shi Hua Island Leader was already three billion kilometers tall and still trying to grow larger. He was in the Freedom Alliance, so he was closer to true treasure palaces belonging to the Freedom Alliance.

One team from the Freedom Alliance was just captured while Shi Hua Island Leader protected another team. There were still four teams left. Their members started to split up. Each team had around 20 universe masters; some of them had bodies, so there were a bit more than 20 bodies.

The combination of those 20 godly bodies was already more powerful than top-tier level six, and it had reached level seven. Attacks at level seven could at least blast away the godly power ocean around them so they could fly slowly. Those separated true treasure palaces flew slowly and were not far from each other. But even though they were not far, it would take more time. And with time flying by, the teams from the Freedom Alliance would be farther from each other.

Hong!

Ancient God Eye and Black Prison Tower combined, swallowed the green, boat-sized true treasure palace. The universe masters inside could do nothing to resist it.

“Capture! Capture! Capture!”

With Ancient God Eye and Black Prison Tower combined, the human team tried to capture as many true treasure palaces as possible.

With time going by, Shi Hua Island Leader was already eight billion kilometers tall. He reached his hands and grabbed a true treasure palace. “Come here!”

The universe masters inside the true treasure palace didn’t struggle; instead, they cheered, “Alliance master!”

Shi Hua Island Leader took it back easily.

He was getting nervous. Shi Hua Island Leader was the closest one to the palaces, so he was the first to act. There were other universe supreme masters in the united forces alliance, too. Empress Palace would enter the area soon.

“I’ll capture them as many as possible.”

Luo Feng stopped thinking.

On the human’s side, every possible asset was being utilized—the godly power ocean, Five-Color Aurora Lake, Palm Universe, Ancient God Eye, Star Tower, and Black Prison Tower. Luo Feng’s Remote Ocean was blocking those universe supreme masters and was also performing Duan Mie to maintain its maximum power. But it still took time to capture them.

Hong! Long! Long!

The largest object from the united forces alliance in Remote Ocean was Empress Palace, which was already 200 billion kilometers tall. Empress Palace was surrounded by godly power ocean winding around it, controlling the palace.

“That Luo Feng’s a handful!” Bug Empress said begrudgingly.

If Luo Feng’s godly power ocean hadn’t been winding around it, Empress Palace would have been ten times taller, and all the true treasure palaces from the Freedom Alliance would’ve been saved.

“Go!”

“Save us, Bug Empress!”

“Come in.”

“Come in.”

A long white arm extended out of the giant Empress Palace and grabbed the palace true treasures. The universe masters inside didn’t resist, making Bug Empress’s efforts much more effective.

Bug Empress and Shi Hua Island Leader were both trying to take as many true treasure palaces as possible.

As for Luo Feng, Darkness Master, and Mosha body, they were divided into two teams capturing the true treasure palaces.

Finally, other than the 11 giant godly bodies and the towering Empress Palace, there were no true treasure palaces from the united forces alliance left in Remote Ocean. Apparently, they had all been taken.

In the endless godly power ocean, Mosha body, Luo Feng’s original body, and Darkness Master stood side by side, checking on the universe masters they had captured. Far fewer than I expected.”

“Hahaha…”

After this fight, nobody would be a threat to the humans anymore!

Chapter 1312 - Settled

Luo Feng, Darkness Master, and Mosha body flew at high speed in the tumbling godly power ocean. They quickly reached light speed and entered the dark universe. They showed up 100 billion kilometers away, gathering with other universe masters from the human team.

“Luo Feng.”

“Darkness.”

The universe masters from the human team were all thrilled, especially the human universe masters. Primal Chaos City Leader said it was around 200!

“Yeah, how many?”

The resistance from the opposite side had indeed made Luo Feng and Darkness Master much less efficient.

The true treasure palaces were generally normal-sized at several million kilometers long. When they were being sucked in, those true treasure palaces shrank to the size of a speck of dust, making them much farther away from Black Prison Tower. Even if they were flying at 100,000 kilometers a second, it still took them a long time to be sucked in.

Of course, Luo Feng and Darkness Master had their ways to cope with it.

All in all, the Freedom Alliance had been trying to resist being sucked in—or at least stall for time—which was why half the members from the Freedom Alliance had gotten away even though Luo Feng had Remote Ocean. However, capturing half was good enough for the humans.

Universe masters from the human team gathered while those from united forces alliance were trapped in Remote Ocean.

All 11 universe supreme masters were enlarging their bodies, trying to escape from Remote Ocean. However, they struggled against the ocean waters. Although Luo Feng was burning his godly power, he didn’t care about that at all. After all, compared to the entire Remote Ocean, the godly power being burned was nothing.

“Get in,” Bug Empress said through her mind. “Everyone, get in.”

“Okay.”

“Okay.”

Shi Hua Island Leader reached out his hands and grabbed the edge of Empress Palace. He shrank and clung to the surface of Empress Palace. Shock Demon Ancestor, Dream Demon Ancestor, Father God, E Zhou, Black Universe Creator, and the others all grabbed onto the surface of Empress Palace.

None of the universe supreme masters got into the palace. They didn’t dare! If they went it, their lives would be in the hands of Bug Empress! They were all carrying universe masters. Bug Empress wasn’t carrying many universe masters, so she wouldn’t turn on them yet, but if they got in and she did turn on them, she would control great power and become the reigning being in the original universe.

All 11 universe supreme masters clung to the surface of Empress Palace.

“Larger, larger, larger!” Bug Empress said, controlling the palace.

Empress Palace was growing larger and larger.

With Empress Palace becoming larger, the universe supreme masters were also moving forward swiftly.

Luo Feng turned around and shook his head. It was easy for a supreme true treasure to be taller than several light years—like Star Tower, which could reach nine light years! With endless godly power, Empress Palace could be taller than more than ten light years. His Remote Ocean body was after a godly body, which couldn’t bulge indefinitely.

Luo Feng stopped hindering them after a short while, as Empress Palace was already over a trillion kilometers.

“Back!”

That Remote Ocean that was already a trillion kilometers long started to retract. Empress Palace faced much less resistance and suddenly became larger. All 11 universe supreme masters fled out of Remote Ocean.

A being in human form, engulfed in flames, floated and exclaimed, “Finally, we got out!”

“Luo Feng’s godly power ocean is indeed a handful. Without Empress Palace, it would’ve taken us a much longer time to get out…” Father God from the automaton race sighed. Facing the endless Remote Ocean, individuals couldn’t flee immediately; the only way was to fly slowly!

The three ancestral gods couldn’t control Five-Color Aurora Lake to continuously suppress them, and Primal Chaos City Leader couldn’t control Palm Universe all the time, as it required too much godly power. Only Luo Feng dared to consume his godly power as much as he wanted. If he was the only one trying to slow them down, they could at least reach one-tenth light speed.

It was difficult to move Remote Ocean, so Luo Feng had to keep enlarging Remote Ocean to stop them. However, he couldn’t enlarge it infinitely, and he certainly couldn’t enlarge the ocean to ten light years long. The united forces alliance could fly for ten years or 100 years and leave the ocean.

“Fortunately,” said Shock Demon Ancestor in a low voice. “It’s almost impossible for him to move that ocean! No wonder Star Tower didn’t move at all; it was hiding the endless godly power ocean the whole time… It’s difficult to move, which means Luo Feng can’t take the godly power ocean out for battle. Even if the supreme true treasure holds the godly power ocean, it can only stay in one spot.”

“If Luo Feng stands still, or a Boat of Mausoleum or Star Tower stand still, we’ll try to avoid them,” said Northern Territory Alliance master. “If he can move easily, it means he doesn’t carry his godly power ocean.”

After that war, Luo Feng was at the top of the list for those universe supreme masters, and they were extremely careful. He was absolutely a risk who should be treated seriously.

“Although the godly power ocean is enormous, Luo Feng’s soul is a human soul to its core!” Prison Race Devil Master said. “Once he becomes a universe supreme master, he’ll return to the origin, and his bodies will be combined in one, turning back to a human! His godly power ocean is enormous, but it’s bestowed by the original universe… Once he makes a breakthrough, his god country will become a miniature universe! His bodies will be combined as one, and his human godly body won’t take that much power. Lots of godly power will be consumed when combining the bodies. Then his godly power won’t be so incredible.”

“That’s right!” everyone exclaimed.

“Yes.”

“When he becomes a universe supreme master and all the bodies return to his original body, he won’t be such a handful in the original universe!”

Luo Feng now had four bodies. All of them could wield power at top-tier level six, yet universe supreme masters only had one body.

Besides, Luo Feng’s endless ocean had limitless godly power, so he was more difficult to deal with than universe supreme masters. Of course, that was the case in the original universe. In Universe Ocean, universe supreme masters were still more terrifying.

“After becoming a universe supreme master, he’ll be on his own. Bodies and inherited techniques will both be gone…” E Zhou sighed. “However, it’s different for Nine Remoteness Master, as his original body is that godly power ocean. Even if he becomes a supreme master in the future, his godly body will still be the godly power ocean!”

E Zhou, Black Universe Creator, Northern Territory Alliance Master, and Shi Hua Island Leader were not worried, as they didn’t have races to care for. However, Shock Demon Ancestor, Dream Demon Ancestor, and Prison Race Devil Master were all concerned about the fight

“Please stop talking about Luo Feng… We’ve lost the fight,” Space Beast Ancestor said in his ancient voice. “What should we do now?”

“That’s right, what should we do?” Father God from the automaton race was worried as well.

Northern Territory Alliance Master shook his head. “What can we do? The human team captured more than 200 universe masters. As long as Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and the other leaders from the human team are suicidal, they won’t kill those universe masters. Instead, they’ll try to draw them to their side. Those captured universe masters will surrender to the humans very soon—for themselves and for their races as well. Lots of universe masters in the Freedom Alliance are close friends with them, and some of them even belong to the same race, so more will be drawn to the humans.”

“Right now, the human team has more than 400 universe masters. As for us, we only have more than 600 even after counting those from the Freedom Alliance. Although we have quite a few universe supreme masters, Luo Feng has four bodies. Plus, we can’t forget Primal Chaos City Leader, Darkness Master, Peng Gong Master, and the three ancestral gods… Combined, they are almost as powerful as us.”

“Although we have more universe masters, they have two mind shock valuables, so they can easily sweep across two of our teams. Besides, the humans will definitely choose the two teams with most members! If we divide them into too many teams, we’ll have weak defense and be conquered one by one.”

“Which means the only advantage we have is neutralized by the two mind shock valuables.”

“They also have a valuable that can control space and time, and the power seems to be stronger than domain supreme true treasures… We don’t have any chance to win, and we can only remain locked in a stalemate. It’s a lose-lose.”

Chapter 1313 - The Dark Flow

Amidst Calmness

Although they were already aware of the situation, Dream Demon Ancestor, Shock Demon Ancestor, Father God of the automaton race, Empress of the bug clan, Demon Ancestor of the prison clan, and Holy Master of the crystal clan—who were all members of the united forces alliance—felt even more frustrated after hearing from the Northern Territory Alliance. There was already bad blood between the humans and themselves to begin with, and with such intense crossfire this time around, how would the humans not bear any grudges? In the future, when the humans grew stronger and more powerful, would they not seek vengeance?

Even so, the united forces camp no longer had the strength to suppress the humans. The advantage of having more universe masters was offset entirely by their opponents’ two treasures with impactful willpower. If they were to really fight all the way, they would be fighting a life-and-death battle—a war of persistence, a war of attrition! Even if a few races were willing to go the distance, the Freedom Alliance, the Northern Territory Alliance, and the Space Beast Alliance would not be willing to do so. And if these alliances did not join in the fight, then depending on the few other races, they would not be fighting a war of attrition; rather, they would be trampled upon!

“This war!” Bug Empress’s voice was brimming with charm as she spoke. “We have already failed! The rise of the human race is unstoppable… When the humans get stronger in the future, the enmity we have formed this time around will be a solid justification to attack us.”

“Yes.”

“That’s right.”

One by one, they all nodded.

“This is why we need to help one another and form a longstanding but dispersed alliance,” said Bug Empress. “An alliance specially assigned to deal with any threats from the humans. This alliance will not ask for anything else—only that in the future, when the threat from the humans becomes overbearing, we help one another and allow our race to survive. What do you think of this suggestion?”

Father God of the automaton race, Devil Ancestor of the prison clan, and the rest all showed approving looks. Northern Territory Alliance Master, E Zhou, Virtual-Real Devil God, and the few other lone travelers were all very easy-going.

“They have retreated.”

“The united forces alliance has left.”

Numerous universe masters stood in the upper skies of the endless remote ocean and looked into the distance. They saw Empress Palace making a hasty departure, moving so quickly that they could detect the waves created within space. Obviously, it was teleporting away. The human camp rejoiced and celebrated. Without a doubt, they had started this war as the weaker party, but by relying on the strength of Remote Ocean, the tables had been turned in just a short period.

Then, mightily, a group of universe masters, including those from Ancestral God School, headed toward the core ground of the primal secret region where the clusters of palaces were. All guards and servants also boarded god country transportation and hastily returned to the primal secret region.

An extremely lavish celebration banquet commenced, and the universe masters from the human race were the most excited ones at the banquet. Universe masters from various other races were delighted, too, because the humans would be having good days ahead, and they, as vassal races of the humans, could look forward to leading better lives as well.

After the banquet, universe masters of the various other races left, but the universe masters from the human race gathered and sat down in various spots. Before them was a simple spread of precious wine and fine cuisine from various parts of the universe.

“Our race managed a definitive victory this time!” Primal Chaos City Leader was tearing up, but his voice was as powerful as ever. “It is fated that our race shall establish a deep and firm foundation within the primal universe. Even if the united forces alliance joins forces with other groups of powers within the primal universe, they will not be able to shake our foothold. Future power and prosperity are within our reach. Our race has lived through Teacher Origin’s era and Huge Axe’s era, and now, we are truly entering an era of power and prosperity.” He sighed. “Teacher Origin once led our race. We rose from a race of humble origins to be ranked as one of the pinnacle races. When Teacher was subsequently subjected to eternal suppression by the primal universe, we were lucky enough, for we had someone like Huge Axe to look out for us. Our position remained unshaken.”

Dead silence. Every universe master was either lost in his own imagination or reminiscing on past events.

“Huge Axe’s annihilation brought us all great pain,” Primal Chaos City Leader said in a low voice. “We had to worry about the safety of our race back then, so all this while, no one really bothered looking into the matter of his annihilation. The story of his sudden annihilation within the core of Tilted Peak Region, deep down in the Land of Darkness, is full of abnormal occurrences… One, the map is fake, so who was the mastermind behind these plots? Two, Huge Axe was undoubtedly aware of how horrifying the Land of Darkness is, so how could he have fallen into it? Three, given Huge Axe’s power, how is it possible that he could be annihilated so suddenly?”

“Of course,” he added in a solemn tone, “the Land of Darkness is the core region of Tilted Peak Sector, so it is extremely dangerous. All of us may know this, but none of us is confident enough, so no one dares to barge their way in.”

“Yes.”

“True, we cannot subject our race to such a heavy loss again.”

All of them nodded. They were all aware that Huge Axe’s annihilation had been a devastating loss for the humans. They could not afford yet another loss.

“This time around, our race scored big time,” said Primal Chaos City Leader. “Luo Feng has made a great contribution.” He looked at Luo Feng. “We should all toast to Luo Feng.”

“Yes, we really owe this victory to Luo Feng.”

“To Luo Feng!”

Everyone raised their glasses and looked at Luo Feng. They saw for themselves and knew that Luo Feng had made the greatest contribution—especially when he used his endless Remote Ocean to resist the soul attack from the entire united forces alliance. How terrifying it had been! But Luo Feng had actually managed to survive while taking it entirely upon himself to resist that attack. At that time, they were all filled with immeasurable gratitude and admiration.

Luo Feng quickly picked up his glass. “Honestly speaking, I kind of caused this disaster by receiving that ancient civilization’s voice transmission. I also made a mistake.”

“How is this considered a mistake?” someone called out. “Our race is so powerful now, all thanks to this ancient civilization.”

“Come, let’s have a toast.”

“Cheers!”

Luo Feng was left with no choice but to respond to every single toast.

Primal Chaos City Leader saw the situation and smiled. Without further ado, he said, “All right. Now, let’s discuss another matter. This time, we captured a total of 208 universe masters. First, we will need to rope them into joining our camp, that’s for sure. Their presence will strengthen us. Second, we still need to practice caution so as to prevent them from betraying us. Third, how are we going to prevent them from betraying us, and how are we going to win them over so that they feel a sense of belonging for our camp? How do we get them to join our side willingly? Everyone, share your thoughts…”

One by one, the universe masters proposed their suggestions.

Soon, a simple yet effect proposal was implemented.

Firstly, because the situation in the primal universe was still dangerous, the majority of the universe masters would definitely stay together. Since the original universe was so massive, sending almost all the universe masters to the original universe was a confirmed arrangement. After all, if they were all widely dispersed, it would be terrible if they all took off.

Second, they should not bring out the anger and dissatisfaction of these universe masters. That was why, for every ten eras, every single universe master would be given a period of one era during which they were allowed to roam about the primal universe and Universe Ocean to their heart’s content with absolute freedom! After all, great beings spent the majority of their time on cultivation. When they were cultivating in the original universe, they only had one-tenth of the time when they were absolutely free. This was a way of pleasing those universe masters. At the same time, as the universe masters would take turns having this “free time,” it was also a good way to guarantee that at least 80 percent of the universe masters would remain in the original universe at any given time!

Third, those universe masters would surely be concerned with the safety of their own races. This was why several universe knights would be deployed to the races in question, where they would remain as permanent residents! These universe knights were stationed there mainly for security purposes. When dangerous situations arose, these universe knights would be the ones handling them, but when there were extremely difficult situations, the headquarters of the human camp would immediately send a group of universe masters to render assistance.

Fourth, there would be gradual sharing of detailed information about the ancient civilization on how universe masters could achieve breakthroughs to become universe supreme masters. The longer these universe masters remained within the human camp, the more information they would be given. This was a way of instilling a sense of longing within these universe masters.

Fifth, while roaming within Universe Ocean, the help rendered to the universe masters had to be reinforced, so that the universe masters would be able to see how strong the humans were—and also realize the benefits of having such strong backing.

The human camp started planning. Those universe masters whose fates rested in the hands of the humans most certainly had no other opinions. They were glad to oblige! Purple Moon Holy Land universe.

Indeed, without the help of Purple Moon Ancestor, this reincarnation era of the primal universe would, normally, only be able to breed 20 to 30 universe supreme masters! With Purple Moon Ancestor’s help, perhaps they might be able to bring this number up to around 100.

Every reincarnation era had a batch of universe supreme masters. How many universe supreme masters did that mean? Yet the number who could transcend their reincarnation era was just two!

Lightwalker Master personally visited the various races like the bug clan, the demons, the automaton race, and the prison clan and imparted the complete inheritance information to them one by one. Chapter 1314 - Hu Yan Bo

The war among the top beings from almost all the superpowers in the original universe was over, yet the ordinary life forms didn’t know anything about it. Lower-tier wars would be catastrophic to them, yet the war among the top beings didn’t affect them at all. Of course, if one side lost, the beings in their territories would be ruthlessly slaughtered.

The united forces didn’t win. The human team didn’t lose. This was how the war had ended!

It could have been foreseen that the two teams would keep fighting each other for a long time. Unless one side was absolutely confident that they could crush the other side, such a large-scale war wouldn’t happen again.

Hu Yan Bo had died, and Yun Mo Star had been destroyed! However, since Babata had become undying, he had rebuilt Yun Mo Star quickly, taking back the power area that had previously belonged to Hu Yan Bo before (except for the area around Earth).

Purple stars shone their light upon Yun Mo Star through dark clouds. On Earth were warriors gathered from all kinds of planets; they were trained strictly on the planet, while warriors most loyal to the master of Yun Mo Star would be chosen from among these candidates.

“Come at me, idiots from A Luo Star!” a giant being roared at the camp opposite to him. “I’m right here waiting! Come if you can!”

“What a maniac! Are you suicidal?”

A voice came from the camp. “Don’t worry about that maniac.”

Babata spent so much time rebuilding it. It seems Hu Yan Bo does have a strong impact on him.” Then Luo Feng kept flying.

He flew relaxedly. Neither the security guards nor the other means of detection spotted him. Some warriors flew past in front of him, but they didn’t notice him either. This was what true control over space and time meant.

He flew for a while as he wanted to observe Yun Mo Star, and it took him a while to arrive above a black castle.

Luo Feng looked down and shouted, “Babata!”

On the throne inside the palace sat a child in a black cape. He had two antennae on his forehead and red eyes. His face was chubby. He may have looked cute, but the female servants from other planets who were performing down there knew how terrifying he was.

Shua!

In the sky above the black castle, the silver-caped form of Luo Feng stood in the sky, and a black-caped child appeared beside him.

It was like a spring bouncing back! Luo Feng didn’t have to endure any burden if he decided not to save anyone, but there would be a price to pay if he wanted to bring back lives by taking them from the past to the present. The punishment was actually for Hu Yan Bo and his nine soul slaves, yet Luo Feng was the one who bore it, as they couldn’t. To Luo Feng, it was easy for him to revive universe knights, not to mention some undying fighters.

After a while, Yun Mo spaceship floated in the sky. Apparently, Lu Feng had even brought back Yun Mo Star spaceship from that time. If a being was still alive, he couldn’t bring it back. As for objects, however, they could be brought back even if they still existed. For example, an existing true treasure could be duplicated by bringing one from the past when turning back time. The punishment for this, however, would be horrifying. It would cost more to bring back a single true treasure than to get ten new true treasures.

Of course, the punishment for bringing back Yun Mo Star spaceship was nothing to Luo Feng. After all, Yun Mo Star spaceship wasn’t even a treasure.

Hua!

The handsome, black-caped man looked at Luo Feng, then noticed black-caped child beside him. “Babata!” he yelled.

This man was both like a big brother and a father to him. “Big brother, big brother, big brother…” Babata kept shouting as he embraced Hu Yan Bo, and his voice showed how much he had missed Hu Yan Bo.

Luo Feng looked in the distance and sighed. Babata was indeed close with Hu Yan Bo.

Hu Yan Bo and his nine slaves were all dazed. They all had the memories from the past, so they all knew that they had died… Yet they had been brought back now!

A universe master turned back time and revived them? How?

“Milky Way Horde Leader?”

Hu Yan Bo and his soul slaves were all bewildered. Of course, they knew Milky Way! Hu Yan Bo had a land in the Milky Way, yet they had never heard of any “horde leader.” They hadn’t expected a Milky Way Horde Leader to be here after being resurrected, and they couldn’t imagine that Babata—who had previously been an intelligent life form—was an undying emperor stronger than all of them now. After all, Hu Yan Bo was only an official.

“How long have we been dead? Ten million years? 100 million years?” Hu Yan Bo couldn’t help asking. “And who is this Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng?”

“Milky Way Horde Leader is one of the top beings in the human race, and he’s also one of the supreme beings in the original universe,” answered Babata. “It was Master Luo Feng who turned back time and resurrected you all. That is Master Luo Feng…”

He pointed at Luo Feng in the distance.

Hu Yan Bo and his slaves turned around to look at the silver-caped man standing in the distance. Their attention had been entirely on Babata. Until he pointed at Luo Feng, they hadn’t even realized he was standing there.

Hua!

The silver-caped man walked forward, which astounded Hu Yan Bo and his slaves. Amazing! This was a being who could turn back time! They were nothing in front of such a being.

“Teacher Hu Yan Bo,” said the silver-caped man.

Chapter 1315

After a while…

Though big brother did that Milky Way Horde Leader a favor, we didn’t know him. Who wouldn’t be scared of a powerful being like him? He might be able to kill us with one look.”

We didn’t know him directly, so we need to be well-behaved. Even if he owes me a favor, I can’t be reckless. Otherwise, I’ll be in trouble.”

Everyone around him nodded.

There was an ancient proverb on the Earth: “To be in the king’s company is tantamount to living with a tiger.” When facing a being with absolute power, one needed to be careful—even if that being owed a favor

Like a king on the earth, universe masters who could slaughter the beings on billions of planets and reserve time to save countless beings were held in awe by ordinary undying fighters. Most undying fighters couldn’t hope to even see a universe master in their lives.

The yellow-skinned man behind Hu Yan Bo said, “Babata, you need to tell us the stories about this Milky Way Horde Leader.”

When they first met, Luo Feng had wanted to talk with them about his stories, and Babata briefed them, too. Hu Yan Bo and his slaves understood how they were connected to Luo Feng. However, after Babata finished briefing them, Hu Yan Bo and the others all looked incredibly nervous. I’ll tell you something about the catastrophes on Earth and the War of Talents…”

In the Milky Way, Luo Feng walked along in the quiet space.

The higher his status became, the lonelier he felt. His family—like his wife, his children, and his parents—would never be estranged from him. But the same could not be said of his friends. Even those friends he had fought with—like Rong Jun and even Hong and Thunder God—would be estranged from him. Luo Feng actually felt quite lonely. When he was resurrecting Hu Yan Bo and the slaves, he couldn’t help recalling all those friends he’d had before. Like Fire Hammer Squad, when he had first became a warrior! Like his friends who had died during the fight against the swallowing beast (the Golden Horned Beast). He had transferred its soul to him, yet the others died.

Could he resurrect them? No, he couldn’t. Although universe masters could reverse time, he wasn’t able to revive his mates from the past. Those heroes who had died fighting the swallowing beast were only at the star traveler level, so they only had 1,000 years to live! If he tried to resurrect them, he could indeed locate them. The punishment of turning back time could be borne by Luo Feng, but the passage of that time had to be borne by them.

Undying fighters could easily bear the passage of time. As for his mates from the past, their bodies would immediately weaken and decay with the passage of time, and without multiple bodies, their souls would quickly be gone. Luo Feng couldn’t help them at all, even if time was turned back.

This was one of the weaknesses of turning back time. It wasn’t perfect, as there were several exceptions to its abilities.

Luo Feng sighed and flew to the palaces in the distance. It was the holy land of Milky Way, where Luo Feng’s palaces were situated.

After arriving back at the Milky Way, Luo Feng reconstructed the time and space around his palace. Through his control over space and time, he isolated the space and time of the area from it. Even if ordinary spaceships went by, they couldn’t enter this space and time. After that, Luo Feng began his first practice after becoming a universe master!

In Luo Feng’s home in the Milky Way, he had garnered great fame thanks to the unprecedented war that had involved almost all the supreme beings in the original universe. Also, Luo Feng’s home was called “Milky Way Holy Land” or “Milky Way Den” by the other races on the outside.

It was where Luo Feng lived. Even an army couldn’t do anything to him, not to mention the others.

In Milky Way Holy Land, Boat of Mausoleum—which was ten billion kilometers long—slowly floated through space. Luo Feng was practicing in the space of inheritance inside it.

“Ever since I created the blade technique and got the inheritance, I haven’t created any blade techniques.” Star Tower started to float on Luo Feng’s palm. “I have Star Tower, too, yet I can only utilize the third-level engravings, and it’s already as complex as Nirvana Incarnation.”

Normally, it was easier to easier to utilize engravings than to create techniques! For example, universe masters like Peng Gong Master, Darkness Master, and Star River Master hadn’t created universe-supreme-master-level techniques, yet they could utilize engravings at that level! And the fact that Luo Feng was able to create a blade technique at that level meant he could utilize engravings more advanced than that.

Star Tower is the most mysterious true treasure I have, Luo Feng thought. Both Boat of Mausoleum and Shi Wu Wing are of the machine type, and they both have apparent functions and power limits. As for Blood Shadow Blade, it’s only an embryo, and all the techniques need to be created by me. Only Star Tower is so mysterious!

Before the war, Luo Feng had been confused as to why Star Tower had such strict requirements for master recognition. However, he hadn’t yet discovered the full extent of its unique capabilities, as he hadn’t been strong enough.

After the war, Luo Feng learned the first special advantage of Star Tower: It was much more efficient in guarding souls than other supreme true treasures!

“I’ll comprehend them carefully now.”

Luo Feng immediately started to comprehend the engravings now.

The time in the space of inheritance was ten thousand times faster than that outside, making it more efficient… After becoming a universe master, Luo Feng could finally start to improve his power comprehensively, trying to maximize his power at this level.

Hundreds of years passed, which was much longer on the outside.

Luo Feng opened his eyes in the space of inheritance after a long time and frowned. “Ancestral God School is looking for me?”

He took out a token, which had been given to him by the Ancestral Gods after he became a sub-member of the Ancestral God School.

“I need to go see the Ancestral Gods?”

Luo Feng was confused. If he was still at a mediocre level, it would have been normal for the Ancestral God school to give commands, but he held a different status now. His power had manifested in the previous war. Only under special circumstances would the Ancestral God School look for him. Besides, even if they actually needed him, they could have sent a prophet instead of summoning him directly.

I talked with all three Ancestral Gods after the war, and none of them is arrogant, thought Luo Feng. There must be a reason why they’re summoning me.

He was already a pinnacle being in the original universe, and there had to be mutual respect when great beings talked with each other!

Shua!

Luo Feng disappeared.

Ancestral God School, Bauhinia Island in the Ancestral God Secret Region.

The palace where Luo Feng lived was still there. A silver-caped being appeared, followed by a dimming light. It was Luo Feng.

“It’s been a long time.” Luo Feng looked around.

Chapter 1316

In the primal secret region of the human territory.
