Chapter 1330 - Coincidence

That enormous thing was flying, yet nobody noticed it.

In the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector, a white boat flew by, and Luo Feng was sitting it. That white boat was Boat of Mausoleum, which had changed its size and color. It was a machine type valuable, so it could change its appearance. However, it still had to be in the shape of a boat.

“Okay, I understand it. Rest assured.”

Luo Feng’s mind answered in the virtual universe. His target was Pei Xing Master, so he needed to locate him first. After all, Pei Xing Master wouldn’t just stay in one place and not move.

“Pei Xing Master was found 11 years ago,” whispered Luo Feng. “It’s Ice Flower Rock World in Tilted Peak Sector. It might take me around 80 years to get there. That Pei Xing Master is indeed adventurous. I’ve been in Tilted Peak Sector for 200 years, and I still haven’t found him. I can’t believe a new universe master can be this mad.”

Luo Feng failed to imagine the passion and ambition of a universe master who had been suppressed for 18 universe eras and finally got the chance to enter Universe Ocean.

Don’t disappoint me, Luo Feng thought. I chose you over the valuables left by Jie Fan Zi.

He then smiled awkwardly. He had already traveled several times to the green keepsake space where the valuables from Jie Fan Zi were left. The first time, he had entered Universe Boat and fought Five Chaos Master. He had gotten trapped in the ninth abyss, yet he had put away the valuables from Jie Fan Zi because of the inheritance from Duan Dong River. The second time, he had gone to get the white wing, and after getting it, he had separated his two bodies. However, Huge Axe had suddenly died, so Luo Feng had summoned his golden horned beast body.

This was the third time. He had been flying in Universe Boat for 400 years, and he had suddenly learned about Pei Xing Master.

“There’s a saying from my home planet, Earth: ‘Good things are a long time in coming,’” Luo Feng whispered. “I failed several times. Can there be some surprising gifts in the green keepsake space of Jie Fan Zi?”

Actually, he didn’t care much about that keepsake space. To him, other wings of Shi Wu Wing were obviously much more important than the valuables left by Jie Fanzi. He turned around the second he learned about Pei Xing Master.

“Perhaps there is a happy surprise.” Luo Feng smiled, closed his eyes, and kept practicing.

Ice Flower Rock World of the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector.

The white boat was flying in the sky.

“Huh? Nothing?” Luo Feng sat in the hall of the boat. He had four wings on his back. “When I sensed that white wing, it was dozens of light years away from me. Yet now, I can’t sense anything? Either that wing isn’t the one I want, or he’s not in Ice Flower Rock World anymore.”

Luo Feng frowned. He looked at the outside world. There were giant flowers growing in Ice Flower Rock World. The flowers looked beautiful, but there was a sense of killing hidden in them. The entire space was made up endless flowers.

“What should I do? I can’t find them anyway.” Luo Feng frowned.

It was very difficult to track a great being in the three Lands of Extremis. After all, it might take someone several eras for a great being to wait for a valuable to be born. Even though the intelligence network of the Hong Alliance was impressive, there hadn’t been any updates on Pei Xing Master’s traces.

“Hmm.” Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed. “Perhaps I can do this…”

Luo Feng smiled. He had a thought, and a being showed up, which was a golden horned beast. It was carrying a pair of white wings.

When I was looking for Heavenly Yang Knight on the original stars, I only had one pair of wings, thought Luo Feng. I could only sense the white wings when I was close enough to Heavenly Yang Knight. With two pairs of wings, I can feel it dozens of light years away in Tilted Peak Sector—even with the waters and wing space in the middle. Apparently, the more wings I have, the stronger than summoning will be. If I combine all three pairs of wings, the detection distance will be far!

The detection distance of one pair was less than ten billion kilometers. The detection distance of two pairs was dozens of light years.

What about three pairs? Hundreds of light years? Thousands of light years?

No matter how dangerous the inner area of Tilted Peak Sector was, Pei Xing Master had been in Ice Flower Rock World 90 years ago, and a universe master wouldn’t be able to go too far. Luo Feng should be able to sense it.

White wings, Luo Feng thought.

The pair of white wings merged with the back of the earthling original body. Just as they merged, the four silver wings and the white wings integrated like gears, forming six perfect wings after connecting with each other.

Weng!

The six silver wings on Luo Feng’s back suddenly shook.

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed, and he looked exhilarated. “The summoning! That direction!” Luo Feng looked at a direction in the distance, as he could clearly sense the summoning coming from there! “Other wings of Shi Wu… There they are!”

Luo Feng was thrilled. It didn’t matter whether those wings belonged to Pei Xing Master or not. There was a summoning, so there were wings in that direction.

“Let’s go!” Luo Feng drove Boat of Mausoleum and raced toward along that direction.

Luo Feng understood that the sensing was mutual, and if the other side ran away, it would be a trouble for him. However, the other side didn’t know where the summoning came from. A great being in the three Lands of Extremis would only think of it as an opportunity, so they wouldn’t run! Besides, Luo Feng was closer to the exit, while the other side was farther away. Even if he was trying to run, Luo Feng could stop him!

Luo Feng dashed toward the other side with his craving for those wings.

The waves were tumbling and sweeping through the area. The space was annihilated every time it was hit.

A strange, three-level tower was on the waves.

“That direction…” All four faces of Pei Xing Master looked confused. “My wings?”

The black wings on his back were trembling.

“Summoning! Something’s calling me!” Pei Xing Master was excited. “Am I really that lucky? I’ve stayed in the holy universe for 18 eras, and my chance comes right after entering Universe Ocean?”

In the holy land, Pei Xing Master had heard a great deal about the dangers and opportunities in the three Lands of Extremis! He’d been expecting the chance for a long time, especially after hearing that a brat who had only practiced for fewer than 20 eras had obtained the Duan Dong River inheritance that even the ancestor wanted.

“Humph! With my power, as long as I don’t meet a universe supreme master, I’ll be safe.” Pei Xing Master was very confident. He had fought quite a few universe masters before, and even universe masters at top-tier level five couldn’t hurt him. “It’s in the inner area, so universe supreme masters shouldn’t be here. Even supreme masters need to show some respect for Purple Moon Holy Land.”

Pei Xing Master’s interest was piqued. He flew in that direction with his palace true treasure. The farther he flew, the more confident he got.

“Haha! The valuable summoning me is also flying toward me. It must be carried by a universe master, and that universe master also senses the summoning.” Pei Xing Master was content. “Based on his speed, he must be a universe master instead of a supreme universe master.”

Pei Xing Master grew more excited after confirming that the individual on the other side wasn’t a supreme universe master.

They could feel each other, and they were racing toward each other as fast as possible.

“Only the stronger one can win. The stronger one will get the valuable.” Pei Xing Master was growing more and more excited. “I just left the holy land, and I’ll be renowned in Universe Ocean!”

Universe masters from holy lands thought differently, as they had eternal lives. Some loved adventures, some loved killing, and some wanted to be renowned in Universe Ocean like Pei Xing Master. It was quite normal for universe masters to have such thoughts.

“Sheesh… They’re coming really fast. Great!” Luo Feng accelerated his Boat of Mausoleum. The wings on his back were shaking vigorously, and the calling was getting stronger and stronger. “It saves me time. I’ll kill you instantly.”

Sparing this being’s life? Luo Feng didn’t even consider it.

Since the Purple Moon Holy Land had already given a killing order, he didn’t need to show any mercy to their beings.

More than 20 years passed, and they got closer and closer to each other. The calling was driving both of them mad.

“Incredible, incredible.” Pei Xing Master felt that the four wings were trying to fly away. The summoning made Pei Xing Master’s godly body tremble. “What kind of valuables have such strong summoning? Are my wings parts of a supreme true treasure?”

Pei Xing Master was excited. Ah! he thought. Could I have such a great chance, too?

“If even that human Luo Feng can get the Duan Dong River inheritance. Why can’t I get a supreme true treasure? The individual on the other side only has a component, so he might not have realized how precious it is.”

Pei Xing Master’s heart was racing. They were drawing closer to closer to each other.

In the sky above the mountains, two traces of light flew toward each other—one from the left and one from the right.

“Here it comes.” Pei Xing Master was ready to attack. “I’ll stay in my true treasure palace first. I just entered Universe Ocean, and I rarely show my true treasure palace. Few know about it. If I show my palace, he’ll know that I’m good at binding and that he won’t be able to get away if he’s trapped. He might fly away now.”

“I’ll show my true self later,” said Luo Feng. “He might run away if he sees my face. Though I can trap him with Golden Country and Snow Sand Ocean, it’ll still take me a lot of time. I might as well save some time. Such a competitor! I might just give him a quick death.”

Luo Feng stayed in the white boat and didn’t leave.

They kept approaching each other.

Just when the two true treasure palaces were only a billion kilometers away from each other—

Hong!

Pei Xing master with four faces and 16 arms had his four black wings wide open and appeared in the space. He thought it was close enough.

Chapter 1331

“There is no escape for you!” said Pei Xing Master as he looked at the white jade boat in the distance away. He was filled with fighting spirit, and the four black wings on his back were shooting out five streams of light rays, representing the five laws of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth. The might of these five light rays soared up high in the sky—high like a rainbow—and immediately moved over to enshroud the white jade boat in the distance.

From Pei Xing Master’s point of view, even if the other party stayed hidden within the palace true treasure, he would still be able to trap him by using a restraining technique. Then he could direct the other party to some extremely dangerous environment within the internal domain of Tilted Peak Sector, where he could make use of it to kill the other party. Then the treasure would be without a master. Just the beckoning of mutual attraction between the treasure and him would bring it flying over to him.

“My precious.” Pei Xing Master was looking forward to laying his hands on the treasure.

“Pei Xing Master!” shouted a voice.

“Huh?” Pei Xing Master was shocked. Suddenly, something felt wrong. He could see the white jade boat stopping too, and walking out of it was a man with six silver wings.

Pei Xing Master momentarily rejoiced at the sight of the six silver wings; his wings were originally silver, too. But when he saw the man… his expression changed instantly.

Human. Black hair. Silver wings. It only took a fleeting moment for a name to surface in his mind—Luo Feng!

The one person he was most jealous of! How could he not recognize him?

Without a palace type supreme true treasure in hand, any universe master who crossed paths with Luo Feng had no chance of survival.

“No!” Pei Xing Master turned around and flew straight into the three-story minaret behind him.

He knew there was no escape. But he was reluctant to admit it! He had been in the holy land universe for as long as 18 reincarnation eras—a very long time. And finally, he had made it here to the Universe Ocean. He felt that his name had just started to make an impact within Universe Ocean, so he couldn’t bear the thought of dying now. Although he knew he could not escape, he still longed to run away. He would try his very best to hang on to even the slightest hope of survival.

“Why are you trying to escape?” Luo Feng shook his head. “How nice if we could have a conversation.”

Luo Feng stretched out his left hand, and in the middle of his palm was a miniature Star Tower.

Hua!

Star Tower flew out and expanded rapidly. A deep abyss black hole appeared at the base level and took aim at the faraway Pei Xing Master. An incomparably strong suction power was directly exerted over Pei Xing Master, causing Pei Xing Master—who had previously been flying toward the three-story minaret right next to him—to instantly let out an anguished howl.

Pei Xing Master, void of any strength for resistance, was pulled toward Star Tower.

“Why—why can’t you give me a chance? Give me a chance for survival!” Pei Xing Master did not even have the motivation to put up a struggle anymore. Previously, he was still hopeful that Luo Feng would not execute any of his killer moves. Then with that little amount of time, he could perhaps try to make a hasty escape.

From a universe master’s point of view, being sucked into Star Tower was an absolute nightmare! He had not expected Luo Feng to execute such a killer move the moment he arrived.

“You are so cooperative,” said Luo Feng. “If only you weren’t from Purple Moon Holy Land, I might still spare your life. What a pity that you are from Purple Moon Holy Land. Your only option is annihilation.”

Luo Feng shook his head. Star Tower, originally exerting a suction force, was instantly driven to the fourth layer of secret engravings by Luo Feng and started executing the technique of “Smashing.”

To make things efficient, Luo Feng also executed Extermination!

Hong!

With extreme might, Star Tower bombarded Pei Xing Master’s four-faced head at lightning speed. Pei Xing Master had 16 arms, and all 16 tried to stop Star Tower at the same time. Unfortunately, they were instantly smashed to ashes, and Star Tower continued smashing all the way to the head of Pei Xing Master. Shortly after…

Peng!

Complete annihilation.

Using power that was at the eighth tier as the top level against Pei Xing Master was immensely effective. He had just come out of his holy land universe without any pinnacle true treasure armor, and his defense level of godly power was barely comparable to a power that was at fourth-tier as the top level. He was simply too weak. Pei Xing Master’s only merit was his ability to restrain. His combat power, defense ability, and other forms of abilities were only at the fourth-tier standard; he was only good at restraining and escaping. These two skills were considered to be at the fifth-tier standard but were not enough to be considered as the fifth-tier as the top standard yet. So by using an eighth-tier as the top level power to kill a universe master who only wielded a fourth-tier as the top level power, the difference was four levels apart.

It was akin to a fifth-stage top-tier existence (like Primal Chaos City Leader) killing a first-stage top-tier existence (like someone who had just become a universe master, whose life gene was merely at 100 times, and who owned true treasures of inferior quality— theoretically speaking, the weakest kind of universe master). Of course, with one swift move, it was an instant kill! After all, it was an attack with a strength that was similar to that used to attack Great Thunder Star Master. Using power at this level to attack a universe master whose defense standard was only at the level of the fourth tier as the top level… Naturally, the task was a piece of cake.

One smash from Star Tower, and instant annihilation was achieved.

Various kinds of true treasures—like a suit of armor, wings, and a three-story minaret—were left floating about the surroundings.

Sou!

Two pairs of wings that had turned back to silver wings instantly transformed into silver light and flew to Luo Feng without further ado.

“Keep.”

With a wave of his hand, Luo Feng claimed the two pair of wings and all other true treasures that had once belonged to Pei Xing Master. For the time being, he was not keen to look into what kind of treasures Pei Xing Master had. After all, how many precious treasures could someone who had just come out of a holy land universe possibly have? To be able to own two pairs of wings was already quite impressive.

“Wings.”

Luo Feng caught hold of the two pairs of wings that were flying toward him. With a grin, he flew back into his little, white jade boat. Shi Wu Wings were a super strong treasure. The combination of the wings exuded an aura with an oppressive force that was extremely strong. It would be better for him to experiment within the Boat of Mausoleum.

Purple Moon Holy Land universe.

“No! Luo Feng!” A bitter and shrill roar was heard, then Pei Xing Master’s avatar, sustained by his godly power, instantly disappeared.

The guards that were standing outside the palace were shocked. Their noble universe master—what had happened? His avatar, sustained by his godly power, had disappeared?

Annihilated?

“Huh?”

In the core region of Purple Moon Holy Land universe—where the universe origin was—a purple figure turned around to look into the distance. His gaze bore through the obstructions in time and space to look at the palace. After all, this was his miniature universe. Everything that happened in this miniature universe, so long as he had the intention of looking into them, could bring about the reversal of time and space to investigate anything that happened.

He held Luo Feng in high regard. Besides, a universe master under his command had been annihilated, and before he was annihilated, he had shouted Luo Feng’s name. Of course, this would raise concern.

“Pei Xing? Annihilated? By Luo Feng?” Purple Moon Ancestor immediately sent his command via voice transmission. “Jue Hua!”

“Ancestor.”

Within his own godly palace, Jue Hua True God suddenly heard a voice ringing in his mind, without further ado, he responded with deference.

Purple Moon Ancestor continued to give his command. “Pei Xing Master has been annihilated, most likely when attacked by Luo Feng. Send my orders… All of my universe masters who are within the surroundings of Pei Xing Master’s residence must exercise extreme vigilance.”

Jue Hua True God was shocked beyond words. Pei Xing Master was supposed to be in Tilted Sector Region, was he not? And Luo Feng should have been in the Universe Boat, right? Yes, Luo Feng had been missing, without a trace, for a long time. When considering the fastest speed a universe master could travel at, he would most likely make it to the region where Pei Xing Master’s place of residence was. Without further ado, he replied, “Yes, Ancestor. I will transmit your orders right away.”

The black, little boat was advancing through space at high speed. Obviously, that was Luo Feng, who had once again changed the color of his Boat of Mausoleum.

The reaction that Purple Moon Holy Land would give in response to Pei Xing’s annihilation was not Luo Feng’s concern. Right now, his focus was entirely on his Shi Wu Wings.

Hong! Long! Long!

Amidst the space of inheritance and within the Boat of Mausoleum, Luo Feng looked up into the sky and saw five huge, outspread wings having a whale of a time. The five pairs of wings were crazily connecting and corresponding with one another, exuding bouts of oppressive force. The oppressive force was getting stronger with the passage of time—even stronger than any other supreme true treasures like Black Prison Tower, Yan Jun Rod, or Great Thunder’s battle armor. It was stronger than everything else Luo Feng had encountered so far.

“Only five pairs of wings, yet the oppressive force was so ridiculously strong. How precious indeed.”

Luo Feng was in awe.

Everything was within his expectations. After all, the two pairs of wings were only inferior to a supreme true treasure, so what if there were three pairs? Or four pairs? Or even five or six pairs? According to Luo Feng’s speculations, it should have been higher than an ordinary supreme true treasure by several levels. After all, these two pairs alone were only second to a supreme true treasure. So, theoretically speaking, three pairs of wings that corresponded to one another should already possess the power of a supreme true treasure.

In midair, the evolution was still in progress. Internally, the five pairs of wings were continuously evolving and combining, which might bring about the integration of various secret engravings to form a more extensive and complex diagram of secret engravings. Then, finally, everything came to a rest.

“Shi Wu Wings.” Luo Feng pointed afar, and his godly power was immediately infused into the wings. “Huh?” he whispered. “Indeed, there are injuries.”

He would not have known if he had not made the comparison. Compared to the previous two pairs of wings, which had been restored after absorbing the internal blade energy of the ‘origin,’ these two new pairs of wings were obviously one notch lower. Especially when godly power was circulating within the two pairs of wings… their powers were obviously greatly reduced.

“The last time, a large amount of internal blade energy of the ‘origin’ was consumed, I was hoping this time would be more energy-saving. And also, the sixth pair of wings is yet to be found.” Luo Feng sighed.

Hong!

Luo Feng had placed the origin within the first pair of wings of Shi Wu Wings. At that moment, as he manipulated the two new pairs of wings into absorbing energy, a tremendous amount of blade energy with extremely terrifying power suddenly came gushing out from the inside the origin.

Streams of blade rays visible to the naked eye came surging out from within. These blade rays were circulating in continuous motion about the surface of Shi Wu Wings—especially before the third and fourth pairs of wings—like water flowing through a dry riverbed. The moment these circulating blade rays touched the two pairs of wings, they would be swallowed.

“I will need to wait slowly.” Luo Feng sat down right away, cross-legged, and waited quietly.

He was experienced. The previous time, to restore the two pairs of wings, swallowing energy from the origin had taken around half a day.

Time passed. After around 35 hours, the frightening ripples within the upper space started to disperse and finally, everything stopped. It was essential to know that every blade ray wielded an attack that was more terrifying than an attack by any universe supreme master. Even a pinnacle palace true treasure, upon being attacked by a blade ray, would be shattered and reduced to ashes. How strong such a ripple was!

“Shi Wu, how much energy from the origin have you consumed?” Luo Feng asked right away.

“Previously, I consumed about two-tenths,” Shi Wu replied. “This time around, the amount should also be around two-tenths.”

Luo Feng heaved a sigh of relief. Still acceptable.

Internally, the amount of blade storm energy of the origin left was still around six-tenths! With only the last pair of wings left, even if it required restoration, there should have been enough energy.

The energy within the origin was infused by an existence that far exceeded a universe supreme master. Whether it exceeded it by one level or even more than one level, one thing was for sure: It was definitely above that of a universe supreme master! Such an existence facilitated the conversion of conserved energy within the origin. It was absolutely the greatest trump card anyone could own. It might have been the most terrifying trump card possible.

Unconsciously, the energy that dispersed in all directions would sweep up everything in its path. It would destroy pinnacle palace true treasures, and if all of this energy were gathered at one point, any supreme true treasure in its way was destined for destruction. Especially when it was executed through blades. Then it would be even more terrifying.

All this while, Luo Feng still had not used it. While he was in the primal universe, he could not bear to use it; yet, when he was in Universe Ocean, there was no need for him to use it.

The primal universe had an ironclad law: Any attack executed by an individual great being, regardless of how powerful it was, would be suppressed to the level of sixth-tier as the top. And once there was an outburst of energy from the origin that originated from any great being, it would be suppressed by the law of the primal universe to the level of sixth-tier as the top. If that happened, Luo Feng would greatly regret this opportunity—would he not?

He might have suspected that the origin of the primal universe could be suppressed, but he was unwilling to take that gamble. After all, this origin within Universe Ocean was certainly powerful enough to sweep up everything.

However, in Universe Ocean, the appropriate opportunity was essential. After all, given Luo Feng’s current ability, he was capable of dealing with most of the dangers in his way.

“Come here!”

With a move of intention, the five pairs of wings rapidly descended from the sky above and integrated themselves onto Luo Feng’s back. With ten widespread wings on his back, Luo Feng activated his godly power.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

Silver armor extended out of Shi Wu Wings and very quickly moved to entirely envelop Luo Feng.

“Battle armor? At the level of a supreme true treasure?”

Luo Feng was dumbfounded.

Chapter 1332

Luo Feng hadn’t expected to get his godly armor in this way, even though Peng Gong Master’s Yan Jun Rod and Huge Axe Creator’s godly axe could both extend and form armor! Luo Feng had owned three pairs of wings before, yet they didn’t extend to form armor, so he hadn’t expected this. Even though Pei Xing Master had black armor and black wings, Luo Feng hadn’t anticipated that the black armor was an extension of the wings.

The five pairs of wings merged with Luo Feng’s body. Under Luo Feng’s godly power, his wings extended, covered his body, and formed a suit of godly armor.

The spirit of Shi Wu transmitted a message in his mind. “Master, this is the subsidiary armor of Shi Wu Wings. It’s a supreme true treasure armor.”

The message amazed Luo Feng. “Supreme true treasure?”

“Shi Wu Wings were a machine type valuable used by a being much stronger than universe supreme masters,” said the spirit of Shi Wu, sounding upset. “Two pairs of wings are only inferior to supreme true treasures, and three pairs can already rival supreme true treasures. As for four pairs, they are already more powerful. The wings you have now are from the first, second, third, fourth, and sixth pair.”

Luo Feng nodded.

He had acquired the first, the second, and the sixth pair before. And he had seized the third and the fourth pair from Pei Xing Master. “Only adjacent wings can perfectly integrate with each other,” said the spirit of Shi Wu. “There are still some inconsistencies between the sixth pair and the first four pairs… The power can’t multiply well. However, the first four wings are already perfect. They definitely surpass ordinary supreme true treasures, and even the subsidiary armor can rival a supreme true treasure armor.”

Luo Feng rejoiced. He had seen the endless power in the wing space before, and he knew that Shi Wu Wing was extraordinary. With more and more wings being integrated, it was indeed getting stronger.

“Why couldn’t the first two wings form a suit of armor?” asked Luo Feng.

“Master, the wings of Shi Wu Wing have different functions,” replied the spirit of Shi Wu, continuing to send messages. “The first and the second pairs of wings are like the foundation—like the roots of a tree. They are the base. With other wings being integrated, other powers will come. I presume that the third to the fifth pair of wings have subsidiary powers, and the sixth pair is for attack!”

Luo Feng nodded. It made sense. The first and second pairs of wings were like the foundation of a skyscraper—the keel of a ship!

“I see. Attack type supreme true treasures can all extend to form armors!” Luo Feng exclaimed. “Machine type valuables are quite variable and have all sorts of uses! They’re also good at fighting those above their level! How can they not extend to form armor? I only have the armor now because this machine type valuable isn’t complete yet. Shi Wu, what’s the power of this godly armor? Be more specific.”

“Firstly, attacks under level eight can be completely neutralized by godly armors,” said the spirit of Shi Wu. “Attacks over level eight can be weakened to 1/1,000,000th. Besides, the godly armor has a high limit. At least no universe supreme masters can reach the limit.”

Luo Feng was amazed. Attacks under level eight can be completely neutralized? And attacks over level eight could be weakened to 1/1,000,000th? That wasn’t too amazing. After all, even Crazy Demon Extermination Godly Armor could weaken the power to 1/100,000th.

However, the limit couldn’t even be reached by universe supreme masters. What did it stand for? It meant the weakening power of 1/1,000,000th could be completely utilized! The more powerful an attack was, the less efficient the weakening power of an armor would be. If the enemy was too strong, it might only be able to weaken it to 1/1,000th, 1/100th, or lower, which made him more dangerous.

Crazy Demon Extermination Godly Armor was impressive at the universe master level. However, when fighting universe supreme masters, its limit would often be exceeded.

“1/1,000,000th? Perfectly utilized?” Luo Feng was shocked. “That means universe supreme masters who have supreme true treasure armors can never be killed by material attacks from other universe supreme masters! Right.”

Luo Feng nodded. It seemed to be true. Those with supreme true treasure armor couldn’t be killed by material attacks. Only some dangerous places in the Lands of Extremis could kill them. Teacher Origin was great at soul attacks at top-tier level ten!

“With that subsidiary armor, I won’t need to fear any material attacks anymore.” Luo Feng was the essence of confidence. “However, I can’t get trapped in a fight for too long.”

Attacks were different from defense. Attacks were aided by techniques and true treasures, and they had no upper limit! As for defense, it depended on the armor! Weapons could help sometimes, but the armor was the most vital part. If someone was too weak to defend himself, he had to resort to armor, as only armor could resist material attacks.

Even if the armor can weaken the power to 1/1,000,000th, my godly body will still be consumed, Luo Feng thought. Universe supreme masters have enormous godly bodies and high-level godly power… I have a small godly body and low-level godly power, and I need to maintain Duan Mie. If I get trapped in a long fight, I’ll be doomed.

Luo Feng understood that he needed to finish a fight quickly.

Compared to real universe supreme masters, one of his weaknesses was that he couldn’t get trapped in a long fight. Also, he couldn’t exceed the speed limit. Of course, he had Star Tower, Blood Shadow Blade, the subsidiary armor of Shi Wu Wings, and Boat of Mausoleum to make up for this.

The five wings were open and floating in front of Luo Feng.

He infused his godly power into the wings and studied Shi Wu Wings. He had found that his Shi Wu Wings were very special. Valuables like Star Tower or Black Prison Tower had many different levels of engravings, but his Shi Wu Wings were exceptional and only had four levels of engravings.

The first pair of wings contained the first level of engravings. The second pair contained the second level of engravings. And the fourth pair contained the fourth level of engravings.

There were only four levels. The first level was called space and time in chaos, and the second level was called Golden Country. The third level…

“The third level is beyond complicated.” Luo Feng frowned. He had already spent more than an era studying the engravings in the space of training. “It’s more complicated than the fifth level of engravings of Star Tower.”

That was how it was. As a machine type valuable, there were few levels of engravings, yet the quality was outstanding. Undying-level Luo Feng could have fully comprehended the first level easily.

As for the second level, he had practiced in Beast God Sector for more than 100,000 years and had reached universe master level on the engraving picture path before he had fully comprehended the second level and practiced Golden Country.

As for the third level, it was too complicated even for him. The gap between each level was exceedingly large.

But Luo Feng wouldn’t give up easily. He could sense that the subsidiary armor was only a side power. The engravings contained on the third wing were truly amazing, which was why he devoted lots of his energy to studying them.

Time passed.

Boat of Mausoleum started to leave Tilted Peak Sector. It spent around 300 years to do so, and 300 years was equivalent to 300 eras in the space of training!

Over the course of 300 eras, Luo Feng spent most of his energy studying the godly power path. As for the rest of his energy, he spent it on the third level of engravings of Shi Wu Wings…

“Too difficult… I can’t understand them. I can’t!”

Boat of Mausoleum flew out of Tilted Peak Sector. Luo Feng shook his head. “I think it’s as complicated as the sixth level of engravings of Star Tower.”

The sixth level of Star Tower was at top-tier level eight! Universe supreme masters like Great Thunder Star Master and Father God of the automaton race could understand the engravings at that level. As for those more powerful, like Huge Axe and First True Master, they could comprehend the engravings at top-tier level nine. Teacher Origin was able to comprehend those at top-tier level ten.

“I’m only a universe master. After I created a blade technique at top-tier level seven, I can comprehend engravings at top-tier level seven or level eight.”

Luo Feng understood that he needed to create superior blade techniques to fully comprehend the engravings at top-tier level eight. He needed a fundamental improvement. Could universe masters create blade techniques at level seven?

None of the great beings in Universe Ocean thought it was possible. However, those great beings also thought that universe masters couldn’t even create blade techniques at top-tier level six, yet the selection criterion for Duan Dong River inheritor was to create a blade technique at top-tier level six as a universe master.

“Based on the records, many talents from the ancient civilization created techniques at top-tier level six as universe masters. All the inheritors of Duan Dong River did that. Creating techniques at top-tier level seven as a universe master was rare in the ancient civilization, yet half the inheritors of Duan Dong River did that. Only two inheritors from Duan Dong River created techniques at level eight as universe masters, including the ancestral teachers.”

Luo Feng had made a decision. After creating Nirvana Incarnation, Luo Feng hadn’t created a better technique. He had much better training conditions after getting the inheritance, and it was likely that he could create a technique at top-tier level seven. He had to train himself as a potential talent like those from the ancient civilization.

“It might take me a long time to become a universe supreme master. I’ll try to improve my power as much as possible. I’ll let them know that after getting the inheritance from Duan Dong River, I can be their better even as a universe master.”

He then decided to temporarily give up comprehending the third level of engravings of Shi Wu Wings and to turn to the godly power path and blade technique creation.

“I can now…” In the chaos air, Luo Feng was driving Boat of Mausoleum and going to Universe Boat to get the valuables left by Jie Fan Zi. “I can totally go look for the last pair of wings. One pair has a very short detection distance. Two pairs of wings can detect through dozens of light years. Three pairs of wings… When I first detected Pei Xing Master, we flew toward each other for around 20 years. The distance must have been thousands of light years, and the summoning was very strong, which means three pairs of wings can detect 10,000 light years.

“That means… For each additional pair of wings, the detection distance must be 1,000 times farther. Four pairs of wings can probably detect tens of millions of light years, and five pairs of wings can probably detect billions of light years.”

Luo Feng was thrilled, as a miniature universe only had a diameter of 100 million light years. The three Lands of Extremis were only 100 million light years. The holy lands were larger but were still only at billions of light years.

“If the last pair of wings is hidden in one of the miniature universes, I’ll be able to sense it if I fly closer to those miniature universes.”

Luo Feng grew even more excited. He only had the last pair of wings left for Shi Wu Wings.

“I’ll go find where the last pair is.”

Luo Feng couldn’t resist the temptation anymore. He immediately drove Boat of Mausoleum and flew toward the nearest miniature universe.

As for valuables left by Jie Fanzi, he would deal with those after getting the sixth pair of wings.

Chapter 1333

The younger a miniature universe was, the closer it was to the original universe, like Primal Chaos City Leader’s, Teacher Origin’s, and Bug Empress’s. The miniature universes from the second universe era were farther from the original universe; those from the first universe era were even farther, and the two holy lands were quite distant from the original universe!

Luo Feng nodded. That sounded right. Even those who were powerful found it difficult to attain supreme true treasure. It took him nine days in Universe Ocean.

Shua! Shua! Shua!

It seemed that a summoning was coming from Purple Moon Holy Land.

“Summoning!” Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed and gazed at the gigantic Purple Moon Holy Land in front of him. “The sixth pair is in Purple Moon Holy Land!”

He had been craving for them for a long time. He wanted to dash in, but he wasn’t stupid enough to do so.

He would leave this issue to the Hong Alliance.

Chapter 1334

On board his Boat of Mausoleum, Luo Feng entered the internal region of Universe Boat, persevering through numerous terrifying, dangerous domains. Looking ahead into the vast space, he had already arrived at the domain where the space of the cyan token secret chamber was.

Hong!

Luo Feng was inside his Boat of Mausoleum, looking far into the distance at the numerous buildings suspended on huge leaves. He drew nearer to try to feel the place out.

Roaming the three most dangerous lands only required a trace of his consciousness. He mainly focused his spiritual energy on cultivation. After two days, Luo Feng found the secret chamber within the space of the cyan token’ that belonged to him.

The little, greenish-black boat reduced speed and slowly descended on a huge leaf. The cabin doors opened. Luo Feng walked out and raised his head to look at the building before him.

With a wave, Luo Feng put away the Boat of Mausoleum. Then he slowly walked toward the ancient building. The moment his body touched it, he felt as though he had touched the surface of water; he penetrated right through to enter the internal space of the secret chamber.

Luo Feng appeared in midair and looked ahead. Amidst the void space, there were nine huge, blazing fireballs, each bigger than any ordinary star by 1,000 times. These nine fireballs were suspended high within the void space, and they were moving in a circular motion.

With one step forward, he teleported himself over to the continent. The expanse of the landform was vast. The scroll was densely covered with a mass of characters that Luo Feng was not familiar with, yet every character contained ripples that transmitted information, so Luo Feng had no trouble understanding the text.

“I, Jie Fanzi, am a special life form, I became an undying cultivating the water law and have been cultivating since I became a universe supreme master. After I became a universe supreme master… one fine day, while I was living a peaceful life on a certain planet, I was struck by a sudden thought. On this life planet, life required water to survive, so water was the origin of life. But the entire planet needed to rely on the heat of the stars to absorb energy for all life forms to grow.

“The water law and fire law. These are not as simple as how we have all used to comprehend. They were not as simple as two individual laws. Water and fire both involve the origin of life—the origin of all forms of life and the origin of reproduction. Therefore, I have created my own studies, a new body of lost knowledge—Water and Fire Origins.

“I have traversed the primal universe, and when the primal universe came to an end, I moved on to observing Universe Ocean and comprehended two reincarnation eras… Water and Fire Origins was getting more complete, and I believe that if I had been given enough time, I would have been able to attain an even higher level in order to transcend reincarnation. But I did not have enough time… I may have achieved a combat power that was at tenth-tier as the top level, but still, I am not confident of achieving a breakthrough to transcend reincarnation. Water and Fire Origins was created with great efforts. After spending a long time—three reincarnation eras—I am most reluctant to see it disappear. My wish is that any later generations will be able to take on what I have comprehended and continue to pass down this legacy of mine.

“The nine fireballs in the surroundings of void space are unique objects from Tilted Peak Sector of the Universe Ocean. They are nine ‘iced crystals’ that have been transformed into nine fireballs by my Water and Fire Origins. They represented the peak of my accomplishment. Now that the nine fireballs have become one, their might should not be spread to the outside world.

“Under this great continent, there is a pinnacle palace true treasure. Inside the palace, you will find all the treasures I have left behind, and you will also find a low-to-high-level inheritance of the lost knowledge I have created. I truly hope that my descendants will not let my life’s work, my legacy, be lost for good.”

On the scroll high up in the sky, upon seeing the information that was transmitted via the characters made out of fire snakes, Luo Feng took in a deep breath. Tenth-tier as the top? Water and Fire Origins?

“Indeed, every generation will give rise to at least one peerless figure who is unparalleled in demeanor and talent,” said Luo Feng, in awe. “This Jie Fanzi actually possessed combat power at the tenth-tier as the top level. This would have been comparable to what Teacher Origin already achieved previously. He must be one of the greatest figures during his era. No wonder… No wonder he was so fixated on his legacy. It seems like his ‘Water and Fire Origins’ was indeed a body of lost knowledge that he had created and was incomparably proud of. This must be why he was so reluctant to see his efforts go down the drain and his legacy discontinued.”

Of course, in terms of talent, Jie Fanzi was still no match for Teacher Origin. After all, Teacher Origin had already attained the tenth-tier as the top level when he was still within the primal reincarnation era before being eternally suppressed. On the other hand, Jie Fanzi had taken a total of three full reincarnation eras to reach the tenth-tier as the top level.

However… Throughout the Universe Ocean—other than Teacher Origin and the ancestors of the two holy lands—the next-strongest in line today were all great beings at the level of ninth-tier as the top. This showed how talented Jie Fanzi really had been.

“Water and Fire Origins—the origin of life? The origin of all forms of life and of reproduction?” Even Luo Feng was touched when he learned all this.

Previously, the laws that he had cultivated, whether gold, wood, water, fire, or earth, were the most fundamental laws. Furthermore, he had always cultivated them as individual laws. Never had it crossed his mind that something as simple as an individual set of laws could contain the mystery of the origin of life.

If this body of lost knowledge was merely an ordinary kind of creation, then even if it were to be discontinued, there was no loss worth lamenting. But something as unique as Water and Fire Origins, which far surpassed what other supreme masters had created… Such a body of lost knowledge was truly something worth being proud of.

“A peerless figure in demeanor and talent,” Luo Feng lamented. “Yet he was gone, just like that, without even achieving a breakthrough of a reincarnation era. Transcending reincarnation. Oh, transcending reincarnation! How difficult it truly is! Keep!”

With a random flick of his hand, Star Tower flew up right away. Following the guidance of Luo Feng’s godly power, the nine huge fireballs high up in space were quickly sent right into Star Tower.

“Rise!” Luo Feng looked toward the continent at his side.

Hong! Long! Long!

The continent split apart, and a palace emerged from beneath. Sandstones separated into two sides, revealing a palace in its entirety.

Luo Feng sent a trace of his godly power penetrating through this palace, and soon enough, he had made this palace true treasure recognize him as its master.

“The treasures inside…”

After this pinnacle palace true treasure had recognized Luo Feng as its master, Luo Feng could quickly learn how many treasures were inside. After sorting and summing up everything, he had a clearer picture of the treasures Jie Fanzi had left behind. What he had summed up dealt Luo Feng with a good shock.

Although there were no supreme true treasures, this pile was still much more than what he had gained from killing Great Thunder Star Master (adding on the gains from sweeping through the miniature universe). There was a total of 32 pinnacle palace type and domain type true treasures. And a total of 91 ordinary pinnacle true treasures (top-tier domain type true treasures were considered to be on this level).

Ordinary top-tier true treasures, senior true treasures, and ordinary true treasures were very few. The total might have only added up to slightly more than 100. Perhaps these did not appeal much to Jie Fanzi, who was simply not interested in them.

As for the large amount of various precious treasures, materials for refining true treasures, treasures for restoring godly bodies, and treasures for increasing the amount of life genes… there were many of all these, too.

In fact, this was considered normal. The wealth of a race was mainly created by universe supreme masters. Supreme masters who were lone travelers—regardless of whether it was Jie Fanzi from eras ago, Sitting Mountain Guest, Shi Hu Island Leader, or several others of the current era—had no need to worry for any race. The treasures they obtained were theirs to keep, yet the treasures they had were in no way inferior to those owned by an entire race!

Jie Fanzi’s combat power was at the level of tenth-tier as the top. During his era, he had once swept through the entire Universe Ocean with his great might. His only problem was that he was obsessed with the Water and Fire Origins. He was very ambitious by nature. If he had put his heart into plundering, he would have gained even more treasures.

But the amount of treasures he had was considered normal, as he had been collecting for the long period of three reincarnation eras.

“So many treasures. Therefore, I will be able to repair the final injury on the white wings of my Shi Wu Wings.”

Luo Feng was happy when this realization dawned upon him. With a flip of his hand, a fist-sized, spherical crystal stone appeared in the middle of his palm. “Let’s take a look at this Water and Fire Origins.”

The moment Luo Feng laid eyes on it, he was immersed. He was pleasantly surprised at what he saw.

The knowledge of Water and Fire Origins was so mysterious and magical that it qualified to be ranked within the core inheritance of the pulse of Duan Dong River. The pity was, Jie Fanzi had only managed to comprehend the fundamentals of the lost knowledge of Water and Fire Origins. Yet even though the fundamentals were just built, the magical side of this lost knowledge could be subtly observed.

“According to what the lost knowledge of Water and Fire Origins describes…” Luo Feng said to himself. “Reaching the peak of this place, with a single move of intention, and taking the two origins, water and fire, as the core, I can instantly develop a true universe. When there is a war, the surroundings of my body can instantly become a true miniature universe. Forcing the enemies into this miniature universe, there will be no way they can survive, right?”

Chapter 1335

Luo Feng had been reading it for half a month, and he sighed, shaking his head, “What a shame. A peerless great being just died like that. If he’d had more time, he could’ve transcended incarnation and created another holy land. Unfortunately, that last step… He got stuck at the last step.”

It was almost impossible to transcend incarnation. Otherwise, there would have been more holy lands.

It was a powerful and special technique that pointed to the origin.

Water and Fire Origin could help a bit as well. Actually, starting from all the ten basic laws was the most efficient way! It was easier to use all ten basic laws. As for Jie Fanzi, he only used fire and water, so he had encountered too many obstacles and had finally died.

A great being could only use a certain number of true treasures. Jie Fanzi had too many true treasures, so he could only leave them in the storage.

Luo Feng had obtained many true treasures this time, so he would leave several for himself, giving all four of his godly bodies better weapons and armors. However, he alone couldn’t use that many true treasures. He would rather leave them to his race, like Teacher Origin and Huge Axe Creator.

Boat of Mausoleum became a silver boat. Luo Feng took the silver boat to the Lands of Extremis. The 600,000th year after Luo Feng started to tour Universe Ocean, in Flowing Level Mountain.

Hong! Long! Long!

Luo Feng didn’t need to rush it. It was going to be a long fight between him and Purple Moon Holy Land.

Time passed.

Luo Feng journeyed in the three Lands of Extremis. 90 percent of the universe masters from Purple Moon Holy Land went back to the holy land after learning that six universe masters had been captured. In a remote area of Universe Ocean where no great beings had been before…

Ten years, 100 years, 1,000 years, 10,000 years…

100,000 years, a million years…

Luo Feng had been traveling in Universe Boat for more than eight million years when the giant object, which had maintained a speed that no universe supreme masters could ever reach, finally entered the area where there were powers from Universe Ocean.

Chapter 1337

Bigger than a miniature universe! And a speed that was beyond one’s wildest imagination!

Swirling Water River!

Hong!

Within the universe of the Divine Eye Clan’s First True Master, an unlucky universe master reported to First True Master, recounting the events he had experienced.

Weng!

Sou!

Hong!
