Hua! Hua!

How endless and boundless!

After more than eight million years, the volume of the vast Remote Ocean—compared to its volume back when the humans and the united forces alliance had been engaged in war—was now exponentially greater! The endless Remote Ocean had such a commanding presence within the primal secret region that every great being who came to the primal secret region was shocked and amazed by it.

“This is the endless Remote Ocean!”

“Endless Remote Ocean? It is one of the godly bodies divided from the main body of the legendary noble, Milky Way Horde Leader. It is said that, back during the war, close to 1,000 universe masters from the united forces alliance joined forces to attack Luo Feng, but no one could do anything to this Milky Way Horde Leader!”

“How…? How big must it be?”

“Such a big godly body. Even if it continues to blaze its godly power, the time taken for the entire godly body to be completely consumed will definitely be very long.”

A spaceship flew along the length of the sky of the endless Remote Ocean. In that spaceship, there were some undying fighters and sector lords who were looking out from where they were. They were gazing at the endless Remote Ocean, and all of them were feeling very excited.

In a long period of over eight million years, the human race’s status within the primal universe had become even higher than before! This was because small-scale skirmishes between the human camp and united forces camp had been ongoing! It was common for a great many sector lords, undying fighters, and knights to engage in battle. Occasionally, there would also be battles between universe masters! Regarding the news about the war, the human race would have made it widespread so that the human sector lords and undying fighters would be filled with fighting spirit and confidence.

Furthermore, under the deliberate guidance of the human race, the generations of new and upcoming sector lords and undying fighters would never forget the names “Primal Chaos City Leader” and “Milky Way Horde Leader.” Probably those sector lords and undying fighters were not really clear on what it meant to be a universe supreme master, but there was one thing they were all clear on: Within the entire human race, the most important and most powerful two existences were Primal Chaos City Leader and Milky Way Horde Leader. The two of them were powerful pillars of support for the entire human race!

“This other body of the noble Milky Way Horde Leader—exactly how big is it?”

“The endless Remote Ocean is said to be constantly expanding. Previously, I received information that the diameter exceeded one trillion kilometers. Now, it is surely going to be much bigger than that.”

Everyone was engaged in a heated discussion.

An undying emperor who was driving this spaceship—a lean yet thin man with a headful of golden scales—spoke up. “The endless Remote Ocean body of our noble Milky Way Horde Leader is currently at a diameter that exceeds two light years!”

“Two light years?”

“Wow! That is a really massive godly body.”

“Back then, close to 1,000 universe masters worked together, yet they were still unable to harm Milky Way Horde Leader. Now, he must be invincible.”

“Invincible.”

The numerous sector lords and undying fighters were all in awe and filled with admiration for Milky Way Horde Leader.

The spaceship flew across the sky of the endless Remote Ocean while everything else remained as peaceful as ever within Remote Ocean. At the moment, the emphasis on the cultivation of human talent was greatly increased, especially after the knowledge of the ancient civilization was transferred over to the human race. Therefore, sector lords and undying fighters were frequently sent to the primal secret region for cultivation and training or sent to Primal Chaos City for cultivation.

In short, the sight that greeted anyone who happened to pass by the endless Remote Ocean would definitely leave one astounded.

At that moment, in the deep central region of endless Remote Ocean, there was a vacuum with a diameter of around 10 billion kilometers. In here, not a single drop of ocean water could be found. It was as though the core of the entire endless Remote Ocean was a gigantic bubble, and within this vacuum, a great number of items hung suspended in the air.

All kinds of metals, minerals, soils, and liquids… Within a diameter of 10 billion kilometers, how vast a region would that be? Yet this region was almost filled to capacity. It could be said that every kind of substance that could possibly be found within the primal universe was present here—whether they were existing substances found normal to star traveler level, star level, neutron star, black holes, and many other places, or mysterious substances like special life forms of seeds of life and undying trees, or even a portion of the corpses of billions of life forms from the billions of different races found within the universe and corpses of special life forms.

The dead and the living were present here—from the primal universe, from the universe ocean, and even from the World of Jin! One trillion types of metals! One trillion types of special energy bodies! One trillion types of plants! Every single kind of substance! To every single living life form! They ranged from beings as minuscule as single-celled organisms to as complex as a whole universe masters or true god corpses! Even that drop of godly blood from the pair of white wings, which Shi Wu Wings had forced out of itself.

All of these things were stored here.

“Inherited technique—Create!”

An inherited technique was executed again.

Suddenly, everything within the region seemed to fall into a peculiar domain, and this domain was unobtainable through cultivation. It was a kind of domain that was naturally brought about during the execution of the inherited technique “Create.” Anything placed within this peculiar domain would be speedily analyzed, and it would also analyze the life origin of whatever was being analyzed.

“Such a large quantity of countless metals and plants, especially the large amount of true gods’ blood, scales, and many more from the World of Jin. I really hope that this time around, I stand to gain big time!”

Luo Feng held high hopes, looking forward with incomparable eagerness. Previously, taking the godly power route, he was stuck at the bottleneck, mainly because there were too few true gods’ life forms to be analyzed! Although there might be one drop of powerful godly blood, that drop was too high-end; any analysis of it could not be understood.

Soundlessly, those drops of blood, pieces of scales to strands of hair suspended in the air were continuously being analyzed, and the most fundamental structure composing the life origin appeared before Luo Feng.

How complex! It was more mysterious than the Rhinoceros Emperor Game—far exceeding any Rhinoceros Emperor Game that Luo Feng had researched. After all, this was the life composition of a true god! Fortunately, Luo Feng did not need thorough research. All that was required of him was to find the difference between the structures of a true god and a universe master. From there, he could change his own life structure to increase his life gene level.

“Haha… So much true gods’ blood, scales, and hairs…! How very satisfying.”

In an instant, Luo Feng discovered millions and billions of concepts, but none of these concepts were destined to be suitable for him.

While the endless Remote Ocean was analyzing samples, Golden Horned Beast was in the World of Jin, hiding within the space of cultivation of the space of inheritance as it maintained time acceleration at a rate of 10,000 times. It was also training.

“Godly power, break down.” Golden Horned Beast Luo Feng made a move in his mind.

Hua!

Suddenly, one of Golden Horned Beast’s clawed hooves broke down into a large quantity of godly power that was suspended over the surroundings.

“Life, recombine!”

The internal life composition within his godly power was instantly controlled and modified by Luo Feng. It was as though he was making changes to his life genes! Previously, the gene level had been perfect, and the life structure was stable. It was difficult to break through and surpass. Recombination of godly power failed!

“Trying again!”

Having gained such a large amount of true gods’ blood, scales, and hairs over time, Luo Feng was bound to develop a great deal of thoughts and concepts. Naturally, he would want to constantly put these through trials, and through these trials and experiments, he could probe the mysteries of life.

“Failed!”

“Failed!”

“Recombination has failed!”

Every failure was experience gained. All paths eventually led to the same ending. Life origin was one of the kinds of origin that had come into existence due to the evolution of the universe, and it contained the ultimate mysteries. Starting out from such a godly power route would be greatly beneficial to Luo Feng’s ability to create secret techniques.

Time passed, but with time accelerated to 10,000 times within the space of cultivation, 160 went by in the blink of an eye.

“I will succeed. I have a strong feeling that I am about to succeed. Previously, I only missed by a little bit… Life, recombine!”

The clawed hoof of Golden Horned Beast, which had settled down within the space of cultivation, had transformed into a tremendous amount of godly power. This godly power was rapidly going through a change. The innermost structure of its origin was undergoing a change.

Buzz!

Everything ceased moving. Luo Feng also stopped controlling and eventually came to a stop. If he failed, then his godly power, which the origin had changed, would rapidly be broken down and then be returned to its original form. If he managed to stabilize its existence, that might possibly mean success. After all, even if he did manage to stabilize it, the new structure of life origin might not necessarily exceed the limit of perfection. It might, on the contrary, even be reduced. For instance, it could reach 9,800 times life gene level…

“It has stabilized!” Luo Feng was delighted. “Level of godly power…”

Luo Feng carefully felt his godly power. This was a new godly power —a godly power that was so strong that it carried a sharp keenness as though it might attack at any moment.

Luo Feng was able to make a rough judgment instantly and was delighted. “16,000 times! I’ve succeeded! I have broken through the bottleneck of perfect gene level!”

If he had continued to study about law masters and the other countless substances, perhaps he might have achieved a breakthrough. But that was too difficult. A true god’s life origin was obviously far superior, and it had inspired Luo Feng with countless ideas and provided him with an untold number of possible routes. After being stuck at a bottleneck for more than eight million eras, now, in a situation where he had enough true god’s blood, scales, and hair samples, all he required was slightly more than 100 years to achieve a breakthrough.

“Godly body, recombine!” Golden Horned Beast Luo Feng let out a low growl.

Hong!

The entire Golden Horned Beast disassembled with a loud crash and transformed into a mighty godly power. Shortly after, a large amount of godly power rapidly condensed back to form a golden horned beast. This new one may have looked the same as the former, but its aura was obviously much stronger.

“Godly body, recombine!”

Luo Feng’s earthling original body, in the Boat of Mausoleum, instantly underwent a recombination of his godly body. Its life gene level soared to 16,000 times right away. The quality was increased, no doubt, but its godly body was reduced as a result. Only 60 percent of his earthling original body’s godly body remained.

“Recharge.”

Golden Horned Beast rapidly charged up the supply of godly power, allowing the earthling original body to speedily recover to a state of 100 percent godly body.

“This feeling is wondrous!”

Luo Feng revealed his delight. He felt as if his godly body was all revved up, and even the distant god country was itching to make a move. His godly body had become more powerful and thus, was able to accommodate a more powerful god country! His god country would only need to expand once more. Then it could immediately evolve into a miniature universe.

This all implied that so long as Luo Feng was willing, he could bring his god country to evolve into a miniature universe. And thereafter, his godly body would zoom its way up to an increase of 100 times! Then he would enter the true god stage!

Now, it was merely 16,000 times life gene level. It was still far from Luo Feng’s personal expectations; rather, this level was not a great help to his ability. After all, the godly power route consisted of three levels of godly body. Achieving 30,000 times would be considered the first level, and this was when the height of godly body could surge tenfold! Yet now, Luo Feng could not even bring his godly body to undergo an outburst in height.

“Haha! I just obtained these true gods’ scales and blood, and I am able to achieve 16,000 times right away…”

Luo Feng was now full of confidence. He had spent more than 100 years in the space of cultivation. In actuality, however, Luo Feng was on board his Boat of Mausoleum and heading for Godly King Valley, and only four days had passed in the outside world! Luo Feng still required more than a month’s time to be able to arrive at the faraway Godly King Valley.

Half a month later, maneuvering and controlling his silver battleship, Luo Feng spotted the vast continent that was right in the middle of the endless ocean. Godly King Valley was the name of that continent.

“We’ve arrived.”

Luo Feng’s attention was temporarily shifted away from cultivation. He was about to embark on an incomparably dangerous mission to receive a title.

Chapter 1373 - Godly King

Sector

On board the silver battleship, he looked down at the vast continent in the distance. As the ship closed the distance via a long-distance teleportation, the faraway continent soon came clearly into view.

This vast continent was named Godly King Sector.

Technically speaking, there were five major continents in the World of Jin. The East Army, the West Army, the North Army, and the South Army each commanded a vast expanse of land and a part of the ocean. On the vast ocean, there were many islands scattered all over, and the biggest among them all was Godly King Sector. Furthermore, it was the place of residence of His Majesty the Godly King, so naturally, it had a unique status, even though its size was far from comparable to the other four continents. Because of its unique status, it was regarded as one of the five major continents.

“Godly King Sector.” Luo Feng looked down.

At first glance. The entire continent was covered with undulating mountains and lakes. The breathtaking view was quite a sight to behold.

“Huh?” Luo Feng felt a sudden jolt of shock.

Those countless rolling, undulating mountains looked like numerous law engravings. Even the lakes resembled nodes. Just by looking down at the entire Godly King Sector, Luo Feng could feel countless mysteries surging into his mind. Yet they were so mysterious that they were far beyond what Luo Feng could understand or comprehend at his current level.

“That’s right.” Luo Feng nodded. “Based on the information I have gathered, Godly King Sector was, after all, the place of residence of Godly King. Normally, living souls of the World of Jin would not be allowed access in here. I have applied for a mission to receive a title. That’s why I am allowed access within the period of this era. The place of residence of the Godly King… How could there not be special formation, secret techniques, and the like, enough to hold all underlings in shock and awe?”

Luo Feng laughed. Just like how many important grounds within the primal secret region would reverse time and space to plant dangers around the land, there would certainly be extraordinary traps if His Majesty the Godly King of the World of Jin was personally responsible for the dangers.

Just as Luo Feng was maneuvering the Boat of Mausoleum to maintain flying in the sky, a lone figure suddenly appeared out of nowhere on the vast land below. Soon, this figure was flying toward Luo Feng at high speed.

An angry command was transmitted: “On the grounds of Godly King Sector, trespassing is prohibited. Stop.”

The voice seemed to come in rolling waves. Suddenly, the surrounding time and space around the Boat of Mausoleum seemed to be isolated from the outside world. There was no way the ship could attempt to escape.

“A true god of void space.” Luo Feng was taken aback.

Luo Feng exited through the cabin doors of the Boat of Mausoleum and directed his introduction to a faraway spot. “I am Milky Way, a warrior from Python River Army of the East Army. Because I am assigned with a mission to receive a title, I have come to Godly King Sector.”

“Warrior Milky Way?”

The true god of void space took one look in the distance and carefully surveyed what he saw, then—

Hua!

Everything in the surrounding time and space resumed normality.

“Follow me,” the true god of the void space beckoned.

Luo Feng put away the Boat of Mausoleum and flew over without further delay. Before this true god of void space, he entertained no other thoughts. After all, considering the power of a true god of void space, even if he put in his all, he would still be hunted down and killed. Of course, it would be wiser to be obedient.

As he flew over, Luo Feng took the chance to observe this true god of void space. He was a tribal warrior, meaning it was a humanoid life form with a dark, golden body that seemed to be cast in bronze. It had six ears and a pair of eyes that radiated red light. Even while standing amid the void space, it exuded an arrogant and domineering aura.

“Milky Way pays respect to you, my Lord.” Luo Feng bowed reverentially upon flying close.

“I am one of the guards of Godly King Sector. I am North Cang,” the true god of void space said right away. “If you want to carry out your mission to receive a title, then do follow me. I will bring you to Godly King Valley. Without my lead, you will not be able to arrive at Godly King Valley.”

“Understood,” Luo Feng replied.

Sou! Sou!

With North Cang, the guard of Godly King Sector, leading the way, both traveled via an extremely long-distance teleportation as they made their way to Godly King Valley.

“My Lord, North Cang.” The more Luo Feng gazed at the sight below, the more mysterious he found it. “I feel that… Godly King Sector continent seems to have law engravings everywhere. Does that mean there is danger everywhere?”

North Cang, the guard, took one look at Luo Feng and revealed a rare smile. “You are right. The Godly King Sector continent is indeed fraught with danger. This continent is, after all, beyond huge. If a large number of law masters and true gods were left free to roam about, even with quite a handful of guards, it will still be impossible to look out for every single one of them. But the moment they are caught trespassing, they will be in danger of imminent annihilation. This is the exact reason why, normally, no one will dare to enter the Godly King Sector.”

Luo Feng nodded. The information he had obtained also included a prohibition against trespassing. Death awaited all intruders.

“As for the law engravings found everywhere…” North Cang, the guard, sighed, “Because the whole of Godly King Sector, is actually a super automaton type true treasure that was created by His Majesty the Godly King.”

“Automaton type true treasure?” Luo Feng was dumbfounded.

A true treasure or a supreme piece of a valuable—one that could be regarded as an automaton type true treasure by true gods of void space of the World of Jin—would be something that other valuables within Universe Ocean would not be able to hold a candle to.

“Such a large automaton type true treasure?” Luo Feng was dumbfounded.

The length of the Universe Boat was around 100 million light years. This Godly King Sector continent was, after all, one of the five major continents. Even though it was barely comparable to the other four continents, its diameter was certainly more than one billion light years. How could such a majestic and resplendent continent turn out to be an automaton type true treasure?

“Haha! His Majesty the Godly King was most highly skilled in automaton type treasures.” North Cang, the guard, sighed as a great sense of pride swept through him. “This Godly King Sector continent was merely an experimental product that His Majesty the Godly Kind left behind… His Majesty still has a true Godly King Sector, and that true treasure followed him on his various expeditions as he roamed about endless worlds with ease. He was simply unrivaled.”

Luo Feng held his breath. Previously, he had seen that humanoid life form. Given that the humanoid life form was so massive, for it to be able to come up with such an outrageous automaton type true treasure was nothing out of the ordinary.

If that massive object really was His Majesty the Godly King, then why has he been reduced to this state? Even his World of Jin became easily accessible by universe masters and true gods from our Universe Ocean. Yet his people from the World of Jin will die the moment they step out?

Luo Feng felt that Universe Ocean and the World of Jin seemed to be at odds with one another. And Universe Ocean had the upper hand!

The living souls of Universe Ocean could enter World of Jin, but living souls from the World of Jin were unable to enter Universe Ocean!

Chatting while on the move, they soon arrived at their destination above a beautiful mountain valley.

“This is Godly King Valley.” North Cang, the guard, pointed down where there was a beautiful and incomparably tranquil valley. “Back when His Majesty the Godly King was here in Godly King Sector, this was where he often stayed in Godly King Valley. I have conveyed the news of your arrival. Let the guard of Godly King Valley know when you get there. They will not stop you.”

“Thank you, North Cang, my lord,” Luo Feng said.

“Also, that nine-story tower!” North Cang, the guard, pointed at the highest building within Godly King Valley. “That is Wu Qi Tower. Move along. I hope you are able to complete the mission to receive a title… and make it out alive.”

Then, while shaking his head, North Cang teleported and disappeared.

Luo Feng looked at the nine-story tower and thought, Make it out alive? Not only must I make it out alive, but I must also find out why, since time immemorial, no law master has been able to make it to the top! I must find out what might stop me!

Luo Feng, ever so proud and confident, would not lose confidence just because of the dangers of a mission to receive a title. If he lacked the confidence, he would not have come.

Sou!

Luo Feng flew over without further ado!

Security was very tight in the Godly King Valley. However, the guards knew that Luo Feng was entering as someone who was here to carry out a mission to receive a title, so they did not stop him. All they did was convey one message to him via voice transmission: “In Godly King Valley, flying is prohibited.”

Therefore, Luo Feng moved about on foot while in Godly King Valley. He walked over to Wu Qi Tower without delay.

Wu Qi Tower, taller than 1,000 light years, was the tallest building in Godly King Valley. At the bottom of this towering building, there were six figures.

One of the six figures entrenched over there—a single-horned beast —ordered in a low voice, “Warrior, come here.” This single-horned beast was the only true god in the area. The other five figures were law masters.

As Luo Feng made his way over, his eyes swept across his surroundings.

“You are the sixth law master of this batch,” the single-horned beast growled. “According to the rules, every ten warriors must enter Wu Qi Tower together. Now, in the Wu Qi Tower, there is a total of three batches. You are the fourth, but first, you have to wait. You will enter when we have ten warriors here.”

Luo Feng nodded to indicate that he understood. On this grassland, the other five warriors were at ease. They were either standing, sitting, or even lying sprawled on the ground (that would be the beast warrior).

“Python River army? You are from the East Army?” A warrior walked over. He was a tall, skinny, strange-looking warrior with a black beard. He was clad in battle armor that had bizarre beast patterns, and his helmet also had the pattern of a roaring beast head.

“You are from Sleeping Dragon army?” Luo Feng asked with a smile.

Sleeping Dragon Army was also a special army troop of the East Army.

“I am Xu Zhong from Sleeping Dragon Army!” said the tall, skinny warrior, introducing himself.

“I am Milky Way from Python River Army!” said Luo Feng, likewise introducing himself.

That tall, skinny warrior expressed his friendly intentions, but he lamented. “The other four warriors are all from other armies, not from our East Army. Fancy meeting someone from the East Army here. How delightful! Which major troop from the Python River Army are you from? This is my first time seeing you.”

“I am a new recruit,” Luo Feng said casually.

The moment this was said, the tall, skinny warrior let out a trace of shock. Even the other four warriors who were not too far away expressed some interest.

“A new recruit?” A realization struck Xu Zhong. “No wonder I have never seen you before. You must have just joined within the past few eras. The number of special army troops in our East Army are not many to start with, and I know the majority of the outstanding ones. For you to be able to make it here to execute this mission for receiving a title, you must be someone with extremely strong powers. I believe that soon enough, you will make a name for yourself throughout the various special army troops of the East Army.”

Luo Feng laughed.

Entering Wu Qi Tower was extremely dangerous, and since they were all from the East Army, he knew he should get well-acquainted with this warrior. Perhaps this might be helpful to him when he was in Wu Qi Tower.

In the blink of an eye, almost six days had passed. Warriors had been arriving in succession.

“We have ten warriors!” growled the single-horned beast true god. “You all will be the fourth batch of warriors to enter Wu Qi Tower this time… A prior warning to you all: Presently, within Wu Qi Tower, more than half of the warriors from the third batch are dead. I hope I will be able to see you all again, walking out of here alive.”

The ten warriors were shocked. More than half from the previous batch were dead?

Even Luo Feng was astounded. Those who dared to come here would certainly be the absolute elites from the four armies.

Hong! Long! Long!

From afar, the towering doors were as tall as a few hundred light years. They were slowly starting to open up with a rumble. The towering doors radiated dazzling, colorful lights, which made it difficult for Luo Feng and company to look straight at it. An endless oppressive force was spreading out from within Wu Qi Tower.

“Go in,” the single-horned beast true god said.

Chapter 1374 - The Strongest

Warrior

Luo Feng and the other warriors—a total of ten of them from the four armies of World of Jin—looked at one another in the eyes. Then, almost simultaneously, they transformed into streaks of flowing light and headed for the towering doors. Out they flew. Not a single warrior dared to teleport recklessly. After all, the mission to receive a title was at an extremely terrifying level that all of them completely understood.

In Wu Qi Tower, the world on the first level was a vast desert where bouts of cold wind blew. It was frigid, and frost could be faintly seen forming on the grains of sands. Faraway was a lofty space portal.

Sou! Sou! Sou!

Ten figures flew in through the space portal and were surveying their surroundings. Thereafter, they gradually descended to stand on the surface of the desert.

“The first level of Wu Qi Tower?” Luo Feng looked around at his surroundings only to see a vast desert. The end was nowhere in sight. Even the faraway space portal had vanished without a trace.

The tall, skinny warrior, Xu Zhong, who was beside Luo Feng, sent a voice transmission. “This Wu Qi Tower is incomparably dangerous. Milky Way, what do you think? Where could the danger be lurking? Could it be under this endless desert?”

Luo Feng shook his head. “I have no idea.”

Ten warriors—a total of six tribal warriors and four beast warriors— all were exercising extreme caution and maintaining great vigilance.

Out of the ten warriors, only two came from the East Army: Luo Feng and Xu Zhong. The two naturally drew closer to one another, whether consciously or subconsciously, so that, in case either met with danger, they could rely on each other to deal with the situation.

Hong!

The quiet peacefulness of the desert was suddenly disrupted by a loud rumble. The impact of the energy waves spread out in all directions. In an instant, it had swept through the entire endless region.

Luo Feng and everyone else could feel the vibrating waves and turned to look. Far away in the sky above the desert, a dazzling beam of light extended downward in a contorted manner, moving fast as lightning. In a matter of seconds, a huge cyan light beam was formed, connecting the desert and the boundless sky above.

“What is that?”

“It seems to contain an extremely strong power.”

The warriors were all filled with doubts.

At that moment, on the upper surface of the cyan light beam that connected the desert to the sky above, many huge black characters suddenly appeared in a distorted manner. In bold black, every character exuded a formidable, murderous intent that wasted no time in penetrating and invading the minds of Luo Feng and every warrior present. It was so powerful that even Luo Feng’s willpower was stirred. Both his eyes reddened slightly, and in his heart, his roaring emotions could not seem to be tamed.

The black characters continued to appear one after another.

This is the passageway that connects the first and second levels of Wu Qi Tower.

Those who enter this passageway will be able to enter the second level of Wu Qi Tower.

You must first kill one warrior before you can enter this passageway.

If you do not kill another warrior, you will never be able to leave this place for eternity… Before those lofty doors open again for the next batch of warriors to enter, warriors who had yet to enter the second level will be annihilated.

Those who hide in battleship treasures to avoid the war shall be considered failed attempts. For them, the final verdict will also be annihilation!

The black characters were suspended in midair, radiating endless, oppressive force.

The murderous intent contained in these characters alone was enough to push every warrior to the limit of his tolerance. Such oppressive force! If it had intended to annihilate some of these warriors, who were merely law masters, one sweep through the crowd would probably have been enough to bring them to annihilation. No one would be able to pull any tricks in Wu Qi Tower; all ten warriors, including Luo Feng, harbored no doubts about its authenticity.

This was why…

“One must kill a warrior to be able to enter the passageway to enter the second level of Wu Qi Tower?” Luo Feng was shocked. “Meaning to say that out of ten warriors, at least five shall die!”

Suddenly, Luo Feng understood why the single-horned beast true god outside had said that half of all warriors from the first three batches had died.

“Kill one? But who to choose?”

Luo Feng’s eyes swept the surroundings.

As all ten warriors had entered together. They were all standing quite near to one another. Everyone was looking around with due vigilance. They were all considering who they should choose as their opponent, since every warrior who had dared to turn up for this mission would be quite extraordinary. If they happened to choose an opponent much stronger than themselves, they would end up being eliminated instead.

Hua!

Soundlessly, the surrounding space was frozen. It seemed to have been done by multiple warriors all at once.

Hong!

Following a wild and raging rumbling sound, one of the warriors made a move, causing the situation—which had previously been kept under control—to erupt instantly.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

One by one, the warriors burst into sudden action, charging toward their individual targets.

“Roar!” An ugly beast with huge scaly wings let out a howl as he charged toward Luo Feng.

“Meet your doom!” said a burly warrior holding a large, fearsome hammer. The hammer was surrounded by endless lightning, and the strength of its power immediately led Luo Feng to the conclusion that this hammer was definitely an automaton type treasure.

Hu!

A beam of black shot swept directly at Luo Feng’s head.

Three warriors were attacking Luo Feng at the same time! Unexpectedly, three warriors had chosen him!

Luo Feng could not help but laugh. It seemed that admitting to the fact that he was a new recruit, when they had all been outside Wu Qi Tower, had indeed brought him some trouble. He had heard it said, “Boldness of execution stems from superb skills,” and this was clearly what the saying meant. He had known that he had skills that would certainly allow him to dominate over these so-called elite warriors. That was why Luo Feng had purposefully dared make such a bold statement.

Sou!

Luo Feng made a speedy retreat.

Hong!

Countless snowflakes suddenly appeared in the surroundings, manifesting in a voluminous amount. This was one of the domain type true god level treasures he had traded for previously, and now, he was using it to suppress and restrain these three warriors who were attacking him.

The moment the three warriors who had deigned to sneak-attack Luo Feng were enshrouded within the domain, he could instantly make out who they were—especially that ghostly one. The first was a beast, the second was a burly warrior, and the third was, unexpectedly, someone who was also from the East Army like himself. It was none other than Xu Zhong!

“Xu Zhong!” Luo Feng sent a furious roar via voice transmission. “You and I are fellow warriors from the East Army. This is just the first level of Wu Qi Tower, and here you are, making a move on me?”

“You are a new recruit!” Xu Zhong shouted coldly. “If I don’t kill you, who else should I kill!”

Hong!

Layers of purple light surrounded Xu Zhong, resisting the countless snowflakes that Luo Feng had forcibly imposed over him. Obviously, this Xu Zhong also had a domain type treasure in his possession.

“Hahaha…!” Luo Feng laughed. He despised warriors like Xu Zhong the most. With a loud roar and a single movement, he transformed into a blurry blade figure. He easily avoided the burly warrior and made a dive for Xu Zhong.

A dodge, followed by a dive. How simple! Yet it was enough to evoke noticeable changes in the expressions of the three warriors besieging Luo Feng. This set of moves not only allowed Luo Feng to easily avoid the burly warrior, but it could even throw the beast far into the distance. A weak fighter may not have been able to notice this, but these were all elite warriors; just one glance and they could tell that this Milky Way had terrifying moves.

“Not good!” Xu Zhong let out a low growl.

Hua!

Layers of white light immediately emerged from his entire being, and, very quickly, he became a white flying beast. The white flying beast shook its pair of wings and soared up high in a straight line to make its escape into the distance.

This caused a slight change in Luo Feng’s expression. “An automaton type treasure, ‘Bib Bird’!”

Bib Bird was an automaton type treasure owned by the East Army. It was extremely skillful in escaping, though it may not have been very adept in other areas, like dodging. It was exceptionally fast when accelerating in a straight line to escape! To trade for it, one would have had to pay 600,000 military credits! It was much more expensive than Golden Claw God, which Luo Feng was using. In the category of escape, it was incomparably impressive.

All Xu Zhong needed was one glimpse at Luo Feng’s simple body movement, and he knew he had been driven up against a wall. With his close-combat technique, Luo Feng had dealt him ten blows, while he had, at most, attacked Luo Feng once. If the situation persisted, Luo Feng would soon be shoving him aside and blocking him out. Seeing that circumstances were to his disadvantage, Xu Zhong had taken out “Bib Bird” right away to immediately make his escape!

“You’re lucky you are fast enough.” Luo Feng snorted with indifference and was no longer concerned with Xu Zhong. He was clearly aware that, with an automaton type treasure like Bib Bird, Xu Zhong would be far too difficult to kill.

Far off in the distance, Bib Bird spread its wings wide and looked in Luo Feng’s direction.

“A new recruit? He is far more powerful than a veteran!” Xu Zhong wore an awful, pained expression. “Is he lying? That can’t be. I know every warrior from Python River Army who has impressive skills other than the new recruits. I don’t know him, so it’s likely he is not lying. He must be a new recruit. But for a mere new recruit to be so impressive… I’m in trouble. Even if I manage to pull through this first ordeal at the first level, I still have the second level, then the third level…”

Xu Zhong was now filled with regrets. What awful foresight he’d had. The single choice he had made would be his greatest misfortune. He had targeted the most powerful warrior of their batch.

Sou! Sou!

Xu Zhong was quick to his escape, while the other two warriors, who also saw the disadvantageous situation they were in, likewise started to make the escape without delay.

The burly warrior with the gigantic lightning hammer gave his body a shake. Unexpectedly, a pair of black wings appeared. Then he speedily flew away with a whistling sound. The beast warrior, on the other hand, was making a slow escape—or at least slow relative to the speed of Xu Zhong and the burly warrior.

“Whose fault is it that you are too slow?” Luo Feng let out a low growl and charged over with ferocity.

Hong!

As Luo Feng was giving chase, slicing through space, his entire being started to transform. In the blink of an eye, he had transformed into an incomparably large and savage humanoid beast. His hands and legs morphed into huge, golden claws.

Automaton type treasure—Golden Claw God! Set ablaze!

His godly power was instantly blazing up to the first stage! Right away, the blazing godly power penetrated Golden Claw God and traveled all the way to its core, where it underwent a change. The powerful golden claws radiated an endlessly wild and ferocious aura.

“No!”

The hideous beast with its scaly, armored wings looked behind it and was instantly dumbstruck. Golden Claw God was closing the distance from behind—and was moving far too fast!

“How could his speed be so fast?”

The beast with the scaly, armored wings felt very troubled. In the first place, why had he not used his military credits to trade for something that could help him escape? He had dared come here because he had an automaton type treasure, but it was one that was used for attack purposes. In terms of attack, he was not the least bit afraid of the other warriors, but seeing how Luo Feng was able to dodge attacks, he knew that he would be bound for failure if he continued battling Luo Feng. He needed to escape!

However, he was unable to escape!

Hong!

With unmatched ferocity, Luo Feng flew toward the beast at such a speed that he produced a whistling sound. High up above, he flew.

With legs like two large blades, Luo Feng sliced through the air with a loud whistle! With both legs, he executed his blade technique, Light of Water and Fire. Although he was only able to execute the first stage of Extermination, his level of secret technique was obviously higher than his opponent; while his blazing godly power was merely comparable to the other party, his dodging ability was much more impressive.

The exchange of blows with Luo Feng had made the scaly, armored beast realize that it had fallen into dire straits. “No!” bellowed the beast.

There was no escape for it at all. It had attacked Luo Feng, who had avoided the attack easily. He had tried to block off Luo Feng, which had caused his power to be greatly reduced. But when Luo Feng attacked him, the beast now realized he might not be able to block off all his attacks.

Hua!

The ferocious, sharp golden claws were like blades. Without hesitation, they slashed at the head of the scaly, armored beast, savagely sending the beast crashing toward the boundless desert.

Hua! Hua!

Luo Feng’s legs were like blades, and with increasing brute strength and cruelty, he pared the scales off the scaly, armored beast one by one.

Chapter 1375 - Alert

Luo Feng was wearing Golden Claw God, and his power surged. He was suppressing the scaled strange beast.

The technique of the scaled strange beast was at level six. It was already impressive for a law master to create a technique at level six. Plus, he knew the first level of godly power-burning techniques; he could wield the power at level seven! Besides, his machine-type valuable was a claw, and it was exceptional at attacks! It could improve the power of attacks by three levels!

Which meant it could wield the power at level ten!

However, it didn’t offer any improvement in defense and evading. That meant the strange beast couldn’t hit Luo Feng, while Luo Feng could easily hit it. Even if it hit Luo Feng, Luo Feng had his own defenses and Golden Claw God to protect him. As a result, he wasn’t injured at all. However, if the strange beast was hit, it would lose a great amount of his godly body.

It wasn’t a balanced battle!

The soldiers were all shocked as they watched. They were the most powerful law masters, who could wield limit-level power. To achieve a breakthrough and become stronger would have been very difficult, which was why there wouldn’t be a large power gap among those law masters. However, that soldier, Milky Way…

“This is incredible. The body technique of that soldier, Milky Way, is incredible. His machine-type valuables are not very efficient.

However, they are all of great help. Once someone is hit, he’ll be crushed.”

“His claw technique is also impressive. Golden Claw God isn’t great at attacks, but Milky Way enhances the power with his claw technique.”

The soldiers all noticed this as they watched them do battle. They understood that they would need to kill each other, since they were required to do so on the first level of Wu Qi Tower and their ultimate goal was to reach the top. Also, it was likely that they fought each other for some additional benefits. They needed to assess the power of the other soldiers now.

All the other soldiers immediately decided, “We must not mess with that soldier Milky Way. We need to stay as far away from him as possible!”

“I wouldn’t have messed with him if I had known he was that powerful,” said Xu Zhong, feeling regretful. “If I had made friends with him, I could have gained his help during the adventures on the following levels of Wu Qi Tower. Then things would have been much easier.”

Hua!

Luo Feng’s right golden claw bent a little. The claws were like blades.

The claw slashed the back of the scaled strange beast, and the beast rolled over. The godly body of the scaled strange beast kept being weakened by the constant attacks. Those gleaming, golden claws were like tumbling waves, slashing the scaled strange beast continuously. The beast lost a large part of its godly body, and its power was already reduced by 80 percent. Naturally, it was being crushed.

“Milky Way, please spare my life!” The scaled strange beast grew exceedingly anxious and began to beg for its life.

Luo Feng didn’t give a damn.

“I am… I am willing to give you all my valuables!” said the scaled strange beast. It was terrified as it didn’t want to die.

“I can still get your valuables if I kill you,” Luo Feng said, transmitting his voice. “Besides, you chose to enter Wu Qi Tower yourself, so you should have prepared for death. You’re much weaker now. Even if I spared your life now, what about the following levels? Do you really think you could survive what still awaits you? Besides, if I don’t kill a soldier, I won’t be able to enter the second level. Then I’ll be annihilated by Wu Qi Tower. I don’t want to die! Plus, even if you survived against me, you wouldn’t be able to kill any other soldiers. You’ll die anyway!”

The scaled strange beast understood. However, it was facing death, and it didn’t want to die like that. It wanted to live as long as it could. As for the dangers in the future? It didn’t care about that.

“I need to kill you to get to level two,” Luo Feng said, his voice cold and steady. This scaled strange beast had attacked him first. If he hadn’t been powerful enough, he would have been killed.

“No!” said the beast in despair.

It couldn’t do anything but watch itself become weaker and weaker. Even if it exploded, the power couldn’t reach level ten. Under attacks like tumbling waves, the scaled strange beast was annihilated!

“It left lots of valuables behind,” said Luo Feng.

He waved his hands and took up all the objects left on the plains. There was a black claw within the objects left behind. It was the machine-type valuable left by the scaled strange beast.

“World of Jin…” said Luo Feng.

“It has the complete ancient civilization, and it’s especially proficient at machine-type valuables!” he exclaimed. “If a universe master can reach level ten with godly power burning techniques and machine-type valuables, it will be as powerful as Teacher Origin in Universe Ocean.”

It was to be expected. Machine-type valuables could greatly improve a law master’s power and could enable him to fight true gods!

Luo Feng took lots of valuables, and he understood that he had been able to kill that scaled strange beast only because he was able to move swiftly and dodge the attacks! He was at a great advantage when it came to dodging, even facing a true god, which had been proven in Nine Smoke Marsh.

“It’s better to kill an elite soldier than to kill ten true gods.” Luo Feng looked around.

On the plains, the wind was still blowing, and there was fighting in several directions. Those soldiers sometimes gave Luo Feng a look.

“They’re all far from me.” Luo Feng couldn’t help shaking his head.

He was planning on killing one or two more soldiers to get more valuables. After all, he had lots of people to take care of—the humans, the earthlings, and even the Luos. They all needed valuables. However, the soldiers all treated him as a huge threat at the moment, so they might have run away if he attempted to make a move.

I’ll wait until the next level, Luo Feng thought. Generally, only 10 percent can survive Wu Qi Tower, yet 50 percent were already killed on the first level! The winners can get valuables, so I’ll kill those winners and get more trophies.

Luo Feng looked around, stopped hesitating, and flew toward the cyan pillar like a streak of light.

Hong!

Luo Feng flew toward that cyan light pillar, and it didn’t stop him.

Hong!

He was like a beam of golden light under the path of the cyan light pillar. He surged and disappeared.

The soldiers were relieved.

“Finally, he entered the second level.”

“Phew! Finally.”

“It’s a good thing.”

If Luo Feng was watching them fight, they would feel anxious; they could clearly tell that they were not at his level.

“We’re all the best elites in the special armies, so there shouldn’t be any beings significantly stronger than us. Why is Milky Way is so much stronger? Especially his close combat techniques? How come? Even true gods don’t have body techniques like that.”

After Luo Feng left, they all returned to fighting each other in groups.

Luo Feng had killed the strange beast very quickly. But contrary to Luo Feng, the rest of them took a long time to finish the battle.

Luo Feng felt that time and space were twisted. The dimming light was blurry, and he showed up in a new place from the cyan light pillar.

“Huh?”

Luo Feng looked around. It was a dark red land. There were fissures across the ground, and red fluids flowed beneath, venting steam that burst from the cracks. The sky was covered by dark clouds.

“Five soldiers?” Luo Feng looked into the distance. There were five soldiers, and all five stayed far from each other. Apparently, they were on high alert. “The former group?” Luo Feng moved his mind.

“New soldiers have arrived,” said a handsome teenager in dark red armor. He smiled. The color of his armor perfectly matched the shade of the ground.

“Why? Why are you waiting for the next round?” asked Luo Feng.

The teenager in dark red armor smiled all the more, yet his eyes glinted ferociously. “When we arrived, Wu Qi Tower told us that each round requires ten soldiers, and only five of the soldiers from our group survived. So we’re waiting for you.”

Luo Feng nodded. Three groups of soldiers had already entered before him. There were 13 soldiers in three groups, so there should have been 15 who survived—unless there were unexpected circumstances.

“How will the second level of Wu Qi Tower test us?” asked Luo Feng.

The soldiers answered.

“Don’t know,” said one.

“We don’t know either,” answered another.

“You’re the first to arrive. It seems you’re the strongest in your group.”

“Just luck,” said Luo Feng.

“What about the other soldiers?” asked the teenager in the red armor.

“They’ll be here in a minute,” Luo Feng said with a smile.

Only after half an hour later, the soldiers arrived, and they arrived at almost the same time.

Sou!

As soon as Xu Zhong arrived, his “Bib Bird” turned, opened its wings, and flew away. He looked around and saw Luo Feng in the distance. All four soldiers tried to stay as far away from Luo Feng as possible, and the other five soldiers noted their reaction. It was evident that these four soldiers were very wary of the one who had arrived before them!

“He intimidates so many elite soldiers.”

“We need to be wary of him.”

The soldiers from the last group were all shocked.

At that moment…

Hong!

Ten light pillars fell from the sky, covering all the soldiers.

Chapter 1376 - The Leader of

Godly King Valley

The ten light pillars moved so fast that Luo Feng and the other ten soldiers didn’t even get a chance to dodge them. They were immediately enveloped completely.

A voice resounded around Luo Feng and the other nine soldiers.

“This is the second floor of Wu Qi Tower,” it said. “You’ll all be transported to a miniature world, and you’ll be attacked there. All you need to do is to survive all the attacks in that small world. The previous group of soldiers have rested for a long time, so their godly bodies have recovered. As for the group of soldiers who just arrived, recover your godly bodies as quickly as possible. You’ll be transported in succession. Those who hide in the spaceship to avoid the fight will be annihilated.”

And then, followed by a tremble in space and time, the teenager in dark red armor and the other four soldiers were quickly transported to a remote place on the red ground. The soldiers were scattered, and they were all trapped in miniature worlds measuring around 100 million square feet in diameter.

“We need to recover our godly bodies as soon as possible.”

“Quick.”

“Recover.”

Luo Feng and the other four were looking around, relaxed. They quickly used the valuables they carried to recover their godly bodies. It took time for the valuables to take effects. They had been transported here immediately after completing battle on the first floor. They couldn’t stay on the first floor. Fortunately, Wu Qi Tower was designed with this in mind, so they could have enough time to use the valuables they had to recover their godly bodies.

The teenager in the dark red armor looked around. He was in a small world with a diameter of 100 million kilometers.

Hong! Long!

A giant, ancient engraving picture with a diameter of 100 million kilometers appeared in the sky bearing engravings of all kinds of colors. Together, they formed the engraving picture just above the ground. Light shot out of the ancient engraving picture, followed by a rumbling noise!

Peng! Peng! Peng!

The light lashed out recklessly! The teenager in the dark red armor held a silver blade and used it to resist the light shooting toward him, but the shock waves absorbed by the blade blasted him away, and he rolled over in the sky.

Countless beams of light plunged from the ancient engraving picture. Many were fired at him even as he was rolling over.

“Too powerful. Each beam of light is as powerful as an attack from a true god. I need machine type valuables.”

The teenager in the dark armor was scared, and circular engravings showed up under his feet. The silver engravings wound around his feet and extended to his whole body. The teenager in the dark red armor sped up so that he wouldn’t be blasted away by the beams of light.

There were five soldiers in five different miniature worlds. All the soldiers were being attacked in the miniature worlds.

Luo Feng and the other five soldiers watched. Luo Feng remained silent, while the other four soldiers were conversing, sometimes glancing at Luo Feng.

“It seems that the small worlds aren’t that dangerous.”

“It’s much better than the first floor of Wu Qi Tower. The first floor requires soldiers to fight each other, so at least half of them die. The soldiers are instead required to fight in the miniature worlds on the second level… Perhaps most of them can live.”

Luo Feng stared at the five small worlds in the distance. Indeed, ancient engraving pictures kept making attacks in those five small worlds, yet the attacks were only as powerful as ordinary true gods. With machine type valuables, those five soldiers couldn’t easily resist them.

Can it be that the second floor is easier because too many died on the first floor? Luo Feng wondered.

Soon, Luo Feng realized he was wrong!

“It’s indeed a handful, but it’s not that difficult to survive this.”

Just as the five soldiers in those small worlds began to feel relaxed, resisting the attacks, the earth suddenly started to tremble.

Hong! Long! Long!

The ground of the five small worlds started to tremble. Crimson liquid burst out of the cracks. The blazing fluids forced the five soldiers to fly up, not daring to land.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The blazing fluids kept gathering. After a while, they formed a towering, dark red giant! As fluids started to clot on its surface, it transformed from a liquid giant to a rock giant! Hot liquid still flowed across its body.

Hou!

All five dark red giants looked up. Crimson fluids kept burst from the cracks, being drawn into the bodies of the dark red giants.

Hong! Long! Long!

The skies of those five miniature worlds kept making attacks below, and many beams of light struck the dark red giants. However, with each hit, only a portion of the rocks was blasted off, and those rocks quickly transformed into crimson fluids that reattached itself to the giants’ bodies.

Followed by the rumbling roar, the five dark red giants raced toward the soldiers. Some stomped across the ground with their enormous feet while others raced toward them on their rocky fists. The soldiers were all blasted away immediately.

“No!”

“Those giants are too powerful.”

“They’re doomed.”

Luo Feng and the other four soldiers, who were still recovering their godly bodies in the distance, were shocked. They could tell what a sinister world those five soldiers were trapped in.

The dark red rock giants were definitely as powerful as true gods! Though those rock giants didn’t have armor to protect themselves, the supply of crimson liquid was endless, so they could quickly recover even if they were injured. They were truly invincible.

And they were not the only enemies the soldiers had—the beams of light kept raining down! The soldiers had barely been able to dodge the beams of light before. But now, they were also being attacked by the rock giants, too. Under such an assault, they couldn’t dodge the light any longer, and they were hit continuously.

Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong!

They kept being hit by the beams of light, and they were all flustered. If they tried to dodge the lights, they would be attacked by the giants.

The light kept coming down, and the rock giants were bellowing! The godly power of the rock giants was being quickly consumed.

The five soldiers who were watching in the miniature worlds all looked solemn. The first five despaired. There were dangers everywhere. It wasn’t that those soldiers were weak. Instead, the miniature worlds were quite hazardous.

“What should we do?”

“We might face the same level of dangers! Countless beams of light raining down, and we need to deal with the rock giants… What can we do? If we try to dodge the light, we won’t be able to defend against the rock giants. If we try to defend against the rock giants, we’ll be hit by the light. Our godly bodies will be quickly consumed, so we may not survive.”

All the other soldiers grew nervous. Luo Feng, on the other hand, remained calm. He also looked solemn.

Those are nothing to me, he thought. But will there be more dangers after the ancient engraving picture and the rock giant? Will there be a third or even a fourth danger?

He wasn’t overly worried about the rock giant and the ancient engraving picture. He was worried that there would be more dangers. No matter how powerful he was, his strength wasn’t limitless.

“Usually, one out of ten soldiers who enters Wu Qi Tower survives. I can be the one.”

Luo Feng nodded and looked on with concentration.

Wu Qi Tower was the tallest building in Godly King Valley. Near Wu Qi Tower was a three-story silver ancient palace, and a large group of true gods guarded the palace. It was also the power center of Godly King Valley.

On the third floor of the silver palace were four gigantic thrones in the vast hall. On the far-left throne was a huge cloud of black mist. The black mist was shaking as it shrouded most of the throne. The form of the throne was blurry, and wicked force emanated from the black mist. The other three thrones were empty.

Hua!

A screen of light appeared in the sky of the palace, displaying the scenes from the second floor. It showed how desperate the five soldiers were.

“Useless.” A sign came from the black mist. “They’re useless. These soldiers are useless! How long will it take before the peerless genius desired by His Majesty the Godly King shows up?”

It was one of the four leaders of Godly King Valley. Even though it was only a true god of void space, it had been sealed by His Majesty the Godly King. As a sealed great being, it could easily annihilate the leader of North True Ocean even though they were both true gods of void space.

“Too weak,” it said. “Useless. This is only the second floor! There were elite soldiers who performed better than them, yet none of them succeeded. As for this group, they don’t have any hope.”

Another sigh came from the cloud of black mist. The World of Jin was the world of His Majesty the Godly King, and Godly King Valley was where he lived.

The valley was actually entirely free of dangers, so there was no need for guards. The fact that was stationed here proved that His Majesty the Godly King trusted it. Its real purpose was to find a peerless being who could succeed at entering the ninth floor of Wu Qi Tower.

“It’s been too long,” said the ancient voice. “This is the only task His Majesty the Godly King gave us. So far, we still haven’t done it yet. If someone can actually make it to the top, I’m willing to die for it.” The voice was full of regrets for Majesty of Godly King as it whispered, “Is it that the competition within the World of Jin isn’t enough? Should it be crueler?”

On the screen, the next five soldiers were also transported to their respective miniature worlds.

Chapter 1377 - Awakening

The vast world on the second level of Wu Qi Tower was a dark red piece of land filled with hot air that soared sky-high. Even neutron stars from Universe Ocean might have been instantly burned to naught the moment they entered this land.

There were five regions with five miniature worlds.

“Roar! Roar! Roar!”

Five dark red rock giants were being tyrannical beyond reason as they went on a rampage, hitting five warriors and reducing them to a sorry state.

In the distance, Luo Feng and the other four warriors watched in silence. There was worry in the eyes of the other four warriors.

“Rock giants are simply indestructible. We must try our best to buy ourselves time.”

The other four warriors were thinking of solutions to deal with their predicament. They had just undergone a round of fighting on the first level and did not have as much time to rest compared to the first five warriors. They took a short rest off to the side, where they could see in advance the dangers that could be found on the second level. This was also a form of compensation.

About half an hour later, after the previous batch of five warriors struggled through a tough round of fighting…

Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong! Hong!

Luo Feng and the other four warriors could feel the vibrations in their surrounding time and space. Then they were speedily being transmitted elsewhere.

Luo Feng felt the distortion of time and space in his surroundings as though he was being transmitted through a wormhole. When everything within his surroundings had stabilized, he had already entered a miniature world.

“Transportation only gives us such a short period of rest. But it also allows us to know the danger beforehand, which seems like a fair exchange.” Luo Feng looked up toward the sky.

Up in the sky, amidst the layers of dark clouds, a gigantic, ancient diagram of secret engravings appeared. The diagram of secret engravings was beautiful beyond words—so mysterious that it was unfathomable—and it enshrouded the entire miniature world Luo Feng was in.

Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

The ancient diagram of secret engravings was like a massive battleship with numerous gun barrels pointing downward and pouring out endless rays of light. Every ray was comparable to an attack from a true god! Fortunately, this was merely a test to hone and train skills, which was why those rays were spread over the entire region. If they had all been concentrated on one area, the combined attack of billions of rays would have been overpowering; even an eternal true god would not dare put up any resistance.

From this, it could be seen how extraordinary this Wu Qi Tower, left behind by His Majesty the Godly King, truly was.

“Huh?” Luo Feng looked up into the sky. Blood Ghost Blade, which was a stone blade slung across his back, was instantly unsheathed.

“Dang!”

Blood Ghost Blade warded off the attack from a streak of light. Luo Feng retreated six steps back in succession, and six large footsteps were imprinted on the ground where he trod. A short moment later —

“I have blocked off nine streaks of flowing light. All are of different colors but carry the same amount of power.”

In his mind, Luo Feng had come to an accurate assessment. He took a brief look at the ancient diagram of secret engravings, chuckled to himself, and then looked down at the vast land beneath.

“You rock giants… Hurry up and appear soon. Otherwise, I would have to use up a fair bit of my godly power just to deal with this ancient diagram of secret engravings.”

Luo Feng made a mental move of intention. “Golden Claw God!”

Hong!

Luo Feng’s appearance underwent an instant transformation. As an automaton type treasure, Golden Claw God could change color as it pleased, and so Luo Feng was transformed into a black, humanoid monster in an instant. His godly power was blazing up to facilitate the emergence of Golden Claw God, which instantly caused Luo Feng’s speed, defense, resistance, attack, and various aspects to soar by two levels.

Luo Feng was reluctant to execute Extermination. The moment he did so, his godly power would be quickly drained. Coping with a crisis at this level, the amount of power he had under such a circumstance was adequate.

Hong! Long! Long!

The earth trembled, and Luo Feng rose up into the air immediately while looking down. From the depths of the numerous gigantic cracks found on the surface of the ground, a scorching crimson-red liquid was continuously erupting, rising up in surging, flowing tides. The great amount of the liquid was rapidly converging to condense into a huge, liquified monster. Then the crimson-red, liquified form rapidly condensed further. Eventually, a dark red rock giant was formed! The crimson-red liquid continued surging in to keep the rock giant replenished.

“Roar!” The dark red rock giant tilted its head backward and let out a roar, then immediately charged toward Luo Feng.

“Great timing,” said Luo Feng, revealing a hint of a smile.

Thrusting hard with his feet, he left a huge claw print in the burning ground. Golden Claw God Luo Feng also charged toward the dark red rock giant head-on. In terms of volume, Golden Claw God Luo Feng maintained a height of 10,000 kilometers, and he was in the state that allowed him to unleash his greatest potential, while the dark red rock giant was close to 200,000 kilometers tall. Golden Claw God Luo Feng merely reached waist-level of that rock giant.

Hong!

The rock giant let out a deafening roar. Soon after, a huge, rocky fist like a mountain peak came flashing toward Golden Claw God Luo Feng’s face.

Shu!

Luo Feng’s figure transformed as if he meant to dodge the blow. The fist followed Luo Feng’s transformations closely, giving chase to deal its intended strike. This punch felt as though it could envelop everything between heaven and earth, denying Luo Feng any chance of escape.

“This Wu Qi Tower that His Majesty the Godly King built,” said Golden Claw King Luo Feng. “Even any random creature that is formed by condensing energy can possess such a subtle fist technique.”

Golden Claw King Luo Feng sighed inwardly. At the moment, he was like a gigantic blade figure and had changed course three times almost instantaneously. That didn’t seem like much. However, to truly attain the ultimate level of his technique, changing course as many times as possible would mean that he had yet to accomplish that level. Ideally, a one-time change in direction should have caused his opponent’s attack to fall short of the target. That was truly impressive! In Nine Smoke Marsh, Luo Feng had been able to easily evade the attack of a true god. But in the face of this red rock giant, he had to change course three times in succession in order to dodge a single punch.

Hua!

As he was dodging, Golden Claw God Luo Feng’s sharp claws deliberately touched the rock giant’s arm, causing the rock giant’s huge form to sway in an unstable manner. Golden Claw God Luo Feng immediately seized the opportunity to hide beside the rock giant.

Hong!

A substantial amount of endless flowing lights descending from the ancient diagram of secret engravings high in the sky and bombarded the rock giant’s body, but none managed to hit Luo Feng.

“Roar!” The rock giant turned around to attack Luo Feng.

“The moment I am within close range, you can rest assured that I will make full use of you as my shield,” said Golden Claw God Luo Feng.

Golden Claw God Luo Feng was like a ghost. Every move he made seemed to be in a linear manner, yet he changed courses several times at lightning speed, leaving the dark red rock giant befuddled as he ran circles around it! The rock giant bellowed. At times, it would turn around suddenly; at other times, it would mindlessly swing its fists in all directions! There were even times when its fists transformed back into the crimson-red liquid to attempt to enshroud and contain Luo Feng.

Chapter 1380 - Power of

Divine Eye
