within the Soul

“Get lost!” Purple Moon Ancestor’s face seemed to be clouded by a layer of frost as he bellowed furiously at the crowd beneath him.

The group of universe masters beneath him were all on their knees, shuddering in fear and overwhelmed by uneasiness. Purple Moon Alliance’s loss this time around was massive. As many as half the entire force of universe masters had entered the World of Jin, and all had perished. The number of universe masters left within the Purple Moon Holy Land still alive was down to less than 100. Even if the universe-masters-to-be all achieved breakthroughs successively, the number of universe masters would barely break 100. But, speaking of universe-masters-to-be, there truly was not a single one.

“Ancestor, we… Are we still going to the World of Jin?” Of all the numerous universe masters who were still on their knees beneath him, none had left, but there were still some who had to ask him this question, as they were filled with great dissatisfaction.

Purple Moon Ancestor looked down at them. His expression was increasingly awful, and he was silent for a long while before saying, “The newly promoted universe masters will go to the World of Jin! And you all shall not reveal your identities as members of the Purple Moon Holy Land!”

The newly promoted universe masters, feeling somewhat delighted at the decision, responded, “Understood.”

They had never set foot out of Purple Moon Holy Land, but this time, because a great number of universe masters had lost their lives, they, as universe-masters-to-be, had been able to achieve breakthroughs. So long as they could change their appearances and not take up symbolic forms—like “three heads and eight arms” or “double faces with four arms”—the other groups of powers within Universe Ocean would definitely not be able to guess their true identities.

Once they had infiltrated the World of Jin, if great beings from the other powerful groups within Universe Ocean saw them, they would probably think of them as natives of the World of Jin.

“Take your leave.” Purple Moon Ancestor’s voice was getting more and more hostile.

Hua!

A group of universe masters finally disappeared and left. Only Purple Moon Ancestor was left in the hall. As arrogant as he was, he had been forced to tell them not to reveal their identities as members of the Purple Moon Holy Land. He must have felt extremely ashamed and insulted.

“Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng!” Purple Moon Ancestor gritted his teeth.

He was furious. He was unwilling. But so what? This was an act of destructive revenge, and he was aware that, other than the humans, he simply could not think of any other top power that would do such a thing!

“I may not be able to do anything to you, but with the birth of the Sector Beast this time around, I don’t think you will not be able to make it out alive.” Purple Moon Ancestor gritted his teeth. Every time the thought of a Sector Beast came to mind, he grew more agitated because a Sector Beast was a major threat to him.

Purple Moon Ancestor tilted his head back and roared.

“Ah! Ah! Ah…!”

How long had it been? Just how long had it been since he had felt so helpless?

Yet no matter how angry Purple Moon Ancestor was, there was nothing he could do. There was no way he could kill Luo Feng. Even if he wanted to make use of the World of Jin to kill him, the moment he failed, all the universe masters under him command that had been brought into the World of Jin would perish. Without all those universe masters, he was unable to do anything to Luo Feng.

If Purple Moon Ancestor was merely furious and unwilling, then the various races from the united forces alliance from the primal universe were filled with endless enmity and hatred!

“Sister!”

“Sister!”

An extraordinarily beautiful young girl, with butterfly wings that were partially transparent, stood amidst the void space. She wore a pained expression as though she was suffering, and the eyes beneath her delicate brows seemed to contain great agony and sadness. Various scenes were replaying in her mind as she recalled growing up with her sister. Her sister had been guiding and protecting her all this while. Her sister was an extraordinary talent and had become a noble universe master of the bug clan. Under her sister’s help and guidance, after many long years, she had finally become a universe knight.

Those years had given rise to a relationship between the sisters that transcended all else—including her life. Her sister was the most important person in her life.

The extraordinarily beautiful young girl raised her head and let out a piercing scream. “No!”

Then her face became contorted. Fiery hatred blazed in her eyes as she said in a hoarse voice laden with endless hatred, “Humans! Humans, I want you all dead! Dead! Dead!”

A faint blue light suddenly appeared around the space surrounding the beautiful girl, enveloping her. In an instant, she was being transported away.

Three minutes later, in the human territory, the towering bug clan mother nest hung suspended in space. Around it, many bugs soldiers appeared.

A wave of anger was transmitted from the mother nest.

“Go out there and kill. Kill all the humans.”

Various bizarre noises were heard as numerous bug soldiers roared and yelled while speeding across the vast void space.

“Oh!”

“Roar!”

They were charging toward the faraway life planet while the mother nest had already vanished with a single teleportation. It teleported like a flash of lightning to reach as far as 10,000 light years away.

“Go and kill, kill all the humans!”

The bug clan mother nest was still giving out the order. Great batches of bugs soldiers continued to roar as they charged out.

This bug clan mother nest was teleporting like crazy. With every 10,000 light years span it teleported across, it released a large batch of bug soldiers. They were largely from the universe level. A small number were from the domain level, and a few were sector lords! There was not a single undying being.

“Kill all the humans! My children, go out there and kill!”

The mother nest moved erratically while releasing countless bugs warriors. To a mother queen who was a universe knight herself, creating billions of universe level bug soldiers was nothing difficult. All of them were at the universe level and more than enough to massacre countless planets.

At the sixth minute after the bug clan’s mother queen had started the rampage in the human territory, the hideous mother nest came to a halt and remained unmoving in the middle of space. Everything quietened down, and around it, the numerous bug soldiers suspended in the air also stopped.

Hua!

A lone figure walked over from afar.

A piercing, hysterical voice was heard from the bug clan mother nest. “Milky Way Horde Leader!”

Luo Feng walked over leisurely, shaking his head. He whispered with a sigh, “Why go to such lengths?”

He pointed into the distance.

Peng!

Far away, a part of void space suddenly shrank, then expanded. Right away, that part of space was annihilated. The lofty mother nest and the countless bug warriors previously occupying that part of space were all reduced to nothingness.

Luo Feng shook his head and sighed. The bug soldiers’ universe knight mother queen had entered a region that was within Ganwu Universe. Once Luo Feng had received information transmitted over from the virtual universe, he had immediately made use of God Country Transportation and a couple of teleportations to rush over. As that bug clan mother nest was constantly teleporting and changing direction, Luo Feng only managed to catch up with it at the sixth minute after the start of the rampage upon entering the human territory.

“Just one revenge. A universe knight annihilated. Is this what we call hatred?” Luo Feng sighed gently. Then, with a single stride, he vanished into the shadows of the starry sky.

All was silent, and everything was shrouded in darkness. It was as though nothing had happened.

Milky Way Holy Land.

Luo Feng returned to a cluster of undulating palaces.

“Horde Leader.” The three universe knights at the forefront bowed and greeted with unparalleled reverence. Out of the three, a tall and sturdy universe knight with green tentacles said, “We have teleported repeatedly and killed all the bugs warriors we found in various places who were in the midst of their rampage. Many of these bug soldiers did not even make it in time to descend on the planet before we killed them. It’s just that… there were still 369 life planets where all the humans were killed. Of these 369, there were 102 where the very planets themselves were completely shattered.” Luo Feng nodded.

In his heart, he could not help sighing. The total population of humans on over 300 life planets most likely numbered in the billions. Yet, in a moment as fleeting as the blink of the eye, all of them were dead. From the perspective of the entire human race, ordinary humans were able to multiply in numbers generation after generation. Overall, even if many were killed, this was nothing much at all. But they were, after all, still life forms that were full of vitality. Among them, there might have been potential talents that could have risen to be the cream of the crop—perhaps even people like Rong Jun, or even an existence like Luo Feng could have been born, although that was highly unlikely. But now, all of these people were merely lifeless corpses.

“Revenge for much too many,” Luo Feng said to himself. “Those who bear hatred for my human race… There are simply too many of them.”

In recent months, the various groups of top powers within the united forces alliance had lost a great many universe masters. Some of them had been from the pinnacle races, but most were from the common pool of races at large. The more powerful races would normally have, at most, one or two universe masters, and these universe masters would be the leaders of their races. To the universe knights of those races, these universe masters were like their parents and mentors!

Some could no longer contain the hatred in their hearts; right away, they had charged forth to take their revenge for the loss of their mentors. There were also others who had decided to put up with the burning hatred. They bore it as best they could, for the sake of their race.

“Fighting the humans? How can we fight them? Our Northern Territory Alliance is already so weak, and our Alliance Master has long abandoned us. Now, the various races within our alliance are so weak. After adding up all the universe masters… we are still not a match for that one single Milky Way Horde Leader. You still want to fight?”

On an ordinary, desolate planet, various godly-powered avatars had gathered for a discussion. They did not dare to come in their original bodies, as they were afraid that they would be killed by the humans all at once.

“This great hatred—how can be we not take revenge?”

“The hatred is certainly great. Two of my brothers were killed. They had been my company for an eternity, and together, we led our race in establishing our footing in this vast universe. Now, they are both dead! They were my most important family member. My most valued companions. And how I wish I could charge in to where the humans are and massacre them all…! But what would be the outcome? If we were to enter important grounds like the primal secret region or Milky Way Holy Land, then not only will there be nothing we can kill, but we will only go there to die! If all I can do is kill ordinary humans, after a couple of decades, another generation will emerge once again. They will not be affected at all. If we go now… it will only serve the purpose of venting our moment of hatred. We need to live, and we must live for our race!”

“But—but I am not willing to! I am overflowing with resentment!”

“You are resentful—just like the Qu Nong race, who had all their universe masters wiped out. They are all rushing to escape for dear lives now. They needed to ensure that their race could survive, but their resentment was far greater! What could they have possibly done? Back when we were still strong, the humans were already exerting their influence over us. What about now? The various minor races were already so afraid that they had left the united forces alliance. How many universe masters left behind would dare to persevere in their desire to fight the humans? For those supreme masters who were lone travelers, the moment they saw how the situation could be played to their disadvantage, one after the other, they left our united forces alliance. As for the few universe masters who were resolute enough to stay behind… the moment the humans sent over an army large enough, the impact of that willpower was strong enough to cast down a great number of them. How many could stand strong in a fight against the humans?”

The godly-powered avatars of the surviving universe masters of the Northern Territory Alliance all fell silent.

How miserable and dreary their situation had become! Various minor races had left the united forces alliance because they simply could not go through another devastating loss. Universe masters who were lone travelers had also left because, to them, the future was bleak and hopeless.

Who remained? The bug clan, the demons, and the automaton race. Yet who would dare to fight the humans again? Who would dare?

“Even if our hatred was larger than life, what more could we do?”

“I don’t know how many other races bear hatred for the humans, but it is fated… that within the entire primal universe, the humans will be the race that truly dominates. No one will be able to stand in their path. No one at all!”

Chapter 1408 - Human Era

Nobody could stop the humans from dominating the original universe.

The human race was destined to reach its peak, and all the other races—the bug race, the automaton race, the demon race, the prison race, the crystal race, and all the other powers—would have to revere the humans from now on. It was widely acknowledged, and nobody would deny it!

“Ah!” A huge black wolf with three heads showed up in the space. It was looking at the planet in front of it, where many life forms from the demon race lived.

Hua!

A ripple swept across the entire planet, and any demons who were hunting, fornicating, or sleeping all disappeared and were transported into a world ring.

“It is the last life planet that I am responsible for.”

Black light surrounded the giant black wolf. He then disappeared after god country transportation.

After a while, he showed up in a space nearby. A giant flying beast giving out endless fire floated there, emanating endless power, causing the stars in the distance to tremble.

“Knight, I’m responsible for a large star sector. And I have already brought here all the life forms of the demon race living on those life planets,” said the black wolf emperor. It then took out the world ring on its claw and threw it toward the flying beast wreathed in fire.

“Okay,” answered the flying beast wreathed in fire. “Go to the Demon Ancestor secret region.”

“Yes,” answered the giant black wolf respectfully, and it left.

Soon, many undying emperors arrived and gave their world rings to that flying beast wreathed in fire. After a long time…

“I’m responsible for all the creatures in this star sector.” The flying beast wreathed in fire sighed. “Migration. The great migration! I can’t believe we demon race also need to migrate… This area breeds us demons, yet we have to leave now.”

Hua!

It performed god country transportation and disappeared.

The entire demon race was migrating—everyone from the two demon ancestors to the ordinary demons on all those inhabited planets. They were all taken away. Demons bred fast, so if one-tenth of them were taken away, it would only take a short while before they had the same population again. After all, they were all from the same race, so they had to take away as many as possible.

“We’ll have to leave and go to our new home now,” said the giant, sawtoothed strange beast. “Dream Tea, have you checked that large star sector?”

“Those other races all ran away when they saw me,” said the giant, silver snake. “But do we really need to stay in that remote area?”

“We should be happy if the humans don’t try to hunt us down in the remote area,” said the sawtoothed strange beast.

“If they don’t even leave us the last piece of territory, we’ll keep fighting them,” the silver snake yelled. “We won’t let them off the hook that easily!”

Top-tier level six was the maximum power allowed in the original universe. If a lone universe supreme master went mad, it would be a nightmare to any pinnacle race.

“We have two universe supreme masters, which is why we can still live in the original universe,” said the sawtoothed strange beast. “I believe the humans will stop pushing us. After all, we’ve given up the most precious core territory. Let’s go.” The beast looked forlorn. “Let’s go to our new home.”

The silver snake took a look back. Then They both disappeared and left the territory.

The demon race was migrating. So were the bug race, the automaton race, the prison race, and the crystal race. There were six pinnacle races in the original universe, and they were pinnacle races because they could occupy precious areas in the original universe. Comparatively, the territories the crystal race and the prison race occupied were inferior, though they were still much better than other random races.

The fact that the five pinnacle races had started the migration themselves meant that they had admitted defeat and didn’t want to fight the humans anymore. As for some of the races that didn’t even have a universe supreme master, like the Northern Territory Alliance, they had started the process of migration and retreat a long time ago. The power of a race determined the territory the race could occupy. Most of the races in the original universe were wise enough to realize that.

At the apex of Thunder Island in the virtual universe, thrones surrounded the round table. Luo Feng and Primal Chaos City Leader sat shoulder to shoulder with each other. As was to be expected, their thrones were larger, while the others were standard sizes. The status was self-explanatory and evident to all.

Luo Feng had killed a true god by himself before! And not just one true god! Even the original mind had admitted that Luo Feng was the most powerful great being in Universe Ocean! And Luo Feng had caused the deaths of those hundreds of universe masters. Everything that had happened had made Luo Feng who he was today.

“Everyone.” Primal Chaos City Leader looked around, beaming. “The demon race, the automaton race, the crystal race, the prison race, and the bug race, they have all left their territories. As for those idle races, none dare to enter their original territories.”

“Those five races are smart to do such a thing.” Ice Mountain Master, who normally was apathetic, was also smiling. “If they still don’t know what to do, we’ll march toward them.”

“The united forces alliance nowadays…” Void Gold Master smiled. “Even if they unite, without lone universe supreme masters, they’ll be easily crushed.”

All the human universe masters were conversing. They knew about what had happened a long time ago, and they were all exhilarated when they heard the news! They were very calm now, but they were still full of joy.

“Many universe masters of theirs died this time, so they hold lots of grudges against us humans,” said Darkness Master. “There are still some undying fighters and universe knights coming here to avenge them. Even though it is utterly insignificant, it proves how greatly they resent us. I think we need to get rid of the threats!”

“There are universe supreme masters in other pinnacle races. If we push it too far, those universe supreme masters will fight us till the end.”

They continued debating, but they reached a consensus very soon.

“We will occupy the territories that previously belonged to the five races: the bug race, the demon race, the automaton race, the prison race, and the crystal race. Let us, the humans, prosper in as many places as possible. There are also other powerful races, and some of them are subsidiaries of the pinnacle races while some of them are alliances. They are in recess now, so they aren’t qualified to occupy the original territories. Occupy them.”

“Take those territories.” The voice of Primal Chaos City Leader was filled with passion. “Let us, the humans, grow and prosper everywhere!”

The humans started to act. They moved group after group of humans—originally living in the universe secret region lands or in god countries—to the new territories. It was indeed a mass migration. They were moved to territories that had belonged to the five pinnacle races like the demon race and the bug race, and also the territories that used to belong to the powerful races.

Although none of the powerful races had huge territories, all the territories they had combined were much larger than those of the five pinnacle races, which could be inferred based on the number of universe masters. Those five pinnacle races had around 100 universe masters in total, yet those powerful races combined had hundreds of universe masters.

The territories of the powerful races were remote, so there was a smaller chance for talents to be born. However, the territories were enormous. The overall chances of elites and talents being born in the human race would surge.

The powers in Universe Ocean all paid attention to what was happening in the original universe. When they learned that a large number of universe masters from the united forces alliance died at the same time, all the powers from Universe Ocean were shocked and terrified. They all speculated that the humans were responsible.

If the humans could do that to the united forces alliance and Purple Moon Holy Land, they could do that to other powers in Universe Ocean as well!

“The demon race, the automaton race, and other powers all retreated. Their power was greatly weakened. They either migrated or narrowed their territories… As for the humans, they are quickly expanding and taking over lots of territories. Half the precious territories in the original universe belong to humans now, and the other half belongs to subsidiary races of humans, idle races, and the other five races.

“The humans will be absolutely invincible in the original universe.”

“This has never happened before, not in any universe era I know of. Even the Divine Eye clan isn’t at such a dominant place as the humans.”

“Fortunately, the humans aren’t hostile toward the powers in Universe Ocean.”

“Fortunately…”

“We can’t mess with the humans.”

All the powers in Universe Ocean were intimidated.

“The original universe will enter a new era. The human era.”

The original universe had indeed entered the human era. Nobody dared to go to the Land of Darkness at the moment, so Universe Ocean entered a peaceful period. The focus of the powerful groups was the World of Jin. There, they worked hard trying to gain inheritances and valuables.

Meanwhile, the humans were also breeding and prospering.

In a vast star region where many peculiar creatures lived on a certain planet, Luo Feng appeared wearing a white cape. He walked across a plain.

“Father God.”

“Father God.”

Six beings appeared in the distance. Luo Feng looked at them with a smiled. None of those beings were tall; they were like children engulfed in flickering fire. These children had been created when endless Remote Ocean was performing the technique “Creation.” After many trials, many creatures had been created.

The humans owned a large amount of territory now, and Luo Feng had chosen a star sector formerly owned by a powerful group. He had arranged it as the dwelling place for the life forms he created. These life forms were innately close to Luo Feng, and they were willing to die for him without any doubts.

The six children surrounded Luo Feng, cheerful.

“Father God.”

“Father God, how long are we going to stay here?”

Luo Feng smiled. “A couple of years.” He genuinely loved these creatures in his heart. After all, they were technically his children. They reminded him of Red Child from Earth, so he had created six children that could control fire. He had created them without much thought, but they were living beings, after all.

“Oh! Oh! Oh!” cheered all six children.

Luo Feng smiled and stroked the heads of the children. Although the creatures he created were powerful—these six children could reach universe level quickly—they couldn’t interbreed like the races created by Nine Remoteness Master.

Luo Feng turned around. Xu Xin, who was also in a white cape, showed up.

“Mother God!” The six children ran toward Xu Xin.

Chapter 1409 - Billions of Eras

(Part 1)

All the six children surrounded Xu Xin, cheering, and Xu Xin was also happily playing with them.

Luo Feng smiled and watched. With his help, his wife had gotten out of the eternal body and transferred her soul to another body. And in a long period of time, Xu Xin had become undying. However, after becoming undying, Xu Xin didn’t want to practice anymore. In fact, with the valuables provided by Luo Feng, Xu Xin could easily become a universe knight if she put forth some effort. She was not, however, into practicing.

“I knew you were coming to this star sector, and you’re indeed here,” Xu Xin said. She then walked toward Luo Feng. The children knew that their Father God and Mother God were talking, so they left them alone.

Luo Feng nodded. “I created them, so they’re technically my children. I’m here to check on them.”

“You have a lot of children. Flesh and blood type, energy type, and plant type,” said Xu Xin jokingly.

“Unfortunately,” Luo Feng said with a sigh, “they can’t breed.”

“You created those creatures randomly, and they can reach universe level easily,” said Xu Xin. “If you actually put in some effort, those creatures could become sector lords easily… If they could breed, how could the other races hope to live? The territories would all be occupied by the creatures you created.”

Luo Feng nodded. He knew that the creatures he could easily create couldn’t reproduce.

“Huh?” A thought struck Luo Feng.

Xu Xin noticed Luo Feng’s facial expression and could tell that Luo Feng had found inspiration. He appeared looked pleased.

“What happened?” asked Xu Xin.

“I have an idea! I have an idea!” Luo Feng was exhilarated.

“What idea?” asked Xu Xin.

Luo Feng’s eyes gleamed. “Both Nine Remoteness Master and I have the gift of Creation, so both of us are able to create one life after another. Although the creatures we create are powerful, none of them are able to procreate. It is much different to grant life forms the ability to procreate. All this time, my godly body has stopped improving and can’t progress. I haven’t even known how to improve myself! Now, I have an idea. Life forms! Reproduction!”

Luo Feng was thrilled. He continued, “It’s very difficult for me to create life forms that can propagate. I need to have a more thorough understanding of life structures… Once I do that, it’ll help me to better improve my godly body.”

Even in the ancient civilization, there were only a few who had become true gods after having their life gene level reach 90,000 times. Although there were methods documented in Duan Dong River about the godly power path, Luo Feng’s life gene level had already reached 60,000 times, so most of the methods were useless, and the helpful ones couldn’t be implemented.

Luo Feng was kind of stuck. He could only study the life structure pictures of true gods. But now, he had found a different way. He would study the life structure pictures and create life forms at the same time. Following two methods at the same time could help him greatly improve himself.

Reaching 90,000 times on the godly power path was more difficult than becoming a true god of void space, and it would take a long time. Billions of eras were only the blink of an eye.

From the third era since the World of Jin appeared, the great beings from the united forces alliance and Purple Moon Holy Land were slaughtered in the World of Jin. All the powers in Universe Ocean were intimidated, and the united forces alliance disintegrated automatically. They all migrated and retreated. Purple Moon Holy Land also kept a low profile and ceased messing with the humans. The humans immediately expanded, occupying half of the original universe. It was the start of a human boom.

The sixth era, the First True Master from the Divine Eye clan obtained a machine-type valuable, and after the news spread, all the powers in Universe Ocean were jealous. They all worked harder in the World of Jin, seeking to acquire machine type valuables.

Those who obtained machine type valuables were all from the special army, and there were no exceptions. This prerequisite alone was already a hurdle to many powers. Otherwise, those great beings certainly could have exchanged their valuables for military credits, and together with the military credits they earned themselves, they could have gotten machine type valuables already.

In the seventh era, Luo Feng met the First True Master in Universe Ocean. The First True Master challenged him because he knew from the three ancestral gods that Luo Feng was deemed the most powerful great being in Universe Ocean, but the First True Master couldn’t believe it.

Nobody watched the fight. Luo Feng fought the First True Master, who had been the most powerful great being in Universe Ocean before the rise of Luo Feng (except Teacher Origin, who was suppressed). Now that he had obtained a burning power technique and a machine-type valuable, he was mighty.

Nobody knew the result of that fight, but they all knew that the battle had happened. After that fight, Divine Eye clan immediately became an ally of the humans, and the First True Master became friends with Luo Feng.

The outer world had no idea what had happened, but Luo Feng knew very clearly that the fight had resulted in a tie in the end! When it came to attacking power, the First True Master of the Divine Eye clan, “Divine Eye True Master,” was at an advantage. However, when it came to godly bodies, Luo Feng had the advantage. And besides, Luo Feng was better at close combat and defense, so it was indeed a nail-biter, but it had ended in a tie.

Of course, if they had fought long enough, Luo Feng could have won by burning his godly body, but the First True Master surely could have left by riding his supreme true treasure. It was indeed a tie, and there was no winner in that fight. Besides, the Sector Beasts were a threat to all the great beings, so Luo Feng treated the fight against the First True Master as a trial. They both understood that they were indispensable in dealing with Sector Beasts.

I can easily kill true gods, thought Luo Feng, but when facing beings like First True Master, who have godly power burning techniques and machine-type valuables, it’s a hard time for me. Even if I perform “one thought void space,” I can only suppress him instead of defeating him.

He hadn’t used his Shi Wu Wings during that fight. “One thought void space” was used to bind enemies. Divine Eye True Master was great at direct attacks, so even if he was bound, he would still be better than Luo Feng. Divine Eye True Master didn’t need to dodge, even if he were bound.

In the 12th era, Bei Chi Star Master obtained a machine-type valuable.

In the time following by that era, one true god after another from Universe Ocean entered the World of Jin, and they all worked hard. Some of them died, but some were very impressive. Gradually, they obtained machine-type valuables. Under the harsh training of the military, the great beings from Universe Ocean started to manifest their true potential. The potential and comprehension of the great beings from Universe Ocean were apparently higher.

In the 91st era, Luo Feng was exhilarated to learn that his teacher True Yan Knight had become a universe master. He was the third human universe master born after Luo Feng obtaining the inheritance of Duan Dong River.

From the 91st era to the 1,003rd era, some universe masters were born in the human race, but no universe supreme masters were born. In the 1,003rd era, the second universe supreme master was born: Peng Gong True God! Even among the human great beings, it was surprising that Peng Gong had become a true god!

Under the will of the original mind, the three ancestral gods did not take care to keep the secret that Luo Feng was the most powerful great being in Universe Ocean. As a result, the word began to spread. No one knew the result of the fight between the First True Master and Luo Feng, but the First True Master did not deny that Luo Feng was the strongest great being, which verified the original mind’s claim.

All the races expected Luo Feng to be the second true god born—or at least the brother of Primal Chaos City Leader, “Darkness Master.” Instead, it was Peng Gong Master, who had kept a low profile the whole time.

In the 3,402nd era, after studying life structure pictures for a long time, Luo Feng finally created a life form that could procreate. The creatures looked like humans, but they were weak. Although they were weaker than the earthlings, they could at least propagate.

Luo Feng had finally made a breakthrough. Three eras after that, his godly body was improved from 60,000 times to 69,000 times. Then it reached 72,000 times.

In the 13,000th era, a new universe master was born from the earthlings: Hong!

Hong, who had always been modest, finally became a universe master after 10,000 eras with the guidance of the ancient civilization. He was a peerless genius, but he was constantly outshone by Luo Feng. If not for Luo Feng, he would have certainly been one of the top-tier beings in the human race. There were 32 universe masters in the human race now.

From then on, there were two universe masters among the earthlings, and there were nine universe knights, including Thunder God.

In the 39,000th era, Hu Yan Bo was admitted into the virtual universe company, and he became a universe knight with the guidance of the ancient civilization.

In fact, those who were able to become emperors and officials without the ancient civilization’s guidance were all highly gifted. Loners like Hu Yan Bo, who had no one to guide them, created their techniques by themselves, so they were talents. Now that they had guidance from great beings and the ancient civilization, it was commonplace for them to make breakthroughs, and many universe knights were born in the human race in this period of time.

Many great beings who were stuck at pinnacle emperors also became universe knights with the help of the ancient civilization. Numerous great beings had achieved breakthroughs over the past tens of thousands of eras, and there were already over 50,000 universe knights in the human race.

In the 39,800th era, Luo Feng got the news from Babata revealing where Devil Hand Emperor Suo Luo Pu was. This revelation stunned Luo Feng. Devil Hand Emperor had killed Hu Yan Bo, and Luo Feng had killed him after he had become stronger—or so he had thought. He hadn’t expected to learn that Devil Hand Emperor was still alive.

However, Hu Yan Bo who had become a universe knight had gone on to hunt Suo Luo Pu down. Devil Hand Master was exposed because the humans were too powerful. The humans themselves occupied half the core territory of the original universe, and the subsidiaries of Luo Feng—as in the other races in the Hong Alliance —occupied most of the leftover territories. The influence of the human race was invisible but indeed enveloped the entire original universe.

Although Suo Luo Pu hid in a remote location, many great beings knew him, and a human great being who had gone on an adventure found him.

Devil Hand Master should have been long dead. Why was he still alive? That news caught Luo Feng’s attention.

However, Hu Yan Bo went after Suo Luo Pu, and after some twists, Hu Yan Bo killed Suo Luo Pu after a hunt that lasted three eras

Chapter 1410 - The Trillionth

Era (Part II)

In the 53,000th era, Luo Feng’s son, Luo Hai, finally became a universe knight. He was the third universe knight of the Luo Family.

Although Luo Feng had two sons, Luo Ping had always lacked interest and focus in various aspects during cultivation, relying on external help like treasures to barely become an undying fighter. As for Luo Hai, he may have given his best, but he had not encountered many setbacks along the way. After all, his father, Luo Feng, had unknowingly given him a lot of help, even if he had not purposely intended to. There were always some great beings who would try hard to please or flatter Luo Feng. Thus, Luo Hai had not been forced to struggle through enough setbacks; even if he was an impressive talent, he would never be as dazzling as Luo Feng and Hong.

“Even with the help from various parties, cultivating to become a universe knight might be his peak,” commented Luo Feng. “If he ever wanted to become a universe master, it would take a miracle.”

An extraordinary talent was truly not that easy to come by.

For a long time, the population of the pulse of the Luo Family grew at an extremely shocking rate. Naturally, the birth of talents was also plentiful. Even before Luo Hai, two others had already become universe knights.

However, out of these numerous so-called “talents,” none caught Luo Feng’s eyes. By his reckoning, even in ideal conditions, reaching the level of a universe knight would be their peak. If such conditions were not provided, and without the ancient inheritance, these first three to become universe knights—including his son Luo Hai—would stop at the level of undying fighters.

Finally…

In the 91,000th era, an extraordinary talent finally emerged within the pulse of the Luo family named Luo Zhen Ni! He was a truly stunning talent who originally had not enjoyed any status in the Luo Family. He was merely a young fellow who lived on an “exiled star,” yet he had quickly risen. Then, finally, he managed to attract Luo Feng’s attraction.

Luo Feng briefly conducted a test and was delighted with the result.

The total area of Luo Feng’s territory and some other deserted grounds on the universe was comparable to a Ganwu Universe. Within this vast land, there had finally been the birth of a talent who met his expectations. Luo Feng took this Luo Zhen Ni as his disciple right away.

This was Luo Feng’s first formal disciple. Many other universe masters who were higher-ups from the human race, even Primal Chaos City Leader himself, had been trying to persuade Luo Feng to take in his own disciples. He was, after all, a number-one master in Universe Ocean. Many groups of powers within the human race were very eager to send the talents from their own camps to Luo Feng, but Luo Feng was never eager to become a teacher. Besides, the birth of an extraordinary talent was not easy to come by. This was why Luo Feng had let the matter drag on endlessly.

This time, Luo Feng was formally ready to take in a disciple. The only thing was, Luo Feng had very stringent requirements for his disciples, which was not secondary to what Primal Chaos City Leader expected of his disciples.

Even for someone as close to him as his own son, Luo Hai, Luo Feng made no exceptions. This went to show how demanding and stringent he was.

In the 91,200th era, Luo Zhen Ni finally became a universe knight. Luo Feng was especially strict with his principles, which delayed the entire progress. Otherwise, Luo Zhen Ni would have achieved his breakthrough long ago.

In the 330,000th era, within the human race in the territory of the primal prison clan, another extraordinary human talent, “Fire Dome,” was born. In the wild, he arose. Incomparably dazzling, he attracted many human universe masters to vie for him as their disciple. When Luo Feng finally stepped onto the scene, these two extraordinary talents unquestionably became his disciples.

When Luo Feng showed up, the other universe masters no longer put up any objection. Even Fire Dome was very excited to have Luo Feng as his Teacher.

In fact, on the peak where Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Peng Gong True God stood, there was no need for them to take in disciples to establish their footing and power, given their status. Luo Feng’s decision to take in disciples was because he had taken a fancy for Fire Dome’s talent. He felt that this Fire Dome was a good candidate as heir to the legacy of his senior, Jie Fanzi, which was not easy to come by.

Fire Dome was also extremely skilled in Water Law and Fire Law. The set of lost knowledge that Jie Fanzi had created, in Luo Feng’s perspective, was superior. If he personally imparted Jie Fanzi’s knowledge, too—further combined with Fire Dome’s innate talent— Fire Dome was bound for great achievements.

The 1,910,000th century, the human race saw the birth of its third true god—Darkness True God!

Darkness Master had finally achieved his breakthrough to become a true god. This was something that the great beings of the human race had expected. The various groups of top powers within Universe Ocean had expected this, too. It was just that they were filled with doubts as to why Luo Feng had yet to achieve his breakthrough!

In the 9,200,000th era, Luo Feng created another race. This race was capable of multiplying in number and could likewise be considered as part of the human race (Luo Feng had created a human-like, flesh-and-blood life form intentionally. After all, he was himself, a human, which had naturally led him to study a race that bore a similarity to the human race.) When this race reached maturity, it could reach star traveler level right away, which was considered highly outstanding.

To be able to create life forms that could reproduce—this was a breakthrough that brought tremendous progress to Luo Feng’s life structure diagram. Thereafter, he underwent multiple breakthroughs. His life gene level skyrocketed from 72,000 times to 79,000 times, then went up to break through to 83,000 times before finally reaching a bottleneck of 85,000 times, where it came to a halt.

Time passed.

Previously, there were undying godly souls who remained at the status quo for a long period of time, and the total accumulated to a large number. With the help of the inheritance of the ancient civilization, many became universe knights. Simultaneously, many universe knights also broke through to become universe masters. This enabled the number of human universe masters to continuously increase. However, the number of true gods increased at a greatly reduced rate.

In the 100 millionth era, the human race saw the birth of the fourth true god: Deserted Mirror True God.

In the 700 millionth era, the human race saw the birth of the fifth true god: Qing Dong True God. In the millionth era after Qing Dong Master broke through to become a true god, Luo Feng’s second disciple, Fire Dome’ unexpectedly achieved a breakthrough to become the sixth true god of the human era.

What a miracle! Fire Dome had gone under Luo Feng’s tutelage after Luo Zhen Ni, who was the first disciple.

Luo Zhen Ni was the first to become a universe master, with Fire Dome following closely to become a universe master, too. No one would have expected Fire Dome to become a true god within a time span close to 700 million eras after becoming a universe master!

This sparked a heated discussion within Universe Ocean. The topic was all about how Luo Feng’s disciple had already become a true god, yet he, the teacher, had yet to become one.

In the twelfth era, the human race saw the birth of the seventh true god: Ice Mountain True God.

Ice Mountain Master had finally become a true god.

The nineteenth era, the human race saw the birth of the eighth true god: Long Yan True God.

Long Yan Master was an aged universe master who had previously been a follower of Teacher Origin. He, too, had finally achieved a breakthrough. In fact, the group of aged universe masters like him had all become universe masters without the help of the inheritance of the ancient civilization. Now, with all kinds of available help, an 80 to 90 percent success rate of becoming a true god was simply a matter of course.

On the contrary, for their descendants—especially those who had depended on the guidance of the ancient civilization to become universe masters—they were certainly a notch lower in terms of potential.

The 10 billionth era was considered to be the breakout period for the humans. The accumulation over endlessly long years had an unprecedented explosion during this century.

This caused the number of human universe masters to soar up to 239, while the number of universe supreme masters soared up to 21!

The skyrocketing within these 10 billion eras was mainly because there was such a rich accumulation to work with in the first place, thus allowing the breakout within such a short period of time.

The humans were not the only ones who had entered a breakout period. The other groups within the primal universe and groups within Universe Ocean were also experiencing breakouts. After all, the inheritance of the ancient civilization was indeed a great help to them. It was just that they did not receive an inheritance as great as the humans, and the information they had was not as detailed. Furthermore, they did not own as many treasures as compared to the humans. After all, Luo Feng was only second to the Godly King in the World of Jin. Many of the treasures he had acquired from there were all sent back to his race.

Even if this was so, for the demons, the number of universe masters soared to 52, and the number of true gods reached four! (Originally, there had only been two.)

For the bug clan, the number of universe masters also reached 32, and the number of true gods reached two. For the automaton race, the number of universe masters reached 39, and the number of true gods was three. For the prison clan, the number of universe masters reached 78, and the number of true gods was four. For the crystal clan, the number of universe masters reached 49, and the number of true gods was five.

As for the Hong Alliance, those races, which had originally been vassal races of the humans, underwent another round of great expansion. Although the humans had intentionally kept them under suppression and deliberately slowed down the development of the vassal races, these vassal races of the humans already had a few hundred universe masters to start with. At that moment, the number of universe masters from these vassal races reached 1,220 while the number of true gods was seven.

In fact, the different races within the Hong Alliance could only have 1,220 universe masters in the first place. This was due to the suppression by the humans and the selections by the World of Jin.

Thanks to the ancient civilization, in the first hundred eras, the whole of Universe Ocean underwent an explosive growth spurt.

The first and second reincarnation eras were no longer able to give rise to true gods, but there was a large batch of universe masters rising within them. These newly appointed universe masters naturally followed in the stead of their preceding fellow universe masters as they charged toward the World of Jin with murderous intentions.

Luo Feng held supreme power in the World of Jin, so although there were past instances when a handful of races had provoked and challenged the humans’ authority due to matters related to territory, Luo Feng was quick to mete out severe punishment within the World of Jin, so no one dared to provoke or challenge the human authority.

In the following years, the development of all the powerful groups in Universe Ocean slowed down noticeably. After all, the accumulation from the previous eras had completely erupted in the past 10 billion eras.

As with the humans, great beings were able to emerge, all thanks to the births of talents. Luckily, the human territory was large enough to accommodate these numerous births.

The first 10 billion eras was a period of explosive growth. The population of the entire Universe Ocean grew tremendously. But as the trillionth era approached, the rate of growth slowed down.

In the 1.6 trillionth era, the human race saw the birth of the 23rd true god: Hong.

Hong, an extraordinary figure from the pulse of Earth, was only secondary to Luo Feng. He had finally crossed over to join the ranks of the true gods. This also raised great concern from the various groups of powers within Universe Ocean. What they were concerned about was the fact that Hong’s brother, Luo Feng—who had the greatest influence over the entire human race and was a Number One Master within Universe Ocean—was still merely a universe master. Why?

“The race that I created, once it matures, can reach star level right away. My life gene level had already reached 89,999 times! Just a little bit more… This is really a fraction of a difference!”

Luo Feng knew that this was an extremely tough step to take.

One could not underestimate the subtle difference between 89,999 times and 90,000 times. In terms of skills, there appeared to be little difference. Yet there was a fundamental leap in the level of life genes. Leading up to the trillionth era, Luo Feng was stuck at this level and just could not seem to achieve a breakthrough. And within the trillionth era, the three shots made by Luo Feng made it evidently clear that he wielded a terrifying power that placed him at the absolute superior position in Universe Ocean.

It was enough to instill fear and send shudders through the various powerful groups. As a universe master, he was already top of the pile in Universe Ocean! If he became a true god, how incredible would that be?

It was the 1,630 billionth era. Within Universe Ocean, two true gods finally joined forces. And for the first time, they set off for the nest of the Sector Beast: the “Land of Darkness”!

Chapter 1411 - Eight Great

Beings Gathered

There were two true gods headed to the nest where all the Sector Beasts lived, known as the Land of Darkness. They were Hong, who had become a true god 30 billion eras prior, and Eye Devil God from the first universe era in Universe Ocean. Compared to other true gods from Universe Ocean, they were only average true gods. However, they had two things in common. They both had machine-type valuables! And they both had strong willpower!

They both traveled toward the Land of Darkness in true god spaceships, yet they were attacked by Sector Beasts at the periphery of Land of Darkness.

The chaos air filled Universe Ocean. Within it, other than the four Lands of Extremis, there were other dangerous palaces. Some of the places were residences created by true gods, such as Jue He Ocean.

Jue He Ocean was originally called “Golden Sand Ocean.” Although true gods weren’t afraid of it, they didn’t dare to enter recklessly. Jue He True God’s power, however, had been greatly improved since entering the World of Jin, and he had roamed Golden Sand Ocean. He had even placed a palace true treasure at the center of Golden Sand Ocean, making it into his place of residence.

“Be careful! Teacher is inviting the other seven supreme beings in Universe Ocean. Pay close attention.” A universe master who had a pair of copper-colored horns on his head was yelling at the universe knights under him.

“Yes.”

“Yes.” All the universe knights were respectful.

The universe master with the copper-colored horns nodded. “Go prepare.”

The universe knights scattered, transmitting their voices excitedly.

Jue He True God was a lone, low-key true god from the second universe era. He had been practicing for a long time, and special life forms were his vassals. He immediately allocated some universe knights from his miniature universe, as he was going to greet seven other great supreme beings.

“The other supreme beings are arriving. I can’t believe we can also see the other supreme beings in Universe Ocean.”

“With our teacher, there are eight supreme beings.”

“They’re coming.”

All the universe knights were looking forward to it.

After a long time, two streaks of light arrived.

“Haha! Divine Eye, Bei Chi. I can’t believe you arrived here together.”

A giant, barefoot god with fiery skin walked out of his palace. He trod across the space with his great feet, taking huge steps, and strange, fiery flowers blossomed under his feet with each step he took. There were dozens of small, golden horns on his head, and there was a golden horn on his head. All his eyes gleamed with green light.

“Aren’t they still here?”

“You guys arrived here first. The others might be coming.” Jue He greeted them by themselves. The three conversed as they walked into the palace.

After Divine Eye True Master and Bei Chi Star Master arrived, Skeleton Master arrived as well, followed by Nine-Headed Demon Master.

Hong!

Three beings arrived like three streaks of light. Skeleton Master, Divine Eye True Master, Bei Chi Star Master, and Nine-Headed Devil Master arrived first. Jue He True God greeted them all one by one. Three streaks of light flew in from a distance and became three beings. One was a man wearing a golden cape. He had a faint smile on his face, and his eyes were gleaming with a dim, golden light.

There was also a middle-aged man looked wicked and eerie. He looked pale with black engravings on his face.

In the middle was a man in a white cape who appeared quite ordinary. He glanced around, and there was unimaginable magical power contained in his eyes. Jue He True God and Divine Eye True Master both missed a heartbeat just looking him in the eyes.

One of them was Primal Chaos City Leader, the person in charge of the first power in Universe Ocean! One was Nine Remoteness True Master, representing the second power in the original universe, the Ancestral God School, and he was undying. The third one was acknowledged as the strongest great being in Universe Ocean, and also had the highest authority in the World of Jin: Milky Way Horde Leader!

“Chaos, Nine Remoteness, Milky Way, welcome.”

The other five greeted them.

The power dynamics in Universe Ocean completely changed. The ancient civilization had greatly improved the chance of true gods being born, and only the original universe could breed true gods! Now, the most powerful era in Universe Ocean was the original universe era—stronger than the first and the second universe eras combined.

As for the two holy lands? True gods were required to fight Sector Beasts, yet there were no powerful true gods in the two holy lands, so nobody cared about them.

The humans had the most true gods, followed by the Ancestral God School, followed by the Space Beast Alliance. This was the internal ranking in the original universe.

Most of those who became true gods during the past trillion eras had all been universe masters previously. The demon race, the bug race, and the automaton races had lost over 200 universe masters in the World of Jin, all of whom had been the true elites who had become universe masters without help from the ancient civilization. After they were killed, the demon race, the bug race, and the others only had weak universe masters left, so there were only a few true gods.

As for the Ancestral God School and the Space Beast Alliance, they hadn’t lost anyone, so many true gods were born in their races! Actually, there were many other races in the Hong Alliance, so naturally, there would be many true gods in that group. However, after the united forces alliance disintegrated, the biggest threat to the human race was posed by those other races in the Hong Alliance! After all, there were hundreds of universe masters in other races, but the humans only had 20. The power gap was too large, so the humans needed to constrain them.

For the past trillion eras, the humans had been trying to suppress the other races in the Hong Alliance. If they didn’t, the humans wouldn’t be able to control them any longer. The humans kept suppressing the other races so that the other races had to respect humans.

The supreme beings were those who truly mattered when fighting Sector Beasts. After all, there were only a limited number of true gods in Universe Ocean, and without quantity, quality mattered! In the past trillion eras, eight supreme beings had emerged from the World of Jin, and they were widely recognized as the eight most powerful beings in Universe Ocean.

The first one was Divine Eye True Master from the first universe era.

The second one was the supreme master from the skeleton race. The skeleton race and the Divine Eye clan had been fighting for a long time. Skeleton Master was highly rewarded in the World of Jin. His power exploded, and he now rivaled Divine Eye True Master.

The third one was Bei Chi Star Master. Previously, he had conducted public teaching in the black-striped stone pillars. He was venerated and also a robust great being.

These were the three supreme beings from the first universe era. The fourth and the fifth ones were Jue He True God and Nine-Headed Devil Master. They were the strongest in the second era, and both were special life forms. Special life forms were revered in Universe Ocean, such as Sitting Mountain Guest. He didn’t participate in any battles, so even though everyone knew he was mighty, no one knew the true extent of his power, so he wasn’t among the eight supreme beings.

The sixth one was Nine Remoteness True Master, who had endless godly power, making all the other great beings jealous.

The seventh one was Primal Chaos City Leader. He had already been a shining star back when he was still a universe master. After becoming a true god, he had reached an incredible level through his hard work and the detailed inheritance from the ancient civilization obtained by his disciple, Luo Feng.

The eighth one was Milky Way Horde Leader. Nobody in Universe Ocean knew for certain the extent of the power of Luo Feng. He was only a universe master, but he was ranked as the strongest in Universe Ocean. Other true gods all knew godly power burning techniques and had machine-type valuables, yet they were still not Luo Feng’s match.

A trillion eras prior, Divine Eye True Master had still been able to fight Luo Feng. Now, all seven great beings admitted that Luo Feng could easily defeat them all. Over the past trillion eras, Luo Feng hadn’t become a true god, but he had become much stronger!

At the center of Golden Sand Ocean, inside the sparkling palace and around the crystal round table, were eight thrones. Fruit and wine from all three universe eras sat on the round table.

Luo Feng and the other seven sat down.

“Illusion Heart True God of you humans and Eye Devil God from the first universe era went to Land of Darkness,” said Jue He True God with fiery skin. “Milky Way, Chaos, you must know a lot about the Land of Darkness now.”

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded. “Yes. Both Hong and Eye Devil God are true gods who are exceptional at illusions, and they have strong willpower… They approached the periphery of the Land of Darkness carefully, but they were quickly attacked by three Sector Beasts all at once. They survived the attacks and were safe and sound inside the spaceships, but once they got out, those three Sector Beasts yelled at the same time. The resulting invisible soul attack put them in great pain even though they could resist it. The three Sector Beasts immediately attacked them, severely injuring Eye Devil God. They retreated immediately.”

“For one thing,” Primal Chaos City Leader continued, “the soul attacks of the Sector Beasts were incredible, so you must have a soul supreme true treasure, and you’ll still feel agony! Both of them have willpower stronger than true gods. Sector Beasts are mighty. Much stronger than them. The energy attack alone was able to severely injure Eye Devil God. The energies the Sector Beasts use are different from our godly power. Their energies can quickly annihilate our godly power. At the same time, their energies will wither away as well.”

Luo Feng nodded. “Yes. A power opposite to godly power.”

Luo Feng had felt that sort of power when he had fought Great Thunder Star Tower. Sector Beasts were using the exact same power, which was why Eye Devil God had been quickly injured even with a machine-type valuable. Both Eye Devil God and Hong only had mediocre godly bodies, so they couldn’t be consumed.

“Ordinary true gods can’t contend with Sector Beasts.” Divine Eye True Master shook his head. “How many Sector Beasts are there?”

Chapter 1412 - Sector Beasts

Come Out

Bei Chi Star Master nodded. “We know too little about them at the moment. First of all, we know that Sector Beasts are great at soul attacks, and secondly, we also know that they wield a power that is the opposite of godly power. Also, we know that although Sector Beasts fight and try to kill each other, when we show up, they’ll work together to attack us. Eye Devil God and Illusion Heart True God were attacked by three Sector Beasts at the same time.”

Luo Feng and the others nodded. They realized that even though the Sector Beasts were trying to kill each other, when facing an enemy from the outside, they would cooperate and fight the outsider together.

“Then…” Nine Remoteness True Master shook his head. “It’ll be difficult to kill them one by one.”

Luo Feng thought, Both Hong and Eye Devil are great at illusions, and their willpower is at void space level! The true gods in Universe Ocean had their willpower at void space level after being trained in the World of Jin, but many are only at the true god level. If they only have willpower at the true god level, they’ll suffer great losses…

Some of the words were forbidden in Universe Ocean; information about true gods of void space and those that were more powerful was concealed.

“We know too little about Sector Beasts,” said Nine-headed Devil Master anxiously.

“What skills do they have? How many are there? We don’t know anything.” Jue He True God nodded.

“Besides, the end of this universe era is approaching,” said Divine Eye True Master. “It might only take several trillion eras for it to come. According to the original mind, we have to end the Sector Beasts before this universe era ends. Otherwise, it’ll be too late.”

The Sector Beasts were a source of worry to all the great beings in Universe Ocean. Even Luo Feng and Divine Eye True Master, who had been foes before, were friends now. With a common enemy, enmities could be erased in no time.

“I think we need to go to the residence of the Sector Beasts again,” said Divine Eye True Master.

“Yes, we need to go again, and we need to get more information.” Jue He True God was anxious. “We must learn more about them. Then we can be more prepared and can plan better.”

Over the past trillion eras, Universe Ocean had been absorbing the inheritance from the ancient civilization, including some ancient techniques, machine-type valuables, and how to control them!

The great beings in Universe Ocean had already reached their limit. Beings like Divine Eye True Master, Skeleton Master, and Nine Remoteness Master wouldn’t be able to greatly improve themselves anymore, even if they were given another universe era. On the contrary, the Sector Beasts would only become stronger as time went by.

It was time to fight!

“We need to form a team of true gods made up of those from Universe Ocean,” Primal Chaos City Leader said with a nod. “We need to go to the Land of Darkness and learn more details about them so that we can make a better plan. Firstly, all the true gods in the team need to be powerful. Also, we need to acknowledge that it’s going to be dangerous. We can’t let this failure shake the foundation of Universe Ocean!”

Everyone nodded. Nobody actually knew how hazardous the Land of Darkness was. If half the eight supreme beings were killed, even if they gained detailed information, it wouldn’t mean anything. After all, the eight supreme beings were the pillars of Universe Ocean.

“I’ll lead,” said Luo Feng. “One true god from the first universe era, one true god from the second true god, and two true gods from the original universe era. We’ll form the team like this, and I’ll also join. There will be five of us.”

Including Luo Feng, three came from the original universe. It was to be expected, since the number of true gods from the original universe was much larger than that of the first and the second universe era.

“Okay.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader is leading this time, so there’ll be no problem.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader will be able to find the mysteries behind this.”

Jue He True God, Divine Eye True Master and Skeleton Master were all pleasantly surprised. Luo Feng was the most powerful being in Universe Ocean. If he couldn’t find out anything, nobody could.

Luo Feng nodded. He was a universe master with several bodies. Even if one of his bodies was annihilated, it could be recovered soon. For the past trillion eras, his willpower had already reached the level of an eternal true god, and practicing “Godly King Technique” was highly rewarding. He also had a giant godly body and was the most powerful being in Universe Ocean. He wasn’t afraid of the home of the Sector Beasts.

“Divine Eye True Master, Jue He True God, go back and talk to the great beings from your universe eras,” said Luo Feng. “One true god from each universe master, and they must have strong willpower.”

Both Divine Eye True Master and Jue He True God nodded and answered.

“Sure.”

“No problem. Many true gods will be honored to go with you.”

Over the previous trillion eras, Luo Feng had become more and more powerful. After practicing “Divine Eye Technique,” Luo Feng could now intimidate true gods with a single glance. All of them venerated Luo Feng, and they also knew that his power would be beyond imagination once he became a true god.

After this meeting, they now had a basic plan for how to deal with the Sector Beasts. The eight supreme beings soon separated. Luo Feng, Primal Chaos City Leader, and Nine Remoteness Master flew back to the original universe.

“Nine Remoteness,” said Luo Feng. “We need two more true gods from the original universe. One from the Ancestral God School and one from the Space Beast Alliance. Will that be a problem?”

“No problem.” Nine Remoteness Master nodded.

The Ancestral God School and the Space Beast Alliance also had many true gods.

“But you need to be careful as well,” said Nine Remoteness Master. “That’s the residence of the Sector Beasts, which forces the original mind to use so many methods.”

“That’s right,” said Primal Chaos City Leader solemnly. “Don’t underestimate those Sector Beasts. Remember Huge Axe.”

Luo Feng nodded, “I know it. I’ll send my Mosha body there this time, so nothing will happen.”

Primal Chaos City Leader relaxed. Mosha body was an energy type creature, and it didn’t have a soul, so soul attacks were useless against it. Besides, Luo Feng could also reach the second level on his energy type lives, and Mosha body was 100 million kilometers tall. Such a large godly body was much bigger than Hong or Eye Devil God, so there was nothing to be afraid of.

This time… Luo Feng thought. When all three universe eras select their champions, I’ll need to go talk with my teacher.

Luo Feng knew that true gods belonged to different races, and it would take them some time to decide who was going.

Land of Darkness in the core area of the remote Tilted Peak Sector.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

There was black mist tumbling on the edge of the Land of Darkness. There hadn’t been so much before, but with time going by, it was growing denser and denser.

Hong!

A streak of black light shot out of the Land of Darkness. Then it slowed down and stopped.

It was a giant monster emitting black light from every inch of its body. It had two ferocious heads, and on each head was a single eye, a nose, and a mouth. It had one pair of arms and one pair of legs. It was completely naked, and wicked force permeated from every part of its body. The singular eyes on each of its two heads glanced around. Its body bore dozens of injuries, and black blood seeped from its veins.

Suddenly, its first head opened its mouth, and its tongue extended. It swept across its body like a giant beam of light, licking every wound on its body.

“Bei Di…!” The hideous black monster bellowed and roared. “I am the ultimate king! I am! You rigged the system, which is why you’re stronger. You want to kill and eat me? Just wait and see—it’s not going to be that easy. Last time, two dishes of food were at our door.”

“Those three idiots were so stupid that they let the delicious food get away,” the ugly monster whispered. “Bei Di, perhaps I can’t beat you in our nest, but other than eating other Sector Beasts, I can also devour delicious food to strengthen myself. I’ll go to the world where the delicious food lives, and I will keep eating it nonstop. I’ll get stronger, and when I come back, I’ll outmatch you. The Sector Beasts in our nest are all wicked, and they won’t let you eat them like that. The food outside is much easier to acquire. When I come back, I’ll be stronger than you. Then I’ll eat you and all the others. I’ll be the ultimate king.”

Hua!

It flew out toward the endless waves where a large boat floated.

As the black light flew toward it, two towering beings flew out.

Chapter 1413

Primal universe.

Amidst the vast, starry sky, a man in a white robe appeared and walked through the darkness of space. He headed straight for a red-hot star—a star that was already headed toward the end of the path.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

Chapter 1414

Each of the three universe eras needed to choose a venture to go to the nest of Sector Beasts. It was extremely dangerous, so nobody was willing to go.

Why did I have to go? Why couldn’t he go? I would be the only last hope of my race, so if I died, my entire race would die.

There were internal discussions and compromises that would take several years or longer to be completed. It was as Luo Feng had expected. Compared to a trillion eras, a few years was a blink of an eye, so there was no need to rush anything.

Wa!

Xiu!

Sector Beast Morosa was excited. It had eaten other Sector Beasts in the past, and the process was a fiesta. However, the smell of the universe origin in front him made him crave for more. It would be just as fantastic as eating other Sector Beasts.

Eat! Eat!

Chapter 1415 - Firefly True

Master

Then they can get into the World of Jin without any obstacles, yet Purple Moon Ancestor didn’t agree to it.

Chapter 1425 - Sworn Enemy

Luo Feng was filled with expectation as he maneuvered Star Tower. He was on his way to Purple Moon Holy Land universe when Divine Eye True Master sent a message.

“Milky Way Horde Leader. That Sector Beast was at the peripheral region of Purple Moon Holy Land, where, likewise, it devoured the origin for a day and then left. At the same time, Purple Moon Holy Land wanted me to inform you, Milky Way Horde Leader, that you… are no longer required to go there.”

Luo Feng’s greatly enthusiastic heart instantly cooled down. Luo Feng’s expression darkened as he transmitted his response. “What do you mean… no longer required to go there?”

Divine Eye True Master said, “The other part of the news means… The promise made earlier on was based on the condition that Milky Way Horde Leader would help them deal with the Sector Beast. But now, the Sector Beast has left of its own accord. There is no need for Milky Way Horde Leader’s help in dealing with it, so, unquestionably, there is no need for them to give you a true treasure in exchange.

“Milky Way… honestly speaking, when they transmitted this piece of information, even I felt angry just listening to it! But, you should know. The Sector Beast is not only an enemy of Purple Moon Holy Land but a common enemy for all the races within Universe Ocean! I know you are filled with anger now, and you will most likely want to let the Sector Beast devour Purple Moon Holy Land to its heart’s content… While swallowing for eight to ten days is no big deal, if the time it spends on devouring grows too lengthy, we cannot stand idly by any longer.”

“I know,” replied Luo Feng. “I will place importance on the big picture. But spread my word… From this point on, Purple Moon Holy Land will be my, Luo Feng’s, sworn enemy.”

Someplace far away, Divine Eye True Master was taken aback. He could also feel the intensity of that endless anger raging in Luo Feng.

“Milky Way…” Divine Eye True Master could not help but feel worried. To deal with the Sector Beast, they had to depend mainly on Luo Feng.

Within Star Tower, Luo Feng’s expression was hideous as he held onto his transmission token. His anger was so great that his veins were threatening to pop out and burst.

“Purple Moon Holy Land, Purple Moon Holy Land…” His eyes flashed coldly. “I wanted to give you all chance, but since you all are not appreciative, my Shi Wu Wings would rather make do with their imperfections and make you all regret that you have done!”

Toward Purple Moon Holy Land, Luo Feng no longer held on to any feelings of pity. However, he was also aware that he could not allow the Sector Beast to continue devouring the origin of Purple Moon Holy Land as it pleased. After all, every time it devoured an origin, it would disappear for half a year. Various races of Universe Ocean had long suspected that the Sector Beast spent that time “digesting and absorbing” whatever it had swallowed to increase its power! A human grew when it consumed food. A golden horned beast grew when it ate metals. All operated on the same theory. The Sector Beast might, unfortunately, feed on the universe origin to become stronger. It seemed highly possible.

Purple Moon Holy Land was, after all, a holy land universe of a true god of void space. That origin would likely be the equivalent of hundreds and thousands of origins of true god level miniature universes combined! If Luo Feng allowed the Sector Beast to continue devouring like that, who knew what would be the result would be?

If the Sector Beast became incomparably powerful, to the extent that no one could fight against it, then Purple Moon Holy Land could be faced with its doomsday. But if this continued, the entire human race—including Luo Feng and his family—would have to face the fate of annihilation… This was what Luo Feng could not accept. He did not dare to use the lives of family and friends, and the lives of the entire pulse of Earth, as bargaining chips. He was reluctant to gamble with them!

“Purple Moon Ancestor, you are indeed ruthless!” said Luo Feng. “You have already guessed that I would not dare to take such a gamble and that I would not risk it all just for a single piece of a true treasure… Perhaps you are not concerned about the universe masters under your command, or perhaps your Purple Moon Holy Land would prefer to continue withdrawing into passive defense.” Luo Feng’s gaze turned icy. “But your Purple Moon Holy Land shall be my, Luo Feng’s, sworn enemy, and I shall remember this! Before I achieve my breakthrough to become a true god of void space, I will definitely try to destroy your Purple Moon Holy Land.” Luo Feng was bellowing the words in his heart as he spoke them. “I will think of every way possible to ensure that you live to regret this.”

To destroy a miniature universe of a true god of void space—usually only an eternal true god executing some superior methods could achieve such a feat. This was a piece of information that Luo Feng had learned in the past. However, Purple Moon Ancestor’s miniature universe was not considered large.

The smallest miniature universes at the level of a true god of void space had diameters around one billion light years, and the biggest could have diameters as long as ten billion light years! The Purple Moon Holy Land miniature universe had a diameter of 2.1 billion light years, while East Emperor Holy Land miniature universe was 3.2 billion light years in diameter.

The size of a miniature universe was related to many different factors, including the erection of the internal structural framework when a miniature universe was established, or whether the godly power route or the law route had been chosen to become a true god. The bigger the miniature universe, the more power was provided, and the more stable it would be.

For instance, the legends of true gods of void spaces had mentions of a “miniature universe with a diameter of 10 billion light years” that was comparable to the lowest level miniature universe of eternal true gods! Of course, that was merely a legend. Even for an extraordinary talent who had once attained 90,000 times life genes— or even for the three generations of ancestors at the true god of void space stage—none of their miniature universes had ever reached ‘0 billion light years. This perfect, ultimate limit was only a legend!

When one was a true god of void space, it was usually unlikely for the miniature universe to be of a diameter that was merely one billion light years. Normally, the size would not be so ridiculously small. Weaker true gods of void space would have miniature universes with diameters around two billion light years, while stronger ones would have miniature universes with diameters around three billion light years. The elites’ miniature universes could reach diameters of four billion light years, while those of extraordinary talents could reach around five billion light years. In short, the higher-level one attained on the social scale, the more difficult it was to maintain the miniature universe.

As for a talent that achieved 90,000 times life genes via the godly power route? And the three generations of ancestors? A true god of void space with a miniature universe that had a diameter of ten billion light years, this was just a legend of the ancient civilization.

Purple Moon’s miniature universe is not big, thought Luo Feng. It’s even smaller than East Emperor’s. If I become a true god of void space, by relying on an automaton type treasure and various secret techniques, I can certainly achieve an outburst to unleash the power of an eternal true god. Perhaps then I might be able to destroy Purple Moon Holy Land universe!

Luo Feng made a mental note.

Luo Feng’s expression grew increasingly awful as he tried to contain his anger.

“Teacher…”

“Luo Feng?”

Fire Dome and Hong were looking at Luo Feng. They felt a little worried, as they did not know what might happen next.

This was outright bullying. The promise made previously had been broken in the blink of an eye. How shameless could they get? It seemed Purple Moon Ancestor was not the least bit interested in appeasing the wrath incurred by the humans and Luo Feng—not even the slightest trace of it.

If that was the case, then they would be their sworn enemies!
