This time, less than a month after it devoured the origin of Purple Moon Holy Land miniature universe, the Sector Beast reappeared in Universe Ocean. The timing defied the expectations of every powerful group. This time, it moved on to devouring the origin of Rampaging Devil God’s miniature universe.

Upon devouring the origin of one miniature universe, it disappeared for half a year. Upon devouring the origin of another miniature universe, it disappeared for another half a year.

Sector Beast had resumed its attacks on miniature universes, and this worried the various races of Universe Ocean. If it went on, many miniature universes would collapse.

It had been three years since the incident with Purple Moon Holy Land.

Within the void space surrounding Sea Badger True Master’s miniature universe, a silver-white vessel hung suspended in space. Luo Feng’s Golden Horned Beast body was inside the vessel. Although it was known as Golden Horned Beast body, Luo Feng had already transformed it so that it took human form.

Perhaps for common universe masters, size and form would have an impact on their power. As for Luo Feng, who had achieved 89,999 times life gene level on his godly power route, he could easily change his life structure to take on the form he would require, according to the circumstances he was in. And he could also unleash his power to perfection.

A piece of information was transmitted over to Luo Feng. “Milky Way Horde Leader, Milky Way Horde Leader! Sector Beast has appeared outside my miniature universe now!”

Golden Horned Beast Luo Feng was momentarily shocked, but shortly after, he showed his delight. “A message from Sea Badger True Master?”

“Milky Way…”

Then surely, there will be at least a chance of encountering this Sector Beast while it is out to devour miniature universes.” Luo Feng was thrilled. “What a pity it did not cross paths with the other team I deployed.”

Luo Feng had divided his other bodies into two teams this time around. One route was taken by his Remote Ocean body and his Mosha body, who traveled with a series of powerful treasures like Shi Wu Wings, Wu Qi God, Star Tower, and Blood Ghost Blade.

The other route was taken by his Golden Horned Beast body alone. Although equipped with several automaton-type treasures, in terms of the ability to unleash power, it was inferior to the other team.

“Even so, the automaton-type treasures that my Golden Horned Beast body possess far surpass Divine Eye True Master and Jue He True Master’s treasures.” Golden Horned Luo Feng was very confident. “This Golden Horned Beast body has combat power that is stronger than any of them.”

Speaking of power, his other team was, of course, much stronger— great enough to surpass the power of all the other seven true masters put together.

As for his Golden Horned Beast body, compared to the other seven true masters, it might have been slightly stronger, but the advantageous position it had over them was not obvious. Of course, given Luo Feng’s comprehension and cultivation for the past trillion eras, even this ordinary Golden Horned Beast body could prove to be an extremely difficult opponent.

“Maybe this time around, I will be able to kill that Sector Beast.”

Golden Horned Luo Feng smiled.

Sou!

This silver vessel teleported over right away. At the same time, Luo Feng transmitted a message to Sea Badger True Master: “Sea Badger, I’ve arrived.”

“Arrived?” Sea Badger True Master was shocked. It had only sent out the call for help a moment ago. Nonetheless, it was overjoyed. Milky Way Horde Leader was the first to arrive. At least he would be able to prevent that Sector Beast from devouring too much. “These are the coordinates of where the Sector Beast is.”

Sea Badger True Master sent the coordinates right away.

Within the peripheral area of Sea Badger True Master’s miniature universe, a chaotic airflow was filling up the void space. A certain area within this endless chaotic airflow was filled with black fog. In the midst of it was a lofty figure. It was Sector Beast Morosa, and it stood upright, right in the middle of the black fog, waving its tail as it delightfully devoured the origin of that miniature universe.

Streams of distorted light rays extended and penetrated the void space.

“Wu!” Sector Beast Morosa was quite pleased. It felt that the whole Universe Ocean was its plaything.

Weng!

The surrounding space suddenly froze.

Based on its experience, anytime it was devouring a miniature universe, the master of that miniature universe—a true god—was likely to drive his palace supreme true treasure over to harass him. But the sealing of space was highly unusual because those true gods were usually quite eager to chase him away. Why would they seal space? Only when top-tier true gods like Nine-Headed Demon Master arrived, or if a big group of true gods arrived together, would they dare to seal the space.

Hua!

A silver-white vessel arrived. When the cabin doors opened, a man wearing a suit of golden armor strolled out.

Sector Beast Morosa took one look and was instantly taken aback. “A universe master?”

Chapter 1426 - Luo Feng

Fights the Sector Beast

It wasn’t that Sector Beast Morosa hadn’t met a universe master. Many true gods would send universe masters to inspect first, but nobody performed space seal, and nobody had a force so terrific or powerful.

“You are…” Sector Beast Morosa stared at the man in golden armor stepping through space, coming at him. “Human Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng?”

“Yes.” Luo Feng took back the spaceship and stared at the Sector Beast Morosa.

“I heard you are the strongest great being in the entire Universe Ocean. You’re only a universe master, but you’re the strongest great being?” Sector Beast Morosa stared at Luo Feng. He sneered. “It seems that the other true gods in Universe Ocean are so weak that you, as only a universe master, can become the strongest great being.”

Though he said as much, Sector Beast Morosa had already stopped eating the origin, and those traces of light started to spin around him. Apparently, he was being very careful and vigilant. After all, Luo Feng’s reputation preceded him. He wouldn’t underestimate this human before him.

“You’ll know after we fight.” Luo Feng’s godly body had already performed Duan Mie.

Hong! Hong! Hong!

He immediately performed the first three volumes, and after burning his godly power, his power became incredible—stronger than the previous true gods. Generally, true gods only had one level of godly power technique. Few of them had two levels.

Hua! Hua!

Luo Feng was in golden armor. He waved his right hand, and out of nowhere, a chain with glowing green light appeared. The giant chain wound around Luo Feng’s body.

“Just a universe master…” Sector Beast was smirking, but it kept gazing at Luo Feng carefully with its bloody eyes.

They were facing each other, observing each other. Suddenly, Sector Beast Morosa opened its mouth without making any sound. The soundless scream echoed in Luo Feng’s soul.

Luo Feng had stronger willpower than Nine-Headed Devil God! As for energies, he had the most in Universe Ocean under three levels of godly power burning! And when it came to techniques, Luo Feng had two inheritances from the World of Jin and Duan Dong River! This so-called soul attack was like a breeze to Luo Feng. He didn’t feel anything.

Luo Feng wasn’t affected at all. He whipped out the giant chain surrounding him. “Go!”

Hua! La!

A giant chain that looked like a python flew out. The chain twisted, slashed through the sky, and endless snow flowed in the space around the chain. The snow was fluttering, covering an area of ten square light years. Time and space were forbidden.

At this moment, Luo Feng had already utilized two valuables. One of them was the chain—a machine-type attacking weapon, “Bi Yan Chain.” The other was a domain machine-type valuable named “Snow World.” It had the ability to control space and time was as powerful as Golden Country, perhaps stronger.

In the past trillion eras, he had obtained many valuables from the World of Jin, so this time, he was well-prepared. Even though this team didn’t have as many valuables as the other team, the valuables Golden Horned Beast Luo Feng had were still awed by true gods like Divine Eye.

The snowy world arrived as if the chaos space had been replaced by a world of white. The snow was falling.

Sector Beast Morosa stood there, but it was surrounded by black mist. There were thickly dotted black threads around its body. A giant chain slashed the sky, and just as it flew across the sky, it became a large flow of water! The giant stream of water cut through the sky. Everywhere it touched, the space turned green, and there was green grass growing in space. The giant water flow splashed Sector Beast Morosa.

Pa!

It was extremely fast. The whip appeared to be soft, but actually, it was rapid and fierce. The giant flow of water turned from the chain and whipped Sector Beast Morosa. The parts of its body whipped by the chain sank—even its head—molded like gold bullion.

Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa!

The giant water pillar kept whipping the Sector Beast relentlessly, turning into a phantom. Luo Feng was staring into the distance, burning his godly power to its maximum degree. He triggered the engravings on that machine type valuable, and he was performing a technique he had created, “Bud of Water and Wood.” The core of that technique was relentless. The water pillar kept whipping the Sector Beast, yet there was grass growing throughout the snowy world, and the liveliness permeated the space, suppressing Sector Beast Morosa. It kept whipping Morosa, turning it into chunks. However, it still hadn’t crumbled.

Hou!

There followed a furious roar. Sector Beast Morosa was furious, completely suppressed under the constant whipping. It was continually losing strength.

“Go!” Sector Beast Morosa glared at Luo Feng in the distance.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

All of a sudden, the black threads surrounding Sector Beast Morosa all flew toward Luo Feng in the distance, trying to cover him. They flew very fast, unhindered by the speed limit of Universe Ocean. Instantly, they reached Luo Feng, surrounding him like a black mist cocoon!

Inside the cocoon, Luo Feng was completely enveloped. The size of the cocoon was variable, and it was stuck to Luo Feng. It started to swallow his godly power.

“He’s indeed quick.” Luo Feng nodded. “Once it was performed, I was immediately surrounded… Firefly True Master was attacked by this move, and he couldn’t dodge it.”

Luo Feng immediately shrank his godly body, but the black mist cocoon followed suit, shrinking along with him.

“Bigger, bigger, bigger!” Luo Feng burned his power madly, trying to oppose the black mist cocoon around him. Even if it was Sector Beast Morosa, it was difficult for him to swallow godly power while it was burning like this.

As soon as Luo Feng grew large, the black mist cocoon became 100 million kilometers tall.

Sector Beast Morosa was controlling the black mist cocoon, but it felt like the cocoon couldn’t swallow much of the godly power. Morosa became anxious. When it saw the cocoon became 100 million kilometers tall, it realized something wrong.

“He’s trying to get out! I won’t let that happen! I’m much stronger than before. Want to get out…?”

“Break!” yelled Luo Feng, trapped in the cocoon. “Break!”

The giant chain in space suddenly became straight as a spear. Then the gleaming spear slashed the cocoon like a dazzling streak of white light. The space the white light passed through wasn’t shattered, but there were circles of strange, swirling ripples. At that moment, Luo Feng, inside the black mist cocoon, also used his claw. The claw was like a blade. It slashed without a sound, but all the space it through passed crumbled.

One from the outside and one from the inside—the chain-spear was outside, while the claw was inside. Both of them were machine-type valuables.

Hong! Hong!

The black mist cocoon suddenly shook. A tiny crack appeared on it, but it immediately recovered while Luo Feng was still trapped inside.

“I can’t get out?” Luo Feng looked surprised. “That shouldn’t be. I used two machine type valuables at the same time, from both the outside and the inside. I was also burning my godly power to support it, so I should’ve broken the cocoon. It seems I need to burn more godly power.

The resilience of the black mist cocoon made all the great beings from Universe Ocean realize how difficult it was to break it with a weapon-based attack. However, Luo Feng deemed that it was possible for him to do so. He had successfully produced a crack on the cocoon just now, so that meant he needed to improve his attacking power.

Normally, the best way to break out was to use his own godly power to consume the power from the Sector Beast! He would just consume the power from the black mist cocoon so that the Sector Beast couldn’t supply that much power anymore. Then it would crumble, as it didn’t have that defense power.

“Do you really think you can get out that easily?” Sector Beast Morosa saw Luo Feng fail, and it smirked. However, the smile froze immediately.

Hong!

Luo Feng, who was trapped in the giant black mist cocoon that was 100 million kilometers tall, burned his godly power. Before being converted by machine type valuables, it spread around like wildfire.

Chi! Chi! Chi!

The energies contained in the black mist cocoon were being quickly annihilated. They were consuming each other!

“Break!” Luo Feng reached out with his hands. His claws extended outward at the same time. After a faint roar from the beast, two strange beasts landed on his hands, grabbing the black mist cocoon at the front. He tore the black mist apart.

Hua!

The black mist cocoon was trying to consume the godly power of Luo Feng, and it was 100 million kilometers tall. At such a size, the energies consumed were so extravagant that even Sector Beast Morosa felt a huge burden. When the cocoon was consuming too much power, the binding strength naturally got weaker.

Luo Feng tore at it again. It was unnecessary for him to use his techniques, as he could just tear it apart with his bare hands. He tore the black mist cocoon apart, then walked out into space.

Chapter 1433 - Newborn

Chapter 1435 - To Change

The willpower of the primal universe origin had been transmitting messages via the three ancestral gods, yet Luo Feng was the Number One Master of Universe Ocean instead of the three ancestral gods. Why did the willpower of the origin choose to do so? Because the willpower of the origin also knew that if it were to rely on us, there would be no way the Sector Beast could be stopped. Luo Feng was the only reliable choice. Now, Luo Feng is merely a universe master, yet he is already above any of us true gods. When he becomes a true god, there will be hope for us to achieve success.”

Divine Eye True Master looked at him. “You say that Ink Dragon made sense, and then you say Milky Way is our hope…”

Just one Sector Beast, yet he failed to kill it. Can he really succeed in bringing it down? Even if he did become a true god, what we have is merely hope. To the Sector Beast, Luo Feng is the one who poses a threat to them, not us. Besides, the Sector Beasts never laid hands on Zhen Jia Master and Dragon Rock Ancestral God’s miniature universes.”

Divine Eye True Master continued listening intently.

So long as we are not so silly to the extent of initiating provocation from Luo Feng, like Great Thunder Star Master did, then we will not be annihilated. We should not be bothered about the Sector Beast crisis. Instead, we should put our hearts into cultivation. We should make good use of the final moments we have to try our best to transcend reincarnation. The moment we succeed, eternal victory will be ours to claim! The efforts we put in now, the side we choose… For the sake of transcending reincarnation in the future, it will all be worth it. If we are unable to transcend reincarnation, then fighting the Sector Beast to come to such a tragic end would only prove to be a joke.”

Divine Eye True Master surveyed the surroundings. Silence prevailed. Quite a few universe masters thought this way, but there were also quite a handful who felt that they should fight the Sector Beast. Divine Eye True Master looked at every one of them, then at the other four true gods. From the looks in their eyes, he could understand the thoughts of the other parties. There were those who raised their objections, but there were also others who were agreeable.

“The Sector Beast is truly powerful. Killing it for real is going to be too difficult! If the Sector Beast is truly able to spare us, then there is no need for us to create enmity with it.”

The demon true gods had gathered in the primal universe. As members of the primal universe, they did not dare to change sides.

It was obvious. The primal universe and the Sector Beasts were opposing groups. Pledging allegiance to the Sector Beast would mean going against the primal universe. They had, at the very least, lived through two reincarnation eras. They did not want to be seen as enemies by the primal universe!

There were many different thoughts and emotions hovering about in Universe Ocean. After all, there was no hatred between the various races of Universe Ocean and the Sector Beast; if the Sector Beast was willing to take them in and not attack them, then on the premise of knowing that there was little hope in defeating the Sector Beasts, quite a number of races were naturally willing to change sides. News from the outside world was streaming in. Luo Feng was aware of everything happening in the outside world; he was also aware of the various changes, but he was still very much at peace.

Chapter 1436 - The Life

Diagram of a Sector Beast

Primal universe, human territory, Milky Way Holy Land.

Hua!

A nine-story tower came flying over from the void space far in the distance. It flew all the way over to the upper skies of the boundless Remote Ocean.

Numerous figures teleported over as quickly as they could.

A group of more than 100 great beings had rushed over and bowed with reverence, but they could not conceal the sense of urgency in their eyes. Luo Feng looked at the group of universe masters before him. He understood that this group just required a little more faith. They were feeling helpless against the Sector Beast. There was simply nothing else they could do.

Instantly, a handful of masters showed a spark of joy.

Fire Dome True God took a step forward and said in a straightforward manner, “Teacher still has some important matters to tend to. Everyone can take your leave now.”

Having received such a reply from Luo Feng, the universe masters, though not completely at ease, were now more reassured with a glimmer of confidence! One by one, they took their leave in a most respectful manner.

Fire Dome True God and Hong looked one another in the eye. They did not further impose on Luo Feng. They both knew that this time, Luo Feng had important matters to see to.

After watching everyone leave, Luo Feng’s gaze became aloof. Even me. I have no confidence at all. Because no one knows how terrifying the Sector Beast will become toward the end.”

Luo Feng shook his head. The unknowns gave rise to the greatest fears. Even the documentation conducted on Sector Beasts in the World of Jin consisted of records made after the Sector Beasts entered their “growth period,” and even those were merely legends. This was why there was no detailed information to be had.

He had obtained some information from a Sector Beast that had only just entered the third stage. Undoubtedly, the information was a far cry from the information that might be obtained from the final form of the king of the Sector Beast.

“Let’s begin.” Luo Feng turned to look at Star Tower. It was suspended by the side. “I hope this blood of the Sector Beast does not disappoint me.”

Hong!

At that moment, the water of Remote Ocean beneath him started to get turbulent with rolling waves. In an instant, the rolling waves surged up to become towering waves ten million kilometers high. These massive waves enveloped Star Tower in its entirety. Star Tower was completely submerged. The height of the waves in Luo Feng’s original location also increased by leaps and bounds, reaching a height of 100 million kilometers. Compared to the diameter of the boundless Remote Ocean—which was as wide as twelve light years— this was relatively inconspicuous.

Amidst the great waves was a vacuum, and Star Tower was suspended within this vacuum.

“The blood of the Sector Beast contains a force that is the complete opposite of godly power. The slightest carelessness, and I will probably be annihilated.”

Clothed in a white robe, Luo Feng looked at Star Tower beneath him. Relying on its suction force, Luo Feng was controlling the drop of black blood, which was also suspended in the vacuum. He did not dare to use his godly power to handle this blood, as he feared that any contact made with it would cause it to be accidentally annihilated.

Previously, he had recreated Sector Beast Morosa with the help of Whirlpool World. He had directly sucked the blood of Sector Beast into Star Tower, which he had used as the storage vessel for this blood. All along, he had never come into contact with it via his godly power. Then Luo Feng had divided the Sector Beast blood into 16 portions. He feared that, should he be a little careless, he might accidentally annihilate this blood. This time around, beneath the base of Star Tower, was one of those 16 portions. It was one drop of Sector Beast blood.

This drop of blood was entirely black in color and was more beautiful than any diamond. With a diameter of around one kilometer, there was no way it could be further cut up. Undoubtedly, this was as small as it could get.

“Talent technique… Creation!”

White-robed Luo Feng looked at the drop of black blood suspended in midair. Then, with a move in his mind, Remote Ocean immediately executed the talent technique right away.

Buzz!

The surrounding space fell into the enshrouded region of this talent technique.

This drop of black blood that was originally so mysterious was rapidly being stripped of its mysterious outer layer under the execution of this technique. The internal structure was speedily analyzed by Luo Feng, and there was a continuous indication that this blood was made up of various spots of light—a total of 100,000 light spots. Each spot was then further dissected. These light spots were…

“Roar!”

A miniature Sector Beast, all black in color, with two heads, a pair of hands, and a pair of legs, standing in an upright posture, was roaring.

100,000 light spots. And upon being dissected, many superb, miniature Sector Beasts were found. Some tilted their heads back and roared. Some were bending over. Some were waving their claws. Some were in deep slumber. Some stood aside in silence…

An even deeper level of analysis found that every miniature Sector Beast was said to be the most profound Rhinoceros Emperor Game, which far exceeded any other Rhinoceros Emperor Game Luo Feng had ever comprehended. It was mysterious and unpredictable.

At that moment, Remote Ocean body entered the space of cultivation within the Boat of Mausoleum and was continuously comprehending and analyzing at top speed under an environment where time was accelerated at a rate of 10,000 times.

The life structure diagram from a single drop of Sector Beast blood was much more complex than the life structure diagram of any other true god or true god of void space Luo Feng had ever encountered!

Because of his status in the World of Jin, from the trillion of eras, Luo Feng might certainly have obtained some scales, armor, hair, and blood samples of true gods of void space. He might even have obtained samples from life forms at the eternal true god level.

What a pity! The life structure diagram of an eternal true god was simply unfathomable. It exceeded Luo Feng’s span of comprehension. Although he was able to understand the life structure diagrams of true gods and true gods of void space, for Luo Feng—who had already attained up to 89,999 times life gene level— the help obtained was not significant. This Sector Beast was, after all, the noblest life form in all of Universe Ocean.

Luckily, it was still in the gestation stage, so Luo Feng could still keep tabs on it. If it went up by one more level, it would have become too profound, and Luo Feng might not have been able to analyze it at all.

“My talent technique can only analyze up to this level. The life structure diagram of a Sector Beast is indeed incredibly complex. True gods and true gods of void space are entirely different.”

Luo Feng’s brows were closely knitted as his consciousness operated at an extremely fast pace. At 10,000 times the rate of normal time, he had memorized a tremendous amount of information. Yet, going deeper, he realized that these were two completely different methods.

It could be understood this way: True gods, true gods of void space, and Sector Beasts were all fundamentally different in regards to their life structure diagrams! They were all composed of different structures.

Previously, Luo Feng had not attained a complete understanding of this. Universe masters, true gods, and true gods of void space were equivalent to the elements of music: do, re, mi, fa!

But the sector beast was more like the binary code of a computer language, which was made up of ones and zeros! All of them were composed of different essential elements! This could be based on one theory: a life form from Universe Ocean was essentially different than a Sector Beast.

“If I truly become a true god, then the path I take will be completely different from the average true god,” Luo Feng said to himself. “How will it help me?”

Luo Feng was frustrated. Just a while ago, he had somewhat gained a flash of comprehension (10,000 times acceleration was equivalent to more than three days). He had already realized that the life structure diagram of the Sector Beast represented another vast world. It also represented another route! That route, in turn, represented a future that was just as vast as the world the life structure diagram represented. The thing was, it was very difficult to comprehend something from it.

“I am really at my wit’s end.”

In order to create a race capable of proliferation and to study the life structure diagrams, I have already spent up to a trillion eras. Yet I am stuck at this final step.” Luo Feng shook his head, “Now, let’s comprehend first and hope that this Sector Beast blood can finally lead me to the enlightenment of my soul…”

Luo Feng thought no more and immediately immersed himself in comprehending the diagrams instead.

Peace and quiet returned to Universe Ocean.

Luo Feng’s Mosha body and Remote Ocean body went onboard Star Tower while his Golden Horned Beast body boarded the vessel and remained stationed in Universe Ocean to stay vigilance at all times while waiting for the Sector Beast to reappear. The Boat of Mausoleum was left in the boundless Remote Ocean, where Luo Feng had left a body sustained by godly power in the space of cultivation to carry out comprehending and cultivation.

Time passed. The various races were still worried, but, in the blink of an eye, 1,000 years passed. The Sector Beast did not reappear in all that time, thus giving credibility to Luo Feng’s claim that at least for a short period of time, the Sector Beast would not reappear.

Virtual universe, in an area in space that solely belonged to Luo Feng.

Amidst that lonely void space, a palace was afloat. On the public square before the palace, there was no one but Luo Feng. Clothed in a white robe, Luo Feng sat cross-legged without uttering a single world. He was looking far out into the distance at the numerous stars that filled the dark void space.

Shua! Shua!

Two figures appeared out of thin air.

Two stylish-looking youths walked over. Luo Feng usually forbade ordinary great beings from entering this place, even if they were his disciples. As for the other true gods, only during crucial times would they be granted the right to come over. However, there were some who could turn up here anytime they wished, such as Primal Chaos City Leader, True Yan, and… his family!

The endlessly long period of a trillion years had certainly brought many changes to Luo Ping and Luo Hai. They were no longer the same men they had been when they were young. Now, they were more determined in the journeys they wanted to take in life.

“Worried?” Luo Feng took one look at his two sons, then turned away to look far off into the endless void space.

Who was not worried? Confronting a Sector Beast, even he was worried. But the other races had pinned all their hopes on him. And he… who could he pin his hopes on? No one! He had no other great beings to rely on; he only could depend on himself. He was worried that if he could not stop Sector Beast, the entire human race, the pulse of Earth, and his beloved family would perish.

Yet, because of this worry, he no longer held on to any fear!

“I… I am only allowed to do my best! I have no path for retreat!” Luo Feng was convicted. “Right down to the final hour, if I have yet to level up to the third stage of the godly power route, then even if my godly body cannot achieve a breakthrough, I will immediately become a true god, gain stronger combat power, and fight this battle with all I’ve got.”

Chapter 1437 - Nest

He was left with no other choice. Although the best situation would be for him to hit 90,000 times life gene level while having attained the third stage of the godly power route, but in the face of an impending calamity, time was of the essence. There really was not much he could do, but becoming a true god at the second stage of the godly power route was still much better than those who became true gods through the law route.

“Father…”

A voice from the side disrupted Luo Feng’s thoughts. Luo Feng turned his head to look at his sons. From the eyes of Luo Ping and Luo Hai, Luo Feng could feel the brothers’ worry and unease.

“Rest assured.” Luo Feng stood up and patted the brothers on their shoulders. “Your father is confident!”

Both brothers heard their father’s words but still felt uneasy. Both were very aware of the news about the Sector Beast calamity. They were aware that during the calamity this time around, none of the other races would be able to stop it. Throughout the entire Universe Ocean, the only hope left was their father! Such tremendous stress! How was he going to bear it all?

“Of course.” Luo Feng’s hands rested on the brothers’ shoulders. “If your father is to fail, then your father and his sons—as well as your mother… Let’s just face annihilation together as a family. That way, at least we will all have each other’s company even in the face of death.”

Luo Ping and Luo Hai laughed. “Mm-hmm.” They agreed, nodding their heads vigorously.

The two brothers disappeared.

There was a trace of a smile in Luo Feng’s eyes. His two sons had undergone a trillion eras of honing and training their skills, so when it came to facing death, they were unfazed.

“If I fail, everything will be annihilated.”

Various scenes flashed through Luo Feng’s mind. His teacher, True Yan, Primal Chaos City Leader, his good friends, Rong Jun and many others, his parents, his wife, his sons, his younger brother… and the countless heroes who had sacrificed their lives fighting the devouring beast to ensure the survival of the earthlings…

Everything, if he failed, would be reduced to nothingness.

In preceding generations before the three reincarnation eras, great beings like Jie Fanzi had long been reduced to nothingness. Perhaps, within the three most dangerous lands, there might be words left behind as evidence that these great beings had existed once upon a time.

Within the faraway World of Jin, Luo Feng’s Earthling original body was within the East Army military camp. However, his godly body had started to collapse and disintegrate.

“That Sector Beast has escaped, and it is definitely not going to give up on revenge. This is just the calm before the storm… Regardless of whether I achieve a breakthrough to 90,000 times life gene level or not, the moment the final calamity occurs, I have to become a true god right away. And the moment I cross over to the level of a true god, my various bodies will merge to form my original body. Then, without a doubt, my earthling original body will have to return.”

Luo Feng stood within the stone house, yet his godly power was dispelling soundlessly and continuously, returning back to the World of Jin.

A short moment later, Luo Feng’s earthing original body was gone. Only the other body sustained by his godly power remained.

“Now, only my other body sustained by my godly power remains in the World of Jin.” Luo Feng’s other body remained in the stone house as he shook his head in silence. “I will have to put all visitation on hold for now and meet no one at all for the time being.”

Within Tilted Peak Sector of the three most dangerous lands of Universe Ocean, in the core region of Tilted Peak Sector, was the Land of Darkness.

Si!

Black skin and flesh were torn apart. Blood was splattered all over. A hideous head was devouring great mouthfuls as it crazily bit and tore at its prey.

“Hahaha… Hahaha…!” Tearing and biting, Sector Beast Morosa laughed as though it had gone mad. “I, Morosa, have turned the tables. I have actually succeeded!”

Its body was marred by injuries all over, and its second head was so badly torn that only half of it remained—clear indications of the extremely ferocious fights it had been involved in.

Battles among Sector Beasts were a completely different story than combat between a Sector Beast and a true god. When Sector Beasts and true gods fought, they could make use of the opposing nature of each other’s strengths to exhaust one another’s power, or the Sector Beast could easily split its to escape when the need arose.

But when Sector Beasts fought one another, the situation was different. Their powers were the same. And they jinxed one another by deploying the same means of fighting. For instance, if one Sector Beast divided itself into 99 different bodies, its opponent could do likewise! There was no way either could escape from the other!

“Morosa… if you feed on me now, in the future, you will suffer the same fate—being eaten up by another Sector Beast,” said a Sector Beast with a gaping hole in its chest. It howled in its unwillingness to be subjected to Morosa’s brutal and continuous devouring. It, too, only had one head left, which Morosa was presently feasting upon. “I was already severely injured before fighting you, but even so, you had such a difficult win that there is no way you can survive through all this.”

“What a fool.” Morosa devoured like mad as he cursed and swore. “Even though you are severely injured and might still be stronger than I am, when it comes to combat experience and techniques… you are so much more inferior.”

In the past, Morosa had stood at the peak of the Sector Beasts’ nest, second only to Beddy! Fighting persistently against one billion Sector Beasts to reach such a position, Morosa was definitely not short of combat experience. Even if it did lose out a little in its foundation, by relying on its techniques and experience made up for this shortcoming. Plus, its name alone could instill fear in its opponent even before the fighting began because opponents thought of the almighty Morosa of before. These factors contributed to it claiming the final victory!

“Devouring you will allow me to level up to the second stage!” Morosa bellowed. “Given my combat experience and fighting with other Sector Beasts at the second stage, my chances of winning are still high. In the future, I can still make my way back to the third stage.”

“The third stage? If your first step is slow, every step thereafter will also be slow. It is fated that you can never be the final king.”

The other Sector Beast, being bitten and torn apart, was drained of its power of resistance. This was because the most important vital point within its body had already been swallowed. Without this area, it was like a dry well. The Sector Beast was completely devoid of combat power.

“Previously, when I realized I was losing the battle, I had already spread news about you throughout the nest.” The dying beast seemed to have gone crazy and went on to say, “I said that, you, Morosa, had returned from the outside world, but that you had regressed by one stage. Even if you finish me off, your power might be at the level of a Sector Beast who has just entered the second stage. You are still extremely weak compared to many others in the nest. Those terrifying fellows who entered the third stage at the same time as you will most certainly seek you out to kill you.”

“You spread the news?” Morosa was slightly taken aback.

This was no great shock. It already expected as much.

Sector beasts were superior life forms who were born to destroy. If it had lain low and not done anything, the other Sector Beasts would never have known that it had dropped in levels. Yet, the moment it started attacking, any Sector Beast it fought against would immediately know the truth. If its opponent had won the fight, the truth about it might not have been disclosed; its opponent might have gone easy on it while basking in glory. Yet the moment its opponent were to lose the fight, the truth about might be disclosed simply as a means of revenge.

And the moment news about Morosa dropping levels was made public, Morosa would be such a defenseless target that any Sector Beast coming out of the nest would dare to attack it! This was also why it had gone crazy after being forced by Luo Feng to fall to the first stage. Morosa knew that to ascend back to the third stage from the first stage was as difficult as going to heaven.

“Afraid now?” the dying Sector Beast mocked.

“Afraid?” Morosa continued biting and tearing big mouthfuls as it continued to say, “It is fated that there will only be one final king. Since I have dropped all the way to the first stage, it is fated that I no longer have the chance to vie for the throne. My future will still be death, eventually. So now, if I have to face death earlier, does it make any difference?”

Internally, Morosa was burning with endless flames of fury. Even if it were to die, before dying, it had to take revenge on that human, Luo Feng, who had crushed its hopes!

“Luo Feng…” Morosa whispered this name silently to himself.

“You’ve ventured to the outside world. I’m afraid you have yet to learn a certain bit of news.” The dying Sector Beast was keen to grasp hold of any slightest chance to deal Morosa with a blow.

“What news?” Morosa looked indifferently at the dying Sector Beast, then took another big bite of it.

“Beddy…” The dying Sector Beast smirked. “Beddy has already attained the fourth stage. This news came from Batur before it died. Many Sector Beasts already know.”

“Before Batur died?” Morosa was taken aback. “No wonder it did not tell me!”

One billion Sector Beasts had been born. After that, they fought one another. The stronger, more powerful Sector Beasts naturally established their footing on the peak. Morosa was one of those at the peak. Batur was another. Both Morosa and Batur bore deep hatred for one another!

Batur had died—killed and swallowed by Beddy. Yet, at the same time, the battle had also allowed Batur to discover that Beddy was already a Sector Beast at the fourth stage. Naturally, it would spread this news before it died, even though it purposely left out some of its arch enemies from the list of parties to inform.

“The fourth stage!” Morosa froze as if doused with ice water.

The first step was slow, and every step after that was also slow. To become the final king, it had to never leave the First Group, where it used to be one of the members. The thing was, it had encountered Beddy’s endless pursuit with murderous intentions, so it had decided to head out to seek its own opportunities to rapidly ascend up to the pinnacle third stage in order to battle Beddy. It had not expected Beddy to actually make it to the fourth stage.

“The final king! No more hope. I… am fated to meet my doom. Then, before dying, I must take my revenge on that loathsome human who had crushed all my hopes!”

Morosa’s other head, the one that was injured, had completely recovered. With both heads drooping low, it was crazily tearing and biting the other Sector Beast, taking big mouthfuls ferociously.

“I will transmit the news to Beddy!” roared the dying Sector Beast. “You and Beddy have been fighting for endless eras… If Beddy knows you have become weak, it will definitely come after you. You are only at the second stage, and Beddy is at the fourth. Beddy’s speed far surpasses yours. There is no way you can escape.” The dying Sector Beast roared its intentions, then sniggered.

Morosa’s other head took another vicious bite, and the dying beast’s remaining head was bitten off.

Tear! Chi! Chi!

One big mouthful followed by another. Morosa devoured and swallowed.

The single eye on each of Sector Beast Morosa’s two heads flashed with icy-cold rays of light.

“Even if I, Morosa, have to die, I will first make Luo Feng pay the price!”

At the same time, it was carefully sensing the numerous Sector Beasts’ positions around it, especially those that were more powerful, like Beddy. Its main concern was to stay vigilant. Deep within the Sector Beast nest, a huge, black figure lay sprawled on a floating desert rock.

Whoo!

A pinnacle first stage, killing a second-stage Sector Beast that was severely injured… It seemed difficult.

Chapter 1438 - Realization

As the most powerful Sector Beast within the Sector Beasts’ nest now, Beddy was naturally concerned about the happenings in Universe Ocean. What a pity Zhen Jia and Dragon Rock are being ostracized by the various races of Universe Ocean, thought Beddy. I can’t even find out whether this Milky Way Horde Leader has achieved his breakthrough to become a true god or not… I also don’t know if this Milky Way has deposed Morosa back to the first stage in his capacity as a “universe master,” or if he did so after he became a true god.

Beddy pondered. The two possibilities were greatly different from one another.

If Luo Feng had become a true god, being able to depose Morosa back to the first stage was nothing impressive, and the threat he posed was not major. But if Luo Feng was merely a universe master, yet had been able to depose Morosa back to the first stage, then when Luo Feng became a true god, how formidable would he be?

“Seems like my powers are still lacking,” Beddy said to himself. “I must increase my power as soon as I can. I need to become more powerful at a much faster rate. I used to focus more on the third-stage Sector Beasts. Now, I need to devour even the second stage Sector Beasts… If I devour a greater number of second-stage Sector Beasts, they can still equate to one third stage Sector Beast.”

Beddy’s past strategy had been very simple. Whatever threatened it, it would devour. And even if it was unable to devour its opponent, it would inflict severe injuries on it. In this way, Beddy was able to keep its position at the top of the pile!

The method was stable and practical. It could easily keep tabs on the hundreds of Sector Beasts that posed the greatest threats to it… but the method was also slow! If it were to devour and attack a tremendous number of second-stage Sector Beasts, it would level up at a much faster rate, but it also meant that he would not be able to acquire enough information about those that threatened it. There were always two sides to any coin.

Sector Beast Morosa and Luo Feng had fought one another in a battle where Morosa was defeated.

This had been the first contact between a Sector Beast and a life form from Universe Ocean and had caused much fear and unrest among the various races of Universe Ocean. The various races were aware that when there was first contact, a second encounter was likely to occur soon.

Likewise, Morosa, upon being deposed back the first stage, had returned to the Sector Beasts’ nest. When the many Sector Beasts from the nest learned this news, they all had a good shock. Back when the inheritance of the ancient civilization had yet to be handed down, becoming a true god was extremely difficult. “Luo Feng!”

True Yan Master knew Luo Feng’s past and had seen how Luo Feng had grown up. He truly cherished Luo Feng as a disciple and had long treated him like family.

True Yan’s family had long passed away due to the passage of time. His disciple was just like his family. In True Yan’s heart, Luo Feng was nothing short of a son. True Yan could not help wishing that he could go in place of Luo Feng. But he was aware that he would only become a morsel of a snack on the Sector Beast’s plate. He would be of no use at all.

Far away, at the three most dangerous lands where the Universe Boat was, within the space of the Black-Striped Stone Pillar.

Right here. This was Luo Feng’s ultimate limit. The nose of the Boat of Mausoleum was almost touching the black-striped stone pillar.

Luo Feng was deep in thought. The space of cultivation was originally able to accommodate an acceleration in time velocity of up to 10,000 times. Of course, this was impossible. Luo Feng, who had a deep understanding of the ancient civilization, was aware that, in an environment where time acceleration was as high as six billion times, if he wanted time acceleration to continue increasing, there would be a drastic increase in difficulty.

Luo Feng maneuvered the Boat of Mausoleum into retreating a bit, stopping at a region where time acceleration was at 500,000 times. Then his earthling original body entered the space of cultivation.

In the space of cultivation, time acceleration could go up to 10,000 times.

With an external time acceleration of 500,000 times and an internal time acceleration of 1,000 times within the space of cultivation, the overall time acceleration reached 500 million times.

Hua!

Luo Feng firmly believed the primal universe bred billions and trillions of life forms with the supreme path of life gestation. Something that seemed as simple as a baby growing up and withering away with age was something Luo Feng meticulously pondered. He investigated every trace left behind under a time acceleration of 10 million times.

Something that seemed as simple as the operation of the celestial realm also fell into Luo Feng’s scope of exploration.

Destroy!

Destroy!

Still destroying!

Looking at all the possibilities the future had in store, Luo Feng merely observed peacefully.

Luo Feng’s eyes lit up. Under his gaze, from the past of the ancient civilization to the future, the Earth was still orbiting around the sun. Even with the various possibilities the future had in store, Earth was still orbiting around the sun, round after round, eternally and without end. From the endless past to the future, Earth, being a life planet, was constantly attracting strange life forces from extremely vast distances to breed life. Beyond space, beyond time, originating from the supreme universe laws, everything would head toward the same ultimate destination. Universe oceans, true gods, true gods of void space… Sector Beasts.

Chapter 1439 - Breakthrough,

Chain Reaction, Legend

Right before him, he could see countless paths that planets and worlds were once found operational—paths outlined by traces of life forces attracted by life planets. His was already a perfect life structure diagram. When compared to a Sector Beast’s life structure diagram…

“They are poles apart. Yet connected somehow.”

Luo Feng stood in outer space, in the area surrounding Earth, deep in thought.

His other body—sustained by godly power and left in the region of the black-striped stone pillar—was laboriously pondering under an environment where time acceleration was maintained at 10 million times. Miraculous brightness was flashing across Luo Feng’s mind as though he was about to be enlightened. Originally, he had found the study of universe masters and true gods to have nothing in common with the study of Sector Beasts. Yet now, between these two schools of life diagrams, which had previously seemed so incongruous with one another, Luo Feng seemed to have found their common ground.

A single picture could be judged differently by different people. Considering the past, when looking at these life structure diagrams, Luo Feng might have felt that they were simply opposites of one another. There was no other perspective from which he could rethink the situation.

But at the moment, after seeing the diagrams from a different point of view, Luo Feng managed to find a commonality between these two endlessly complicated life structure diagrams.

“Life structure!”

Luo Feng stretched out his right palm. His palm was constituted of countless bouts of godly power, and all of them contained soul imprints. Naturally, he was so well-informed that he had everything under control. He was also able to analyze it all in the most detailed manner.

“Combination!”

With his conscious mind, Luo Feng gave his order, and his life structure started to change.

He had achieved 89,999 times life gene level, which already considered to be the ultimate perfection for a life structure diagram. But at that moment, Luo Feng was like a superb sage; with just a few strokes, he could make a picture come alive! Similarly, his changes to the life structure diagram were very simple. Many detailed structures were still the same as they had been, but the overall framework underwent a peculiar change. Also, following the changes in life structure diagrams, Luo Feng was gaining a clearer grasp of the commonality between the school of universe masters, true gods, and true gods of void space, and the school of Sector Beasts.

The process of alteration in the overall framework of Luo Feng’s life structure diagram seemed simple, yet suddenly—

Pa!

An extremely small portion of the complex life structure diagram suddenly fell apart like a melon dropping from its branch upon ripening. Then it very rapidly started to detach itself from the entire life structure diagram. This was not within Luo Feng’s control, but rather, something like a natural reaction. When changes were happening to Luo Feng, parts of his life structure diagram automatically started to show signs of detachment.

“What…?” Luo Feng was shocked, but the thought of stopping these things never crossed his mind. Instead, he watched on.

The extremely small parts of his life structure diagram that were rapidly detached were also going through changes internally. The internal structure seemed to be subjected to a domino effect, where the first change sparked the start of a chain reaction. From a structure diagram that Luo Feng could understand to something else, it transformed rapidly into another structure diagram that was so mystical that even Luo Feng could no longer comprehend.

Buzz!

The extremely small portion of life amazingly took on the form of a naked Luo Feng, seated cross-legged with a smile on his face.

Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa! Pa!

The moment this extremely small portion of the life structure diagram transformed into a naked Luo Feng, the change extended to the other parts of this life structure diagram. Suddenly, many Luo Fengs started to appear; there might be a Luo Feng roaring in anger, or a Luo Feng with a warrior’s pose, or a standing Luo Feng who was deep in thought, or a Luo Feng curled up in bed, or a Luo Feng deep in slumber, or a Luo Feng laughing out loud… All manners of appearances, one by one, were being born.

To describe it all would have taken an eternity, but all these chain reactions happened in the blink of an eye. Luo Feng’s entire life structure diagram had suddenly transformed into 100,000 spots of light, and every spot was a miniature, naked Luo Feng. These 100,000 miniature Luo Fengs, though not physically connected to one another, were still indistinctly associated. Putting all of them together would form Luo Feng’s life structure diagram.

“100,000 light spots…” Even though Luo Feng was the creator, he had never expected to see such a chain reaction happening when he reorganized his life structure diagram.

Earlier, when he had been analyzing the Sector Beast, the life structure diagram of a Sector Beast had also been comprised of 100,000 spots of light, and every one was a miniature Sector Beast. Each miniature Sector Beast itself was the most complex life structure diagram possible.

At this moment, it was likewise for Luo Feng. His life structure diagram was also made up of 100,000 spots of light, with each one being a naked Luo Feng. Each miniature Luo Feng also contained an extremely complex life structure diagram. But, of course, there was a difference between the miniature Luo Feng and the miniature Sector Beast; even Luo Feng himself felt that he was more profound than the Sector Beast!

100,000 spots of light were coming into existence successively. Such a chain reaction seemed to indicate that everything would fall into place. It appeared that success was near at hand.

Weng! Weng! Weng!

After the first trace of godly power on Luo Feng’s right palm changed, it was as though the process was contagious. There was no need for Luo Feng to give another command. Right away, the change in godly power started to spread rapidly. It was like a drop of black ink spreading out rapidly in water. From Luo Feng’s arm, a trace of golden light rapidly started to emerge. Shortly after, this golden light spread out and began filling his surroundings like crazy!

Luo Feng’s palm very quickly became a hand that radiated an endless, dazzling, golden light which, at the same time, moved on to spread through his entire body. Because the godly powers he had before and after the changes all contained Luo Feng’s life imprints, under some guidance, this much more superior life structure diagram—which had attained ultimate perfection—had a deadly attraction for other godly powers. It was just like how a magnet would attract other metallic elements. It naturally attracted the other godly powers around it and caused them to change in a most unrestrained manner.

Hua!

In less than five seconds, Luo Feng’s entire body, including his hair, was radiating golden light.

At the very moment the transformation of his godly body reached the point of completion, it was as though there was a nuclear fusion —as though a massive explosion had gone off within the solar system. The power released was ten million times greater than the power produced when a universe master self-destructed.

The moment Luo Feng’s godly body was approaching the final stage of transformation, his entire body naturally released an outburst of a trillion light rays! A trillion light rays, shining upon a trillion light years…

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The golden light that surged out of Luo Feng’s godly body was not subjected to any restrictions,. Therefore the speed at which it traveled at was comparable to teleportation. In an instant, it was shining upon the entire solar system. Then it moved on to shine upon Milky Way Holy Land, which was not far away, then over to the entire Milky Way Galaxy, and then to the entire Ganwu Universe. This golden light was advancing at top speed, soundlessly transcending time and space. It was unstoppable.

Hua!

A trillion lights penetrated through the human territory to shine upon territories of other races like the bugs, the automatons, and the demons. It then reached out further to shine upon even the most deserted and darkest regions of the primal universe, where no life was able to survive. At that very moment, even the willpower of the universe origin would not have been able to exert any influence over the might of this golden light.

Hua!

A trillion lights finally penetrated through the membrane walls of the entire primal universe, charging toward the endless, chaotic Universe Ocean…

At that moment, Luo Feng was the very core of the primal universe. A trillion lights surrounding him, shining upon the entire primal universe and even spreading out beyond to the surroundings of the primal universe.

The numerous life forms of the “pulse of Earth” who lived on the planet nearest to Luo Feng experienced the influence. Every single Earthling—whether in the sunlight or the dark, in the vast land outdoors or the halls indoors, a powerful earthling who had become an undying or a babbling, newborn infant—at that very moment, every single one’s head was raised in the direction of the golden light.

Nothing material could block the golden light. It transcended time and space, shone into the eye of every living soul, and eventually penetrated into the very soul of every living life form. Within their souls, a lofty golden figure appeared, and they all had a clear view of the face of this figure.

This was Luo Feng, whom they most admired. To the earthlings, who regarded and worshipped Luo Feng as their highest spiritual leader, they were naturally able to recognize him. Even toddlers who might not have known the name of this lofty golden figure would always remember what he looked like in that moment. Upon growing up, after all the memories of childhood had faded, these children would never forget that lofty, golden figure.

“It’s… the great, noble Luo Feng!”

“Luo Feng, the hero!”

The numerous earthlings were greatly taken aback. When the golden light shone upon them and reached deep within their souls, they felt the desire to grovel and kneel before it. It was as though they were seized by a sudden impulse. Whether they were the high-and-mighty undying fighters or the weak and tender youths, all of them went down on their knees.

Within Milky Way Holy Land, a trillion golden lights enshrouded the region where over 100 universe masters lived. There were even some who were true gods, but regardless of whether they were warriors, servants, or true gods, the golden light enveloped them all and directly penetrated their life imprints. Within their souls, a lofty, golden figure appeared.

Respect arose from the depth of their souls. The fundamental distance between different levels of life was the reason why these life forms at lower life levels, in spite of themselves, were compelled to bow and kneel.

Yet regardless of whether they were the weakest life forms— meaning those at universe level of Milky Way Holy Land—or the superior true gods, none was able to go beyond him. Even the true gods knelt as though seized by an irresistible impulse. They were not kneeling to Luo Feng, per se, but rather, their life origins were kneeling to the birth of the noblest life form. This collective show of respect was an act that was purely instinctual.

At this moment, Luo Feng was no longer Luo Feng. He had come to represent the most supreme life form—the greatest and most perfect life form. There was hope for them all to stem the tide of this calamity.

“It’s Milky Way Horde Leader!” The numerous universe masters and even the true gods were all greatly shaken.

“It’s Teacher.” Fire Dome and Luo Feng’s other disciples were stunned yet excited.

The golden light shone. It shone over a trillion light years; it shone over the entire primal universe.

No one was able to stop it. Even the willpower of the primal universe origin had to temporarily retreat because of the supreme universe law of Universe Ocean. This supreme law enveloped the golden light. Because the golden light contained the supreme laws, it could surpass time and space, as well as all material obstacles. This was how it could make all other life forms kneel before it.

Regardless of good or evil, weak or strong, be it Luo Feng’s enemy or even his family, Primal Chaos City Leader, Peng Gong, Dream Demon Ancestor, the many Father Gods of the automaton race, the few dozen true gods from the entire primal universe—all were down on their knees. They were deeply touched from deep within their souls as they knelt. It was not a situation in which they, beings with lower social statuses, were compelled to kneel by one who was above them in social standing; it was more of a way of showing their respect for the greatest life form born under the supreme law.

In hundreds of millions of races as well as countless planets, god countries, and universe secret regions, blood and flesh life forms, automaton life forms, plant life forms, energy life forms—all kinds of life-forms—the low and the weakest link to the highest and strongest masters, all were showing their respect in their own ways. They were kneeling and groveling, and all these were representative of their life origins showing respect.

Gradually, the golden light that had spread over an area of a trillion light years dispersed. The supreme law no longer worked any influence over the trillions of life forms. Once again, the willpower of the primal universe origin moved to enshroud the entire universe.

The millions and billions of races within the entire primal universe, regardless of whether they were weak or strong, could no longer see the golden light. Everyone was now awakened, but in their souls, their life cores would be eternally imprinted with that lofty golden figure.

Chapter 1440 - True God

The supreme law dictated how everything operated within the entire Universe Ocean, such as why the primal universe forever went through the cycle of destruction and birth, and why there was the birth of Sector Beasts. The supreme law did not have any ability of thought, no trace at all. It was merely a set of rules to be adhered to. Yet it was above all else.

“Luckily, the supreme law was only there to guide the life origin of living souls,” Sitting Mountain Guest said to himself. “Life forms of the lower class naturally hold great respect for the life forms of the higher class, and they will definitely admire those higher-class life forms… The supreme laws merely served to guide and reinforce so that every single life form, including true gods, would obey their instincts and bow before the golden light. Luo Feng regained normality.

That was how high his degree of precision was.

Luo Feng was seriously shocked. God! This was simply unbelievable.

The godly body was divided into three levels. 30,000 times to 60,000 times constituted the first level. 60,000 times to 90,000 times would be the second level. 90,000 and any limit that was almost 100,000 times constituted the third level.

The inheritance of the pulse of Duan Dong River documented that no one had ever attained a level of 100,000 times. Right. It seems like in the records of the World of Jin, the records on Sector Beasts were also legends, and the Sector Beasts present in the records all seem to have been very powerful. Those were Sector Beasts in their growth stages.”

Since no such occurrence had ever been discovered, naturally, the exact cause was unclear. Luo Feng had succeeded, but he could only arrive at some vague speculations to explain his success.

At the same time, Luo Feng’s Remote Ocean body, Mosha body, and Golden Horned Beast body—which had been stationed about Universe Ocean, patrolling the grounds—were rushing back.

Chapter 1441 - Miniature

Universe

The boundless Remote Ocean was extremely wide, and above it, there was an even wider shadow of the ocean of laws. A tremendous amount of godly power ocean water was continuously falling like a rainstorm.

“It’s the ocean of laws!”

“Such an unexpected amount of godly power that has befallen!”

Within the clusters of palaces in Milky Way Holy Land, the true gods, universe masters, and many universe knights were all watching from afar. They were all shocked by the shadow of the ocean of laws in the distance.

Enveloped by the endless godly ocean waters was a figure clothed in a white robe.

“It is devouring at such an unbelievably fast speed,” Luo Feng marveled in wonder.

For the average godly body to recover from severe injuries, recovering 90 percent to 100 percent generally required a short time. However, to recover from 50 percent to 100 percent, the required time would skyrocket to at least 10,000 or a million times! Consuming the godly body would mean losing part of the soul. Therefore, recovery was extremely difficult. This was why a small consumption of godly body was easy to recover from. For example, recovering a godly body from 98 percent to 100 percent was certainly quite easy to achieve.

The same theory applied here. The volume of the boundless Remote Ocean was only an approximate 90 percent of its actual size because it was a recombination of godly power. In fact, Luo Feng had not lost any part of his soul! Thus, his absorption speed could be extremely fast.

“I can feel it as though every bit of godly power within me is screaming out loud while madly swallowing,” Luo Feng said in amazement. “Under normal circumstance, absorbing the godly power within the ocean of laws is relatively more difficult, but now, as I am swallowing, the virtual shadow of the ocean of laws descends directly, and everything seems to fall into place nicely.”

When crossing over the levels from undying to knight and then to universe master, every time he had crossed a particular threshold, the ocean of laws had directly poured out its godly power. But Luo Feng’s breakthrough this time around was a breakthrough of the godly body level; he had not crossed any threshold. Regardless of how keen the willpower of the origin was in helping Luo Feng build up his godly body as soon as possible, it had to obey the law, which made it a must for Luo Feng to be proactive in his absorption—in order to prompt the fall of the godly ocean water.

One, Luo Feng’s soul was complete; two, at 100,000 times godly power, the absorption was shocking; three, with the permission of the supreme law, the willpower of the origin was remarkably cooperative. This was why it only took slightly over a year for the boundless Remote Ocean to expand again. This time its diameter was as wide as 12 light years.

“It cannot expand any further.”

The white-robed Luo Feng stood on the surface of the boundless Remote Ocean. High in the sky, the shadow of the ocean of laws finally dissipated.

“I have reached a diameter of 12 light years. There is no way I can swallow any more godly power.” Luo Feng was deep in thought. “I have achieved the third level of godly body, where the size of a godly body is supposedly adjustable according to one’s own preference, but this unlimited godly body, most unfortunately, does not seem to be truly unlimited after all.”

It should be noted that within the ocean of laws of the primal universe, there were limited resources. So how could it be possible to be truly unlimited? A diameter of 12 light years was already a limit that was impossible to surpass.

Luo Feng took one look at the faraway cluster of palaces. There were indeed many great beings looking over from afar. It swallowed and accommodated all the godly ocean water to its heart’s content, and within the blink of an eye, the mighty and boundless Remote Ocean had vanished. Not a trace was left.

But no! To be more precise, a small lake remained. Compared to the previous Remote Ocean, this small lake was negligible.

He mused to himself, The power of that small lake is equivalent to the reserve of power in my earthling original godly body, meaning to say, the godly power my earthling original body had was the same as that of the boundless Remote Ocean when its diameter was at 12 light years. No more, no less.

The white-robed Luo Feng looked to his side.

Buzz!

An indistinct golden light came on. Right away, his earthling original body, his Golden Horned Beast body, his Mosha body, the small lake, and his Remote Ocean body all went into the golden light.

In the vast god country, there were grasslands, a great ocean, and mountains. Luo Feng stood high up in the air as he looked down at his vast god country.

“My god country has reached its limit. I just need to start expanding, and very soon, my god country will be able to evolve into a miniature universe. My godly power has also absorbed to its limit. I am no longer able to absorb any more… so… let’s begin.”

Luo Feng was standing high up in the sky where he could not help but feel a little excited. How could he not be excited, considering he had looked forward to this day for as long as a trillion eras? Then, with a thought, Luo Feng’s vast god country started expanding with a loud rumble.

From where they were originally, the boundary walls of his god country started expanding outwards. This expansion brought about a sudden, violent reaction.

Hong!

The entire god country trembled, and instantly, a void passageway appeared. It remained connected to his god country. He did not know where it originated from, but from the end that was lodged within his god country, an endless, chaotic airflow started to surge outward like crazy. The moment this dense, chaotic airflow charged its way in, it tore heaven and earth apart; it tore the ocean apart; everything was shattered and returned to a chaotic state.

With the tremendous amount of energy supplied by the chaotic airflow, his god country started to expand like crazy.

Hong!

Following the expansion of his god country, another void passageway appeared. This allowed even more chaotic airflow to surge in. It was like a scene in which the world was facing total destruction.

Luo Feng stood in the middle of his god country and looked around. Numerous void passages were emerging successively, thus allowing an upsurge of chaotic air flow. This caused the whole god country to become a chaotic whirlpool. At this point, his god country was still expanding.

As it was expanding, it was constantly on the move. Luo Feng’s god country had originally been within a “space interlayer,” and beyond it was the membrane wall of the primal universe. By penetrating the membrane wall, one would enter the primal universe! At the moment, his god country was consistently making progress in its advances. However, expanding from a god country to a miniature universe did require a certain amount of time.

Luo Feng stood amidst the endless, chaotic airflow, filled with anticipation for his own god country. The diameter of miniature universes of true gods of void space usually fell within a range of one billion light years to ten billion light years. But for true gods, the diameter was kept at a consistent 100 million light years. This was because when these miniature universes were first born, it was always the same situation. Upon expanding and acquiring their fixed forms, the miniature universes would immediately begin working out their internal structures. And when the true gods became true gods of void space after their breakthroughs in the future, these internal structures and true gods’ powers would affect the sizes of their miniature universes.

Peng!

The entire god country trembled suddenly. The walls surrounding his god country slowly transformed into universe membrane walls and eventually became a massive godly body with a diameter of 100 million light years.

Then this miniature universe with a diameter of 100 million light years unexpectedly continued to expand.

“Still expanding.” Luo Feng, who was already exhilarated, was now shocked. “All miniature universes of true gods are usually around the same size. Why is my miniature universe still expanding?”

Could it be related to my godly body? Luo Feng could not help wondering.

Previously, when he had first achieved 100,000 times life gene level, the billions of races from the primal universe had knelt before him to offer their congratulatory wishes. That scene had been incredible. As for the expansion of his god country, it was closely related to the godly body.

For the godly power route, there would first be a breakthrough in one’s godly body, so that the god country could continue to expand a little. Usually, for those who chose the godly power path, regardless of whether it was 30,000 times, 60,000 times or 90,000 times, their miniature universes would still remain at a diameter of 100 million light years. Yet Luo Feng had managed to unshackle himself from this restraint.

According to the documentation on the ancient civilization by the pulse of Duan Dong River and the World of Jin, no true god was known to have achieved 100,000 times life gene level. This was much more difficult to achieve than 90,000 times life gene level, hence the scarcity of such occurrences. In such a situation, could it be so simple to achieve 100,000 times life gene level?

To achieve 30,000 times life gene level, the height of a godly body would increase sharply by ten times. To achieve 60,000 times life gene level, the height of a godly body would increase sharply by 1,000 times and achieving 90,000 times life gene level would allow one to reach the stage of an unlimited godly body, where its size was entirely up to the true god’s own preference. As for 100,000 times? More laws would fall, and the various other races would come forth to express their congratulations. If this were not regarded as unique, that would be a joke.

Yet now, Luo Feng was focused on becoming a true god. Thus, he had yet to look into this area in depth.

At that moment, his miniature universe had exceeded the common diameter measurement of 100,000 light years, which was one of the special traits enabled by the achievement of 100,000 times life gene level.

The greater the diameter, the more the volume would increase by leaps and bounds. This would then hinder the speed of expansion of the miniature universe because more chaotic airflow would be required.

The diameter increased from 200 million light years to 300 million light years…

As Luo Feng expanded his miniature universe, every single race from the primal universe all the way to the Universe Ocean had been waiting expectantly for a new miniature universe to appear. Yet, no matter how long they waited, there was no sign of a new miniature universe emerging.

“What is going on?” Primal Chaos City Leader wondered, feeling a bit anxious. “Luo Feng previously told me that his god country was starting to change into a miniature universe. The evolution to form a miniature universe should not take too long, right? It has already been half a year. Why is there still no news?”

Opposite Primal Chaos City Leader, there was another white-robed man, Teacher Origin.

Luo Feng liked white robes, and so did Teacher Origin. But the two were of very different temperaments. Luo Feng was more like a long-range rifle—unwavering, sharp, and unstoppable! On the other hand, Teacher Origin was of a gentler disposition.

“I, too, don’t know.” Teacher Origin shook his head. “The virtual universe could only vaguely detect the other region. I am sure of it. Luo Feng’s god country is right at that region… but right now, it is expanding, and his origin is starting to take form. I cannot intrude any further. No need to mention that when his god country is expanding—with the help of the willpower of the origin, and with the supreme laws will help to bring about—no one will be able to affect him. No one will be able to contact him.”

During a breakthrough, one was under absolute protection. No one was able to interrupt another’s breakthrough period.

The various races of Universe Ocean were all feeling anxious.

Within his own miniature universe, Luo Feng could feel the continuous expansion of his miniature universe until one fine day, when the miniature universe finally stopped expanding with a rumble, and everything was formed. At the same time, an unstoppable, mighty force was exerted over the miniature universe. The miniature universe was originally already situated by the membrane walls of the primal universe. Under the influence of this unstoppable and mighty force, it was popped out easily as though it was no more than a glass ball.

Hong!

The entire miniature universe crashed its way out of the primal universe, and like a fish entering the ocean or like a bird soaring up into the sky, this miniature universe finally made its way into the vast Universe Ocean.

Chapter 1442 - Unity of

Bodies, Universe Structure

This miniature universe had a diameter of one billion light years. No more, no less.

“Wow! One billion light years!”
