Purple Moon Holy Land universe has a diameter of 210 million light years, and East Emperor Holy Land universe has a diameter of 320 million light years, but both the holy land ancestors had long transcended reincarnation to achieve a much higher level… That is how their miniature universes were able to get so big. For this Milky Way Horde Leader’s miniature universe to be so big… This is quite unexpected.”

They were all shocked. But even though they were shocked, they were still able to accept. Because in their hearts, they all knew that for Luo Feng to become the Number One Master of Universe Ocean while still a mere universe master, and for him to be able to get billions of races (including true gods) of the primal universe to bow before him the moment he achieved a breakthrough, it was not strange for him to be able to create such a miracle, given such impressive power and influence.

Right away, the news was rapidly spread to every race in the entire Universe Ocean.

“He has become a true god, and his miniature universe has a diameter of one billion light years? Haha! Great.” Divine Eye True Master and the other four true masters had gathered, and Divine Eye True Master was greatly delighted as he commented, “Milky Way is by far the most powerful true god! We finally have a hope of stemming the tide of the Sector Beast crisis!”

“Only a true god, and yet his miniature universe is so big. Even the inheritance of the ancient civilization of the World of Jin has no records of such a feat. Incredible, incredible.”

“Impossible!” Purple Moon Ancestor also got the news and was in for a great shock.

“Ancestor, I saw it with my own eyes!” the godly-powered avatar of a particular universe master beneath Purple Moon Ancestor reported deferentially. “Not just me, in fact. The various races of Universe Ocean all know that this is the absolute truth.”

Purple Moon Ancestor was dumbfounded. “This, this, this…”

During some favorable encounters in his life, Purple Moon Ancestor had belittled even someone like East Emperor. Undoubtedly, he must have known a great deal.

“Previously, billions of races all bowed to him as a means of congratulating him, and now, his true god miniature universe has attained a diameter of one billion light years.” Purple Moon Ancestor shook his head. “From this pulse of mine, there have been several existences who stood at the peak of the ancient civilization. However, for all of them, when they became true gods, their miniature universes had diameters of 100 million light years. It was the same for everyone in this ancient civilization, without exception. This Luo Feng… what has he done?” Purple Moon Ancestor gritted his teeth. “No matter how strong you are, it will be best if you can kill all the Sector Beasts!”

In Universe Ocean, it was a scene of celebration. Even Luo Feng’s enemies were equally delighted because he was their only hope of dealing with the Sector Beasts.

Of course, the humans in their own territorial grounds were most excited. Luo Feng’s parents, his wife, his sons, and his other family members, as well as Primal Chaos City Leader and True Yan—all of whom were always greatly concerned about Luo Feng—were excited beyond containment.

Even Teacher Origin could not help marveling when he learned of the news, saying, “How can a mere true god’s miniature universe be this big? Incredible. This is simply incredible!”

No matter how the outside world rejoiced, no one was able to establish contact with Luo Feng.

Within his miniature universe, Luo Feng looked all around. The void passages had long vanished, and the entire miniature universe was filled with an endless and majestic chaotic airflow.

“The universe has expanded to its ultimate limit. The next step will be to unite all my other bodies, return back to their origin, and then transform back into my earthling original body. There are also the universe origin and universe structure.”

Luo Feng held his breath. The next steps had to be completed in succession. And among them, the one involving the universe structure was the most important step!

The internal structure of the miniature universe had to be determined at the very beginning, before everything else could be finalized. Once the chaotic airflow started to transform into the ten basic law forces, such as time and space, there would no longer be the chance to establish the structure. For any superior great being, there was only one chance for structuring their universe.

This was a once-in-a-lifetime event. One, this structure would determine the future of the miniature universe when it had to undergo evolution in the future; two, it determined the origin of the miniature universe! And three, it determined the ultimate limit that the great being could attain.

Determining the most basic structure was like laying the foundation when building a skyscraper. If the foundation was not well-established, then naturally, it would not be possible to construct a skyscraper at all. If a universe structure was not well constructed to begin with, then in the future, the gradual evolution of the miniature universe would also be limited. For instance, it would be impossible to achieve a breakthrough in evolving to the eternal true god stage.

Even if one might already have an extremely high comprehension ability, if one’s miniature universe did not evolve and enhance itself, there would never be a breakthrough.

How could this step be taken lightly?

Luo Feng stood amid the endless, chaotic airflow where his eyes could easily reach any corner of his miniature universe.

“All bodies unite! Return to origin!”

Luo Feng gave the order right away. His voice resounded throughout the entire miniature universe.

Hong!

A strong bout of power immediately worked its influence over Luo Feng’s original body, Mosha body, Golden Horned Beast body, Remote Ocean body, and the small Remote Ocean lake. Instantly, all of these were shifted to another space. This space was contained within the miniature universe origin. At that moment, it was chaotic within the internal space of the universe origin, as the structure had yet to finalize. The universe structure must be finalized before the origin could take full form.

“Disintegrate!”

The other bodies were completely disintegrated instantly while all the treasures that they carried with them floated aside. This combination of disintegrated bodies transformed into the core of a formidable godly power, where a “heart” was found. That was the heart of a true god.

The heart of a true god was the most important thing within the body of a true god. The soul would be hidden within the heart, and it was how he could communicate with the origin of his miniature universe. If the origin of his miniature universe was transformed into a great amount of godly power, this power could be transmitted directly to the heart of a true god. Once the heart of a true god shattered, that marked the end of the true god. Luo Feng’s origin of miniature universe was 1,000 times stronger than that of any other true god at the same level, so his heart was also stronger by 1,000 times.

“Return to origin!”

As the voice of Luo Feng’s willpower sounded, a great godly power started to change and condense through a cohesion process. In the process of cohesion, the godly power was constantly being refined, and in moments, it soared by 100 times. At the same time, the cohesion process gave form to flesh and blood, skeletal structure and bones, skin and hair. Very soon, a naked, black-haired man appeared within the origin of the miniature universe that had yet to take complete form.

“When the miniature universe is complete, I can return to the origin,” Luo Feng whispered to himself with a sigh. “With the previous god country, how would it be able to support such an original earthling body of mine?”

Unfortunately, he thought, my power that has soared up to 100 times. This is merely a transformation of my godly power. So now, my godly power is only left with 1 percent of my previous amount.

If this remaining power was spread out and transformed in the form of an ocean, then previously, his godly power could be transformed into an ocean with a diameter of 12 light years. Now, he was left with a power that could be transformed into an ocean with a diameter slightly more than two light years.

Of course, so long as there was enough power, it was still possible to recover back to the diameter of 12 light years. This was, however, up to Luo Feng’s miniature universe to swallow and consume enough power for supply. The primal universe could no longer provide Luo Feng with any more energy.

“Fortunately, by becoming a true god, my soul will be hidden within the heart of true god. In terms of quantity, even if I have not achieved my ultimate potential, my power can still be released to its maximum potential. Regardless, I have finally become a true god.”

Luo Feng let out a long sigh and, for the moment, felt a tremendous amount of fiery passion.

“True god!”

He had waited so long for this day.

“Come.” Luo Feng set his gaze afar. Not far from him, all the treasures—like Wu Qi God and Shi Wu Wings, which were afloat in midair—suddenly came flying at high speed toward him. Wu Qi God enveloped him all over, forming an armor over his entire body, while Shi WU Wings also appeared on his back. Star Tower, Blood Ghost Blade, and various other treasures were all stored with a flip of Luo Feng’s palm.

“Now, we have to start on the most important step,” Luo Feng said to himself. “The pulse of Duan Dong River and the pulse of the World of Jin—both have a set of their own miniature universe structure laws. Even the three generations of ancestors and the Godly King of Jin’s miniature universe structure laws have records. However, my set of structure law does not necessarily have to be the same as theirs.”

A long time ago, Luo Feng had once put some thought into designing a framework for his own structure law. This was a final set of laws that Luo Feng had come up with. It was based on other various structure laws from the pulse of Duan Dong River and the pulse of the World of Jin. At the time, Luo Feng had named it “Cloud Nine.”

However, this time around, he had broken through to achieve 100,000 times life gene level. For the past year or so, while swallowing godly power from the endless Remote Ocean, Luo Fen had been constantly pondering the matter. Based on his comprehension of the life structure diagram and the numerous structure laws that he had come across throughout this period of time, he had created another set of structure laws.

Upon coming up with this newer set of structure laws, Luo Feng could instantly sense that it had absolutely transcended its predecessor, Cloud Nine. Luo Feng named this set of structure laws, “Beginning of the Origin.”

Luo Feng stood within the space of the universe origin of his miniature universe. Internally, everything was chaotic because it had yet to take complete form.

“Rise!”

Luo Feng’s thoughts shrouded the entire universe, and regardless of the space of origin or all the chaos within the universe, everything shook and trembled.

“100,000 Heavens!”

Luo Feng’s willpower enshrouded everything around him as it started to get mobilized. It was just like how the myths and legends described the creation of heaven and earth. It was not one Pan Gu creating the universe, but 100,000 of him, simultaneously creating the universe.

The chaotic airflow within the entire universe was manipulated into splitting and rotating, then gradually condensing to take form as planes within space started to rapidly emerge. Within the span of a single thought, 100,000 planes within spaces were formed. Luo Feng’s face registered a solemn expression. The execution of this structure law, “Beginning of the Origin,” was tens of thousands of times more difficult than the execution of “Cloud Nine.”

Even if his willpower was differentially controlled, there was still a chance of failure. The moment he failed, his structure law could not be regarded as a “Beginning of the Origin.” It would only suffice as “100,000 Heavens,” which meant it was only comparable to structure laws that were considered relatively superior, like those of the pulse of Duan Dong River or the pulse of the World of Jin. Luo Feng, for one, would certainly not be content to be at this level.

Chapter 1443 - Beginning of

the Origin, Arrival of Sector

Beast

Just as Luo Feng was putting his universe structure in place, within the vast Universe Ocean, Sector Beast Morosa was advancing at high speed.

“Loathsome.” The two heads of Sector Beast Morosa looked ferocious. “They all knew my power is greatly reduced… Even those fools whom I have always looked down upon previously are all charging toward me now. Now, I don’t even have a space to survive in within the Sector Beasts’ nest. If not for them, given my power, it would not be difficult at all for me to make my way back to the third stage.”

Anger. Although Morosa had madly devoured an entire Sector Beast to climb its way up to the second stage, that Sector Beast had transmitted the news about Morosa’s greatly reduced power before it was annihilated. This had reduced Sector Beast Morosa to the state of a rat scampering across the street, with everyone chasing after him, trying to attack him. When Morosa had stood at the peak, instinctively, it had wanted to kill the other Sector Beasts too; now that it was weak, it was natural for the other Sector Beasts to want to reciprocate with revenge.

“I can only return to Universe Ocean.” Sector Beast Morosa shook its head. “Since I no longer have a place in the nest, then before I meet my end, I shall let that Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng know the consequences of messing with me.”

Morosa was not fully confident that it could take revenge on Luo Feng. However… it did not have a choice!

The burning desire to destroy ran in its blood. It was the source of its courage to bring destruction upon itself by taking revenge on Luo Feng. Even if it could not kill Luo Feng, it would still attempt to draw out the repulsive feelings toward Luo Feng. And finally, it would transmit all the information it had back to the Land of Darkness and cause Luo Feng to fall into a truly massive calamity.

Sou! Sou!

Sector Beast Morosa executed a series of long-distance teleportations, and very soon, it arrived at the peripheral region of a miniature universe.

“Roar!”

The black fog reappeared in a winding manner around Morosa while streams of distorted light rays extended out directly toward the miniature universe. It did not devour but merely maintained this state.

A short while later, a ship appeared out of nowhere, and a figure flew out from within it. This figure was none other than the majestic and burly Nine-Headed Demon Master.

Nine-Headed Demon Master took one look at Sector Beast Morosa and could not help feel a pinch of regret. He was a true god that had always stayed low-key and showed forbearance to all its wrath and frustrations. After he had learned that the World of Jin had appeared, he had gradually started to reveal his power. He was, in fact, ranked as one of the eight heroes of Universe Ocean.

Even before Hong and Eye Devil God, he had already sent some of the universe masters under his command over to the Sector Beasts’ nest to explore. Every time he sent an exploration team, someone was bound to be annihilated. However, he usually sent out energy life forms, so at least there would not be souls being exterminated.

It was through these explorations that Nine-Headed Demon Master had gotten to know what a terrifying quantity of Sector Beasts were within the nests. His underlings had found out about merely a portion of them, yet that many Sector Beasts was enough to completely fill up a substantial amount of land. The number had sent shivers down his spine!

He was still filled with anticipation. Even though the Sector Beasts were not considered to be very powerful at the moment, one was enough to bring the races within all of Universe Ocean to the brink of collapse.

Finally, Nine-Headed Demon Master had secretly contacted Sector Beast Morosa, and he had decided to pledge allegiance to the Sector Beasts! Just like how Great Thunder Star Master, Dragon Rock Ancestral God, and Zhen Jia Emperor.

However, the moment Nine-Headed Demon Master changed sides, he had greatly regretted his decision. Changing sides meant becoming an obedient servant that only listened and acted according to the wishes of the Sector Beasts. Furthermore, he had a hunch that more trouble was brewing. In the future, when the king of Sector Beasts was born, those who had defected would face tragedy all the same.

He felt deep remorse, but it was too late for regrets!

“My original intention was to keep myself safe during this crisis by taking the side of the Sector Beasts,” Nine-Headed Demon Master said to himself. “I am from the second reincarnation era, and I have the inheritance of the ancient civilization from the World of Jin. With all these, it is totally possible for me to transcend reincarnation during the final period of the third reincarnation era. I never expected such an outcome for pledging allegiance to the Sector Beasts… Loathsome willpower of the origin! It should have mentioned this earlier.”

Nine-Headed Demon Master was regretful and angry. Thanks to Nine-Headed Demon Master’s role as a traitor, Sector Beast Morosa had been able to evade the area where Luo Feng had hidden in order to ambush him.

“Nine-Headed Demon Master,” Morosa said, staring.

“My great king,” Nine-Headed Demon Master responded respectfully. The moment he had changed sides, he had begun to address any Sector Beasts he met as “king”!

Morosa nodded. “Tell me. During this period, what is happening within Universe Ocean? What is Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng up to nowadays?”

Nine-Headed Demon Master replied right away, “My great king! It is relatively peaceful in Universe Ocean. It’s just that Milky Way Horde Leader has now become a true god.”

“He became a true god!” Morosa was greatly taken aback. Previously, when Luo Feng was still a universe master, he had been able to bring Morosa down from the third grade to the first grade. Morosa had only just managed to make it back to second grade, and Luo Feng was already a true god. If they were to cross paths again, the outcome was a given. Morosa would be the one being trampled upon.

“So fast!” Morosa said in shock.

“Not fast.” Nine-Headed Demon Master shook its head. “Milky Way Horde Leader is our universe’s Number One Master. Given his impressive talent, it is considered slow that it took him a trillion eras to finally break through. Besides, his disciple long go became a true god. Also, I have to inform my king… during the time when Milky Way Horde Leader broke through, he…”

Nine-Headed Demon Master related everything he knew, including the billions of races within the primal universe going down on their knees to bow to Luo Feng, and Luo Feng’s miniature universe with a diameter of 100,00 light years. Everything it knew, it related without leaving out a single detail.

The more Morosa learned, the more twisted his expression became.

“Milky Way Horde Leader’s miniature universe has just entered Universe Ocean,” Nine-Headed Demon Master informed Morosa. “At this point, he ought to be laying the structure of his miniature universe. Even if his miniature universe has finalized its form, there is still the evolution of chaos… All these steps require time to complete, and since his miniature universe is so big, I suspect the time that is required will be much longer than most true gods. He might be stuck in there for a month or two.”

Sector Beast Morosa was delighted to hear this. Stuck in there?

Joyfully, Morosa thought, True. After becoming a true god, this Luo Feng will have no other bodies. Only his original body… Then he will not be so daring as to patrol about Universe Ocean. He has to protect his miniature universe as well as his human race. However, there is also the possibility that he will risk coming out to patrol anyway. After all, with so many true gods in his Hong Alliance, if such a group were to take action together, they would still be able to stop me.

Endless thoughts went through Morosa’s mind. Then it grinned.

No matter what, at least for the coming two months… Luo Feng was not able to come out!

“Hahaha…” Morosa laughed heartily. “Nine-Headed, you did well,” he praised.

Nine-Headed Demon Master bowed his head to indicate his allegiance.

Morosa roared with laughter, then teleported away. Nine-Headed Demon Master raised his heads, but all nine of them registered awful expressions. One wrong step, and all the following steps were wrong, too. There was no longer any chance to look back and reconsider his decision.

Within Luo Feng’s miniature universe…

“100,000 Heavens!”

The entire miniature universe had 100,000 planes. They were of different sizes, and there were also differences in structure. Indistinctly, there was contact across every one of these planes within the space. Just like a whirlpool, the chaotic airflow encircled the peripheral region of the planes. 100,000 heavens were all revolving. And internally, everything was pushing toward completion.

At the same time, in the chaotic environment within the universe origin, 100,000 planets started to revolve. These 100,000 planets corresponded to 100,000 Heavens. It was as if the structure of the miniature universe was undergoing a process of “miniaturization” within the space of the origin. Yet Luo Feng knew that it was, in fact, the space of the origin guiding everything happening on the outside world.

After a while, Luo Feng’s eyes shone brightly. “100,000 Heavens is successfully completed,” he said. “Now, I must begin the most important step! Beginning of the Origin!”

Luo Feng’s willpower enshrouded his entire miniature universe. Instantly, 100,000 planes within space started to revolve violently. Every plane was indistinctly maintaining contact with one another. Such contact was unable to be detected by the naked eye. However, within the universe origin, the 100,000 planets that corresponded to 100,000 Heavens, were bursting with streams of golden light. These rays of light were connecting to form a massive network of incomparable precision, like a “super complex” in The Rhinoceros Emperor Game.

“Form!”

Luo Feng’s willpower let out a ferocious roar. 100,000 planets within the universe origin suddenly unleashed a dazzling light. The complex Rhinoceros Emperor Game that was formed by the countless golden light rays was also bursting with energy. Within the entire core, a mass of nothingness was formed.

Hong! Long! Long!

An earth-shattering sound was heard, and the 100,000 planes were still revolving. The whirlpool they created was expanded upon their continuous bombardment against one another. These planes seemed to be randomly scattered about, but once they all started to revolve, once every single plane started to rotate at the same time, it was like Earth revolving around the sun; the 100,000 planes within the surfaces also started revolving around the core!

It was too difficult. It was like pulling and grinding. The beginning pull was always the most difficult. All 100,000 planes within the surfaces surrounded the central core. And the moment they started to revolve, Luo Feng’s willpower felt as though it was about to crumble and collapse. At long last, everything seemed to be revolving. Then the speed of revolution gradually increased! Steadily, some of the planes started to collide with one another. The more delicate ones immediately started to show signs of cracks.

Peng!

One of the planes collapsed right away. Luo Feng remained expressionless. He continued to keep everything under control.

“I say, form!” Luo Feng’s willpower roared once again.

Hong!

The miniature universe let out another rumble that was so loud that it could be heard even from the outside. Luo Feng’s universe origin also let out the same rumble. Then what could be seen was the central position of almost 100,000 planes within spaces, a whirlpool that was in continuous revolution had appeared. It was like a bottomless black hole of whirlpools. Right in the center of the whirlpools was the universe origin.

At that moment, close to the center of these 100,000 planets that were within the universe origin, a void whirlpool appeared.

“Done.” Luo Feng could not conceal his delight.

Everything returned to peace and quiet. With the void whirlpool as the center, close to 100,000 planes were led into continuous revolution. While they were revolving, a new plane unexpectedly emerged. Thereafter, planes started emerging successively. In a fleeting moment, 100,000 planes were recovered. Likewise, within the universe origin, 100,000 planets were recovered.

Luo Feng’s face reflected his joy. “The ‘Beginning of the Origin’ is formed. Everything will have the origin. The birth of everything and anything on Earth is now endless and limitless.”

The void space formed by 100,000 Heavens was none other than the origin. With this origin, his miniature universe could be given endless possibilities. Even if all 100,000 planes within space were shattered, they still had the chance of rebirth.

“Beginning of the Origin…” Luo Feng looked within his own universe origin and saw 100,000 bright, dazzling planets encircling the central void as they revolved around it. This central void was the ultimate core of the entire universe origin. This origin was where everything began. Within the void space, loud gurgling sounds were soon heard. Then, like a fountain spraying water, a tremendous amount of godly ocean water gushed out. And outside Luo Feng’s miniature universe, the tremendous amount of chaotic airflow was being absorbed like mad.

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The endless chaotic airflow started to wind and revolve around Luo Feng’s miniature universe, forming a massive whirlpool. Every moment, a tremendous amount of chaotic airflow was being swallowed and transformed into godly power.

All miniature universes possessed the ability to transform godly powers, yet for Luo Feng, his “Beginning of the Origin” structure had enhanced this ability of transformation up to a level that was incredible beyond words.

Chapter 1444 - The Rapid

Exaltation

A lone figure appeared out of nowhere. It was none other than Morosa.

At that moment, Morosa was in its original form. Its ugly two heads looked afar at the indistinct silhouette of a miniature universe, while the two single eyes—one on each head—flashed with greed. “Finally, I am here again. So long as I swallow one miniature universe origin, I can be elevated to the second stage pinnacle.”

An evil black aura spread and filled the surroundings as streams of distorted rays of light rapidly penetrated the void space for a distance up to 100 million light years. Continuous streams of dazzling brilliance traveled along those distorted rays and headed right into Morosa’s body.

“How comfortable.” Morosa’s two heads were raised in great satisfaction.

Shock Devil God was entrenched somewhere along the rolling mountain range, where its tail was wrapped around the foothills of the mountains and its head entwined around the mountain peaks. Suddenly, its eyes shot open with such ferocity that they resembled two massive, blazing stars.

“Sector Beast!” Shock Devil God revealed a hint of fear. “The Sector Beast is finally here again. I’m afraid the situation won’t be so simple this time.”

Shock Devil God was fearful and anxious. It was not confident about confronting the Sector Beast. The first opponent Morosa would choose among the true gods would definitely be one of the weaker powers.

The Sector Beast had reappeared!

The news was like a storm that spread very rapidly among all the races within the entire Universe Ocean (not including the two races headed by Zhen Jia Emperor and Dragon Rock Ancestral God).

In the virtual universe, there was a beautiful godly palace suspended in one of the individual spaces. At the highest level of this godly palace, there were two thrones. Beside the two thrones, as many as 100 other thrones were arranged according to rank. This place was True God Palace.

Presently, the humans were held in great esteem throughout the entire primal universe, especially in the face of a Sector Beast crisis. Occasionally, some true gods’ meetings would be held at this True God Palace, where everyone would be gathered. The two thrones at the highest position belonged to two of the eight heroes—Milky Way Horde Leader, Luo Feng, and Primal Chaos City Leader! Even Nine Remoteness True Master had to sit one level down. This showed the current status of the humans!

Many figures were appearing successively, filling up those vacant thrones. At the top, garbed in a golden robe, was Primal Chaos City Leader. Right away, he took his seat and looked down at the crowd.

As Golden Horn True God’s original body was also a golden horned beast, throughout the entire Space Beast Alliance, it shared the closest relationship with Luo Feng. Therefore, Golden Horn True God was usually the main point of contact between the Space Beast Alliance and the humans.

Some of the true gods from other races spoke up. The true gods from the human race, on the other hand, kept mum.

His power is greatly increased, and this concerns the fate of all the races in Universe Ocean. Before Milky Way Horde Leader’s miniature universe is formed… no one is allowed to bother him!”

A voice was heard from the floor. “The Sector Beast?”

Primal Chaos City Leader responded flatly, “As for the Sector Beast at Shock Devil God’s miniature universe… we shall let the respective true god troops settle the problem.”

Instantly, no one had any different opinions to raise. After all, everyone present was from the primal universe. If the Sector Beast had the intention to devour any miniature universes, it would target those from the first and second reincarnation eras. Those from the primal universe were naturally not worried. The degree to which Luo Feng’s power increased had a direct impact on their fate; so undoubtedly, no one would wish to disturb and affect him.

Outside Luo Feng’s miniature universe.

Instantly, the primal universe sent out a great many universe masters and a handful of true gods to encircle and patrol the area surrounding Luo Feng’s miniature universe. This was to prohibit any great beings from the first reincarnation era and second reincarnation era from attacking Luo Feng’s miniature universe, which would disrupt Luo Feng.

“Everyone, take your leave.”

“The increase in Milky Way Horde Leader’s power directly affects the fate of every race within Universe Ocean. No one is allowed to disturb him.”

“Leave.”

In the face of the more powerful races of the primal universe, those from the first and second reincarnation eras naturally would not dare to raise any objections.

Time passed, day after day. This time around, the Sector Beast maintained a continuous record of devouring. It was unlike before when it merely ate for a day and disappeared afterward.

When the origin of Shock Devil God’s miniature universe was almost devoured by half, a troop of 12 true gods showed up. The moment this troop of true gods appeared, Morosa immediately executed the technique of disassembling his body and made a speedy escape.

Merely half a day after the escape, Morosa showed up outside another miniature universe and started devouring again.

One miniature universe, two miniature universes, three miniature universes… six miniature universes!

Morosa had no intentions of battling any of them. Every time it encountered a troop of true gods, it took off immediately. Even though it was only a second stage Sector Beast now, if it wanted to escape, there was no one—other than Luo Feng and Nine Remoteness True Master—who could have stopped it from escaping.

“Primal Chaos City Leader, this is already the sixth miniature universe. In just one short month. If we condone all of its devouring, the origins of our miniature universes will eventually be greatly weakened. Even if we do manage to evade the Sector Beast crisis, given how weak our miniature universes have become, we will not be able to further rise up to the level of true gods of void space.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader should be doing fine, we hope.”

“If this goes on, those of us from the first and second reincarnation eras will find ourselves in a hopeless situation.”

Several overlords, including Divine Eye True Master, Nine-Headed Demon Master, and Jue He True God were all communicating with Primal Chaos City Leader via their transmission tokens. Like Divine Eye True Master, they might have had strong powers, but if the Sector Beast was bent on escaping, none of them would be able to stop it.

“Enough,” Primal Chaos City Leader responded indifferently. “Everyone, remember. Not to mention devouring only part of your miniature universes, even if it were to finish off a few miniature universes, or to the extent of a few true gods being annihilated, bothering Luo Feng is absolutely not allowed! Anyone who dares do otherwise will be an enemy of us humans!”

The moment he set the ultimatum, the numerous true gods from the first and second reincarnation eras were instantly left with no choice but to hold their peace.

Luo Feng was completely oblivious to the chaos within Universe Ocean. In his miniature universe, Luo Feng was working on the evolution of chaos.

The lofty Law of Chaos was starting to undergo a gradual transformation. It was transforming into the ten major basic laws, including time, space, gold, wood, water, fire, earth, thunder, light, and wind. Throughout the process of change, there were also various fusion laws involved—for instance, Golden Space Law, and Time and Wind Law. However, these fusion laws were all concealed within the law of operation of the origin of the miniature universe the moment they appeared.

The law of operation of the origin of the miniature universe was based on the ten major laws. The law of operation of the origin of the miniature universe would conceal every complex law.

Only the Law of Chaos was exempt because all of these were possible because of the evolution of the supreme Law of Chaos.

“The evolution of chaos can only be witnessed once in a lifetime. That is when one becomes a true god. There will be no such opportunity in the future.”

Luo Feng could not afford to be a tad inattentive because, in the future, the exaltation of his miniature universe would only be in numerous transitive increases. The Law of Chaos would no longer be visible at all!

Being able to control the chaos, in the eyes of the ancient civilization, would make one worthy of being called a saint!

Hua! Hua! Hua!

The law was constantly changing. Starting out from the Law of Chaos alone to the point where all the other laws (with the exception of the Law of Chaos) were mixed together, Luo Feng carried out the transformation of the law of his universe origin. This transformation process was none other than the internal evolution of Luo Feng’s universe. Naturally, Luo Feng felt overwhelmed. He had completely immersed himself in the process, and far away in the Universe Boat, by the black-striped stone pillar, the other body sustained by his godly power was also rapidly brooding and comprehending in an environment where time was accelerated by ten million times.

Luo Feng’s comprehension was skyrocketing at an unbelievable speed! The speed at which it was soaring was simply astonishing! When crossing the threshold from a universe master to a true god, the moment the fastest increase in level attained could be seen was this very moment, when he managed to complete comprehending the evolution of chaos. Similar to how many true gods could spend just one to two reincarnation eras comprehending, the time they took was not comparable to this short period the evolution of chaos required.

Before they could become true gods, most universe masters would likely only be fifth-tier universe masters. Yet, upon becoming true gods, their level of secret techniques could quickly increase to the sixth tier as the top, or even up to the seventh or eighth tier!

Before the appearance of the World of Jin, before there had been the inheritance of the ancient civilization, the most powerful outburst of combat power possible was only at the ninth tier. This was true even for the deceased Huge Axe and Divine Eye True Master when relying on their supreme true treasures. This showed that, at that time, the secret techniques they had created were only at the level of the eighth tier as the top, which was already the top-tier standard of the true gods of Universe Ocean at that time. Those who almost reached the level of true gods would likely only be able to create secret techniques at the seventh tier.

As for Luo Feng, he was only a universe master! Yet he could compel himself into creating two sets of secret techniques that were at the eighth-tier level. How abundant a supply he must have accumulated! At the moment, it like an incomparably dry desert that was absorbing water like mad; during the process of “evolution of chaos,” all enlightenment gained via comprehension was rapidly being transformed, and the avatar sustained by his godly power was comprehending while memorizing everything as fast as it could.

The levels attained continued to soar, from the eighth tier as the top the to the ninth tier as the top. Luo Feng did not comprehend any secret technique intentionally, but at that moment, the level he had attained could allow him to create a secret technique at the tenth-tier level without much effort!

The only catch was that there was only one chance for the “evolution of chaos”! The moment it was lost, there would not be a second chance!

“Phew!” After a long while, Luo Feng finally let out a long sigh of relief.

One of his eyes indistinctly reflected an endless whirlpool that devoured and swallowed as though the destruction of the universe was its purpose, while the other eye reflected a dazzling, golden light as though the creation of the universe was its purpose. He shut his eyes, and the next time he blinked, all these bizarre sights vanished.

“Evolution of chaos. How very magical indeed,” Luo Feng mused. “What a pity it can only happen once! Everything is now in place. Evolution is completed, and the laws of operation of my universe are also established.”

Luo Feng took a single step and emerged from his universe origin to enter into the vast miniature universe.

The law of operation was established. And so, the endless chaotic airflow within his miniature universe started to transform into gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, lighting, light, space, time, and various other forms of energy. Within his miniature universe, there were also emerging continents and rivers—it was the birth of everything. This was the initial stage of evolution of the entire miniature universe after its birth, which could be considered to be in its primal state.

Even if this had been an evolution of the primal universe, it would also have to undergo the few mandatory stages of an entire cycle— namely, the stages of birth, reaching the primal state, flourishing with prosperity, entering the stage of decline, and finally, meeting destruction.

The time spent on an entire primal stage was so long that it needed to be counted in units of 100 million eras. It was just like the evolution of Teacher Origin’s primal universe; when Teacher Origin had provoked the willpower of the primal universe origin, the evolution of his primal universe had yet to be completed. This proved that the amount of time taken up by the primal stage of the evolution of a miniature universe was extremely lengthy.

“The law of operation has been established,” Luo Feng commented to himself. “Now everything is in place for any future evolution of the universe. It’s time to head back.”

With one stride, Luo Feng exited his own miniature universe.

Chapter 1445 - Patrol

Hua! Hua! Hua!

With him as the center, tens of millions of endless water pillars burst out and extended relentlessly, forming a vast ocean. All of a sudden, 32 of the 99 bodies were covered in the ocean immediately. Even though all those bodies tried to hit the ocean, they weren’t able to make their way out.

“Don’t you dare hurt my teacher!” Darkness True God raised his head and roared. At the same time, the cloak on his back was suddenly enlarged, transforming into endless darkness. It covered all 99 bodies like a dark universe.

“Don’t you dare hurt Teacher Origin!”

“Die!”

“Die!”

There were more than 30 true gods, and all of them were performing every skill they knew—either spiritual weapon binding skills or godly power sweeping from Darkness and Peng Gong. Those weaker true gods like Fire Dome and even the true gods from other races in the Hong Alliance all tried their best. They were doing everything in their power to save the most ancient leader of the human race.

“Gather!” The other 98 bodies of the Sector Beast that were fleeing all disappeared, and the only body left turned back to the original body. That move rendered everything that Darkness and Peng Gong did useless.

“Separate.”

Sector Beast separated into 99 pieces and tried to flee again.

It was fleeing at a rapid pace, but the binding power couldn’t be overcome. If there were already domain type binding valuables in place, any other domain type valuable would be useless over that. Meanwhile, the Sector Beast was incredibly sly and fast, and it finally made its way out of the army of human true gods.

“This is crazy. They’re acting like crazy.” Morosa was scared as it moved through space. “It’s only been a short while, but under that godly power consumption, one-third of my strength is gone. Fortunately, I decided to run immediately. Otherwise, I wouldn’t even have had a chance to get away. However, it’s not that easy for me to give up. The more intense you get, the more satisfied I am. I am even happy to die!”

Morosa’s eyes gleamed with madness.

Sou!

It teleported and rushed toward the primal universe again.

In the space outside the primal universe, Primal Chaos City Leader and other true gods he was leading were all furious. Primal Chaos City Leader gave an order: “Let’s stay here and guard the primal universe. After all, it is the more fragile one! If other miniature universes of ours are swallowed afterward, we can still make other plans.”

“Okay,” answered all the true gods from other races in the Hong Alliance.

“Let’s follow Primal Chaos City Leader.”

Primal Chaos City Leader nodded, but he was still worried. Although they were here, they had their godly power avatars in the primal universe, so they could easily connect to the virtual universe.

“No! The Sector Beast has started to swallow the primal universe again!”

“It’s still swallowing the universe?”

“How dare it come again!”

Everyone was shocked, but, at the same time, they also received the coordinates of the Sector Beast sent by Teacher Origin.

“Go.”

Everyone teleported and dashed toward the Sector Beast. A miniature universe had a diameter of 100 million light years. Usually, Sector Beasts were able to swallow them from several hundred million light years away, so even if Sector Beasts randomly chose a place several hundred million light years away from the miniature universe and began to absorb it, it would take the true gods a while to get there.

The Sector Beast swallowed the small universe from one spot for only ten seconds at a time, and then it would immediately teleport and flee to a more distant spot and swallow the miniature universe for another ten seconds. Primal Chaos City Leader and the other true gods were being made to look like fools.

“Separate now and separate into ten different teams,” Primal Chaos City Leader ordered. “That Sector Beast is obviously weaker than the one last time. Scatter into ten teams. Even though we can’t kill it, we can at least banish it.”

“Okay.”

“Okay.”

Immediately, they were divided into ten different teams, surrounding the primal universe in different locations. By doing so, the team closest would be able to get to the Sector Beast in several seconds once they located it, forcing it to flee… However, now that they were separated into ten teams, none of the teams would be able to kill or even severely injure the Sector Beast.

It was madness. Sector Beast Morosa had gone completely mad. It had no intention of fighting any true god, and once it ran into one, it would fly away, then come back and keep swallowing. It had its sights on the primal universe! It was only able to swallow it for one or two seconds at a time, but it was determined to destroy the Primal Universe.

A message arrived: “Where is the Sector Beast, Teacher?”

“Finally, you have come back, Luo Feng!” Primal Chaos City Leader was exhilarated, and he immediately sent a message to Luo Feng. “It’s at…”

Although he was one of the eight great overlords and it was easy for him to defeat a Sector Beast, it was almost impossible for him to kill one.

In the space surrounding the primal universe, Luo Feng, clothed in a white cape, stepped forward. After he confirmed the coordinates, he turned around with his eyes looking aloof. “That’s where it is.”

Sou!

Luo Feng took a step and teleported. He was able to teleport much farther than other true gods. Although the Sector Beast was also able to teleport farther than other true gods, it was still a shorter distance than Luo Feng.

“You’ve finally come,” said Morosa.

“Get in.”

Luo Feng reached out his hands, and a tower flew out of his palm. It was Star Tower.

Star Tower immediately flew to the sky, giving out endless gleaming light. There was an endless dark whirlpool at the base of the tower that covered an area of several square light years, extending toward the Sector Beast Morosa in the distance.

Before this whirlpool, Morosa felt incredibly weak; it wasn’t able to resist it in the slightest. It was immediately swallowed by the endless darkness at the base of Star Tower.

Chapter 1448 - Suppression

“Luo Feng is here.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader is dealing with that Sector Beast.”

“Teacher is here.”

The true gods scattering around the Primal Universe knew that Luo Feng had arrived, so they all gathered toward where the Sector Beast was staying immediately. All the beings teleported and arrived there, arriving at the outer area where the space was condensed. After all, the fighting area was completely sealed, so they couldn’t teleport in there.

“Look!”

Primal Chaos City Leader and Darkness True God all looked in the same direction. The giant Star Tower gave out endless gleaming light. It was like a lighthouse in the dark. The power let out from its base covered an area of several square light years, forming an endless, dark whirlpool. The endless, dark whirlpool immediately shrank. As for Sector Beast Morosa, it was being swallowed by the whirlpool.

“Impossible.” Morosa struggled to get out.

The power of that black whirlpool was too strong. Even if Morosa gathered all its power, it wasn’t able to resist it, let alone separate its body.

“Break!”

It kept yelling. There was bloody light all over its body. Its power surged as it struggled to get out of the dark whirlpool. However, no matter how it performed its bloody light technique, it wasn’t able to get away.

“How…? Last time—last time, even the combination of Star Tower and space and time binding weren’t able to trap me.” Morosa found it hard to believe. “I am now weaker, but how can Star Tower alone be able to capture me?”

Morosa couldn’t believe what was happening, but it was of no use.

Sou!

The ferocious and ugly Sector Beast Morosa was sucked into the abyss at the base of Star Tower. Everything went back to peace, and the dark whirlpool also disappeared. Star Tower, which was emitting a gleaming light, also flew back to the palm of Luo Feng.

When they saw that scene from a distance, Primal Chaos City Leader, Darkness True God, Peng Gong True God, Fire Dome, and the others were all amazed. They knew exactly how difficult it was to deal with the Sector Beast, especially after the Sector Beast performed the blood light skill… Even Primal Chaos City Leader wasn’t able to trap it.

“Incredible.”

“He suppressed that Sector Beast so easily.”

“Milky Way Horde Leader is much more powerful than before. He’s definitely the most powerful true god Universe Ocean has ever seen.”

Thoughts flooded the true gods’ minds. Little did they know the powerful true gods in Universe Ocean, like Divine Eye True Master, were only able to create techniques at top-tier level nine. And with supreme true treasures, they were able to attain techniques at top-tier level ten. However, when Luo Feng was comprehending the evolution of chaos, he was able to create top-tier level ten techniques, and when he was patrolling against the Sector Beasts, he absorbed the comprehension he had during that time aside from exploiting the potential his body had, so his power had reached a new peak.

“Star Tower, given to me by Teacher Sitting Mountain Guest, is indeed incredible!” exclaimed Luo Feng as he took a look at Star Tower in his hand.

Star Tower might have been even more precious than Wu Qi God. He just hadn’t figured out how valuable it actually was.

“Luo Feng.”

“Milky Way.”

“Teacher.”

Everyone flew toward Luo Feng. They all looked relaxed.

Primal Chaos City Leader was smiling. “Haha! After becoming a true god, your power has been greatly improved. I’ve tried everything in my power against that Sector Beast, yet I still failed to capture and kill him. However, you captured it easily.”

“It’s more difficult to kill a Sector Beast than to defeat one,” said Luo Feng.

“It’s harder to capture one alive,” added Darkness True God.

All the true gods were talking calmly. Everyone was laughing. Apparently, Luo Feng capturing the Sector Beast alive had left everyone in a fantastic mood. They could also infer just how exceptional Luo Feng was now that he had become a true god. After all, Luo Feng had only displayed a fraction of his power in that battle.

“Let’s go back,” said Primal Chaos City Leader.

“You guys can go first. I’ll trap this Sector Beast in Star Tower,” said Luo Feng. “I’m going to question it to get some information.”

“The issue about Sector Beasts is very important.” All the other true gods nodded.

The true gods from the human race left one by one while Luo Feng went back to his miniature universe in Star Tower. After all, he was able to utilize his maximum power with his origin inside his miniature universe.

Inside the tower, in one of the suppression spaces, the ferocious and ugly Sector Beast Morosa stood on the ground. There was an invisible yet powerful force suppressing it. It appeared to be at peace as it waited there in silence.

“Sector Beast,” a white-caped being said as it showed up. He was stepping on the space, and he landed on the ground afterward.

“Milky Way Horde Leader…” Morosa glared at Luo Feng. “Luo Feng!”

“Sector Beast, you—” said Luo Feng.

“Call me Morosa!” Morosa raised both its heads. “You’re qualified to call me by my name.”

Luo Feng smirked. “Okay, Morosa.”

Morosa nodded. “Out of all the great beings in Universe Ocean, you’re the only one I admire! You’re indeed powerful beyond imagination. Even if I were still at level three, I still would have been swallowed by this Star Tower of yours.”

Luo Feng raised his eyebrows. He knew about Star Tower?

Of course. Some true gods had turned to Morosa, so it shouldn’t have been a surprise that Morosa knew about Star Tower.

“Unfortunately, you’ve come back much too soon.” Morosa shook its head. “I assumed that you were still guarding one of the miniature universes of a true god from the first or second universe era, and that it would take you several days to come back. I tried to swallow the origin of the primal universe. Without a guard for the willpower of that Teacher Origin, I would have been able to swallow half of the origin in several days, even if all the human true gods had tried to stop me. And then this Teacher Origin of your human race would never have stood a chance to make a breakthrough. But I didn’t expect you to come back this soon.”

Luo Feng nodded. Morosa’s plan was sensible. By swallowing the primal universe several seconds at a time, it would be able to absorb over half of the origin of the primal universe! However, Morosa hadn’t expected Luo Feng to be able to teleport as far as a true god of void space, which was why he had arrived after only an hour. Morosa hadn’t even been able to swallow 10 percent of the origin of the primal universe!

“I’ll be thrilled if I can avenge myself, but I don’t care if I fail.” Morosa gazed at Luo Feng. “I’m only a Sector Beast at level two. A true catastrophe is coming for you, the human race, and all the others. Hahaha…”

With insane, ear-piercing laughter, Morosa suddenly attempted to self-destruct.

Weng! Weng! Weng!

All of a sudden, three levels of power arrived at Morosa. The first level of power was “single thought void space” from Shi Wu Wing. The second level of power was the suppression from the sealing space from Star Tower. And the third level came from the power of the origin of Luo Feng’s miniature universe.

All three levels of power were suppressing Morosa so that it wasn’t even able to self-destruct.

“What…?” Morosa stared at Luo Feng.

Luo Feng smirked. When an undying fighter met a universe knight, he wouldn’t be able to self-destruct! That was due to the absolute power gap. And now, Morosa, who was only at pinnacle level two, wasn’t able to self-destruct before Luo Feng, either.

“You’re indeed much more powerful than before if you can even stop me from self-destructing.” Morosa was enraged.

If Luo Feng had been using godly power, Morosa would have tried to neutralize it. However, of the powers that Luo Feng was using now —”single thought void space,” the sealing space of Star Tower, and the origin—none utilized godly power, so Morosa couldn’t even fight it.

“You’re not going to die now,” said Luo Feng.

Truthfully, it was difficult to suppress someone so that they couldn’t self-destruct. If Luo Feng had remained outside without the origin of the miniature universe and the sealing space of Star Tower, he wouldn’t have been able to do that.

Star Tower was a mysterious valuable. Aside from the attack techniques, its major function was suppression! If someone was trapped in Star Tower, it would be difficult for them to die! This made Luo Feng doubt where Star Tower was actually from. He no longer believed that Sitting Mountain Guest had created Star Tower himself and that a trace of golden light had flown into the valuable and changed it qualitatively.

There was no way it was a coincidence. There was no way that a trace of golden light flying in could have sculpted such advanced techniques on it. Even Luo Feng wasn’t able to figure out some of the engravings on Star Tower. And based on the connection between Sitting Mountain Guest and the World of Jin, Luo Feng believed that Star Tower might have belonged to a supreme being from Jin Country—a valuable perhaps left by His Majesty the Godly King of Jin or one of his supreme beings.

“It’s no use. I can’t blow myself up.” Morosa smirked. “Do you really think that trapping me means the ultimate king of Sector Beasts won’t be born?”

Luo Feng smiled. “That’s exactly what I mean to accomplish.”

According to the original mind, the Sector Beasts would try to kill and swallow each other until only one was left. The final one would be the king of Sector Beasts. If Luo Feng suppressed and trapped a Sector Beast so that the others weren’t able to kill it—even if all the other Sector Beasts swallowed each other and a final one survived that was so powerful even Luo Feng couldn’t rival it—no Sector Beast wouldn’t be able to kill Morosa. Then there wouldn’t be any king of the Sector Beasts.

And if there wasn’t a king of the Sector Beasts, there would be a chance to turn things around.

“You’re wrong,” said Morosa. “Even if I can’t self-destruct, I’ll have to fight the final Sector Beast. Otherwise, I’ll die. This is our fate, and you won’t be able to do anything about it.”

Morosa had to do battle? It seemed that it wasn’t a coincidence that the ultimate king was always born.

“You look so confident,” said Luo Feng. “Are you really that powerful?”

“Of course,” said Morosa. “It’s so easy for us to annihilate all the races in Universe Ocean. Even the original universe will have to destroy itself.”

“But I can tell from you that Sector Beasts are very weak,” said Luo Feng.

Morosa glanced at Luo Feng. “If you want to tempt me to tell you about Sector Beasts, don’t try to disguise it. Just ask me.”

“Okay.” Luo Feng nodded. “Tell me, how many Sector Beasts are there in the Sector Beast hive, and how powerful are they?”

“Do you really think I’ll tell you?” Morosa’s eyes were glaring at Luo Feng. “I can’t believe you’re this stupid.”

Luo Feng frowned.

“You’re such a moron.” Morosa raised his head and guffawed. “You want to kill me? Are you angry? Want to kill me? Come at me!”

“Not cooperating?” Luo Feng shook his head. “If I can make you my slave, you’ll have to follow me.”

Luo Feng pointed, and a beam of triangular light flew out of his finger, flying toward Morosa. Morosa wanted to dodge it, but he wasn’t able to. The triangular light sank into his chest.

Chapter 1449 - Enslave

Luo Feng had captured Morosa alive this time so that other Sector Beasts wouldn’t be able to kill him. By doing so, he hoped that the ultimate king of Sector Beasts would never be born. Then they would stand a chance of surviving the catastrophe of Sector Beasts this time. However, according to Morosa, it was not going to work, so Luo Feng thought of a different way. He had decided to enslave Morosa.

As long as Morosa became his soul slave, Morosa would trust Luo Feng completely from the bottom of its soul. It would even be willing to die for Luo Feng, and it would tell Luo Feng everything it knew.

Once I enslave it, I might be able to cultivate Morosa into the ultimate king, Luo Feng thought. Perhaps it’s almost impossible to do it, but if it becomes my slave, it’ll devote its entire heart to me. It will tell me everything about the hive of the Sector Beasts. It’ll also tell me the strengths and weaknesses of Sector Beasts. I can only defeat the Sector Beasts after I know all about them.

No matter what, enslaving a Sector Beast would give Luo Feng a much better chance of winning.

Chi!

After the trace of triangular light was absorbed by the body of Morosa, it said something in a mild voice, and then Luo Feng wasn’t able to sense it anymore.

“I failed?” Luo Feng frowned.

“Hahaha…” Both of the two heads of Morosa were guffawing, and it looked scornful. “Milky Way Horde Leader, you’re too arrogant. Do you really think you can enslave me? I am a majestic creature birthed by Universe Ocean, and I am a destructive being—the opposite to the original universe. Do you really think you can enslave me?”

Luo Feng said coldly, “To be accurate, the ultimate king out of the one billion Sector Beasts represents destruction and stands against the original universe. As for you? You’re not qualified to do so.”

Morosa stared at Luo Feng with his two singular eyes and smiled wickedly. “That’s right. I’m not there yet. However, you’re only a creature born in the original universe. Do you really think you can enslave me?”

“Just sit and watch,” said Luo Feng indifferently.

Luo Feng flicked his fingers, and suddenly, traces of invisible threads gathered in front of him. The threads suddenly formed a strange picture. There was an ancient word made up of engravings on the picture.

“Enslave!”

The transparent picture broke the surrounding space and flew toward Morosa, penetrating its body.

Chi!

Morosa said something in a mild voice again, while Luo Feng lost his sense of the picture.

“Huh?” Luo Feng frowned.

“What now?” Morosa was exhilarated. “Show me everything you’ve got! Show me now! I’m a Sector Beast at the same level as you true gods. You’re only a true god yourself… Do you really think you can enslave me? Quick! Show me!”

Morosa was being suppressed by Luo Feng at the moment, so it reveled in upsetting Luo Feng.

“Humph!”

Hua!

Two traces of blurry, golden light shot out of Luo Feng’s eyes, and the two light pillars intertwined. All of a sudden, countless traces of golden light wound around each other, forming a gigantic network of golden threads. It covered Morosa and penetrated its body, but then, it vanished.

“How?” Luo Feng said. He heard Morosa’s jeering, but he didn’t care, as Morosa was only a suppressed Sector Beast. “The skills I performed are all the top-tier enslaving skills from Duan Dong River and the World of Jin.” Luo Feng couldn’t believe it. “I didn’t even feel its resistance before the skills I performed dissipated.”

Normally, those facing enslavement would fight against it. One party was trying to enslave the other, while the other party attempted to resist it. If one was too weak to resist, it would be enslaved.

However, Luo Feng didn’t even sense resistance when performing his top-tier enslaving skills. They all vanished once they entered the body of Morosa.

“And I didn’t feel any power consumption.” Luo Feng was confused.

Godly power and the power of the Sector Beasts would consume each other. However, that wasn’t the case for blurry godly power. Many true gods were able to perform soul attacks, and those attacks could penetrate the bodies of Sector Beasts and damage their souls. However, the blurry godly power he used vanished without even being resisted by the Sector Beast.

Does that mean that since it represents destruction, I’m not qualified to enslave it? Luo Feng shook his head. He wasn’t willing to give up like this. I might need to use the power of Sector Beasts.

Luo Feng pondered the issue.

Morosa was exhilarated. It was sneering and ridiculing Luo Feng. “Do you really think you can enslave me? Hahaha…! Come! Let’s see what you can do…” But then Morosa’s demeanor changed. “How?”

Morosa stared at the white-caped man in front of him, dazed. Luo Feng’s forces and power were quickly changing. Soon, Luo Feng became dark, emitting wicked forces—as if he were a Sector Beast. The only difference was that Sector Beasts had two heads while Luo Feng only had one. He didn’t want to change his shape as well.

“How can you become…?” Morosa shook his head. “It must be fake. You’re only simulating my look. The power you use isn’t the power of Sector Beasts. I can say that for sure.”

Ordinary Sector Beasts were also able to turn into true gods and produce godly power forces. However, those were all fake, as they weren’t actual godly power.

“Oh?”

Luo Feng pointed, and the threads immediately gathered in the sky, soon forming a new picture. There was an ancient word, “Enslave,” on the picture; the difference was in the power that constituted the picture. The power used this time was the peak of the power of a Sector Beast.

The picture flew toward Morosa, who grew anxious for the first time. The picture penetrated its chest.

Chi!

The image immediately went into its chest.

“Sector?”

Luo Feng raised his eyebrows. He was able to sense the sector inside Morosa’s body through the picture. He had performed all sorts of skills, but they had all vanished each time they touched the sector. He hadn’t even been able to sense it. But this time, it penetrated the body, even after touching the sector.

“No wonder nothing worked before,” whispered Luo Feng. “There’s a sector inside the Sector Beast body that resists all other forms of power.”

The soul of Morosa was hidden in its sector, the most important part of its body.

Hou!

Its soul was roaring as it tried to resist it. The picture emitted endless traces of light and tried to suppress it. It tried to attach itself to the soul, attempting to merge with the soul.

Hou!

Its soul was trying everything, and the sector was empowering the soul. For a long time, it was a stalemate.

Peng!

The picture disappeared. Luo Feng had failed again.

Morosa looked at Luo Feng. It couldn’t believe what had just happened. It hadn’t expected a great being born in Universe Ocean —whom it viewed only as food—would be able to use the power of Sector Beasts! Even though Luo Feng was powerful, Morosa only viewed him as a more powerful meal. However, it doubted itself now. This weak meal was able to use the power of Sector Beasts, yet he hadn’t turned into a Sector Beast! If he had, Morosa wouldn’t have been able to resist it.

Without turning into a Sector Beast and without being bestowed with their power, Luo Feng had still been able to perform the power of Sector Beasts on his own.

“Impressive,” said Morosa. “You’re more powerful than I thought, but so what? Ever since Sector Beasts were born, we have had magnificent willpower.” Morosa stared at Luo Feng. “Our souls are almost perfect. Do you really think you can enslave me? Impossible! Even if you have the power of a Sector Beast, you wouldn’t be able to enslave me.”

Luo Feng smiled. He didn’t care about how Morosa reacted. Although he had failed again, he understood that there was a chance that he could succeed in enslaving a Sector Beast by using the power of a Sector Beast.

That only means my soul enslaving skills aren’t good enough yet, Luo Feng thought. I need to learn better enslaving skills.

And then, Luo Feng sat down with his legs crossed. He sat on the ground, facing Sector Beast Morosa in the distance.

“Single thought void space,” suppression from the sealing space, and the origin of the small universe—all three combined were repressing every inch of the power inside Morosa so that it wasn’t able to self-destruct at all.

“Come, come you…” Morosa was swearing and taunting.

However, Luo Feng pretended that nothing was happening. He didn’t care about it. Instead, most of his mind was on the godly power avatar under the black-striped stone pillar. The godly power avatar was studying the soul enslaving technique in a place where time traveled ten million times faster. He started to learn something more complicated.

He had improved a lot after comprehending the evolution of chaos when his miniature universe was born. However, after a year as a true god, Luo Feng had exploited the potential of his body and understood the “Invisible and Formless” ability. He tried to integrate his comprehension after his power peaked. Also, he had focused his energy on some fighting techniques of Star Tower and Wu Qi God. Meanwhile, he had never studied the technique to enslave souls, and prior to this war, Luo Feng had never even thought of enslaving Sector Beasts.

The more solid his foundation was, the more advanced enslaving techniques he could learn.

This time, Luo Feng was studying an enslaving technique he had obtained from the World of Jin. This enslaving technique had been created by a holy being under His Majesty the Godly King from Jin Country when it still existed. Its name was “Three Stars Sector.” It was arguably the best soul enslaving technique in the World of Jin. Even the enslaving techniques created by the Godly King of Jin couldn’t compare to that technique.

Everyone had their own strengths. When it came to enslaving, that supreme being from Jin Country was the most powerful. Three Stars Sector was an enslaving technique utilized through illusion. There were different enslaving techniques, including enslaving by strength and enslaving by illusions. As for enslaving by illusion, this was done by trapping enemies in illusions without letting them realize it, and then the enemies would become slaves.

Time passed. The technique was intricate, and soon, more than one year had passed.

“Luo Feng? Where is he?” Primal Chaos City Leader asked. He couldn’t wait any longer.

Luo Feng had captured the Sector Beast alive because he’d wanted to question it. He had asked Primal Chaos City Leader and the others to leave first, saying he would come back soon. But now, one year passed, yet Luo Feng still wasn’t back.

Inside the miniature universe, Star Tower was floating.

Inside a suppression area in Star Tower, the Sector Beast faced Luo Feng. It kept taunting, laughing, swearing, and provoking, but Luo Feng simply pretended it didn’t exist.

“I’ll be back soon, teacher.” Luo Feng said via message. He had finally learned the first volume of “Three Stars Sector.”

“You…” Morosa was shocked, as Luo Feng, who had been sitting for more than a year, suddenly stood up.

Luo Feng stared at Morosa. “Let’s see whether or not you can still resist it.”

Chapter 1450 - Common

Enemy

“Just come at me!” Morosa looked fierce, but it was actually afraid. However, it couldn’t even dodge while beneath the three levels of suppression.

Luo Feng pointed, and a crystal in the shape of a drop of water flew out of his fingers. There were engravings on the drop of water.

Sou!

The drop of water went into one of the bloody eyes of Morosa. Morosa blinked both of his eyes, and then it stood there still. It wasn’t moving at all…

“I’m the ultimate king, Beddy! I am the ultimate one! Hahaha!” Morosa stood beside a broken body. It raised its head and guffawed. It bowed its head and devoured again, “I’ll eat you after all. If I can eat you, I’ll be the ultimate king, and then I’ll go kill the human, Milky Way Horde Leader. I’ll be truly invincible. That pathetic Milky Way Horde Leader… He really looks down on me. I’ll make him regret it.”

Morosa was insolent.

Luo Feng stared at Morosa, who was still standing there without moving. Suddenly, a strange imprint of three drops showed up on its chest. Then the imprint disappeared.

“It’s done.” Luo Feng saw the waterdrop imprint show up on the chest of the Sector Beast. He could sense the soul of Morosa very soon, and he was overjoyed.

Morosa blinked its eyes, dazed. It whispered, “I—I am the ultimate king…”

“It’s time to wake up!” said Luo Feng.

“I should—I should get away from you,” said Morosa. “You fought so many Sector Beasts and left the hive in chaos. I’ve been struggling to climb up from rock bottom, getting stronger. I even ate Beddy. I’ll be the ultimate king. How…?”

Luo Feng yelled, “Morosa!”

Morosa was dazed, and the absolute veneration from the bottom of its soul made it bow. “Master,” it said.

Luo Feng smiled.

“Master, what kind of enslaving technique is that?” asked Morosa. “I didn’t even realize what was happening, but I was just enslaved like that.” Even though it was enslaved, it still had perfect memories of before, so it still remembered everything that had happened. However, from this moment on, Luo Feng would be the one it completely obeyed and admired.

“It’s called ‘Three Stars Sector,’ created by a supreme being called ‘Gold,’” said Luo Feng.

“Gold?” Morosa whispered.

“Yes, Gold.” Luo Feng nodded.

Gold was the holy one who had been the best at enslavement under Godly King of Jin Country. Before Jin Country was destroyed, he had been the right-hand man of the Godly King of Jin! His enslaved army was a mysterious but powerful force in Jin Country. Unfortunately, it had died just like Jin Country.

Hong!

Luo Feng’s miniature universe suddenly trembled, and a powerful force swept across it, as well as Luo Feng’s Star Tower.

“Huh?” Luo Feng raised his head, and so did Morosa, who was shocked.

“It’s the rules,” said Morosa.

Luo Feng nodded. A supreme force had just swept across the miniature universe, and it seemed to be an alarm—a warning of life and death.

“It’s not that easy to enslave Sector Beasts.”

Luo Feng took a look at the Sector Beast beside him and felt heavy-hearted. He understood that Sector Beasts represented destruction. He had enslaved a Sector Beast just now, which meant he might enslave the king of the Sector Beasts, who stood against the original universe and who represented the destruction of the origin! There had to be repercussions for enslaving a Sector Beast; the law wouldn’t simply let him succeed like that.

Sitting Mountain Guest sat on a fragment of a cabin that was flying outside Universe Boat. He suddenly opened his eyes, as he could feel the blurry ripple.

“Rules?” he said. “Last time, when my disciple made a breakthrough, the supreme law was triggered. Is that what just happened again?” Sitting Mountain Guest was a bit worried. “Has the king of Sector Beasts been born? Or has something else that affects the entire Universe Ocean happened again?”

Only something major could trigger the supreme laws.

Far in the distant Tilted Peak Sector, in the Land of Darkness, inside the core, within the endless darkness were many Sector Beasts. Some were fighting and eating. Some hid and tried to swallow power to improve themselves. Some were stalking their prey.

All the Sector Beasts were fighting to become the ultimate king. Even the weaker Sector Beasts were trying to survive, causing other Sector Beasts to die.

All of a sudden…

Hua!

Beddy, who was chasing a feeling Sector Beast, stopped. There was blood on the edge of its mouth. Both of its heads were looking in the same direction, and it whispered, “Morosa…”

“Morosa!” whispered a hideous Sector Beast clutching an axe, looking in the same direction.

Two Sector Beasts who were fighting also stopped. The ones hiding and recovering their power opened their eyes. The weak Sector Beasts that were just trying to survive also looked in the same direction.

“Morosa…”

“Morosa…”

All the Sector Beasts were dazed. They all stopped no matter what they were doing. All of them only had one thought in their minds: Morosa!

When the one billion Sector Beasts were born, they had been destined to fight and kill each other so that only one could live, which was why they could sense each other, and no matter how far they were from each other, they were able to send messages.

When Morosa was enslaved by Luo Feng, all the Sector Beasts sensed it at the same time. The life ripples of their comrade, “Morosa,” sharply changed. All the Sector Beasts immediately understood that Morosa had been enslaved!

No need for language! No need for messages! At this moment, all the living Sector Beasts sensed each other, and they could all confirm that Morosa, in the distance, had been enslaved. Morosa was no longer their comrade; instead, Morosa would be their true enemy.

Hou!

Beddy raised its head and yelled in a shrill voice.

Hou!

The Sector Beast carrying an axe did the same thing, and the voice was full of anger, hostility, and insanity.

Hou! Hou! Hou! Hou! Hou! Hou!

At that moment, all the Sector Beasts in the hive roared at once. They were furious. They were noble creatures, yet one of their brethren had been enslaved! It was a provocation to them that could not be tolerated. It was a disgrace! A disgrace to all the Sector Beasts! One that had to be washed away by death!

Not long ago, Morosa had sent a message to all the Sector Beasts—a message about Milky Way Horde Leader Luo Feng. Morosa had said that it was being suppressed by Milky Way Horde Leader and had warned them to beware of the Star Tower of Milky Way Horde Leader. In Universe Ocean, it was difficult for other true gods to kill Morosa, but it wasn’t impossible. However, when it came to enslaving, only Milky Way Horde Leader was able to do so. And besides, Morosa had been suppressed by Milky Way Horde Leader, which meant it must have been Milky Way Horde Leader who enslaved Morosa!

“Milky Way Horde Leader!”

“Milky Way Horde Leader!”

“Milky Way Horde Leader!”

At that moment, all the Sector Beasts were exasperated. They were all hostile toward that reckless Milky Way Horde Leader. At that moment, they had a common enemy!

It was rare for Sector Beasts to cooperate. They didn’t want to cooperate; they were born to fight and kill each other. However, when they were threatened or angered, they would collaborate. Apparently, Milky Way Horde Leader had enslaved Morosa. This incensed all the Sector Beasts in the hive.

Hou!

The shrill and insane yelling echoed through every inch of the hive of Sector Beasts.

Inside the suppression space of Star Tower, Luo Feng had already taken away the three levels of power used to suppress Morosa. Since it was enslaved, so it would completely obey Luo Feng.

“Master,” said Morosa with veneration.

“Tell me about the hive of Sector Beasts.” Luo Feng looked solemn. From the force of supreme laws, Luo Feng could tell that there would be dangers coming.

Morosa answered, “I need to tell you something, Master. I told every Sector Beast in the hive about you. I shared your information.”

“What information?” Luo Feng frowned.

Morosa immediately told Luo Feng what it had revealed to the Sector Beasts. Luo Feng was stunned.

“Please forgive me, Master,” said Morosa. “I was filled with hate for you, and I was sure that I was going to die, so I wanted you dead, too… I tried to reveal how powerful and terrific you are, to motivate all the Sector Beasts to fight each other harder. They might cooperate under a threat.”

Luo Feng said, “Keep talking.”

“Also, when I was suppressed in Star Tower, I sent a message to them. I told them I couldn’t fight back at all. I told them that I had been swallowed by Star Tower and was suppressed, and I couldn’t even self-destruct.”

“What?” Luo Feng clenched his fist. He was in trouble now.

He had told the others that he couldn’t self-destruct? Apparently, Morosa had been trying to warn the Sector Beasts in the hive of how terrific Luo Feng was, so that they would be well-prepared for a threat like him.

“Master,” said Morosa anxiously, “I just wanted to take revenge against you, which is why—”

“I know, and I don’t blame you.” Luo Feng shook his head. “Let me ask you, how many Sector Beasts are there in the hive of Sector Beasts? And how powerful are they now?”

This was the problem Luo Feng was most concerned about. He needed to know thoroughly about the Sector Beasts so that he could be better prepared.

Morosa started to tell him everything it knew. “At the start, one billion Sector Beasts were born in the hive, and all the Sector Beasts were at primal status, level one.”

Luo Feng listened carefully.

“Normally, for every 33 Sector Beasts born at level one, one Sector Beast is born at level two. And out of 33 level-two Sector Beasts, one level-three Sector Beast is born, so on and so forth,” said Morosa. “If there are more than 30 level-six Sector Beasts born, they’ll keep eating each other, and the one who survives in the end will be the ultimate king—the one with the power to destroy the origin. Once a king is born, Master, you won’t be able to stop it no matter how powerful you are. As for now, the most powerful Sector Beasts in the hive should be at level four. Of course, the number of Sector Beasts at level two is the greatest. There are almost ten million Sector Beasts in the hive now.”

Ten million?

Luo Feng had already determined the number before, but he was still scared by what Morosa had just said. There were around ten million Sector Beasts in the hive that were at least as powerful as this Sector Beast? No wonder the original mind was trying everything it could to stay alive.

Chapter 1451 - The Five

Techniques of Sector Beasts

Struck by a thought, Luo Feng speedily deduced and came to an understanding.

Out of 33 Sector Beasts, one higher-stage Sector Beast could be born.
